AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_1.review_title: Nice Presentation, Great Positive Message, Very Giftable
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_1.review_text: This gift set makes a great first impression. The box is black trimmed in gold. On the cover there is a gold outline of a compact mirror. I ordered this for my wife, and she is thrilled to have it so that she can be ready when shorts and swimsuit season arrives. Not having to shave every day will be an absolute blessing for her. This SmoothSkin Pure Fit Intelligent Ultrafast IPL Laser Hair removal device comes with the device itself, a power cord, an optional precision head for use on smaller areas, and a detailed instruction book. Since this device does not work if the skin is too dark or the hair is too light, it is important to check the online skin suitability chart before purchasing to make sure that this device will actually work for the user. My wife's skin and hair color fell within the effective range, so she was good to go when this arrived. Also, since this device can make the skin photosensitive during the course of treatment, winter is the best time to start the initial 12 week course of hair removal. For those who live in a place where there really isn't much of a winter, just be aware that skin needs to be protected from the sun during this treatment period. Since my wife is still in the early phases of this treatment and it's already mid-March, she'll be cutting it kind of close. Worse case scenario, though, she can at least get a month or so of treatments done and then resume and/or start her treatment over again when winter is back. This SmoothSkin device has two modes for treatments, Glide, which is just like it sounds and is a continuous firing as the device glides along the skin in a steady movement, or Stamp, which is a single controlled burst at a time, designed for areas where you want tighter control over when and where the light fires, such as on the upper lip. There are also three treatment intensities, Power, which is the highest setting and good for larger areas, Gentle, for sensitive areas (also recommended when first starting IPL and getting used to how it feels), and Speed, the fastest treatment mode, for quickly covering larger areas and for doing fast touch-ups. This sounds complicated, but after my wife began doing these treatments once a week, she found that it was actually fairly easy to do. Granted, she is just doing legs and underarms for now, which are fairly basic. My wife's initial opinion of this SmoothSkin Pure Fit IPL laser hair removal device is extremely positive. It's easy to learn, easy to do, can be done in the privacy of our own home and at a time that is convenient for her, and is far cheaper than having either IPL or laser hair removal treatments done in a shop. Not only that, but so far it's working.

I followed the instructions and added the product (actually two products) to a hot bath and hopped in.  Sat soaking for about 15 minutes with no relief.  Then I put a muslin washcloth over my face and started pouring hot bath water over it.  After about five minutes of deep breathing (in through the nose, out through the mouth) the nasal congestion started breaking up somewhat.  Didn't completely break up but got better.  Drained the tub (tons of sandy debris left) and took a hot shower to rinse the clay, etc, off.  That's when the congestion broke loose.  I was able to blow my nose and breath through my nose with very little to no congestion.  Unfortunately the relief didn't last all that long, probably about three hours.  At 36 bucks a pop, that's 12 dollars per hour for three hours relief.  Pass, I can buy a lot of nasal spray for $36.

AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_title: IMHO Not Fragrant and They're Tiny
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_text: The pictures of these "petal balls" on the web page are bigger than the actual balls.  I was kind of expecting the opposite.  I followed the directions and put one of the balls in a dish and poured boiling water over it.  It was kind of fun to watch it re-hydrate but that was about the end of the enjoyment.  The "fragrance" given off by these petal balls was akin to a weak tea although I surely wouldn't drink it.  As for putting one in a tub, I suspect the "bloom" would clog up the drain and just create a mess.  Plus I don't want to take a bath in a pot of tea.  I'll have to pass on this one.

I've got a bad back and regularly do Epsom salt soaks in very warm to hot water.  I usually pay about $5 for a bag of Epsom salt that's good for 4-5 baths.  That's about $1 per soak.  The Pursoma Digital Detox Bath Soak did about as much to relax me and relief pain as the Epsom salt and with the Epsom salt I don't have to shower to remove the "mud" and rinse out the mud/dirt from the tub after using it.  I suspect more of the relaxation comes from the hot water and length of time a person soaks as it does from any additive put in the water.  With the Epsom salt baths I can also add in a bath bomb for a couple bucks more and enjoy the aroma and moisturizing effects of the bomb.  I'll stick with my routine.

AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_title: Not Just a Name, The Shampoo and Conditioner Really Are Purple
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_text: I got this shampoo and conditioner for my wife--here is her review: I wanted this shampoo and conditioner because it said it worked really well for gray and white hair--as a senior I have plenty of both--and because it got good reviews re fragrance and how soft it left hair. When I was in the shower and squirted some shampoo into my hand, I was amazed to see that the shampoo really is a dark purple color. I asked myself if I could live with it if it actually turned my hair purple, decided I could, and lathered up. The shampoo did an excellent job of creating a strong lather, and my hair felt really clean when I rinsed it out. The shampoo has a soft floral fragrance that is very pleasant. I took a quick look in the mirror to see if my hair was purple, and it wasn't, so I then squirted out some conditioner into my hand. It was purple, too, although thicker and lighter in color than the shampoo. As I rubbed the conditioner into my hair, the wonderful floral scent of the conditioner filled my shower--what a delightful sensory treat! I checked my hair again when I got out of the shower and dried off--still no purple hair, thank goodness. However, when I squirted some shampoo into my hand to take a photo, there was a big purple stain on my hand when I washed the shampoo off. I squirted the conditioner in a different spot on my hand for that photo, and it did the same thing. I've washed my hands several times since then, and the purple stains are still there. So...even though the product information online says it works fine with gray and white hair, I look down at my purple stains on my hand and I have to wonder. Since I love the smell of this shampoo and conditioner and how incredibly soft it leaves my hair, I'm going to continue using it. If it turns my hair purple at some point in the future, I'll do an update and give everyone fair warning.

AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_title: Some Good, Mostly Bad, A Little Surprising
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_text:
The good: The scent - prior to mixing the powder with water, there is strong orange scent, which I like.
The bad: It's a powder that you have to mix prior to use. Directions say to mix it in a bowl or just mix it in your hand prior to use. Well, I went with "hand" option. The first time I got a thick paste that was pretty gritty, which I like, but it left my skin dried out but with a feeling that there was still some residue on it despite having rinsed quite well. Second attempt produced a thinner mixture which was again gritty enough but still left me with the same results.
The surprising: Although I didn't care for this product as a "facial scrub" it did have an interesting side effect: it lightened an age spot that's on me cheekbone area. After the first use I noticed it but didn't really attribute it to the scrub. After the second use if was more pronounced and I can't attribute it to anything other than the scrub. While some may consider the lightening of age spots a good thing, I don't. If I wanted to lighten anything I'd buy a product that claimed that ability. The fact that it had that effect kind of tells me I don't want to use the product anymore. Between the hassle of having to mix the scrub and the effects it had I'll not be using it again. Some products I order but don't end up liking I'll give to other family members but not this one. Not recommended.

I like a facial scrub that I can actually feel scrubbing and this Disco scrub meets that criteria.  In the attached photo you can see the grit contained in the scrub.  The directions say to use a amount equal to a penny and my experience says that's enough to do a good job of exfoliating facial skin.  The scent to me seemed like a burnt avocado, not particularly pleasant but I'm not using it for the scent and the scent rinses off.  I deducted one-star for the price which seems a bit steep to me.  My regular scrub costs significantly less and exfoliates as well if not a bit better.  Good to try, good as a gift but I probably wouldn't buy again.

AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_title: Smells Nice, Cleans Well, but Very Tiny Bar--Update
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_text: I ordered the Vitamin Papaya facial beauty bar. The online product information says the facial bars typically last 2-3 months with daily use. This is such a tiny, tiny little bar, I can't even remotely imagine it lasting as long as they claim. This little bar measures 2 1/4'" x 1 1/4" x 1/2". It weighs 1.3 oz. The soap comes with a facial sponge that is 2 5/16" in diameter. The soap lathers nicely and cleans my face well. The scent is very pleasant. I do not see myself reordering this little bitty bar of soap, however, when I can buy a full size natural, handmade bar online for the same price from quite a number of different sellers.***Update. I discovered the way to make the soap last as long as claimed is to apply it using the face sponge provided. It only takes a tiny swipe of the soap with the facial sponge to have enough lather to wash my whole face. After using a number of other facial cleaning products after I initially wrote this review, I switched back to this facial bar and realized that, using it with the facial sponge, it leaves my face feeling incredibly smooth and blemish free. I am happily upgrading this little bar to a 5 star. It may be small, but it does an amazing job!

AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_title: Impressively Sharp, Sturdy and Well Made
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_text: This pair of nail clippers definitely have some heft to them compared to regular store-bought clippers. They are solid stainless steel, and built to last. The same colorful design is on the back of each, but the curved blade clippers are a bit darker green than the diagonal blade clippers, making it easy to quickly grab the one I want out of the bathroom drawer or my shaving kit. Boy, are these clippers sharp! I usually use a curved blade for trimming both fingernails and toenails. Where the diagonal blade comes in handy for me is when I have to go after a hangnail. This blade allows me to remove the hangnail with surgical precision. Trying to do the same thing with other blades usually results in part of the hangnail still being left behind to cause me a great deal of pain and aggravation later. This is a fantastic set of fingernail clippers, and well worth the current price of $8.99.

AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_title: So Much More than Just an Air Freshener
AEC6IZVI2NGFBCIYVD4X5MDGB6DQ_2.review_text: I never in my life would have thought I'd consider an air freshener as a giftable item, except perhaps as a gag gift to one of my brothers. This Florona Hibiscus Air Freshener, however, is in a class all by itself. Even the box it comes in is beautiful, with soft sweeping white and beige brush strokes in the background and beautiful flowers embossed in gold. The pattern wraps all the way around the box, with each side being different. The inside of the box is a vivid lime green. The spray bottle for the air freshener looks more like a perfume bottle, light and dark pink with more of the gold embossing, this time with leaves instead of flowers. The key ingredients of this air freshener are water, hibiscus oil, and hydrogenated castor oil. The bottle contains 3.38 fl oz (100 ml). The directions say to wash linens and clothes before spraying this linen mist on them. It says this spray can be used on sheets, furniture fabric, drapes, pillows, and directly in the room as an air freshener. It also says to shake the bottle well before using it. When sprayed, the hibiscus scent is very subtle and faint, but definitely there. My wife had me spray some on the blouse she was wearing so that she could enjoy the hibiscus scent all day long, and she plans to spray her pillow before she goes to sleep. For a soft, gentle hibiscus aroma that stays pleasantly in the background without overwhelming my senses, this Florona Hibiscus Air Freshener works well.

AECJWYAOJ34RILHGK2CKU42UOVKA.review_text:
I love the look of this lamp. It almost looks like it came straight out of a salon from the 50s, but also manages to look very modern. It's relatively small and doesn't take up too much space among my other bathroom appliances beneath the sink. The plug isn't very long, maybe 4 feet, so wherever you do your nails you will need to be sitting near an outlet.

My daughter has sensitive skin, and when she stuck her hand under the lamp she said it bothered her hands a little because of the heat. I don't think the heat was too intense. I have a fresh burn on my finger that didn't feel bothered by the light so I'm attributing that to her being younger and more sensitive to heat, but I do think it's something to be aware of.

My fingernails weren't completely dry when I pulled them out, and I had to run them through twice as many cycles as the nail polish recommended, but honestly I think it was due more to the nail polish I used than it was a fault of the lamps (for reference, it was China Glaze brand Gelaze). The nail polish was really super runny and had a watery consistency with very thin coverage.

Two days later though (a record for two people who are hard on their nails) my daughter and I both have zero chips in our polish. I'm pretty happy to have received this and think it would make a great gift or be a good purchase for those who want to save a little money from getting a professional manicure.

Just one last note: I had to go to a beauty supply store to find a gel polish that needed a lamp. It seems like many gels these days advertise no lamp needed. Personally I feel like those aren't any better than regular polish, but it's something to consider.

These masks are awesome! They are easy to use. Just take them out of the package and carefully separate the loops for your ears.

It does take a few minutes to heat up. The heat stays at a comfortable temperature and does not burn. The smell is relaxing (lavender and a hint of menthol).

I just wish they stayed hot a little longer (they seem to last about 20-30 minutes and then the heat fades). You get ten masks in the box.

The packaging and design are all great but if you can’t use the gel I don’t see how it matters. Would not recommend.

AECLZPHQ72FZTCG2MWNAZIJXCRZQ.review_text: So I thought this will be nice for my 4c hair but  no. So I used it on my wigs and I didn't really like the results. Its definitely not for my hair type.

AECLZPHQ72FZTCG2MWNAZIJXCRZQ.review_title: Using it every day it's an excellent product
AECLZPHQ72FZTCG2MWNAZIJXCRZQ.review_text: I can't tell you how much this have been helping my little ones eczema that itches all day behind the legs..... once I rub it on the spot the skin is immediately hydrated, stop itching. The scaring and rough skin is also clearing. Am really happy using this product. And I will definitely buy more. I also it on my edges too and I have noticed growth.

AECLZPHQ72FZTCG2MWNAZIJXCRZQ.review_title: I really like this face moisturizer
AECLZPHQ72FZTCG2MWNAZIJXCRZQ.review_text: Exactly product I must say, I have dry skin and always In search of a light weight hydrating face moisturizer. And am glad I tried this, it's not sticky and very hydrating. Down side for me is, it's very pricey. But I definitely recommend It, would be nice to have some discount on.
Great moisturizer. It goes on light and doesn’t make my skin feel sticky, It absorbs quickly leaving my skin hydrated, it's also good for the summer
Cute colors my toddlers gets to pick the colors she wants when we get our hair done. It's has a good stretch, great for my baby's afro hair. Excellent price point

AECO2ZWV634CZOOCC7MQ23TC3GMQ.review_title: First time with a a Cleansing Oil
AECO2ZWV634CZOOCC7MQ23TC3GMQ.review_text:
To be honest, the first day I used it, I really didn't like it very much. I felt like it really dried my skin out, but after using it for a week, I think my skin has adjusted and I enjoy it. The sensation of cleansing with an oil is a little bit dfferent. You apply it to a dry face and then add water as you continue to massage and cleanse the skin.

It sounds strange, but the scent reminded me a bit of berry flavored children's cough medicine. Not entirely sure why, but it wasn't an unpleasant smell. The pump applicator made it easy to use. I can't say that it's my favorite cleanser, but it has definitely grown on me over the last few weeks.

When I first opened up this toiletry bag, I didn't think that it would hold very much, but I was pleasantly surprised. I was able to easily fit a travel sized shampoo, body wash, and hair products, a full-sized bottle of contact solution, some body spray, make-up remover wipes, deodorant, toothbrush, toothpaste, and some miscellaneous cosmetic items.

The bottom pocket is removable thanks to some velcro, so you could take it with you.

This cosmetics organizer is smaller than some others that I own, but it is definitely adequate for the basics. It zips up to a nice, compact size and kept all of my toiletries contained and organized on my last trip.

This shelf feels solid. It definitely has some weight to it, which is why I decided to mount it with wall anchors and screws rather than with the adhesive pads and random tubes of glue. I can't imagine what a nightmare it would be to try to get it off the wall if you used the sticker/glue option.

It fits my Dyson and accessories perfectly (although my cord doesn't look nearly as neat as the stock photo does. The attachments snap on magnetically and there's plenty of room at the top for hair products or a flat iron.

Assembly was easy. I only needed to drill the holes for the anchors, and then attach the shelf via the two screws.

I like that it keeps stuff off of my bathroom counter while still making everything easily accessible. The stainless steel has a modern look and clean lines.

AECO2ZWV634CZOOCC7MQ23TC3GMQ.review_title: My favorite type of deodorant applicator
AECO2ZWV634CZOOCC7MQ23TC3GMQ.review_text:
The forest scent is probably my favorite. It reminds me a little bit of Christmas time. This applicator is probably the best natural deodorant applicator I've ever tried. You squeeze the tube and product dispenses through some grooves at the top. You then swipe it in your underarm area to distribute it evenly.

I haven't had any issues with irritation to this point. I feel like it does a good job controlling odor in normal situations, but I feel like I was a little bit stinkier than I would have liked after a cardio workout.

There's a little bit of a learning curve with these magnetic lashes, but they're a bit more forgiving than adhesive lashes. You can remove them and reposition them (although you may need to reapply the magnetic liner). Most of the lashes needed to be trimmed just a bit in order to fit my eyes. They do pump up the drama when worn with a bold eye shadow.

This set includes three different color combos. The material is like a stretchy jersey. It allows for plenty of bow storage. I sometimes have to group a bundle of the cords together to make it thick enough to clasp some of the larger bows to. My daughter likes the colors and I like that it helps to keep her hair accessories organized and easily accessible.

I have naturally wavy/curly hair, so I've started sleeping in a satin bonnet to help keep my hair from getting frizzy in the morning. It's not overly tight or constrictive. I did find that if I toss or turn a lot at night, that it does sometimes fall off while I sleep. That being said, I found it to be way more comfortable to sleep in than tighter bonnets I've tried in the past.

AECOPBDL3PHOESNB2RXKPZSXGBOA.review_text: I make my own hydrogen peroxide based laundry stain remover, which is sensitive to light, so these bottles are perfect! The bottles themselves are nice, thick glass and come with a sprayer nozzle for each bottle as well as screw on caps and cute chalkboard labels. The sprayer nozzles feel a bit cheaply made to me, but they do work quite well. I would like to see the tops be made of nicer plastic, but for the price, I would recommend these.

AECOPBDL3PHOESNB2RXKPZSXGBOA.review_title: Only Works WIth Liquid Soap and Hand Sanitizers
AECOPBDL3PHOESNB2RXKPZSXGBOA.review_text: My 3 year old has a knack for making a huge mess out of our old soap dispenser. Tipping it over and spilling the soap, leaving globs of it all over the place, it was just pain messy. This dispenser is perfect for her, and everyone really! I was initially pretty frustrated the first time I tried to fill it with regular, thick gel hand soap because it wouldn't work. Then I went back and actually read the directions and found that this only dispenses LIQUID soap and hand sanitizer. It will not work with gels. If you want to use gel hand soap in it you will have to water it down until it's liquid. This dispenser is a sprayer, so it doesn't turn the soap into foam, and it doesn't work with gel soaps or sanitizers. If you're ok with only using liquid products then it works as advertised.

This is a nice set of glittery nail polish. I personally wouldn't wear this on it's own since it's quite sheer, but it's perfect for putting over a color. I ordered this set because my 3 year old LOVES all things sparkly, so it's perfect for kicking solid colors up a notch and making them fabulous enough for a preschooler. It took two coats to get enough sparkles for her taste. It's kind of tricky to get them even, which for makes my inner perfectionist feel a little crazy, but she's 3 and doesn't care. The sparkles are almost holographic so they are intensely sparkly. These nail colors arrive in a nice box with a foam cutout for each bottle. My only complaint about the packaging is that nowhere on the bottles does it say the name of or show the color. There are color dots included if you'd like to make your own color dot for each bottle, but I would much prefer that it arrive with the color on the bottle already so I don't have to. I don't understand why you wouldn't include the color on the bottle. Other than that I'm happy with these.

AECOPBDL3PHOESNB2RXKPZSXGBOA.review_title: Soooooo Much Better Than The Budget Option!
AECOPBDL3PHOESNB2RXKPZSXGBOA.review_text: I tried a more budget friendly at home laser hair removal device a while ago and was less than thrilled with the results, but decided to give it one more try with a better device. I'm glad I did! This is a significant improvement! I wanted to wait several weeks to write my review to see if there were results and after 6-7 weeks of use I'm definitely seeing a significant reduction in hair! The device is super easy to use and instead of having to manually select the correct level of power for your skin tone, the device analyzes your skin tone and makes the selection for you. It literally could not be easier. There's little to no irritation if you use it correctly. If I get lazy and try to use it with any sort of stubble, then it stings a bit. But if I shave prior to use then it's quite comfortable. It's absolutely worlds better than epilating for sure. But that's a different story for a different day. (Ouch.) The one thing that's a little tricky about using this device is that you're not supposed to overlap the rectangle of light, but there's really no way to see exactly where you're placing it because it's up against your skin. Other than that, this is a breeze to use. In the 6-7 weeks I've been using it I've seen probably a 40-50% reduction in hair growth and what is growing is lighter and more fine. I don't expect to be completely hair free even after the 12 week treatment program, but even a significant reduction in hair would be fantastic! Bring on the shorts and tank tops!

AECQQBG6YRYCOJL2NCB2H3V6LD6Q.review_text:
I have difficulty with serums as they tend to cause breakouts. Happily, this one did not. Maybe because there is almond oil in it, my skin does very well with that. I haven't noticed a reduction in wrinkles but this is gentle enough to use around my eyes. This makes my skin smoother for applying makeup in the morning and the serum isn't greasy at all.
I really like that this isn't tested on animals and I think the price is decent. Time will tell if this makes me look younger.

I'm disappointed. Mostly in myself as I should have read the ingredient list carefully. This is just a glycerin soap with chemicals and a negligent amount of honey and lots of heavy perfume. It's a bit drying for my face. I will probably finish this as a hand soap.
I'm going to continue to look for a better, more natural honey soap.

This is a small oil diffuser than others I have seen or used but it is very nice and looks better in person than in pictures. The light design is nice but too much for me when I’m sleeping. You have to turn off the whole thing to turn the lights off. You can turn on the diffuser without lights but once on I can only get them off by turning off the diffuser. It lasts almost through the night maybe 6 hours? I find taking off the ceramic cover easier than covers of other diffusers. I use this for just my bedroom so it is perfect. I did not come with a measuring cup for water, this is unusual but I had an extra so no big deal.

These bubble masks are so fun. I like the tingly way they feel while they get all foamy. My face feels super clean afterwords and brighter. It feels messy but it isn’t really, I didn’t get anything on my clothes. This is perfect for the end of a long week when your pores feel clogged. I don’t know if there is any long term benefits but I like them.

This is a very hydrating gel-cream moisturizer. It’s light and absorbs well.  It lasts all day, I think it is perfect for morning use under makeup. I like the green color too. It’s almost as good as Moisture Surge, better than the similar gel cream by Neutrogena. I’d definitely use this on an ongoing basis. Highly recommend!

AECQQBG6YRYCOJL2NCB2H3V6LD6Q.review_title: Works well, a bit too tingly
AECQQBG6YRYCOJL2NCB2H3V6LD6Q.review_text: I just recently started using the paper charcoal bubble masks but I do love peel off masks even more. I put on a medium layer of this and after a few minutes it starts to bubble. Unlike with the paper masks it was almost too tingly that made me want to just wash it off. But it went away after a few more minutes and then I just had to wait for it to dry. Maybe 20 minutes total. I like to leave peel off masks on longer to tighten my pores. It came of in just a couple pieces which was unusual, usually you have all these scraps left on. My skin looked and felt very fresh after.

I don’t know about you but I have been having dry hands from lots of hand sanitizer. And my poor cuticles. This hand cream is very rich and hydrating without leaving any greasy residue or taking forever to absorb. This is excellent quality hand cream and my hands are getting better. I only need to use it once or twice a day.
This is one of the better HA products that I’ve used. It’s great for keeping my skin hydrated all day and hiding fine lines. Can be used at night and in the morning under make up.

I love this mask almost as much as an avocado sheet mask I have. It really hydrates your skin and it is so soothing. I’ll be buying more of these for certain. I used this after a chemical peel that I use and it really took care of the usual redness I get.

This retina serum, more like a cream, is very gentle so if this isn’t something you normally use due to redness or sensitivity this might be a good product for you. Results will be much slower but you won’t have peeling skin or dryness. This is also hydrating so it’ss good mix of ingredients to make it perfect for sensitive skin. It works well but I’m not noticing any brightness to my skin.

Although I wish this body wash was more sudsy, it smells delightful, a nice burst of sunshine in winter. It is hydrating but not enough for dry winter, it’s probably going to be fine on summer months. The scent really is luscious!

I love this mask. It is very hydrating and the mask is thicker than most and clings very well.  The benefits last much longer than others I have used. This is by far one of my favorite masks and it’sa good deal for the price.

This isn’t the strongest vitamin c cream I’ve used but it is better than most serums. I seem to see better results with lotions like this. I’m not sure if the lemon adds anything, the aloe might be why I can use this daily without irritation. It is gentle enough for day use though you might want to use sunscreen with it.

Omg these are wonderful. I used to rub ice over my face in the morning years ago. This is much better. It’s nice to have 4 to keto cold but I have not had to use more than one at a time. They stay cold for with a while. When it feels like it isn’t cold, I roll it a little with my finger and then it’s fine. This is a fantastic tool to use in the morning especially if you have puffy eyes. I like using it before I put on make up. At night I will sometimes use it after I put my serums  and moisturizer on. It’s very relaxing.

I’ve never tried anything like this product before. You put it on, wait 5 minutes and then wash your face with it. Over time it really does make my skin look clearer and brighter. I don’t use this daily, just a couple times a week. It could be used daily though but it is kind of expensive.

I really like this line. I see improvements using the exfoliating scrub, the toning serum and my favorite is the hydra-whipped moisturizer. The scrub and the serum are also sold separately in full size bottles but the hydra-whipped is not and I'm so hoping it will be in the future. It absorbs without a trace of residue and the benefits are long lasting.
The only thing that did not wow me was the eye cream. It is pretty basic, offers some hydration.

Thin Bamboo Sheet Sap infused sheet facee masks with rice essence extract cream for intensive moisturizing for pore reduction for all skin types, product made in Korea
The Power of Rice, for Your Skin care : With an innovative delivery system, this Korean Rice Cream Topping facial mask sheet actively works to deliver the skin enhancing power of our proprietary hydrating Rice Extract Cream faster and deeper to restore suppleness and moisture.
This is a pretty neat idea for a mask. The mask is soaked in serum, you put this on and then you add the rice cream on top so it soaks into your skin after the serum does. It’s quite hydrating and soothing.

This is great eye cream, it hydrates and erases fine lines. It even gives a bit of a glow and looks great under makeup. The cream is thick and rich, one of the best I’ve ever used. And it will last a long time!

I love the smell of this and is is very hydrating. The only issue is that it is so thick that it is hard to squeeze it out from the bottle. You need 2 strong hands to get it out. This is definitely annoying.

This is a gentle and hydrating mask. Even though it has a retinol alternative, you can use it over a stronger serum. This is almost like a sleep mask, not all of it absorbs, it keeps a protective layer on your face while you sleep. It really hydrates so you look rested even if you aren’t.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Great, all day protection with a pleasantly subtle scent
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: Exactly as advertised.  Lasted all day with great odor and wetness protection.  I also appreciated that the scent was subtle enough not to compete with my cologne.  I'll be buying this again.

The color shift isn't quite as pronounced in person, but it's still super pretty. In good light, the pink color flashes copper. The wear time is good too. The picture is after three days of wear and it still looks excellent.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Super pricey, but much better than the budget-friendly alternatives
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: I've been in the market for a microneedling device for a while now, but I wasn't sure if I needed something super expensive or if I could get away with a more budget-friendly option. I decided to try two super inexpensive versions , both costing around $20 and see if this significantly more expensive option from GloPRO was really worth it. In short, yes. Both of the cheaper options were incredibly painful and flimsy feeling. One of them even felt kind of like getting a face tattoo. It was awful. The GloPRO option actually feels nice on the skin because of the vibration feature and the red light therapy is a huge benefit for those monthly breakouts. I do feel like my skin care is absorbing more effectively since I've been using this, but it's still an extremely expensive tool. If you really want a microneedling device, in my opinion this is worth the investment, however, I don't think it's a necessary item.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Kind of firm but good shapes
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: I'm not a complete beauty sponge snob and I've tried lots of different brands, both high-end and budget friendly, and I found sponges I liked at both price points. These sponges are definitely on the farmer side, so for that reason they aren't my favorite. They do expand when wet and I really do like the shape of the larger ones in this set--they are very similar to the Real Techniques sponges--but they're just not as soft and bouncy as some of the others that I prefer. If you're looking for a good drugstore-priced sponge I recommend the Loreal ones.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: It does pull and it doesn't get every hair.
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: I didn't have great success with his nose hair trimmer. First off it does pull despite claiming not to. It's not incredibly painful but every now and then it would snag and Pull and I did enjoy that. Also it didn't seem to do the best job getting all the hairs. I had one here that I was trying to get and I had to go over it several times and it just wouldn't seem to trim it. It's not super expensive so it's not a complete fail for me but I'm not going to be using this a lot unless I really need to. It also heats up relatively quickly.

I tried a few other products and they no poreblem line and overall I'm pretty impressed. It swipes on and does a decent job of minimizing pores. It's not as effective as my cover FX pore filling primer or my tarte pore filling primer but I do like the convenience of having this in a pen.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Beautiful Dyson style design and pretty impressive hair dryer too
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: They're quite a few of these hair dryers popping up that are designed to look like the ridiculously expensive Dyson. While I've never tried the Dyson, I was excited by the design and so I picked this one up. On the plus side it does have an extremely long cord so if you can't stand right directly next to you anymore you'll be fine but it is not a swivel cord so it's not as maneuverable as others. It's not a huge deal for me but just something to be aware of. I love the hat and cold functions which makes it really nice to set your hair at the end and seal in the style. If you've only ever used regular hair dryers you'll really appreciate this added feature. It's a pretty substantial hair dryer. If you're used to really inexpensive lightweight ones you'll notice the additional weight however it's not so heavy that your arm will get tired even if you have a ton of hair like I do. And I just have to go back to the overall style and design again because this hair dryer looks so sleek and cool. I get a kick out of using it every time I see it.

I'm not generally a huge fan of cream shadows but I wanted to give this one a try and I'm so happy I did. It is so glimmery and beautiful. My favorite way to wear this is just padded over a bear eyelid with some mascara and maybe a little bit of liner. It just adds a beautiful finished touch. It also looks really lovely tapped on top of eyeshadow. For that method I prefer my finger versus a brush. It's nice because it doesn't bunch up or overly crease. And I really like the airtight packaging as well.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Super comfortable, long wearing, and fades beautifully
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: This is so beautiful! I love the packaging and the color was really rich and a beautiful tone on my skin. Oftentimes reds can be too warm or too cool and this is just the right amount of warmth for me. It's very comfortable to wear and was nice and long wearing without being drying. and then I was really pleased with how beautifully it faded after a very long time. I'm excited to try different shades in this formula.

This is a better than average costume wig. The hair does have that typical slight plastic sheen but it's not nearly as noticeable as others I've seen especially blonde wigs. There's a good amount of hair here as well so it's not one of those wigs that gets wispy towards the ends. The part hairline could look a little better but if you fiddle with it you can make it look pretty good. All in all this is going to be a great wig for my Hocus Pocus costume.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Sturdy and great if you have a lot of hair
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: These are much larger in person than I was expecting but they're perfect if you have a lot of hair or long hair or you want to be able to clip a bun securely on your head. They feel like they are quite sturdy as well. I always break my clips and I think I'm going to have a hard time breaking these. I also appreciate the included hair ties!

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: Is this a curling wand for dolls? So tiny!
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: The product images for this curling wand are deeply misleading. It shows the curling iron on a model's hair and it looks like an average sized curling wand with three barrels. No, in person this thing is so tiny. It honestly looks like a curling iron for dolls. As you can see in my photo I'm using a pencil for scale. Each of these barrels is about a pencil and a half to two pencils big. Meaning that the type of curls you get are more like 1920s finger waves than anything you would probably want to wear today. It's just ridiculous.

This is exactly what I was looking for in a scalp scrubber. It has a fairly comfortable to hold handle which makes this easy to hang on to and not slip out of your hands even if you have super slippery shampoo. The bristles are firm enough but very flexible so they're quite comfortable on the scalp. I also love that you get so many colors here! I was able to gift several to my family and still have one for myself.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: This stuff looks great and it lasts forever on your eyebrows
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: I am shocked. I was kind of expecting this to be a mess but I was curious so I decided to try it. This works exceptionally well. I have tried some of these little three-pronged brow markers in the past and never been very impressed. These have enough stability to them that you really can flick and get straight little lines that look just like hairs. They are thin and you have actual control. This formula also lasts forever! I definitely have to use makeup remover to get it off, so it is for sure waterproof. I also like that this color isn't pulling red on me. So often browns do that but this is nice and dark and definitely neutral. The only complaint I have is that when I open these there was a little bit of ink that had leaked out around the applicator at the top so it looked a little messy, but I love the way this works so much I don't care One thing to note is that it's best to put this on before you use any other wax or gels to keep your brow hairs in place. This really doesn't work well on top of anything but dry plain skin.

AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_title: The right level of softness for me
AECTRGMRKOGAYIV3YXX73CQEQCSQ.review_text: This is a decent set of toothbrushes. As advertised the bristles are soft though not as soft as some of the bamboo toothbrushes I've tried. I actually prefer this level of softness. The handles are ergonomic and easy to hold and I appreciate that they come and assortment of colors so if several of you are using this at once in the same bathroom it's easy to tell whose is whose

I'm a big fan of the style of this brand and have been for years. There's something about the vintage aesthetic that they capture so perfectly that always draws me in. I wasn't sure what I would think about their actual lipsticks however because of the bullet style is so unusual, but I really love this. The formula is creamy but long-lasting and even leaves a little bit of a stain, and the color is just the perfect red in my opinion it's a slightly deeper red so it feels a little more sophisticated and a little more wearable than a brighter red. It also has a slight blue base to it which makes your teeth look a little wider. The packaging is absolutely lovely and I actually find that I really enjoy the style of the lipstick bullet. I still always wear a lip liner of course but the angle of this makes it really easy to fully coat your lips. I will absolutely be buying more lipsticks from this brand.

AECUSWY5W5OI6TI5U3K7RN65S3IQ.review_text: I got this as a gift because I was having so much trouble finding a good matte top coat. This stuff is amazing!! Best I've seen and at a really good price.

AEE4M36AZAKURLEYGV23TM3BE7OQ.review_text: This shampoo and conditioner set is very moisturizing, but doesn't leave your hair limp or greasy-looking.  It leaves my fine, shoulder-length hair bouncy and shiny.  The travel size is also very convenient.

AEEHSGIEOXLHDMNDUYGX4R4W5TZA.review_title: Exciting product for smooth and glowing skin
AEEHSGIEOXLHDMNDUYGX4R4W5TZA.review_text: I'm pretty happy about the LumaRx facial cleansing brush. It is designed very ergonomically and is very comfortable to hold during use. The tool is extremely lightweight and has a tapered design which makes it so comfortable to use. The instructions are to use it for a minute each morning and evening. It has illustrations which show you to spend 20 seconds on the right side and 20 seconds on the left side and 20 seconds on the T-zone. The tool will actually buzz gently when you should move to the next area. This is a great feature! It also comes with 3 brush heads; massage, sensitive and normal skin. I am using the sensitive for now and it is perfect for a gentle exfoliation. When I am finished with that minute, my skin just glows and feels so clean! Hopefully the heads do not need replaced quickly as I do not think they are yet available on Amazon or online. It also comes with a sleek charger that does not take up any room at all on the counter – this is important to me as I have a small bathroom. Also, the LumaRx comes with a very nice carrying case that will come in handy for an upcoming vacation.

I've heard of face cream made from snails (or their secretions) and was a bit hesitant to give it a try. This is from Korea so perhaps that's not so surprising, and has a nice citrus scent to it, is a nice thick cream (no SPF) that does a really good job moisturizing my skin. It absorbs quickly and gives it a nice, dewy look and does seem to provide some tightness to it.

Okay, I love eyeshadow palettes and probably have too many, and they range in price and brand. I definitely love the 'sunset/rose gold' palettes, and this reminds me of a Huda palette I have with similar shades. It's in a slim, cardboard palette without a mirror, but this is a lower price point for all the shades you get. The shadow itself is a creamy powder blend, and it suggests that you use your fingers for the metallic shades (I find a small crease blush works fine and tends to have less loose powder that way).

You have a nice mix of matte and metallic shades this way, with a lot of earth tones. Definitely a lot of copper and reds here, some golds and rose golds and pinks. Colors that will stand out but not all of them. These felt nice on the skin and blended well. Why the three stars?

I tried this with and without primer, and this kit definitely needs primer to last more than a couple of hours on my skin. Also? The mattes will last several hours, but not the metallics even with primer (as well as a setting spray on top). I love the metallic colors, but they just fade on me somehow - even if I layer them on top of the matte. I'm used to eyeshadow blending on me after a few hours, but never have I seen metallics melt away on me like this. That's not to mean it won't work better on other people.

AEEO4SJ4MMZH2GD3NY56GLGO3VEA.review_title: A tasty alternative to table salt...
AEEO4SJ4MMZH2GD3NY56GLGO3VEA.review_text: I like that this salt contains additional minerals and other nutrients I need. About ten years ago, I stopped using salt at the table. Because of a family history of hypertension, I wanted to start lowering my sodium intake, and just start a few healthier eating habits, in general. I used to sit at the table and sprinkle salt on my food before I'd even tasted it, and I just thought it was a terribly unhealthy habit and that it was time for a change. I'm not sure of all its health benefits of this pink Himalayan salt, or how significant they are, but I like the flavor. The kid in me loves the pretty pink color, and while I know, rationally, that it has no bearing on the flavor, I can't help but enjoy the way it looks in the shaker, with its grains of different shades. I tasted a bit upon opening the bag. To me, it doesn't have as strong a salty taste as regular table salt does, and it dissipates more rapidly on the tongue. In use with cooking, I also feel it's not as salty as my normal variety. It does a great job of allowing my other spices to do the work, and the seasoning blends I use can be better appreciated. I've also found that if I accidentally get a bit heavy-handed with this salt, it's more forgiving, since it's not as salty. Overall, I'm enjoying the way it looks and tastes, and my next experiment will be making my own body scrub. I was able to purchase this Himalayan pink salt at a discounted rate in exchange for my evaluation and unbiased review.

AEFDIVNWWBP2IEEPXCTIRWCIPWSA.review_text:
I have owned the Sonicare Flexcare sonic electric toothbrushes the last 3 years and they break about once a year. After this last time, i thought i would give Oral B a try to see how they hold up.

The toothbrush heads are very different. Sonicare uses a more oval shape that is smaller than a regular toothbrush(which i like because it can fit in your mouth easier) and Oral B uses a circular shape. I feel that the Oral B cleans your gums a bit better because it is more wide and can reach your gums, even when you're not trying to, just when you're normally brushing your teeth. The slimmer oval shape of the sonicares do not do this when you're doing a normal brushing. I feel as though this could be a plus or a con depending on the individual. some people have sensitive gums and may not like that you cannot control the Oral B to stay away from the gums, however it gets the job done all at once. Between the two, they both do a great job of getting your teeth feeling very clean, sonicare may do it very slightly better, but both are MUCH better than a regular toothbrush. I could never go back.

The vibrations of the sonicares are, i feel, more controlled. When i use the Oral B's i can feel the vibrating in my head and my vision gets a little weird while i'm brushing, the sonicares do not do this. This was the biggest issue for me when using the Oral B's. It's a bit annoying.

The brush heads are VERY expensive for the sonicares! I buy mine from costco, and i spend about $50 for 7 brush heads. For one person, thats not so bad, but when you have a family of four, thats $50+ every 6 months. So maintaining them is not cheap. Oral B is about $40 for 8. They're a little bit cheaper, not by too much, but enough to give you something to think about.

Overall i would say the Sonicares perform better, but often break. While the Oral B are cheaper, and last longer. If you are trying to decide between the two, i would look at how much you want to spend as the bottom line. They're both going to get your teeth exceptionally clean, and if you're going to have a metaphorical aneurism when your sonicare breaks, it might be a lesser disappoint to get a oral b. These Dreadlock Beads for Hair, Braids and Locs caught my eye. I actually wanted them for two reasons. One reason being that summer is coming and I wanted to do a slightly BOHO look with little braids without having rubber bands showing. I LOVE summer BOHO and silver filigree is just my style so these beads (which are actually more like cuffs) are perfect for me. The second reason I wanted these is that I am starting to make handmade dolls and these would be perfect for a little boho doll I am currently working through the design on. I found several good things about these little beads:

-they are lightweight so they won't weigh heavily on your hair and damage it
-they are easily opened so that you can slide your hair in and not have to 'thread' it through
-they are not large (only 8mm) or overly ornate so they add to your hair design rather than take away from it
-they can be used at the root of your hair, the middle of your hair or the end and are still comfortable to sleep on
-they come in a pack of 50 which is more than ample for your hair styles (although if you have very thick hair and are using two per braid or dread you may want to get more)
-they lock onto your hair or braid snugly

The only downside I had with these little cuffs was when I used the first one. It was my fault though as I closed it too quickly and a bit too hard, I flattened the poor little thing. Unfortunately once you flatten them they are near impossible to get round again. The next one was simpler. I had opened it gently, slid my hair through and placed my thumb and forefinger on either side of the opening and GENTLY pushed the ends back together and VOILA! perfectly round still! With each bead it got easier and easier until I didn't even think about it anymore. To get them over a rubber band simply slide your braid into the bead then slide it down over the rubber band rather than trying to open and close it enough to fit the rubber band. Also wrap the rubber band in such that it is the same length and the bead (or a little shorter) so that there is no 'belly' and it is hidden by the bead.

Overall I found these little beads to be just what I needed! I did get my first pack at a discount in exchange for a fair review and that is what I have done. I LOVE these little beads and am looking forward to getting more for myself and my creations.

Here's what I say:
I LOVE Halloween, I am dying to go on a Zombie walk and I love these gelatin cubes! I made a bite mark for my son several years ago and wanted to be able to do so without one of the cheap Halloween kits they sell. I was ecstatic when I saw these gelatin cubes and couldn't wait to get my hands on them. They were a little smaller than I had thought they were going to be but exactly as described. I am happy that these did not require any glue and that they could be used directly on the skin. Heating them up was so easy that I skipped directions and overheated them lol Whoops. I had to wait a little bit for them to cool down, thankfully I did not destroy them. I took another cube and placed it in my metal shot glass and put that in a hot bowl of water. After only a moment or two I was able to stir in the original gelatin as well with a popsicle stick and begin applying the gelatin to my forehead. I wanted to make a large 'chunk' of skin and knew it would take a bit of time and patience and wanted to make sure it was just the right size. I wear glasses because I haven't gotten a new pair of contacts, and I have REALLY bad eyesight so I started it on my forehead, making sure it was the right size and shape. Grammy® 18 Inch Long Straight Nature Full Head Clips In Human Hair Remy Hair Extensions Clip Extensions Human Hair Clip 7pcs ( #99J Red Wine Burgundy) ...

This is a review for Grammy 18" long straight nature full head clip ins. The hair extensions arrived as planned and they were attached to cardboard the length of the hair to keep safe. They were then wrapped in a plastic bag to cover hair. Upon opening the hair I did not smell any kind of smell to the hair. The hair is soft to the touch and was the right color that I had ordered. As with any extensions, you receive in the mail first thing you must do is use a hot iron and get the creases out from shipping. When combing through the hair there were no tangles or missing hair. I did have a little bit of shedding but that is to be expected and was not enough to have a second thought about. The hair straightened great with no problems. The hair is sewn onto a small comb metal clip and I did not see any loose clips.

The quantity: The hair is what I expected it to be. When I compared the two matching pieces together I did note that one has more hair than the matching piece. (You will see in pictures that I have included in this review). However, this was on the two smallest extensions and not any other piece so for me that is not a big deal because I usually do not use those pieces.

The quality: This is my second hair extension I have ever owned. The first one I bought I paid quite a bit of money for and the hair was not near as soft as this one from Grammy. The quality of this hair is what I expected it to be but with softer hair. I am very pleased with the quality.

In my opinion, if you have somewhat fuller hair than one package should give you the fullness you are seeking. With that being said, if your hair is really thin and you are seeking a full thick head of hair look than you might need to go with 2 packages. I would but then you run into how to clip all the pieces in your head. You must have hair to clip these on for them to stay in place.

How I manage to be able to keep the extensions in my head all day all night and even sleep in for 2 nights if I want is by starting with clean dry straighten hair. I then part my hair every spot that I will be clipping an extension to and I spray with a strong hair spray let dry and then I take a small man's comb and tease just at the base of my hair close to my scalp, that gives the clips something to hold them in tightly no matter what I am doing.

I hope that this review has helped in your buying decision. I have posted pictures that I hope will allow for you to see each piece and the clipping device. Thank you for reading and if you have any questions or comments please feel free to post. I have added 12 pictures and I hope this is helpful.

AEG4HM36PVDBVOJY752SHLLENIYQ.review_title: This is a nice kit for your spa night collection
AEG4HM36PVDBVOJY752SHLLENIYQ.review_text: This is a nice kit for your spa night collection. I did receive a discount to review this product.

AEG4HM36PVDBVOJY752SHLLENIYQ.review_title: I was using a last grower on my brows and ...
AEG4HM36PVDBVOJY752SHLLENIYQ.review_text: I was using a last grower on my brows and the application was hard and I didn't see much improvement with it. When I saw I could receive a discount on this as long as I left a review it was a no brainer. I have been using this at night and I have had some regrowth. Its not the products fault, but the growth is sparse so I think I will have several months of growing to do before I am a bushy eyebrow queen. Four stars because if you are experiencing thin brows due to age I don't believe this will help as it stimulates the follicles..and if they are gone they are not coming back.

AEG533WPF52J6XCYRKB4RI7KLF5A.review_text: Nice smooth texture and good payoff with finger swatch. Very nice girlish colour. No smell.

AEG533WPF52J6XCYRKB4RI7KLF5A.review_title: Very agressive peel off mask which took skin with it.

Lathers well.

This polish is so sheer and streaky.

AEG6H2SPZVYRZXCFR4EE2GZL7TOA.review_text: I purchased these rods right before christmas and I was so excited once I got them.  I rodded my hair, wrapped my hair in a scarf and slept on the rollers with no problem.  When I woke up I had some wonderful curls.  My curls lasted for over three days and the only reason im sure they didn't last longer is because I had to wash them out.  I didn't have to use a bunch of hair spray or any other products for that matter and I ended up with soft, bouncy curls.  LOOVVVEEEE IIIIITTTTT.

I love this hair.  Made a 3/4 wig.  This hair was great from the start.  It came packaged nicely, it was soft, no odors at all (I still co-washed it though).  It's true to length in fact I believe they may have given me an extra inch on one my bundles. There was no tangling or shedding during the initial handing of the hair, I didn't even lose any hair during the co-washing process.  I sealed my wefts so of course the hair won't be shedding now either :)  I really like the wefts on this hair.  I've purchased some virgin hair and the wefts were so thick it almost made my installation look lumpy but these wefts are perfect.  They are not too bulky, nor are they paper thin (like most beauty supply hair).  I am also using a closure(did the old fake scalp trick) so I only ended up using maybe 2 1/4 bundles but if you don't have a closure the three bundles should be more than enough to do a complete FULL sew in.  I also ended up flat ironing it which made the hair look even better.  If you all want pictures of the unit let me know.  Overall I would definitely recommend this hair.

AEG6H2SPZVYRZXCFR4EE2GZL7TOA.review_title: This is the softest hair I have ever had!
AEG6H2SPZVYRZXCFR4EE2GZL7TOA.review_text: I really like the hair. Granted it's not the same quality as the $400-$500 hair but it's still very high quality. I would love to give this beautiful hair 5 stars but I had to take away one star because of the fly away hairs. I'm sure it's nothing a deep conditioning with some silicone couldn't fix but if you're a beginner you might want to take it to a stylist to do the deep conditioning. The bundles are full, the hair is extremely soft (oh my goodness it's so soft), it's very bouncy and lightweight, it doesn't tangle or shed (thank God), and it came beautifully packaged. Feel free to check out my detailed review on youtu be, my channel name is liber8tedone3.  Just in case you can't make it over there I've inserted some pictures below. AEG6H2SPZVYRZXCFR4EE2GZL7TOA.review_title: The hairline is nice but the frontal is super thin.

AEG6H2SPZVYRZXCFR4EE2GZL7TOA.review_title: The BEST braiding hair hands down.....
AEG6H2SPZVYRZXCFR4EE2GZL7TOA.review_text: This is the BEST braiding hair I've ever had. It's soft but not so soft that it takes away from it holding a braid. It doesnt tangle, and the color is gorgeous.  The picture of the braid was after me using half of it, I forgot to take a picture sooner. I used about 4 1/2 out of 5 packs. It also came with colorful and black rubberbands, gold and silver braid claps (The same ones used in the picture, a crochet needles, and some lashes. I flexiroded the ends and dipped them in boiling water.

AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_title: Not great for exfoliating, but a pleasant experience
AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_text: Not great for exfoliating, but a pleasant experience.  All the salt in this product is less than I would’ve expected and very fine grained so the exfoliation experience isn’t what I expected. What I did like about it was it was not as oily as many of the products that I’ve had in the past. It did leave my skin feeling soft and refreshed. And I do think the price is very reasonable for the quality of the ingredients that are in it. I took one star off for the misrepresentation of the exfoliation product.

Sturdy components, good quality glass bottle, sprays a perfect super fine mist.  No complaint at all about the quality, the price...a bit steep even for this quality but I don't find it obscene, hence only one star removed.

I don't think there is a part of your body that wouldn't benefit from this oil.  I use it on my hair, and mix a bit in my conditioner.  Great for the skin and especially the face.  I also use it for dried cuticles.  Perfect size.

AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_title: The Covid answer to post gym workouts!
AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_text: The Covid answer to post gym workouts!  If I were a gym owner,  I would keep these well in stock! This is a nice big cloth, used to clean up after a workout. It is not dripping wet but it is adequately moist. There is a slight clean scent to it, but nothing perfumy or anything that would fight with a perfume. It did a nice job, however other than doing may be under arms face and chest one of these towels would not be enough if you really wanted to clean yourself up.  These would also be great during camping trips. Or even long car trips when you like to refresh. For what it is, I don’t think the price is unreasonable. If I were a gym owner I would give each patron two of these towels when they arrived. I thought the product was good, the towel was really soft and enjoyable to use.  The towel itself is also as strong as it is soft. I will make sure to have a couple of these in my purse at all times.

Nice quality but overpriced.  The bottle is quality glass, the sprayer is sturdy with multiple functions, you can spray or stream. It even has nice chalk type labels included. They are perfect if you want to make your own natural cleaning supplies, and the dark amber color will protect your essential oil’s, but I feel that the price is way out of line. I’m not debating the quality, the quality is there. The price… Not.

I like making my own hand lotions and sanitizers and these little keychain lotion bottle and holders are just adorable for those projects. What’s really nice about them is they make a nice gift for a guy and a lot of these types of holders are way too feminine to give to a guy as a gift. Any patriot would certainly love it.  The price? I found it to be fair for the novelty that it is.

Great for homemade projects!  I would’ve like them to be a little bit more flexible for pushing thicker lotions out. But if you’re going to be putting liquids and it won’t be an issue. Well packaged. I felt it was a decent value.

These well made bottles are big and perfect for cleaning solutions.  The sprayer works well and I liked the addition of the metal funnel and the labels.  That being said, $5 each for a glass spray pump bottle is pricey...they back it up with quality, but if your buying 4 of them I think the price should be lower.

I used these for a homemade essential oil facial spray.  The mist is really fine which I liked.  It has a double cap which is nice as it stays secure in your purse.  Well constructed and just cute.  I felt for a buck a bottle it was a good value.

These pumps are good quality, solid construction meant for larger bottles to pay attention to the type of bottle it fits or you will be unhappy.  The same company sells a smaller pump, set of two for $6 which I found way overpriced so I was surprised to find these pumps so reasonable and a good value.

AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_title: Great price for a quality product!
AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_text: Great price for a quality product!  Are use a lot of castor oil in lotions and creams that I formulate myself. I like to use the best quality caster oil I can find and I find this product compatible with brands that I spend the same amount on for a 4 ounce bottle. So I find this to be an amazing value.

The mist is fine and the pump works well, make sure not to fill it all the way as when you prime the pump you need a little wiggle room.  The quality is not great, and this company makes a beautiful set of six with much better materials and gold accenting for two dollars more...spend the money on the other set.  The airless pump will keep ingredients from oxidizing too quickly.  Not a bad set, but since I've used the other one...I'm spoiled, so this one is just okay.

This is a nice quality oil, it absorbs well and leaves the skin soft.  At the time of this review there was no price listed, but I have to wonder...with good quality almond oil, even organic available in 16 ounce bottles for well under $20, what price will they put on this tiny bottle with less than 2 ounces.

AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_title: A different kind of treat for Halloween!
AEGKJTQWHGBIOTO34OB3GKIGCN7A.review_text: A different kind of treat for Halloween!  I don’t do candy anymore for Halloween but I try to find fun things for the kids and this was perfect!
