All you do with this gel is swipe it over the area of your brows that you want to color in, wait a little bit for it to tint and solidify, and then peel it off. The result is perfectly tinted and long lasting color on your brows! I am still working on using it precisely enough to get my brows really even, but that’s mostly because I am still pretty novice at using makeup at all, so that’s me and not the product. Overall I love this product so much. It’s probably one of the best brow products I’ve tried. Definitely recommend!

I am extremely impressed with this skincare set. First off, it is presented like a gift, which just tickled me. Everyone likes gifts, and receiving this in the box with the cool carrying pouch and the compliment on the inside of the box felt great! I really like this touch. Second, the products themselves are great. Obviously, that’s going to be the major selling point, but it always helps when companies treat their customers really well from the onset, so I was already feeling great about these starting out.

Now about the products. The soft gels are awesome. Those are what I started first. I actually got this kit because I have dealt with blepharitis for over ten years. If you have ever dealt with this then you know how extremely difficult it is to treat. I’d heard that one effective treatment at controlling it was sea buckthorn, so I was willing to try this. The soft gels are medium size gels, and I started those right away, the day I received the kit. They are easy to swallow and I simply added them in with my other supplements.

The next morning I started the wash. The wash has been nice. I use it both on my face and to cleanse the eye area thoroughly, and on my back where I have some issues with adult acne. My back hasn’t really had any change with this product, but my face and eyes have seen some benefit already. My eyes in particular are looking a ton better, which is not only a relief but also super amazing. I am going to continue to use these products and we’ll see how things go. I hope that there will be continued relief and improvement the longer I use them.

I admit that I haven’t used the oil on my face, mostly because I am just not used to an oil on my face, but I have used it on my body and I like it. It has cleared the chronic breakouts I used to get on the back of my neck and so far they haven’t started reappearing. These products are winners, and the fact that they address more than one issue is so awesome. Given the progress I’ve had so far, I definitely recommend this kit.

This deodorant by Loupe Organics smells so good! Plus it’s certified organic, which is a big plus for me. The deodorant relies on essential oils in large part to help control odor, and I love how the bottle reminds you to inhale the aroma of the deodorant and smile before applying. Even just seeing that reminder makes me smile.

The scent of this deodorant is spicy but has the creaminess of the vanilla to add that bit of mellowness to take the edge off of the spice. It’s a perfect scent for both men and women, in my opinion. I love the scent. I have very sensitive, unpredictable and allergy prone skin, and I have been good using this deodorant. No skin reaction at all. This has been my favorite “natural” deodorant I’ve ever used. Part of it is the scent, but it’s also the presentation: the glass bottle, the box, the feel good reminders…everything about this deodorant is soulful and pleasant. Highly recommend. Oh, and just wanted to add, this kept me smelling fresh all day. Five stars and more.

This fiber lash mascara set is fantastic and the effects is creates are so beautiful. It has been one of the best mascaras I have ever used, from purchasing on Amazon or anywhere. The set includes a fiber building wand and a mascara wand. Both have color in them, which is different from what I have found in other sets! I love this, because you can technically use the fiber wand on its own if you want a less built up lash look, or you can use it with color mascaras from other sets as well. I guess you could do that with other fiber wands, but I have found that they are usually white, and this one is a soft black. It’s so, so pretty. The mascara is also black and it makes lashes beautifully long, separated, and offers a dramatic finish. There are no clumps or flakes though, and the mascara lasts through any amount of crying (I can be a cryer!) or water. The waterproof-ness of this set is excellent. You can also build the mascara with more coats if you want a thicker effect, but something I really like is that the mascara isn’t super thick on the first coat, so it allows that option. Overall, I can’t recommend this set enough. If you are caught between different sets and not sure which one is for you, this is the one! Highly recommend.

At nearly $18 for 8 oz., it’s a pricey treat but also worth it.

Thank you for taking the time to read this & I hope it’s helpful!

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: Makeup klutz me can actually use this! Very easy to apply & draw…
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
Full disclosure: I’m a makeup klutz who has no business posting a pic of eyebrows BUT — for the 1st time, I found a product that let me actually draw some in!
My brows never fully grew back after chemo in 2005, so I’ve just learned to love my sparse & whispy nothings.
This pen, though, is pretty goof proof! I think it’s the way the end is shaped with 4 little tips similar to a fork… the lines that come out aren’t thick & bold, but they can be if you just keep drawing over & over.

My daughter is a brow fill-in champ, so I will definitely have her help me next time she’s home but, in the meantime, I will recommend this product since if I can use it, anyone can!
I’m timid about big dark brows, but will try a little more each day. At just under $10, it’s a great value for an excellent product.

**Thank you for reading this review & I hope that it’s Helpful!**

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: You can actually reach your back with this! 1 week use & it looks much improved…
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
I ordered this for my daughter who spends a lot of time in the gym, so fitted workout clothes + sweat + misc. dirt = back breakouts!
This spray not only feels good going on, but it has helped her flare ups considerably after using it for a week after each shower (2x/day).

The design allows it to spray out at all angles which is important to reach your back if there isn’t anyone to help you with it.
There’s no downside - it feels good, there’s no funky residue, it has reduced the redness & inflammation, & it’s easy to use.
Definitely recommend & will order again!

**Thank you for reading my review & I hope that it’s Helpful!**

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: Scrubber feature is better in theory than in practice - NOPE! Cleanser is fine…
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
The scrubber tip on this tube of cleanser sounded like a great idea, so I ordered it. I’ve used charcoal face products on my very dry, sensitive skin in the past with no irritation or reaction & this one is fine, too. Cleans, rinses well, moisturizes a bit.

BUT — the angled tip has teeny nylon bristles that are actually too short. You squeeze the tube to push some product onto the surface & gently “scrub” your face with it. The problem is that the bristles are so short that it just feels like a plastic disc massage! No matter how gently or firmly I applied it, the result was the same - rubbing creamy gray cleanser across my face with a circle of hard plastic.

In theory, this idea is good but the actual design of the tip does not work for me.

**Thank you for reading my review & I hope that it’s Helpful!**

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: OUTSTANDING cream that glides on & leaves you glistening… my hands & feet LOVE it!
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
I have super dry skin in general & go through creams & lotions Iike crazy, always looking for the perfect one.
This one? WOW - is it ever super moisturizing.

On my hands, I can rub it in for several minutes & it feels really creamy like a good massage cream. The lanolin must be what makes this happen & the olive oil must be the reason my skin is glistening afterwards. If I need to do something right away, I do wipe my palms off a bit but, at night I’ve been rubbing this in & leaving it to soak in all night.
On my feet, I rub this on my heels & balls of my feet after a late shower, then cover them with comfy socks & let this soak in all night.
Next morning? New hands, new feet! They feel great.

Manuka honey is known for its effectiveness in treating skin issues due to its antibacterial properties, so the combination of this, along with the other ingredients makes this an instant favorite in my book.
A little goes a long way & the price is very reasonable for the excellent quality.

**Thank you for reading my review & I hope that it’s Helpful!**

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: The cream is great! The syringe dispenser? Unnecessary…
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
I’d rather pay less for this eye cream & have it come in a simple tube with a narrow tip to just squeeze out a little at a time.
The syringe seems like much ado about nothing - I mean, it’s just a way of squeezing out a little cream, too! Except it’s a lot of packaging & fuss. Once the cream is gone, there’s no way to open this up & get all the rest out from inside the container like you can do with tubes.

Besides that, the cream itself is great!
No scent whatsoever, it glides on smoothly & easily, and it absorbs quickly & completely.
It’s nice to find an under eye cream you can use in the morning before applying concealer. I also have been applying at night after I wash my face & my under eye skin area looks & feels moisturized in the morning.

So — 5 stars for the cream, 3 stars for the silly syringe brings me to 4 stars overall.

**Thank you for reading my review & I hope that it’s Helpful!** 🤗

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: Maybe I'm not the ideal customer? Just not a great experience...
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
I can honestly say that I've given this thing a try.
I've had it for nearly a month now & have tried all the colors on a regular basis and... the jury is still out here.

Maybe I started too late? Maybe my very dry, very sensitive, sun damaged 60 year old skin is past redemption?
I'm not quite sure, but the improvement is - negligible?? Imperceptible??
I clean my face, wear the mask, moisturize, & wait. A couple times/week for a couple of weeks now.
I think part of my problem is that I don't find the process relaxing. Having lights on my face & having to sit still. My hyper tendencies kick in & I get squirmy and anxious.
I also have a large size head, so the face mask is pretty snug. Rather torturous, actually.

So -- as far as the review goes -- the product is fine. It does as it says it will, apparently. I'm just not the target audience! I'll share it with my smaller headed, more low key sister.

**Thank you for reading this review & I hope that it's Helpful!**

AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_title: An excellent eye cream that passes my “tests”! First, do no harm…
AEIFXWDWF3NU6Y5L5VQBEITE7KJQ.review_text:
Forever in search of the perfect skin care products, I ordered this eye cream.
I always try it on the back of my hand first to see what it feels like & what it smells like - it’s very creamy but not thick & has no odor at all.
Then I dot some on my forehead to see how it absorbs & how it dries & to make sure there’s no reaction on my very dry & sensitive skin - it’s very light & dries quickly. Leaves a bit of stickiness that dissipates.
Finally I dot the cream all over my undereye area & hope for the best!

In this case, it’s great. I’ve been using it for several days now at night after a shower & again in the morning before makeup.
I really don’t expect all the magical things to happen that are listed on eye creams, so suffice to say it’s moisturizing, it spreads easily, & my undereye area feels soft & smooth after using.
All good!

This set of three essential oils is very useful. The oils are certified organic and never tested on animals. The quality seems very high and the oils smell wonderful. The perfectly packaged set would make a great gift for someone beginning with essential oils or for an old hand since it contains three of the most commonly used oils.

Personally, I don't use oils medicinally unless you count the calming benefits of lavender in your mister. I use them either in a mister or atomizer or as a dot of fragrance on my wrist. Essential oils don't cause headaches or change their scent when I wear them.

The kit includes lavender, lemon, and peppermint. All three smell absolutely wonderful, whether you use them in a mister or add a drop to your washer's rinse cycle. I always add a drop or two to loads containing our bedding. It's delightful.

I would definitely buy Bloomy's brand again. I'm very impressed with the fragrance and quality.

With this tool, you won't need to change out removable trim guides for the lengths you want - and if you're like my guy, that also means you won't lose them constantly.

One added feature that's really appreciated is that you can lock it so it won't turn on accidentally in the travel bag or suitcase.

This set would make a nice gift. It includes four adhesive (but removable) hooks, the scrubber and a foam bath sponge.

Since I wear contacts, I put the drops in the morning then doze in bed for another fifteen or twenty minutes before it's time to insert my lenses. During this time, my eyes tear up a little from the medication. The tears, combined with drips of medicine, create crusts around my eyes that are irritating if I'm not careful about wiping them away. They often sting and I don't have time for that -- cats are calling for breakfast and I need my contact lenses on to see to feed them.

These wipes are terrific for cleaning away excess eye drops on my skin and lashes. They're thorough and don't sting and the wipes are big so I can use one side to do most of the cleaning turn it over to make sure my lashes are completely clear. There is no pain despite my dry eyes.

I wish I'd found these sooner, and I'm glad to have them. They make my morning routine less stingy and crusty!

I'm fragrance-sensitive and any man-made scent will instantly curl my nose and tweak my sinuses and put me in a foul mood as I scrub my skin with dish soap to get rid of the odor. Sasy n Savy's Citrus Souffle Body Cream makes my nose and sinuses very, very happy. It's naturally and deliciously scented and my skin just eats it up.

This cream is light and soaks in very quickly. It moisturizes very well and gets rid of itchiness caused by dry skin. Made with all-natural ingredients including those delicious essential citrus oils, hibiscus, and oils of macadamia and avocado, there's nothing bad in the ingredient list, and it's cruelty-free. It quenches my skin and the pleasant scent lingers faintly for quite a while. I keep a tube on my desk and use it several times a day. Its scent is uplifting and its moisturizing properties are fabulous.

This moisturizer is described as a gel cream and contains aloe vera and hyaluronic acid. The latter is something I always want in face creams because it does a great job on my aging skin. The aloe vera is a nice touch, as well.

I'm usually the one complaining about fragrances, but this time, I'm happy. The gel-cream has a light (quickly dissipating) scent that's herby, almost minty. Unlike many fragrances, it doesn't bother my sinuses, plus I enjoy the odor.

This product goes on clear and soaks in fast. I mainly use it on a dry spot on my face that flakes if I skip hyaluronic for more than a day or two. There's no sign of the flaky spot, so I'm very happy with this reasonably-priced cream.

For the price, I have to wonder why this item is not listed under Amazon's "luxury beauty" line. Like many reviewers, I was put off by the sheer amount of packaging that came along with this item. It wouldn't be so bad if they didn't tout how conscious they were of environmental issues, but I've purchased Chanel with less packing, come on!

All of the beauty and skin care products I consume are luxury, at the moment I've been using Dr. Gross's skin care line but until I could get back to Sephora, I've been using Purity cleanser. I was hoping this product would be a suitable replacement but I'm not convinced so let me tell you about the photos.

Each night I cleanse my face with Purity using Clarasonic's Uplift with the Revitalizing brush. I follow this with micellar water (by Borghese) and then a serum and moisturizer. The whole thing takes about 7 minutes (it's therapy, don't judge!).

Upon waking, I swabbed my face with the micellar water and then took a picture of the cotton ball along with an untouched cotton ball for comparison. And by the way for the uninitiated, micellar water is the best skincare product to come out since mascara was invented. I was sure that my $349 Clarasonic erased all traces of dirt no matter the soap, but the micellar water never lies.

On the second morning, first thing, I used the Clarasonic with the Radiance brush and three pumps of LaClaire Foaming Botanical Facial Cleanser. Two pumps did not create a bit of lather. Then using micellar water, I swabbed my face again and there you have the picture of both -- no cleanser and cleanser.

You can see that there is still a lot of dirt left behind after using this cleanser, certainly less than no cleanser at all but there is still some there. There is less dirt left after washing with Purity so I wouldn't call it a miracle cleanser, it's really just "okay."

I haven't been using this item long enough to report on any discernible difference in my face but I can speak to a couple of other interesting tidbits.

I know that these have been in use for generations and they must work because people swear by them. If that weren't proof enough, I use my Clarisonic Uplift daily, and it comes with an attachment that does the exact same thing that this roller does, only with using technology. The instructions on this roller is to use it for 5-10 minutes a day, 2-3 times a day. That's a lot and I don't know of many people who care to carve out time to do this, but if you're sitting quietly watching TV or even reading, you can do it absentmindedly. With the Clarisonic, you're supposed to use it with a moisturizer or a serum but with this, you use it on a dry face. With or without a lotion, the massaging affect is exactly the same.

The jade roller feels cool across the skin (even if mine does squeak a little) and it feels wonderful. I'm not sure it does anything if you're rolling it on your chest, but it feels amazing if done with a bit of pressure. It comes in a nice little Asian-inspired embroidered bag, so it doesn't look bad if you want to leave it on your bedside for easy access. I'm going to continue to use the Uplift each night but this item doesn't require a battery and I can whip it out anytime.

I'm a lash-addict! I have all the really nice mascaras (Chanel, Bobbi Brown, Dior) and for a year I got regular eye-lash extensions twice a month. I really wanted to like this but I can't. I put it on morning and night for five days straight, and I always woke up (and spent the day) with itchy eyes. I tried to convince myself that it was something in the air, but when I forgot to use it I was just fine. So I stopped using it and I was just fine.

However, I do believe in the concept. My family in Jamaica swear by putting coconut (or castor) oil on the lashes daily to keep them supple. When they're moisturized they don't fall off as fast, and putting on mascaras certainly aid in drying out the lashes. I try the oil-on-the-lashes thing but I've made the decision to stop using this product.

If you haven’t been using makeup primer, then you’re really missing out.

Whether you wear a full face of makeup everyday or you prefer to keep it simple with BB cream and tinted lip balm, makeup primer is a godsend when trying to combat shine or create a smooth base for foundation.

Yet, many people often skip this step because they believe they don’t really need it, are unsure of how to use it or don’t think it’s worth the investment. However, using primer underneath your makeup will make everything last longer, whether that’s on your skin or in your cosmetics bag. We asked two beauty experts to discuss the ins and outs of primer and why it’s a must-have. Here’s the deal.

Makeup primer is a base for foundation or face makeup that allows it to go on smoother and last longer.

Formulas are available in cream, gel and powder. While moisturizer softens skin, editorial and celebrity makeup artist Stephen Dimmick points out that primer prepares skin for your favorite tinted moisturizer or foundation, giving it something to hold onto so it lasts throughout the day.

Many makeup primers are formulated with silicone-based polymers like dimethicone because of their ultra-smoothing effects. But for those who struggle with cystic acne and other skin conditions, do a patch test or check with a medical professional before use, as there have been reports of allergic reactions to dimethicone.

Physicians Formula’s celebrity makeup artist Joanna Schlip adds that makeup primers can also help smooth any fine lines, wrinkles or large pores. If you are searching for a face primer to help color-correct rosacea or conceal acne spots, Schlip’s go-to is this light green primer as that hue cancels out redness.

Primers are even available just for your eyelids to prevent creasing. “I’d recommend pairing a primer with extra long-wear [eyeshadow or eyeliner] formulas for a look that will really stay put,” says Schlip. If you have oilier eylids, Dimmick advises that you use a mattifying eyelid primer.

Using your fingertips to apply makeup primer allows you to really work the product into your skin.

Schlip thinks it’s best to apply primer with fingertips for areas larger than a quarter. “If only using for small areas, I’d recommend a brush. I like to use a concealer or lip brush for this,” she said. This spot-treat technique gives the look of a more natural finish, according to Schlip.

Taking this routine a step further, Dimmick considers the process “an exercise for the face.” He explains that massaging primer onto skin with fingertips helps “to get the blood flowing underneath.” We’ll consider that the next time we’re meditating while putting on makeup.

Primer is a life-saver for getting your makeup to stay-put in extreme weather.

If you live, visit or plan on traveling anywhere that experiences hot and humid or cold and dry temperatures, Schlip suggests having primer handy to help your makeup wear longer. However, Dimmick advocates for using primer year-round. “No matter what the weather is like outside, this extra step will save you a lot of time and effort.”

Primer can even be worn on its own.
Love the fresh no-makeup look but want to look a bit more polished than when you first woke up? Primer is your answer. The product can be worn on your eyelids and double as a light eyeshadow, or it can serve as a lighter alternative to foundation.

I have a new skincare obsession: hyaluronic acid. I’ve been using hyaluronic acid for about a month and I’m amazed at what it’s done for my acne-prone skin. Inspired to learn more about how the stuff works (and if it’s really ok to put something involving the word “acid” on your face), I talked to a few experts to find out what hyaluronic acid is and why, exactly, it’s so awesome.

I first read about this magical stuff called hyaluronic acid over on I Heart Daily (tons of good stuff over there, all the time, by the way!). Then I found it recommended over and over again as an ingredient in facial creams in the beauty magazines I read on a recent flight. So I thought, why not try it? I ordered up a bottle and started using it, twice a day.

And whoa. When I layer this on underneath my regular daily moisturizer with SPF, my skin looks incredibly dewy. Yup, dewy. I’d always read that word in beauty mags but thought it was just an overused editorial cliché, not a descriptor that could ever be applied to my own skin, with its large pores and tendency towards oiliness. But dewy it was. And the acne that’s plagued me since 7th grade (over half of my life) has considerably lessened, too. All of a sudden, I have beautiful, clear, perfectly moisturized skin, even in the dead of winter.

I’m pretty committed to being as “natural” as possible with my skincare, meaning I try to buy products that use ingredients sourced from nature rather than chemicals and plasticizers. I knew I loved hyaluronic acid, but I wanted to know more about what it actually was and if it fell into my own admittedly loose category of “natural.” (Yes, I know I probably should have done more research before I started slathering it all over my face.) Here’s what I found out:
What Is Hyaluronic Acid?

Hyaluronic acid isn’t necessarily a new ingredient in skincare, but it’s been growing in popularity in recent years. According to Dr. Jessica Krant, dermatologist, founder of Art of Dermatology and Assistant Clinical Professor of Dermatology at SUNY Downstate Medical Center:

Hyaluronic acid, or hyaluronan, is the body’s lubricant molecule. It is basically a very big and complex sugar-related molecule called a glycosaminoglycan that is found naturally throughout the body and works in many different ways to keep us healthy and active. It’s involved in the health and function of skin, joints, and the immune system, among others. It is very popular as used in a number of cosmetic fillers known as hyaluronic acid dermal fillers, which get injected under the surface of the skin to replace lost volume and fill deep folds. Lately, topical products have begun to include the molecule as a moisturizing or antiaging ingredient.

So, it’s found naturally in the body and is commonly used in fillers. Ok. But if it’s found in the body, where, exactly, does the hyaluronic acid that I use on my face come from? Cosmetic dermatologist Dr. Oscar Hevia explained that cosmetic hyaluronic acid is made in a lab:

The current method of production involves bacterial fermentation, a process whereby genetically modified bacteria can produce the hyaluronic acid in large quantities which is then filtered extensively to obtain a purified, finished product.

Is Hyaluronic Acid Natural?

So is something that’s made in a lab “natural?” Dr. Hevia continued:

…it depends how you define “natural.” Most would probably not utilize this term for a substance that is produced by genetically modified bacteria, but nonetheless, the finished product is pure and identical to human hyaluronic acid.

read this article to make an informed decision:
What Is Skin Bleaching?

Skin bleaching is a cosmetic treatment to reduce the prominence of skin discolorations and even out the color of the skin. You can buy bleaching creams over the counter and by prescription.

Some people apply skin lightener to their entire body to change their complexion, but this can be very risky. The active ingredient in some skin lighteners is mercury, so bleaching can lead to mercury poisoning.

Mercury is a toxic agent that can cause serious psychiatric, neurological, and kidney problems. Pregnant women who use a skin lightener with mercury can pass the mercury to their unborn child.

The use of mercury as an ingredient in skin lighteners is banned in the U.S. However, some skin lighteners produced outside the U.S. may still contain mercury.
How Do Skin Lighteners Work?

Skin lighteners contain an active ingredient or a combination of ingredients that reduces the amount of melanin in the skin where it is applied.

How Do Skin Lighteners Work? continued...

The most widely used ingredient in skin lighteners sold in the U.S. is hydroquinone.

The FDA regulates the use of hydroquinone in the U.S. Over-the-counter skin lighteners can contain up to 2% hydroquinone. Dermatologists can write prescriptions for lighteners that contain 4%-6% hydroquinone.

It's important to check with your doctor before using a product with hydroquinone and to follow the doctor's directions exactly.

Other skin lighteners use drugs such as steroids and retinoic acid, which comes from vitamin A, as active ingredients. And some skin lighteners use natural ingredients such as kojic acid -- a compound that comes from a fungus -- and arbutin, a compound found in various plants.
Risks of Skin Lighteners

One of the most significant risks of using some skin lighteners is the potential exposure to mercury. One study found that nearly 1 out of every 4 skin lighteners made in Asia and sold outside the U.S. contained mercury.

There are other potential risks of skin lighteners. Those risks can include the following:

Prolonged use can contribute to premature aging of skin.
Long-term use may increase the risk of skin cancer from sun exposure. Always use sunscreen when using a skin lightener and going out in the sun.
Steroids in some skin lighteners may increase risk for skin infections, skin thinning, acne, and poor wound healing.
Applying steroids to large areas of skin may put you at risk for health problems related to steroid being absorbed by the body.
Hydroquinone may cause unwanted and untreatable skin discoloration (ochronosis).
Various bleaching agents, including natural ingredients, can cause skin irritation or allergic reaction.

It is often claimed that periorbital dark circles are caused by tiredness or working too hard or even just staying up late. While this can be true, the truth is that your genes play a huge role here. So what exactly is happening when you get dark circles under or around your eyes?

Simply put, periorbital dark circles are a result of the thin layer of skin below your eyes showing the blood vessels and the blood they contain more clearly than anywhere else on your body. (For reference, this skin around your eyelids, called periorbital skin, is on average about 0.5 mm thick compared to an average of about 2 mm thick on most of the rest of your body.)

Now, as you may or may not already know, the reason veins often look blue isn’t because the blood inside them is blue; it’s because your skin/subcutaneous tissue only lets blue/violet wavelengths of light pass through it. As a result, only blue light is reflected back and the veins look, well, bluish. (Veins often won’t appear blue if a person has darker or lighter skin. Rather, the veins tend to appear green or brown. On the other hand, people with extremely light skin, such as albinos, will typically have veins that show up as dark purple or dark red, more closely resembling the actual color of the blood running through the veins.)

It’s the exact same concept with the skin below your eyes. Those dark bluish circles are (usually) just the result of light being reflected back off of the blood vessels sitting just below the surface of that incredibly thin patch of skin. This is the same reason facial bruises are more prominent below or around the eyes; the thin skin just shows the blood from the ruptured blood vessels a little bit more clearly.

Again, as you may or may not know, as we age, our skin loses its elasticity and ability to regenerate and as a result, it becomes thinner. This is why more often than not, elderly people will have rather prominent periorbital dark circles regardless of how much they sleep. As with those who are genetically predisposed to having thinner skin below the eyes, it’s just biology.

AEKZVUWFM4AVGF2JGBGPVRKKIUHA.review_title: I❤️the cooling tip on this device👍⭐️
AEKZVUWFM4AVGF2JGBGPVRKKIUHA.review_text:
This device comes in a very nice case for storage. The protective glasses 👓 even come in a very nice case. The directions are quite detailed so there is no need for me to discuss that in this review. If you purchase this device you’ll see.

Operating an IPL device is pretty simple if you follow the directions. It’s choosing the level, making sure you don’t miss a spot and having the patience/commitment to follow through with it to get the results you want.

I have seen reviews under many IPL hair removal devices that says they used it for a month and they didn’t see any results. Well, it does take time. Like I said, if you are committed, patience and consistent, then any IPL device will work. This particular device recommends using ONCE a week for 12 weeks, and then once a month there after for maintenance. Most people want to see results by snapping their fingers, and that just isn’t going to happen, even if you do go to a professional, and have it done, it takes time. My advice, if you are not in the mood to take the time, don’t have the patience and or not going to be committed, then don’t get one of these devices because you would be wasting your money.

It took about 4 weeks or 4 treatments before I really started to notice results. First noticed the hair on the underarms because it had become finer, thinner, softer hair that was growing. My bikini 👙 area had spots that the hair didn’t grow back but other spots where it was finer, thinner & softer hair. Even though I had spots with NO HAIR growing back, I still go over all the areas regardless. My left armpit has no hair growing at this time, but I still do a treatment. Once I get to the proper weeks since I first started the treatments, then and only then I will 🛑 treating areas where no hair grows.

My legs 🦵🏼 have been frustrating but it’s definitely working. The problem is that I miss areas each time I do a treatment. There’s no way of getting the entire leg each time. I have come up with a pattern I do that helps me the best. I start at my ankle and go around my leg 🦵🏼 in a circle ⭕️ while spiraling 🌀 up my leg. I found that going up and down is when I was missing the most. Doing a spiral has helped me tremendously.

On the days I am scheduled to do another treatment, I shave 🪒 the areas that I’m going to treat. I also exfoliate the areas using [[ASIN:B099HDG45M Revealer Skin Exfoliator]]. Then about an half hour after I shave 🪒, I start me treatments. KEEP YOUR LEGS DRY, CLEAN AND NO LOTIONS/OILS ETC. NOTHING.
ALWAYS WEAR THE PROTECTIVE 👓 GLASSES!
Since I shave my underarms first, I start there. Underarms takes about 2 minutes each. Then I do my bikini 👙 area and then onto my legs. If I think I forgot a spot I do go back and do it, but I really try to pay attention so I don’t. Once complete I either apply [[ASIN:B0B1N8Z7BR Reviver Skin Soothing Gel]] or [[ASIN:B073WVKRBN USDA Certified Jojoba Oil]]. Both are soothing, but sometimes I feel I need a decent moisturizer and Jojoba Oil is my go to for that.

Well, that’s how I do each treatment. I also put in my schedule/calendar📅 when I’m supposed to do my next treatment. It is time consuming, but the results are so worth it. Think off all the money you are going to save by NOT having to buy EXPENSIVE RAZORS 🪒 anymore. Not to mention the time saved in the shower 🚿.

HOPE THIS HELPS others understand a little of how it works. 👍I feel very comfortable using this device and knew going into it, this is a commitment and requires patience.

AELZIKZNMROP2SMO5XXVB4V36RJA.review_title: Good kit for beginner or intermediate. Pretty much everything you need.
AELZIKZNMROP2SMO5XXVB4V36RJA.review_text: First off, there's a LOT in this set.  Pretty much all the tools you need, some better quality than others but overall quite good.  The lamp is big. It has 3 (actually 4) settings.  30, 60 and 120 buttons and when you put your hand in it auto goes to 90.  Big enough to do whole hand or toes at a time. The detachable cord fits snug in the back (not a USB, a real plug).  The cord is about 3 ft long.  Base is attached.  8 color polishes ranging nude to red and brown.  I got 2 duplicate colors.  That may have been a boo boo.  Base coat, no-wipe clear top coat and frost (matte) top coat.  Bottles are smaller than regular size but for the price it's not a deal-breaker. Gloss top coat was surprisingly shiny.  Matte has a velvety look.  Lots of embellishments; seed beads, rhinestones, chunky glitter and glitter powder (which I had no luck with) but no applicators, all in tiny pots and wheel with an opening. I found the wheel to be a bit of a pain and the rhinestones stuck to the top and transferred to the next pot when turning.  The rhinestones are super tiny and difficult to pick up even with the weeding tweezers included. No adhesive so you just have to paint top coat and place before curing. This would be an excellent purchase for a beginner (to intermediate) wanting to try several different looks.  Well worth the price.  Most everything met my expectations. I would be eager to try other products from this brand.

Something about these liquids wreaks havoc on brushes and usually after one or 2 nails your brushes are toast. That's why they make the saver and usually include extra brushes.

AELZIKZNMROP2SMO5XXVB4V36RJA.review_title: SmoothSkin IPL Hair Remover seems to be working and fast, easy to use
AELZIKZNMROP2SMO5XXVB4V36RJA.review_text:
IPL hair removal is not an immediate fix for hair removal. None of them are. There is a bit to learn before using successfully, so do some homework beforehand and read the manual. And it's important to know it's not for every skin type nor is it a "permanent" fix. You will have to use occasionally to maintain. That being said, this is one of the better IPL I have tried. Anything that keeps me from shaving is a plus.
There is a bit of "pain" like needle pricks but after repeated use, it gets less noticeable. There is a precision guard that also helps buffer a bit. The cord is annoyingly clunky. Not sure why it's so bulky. There isn't an on/off. Unplug when you're done. It's a bit large for travel, especially if you're keeping it in the box. No glasses, surprisingly. Some small improvements would definitely make this a 5 star review for me but certainly not a deal breaker. High 4 stars for performance and ease of use.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Pretty Decent Set! Avoid If Sensitive to Smells!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is a pretty decent set! For $25.99 (at the time of writing this review), you get a lot of items!!

I love that it comes in a cute little caboodle box! Everything fits in it great! So all of the stuff is together in one place and it’s small enough that it’s easy to store!

The little pots of glitter cake together in a little zip lock bag, which I appreciated because some of the glitter had spilled out, so that kept it contained. It was only a few glitter particles, but I was still glad it was contained to the little bag! The poly gel tubes each come in their own little bags too, which I thought was nice. None of them leaked, but if they had it would have been very messy had they not been in a bag and still messy if they weren’t in separate bags. So, even though mine didn’t leak, I’m glad the company thought of the possibility and planned ahead just in case!

The polishes all come in their own box. I wish they would have labeled the OUTSIDE of the boxes. The only thing on the boxes were “Nail Polish” on 2 of them and “Gel Nail Polish” on the rest. Since 2 were supposed to be the top and base coat and only 2 said “Nail Polish,” I figured those were the top and base coats. I was wrong. I’m not sure why 2 said “Nail Polish” and the others said “Gel Nail Polish,” especially since they’re all supposed to be Gel polishes 🤷‍♀️ So, I had to open each box and look at each nail polish bottle to see which ones were which. The base and top coats were labeled on the outside of the bottles. BUT, the colored polishes weren’t labeled in any way. So the only way to figure out which color was which was to open each one. A minor inconvenience, but annoying when they could have just labeled them with the colors! So, I ended up putting a dot of the polish on the top of each box so I’d know in the future. It would just be nice if in the future the company labels them better!

The polish STINKS! It smells like burnt plastic 🤢 All Nail Polish stinks, but I’ve gotten used to the “regular” stink of nail polish. Smelling burned plastic while painting my nails is not something I’ve gotten used to! But, for the price of everything I got, it’s something I can deal with. But if smells bother you, this is not the kit for you!!!

The UV lamp works okay. I took a few times of turning it on to get the nails to dry, but it’s small so I wasn’t expecting too much and they did and it was still faster than if I painted my nails with regular polish and waited for them to dry. So I’m happy!

Overall, it’s a good little kit! I love that it comes all together in the cute little caboodle box. I love that you got an assortment of polish colors and an assortment of poly gel colors. I love that it came with the base and top coats. I love that it came with a UV lamp. I love it came with the tool needed for the poly gel nails. I love it came with glitter, foils, and strip tape to decorate the nails. I didn’t like that the polishes weren’t labeled better and I didn’t like the burnt plastic smell of the polish. But for everything I love and the affordable price for everything you get, I can get past those 2 things I didn’t like!!

I’d say the only thing that would make me tell you to avoid getting this kit would be if you’re sensitive to strong smells because of the burnt plastic smell from the polish. Other than that, I’d recommend this kit!!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Meh...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I like false nails, but I don’t like really long ones. When I saw these looked short, I thought they’d be great! I wasn’t too sure about the diamond gemstones on them. I was a little worried they would look too gaudy, for my taste at least. But, the images of the nails on the hands in the product photos they didn’t look too bad, the ones on the thumbs seemed a little big but I figured that was okay.

So, I get them and see the diamond gemstones seem way bigger than they do in the product photos. But, I figure they’re worth a try anyways!

It took me FOREVER to sort them into their separate sizes. Of course, when I was laying them out to take the photos of them, I noticed that the plastic part you pull off the nail to reveal the adhesive have numbers on them 🤦‍♀️ Wish I would have seen them when I went to apply them! The instructions say NOTHING about them having numbered labels. And, the numbers are REALLY hard to see. So if you don’t have perfect eyesight, you might have a really hard time! I have perfect eyesight and still had trouble. I showed in a photo the best I could the number on one of the nails. That one is labeled 2. In the photo I have with them all separated and labeled, so maybe it will help someone avoid the headache of figuring it out!

The nails themselves I feel are kind of small and the thumbs I think are too big. Like my fingers aren’t too big. The 0 ones were too big for my thumbs. I had to go with the 1 ones. But then the 2 were too small for my middle finger. The 1 ones fit good, but there was only 3 of them and I was already going to use 2 of them for my thumbs. So I had to use the 0 ones for my thumbs which were too big, so they looked weird. I feel like only having 3 of each size isn’t enough. I wore these before taking the photo showing them all separated. I kept the ones I had worn and taken off to include them in their size group. Having only 3 of each size, if one size fits 2 different fingers, you’d need 4 so you wouldn’t have enough, which is an issue I had.

I don’t like that there’s only 2 sizes with nothing on them, both tiny, pinkie kind of size nails. Usually when I wear something - gems, designs, etc. on my nails, I either have the designs on my ring and pointer finger, just my ring finger, maybe my thumb as well. But not every finger. But with these you pretty much have to, except for your pinkie. The 2 sizes that have the other design on them (the 5 and 55 ones), those sizes are so darn close that it’s almost impossible to tell the difference. So it doesn’t give much choice to have those on different fingers either. I ended up putting them on my pointer finger. So every finger had a diamond gemstone except for the pointer fingers that had the other design and the pinkies that had nothing.

I like that the set comes with the stick for your cuticles, the nail file, and a alcohol swab. The nail file is great. The nails stick well. I used the cuticle stick to push back my cuticles, filed my nails, and then used the alcohol swab on them. Then I attached the nails. I used them as stick on ones, with the adhesive only. If you wanted them to last longer, you could use glue as well. I just wanted to test them out how they were so I only used the adhesive that’s on each nail. They stuck very well. The only issue I had was the size 1 ones that I used for my middle finger didn’t curve over my middle finger well, so the corner looked like it was sort of lifted. But it still stayed stuck on well and didn’t pop off throughout the 2 days I had them on, doing all the normal things I do every day. They probably would have lasted much longer, but I didn’t want them on anymore. I didn’t like how big the diamond gemstones were. I didn’t like they had the diamond gemstones on so many nails. As I said, I would have preferred only having them on the ring finger, maybe pointer finger, possibly thumb. But not all. I didn’t like the ones on my thumbs (the 0’s) looked so big since I had to use those on my thumbs instead of the 1’s since I had to use those on my middle fingers.

Overall, for $15.20 (at the time of writing this review), I don’t think they’re worth it at all. If you feel your fingers are the right size to have better options when choosing sizes, if you like bigger gemstones, if you like gemstones on pretty much every nail, then you would probably really enjoy these. Like I said, they apply well and stick well. But, if you’re like me and don’t like big gemstones on your nails and don’t like gemstones on pretty much every nail, then these probably aren’t for you. Honestly, I can get a set that has more size options and designs I really like at the drugstore for way less. So these just aren’t for me!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: A Great Mascara AND A Great Lash Curler!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I have pretty small, hooded eyes, so it’s hard to find a lash curler that works for my eyes. The biggest issue I have is them pinching my eye when I’m clamping down to curl them. I always have to lightly clamp down to see if I’ll pinch myself and, if I will, then adjust. Then, I end up having some parts not curled. I’d been looking for a new curler for a while, when I saw this I figured it was worth a try since I also got mascara.

Someone in the reviews had said the package came damaged. Mine also did. It wasn’t too bad, just seemed a little beat up. But, the products inside were completely fine and didn’t seem damaged at all, so I was okay with that.

I am very picky about my mascara. Well, not so much the mascara as I am the mascara wand. With my small, hooded eyes, it makes it so I end up with a lot of mistakes of the wand hitting below my lower lash line or onto my hood. So, I prefer thinner wands. I wasn’t sure what to expect with this mascara, but I was also getting a lash curler so I figured I’d hopefully like at least 1 of them. I’m happy to say that the mascara wand isn’t too thick. It’s not extremely thin, but still thin enough so it works for me. It also has a little bend to it, which helps with application. The mascara goes on very easily and doesn’t clump up after a few coats, which is great! It stays on all day without smearing. But, it also washes off easily at the end of the day, which I always love. It’s hard to find a mascara that stays all day without smearing or smudging, but is easy to wash off. So, it’s nice this does both!

The lash curler is amazing! It’s lightweight. It feels so nice. I love the red, black, and gold. It looks so fancy! It fits my eyes really well and curls my lashes AMAZINGLY without pinching my eyes at all! I’m really happy with it! It also comes with replacements for the rubber part on the curler, so that was great!

For $11.99 (at the time of writing this), it’s an amazing deal! You’re getting an amazing lash curler and an amazing mascara. You can’t beat that! If you’re looking for a great mascara, a great lash curler, or both, you should definitely give this a try!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Pretty Great!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
So far I’m really enjoying this! It comes with a dropper, which I like. It’s consistency isn’t too thick or thin. It glides on smoothly, and absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue. It has no scent, which I also love.

I am 34 and still suffer from hormonal breakouts. When will they end?! 😤 I get them around my mouth and chin area. I’m always looking for something to help with the hormonal breakouts. Usually, I get a pimple or 2, it usually takes forever to go away, and a lot of times there’s a red dot left behind where it was that just seems to hang around forever, sometimes even after a new breakout has come there’s still a red mark where the old one(s) were! By the time the breakout finally goes away (at least mostly other than the red mark that sometimes stays), it’s time for another! Vicious cycle 😠 So, I’m always looking for something that will help! I’d love if I could find something that would keep the breakouts away completely...if anyone knows of that magic, please let me know!! But, I’d be happy with something that would help get the breakouts to go away faster and leave no marks. I also have some indentations (scars) where I had breakouts in the past and picked them (oh, if only my past younger self could know what I know now!). So, I’m always looking for something to help make those go away or at least lessen them.

This says it’s an intensive 21 day treatment. The product information on the product page says, “Achieve a flawless complexion in 21 days.” The company is even is so confident in that claim that it also says, “We're confident you'll see results in 21 days with our acne treatment. And if you’re ever unsatisfied, no worries! We back it up with a 100% guarantee!” That is a bold claim, and they are backing it up! So, when I saw that I definitely wanted to try it!

It doesn’t say exactly what you do AFTER you’ve used it for 21 days. I guess since they are guaranteeing a “flawless complexion” in those 21 days, so they didn’t feel the need to say what to do once those 21 days were over. 🤷‍♀️ I did see someone asked if they could continue using it after 21 days, and the company responded saying, “The optimal time is 21 days, but you may use it even longer, as you see fit.” So, that answered that question.

I have been using the serum for 21 days every night, and some days even in the morning. I did notice that my hormonal breakout wasn’t quite as bad, but I still got it. It did seem to go away slightly faster too. But, I definitely do NOT have a “flawless complexion.”

I honestly didn’t think I would get a “flawless complexion” after using this for 21 days. That is a pretty bold claim. I honestly don’t like the fact that they are making such a claim. That sets people up for disappointment if they really believe that using this for 21 days will give them a “flawless complexion.” The fact that they offer to backup that bold claim by offering a 100% refund if the person isn’t “satisfied with the results,” makes it a little better. But, I’m sure they know most people probably aren’t going to take the time to send it back after using it for 21 days. 🤷‍♀️ Even though I didn’t think I’d get a “flawless complexion” after using this for the full 21 days, I at least hoped it would help lessen the hormonal breakouts and help them go away quicker. It did seem to do that. Now, since my breakouts are hormonal, that might be a factor in why I still got them even while using this regularly. So, if you suffer from acne and it isn’t hormonal, it might heal up current breakouts and keep any future breakouts away. I can’t really speak to that.

So, if you see that this product is saying you’ll have a “flawless complexion” in 21 days and that’s why you’re getting it, I think you might be disappointed. But, if you have realistic expectations - that this will help lessen the breakouts and help heal them up a little quicker, then I think you’d like this. Overall, it helped lessen my hormonal breakouts, helped them go away a little quicker, and my skin seemed smoother and less red in the areas. So, I’m happy with the results. But, boy do I wish it really did give me that “flawless complexion!” 😉

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Mask! A Lot of Product!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These are great masks! There seems to be a lot of product on the masks, which I wasn’t sure I’d like at first. But, after using a few of them, it really seems like your face is getting the extra benefit of the extra product. With most sheet masks, there’s product on them, but once they sit on your face and you remove the mask, there’s only a little residue left, that you rub into your skin. With these masks, it seems like there was a lot left after. So, I rubbed it into my face after. With all the excess product, I feel like my skin is getting mote of the benefits. You can feel the bubbling, which feels interesting but in a good way!

The only weird thing I found was, with most sheet masks, you apply the mask, let it sit for the appropriate time, remove the mask, rub in any excess product left over, and you’re done. With these masks, however, the instructions say to re-wash your face after removing the mask. It says, “Apply the mask to face after cleaning. Remove it after 15-20 minutes. Re-clean skin until it is completely absorbed.” That makes zero sense to me. “Re-clean skin until it is completely absorbed” 🤷‍♀️ If you’re washing your face after removing the mask, the product won’t be absorbed, it will be washed off. So that makes no sense. I’m not sure what that’s about. So, I would leave the mask on for the 15-20 min, remove the mask, rub in the excess product for a minute, then rinse off my face.

I love that you get 10 masks! A lot of facial sheet masks you only get one or you get 10 but at a higher cost. So, I love you get 10 of these, and that they didn’t skimp at all on the product on the masks! I definitely recommend these!

I value reviews and always try to provide the kind of information I’d want to know about a product before making a purchase. So I hope that this did that for you and was helpful to you in making your decision! If so, please click “helpful” below!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Amazing! YouNeed This!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I wasn’t sure about this at first because the product page says that it’s for “oily, trouble, acne prone skin.” I have normal to dry skin, more on the dry side. But, I do suffer from hormonal acne, so I figured I’d try it! And I am SOOOO glad that I did!

First of all, it has the cutest name - “I woke up like this” - and it comes in pink packaging! So I was a fan of that! It comes in a jar that has a seal on it, which I always appreciate. I usually prefer pumps and don’t care too much for jars because you have to put your fingers in, which can lead to bacteria getting in the jar and then you putting bacteria on your face when you use it again. BUT, they have a little spatula type tool that comes with it. So, you use that to scoop out what you need and don’t have to put your fingers in the jar. Such a nice touch! I’ve seen that before with more expensive moisturizers but not with such an affordable one! So that is amazing!

I’m honestly not sure why they call it a “cream.” To me, the texture is like a gel moisturizer. It has that thin, gel like kind of texture. And I’m not mad about it! A little goes a LOOOOONG way! The first time I used this, I applied how much I do of my normal moisturizers and it ended up being waaaaay too much! I had to wipe some off! So after that, I used way less and it worked out fine! So that’s even better since it’s a,ready affordable, but with such a little amount going such a long way, this will last you for a while.

It glides on the skin so smoothly and leaves you with a dewy face. It absorbs well. It doesn’t feel sticky or greasy after. I’ve been using it before makeup, and it works great! I haven’t had any issues with any makeup products I’ve put over it!

There’s no scent either, which I’m happy about, but honestly I love the way this works so much, I wouldn’t have cared if there was a scent! 😂

This is something I will DEFINITELY repurchase, and I will be sure to have backups on hand! I’m loving it that much!! If you have dry skin, don’t let the “for oily, trouble, acne prone skin” part scare you off and make you think this won’t work for you! It’s been amazing for my dry skin! I only get hormonal breakouts around my mouth and chin area, and other than my time of the month, I don't suffer from acne. So, even if you’re a dry skin person who gets acne sometimes, a dry skin person who never gets acne, doesn’t matter, this will work for you! I seriously recommend trying it out if you have dry skin and are looking for something to moisturize!

If you’re looking for a little thicker, fuller, and/or longer hair, I’d recommend these! They are great quality for such an affordable price!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Pretty!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is a really pretty wig! Looks natural. Not too much shine. It’s long. Thick enough, but not where it’s heavy. Covers the wig cap well. The color is pretty too.

It’s long so it can get tangled up easily. But if you brush it out well, it isn’t too bad, and you can run your fingers through it to easily get the tangled out too. It doesn’t shed much. It shed a few hairs when I first took it out and brushed it, but that was it. The picture is of me wearing it right after taking it out and brushing it.

I think this is a great wig if you want something that’s affordable but good quality.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Okay...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I wanted these because they looked short. I love fake nails, but hate really long ones. And most are so long. So, I liked that these were on the shorter side.

I like the French manicure look. They look beautiful. However, I do not like the rhinestones. I thought that they’d be smaller. But they are so big. If they fall off, it’s pretty noticeable....and they do fall off.

They come with an alcohol wipe, nail file, and stick to clean under your nails and push your cuticles back. If you use the alcohol pad, file your nails, and push your cuticles back, these last a decent amount of time. However, a lot of them didn’t fit the curve of my nails so the sides kept lifting up on some. That was pretty annoying and those areas just wouldn’t stick down. Also, not many of the nails fit well. So, in the product photo, the nails with rhinestones are on the thumb, pointing finger, and middle finger. I usually prefer my nails with accents (like rhinestones to either be on the thumb and ring finger or pointer and ring finger, not the first 3). I couldn’t find a nail to fit my middle finger, except for one with rhinestones so I ended up with rhinestones I’m the first 4 fingers, and I just didn’t like the look of that. It seems like you don’t have many options for fit with these nails. And I didn’t like how big the rhinestones were. So these just aren’t for me.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Tools!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These are great! I had used a Jade roller before, but never a Gua Sha, so I really appreciated that these came with a little pamphlet telling you how to use them.

The Jade roller is great quality. It doesn’t squeak at all. Rolls nicely, without any skipping or sticking. The bigger side is great for your whole face, and the smaller side works perfect for under your eyes.

I love using this to rub in any oils or serums I’m using. Sometimes I will put this in the refrigerator to get it cold, and then use it. It feels so nice on! It’s really relaxing whether you use it cold or room temp.

I definitely recommend this set! It’s so affordable but so well made!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: My First Nail Drill and I Love It!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This was my first nail drill and I love it!

It comes well packaged. It’s in a box, and everything is in it nicely.

I’ve been doing my own nails, and wanted a drill to make it easier. I was a little scared since I’d never used one on myself before. This one was so easy! It comes with instructions. It’s so easy to work! It is easy to hold and maneuver, it isn’t too big or heavy. It doesn’t get too hot. I love that all the controls for the drill are on the power cord, so I don’t accidentally hit anything and end up hurting myself while I’m using the drill! I love how it comes with so many attachments! It even comes with a little brush so you can dust off any dust. The one thing I wish is that it had a standard plug, rather than a USB. It seems so many things are USB plugs now though, so it is what it is. But, if it had the standard plug, it would have been perfect! Other than that, I have no complaints!

The ease of use and compact size make this perfect for a beginner like me!

EDIT: There’s no switch or anything to remove the different heads. You just need to pull it out. They push in easy enough, but my goodness are they hard to pull out! It makes sense since you’d been using it and it was rotating. So I wish there was some kind of switch to make it easier to take out the heads. So I’m taking off 1 star because of that.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Quality!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: Love this comb! The tail end of the comb works great to section hair. The teeth of the comb are spaced evenly apart. It feels sturdy.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Very Gentle
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This a really nice serum! It comes in a sturdy glass bottle with a dropper.

Even though this has glycolic acid in it, it isn’t harsh. I don’t have sensitive skin but some glycolic acid products I’ve used have made my skin red while it’s on and I would feel slight tingling. But with this one, I don’t get that at all. So I love that it’s a glycolic acid product that give me the benefits of glycolic acid, but is gentle enough to use every day.

My skin feels smoother. I haven’t noticed any fading of spots, but I’m hopeful with continued use I will! So I will update this review if I notice any fading or if I don’t!

I’ve tried a few products from this brand so far and have really enjoyed all of them! So I would recommend giving this a try!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Clips!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: These are great! You get 20 for $7.99 (at the time of writing this review) which I think is a great deal! They are easy to open and close but clamp tightly onto the finger. They are so helpful when doing poly gel nails! They keep the mold in place, keeping it flat against the nail bed without any bubbling, giving me a smooth poly gel nail! I’m so glad I got these! They’re definitely one of those things you don’t really think you needed until you get them, then you’re wondering how you ever did it without them! If you like doing poly gel nails, these are a great help!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: STRONG Smell, Couldn’t Get Past The Smell to Really Use It Other Than a Drop on My Hand
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
When this first arrived, I was going to open the amazon packaging and I could smell a strong, medicine like scent. So, I immediately thought that it must have broken in transit. Once I opened the amazon shipping package, there was a box inside. There wasn’t anything all over the box, so I opened it, and inside was a glass bottle completely intact. I couldn’t understand why the scent was so strong if the bottle was intact. Then, I thought if I can smell it that strong now, I wonder how it’ll be using it. The scent of the packaging had such a strong medicine kind of pepper smell, it was really overpowering.

Inside the box, there’s a product info card. It has the product on one side with what benefits it’s supposed to have. The other side has specific instructions on how and when to use, and a full list of ingredients. I really liked that!

The product comes in a glass bottle with a dropper. The bottle seems nice and durable. The product itself is a orange-yellowish color. I applied a little to the top of my hand and it felt oily. Someone in another review said it felt oily but they expected that since it was an oil. I’m not sure if they were talking about this product or another one. This is called a serum, so I don’t really expect it to be oily. I’m not sure if it’s some kind of serum, oil combo? I have dry skin so the oiliness wasn’t too bad for me. But, I could still feel it, so if I had oily skin I probably wouldn’t even want to use it.

Anyways, the most use I could get out of it was the little I put on the top of my hand. The scent was so strong, it made me a little sick to my stomach. I’m not usually sensitive to smells, so it must have just been this specific scent - it had a medicinal, pepper type smell. I don’t really know how to describe it, but it wasn’t for me. So, unfortunately I can’t really say whether or not this is a good product. All I can say is that it comes in a nice glass bottle with a dropper, has a really strong scent, and it feels oily. If you’re sensitive to smells, I would say this isn’t for you.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Bad Smell, Don’t Wipe Off Makeup Easily
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
They come in a nice little disposable pack. Theres a plastic area where the top opens and closes. The opening for the wipes wasn’t big enough. It had the little plastic opening with the split in the middle, and it was just TINY! I ended up cutting the plastic part off, and then the opening was big enough.

The wipes are a good size. They are nice and soft. However, they have a weird smell - like cardboard? I don’t know. I can’t really place it, but I don’t like it.

The wipes aren’t too wet. I do a lot of makeup swatches of eyeshadow palettes and things like that. So, I constantly am using makeup wipes to wipe the swatches off of my arms. These work good for that. I wouldn’t use them on my face because, while they’re wet enough to wipe the swatches off my arms, I need to rub more than I do with my usual wipes. Given that, I wouldn’t want to use them on my face where I’d need to rub hard, pulling my skin. It’s not good to use makeup wipes to remove your makeup anyways, since it can tug at your skin and because they usually don’t remove all of your makeup. I still sometimes like to use makeup wipes to wipe the majority of my makeup off, then go in and cleanse my face. But, again, I just wouldn’t use these for that. With the odd smell and needing to rub more to get the makeup off, I wouldn’t want to use these on my face. But, for getting the swatches off my arms they work good.

So, for purposes of wiping swatches off my arm, they work good enough. As I said earlier, with the weird smell and them being not that wet, causing me to need to rub harder, I just wouldn’t use them on my face.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Came With No Safety Seal, Cream Leaked Everywhere, Leaving Jar Half Empty...Disappointing
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in a cute pink box, and a cute jar with pink on it. The cap twists off.

Unfortunately, when I received it and was taking it out, I noticed the box had cream all over it. When I opened the box, there was cream all over the jar. When I opened the jar, there was no protective seal (which I’m guessing it how it was able to spill in the first place), and it looked like about half the product was gone (unless it wasn’t completely full to begin with 🤷‍♀️). With no protective seal, I wouldn’t feel comfortable using it on my face. But with the way the world is right now, I definitely don’t feel comfortable using it on my face. That, along with the fact that it had leaked everywhere, I just wasn’t comfortable trying it.

I can say that it has a nice, light scent. And I did rub some onto my hand and it felt nice and creamy, not too thick, and absorbed easily. But, unfortunately, that’s all I can say about it.

I really think if a company is going to produce cosmetic/skin care products, they should include safety seals. Yes, the jar comes in a box, but anything could have gotten in the jar before it was placed into that box. I don’t know anyone that doesn’t feel a little uncomfortable when a cosmetic/skin care product doesn’t have a safety seal. It’s really disappointing because I was really looking forward to trying this.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Palette! Great Dupe!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:f3800eaac90f72192ba79de85cf049ce]] This comes very well packaged. Protected on a lot of bubble wrap. With how often eyeshadow palettes come with broken shadows, I always appreciate when one comes with extra care taken to protect it! The palette has cardboard packaging. There’s an outer sleeve cover. It has the exact same look on the front and back on the outer sleeve cover as it does on the outer packaging of the palette. The shade names are found on the back of the palette and are also labeled under each shade inside the palette, which I like. A lot of affordable palettes, they don’t have the shade names inside, which is usually fine with me because it’s so affordable and they have to cut costs somewhere. So, when the shade names are included inside the palette on affordable palettes, I always appreciate it. There’s also a big mirror that is just a little smaller than the lid. Again, a lot of affordable palettes don’t have mirrors, which is another way to cut costs for the companies to make the palette a cheaper price. Again, not something I mind since it’s affordable. So, again, when I see mirrors in affordable palettes, I appreciate it. There’s also a removable plastic sheet cover over the shades inside the palette.

The shades are all beautiful. (See photos of swatches).

The mattes have good pigment, feel smooth, not chalky at all. Brushes pick them up well and they apply on the eyes nicely. A few shades need built up a little more, but not too much where I get annoyed 😂

The shimmers/metallics are smooth, pigmented, and pretty shimmery. A brush picks them up easily, and they apply easily and look beautiful using fingers or brushes.

There’s 2 pressed glitters. 1 of them isn’t small circular kind of glitters. It’s small stars. I don’t really love when pressed glitters are in a palette. I have a love hate relationship with glitter. Love the look of it, hate how it gets EVERYWHERE, you’re finding glitter particles everywhere for a while after you use it. Plus, they aren’t safe for the eyes. Get some in the eye and you can scratch your cornea! But, smaller glitter particles aren’t too bad in my opinion. However, with the one in this palette that has stars, those would be waaaaaay more risky than smaller circular like glitter particles. The stars are bigger and have extremely pointy edges. Plus, it’s hard to pick up with your finger. So, I really don’t like that pressed glitter. The other pressed glitter is made up of tiny particles. It picks up easily, sticks pretty good on its own, great with a wet base like concealer or glitter glue. So, I don’t like that 2 shades are pressed glitters, but the palette is so affordable, 2 I don’t like and probably won’t use out of the 18 isn’t so bad to me.

There’s 1 shade that is a concealer shade. It’s a cream kind of concealer. I fear it would dry out, so I’ll be putting a piece of tape over it, with the edge bent over together to leave a little tab to pull it up if I want to use it (I did this with my Huda New Nude palette and the concealer shade hasn’t dried up). The shade is pretty thin and waxy feeling. I don’t feel I’ll ever really use it, but just in case figure I’d keep it from drying out.

This is a dupe for Hudas New Nude palette (see swatch photos comparing the 2).
- They even have the shades named the exact same as the shades in Hudas palette, except one that is named “Spanked” in Huda is named “Spaked” in this palette and one that is named “Love Bite” in Huda is names “EITE” in this palette 🤦‍♀️ 😂 (see photos to see both palettes together).
- All of the shades and their placement in this palette correspond exactly to the shades and their placement in Hudas palette, except the shades “Spanked” and “Love Bite,” and “Concealed” and “Play.” In both palettes, “Spanked” and “Love Bite” are in the first row, the last 2. But, in this palette it’s, “Spaked” and “Love Bite” and in the Huda palette it’s “Love Bite” and “Spanked.” In the Huda palette, “Concealed” is the concealer shade and “Play” is a light peach matte shade. In this palette “Concealed” is a nude type shade, that has a little peachy color to it and “Play” is the concealer shade. So, in the Huda palette there’s a light peach matte shade called “Play” that this palette does not have (this palette has a nude with a slight peach tint to it).
- Other than that, the shades are pretty spot on. In the Huda palette, the metallics feel just a little creamier, but not by much. In this palette they feel really smooth, not chunky at all. As you can see in the swatches, the metallic shades aren’t quite as metallic as they are in the Huda palette, but they are pretty darn close. The colors of all the shades are also pretty darn close. I’d say the shade that’s most off, other than the light peach matte shade not being a full on peach shade and more of a nude shade with a peach tint in this palette, the other shade that’s the most off is “Kinky.” In the Huda palette it’s a deeper, richer red. In this palette it’s more of a burnt orange type red or rust kind of red. You can see in the swatches. Then, the “Concealed” shade in the Huda palette, the corresponding shade in this palette is “Play.” The Huda one is creamier, and has more color. As I said before, the one in this palette is thinner and waxy feeling. The pressed glitters - “Excite” is made of small, red glitter particles in both palettes. The Huda one is smoother feeling, not so rough feeling. “Infatuated” in this palette is totally different than Hudas, it’s silver and stars, not red with small glitter particles.

Overall, I think this is a great palette. Good packaging, a nice mirror inside. The shades perform well. The mattes are smooth and blend easily and have good pigment. The metallic shades are smooth and pigmented and look beautiful. If you were looking for a nude/pink palette, this is a great choice! If you have been wanting the Huda palette but didn’t like the cost of it, this is a great choice instead. The colors are pretty spot on, the differences are slight where once they’re on the eye, it wouldn’t be too noticeable. Other than the star pressed glitter and the nude shade with some peach in it. This palette would definitely give you the same looks. I really do think it’d a great affordable palette!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Cute! Feels Nice! But Mirror Arrived Out In Corner
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes wrapped in bubble wrap well. The front of it is a glossy pink. Inside it is glossy black, with the glossy pink bordering the edges. There’s a nice big mirror inside.

When mine arrived, the mirror in it was coming out in one corner. Normally, when products come damaged and it can be from shipping, I don’t really complain about it in a review. Things get damaged and shipping, and most times if you contact the seller or Amazon, they will handle it well. However, this doesn’t seem to be something that happened in shipping. I feel like if it had just come loose during shipping, I’d be able to push the mirror back in. But, I wasn’t able to push it back in at all. I tried really hard, but it wouldn’t budge. So, I think it was just manufactured that way. Thankfully, the mirror wasn’t broken. But, there are small cracks in the area. So, that’s a bummer. But, the palette is still magnetic and does what I wanted it to do.

The palette has weight to it. Since the mirror was popped out some, I was able to see it’s pretty thick. I’m guessing that along with the magnetic area is where the weight comes from. Maybe they should have used a thinner mirror so it stayed in the lid better. The magnetic area is a decent size, where you can fit a good amount of eyeshadows, blush, bronzer, etc. into it. They adhere well and don’t fall out when moving the palette around.

Overall, I think this is a great magnetic palette. It’s simple but cute. I wish the mirror came in it properly and without cracks, but it’s still usable. Due to the mirror, I’m giving 4 stars.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Provides Great Coverage. Feels Nice On Skin & Looks Smooth!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes with an outer product box. It has the same appearance as the tube of foundation - black with white wording. There’s also a little rectangle in the shade, with the shade number and name. The product packaging looks nice. It comes with a product card saying they love to hear from you and 2 samples for hair products (which I thought was odd for hair products with foundation, but whatever 😂) - 1 for “RG II Hair Loss Clinic Premium Shampoo” and 1 for “Sohair Morocco Argan Oil Hair Essence.” I didn’t try either of the samples so can’t say anything for how those work.

The foundation comes in a squeeze tube. When you twist off the main top, there’s a protective seal. I usually like pumps with my foundations. But, I don’t mind this being a squeeze tube. It isn’t messy at all. I just squirt some out onto my brush or sponge, dab it in areas on my face, then blend it out.

They don’t have a large range of shade options - there’s only 2. With BB & CC creams, they’re usually so thin that a shade that’s a little off from you is usually still okay. I got the shade “#1 Light Beige.” I’m pretty pale. I can make the shade work for me, but I do wish it was a tad lighter. See my photos. I did a photo showing a drop of this Bb Cream, then a swatch doing 1 swipe with a small amount on my finger, then took what was left on my finger from the swatch and dabbed it and blended it out. I also show a photo of a swatch of this BB Blemish Cream, where I also show some blended out. Then I compared it to a swatch of L’Oréal Infallible Pro Glow in 201 Classic Ivory and Maybelline 24 Hr Foundation in 102 Fair Porcelain (I tried to use foundations most people might have tried). As you can see, both are lighter than this BB Blemish Cream. The Maybelline is MUCH lighter. I’m pretty pale, but even that one is a tad too pale for me, so I always have to warm it up with bronzer. But, this BB Blemish Cream is definitely on the darker side for me, but I’m able to make it work.

The formula feels nice. It isn’t too thin or runny. It feels nice and creamy.
