On the product info page it said, “BB Cream Tinted Moisturizer Blemish Balm lets you perfectly blend & build tones from sheer to medium coverage.” Most BB creams I’ve tried are usually sheer to light, not able to go up to medium coverage. But, this actually provides a lot more coverage than I expected with a BB cream! I usually don’t go for BB/CC creams that often because they’re such light coverage. But, there’s times when I want lighter coverage and was looking for a new BB/CC cream and figured I’d give this a try. I’m really glad I did! It evens out my skin tone like I’d expect with a BB cream, but also provides decent coverage too. It doesn’t feel dry on my skin. You can also build it up too if you want, and it doesn’t look dry or cakey. I’d say you can get anywhere from really light coverage (like just evening out your skin tone and maybe covering small, light spots with a thin layer) to good medium coverage (if you build it up some). It builds up nicely enough where it might even be considered full coverage to some, but for me I consider it medium coverage 😂 I can’t build it up too much on myself because the color isn’t a good enough match for me. The more I build it up, the more it doesn’t match my skin. So, when I use this since it’s not really light enough for me, I can only use a thin layer of it. But, I did build it up just to test it out for this review and it looks nice and smooth on the skin whether you’re doing a light layer or building it up.

Overall, I think this is a really great BB cream! It gives you more coverage than other BB creams I’ve tried. I like the squeeze tube. The product feels and looks nice on the skin. I definitely recommend giving this a try if you’re looking for something that will give you light to medium coverage while looking nice, smooth, and not dry or cakey.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Gorgeous!! Such A Great Set!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:a7c1d14af37e75840e647b8774b319cb]] I have been wanting to get a variety of different liquid glitter eyeshadows, but I kept only finding them where you have to buy them individually. I was happy to see this set of 4!

These liquid glitter eyeshadows are GORGEOUS!

They come in a product box. The tubes of product have gold caps and clear tubes, so you can see the shade. The brand name and logo is on the front of the tubes in gold. The applicator is a nice sized doe foot - not too big for my small eyes, but big enough. These are short tubes, so the applicator is short. But, it’s still easy to hold and maneuver. The shade number and name are on a sticker on the bottom of the tube.

You get 4
- 001 Mauve Plum - Mauve liquid shadow with silver glitter.
- 002 Rosy Gold - Rose gold liquid shadow with silver glitter.
- 003 Silver Flash - White liquid shadow with silver glitter
- 004 Sparkle Midnight - Black liquid shadow with silver glitter.

They all look so beautiful. The shimmer with them looks even with application. You can layer them well. They don’t take too long to dry. They lasted well on my hooded eyes without creasing (that is, no more than what I normally get with any eyeshadow). When the light hits these they look so beautiful.

I show photos of swatches - I did 1 swipe for each color. Then I did little areas where I layered the colors to show how they built up. I also did a video showing them.

I think this is such a great set! To get 4 liquid glitter shadows for $13.99 (at the time of writing this review), I think that’s a great deal! All other liquid glitter shadows I’ve found were sold individually and buying 4 would have been way more than this set costs! I’m definitely going to be using these up and hoping they’ll come out with additional colors soon!!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Beautiful Colors!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come together in a little pink box with gold writing and a clear window in the middle showing the glitter shadows inside. There’s a clear plastic sticker sealing the box closed. The back of the box has the ingredients on it.

Inside the box, the glitter shadow tubes are separated by a cardboard piece that has cutouts with separators for between each tube (see photos).

Each tube is clear with “Amber Dazzle” written in gold on the front of the tubes. The cap is silver with clear casing around it. The top of the caps has a gold circle in the middle (see photos). The bottom of each tube has a sticker with the shade name.

Each tube is a good size. Like the size of a full size lip gloss. The applicator is a doe foot applicator. It’s flat on each side, with a rounded tip.

All of the shades are beautiful. They are pretty pigmented with just 1 layer. But can also be built up nicely. See my photos - I did a photo of swatches that were just 1 layer. Then I did another photo of swatches that were 2 layers, where I did a layer, let it dry, and then did another layer.

I had been looking for glitter liquid shadows for a while, but it’s hard to find them as sets and be affordable. Most times I found them as singles and getting multiple ones got pretty pricey. So, when I saw this set I was excited! I’m glad I tried it! You get 6 tubes. They’re all big tubes (like the size of a full size lip gloss). Most liquid glitter shadows I have are tubes half the size of these! So this is great! Plus, you get such an assortment!

You get “Blue Night,” which is a beautiful bright blue. It doesn’t seem like it has glitter in it, just metallic look to it.

“Emerald,” is a beautiful green shade that doesn’t seem to have glitter in it, just metallic.

“Red Wine,” I’m not sure why it’s called “Red Wine.” I guess it’s kind of red. But to me it looks more like a rose gold. It does have glitter in it, but has more of a metallic look overall. The glitter I’m not sure if it’s gold or a rose gold color, but it blends in well.

“Black Moon” is a beautiful dark silver shade. When it’s built up, it looks like it has a black base with silver. It has silver glitter in it.

“Golden Goddess” is a beautiful gold shade with gold glitter.

“Silver Lining,” to me, it looks more like a cream shade, kind of like a white gold, with I think gold and silver glitter, so I guess that’s where the “silver” comes in.

Like I said, I think they are all really beautiful! I think you get a great amount of product. The packaging is nice. They work really well and build up really well. They last good. I think this is a great option if your looking for glitter liquid shadows!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Beautiful Shades! Good Formula!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come in a cute little red product box sealed with plastic wrapping. The back has a sticker on the plastic wrapping that has the ingredients listed (see photos). The box has “To be a sexy lady surprise yourself” on the front along with a red heart sticker that seals the lid and says “Surpise!” Then, under that it says “She Loves” and below that says “True Love Classic Velvet Lip Gloss.” It’s really cute outer packaging. Once you remove the outer plastic wrapping, the back of the box just has a bunch of Chinese writing (see photos), so I like they at least put that sticker on the back on the outside of the plastic wrapping.

The tubes are really small, but cute. They are a kind of matte white with “SHE LOVES” written in silver holographic letters going all around the top. The caps are matte and the color of shade of lipstick, and the bottom of each tube has a sticker that’s the color of the shade of lipstick and the number for the shade. The caps twist off and there’s a doe foot applicator. For some reason when I first went to open one, I pulled on the cap. It came right off, revealing a black cap (see photos). Luckily the cap cover went right back on and stayed on without issues. But, kind of weird it comes off like that. Like it’s not glued on or something? So, of course, I then had to see if they all pulled off like that....they did (see photos). 2 of them I thought weren’t going to come off (I was just pulling lightly, I didn’t want to force them off), but then they came off too. But, again, I’m just glad they went back on and stayed on without issue.

The tubes are small, so the doe foot applicators are small (see photos). The doe foot applicators are thin, longer rectangle shape, flat on each side. I liked them. They were small, but still easy enough to handle.

The colors are all extremely pigmented. They are all nice and smooth. They go on evenly. They don’t take long to dry. They last a good amount of time.

The only downside I see is the tubes are white, so they can get dirty easy. If you have them in your purse or makeup drawer, they will probably end up getting dirty. Also, the caps coming off like they do, like they aren’t glued on good. But other than that, I think it’s a really cute set!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Set! Good Way To Try Touch In Sol Primers!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I had tried the no poreblem primer before when I got it in a boxy charm. I liked it, but didn’t love it. But, I’d always wanted to try their other products but never had. So when I saw this set I figured it was the perfect time! I love travel sized products, so you can try the product to see if you like it!

I really liked the priming essence and priming water. They worked way better for my dry skin than the no poreblem primer did. The no poreblem primer feels too silicone for me. The priming essence and priming water both feel so light but hydrating and my makeup looks so much better when I use one of them!

If you’ve been wanting to try Touch In Sol primers, this is a great way to try some of them! This would also work as a great gift with how cute it’s packaged!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Ingredients! Hydrating!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes with minimal packaging, which I appreciate (I hate getting some tiny little item in some big box!). This comes in cute little pink bubble mailer. It’s come with a pump. This is made in the US. It’s “Korean inspired, American made.” It has no parabens, fragrances, GMO, or allergens, and is cruelty free.

The pump works well. It disperses a good amount of product, but not too much. The product is a nice, thin cream. It glides onto the skin easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky or tacky feeling or residue of any kind.

This has a lot of good ingredients like organic aloe, hyaluronic acid, jojoba, Shea butter, and retinol. These good ingredients are high on the list of ingredients too.

Overall, I think this is a great product. It feels good on the skin and my skin feels hydrated. It isn’t too pricey and a little goes a long way. I can’t speak to any long term results since I haven’t been using it long. But, so far I like it. I would recommend trying this!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Extremely Gentle! Very Hydrating!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in a product box. The bottle is a pump bottle. The product itself is white, a medium consistency cream feel.

It’s very gentle. It doesn’t lather up at all. You just move the product around on your face to get off any makeup or whatever. I always double cleanse, but if I didn’t, this isn’t something I’d use to remove makeup. This is something I’d use in my double cleanse - I use a makeup removing oil to remove my makeup, rinse that off, and then use this cleanser. This is marketed for people with sensitive skin, and I would definitely say it’s very gentle. I’m not saying this wouldn’t clean off makeup, but personally since it doesn’t lather up, I just wouldn’t feel like my face is totally clean just using this. But, I already always double cleanse anyways, and I like how gentle this is so I’m not overly stripping my face.

This is such a nice, gentle cleanser. After using it, my face doesn’t feel stripped or dry. Usually, after I wash my face it feels tight and dry and I need to put on moisturizer. After using this, my face doesn’t feel that way. I don’t feel like I HAVE to apply moisturizer.

Overall, I think this is a great choice for a gentle cleanser! If you’re looking for something extremely gentle, I’d definitely recommend this!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Breakouts Cleared Up Quicker & Seems to Keep Breakouts Away!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes with an outer product box. The tube is a squeeze tube that has a cap that flips open and closed.

The box says that this is “for dry to normal skin with light to moderate acne.” It says, “sulfur-enhanced benzoyl peroxide penetrates deeply to loosen pore-clogging debris and hardened oils while killing bacteria and soothing inflammation. This has 5% benzoyl peroxide in it as the active ingredient and 3% sulfur as an inactive ingredient to fight acne. I really liked that it listed the percentage of each in the product.

This is a medium consistency cream. It glides onto the skin easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any stickiness or residue. It says to apply this sparingly to affected areas once or twice daily as needed. It says that dryness and light peeling may occur during the first few weeks of usage. I used this as instructed, sparingly on affected areas, and chose to sometimes use it twice a day and sometimes only once a day. If I was going out and wearing makeup, I didn’t apply this in the morning, only at night. If I wasn’t going to be wearing makeup and was staying home, then I applied it twice a day (morning and night). I don’t have sensitive skin. I have normal to dry skin, with some areas extremely dry. Usually when I use heavy duty acne fighting products, I get a lot of dryness in the area. I did have slight dryness in the areas I used this if I used it twice a day for a few days in a row. Like one time, I used this twice a day for 4 days in a row. I got a little bit of dryness in the areas I used it in, but after not using this product and applying a good moisturizer morning and night on the area for 2 days, the dryness was gone. After that, I didn’t use this twice a day for more than 3 days in a row. Once I started making sure to do that, I didn’t experience any more dryness.

I really liked the results with this! It really helped my breakouts go away a lot quicker than they do on their own or with other products I’ve used in the past. I also felt this helped keep breakouts away because I usually suffer from hormonal breakouts, but I started using this in those areas before I would usually get a hormonal breakout, and I didn’t get one! So, while this is on the pricier end for me, it’s definitely something I’ll purchase when I run out! And it’s definitely something I recommend if you’re suffering from breakouts!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Set! Makes Fixing Makeup Easy!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This kit is so cool! I’m a huge makeup lover. With that comes sometimes getting palettes I order online that come with broken pans or having palettes I own end up with broken pans. I would always repress them myself, but it always bothered me because they never looked quite the same afterwards. I also like to de-pot singles and put them in magnetic palettes, and it can be complicated and/or I can end up breaking the product. I didn’t even know they made sets like this, but, when I saw this, I needed to try it!

There’s a medium sized magnetic palette in plastic wrapping and then the fix kit in a small box. When you open the box, you’ll take out a plastic box, a small magnetic palette in plastic wrapping, and the makeup repair solution in plastic wrapping. So, you ask, where are the rest of the parts? They fit together in that plastic box! It makes it nice and compact so everything is all together but not taking up a bunch of room. The plastic box, you lift off the main lid, you’ll see a layer that has a strainer type thing in the center and a layer that has 3 circular areas filled with black. You remove the plastic layer with the 3 circular areas, and it reveals 3 black cylinder tower type things. You can lift the layer with the sifter, which will reveal just a bottom plastic part of the plastic box. In the bottom, you’ll find a plastic bag that has the empty tin pans in different sizes - you get 3 sets of 3 sizes. I thought it was nice to get 3 sets of the different sizes. You also get 2 black tools to help put the powder products into the pans or circular areas to flatten them.

Overall, I think this an amazing kit! Is it something anyone who uses makeup needs? No. Especially when everything you can do with this kit, you can DIY without it. But, this kit does make the process easier. So, if you’re a huge makeup lover, order a lot of makeup products online (where you could end up getting broken pans), travel a lot where your products tend to break, just end up with broken products at home, or de-pot products a lot - then I’d say this would be a great kit for you or as a gift for someone who know who fits those things! Again, it’s not something you NEED. But, it’s definitely something that makes things easier!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Feel Soft and Creamy! Not too Pigmented But Do Build Up Well!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come in an outer product box that is sealed in clear plastic wrapping. Once you remove the plastic wrapping, the product box has an open window in the front where you can see the eyeshadow shadow sticks (see photos). The back of the box lists the ingredients be the manufacturer (in China). It also has the cruelty free bunny logo. (See photos)

The eyeshadow sticks are all in black tubes. They have the brand name “Luxaza” along with the name of the shade on the front written in the shade of the shadow stick. There’s black lids on one end and a clear lid on the other end. Under the clear lid, there’s a brush. Now...it was really weird with the brush end. First, I went to pull off the clear cap, and it wouldn’t pull off. So I thought maybe it was screw off, so when I tried to twist it, I heard the clicking sound like the crayon part was twisting out, which I didn’t want since I still had the cap on that end. I then pulled really hard and the clear cap came off. Then, I brushed my finger across the tip of the brush to feel it, and it looked like a bunch of powder came flying off of it. So I thought maybe I missed somewhere where it said the other end of the shadow stick had a powder brush. So, I went to the product page to see and it doesn’t say anything about powder. It was just what I initially thought, that it’s a brush to blend out the shadow stick. So, I brushed my finger across the tip of the brush again to see if more powder came off and none did. So, I then took the clear cap off another shadow stick and brushed my finger across the tip of that brush to see if powder would come off...none did. Then I went through doing that with all the other shadow sticks and no powder type stuff came off of those. So I don’t know what it was with that first one...or if I’m just crazy which is entirely possible too 😂 Anyways, the brush feels nice and soft. It’s short and dense, but still a little fluffy, so blends out color well. Like I said, the clear cap is a little tough to remove...I really had to pull to get it off each shadow stick. Also, you need to be careful when putting the cap back on because the hairs of the brush get in the way.

The crayon part you don’t need to sharpen. It twists up. You twist the end with the brush. There’s not too much product in the tube. I twisted them all the way up to see. It ends up looking to be less than half the size of the tube (see photos, I took a photo of one twisted all the way up). They do feel smooth and creamy. They aren’t very pigmented. To get the pigment you see in my swatches, I needed to go over them each quite a few times (about 5 times). Most are shimmers. 2 of them have glitter particles in them (“Mermaid Teardrop” and “Purple Sunset”). The glitter isn’t too bad, it doesn’t fall out and leave glitter particles everywhere. But, like any glitter, when you try to remove it, you will see glitter particles randomly afterwards (anyone who have used anything with any glitter in it knows what I mean....it’s just everywhere! 😂). I do think that a few of the colors are so similar you don’t notice a difference on the eyes. Especially “Dark Orchid” and “Dark Magenta.” I just don’t notice much difference between them. The brush on the other end blends them out well. They last okay on my eyes. I have really hooded eyes, so any type of cream shadow usually creases and wears off within a few hours. These were no different when I used them on their own. But, if I used them together with powder eyeshadow, they lasted well.

Overall, you get 6 shadow sticks for $9.99 (at the time of writing this review). If these are colors you like and you want just a wash of color, I’d say go for it! They are smooth and creamy. If you’re looking for something with really good pigment, you’re going to have to really build these up for good pigment. Since there’s other cream stick shadows out there that are much more pigmented without needing to build them up, I wouldn’t really recommend these if you want something with a lot of pigment without needing built up.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Works Great! Dries Nails Fast!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes packaged in a nice box and well protected.

It’s a good size. It’s 128 watt! So it has great power! It dries your nails quickly! It has a digital display. The plug is a standard prong plug, which I love! So many products have USB plugs nowadays. I always appreciate when a product has a standard plug!

The shiny gold appearance of it is a little gaudy for my taste. But, I hadn’t seen an at home nail lamp with this high of wattage before, so I was willing to have the shiny gold if I got the high wattage. It actually didn’t look too gaudy once I got used to it.

Overall, I’m very happy! I think you get a great lamp, that works great with such a high wattage.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Set! Variety, Tools, and Labels!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes packaged nicely. It’s all in a little plastic resealable zip lock bag. The bag is thin plastic, but feels durable.

There’s 2 small plastic jars. They have clear bottoms and pink lids. The tops screw off, which is nice so the kids won’t easily come off. There’s 2 spray bottles, one a little bit smaller than the other. They are clad bottoms with pink tops and clear lids. There’s 1 pump bottle. It is a clear bottom with a pink top, and it has the little clip that stops the pump from going down. That’s a really nice addition! Since these are travel bottles, with a pump there’s always a risk it can get pushed down when traveling and make a mess. So, it’s really nice that the little clip was included. There’s 1 squeeze tube. It has a frosted bottom and a pink top. The lid flips open. There’s also a clear spatula and a little funnel to help fill the bottles. There’s also little clear stickers that can be used as labels. They have it written in Chinese and English. There’s labels like “Moisturizer,” “Mouth Wash,” “Hand Cream,” etc.

They all seem durable enough. They are decent sizes. You get a good assortment, a little bag to hold them all, tools, and labels. I think it’s a great little set!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Work Well. Feel A Little Flimsy
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come packaged in a kind of sealed plastic bag. They are easy to put together.

They feel a little flimsy. They hold my shoulder length wigs fine. But, with how flimsy they are, I’m not sure how well they’d hold really heavy wigs.

I show 1 photo that shows the 2 wig stands - One has my brown bob wig on it and the other has my pink shoulder length wig on it. The wig stands are pretty short. As you can see in the photos, the one with both the wigs stands in it (that has my brown bob wig and pink shoulder length wig), you can see the bottom of the brown bob wig is almost touching the table and the bottom of the pink shoulder length wig is bunched a little on the table. The 2nd photo is comparing the size of these wig stands to the size of another wig stand I have. The pink shoulder length wig is on one of these stands, the black shoulder length wig is on a different wig stand. You can see that this wig stand is a lot shorter than the other. So, if you were wanting to have these stand on a surface and hold long wigs, be aware they will be touching the surface of the table.

They do come with an attachment that allows you to hang the wig stand. So, if you’re using these stands for longer wigs and don’t want the wigs touching the surface, you could hang them.

Overall, I think these are nice wig stands. They are a little flimsy and pretty short. But, they get the job done.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Beautiful Glitters!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come together in a nice box that flips open at the top. There’s styrofoam at the top protecting the bottles. There’s an instruction booklet inside. There’s styrofoam holding each of the bottles in place inside, which I liked a lot! There’s stickers on the top of each colored polish. The stickers are the color of the polish and have numbers on them (like P037 and P038). I really liked they had stickers on the TOPS of the bottles so you can easily see which color the polish is. The bottles are all made of glass. They feel nice. And they are decent sizes.

There are NO base or top coats included. This is ONLY colored polishes. So, if you don’t have a top and base coat, you’ll need to get your own to use this set.

I got the chameleon shimmering color and black. Theres 6 polishes in total. There’s 5 glitter polishes - a lime green, a blue (the sticker is a little misleading, it makes it look like it’s a baby blue, but really it’s a royal blue), purple (again, the sticker is a little misleading, it looks like a pink, but the color is a purple), another purple, and a dark blue (again, the sticker is misleading, it looks like it’s a silver, but it’s a dark blue). There’s 1 solid color - a black.

Even the photos on the product page can be a little misleading. On the product page the first photo shows a dark teal glitter, a dark blue glitter, a dark green glitter, a dark purple glitter, a blue glitter and then the solid black. But those are what the shades are supposed to look like with a black base. If you look at the other product photos, especially the 3rd one, you’ll see what the colors are without a black base and with a black base. All the shades look the same in the bottle as what’s shown in the 3rd product photo without a black base, EXCEPT “P041.” In the 3rd product photo “P041” without a black base looks like a silver glitter, just like the sticker on top of the bottle makes it seem. But, in the bottle and on the finger (without a black base), it looks like a dark blue glitter.

These are glitters so they are a little thick, but they’re still easy to work with. They cure easily. They look beautiful with or without the black base. I love that I basically get 10 colors because I get 5 colors when I use a black base, and then 5 slightly different colors if I use the black base.

Overall, I think this is a cute set if you’re looking for glitter polishes!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: They’re Okay...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come in a resealable ziplock bag. Inside the ziplock bag are 3 individual product boxes. Each product box holds 1 pencil and 1 sharpener. I initially thought that there wasn’t a sharpener included like the product page said, but then I saw it at the bottom of the box (I show a photo). I initially thought that it was somehow attached to the box because the thing wouldn’t come out! I had to take something and push it out.

I wanted to try these because I thought they’d be nice to help my brows stay in place but not look and feel stiff like a clear gel can do. These do that. They keep the hairs in place nicely and they don’t look or feel stiff at all. It looks natural. It holds okay. You just need to make sure you really get it in all the hairs and use it to move them into place, then run a spoolie through to spread it around better and blend it out because you do get some areas that get more wax than others, so the spoolie helps spread it around. Then you need to go in and add more. You go back and forth adding some and using the spoolie until they get how you want them and stay in place. They work well.

One thing I really don’t like about these pencils are the caps. They will NOT stay on! If you go to pick up the pencil and grab it at the top where the cap is, the cap just comes right off. Some seem to stay on better than others, but they all come off waaaaay too easily. When I first noticed it I didn’t think it would be too big of a deal, but it’s gotten pretty annoying!

The wax pencil tip wears down pretty quickly. I only used the pencil twice and you can see in my photo a brand new pencil next to the one I’ve used twice. It didn’t surprise me too much since it is wax. Plus, it’s not a big deal since you get 3 pencils, they’re good sizes, and you get sharpeners with each pencil.

Overall, these are okay. For me, I needed to work applying the wax pencil to my brows a lot more than when I add clear brow gel. But, I like the soft and natural look it gives but still keeps my brows in place. If you’re looking for something that will keep your brows in place but will keep them looking soft and natural, I recommend giving these a try!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Cute Brush!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is a cute brush! The back of it has an interesting feel. It feels almost matte. The design is cute.

The brush itself feels durable. It’s a good size. Th brush works well. It doesn’t feel harsh or rough on my scalp. It doesn’t pull at my hair. I really like it!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Way Too Big For Me to Use
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: I’m an adult female, but this is way too big for me to use. I’ve always had a small mouth, it’s even been an issue for my teeth. My teeth were crowded and my dentist always said it’s because my mouth was too small for the normal amount of teeth. I didn’t think about the fact that my mouth might be too small to use this. So, unfortunately I wasn’t able to actually use this since it was just too darn big! It seems like it is a standard jar exerciser. It seems durable. Just unfortunately couldn’t work for me.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: It’s Okay, But Not For Me...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is okay but there’s a few issues I have with it....

First, the mirror came with a little chunk in the corner gone. It’s not a big deal because it’s so small, but it would be nice if the mirror would have come better protected so that it wasn’t missing a piece no matter how small.

Second, this doesn’t really hold much unless you want it to be all separate parts. If you have it all put together with the side trays sitting on each side of the big oval tray, the silicone pieces over top the side trays, and the square tray sitting in the middle of the big oval tray - Then you can’t hold much with it. The side trays with the silicone pieces only hold so much. The one with the lines you can lay brushes in the grooves like shown in the photos on the product page. But, there’s only 4 grooves where brushes can actually lay, and more than 1 or sometimes 2 brushes is all that fits in each groove. The other silicone tray has the X’s that you can put things in so they stand straight up. There’s 11 small ones and 8 big ones. The big ones you could potentially fit more than 1 item in. Also, the middle tray part that the mirror goes over as a lid, if you’re going to do that, then you can only have items in that tray that the mirror will be able to lay flat over, so that limits how much and what you can place in it. If you have it all put together, then it doesn’t take up much room. But, if you have it all in separate parts (like the first photo on the product page), then it takes up a lot of room for not holding too much. I might as well keep using my cups or brush holders for my brushes, which hold a ton of brushes, and plastic or acrylic drawer organizers.

Third, I don’t like how the mirror just sits, it isn’t actually attached. It comes off so easy. One little bump and the mirror falls over. It would be nice if they would have that attached somehow so that it would fold down over the tray but still be connected.

Finally, it’s supposed to be easy to wash and dry. To me, the silicone pieces are not easy to clean. The dust collects on them like crazy. And I try to just wipe off the dust with a dry cloth but the silicone is rubbery and the dust just kind of sticks to it. If you use a wet cloth you’re able to get the dust, but you have to work really hard to get it off. I just don’t like it.

Overall, this just doesn’t work for me. I wanted it to organize things while taking up less space. But, when it is taking up less space, it doesn’t hold enough for me. If you’re looking just to hold a few small things. Like you have some small items that you just want to have a place, then this might work for you. As long as you don’t mind that the mirror isn’t attached and might come off easy.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Lots of Colors!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come in a ziplock bag. The extensions are each packaged in plastic individually there’s a rubber band holding them together. There was also a pair of false eyelashes.

You get 2 of each color - red, sky blue, green, baby pink, yellow, royal blue, lilac, hot pink, and neon yellow. I think it’s a good assortment of colors.

They don’t seem to have much hair in each extension. They seem kind of thin. I show a photo of one of the hot pink extensions, you can see how thin it is. It would be nice if they had more hair. I like that they’re longer, so I could trim them to fit my length.

They don’t come with any kind of care instructions. The product info page says they are heat resistant, but doesn’t say max temperature. The way they came, the extensions ended up being crimped in a few spots, so I straightened the crimped areas out. I used an extremely low temp and it was fine.

Overall, I think getting 18 pieces for $9.99 (at the time of writing this review), it’s a good deal. Just know that each clip doesn’t have much hair - they’re pretty thin. But, mixing them in your hair, they mix in well and look good for a fun addition to your look that isn’t permanent.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Nice Brow Pencil But Nothing Special
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in a nice outer product box. It says it’s made in Korea. There’s no ingredients or cruelty free logo on the box.

The outer packaging of the pencil is a cream color. It has gold writing on it. It looks nice. It’s lightweight. The writing on the back of the pencil is in Korean (at least I’m guessing that’s what it is since the product was made in Korea). There is English on the back that has “Pencil” just under the cap on one end, and “Brush” just under the cap on the other end. So, it’s nice each side is labeled. The pencil is triangular shaped. The spoolie is the standard spoolie. It is soft, not too scratchy.

It glides onto the eyebrows easily. Very creamy. It has good pigment. It blends into the eyebrows well and doesn’t just blend away when you use the spoolie. I usually like micro tips because they give you hair like strokes. You can get pretty good hair like strokes using the tip of the triangle. Using the side you can fill the brows in quickly. The product lasts in my brows all day without fading or smearing.

Overall, I think this is a nice brow pencil. Honestly, I don’t think it’s any better than my drugstore brow pencils that are cheaper. So, I wouldn’t purchase this. But, it is a nice brow pencil.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Good Magnetic Palette! Comes with Metal Adhesives for Bottom of Pans!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes bubbled wrapped well. The plastic see-through part on the lid has a protective sheet stuck to it. I like that you have the see-through part, seeing the shadows through it looks cute. The palette is nice. It has some weight to it. It has a pretty look. The palette has a strong magnetic closure. So it won’t accidentally come open. The one thing is mine was kind of bent. It’s lifted up in the front right corner. I tried to add a photo showing it. I can see it because I know it’s there 😂 but hopefully you can see what I mean! But, the palette is simple and works well and looks nice.

I’d say this is a smaller magnetic palette. The eyeshadows I put in it in the photo were small pans. I then added 3 eyeshadows in normal sized pans at the bottom to give you an idea of the difference. It is a good size to hold a good amount of eyeshadows. Since I just started depotting eyeshadows, I don’t need anything too big. So, it works for me!

I LOVE that this came with 12 circular metal pans that have adhesive on the backs, so you can stick them to any pans that aren’t magnetic. I have just recently started depotting shadows from palettes and it surprised me how many weren’t magnetic! So the little adhesive stickers have come in handy!

This palette holds a good amount of shadows! Plus you get the adhesive metal pans that come with it! The only downside was the front right corner being kind of bent up. But, it does it’s job and it’s still cute. If you’re looking for a cute, affordable, small to medium magnetic palette, I recommend this!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great Starter Set!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes packaged together in a cute purple box.

There’s 8 tubes of poly gel. Each tube is sealed. There’s a nice sized pink nail file. There’s a dual headed tool - one end has the flat metal side to apply the poly gel. The other side is a brush. There’s a bottle of base coat and a bottle of top coat. There’s also a bag of dual forms.

This has everything you need EXCEPT for slip solution, which you can just use alcohol so that’s not a huge deal. The product info page says, “you can use alcohol ,cleanser or base coat to instead, They act the same effect.).” Also, one of the photos on the product page says, “Base coat could be used as a slip solution. It will make it easier to make gel smoothly. No alcohol or nail cleanser needed!” I’ve never heard of using cleanser (what cleanser do they mean? 🤷‍♀️) or base coat as a slip solution. But I’m pretty new to poly gels, so I could just not know. Unless it’s just this brands base coat that can be used as a slip solution? 🤷‍♀️

There’s a good assortment of colors. You get “clear,” “nude,” “pink,” “orange red,” “bean paste” (I’m not sure why the product info page calls it that but it’s like a pinky mauve type color to me), “brown” (this is like a light tan color), and 2 “color changing” (one looks like it goes from a hot pink or purplish pink to white and the other looks like it goes from a pinky red to a white).

Overall, I think this is a great set. There’s a good assortment of colors. The poly gels work well. You get everything you need (EXCEPT the slip solution). So, I think this is a great set for anyone, especially someone starting out with poly gels.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Cute Little Organizer!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: This is a cute little organizer! It’s heart shaped. It holds a good amount of products without taking up much room. It can’t hold items that are too big since the little compartments aren’t huge. Like one compartment can hold 2 tubes of lipstick. I have short little lippies that are kind of like small pencils. I can fit about 5 and 1 tube of lipstick in a compartment. So, you can fit a good amount of smaller items. If you want to store anything bigger, you’ll want to get an organizer with bigger compartments. But for the little things cluttering up your counter, this is perfect!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Good Assortment...I didn’t get the golden silk line though
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
These come in a sealed bag that you rip off the top part and there’s a ziplock. It’s nice so you can keep everything in the bag if you want. Then, inside that there’s another ziplock bag that has everything inside it.

Everything is individually sealed.

I was supposed to get:
15 piece nail art brush set ✅
1 box of nail art rhinestones (in a white container which different sections for the different colored rhinestones) ✅
10 assorted colors of nail stripping tape ✅
12 pots of foiled stickers in 2 colors ✅
6 pots of colorful white nail glitter ✅
1 box of half cover clear false nail tips ✅
1 box of nail decals golden silk line ❌ I did NOT get this. It seems in place of this I got a jar of more rhinestones but these are all gold rhinestones in different shapes and sizes (see photos)

So, I didn’t get the nail decals golden silk line, which stinks. But, at least I got something else in place of it instead of just being short 1 item.

Everything is separated nicely. The brushes all look and feel nice. They work well. The nail tips feel nice. I like that the foiled pieces are in both gold and silver and that you get so many. I also really liked that the colored rhinestones are in the little container with separate areas to keep the colors separated.

Overall, I think this is a nice set for nail art. You get a bunch of different things, and I think the price is pretty good for everything you get.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Beautiful Multichrome Pigments!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:bde866136544c24b41b9800127851a48]] These come with the 2 jars in a little bubble wrap bag. Inside the jars are held together with some strong plastic sealing (see photos). I really liked that because it helped ensure the jars didn’t break or the lids didn’t come loose and end up with powder everywhere! So I loved that!

The jars are plastic. On the lids is a sticker with the brand name, it’s placed on there unevenly so probably done by hand. The lids twist off and there’s a protective seal on the jars inside. Be VEEEERRRYYY careful when you pull off the protective seals. They are easy to lift and pull off, but I ended up dropping one of the seals after I took it off and it got pigment all over (see photos). I don’t have nails, which probably would have helped me hold onto them. In hindsight I should have used tweezers to pull them off. But, no big deal! The jars are both look to be filled up pretty evenly and the jars are pretty full.

These are beautiful! The shift is definitely more noticeable with the teal one than it is with the purple, but they are still both really beautiful. The shifts I see with the teal are the dark teal color, a brighter teal, dark purple, a pinky purple and a dark green. The shifts I see with the are the purple color, a royal blue color, a brighter blue, and a pinky purple.

These are loose pigments. I touched my finger on the jar to pick some up and swiped it onto my arm. It goes on pretty thin and then when I try to build it up, that only works so well....if I put a swipe on then add another swipe it builds up okay. But, if I try to add more swipes than that, it kind of moves the pigment around and I end up getting uneven areas. When you try to apply them with a brush, a brush picks the pigment up really well, but when you go to apply it, it just kind of blends it away. The more you try to add, the more it seems to blend away. But, since these are pigments, they really should be applied to a sticky base. I always use NYX Multitasker Mixing Medium as glitter glue, but really it’s to use to mix in with loose pigments. So, I took a very tiny dot of the NYX Multitasker Mixing Medium and put that onto my arm. Then, I took a brush and picked up a small amount of pigment. I applied the pigment I picked up with the brush onto the area I put the NYX Mixing Medium. The pigment stuck to it really easily and made it look beautiful - smooth, pigmented. The NYX Multitasker Mixing Medium is just a clear gel like consistency. You get a sticky area wherever you apply it. So, you don’t have to use a mixing medium. Anything that leaves a sticky area for the pigment to grab onto will work, like glitter glue, cream eyeshadow, concealer - just apply it while the product is still wet. I show a photo of the teal where I applied it on the NYX Multitasker Mixing Medium, on a white cream eyeshadow, and on a concealer (LA Girl Pro Conceal in Fairest). I also have a photo of the purple where I applied it on the NYX Multitasker Mixing Medium, on a white cream eyeshadow, and on a concealer (LA Girl Pro Conceal in Fairest). They all held onto the pigment perfectly and the pigment looked beautiful! I also tried all 3 as bases with the pigment on my eyes and they worked just as well. They lasted all day without fading. I definitely want to try more colors!

Overall, I think these are beautiful multichrome pigments! They have beautiful shifts. As I said, I can see the shifts in the teal one a lot easier than in the purple one, but that’s usually the case when I have dark purple multichromes - for me, it always seems like it’s harder to tell the different shifts in a dark purple. In my opinion, most multichromes are usually pretty pricey. At the time of this review, these 2 multichrome pigments were $25, so that’s $12.50 a piece. Considering you get a little jar full of pigment, I don’t think that’s too bad. For example, a JD Glow multichrome eyeshadow (pressed in a pan) is $15. I don’t mind paying more for an eyeshadow over a pigment because I just prefer working with eyeshadows pressed into a pan rather than loose pigments. So, for these jars to end up being $12.50 each, I don’t think that’s too bad. They look beautiful and perform well!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Very Pretty!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is really pretty. The leaves are a pretty green. The flowers look nice. It looks pretty realistic to me. The flowers and leaves and stem all feel like they are good quality. They don’t feel thin or cheap. They feel nice and durable, but still look really nice and not overly fake. There’s a beautiful ribbon to tie it. I didn’t get this to use on my head, I got it for a little project I’m doing. But, I did try it on my head and it fit nicely and didn’t feel uncomfortable at all.

Overall, I think this is really pretty! I definitely recommend!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Small Jar, But Very Moisturizing!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in an outer product box. The bottom of the jar is made of thick glass that is frosted, the top is thick, white plastic. It has a nice appearance. There’s a plastic safety seal, which I always like. The cream is white. It has a thick consistency, but just glides onto the skin and melts into the skin. It doesn’t feel heavy on my skin. It actually does t feel like anything on the skin...it just feels like you have really moisturized skin without anything on. It absorbs quickly, it doesn’t leave any residue or sticky feeling. The cream does have a scent, like citrus, but it isn’t too over powering and is a nice smell.

The cream feels nice on the skin. I feel really moisturized after applying it. My skin feels nice and soft. Whenever I’ve applied this at night, the next morning my skin still feels moisturized. I have dry skin, some really dry areas, so I love anything that can make my skin feel moisturized and keep it feeling that way for a while! It works nicely under makeup too. I wouldn’t use it under my makeup all the time, but on days when I’m extra dry, this works perfect! A little goes a long way, which is good since the jar is so small!

I haven’t noticed any help with brightening or anything, but I am hopeful! The only thing I don’t like is it’s a pretty small jar for the price. But, a little goes a long way and with so many great ingredients and how moisturizing it feels, I would consider paying that. But, I can’t say for sure if I would just yet. So, I’ll update the review once I’ve used this for longer. So far, I definitely recommend this if price isn’t a factor! It has great ingredients, I love the way it feels on my skin.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Okay, But Not Worth the Price...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
It’s odd how much lace it looks like this wig has in the product photos, but in reality it isn’t that much. I wish there was a little bit more. But, you can work with it. The hair is really nice. It didn’t shed too bad. It looks realistic - not too synthetic. It feels nice and full. It isn’t bad quality, but it isn’t great quality either.

Overall, the wig is okay. For the price, I’d rather just find something that is in the same price range or a little more that is better quality, more lace. I feel like the current price point of this wig is a little much given how there isn’t a lot of lace and the quality isn’t that great. For the same or a little more you can get one that has a good amount of lace and is better quality. If you’re looking for affordable, there’s options out there much more affordable than this that have the same kind of quality.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: So far so good...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: So far I really enjoy this! The EGF is at the bottom of the ingredient list so there isn’t a lot in it, which I’m okay with. It’s my first product with EGF in it and I read that EGF can be harsh on the skin. I don’t have sensitive skin but did get slightly red when using this. I’ve been using it every other night. It moisturizes my face well. I haven’t noticed any other benefits so far. If you’re looking for something with a high amount of EGF, this isn’t for you since it’s so far down on the ingredient list. But, if like me, you’re looking for something with some EGF in it to get you started but not be too much, this is a good one to start with!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Amazing Mattes! So Pigmented, Soft, and Smooth!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes bubble wrapped nicely. The palette is sealed with plastic wrapper. There’s a cardboard sleeve that looks just like the palette on the front and back. The ingredients are listed on the back, which includes talc and mica. There’s a cruelty free logo (leaping bunny, and the brand MS Glamour can be found on the leaping bunny website).

The palette is cardboard and has magnetic closure. There’s a protective plastic sheet over the eyeshadows. There’s no mirror. There are shade names below each shade.

There’s 35 shades - 20 matte, 6 shimmer, 3 sequin (matte with glitter in it), and 6 pressed glitters.

I did finger swatches on my clean forearm (no primer, lotion, etc.). I labeled how many swipes (layers) for each shade.
I didn’t swatch the pressed glitters because I hate pressed glitters! They just get everywhere! Even when you don’t use them, they still creep into the other shadows and contaminate them! So I just put a piece of tape over the pans with pressed glitters in them and pretend they aren’t there 😂

The matte shades really surprised me! They were all amazing! So soft and smooth, really pigmented! There was only 1 in the first row that needed 3 swipes (layers), and then some of the pastels on the third row needed 2 swipes, but those were still really pigmented for pastel shades and built up really well! The shimmer shades were soft, smooth, and pigmented. They weren’t in your face shimmery but they had a slight sheen and looked better when wet. The mattes are definitely where this palette shines, which is good because it’s mostly mattes! The sequin shades are mattes with really tiny pieces of glitter in them. You can’t hardly see them when swatched. So, like most sequin shades, my guess is you could use it like a matte and when you start to blend it, the little pieces of glitter will just fall away, but you could pack it on and/or use it wet, to keep the glitter. When I put my finger in the sequin shades to swatch them, they were all really soft, where I got a lot of kickback in the pan. But, the sequin shade in the third row was different. It felt grittier and didn’t give any kickback, and took 3 swipes to get the swatch you see. I’m not sure why that one was so different.

Overall, this palette was really surprising! I wasn’t expecting it to be so great! The matte shades are definitely where this palette shines! They are so soft and smooth and pigmented! They aren’t patchy at all! They are easy to blend. I’m really happy with this palette! If you’re looking for some amazing colorful mattes, you should grab this palette!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Beautiful Palette! Great Shadows - Pigmented, Soft, Smooth! Unique Packaging!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes packaged really well! It comes in its own shipping box. Mine came in a bigger Amazon box with other items from an order. So, if you just ordered the palette on its own, I’m not sure how Amazon would ship it. But, inside the Amazon shipping box, there was another brown shipping box with the brands name on it (“Hot Sugar”). It was sealed with tape. Then, when you opened that, it had the palette inside an inflatable air cushion. I don’t see many companies using these, but they are so cool! I feel like it’s the best way to package a palette so it arrives safely. If I had a palette packaged like this and a shade or more came broken, I wouldn’t blame the company at all! I would think the company did as much as they could, more even, but it still happened. Luckily, this palette arrived completely safe, all in one piece, no broken shades. And I believe it had everything to do with how well the company packaged it! I always appreciate companies doing at least the bare minimum to make sure an item arrives undamaged, but it always means a lot when I see a company go above and beyond to make sure an item arrives undamaged. I remember that company did their best to protect my purchase, so I will return to them for future purchases. I don’t mean to ramble on about this! I just had another palette from a different brand that came with not even the bare minimum protecting it and it had a shade broken that got EVERYWHERE! So going from that to this palette being protected so well, it meant a lot! So, i will definitely be happy to buy from this company again just on that alone! Okay, I’m sure you’re sick of me talking about that! Let’s get to the actual palette! 😊

The palette has an outer pink cardboard sleeve. It is made in China. It has ingredients listed on the back, which include talc and mica. There’s a cruelty free logo. I looked up “Hot Sugar” to see if it was in fact cruelty free, but couldn’t find anything one way or the other. The box said the palette was “manufactured for Chongqing Fendai Cosmetics Co., Ltd.,” so I looked that up too and couldn’t find anything one way or the other. So, I can’t guarantee that it’s cruelty free. Just that they have the cruelty free logo on the box.

The outer design on the palette is really interesting! I’ve never had one like this before! It is blue and black animal print. It has a rough feel to the outside. It feels like it’s fake leather possible that it’s made out of. The palette has some weight to it. It feels really well made. Not cheap. It has magnetic closure. There’s a big mirror inside. There was a plastic protective sheet over the shadows.

I did swatches. I did finger swatches on my clean forearm (no primer, lotion, etc.). I did 1 swipe for each one. They were all really soft, smooth, and pigmented. The shimmers are standard shimmers. They aren’t metallics where you get that wet, metallic look. But, they are really pigmented. They pick up very easily with a brush or your finger. They give a nice soft sheen when used dry. If you wet them you get more of a sheen.

Overall, for $19.99 (at the time of writing this review) I think this is great!! The palette itself is very nice! It is really well made. It doesn’t look or feel cheap at all. It has an interesting design on the outside! It’s something different, which I like! The colors are all beautiful. They perform great. They are pigmented, soft, and smooth. They apply nicely on the eyes. They are easy to blend out. They aren’t patchy at all. I’d definitely recommend this!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Cute headbands!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: I love these! They’re so cute! They work perfect to keep my hair out of my face when I’m doing my makeup! They are comfortable. They fit my head nicely without being too loose or too tight. They haven’t seemed to stretch over the many uses. They are so soft! I love that you get 2! I use one for when I do my makeup and I use the other for when I do my skin care routine! It’s perfect! And they’re such great quality for such an affordable price! I definitely recommend!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Pretty...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is pretty! I feel if you had thicker hair or really curly hair, you might struggle a little with it. The clip isn’t too big or strong. It just barely held my hair and my hair isn’t thick at all. The little pieces that come off with the beads can get tangled in your hair when your trying to apply it, so I feel like if you had really curly hair that might be even more of an issue than it was for me with my straight hair. But, I do like that the pieces with the beads can be moved around. You can move them and bend them into different positions, so I thought that was great. I moved them around a little and was able to get it into my hair easier.

Overall, I think this is really pretty. If you’re willing to work with it a little, it looks pretty once you get it in your hair.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Beautiful Tube! Beautiful Glitter! A Lot of Glitter & Even in Just 1 Swipe!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in an outer product box. It is made in Korea. There’s no ingredients in English.

The tube is really pretty! Pink and sparkly! The glitter on the cap doesn’t transfer onto your hands, so that’s great! The tube is small, but about normal size for a liquid glitter shadow like this.

The applicator is a little doe foot. It’s easy to hold and maneuver.

The glitter in it is great! A lot of liquid glitter shadows like this you need to layer to get a good, even amount of glitter. With this one, I did 1 swipe using the doe foot applicator on my arm and it came out with lots of glitter and was evenly spread! You can see in my swatch photo.

Once it dries, it stays in place well, even on my hooded eyes!

If you’re looking for a really glittery liquid shadow that will apply it evenly and a great amount of glitter from the start, I’d recommend this!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Comes in Nice Packaging, Great Screened Area, Not Sure It’s Worth the Price.l.
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text: This comes in a nice product box. The jar is really nice. The screened area is great! It’s not messy like most loose powders, so that I love! I’m pretty pale, I got the shade fair to light and it works well for me. I have normal to dry skin with some areas extremely dry and I’m in my mid 30s. I usually use powder sparingly in specific places where I need it, so I don’t often use powder foundations. I like that this has SPF 30, but wish it was higher. It goes on nicely without making me look too dry or cakey. But, I don’t feel like it gives the coverage I want. Really, it didn’t seem like it covered much of anything. So, then, I used my usual liquid foundation and used this as a kind of setting powder in areas where I needed a little extra coverage or needed to set, and it worked good for that. But, at the current price of $48 it isn’t worth it to me.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Works Well, Need to Leave on Longer for Opaque Color. Not Worth the Price for Me...
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I tend not to like matte lipsticks because they always make my lips feel so dry. But, they last better than gloss. So, when I saw this and the claims of how long it lasted, I figured I’d try it! I was worried it would be more of a gimmick than anything, but hoped it would work to help me have lip color that lasts all day without the dryness!

You have to be careful when putting it on to make sure you stay within your lips. If you get anywhere outside the lips, that area will be stained too. So, if you tend to do that a lot when applying lipstick, I definitely wouldn’t recommend this! It definitely takes a little longer than applying a regular lip product since you have to let it sit on your lips for at least 10-15 seconds before taking off the mask, longer if you want the color to be more intense. Whenever I left it on for only 10-15 seconds, the color was very, very faint. It gave my lips color, but not much. It said if you want more intense color to leave it on for 39-45 seconds, so I tried that the next time. It definitely gave my lips more color, but still not opaque color. So, the next time I left it on for almost a minute. Finally, I had opaque color. Having to leave it on for almost a minute can seem annoying, but I figured it’s worth it to have it last all day. It does last really well, way longer than any other lip product I’ve tried. But, when I eat or drink, it starts to fade a lot. So, if you’re not going to be eating or drinking much while wearing it, then it will last well for a long time. But, if you’re going to eat or drink a lot while wearing it, it definitely is going to fade.

Overall, I think it’s a cool product. It’s definitely unique I think. But, for me, it’s pretty darn expensive. I’d rather just keep applying my lipstick or lip gloss throughout the day and only spend a few dollars on the product than have to apply it only once or twice but spend $32.50 on it. So, I’d say it’s up to you what is worth more to you. If you’re willing to pay $32.50 for your lip product to last all day on your lips and not have to keep reapplying it, then I’d recommend this. I will say remember if you’re eating or drinking a lot, you might feel the need to apply it again a second time after a while, but that’s still better than having to reapply it a ton like with most lip products. But, if like me, you’d rather spend less and just keep reapplying your lip product, then I wouldn’t recommend this for you.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Gorgeous Packaging! Amazing Formula! I Love All 3!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in a nice outer product box. The ingredients are listed on the back. It’s cruelty free, talc free, gluten free, and paraben free. It’s made in the PRC. (See photos).

The palette is plastic. It has a white marbled appearance, which I really like. It looks really pretty. Personally, I don’t usually like to leave things sitting out on my counter. I feel like it looks like clutter. But, sometimes packaging is pretty enough where I don’t mind leaving it out. This is one of those items. There was a plastic protective sheet over the pans. A nice thing that this palette has is that the pans can be taken out, so if you want to put them in another palette or I suppose you could even rearrange them. There are shade names below each pan. The blush is “Blessed,” the highlighter is “Goddess,” and the bronzer/contour shade is “Incredible.” I like the names!

They are all very soft, very smooth, and pigmented. They all applied beautifully! They picked up easily with a brush. Applied nicely and blended so easily! I applied too much of the bronzer/contour shade one time, I just wasn’t paying attention and dug my brush in too much, and I was still able to blend it out easily! I love when powder products are like that! I hate having to always pay attention and be careful not to pick up too much product or else I have to spend forever blending it out or apply a skin tone powder to blend it out. So, I love when powders are like these and blend so easily that it’s okay if you accidentally apply too much because you can easily blend them out!

The blush is a beautiful light peachy color. The color works great for my pale skin. It’s pigmented, but since it’s a light peach color, it gives a nice kiss of color to the cheeks. Even if you really put a lot of product on your brush, it never looks like too much! Given that, I don’t think this would work well for darker skin tones. I’m pretty pale. I usually go for the lightest foundation shade, and even on me this blush gives just a kiss of color. It does build up slightly, but I still feel like it never looks like too much. Hopefully they have other shade options for darker skin tones because the formula is great! The blush has a slight sheen to it, but it’s just a touch of sheen. It shows up more when I swatched it than it does on the cheeks. On the cheeks, I don’t notice the sheen at all. But I do feel like it doesn’t look at flat as a matte blush, if that makes sense? I like that because I love a glowy look and love blushes with sheen, but sometimes blushes with sheen emphasize texture too much. So, I love that this sheen isn’t really noticeable, but still looks better to me than a matte blush.

The highlighter is a beautiful gold. I was a little worried it might be too dark for me looking at it in the pan, but it seemed like it would be odd if it was too dark for me since the other shades seemed like they’d work so well for me. After swatching it I saw that it was pigmented, but a light gold, so I figured it would work for me, and it did! It’s pigmented and smooth. It gives a nice highlight. You can get a slight glow from within or build it up to be a little more. I always like having the option. It works beautifully on my skin. It didn’t emphasize texture. It didn’t look powdery at all! I love it!

The contour/bronzer shade is just as good! It’s soft and smooth. It has good pigment. It goes on easily and blends out really easy, even if you accidentally apply too much, it’s still really easy to blend out. The color works perfectly for me.

Overall, I think this is an amazing palette! I love all the powders! They all work beautifully! They are beautiful colors that work perfect for my pale skin. They are all so buttery, soft, and smooth. They are so easy to work with. It says the palette was $28, but now it’s $19.95 at the time of writing this review. With the packaging being so pretty and nice, decent pan sizes, and the powders being so beautiful and working so well, I would spend $28 on it, but the $19.95 is even better! If you have pale to light skin like me, I definitely say go for it! I don’t think you’ll be disappointed! If you have darker skin, I hope they have other shade options because the formula of these powders is great!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Pink I chose was a medium pink shade. Pink I got was a light bubblegum pink
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in an outer product box that is inside a sealed plastic bag. It is made in the US. The ingredients are listed. The product box says that this is “80% organic. Made with organic ingredients, cruelty free.”

This claims to be a moisturizing lipstick. That sounds great to me, because I hate the feeling of my lips being dry at all. It claims to be highly pigmented, and have lasting color. It also said it has a vanilla fragrance.

I liked that it’s made of 80% organic ingredients, and it also had botanical extracts and essential plant oils. Looking at the ingredients, there’s some great ones like castor seed oil, sunflower seed oil, Shea butter, cocoa seed butter, jojoba seed oil, coconut oil, and vitamin E.

The tube is plain matte black with the brand logo on the cap. It has some weight to it. It kind of feels like it’s metal, but when I pull the cap off, the cap feels like plastic. The bottom part where you twist the lipstick is the part that feels like metal. It’s also the part that has the weight to it. But I’m not sure if it really is metal or not. The cap pulls off. It goes onto the bottom part really snugly, so I don’t see it coming off accidentally.

I got the shade “Crazy For You.” The product photo swatch made it look like a pretty medium pink color that had maybe a little peach color to it. It looked really pretty! I don’t think the color matches the product photo swatch much. I still like the color, but it’s a lot lighter than the product photo made it look, and no peach in it at all. It’s a bubblegum pink color. It’s pretty light with 1 layer. I did 2 swatches - One is 1 layer, the other is 3 layers. Even with 3 layers it didn’t look as dark as the product photo swatch.

There is no vanilla scent at all. I found that really weird since the claims on the product box state it has vanilla fragrance and the last ingredient listed is fragrance. But there’s zero scent, not even a hint of scent. I don’t mind if lipsticks don’t have fragrance. I just find it odd to claim it has a certain fragrance when it has no fragrance at all! The formula is really nice. It’s very moisturizing. It doesn’t feel dry at all. So I agree with the claim that it’s a moisturizing lipstick. It lasts nicely on the lips, so I agree with the claim of lasting color. The color is pretty, but I wish it was the color I saw in the product photo. I wouldn’t say it’s highly pigmented. It has decent pigment. It might be the color I got, but 1 layer is light, and it takes 3 layers to get it to show up more.

Overall, I think it’s a nice lipstick. The packaging is simple but nice. The formula is moisturizing and the color lasts well. I don’t like that the color isn’t what I chose based on the product photo swatch. It’s not even close, aside from the fact that it’s pink. The product photo swatch is a medium pink color, with a hint of peach. The color I got is a light bubblegum pink. So, I’m taking 2 stars off for that. I thought about only taking 1 star off since I do like the color. But, when you choose a color of lipstick, you choose it for a reason (whether it’s a color you like on yourself, a color you want to try out, a color you like that you want in your collection, etc.). Whatever the reason for choosing the color you choose, you should get that color. I understand sometimes colors can be off a tiny bit when ordering things online. But the pink I received is way off from the pink I chose. Other than that, the formula is nice. If you like moisturizing lipsticks and don’t mind risking getting a color way off from what you chose, I’d recommend this!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Nope...much better options out there that actually work for sooo much less than this.
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
Overall, the product is okay. It glides onto the skin nicely. It feels silky smooth (thanks to the silicones in it). But, my skin doesn’t feel extra hydrated, I haven’t noticed any difference after using it for a month, let alone 7 days. I don’t like rating things based on price, but when it comes to something at this price point, I feel like it’s going to play a part in the decision, at least for me it would. And for me, the ingredients and effects resulting from this product just aren’t there to justify this price point. Honestly, even if it was way cheaper (like $20), I still wouldn’t purchase it. There’s so many great skincare products out there that are waaaaaay cheaper that I’ve actually seen results from. So, I can’t recommend this.

I wanted to love this.....

A serum for $171 (at the time of writing this review), I figured this had to have some pretty special stuff in it. I mean, it must have some kind of magic potion in it that reverses time and makes me look like I’m 20 years old again. Right? I mean, it’s gotta have something pretty darn special in it to price it so high and expect people to pay it. Plus, it’s not even from a brand I had ever heard anything about, so it wasn’t just some name brand that was what would hike the price up...You know, how some companies just feel like since their brand is well known and popular that they can slap their name on their products and it doesn’t matter if there’s nothing in them or about them that would account for the price other than the brand name?! Yeah, well as far as I know this isn’t a well known, or even known brand, so that’s definitely not the reason for the high price. So that means there has to be something in it that makes it worth a higher price. And it has to be something amazing to make it worth a price as high as $171 for 1.7 oz of product! Right?! Unfortunately, that does not seem to be the case.

The info for this product on the Amazon product page is seriously LACKING! On the top of the product page where there’s usually some bullet points with info, there’s nothing. You scroll down a little and there’s a small paragraph. It claims to “rejuvenate your skin in 7 days.” That’s a HUGE claim! Most skin care product I use and have tried usually say to use consistently for a month or so before you’ll see results. So, to claim to see results in 7 days is huge. Looking at this product on the company’s website, it states that clinical tests were done “under dermatological control on 29 volunteers aged between 35 and 60, including sensitive skin.” It states that 81% had “skin more radiant, luminous and revitalised ,” 81% had “visibly rejuvenated skin,” and “in 1 month all the signs of aging are visibly corrected.” Again, some HUGE claims, but it seems 81% is the lucky number 🤨

The ingredients weren’t included on the product page. All it says is, “The new anti-ageing serum includes an innovative active ingredient that multiplies by 8 the power of absorption(2) of your skin, making the serum penetrate deeper.” Ummmm....what?! I don’t know about you, but that description is not helpful in any way! I’m not even totally sure I get what it’s trying to say. It includes an innovative active ingredient....why not say what that innovative active ingredient is? This innovative active ingredient multiplies by 8 the power of absorption of your skin. What on earth is that supposed to mean? “...multiplies by 8 the power of absorption of your skin...” I take it to mean that this ingredient multiplies the absorption of your skin by the power of 8, so 8 times. Looking at the company’s website and the info for this product on there, most of it says the same things but some parts are said differently, which makes it seem clearer, at least to me. It states, “...includes an innovative active ingredient that increases 8 times the power of absorption(2) of your skin making the serum penetrate deeper...” So, that definitely makes me think it’s saying it increases absorption of your skin 8 times. But, it just would be nice if they stated that in a way that was a little clearer.

The paragraph description on the product page also says that the innovative active ingredient that increases the absorption power of your skin 8 times makes “the serum penetrate deeper and activate the capacity of self-protection during the day and unfold all its power of regeneration by night, working in a synchronized way and thus achieving more visible results in less time.” It does state you use the serum morning and night. But, I wondered how the heck the serum would know to work differently in the day than it does at night. How would it know to activate self-protection during the day and start regenerating at night? It states that, “At night, when you sleep and while your skin is more receptive, it repairs damage, reactivates cellular regeneration and rejuvenates your skin. By day it increases the resistance of cells to oxidative stress and protects the skin defending it against external aggression.” Again, I don’t really see how it would know to do something different at night than it does during the day? But, I’m not a scientist so it could just be beyond my understanding!

It sure would be nice to know what they believe is this innovative ingredient, because looking at the Amazon product page it doesn’t mention much, let alone what this innovative ingredient is. Looking at the product on the company’s website it states “NEW AND REVOLUTIONARY FORMULA. 22 ACTIVE INGREDIENTS.” It goes on to state that the serum incorporates “Glyco 8-Power biomolecules that generate small vesicles that trap inside them the active ingredients of the formula. Their great affinity for the lipids of the skin make them penetrate easily, liberating the content inside, increasing by 8 the capacity of absorption and multiplying the benefits of the serum on your skin.” I have no clue what “glyco 8-power biomolecules” are and doing a search on Google doesn’t explain it either. All that shows up is this serum. I’m not sure if the “innovative ingredient” is supposed to be the “glyco 8-power biomolecules?”

INGREDIENTS
Let’s take a look at this products ingredients...

Antioxidant Ingredients: Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Polygonum Cuspidatum Root Extract, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E)

Cell-Communicating Ingredient: Retinyl Palmitate (Vitamin A)

Skin Brightening Ingredients: Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract

Skin-Identical Ingredients: Glycerin, Squalane, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ceramide 3

Soothing Ingredients: Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Panthenol

Antimicrobial/Antibacterial Ingredients: Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Alcohol, O-Cymen-5-Ol

Moisturizer/Humectant Ingredients: Glycerin, Pentylene Glycol, Ethoxydiglycol, Caprylyl Glycol, Butylene Glycol, Dimethiconol, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Soluble Collagen, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Prunus Persica (Peach) Kernel Extract, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Sorbitol

Perfuming: Ethoxydiglycol, Fragrance

Preservative: Potassium Sorbate, Phenoxyethanol, O-Cymen-5-Ol

Theres a total of 57 ingredients.

Theres 3 ingredients that I consider great (superstar) ingredients - glycerin, licorice root extract, and Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract.

There’s 18 ingredients that I consider to be good - sunflower seed oil, hydrogenated lecithin, bifida ferment lysate, milk protein, squalane, vitamin E, Shea butter extract, hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, vitamin c, soluble collagen, Polygonum cuspidatum root extract, scutellaria baicalensis root extract, centella asiatica extract, Lupinus Albus Seed Extract, rosemary leaf extract, sodium hyaluronate, retinyl palmitate, and Panthenol.

Even though there’s a total of 21 great and good ingredients, that is less than half of the ingredients. In a product as high priced as this, I expect a lot more great (superstar) type ingredients.
