AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Matte liquid lip NOT a gloss. So drying it’s like it pulls every bit of moisture out of your lips!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
Color - “Stone”

I don’t like matte lip products. Usually, they’re way too drying. I don’t mind semi matte lip products that aren’t too dry. But, for the most part, matte lip products just feel too drying on my lips. I was a little confused by the product page for this. The title said it was a “lip liner and lipstick set,” but also said it was a “matte lip gloss” and “liquid lipstick.” I’m not sure how it could be matte and a gloss at the same time. It’s one or the other? So, I looked at the description, whcih said it was a “high pigment lip gloss and lip liner.” It talked about not being sticky, which to me definitely implied a gloss. I’ve never heard a matte liquid lip being described as sticky or non sticky. So, I decided to give it a try. Unfortunately, it’s NOT a lip gloss.

This is a matte liquid lip (NOT a gloss) and a lip liner.

The lip liner is great. It’s pigmented, creamy and smooth. It glides onto the lips easily. It’s easy to get it where you want it. It lasts well on the lips. It doesn’t feel too dry after applying it, but I did top it with a gloss.

The liquid lip on the other hand is horrible! It is waaaaaay too drying! It is NOT a gloss at all! When applying it, it has a grainy, rough feel. Once it drys down, it’s like it sucks every bit of moisture out of your lips. I even tried putting a really moisturizing lip balm on before this and it still seemed to suck out all the moisture leaving cakey, dry looking and feeling lips. It shows every single line, even lines you didn’t even know you had in your lips. It’s crazy! It’s not sticky like it claims, though I don’t know why it would be since it dries down completely matte. I don’t know how well it lasted because I couldn’t stand it on my lips for longer than about 10 minutes and had to take it off. It came off really easy though, so I don’t see it lasting too long.

I really hate when product pages are so wrong. This one gave mixed info, not making it clear what it was. I don’t like that at all. It’s like they were trying to make it so people who liked lip glosses would be interested in it, but also make it so people who liked matte lips would be interested in it. You can’t have it both ways. Just describe the product for what it is and let people decide if it’s something for them. Trying to sell it as both is ridiculous!

The color “Stone” is pretty. It’s similar to my actual lip color, which is what I prefer.

Overall, this isn’t for me. I really liked the lip liner and for the price it isn’t bad just for a lip liner. But, I HATED the matte liquid lip. If you’re someone that likes extremely matte liquid lips, you might like this. But, I honestly don’t know about that. This is the MOST drying matte liquid lip I have ever tried! I give it 2 stars for the lip liner being good and the nice color, but I took off 3 for the horrible description on the product page and the horrible liquid lip.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Very thin, looks and feels like nothing on skin but sets makeup in place well!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I have loved a lot of the By Terry products I’ve tried. I tried a mini of the loose Hyaluronic Hydra Powder, so I was excited to try the pressed powder version of it. But, I recently tried the By Terry Hyaluronic Hydra-Powder palette that had 4 different pressed Hyaluronic hydra-powders in it. It had colored powders, not translucent like this one. I got the “Fair to Medium” so it contained a pale pink, a pale bone colored shade, a pale bronzer, and a light bronzer shade. I didn’t like the light colored shades at all for setting my makeup. They seemed to make my skin look so dry, which I thought was so weird since it’s just a pressed version of the loose Hyaluronic hydra powder, which I loved. But, the loose Hyaluronic Hydra Powder only had 2 ingredients - silica and hyaluronic acid. The Hyaluronic Hydra-Powder Palette had a lot more ingredients, so I’m guessing that’s where the difference came from. They were also colored and the loose powder was translucent. This pressed powder is also translucent. It does contain more than 2 ingredients, I guess since it’s in pressed form rather than loose. But not a ton of ingredients (full list at end of review). But, given it had more ingredients and they were similar to the ones in the Hyaluronic Hydra-Pressed Powder Palette I tried and didn’t like, I was worried I wasn’t going to like this one either. But, I’m glad I tried it because I ended up loving it!

This comes in a nice outer product box. It comes in a nice compact with clasp closure, a mirror in the lid, and a powder puff. I never use the powder puffs that come in compacts like this, but it seemed nice enough.

The powder is very thin. It almost seems like you don’t pick any up when you dip your brush into it, but you do. Usually when I dip my brush into a powder, I have to dab off the excess from the brush before applying it to my face. I don’t have to do that with this. It only picks up a light amount, which is just enough for a very light layer. I have normal to dry skin, more on the dry side with some extremely dry areas. This doesn’t dry out my skin like the powders did in the palette that I tried. This goes on smoothly, sets my makeup in place with a very light layer, and doesn’t look dry, powdery, or cakey on the skin. It lasts well throughout the day.

I did notice that if I applied too much, I could get a dry look and feel to my skin. It’s so thin that it’s easy to think you haven’t applied any and to add more, which is when I get the dry look and feel to my skin. With the Pressed Powder Palette I tried, I found those powders worked well with a thin layer and didn’t leave my skin looking and feeling dry, but they also didn’t seem to set my makeup in place unless I applied more, which ended up giving me the dry look and feel. With this powder, I can apply a very small amount and my makeup seems to be set in place well and I don’t get a dry look and feel to the skin. So, I’m not sure why I got such a different result with the powders in the Pressed Powder Palette vs this one. Given they have similar ingredient lists aside from the color ingredients, the only thing I can think of is that this one is translucent and those ones in the palette were colored so that much

Overall, I think this is a great powder! It’s very thin and looks like nothing on the skin, but sets my makeup in place. It doesn’t feel or look dry on my skin. It works really well!

FULL INGREDIENTS
Talc, Silica, Mica, Ci 77120 / Barium Sulfate, Octyldodecanol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Magnesium Stearate, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Diisostearyl Malate, Methicone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Hyaluronate. (T3355a1).

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Great IF need quick application, need to last no more than couple hrs, & only need couple uses
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
I got the style “A201.” I have really small, really hooded, and downturned eyes. With such small, hooded eyes, a lot of full lashes can end up poking me in my inner corner. I like the inner corner of the lashes to be shorter. Somehow, I missed seeing that the inner corner of the “A201” style was the same length as the outer corner. I also like the outer corner to be longer and lifted to give my eye a more lifted look. While the “A201l style isn’t bad, it isn’t as good as “A202” would have been. I’m not sure how I picked so wrong 😂 I think I just saw the “A201” style looked more natural and “A202” looked darker/thicker/fuller, so I went with the more natural looking ones? No clue! I’m usually so picky when choosing lashes and so particular, I don’t know how I missed that! But, “A201” worked well enough.

I liked the idea of self adhesive lashes. No glue, no magnetic liner, no magnets. Just pop them on and be done! Easy peasy! I had a feeling they weren’t going to stick to well, but figured they were worth a try because…..”WHAT IF THEY DID?! Wouldn’t that be something?!”

They did stick….but not for long. These are perfect for anyone who only needs the lashes to feel secure for no more than a couple hours, after that, they start lifting and feeling like they’ll fall off at any moment. You get 4 pairs for $14.99 (currently down from regular price of $16.99), that is $3.75 (or $4.25 at regular price) per pair. Not too bad. At that price, some might not mind them only feeling secure for a short while. Like if you’re someone who does makeup looks on Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/etc., you might only need the lashes on for a quick photo session or video. These would work well for that.

They did say you need to apply these BEFORE makeup. I tried it that way and then applied my eyeshadow and it was fine. I also applied them after applying my eyeshadow. They stayed secure longer when applied BEFORE eyeshadow, but did stay secure for about 40 min when applied AFTER eyeshadow.

After the first use, they don’t stick very well. If you applied them to clean, dry skin, they stick much better and stay secured longer. But if applied to eyeshadow, they don’t stick as well the second time, even if you make sure to clean them off after.

Overall, I can’t really recommend these unless you only want lashes that will be quick to apply (few seconds), don’t need them to last longer than a couple hours, and don’t mind getting only a use or 2 out of them. If that works for you, go for it because they do stick.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Only meant for gel polish! Works well when used correctly
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This is ONLY meant for GEL polish NOT for acrylic powder, dip powder, Poly gel, or builder gel. Why? I don’t know. I’m guessing whatever chemicals in it breakdown the gel polish won’t breakdown the acrylic powder, dip powder, Poly gel, or builder gel in the same way.

This works great! I have tried other gel polish remover before and they just don’t feel right on the nail. It’s hard to describe, but it’s just a weird feeling I get in my nail bed when I’ve applied them. I’ve been trying out different ones hoping to find one that doesn’t feel like that and works really well…I finally found one!

This is easy to use.
-USE NAIL FILE TO REMOVE TOP COAT. This step is important. A lot of people think this step isn’t necessary with a gel polish remover like this. That it’ll remove the top coat too. It might, I haven’t tried it. But, I’m guessing it wouldn’t do it as quickly and easily. Just take a nail file and lightly buff off the top coat. It doesn’t take much.
-Apply a thin coat of the gel polish remover just like you would any nail polish
-Let it sit for 3-8 minutes. It will start to crack/bubble.
-Take a cuticle pusher and use it to push off the nail polish. It should push off easily. You can always add another coat of the remover if it’s not fully off.

I found for me with 2 coats of gel polish on, it usually took me about 10 minutes from start to finish. So much easier than acetone or even a drill! As long as you remove the top coat by filing it off before applying this remover and give it time to work and soften the polish, it’s easy to scrape off!

As a side note, even though this says it’s not meant for acrylic powder, dip powder, builder gel, or Poly gels, I tried it with dip powder. It worked well but did take longer for it to crack/bubble and I had to do 2 coats of the remover. It also worked much better when it was a solid color dip powder and not a dip powder with glitter in it.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Extremely hydrating but lightweight. Does have essential oils & fragrant ingredients though
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes with no outer product box, just the bottle. But, the bottle is sealed with plastic wrapping around it. It is made in the US. The ingredients are listed on the label.

This is supposed to be cruelty free, gluten free, silicone free, sulfate free, paraben free, talc free, 100% vegan, and have clean ingredients. It didn’t have any labels on it saying it was cruelty free, but the brand’s website said they’re cruelty free. It also said they use natural and organic ingredients. But, they are not certified organic. It states, “Our products are made with natural and organic ingredients, however, they are not certified organic. All of our products are made in the U.S. using top-quality domesticated and imported ingredients.” I’m not surprised they said they’re not certified organic. I love their honesty. I’ve seen lots of skincare brands claim their products are 100% organic when they definitely aren’t. Most skin care products are water-based and water can NOT be certified as organic, so the possibility of finding a 100% organic skincare product is close to impossible.

This claims to be hydrating, brightening, and soothing. It claims to target fine lines around the eyes, reduce appearance of dark circles and puffiness, and hydrate the eye area. It claims the key ingredients are triple peptides, bergamot oil, and citric acid. I included a full ingredient list at the end of my review (marked with 🟣). I included some info on some of the ingredients before that (marked with 🟢).

This comes in a nice pump bottle. The pump does squirt out too much if you’re not careful. I find if I carefully press it so I’m not pushing it down all the way, I get enough product and don’t waste any. It’s a thin gel consistency. It glides on nicely. It absorbs quickly leaving my under eyes feeling really hydrated and smooth. I have pretty dry under eyes. If I apply concealer, I have to make sure to moisturize them really well so they don’t look dry and cakey. A lot of the moisturizers that hydrate my under eyes enough are thicker and end up being too heavy to use concealer over. This is PERFECT! It’s thin and lightweight, but feels extremely hydrating! It gives my under eyes enough hydration and plumps them up. It doesn’t leave a sticky residue at all. Concealer goes over it beautifully and looks nice and smooth.

I haven’t been using it long enough to say anything about how it works long term on dark circles, firming, etc. But, I can say it’s really hydrating and plumping if you’re looking for something extremely hydrating under the eyes. I’m hopeful for other benefits long term given the ingredients, but even if I don’t get any more benefits, I’m still loving how well it hydrates my under eyes while being so lightweight! Just keep in mind it does have some essential oils and fragrant ingredients in it, so if you have sensitive skin, you might want to avoid this or at least check the ingredient list to see if they’re things that you’re sensitive to.

🟢Info on ingredients
Saccharide Isomerate, which is a 100% natural and plant-derived moisturizer. It binds to the skin stronger and longer than other moisturizer ingredients do so it can keep skin hydrated longer than usual.

Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 & Palmitoyl Tetrrapeptide-7 - These are peptides combined to create a compound called Matrixyl 3000. Matrixyl is a highly-effective peptide composition that has been shown to stimulate the production of collagen and elastin, fill in fine lines & wrinkles while restoring elasticity.

Sodium Hyaluronate, which is a form of hyaluronic acid (HA). Helps skin hold onto water, making skin more plump and elastic.

Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 (aka Argireline), which is called “natures Botox.” It is a synthetic peptide that has several different potential wrinkle-fighting and anti-aging effects. It's so effective, that experts say it's the closest thing to Botox you can get. It prevents the muscle movement that leads to wrinkle formation. Argireline also promotes collagen production and optimizes the function of collagen, which both fight fine lines and improve moisture levels in the skin. It’s good for anyone looking to smooth wrinkles caused by repeated muscle movement in areas such as the forehead and around the eyes.

Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, which has great anti-inflammatory properties and antioxidant properties.

ESSENTIAL OILS, PERFUMING INGREDIENTS
It has some essential oils and perfuming ingredients in it - Bergamot Fruit Oil, Orange Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Geranyl Acetate, and Linalool. These are super common and cheap fragrance ingredients. They oxidize on air exposure and the result can be quite irritating to the skin and can lead to allergic contact dermatitis and they count as frequent skin sensitizers. It is best to avoid them if you have sensitive skin.

🟣FULL INGREDIENT LIST
Water, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Saccharide Isomerate, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Sodium Hyaluronate, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Carrageenan, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis Oil, Sclerotium Gum, Xanthan Gum, Carbomer, Polysorbate 20, Potassium Sorbate, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Triethyl Citrate, Linalyl Acetate, Geranyl Acetate, Terpineol, Linalool, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Reduced redness & hydrating, but need ingredient list in ENGLISH!
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
This comes in a nice outer product box. Made in Korea. The brand’s website said it’s 100% vegan, excluding animal ingredients and animal experiments. It also doesn’t include parabens.

It comes in a nice compact. It’s a compact like a cushion foundation where you open it and there’s a kind of lid that holds the sponge applicator, and you lift that lid to reveal the product. You press the applicator sponge into it (or your own sponge or brush) and then apply it. The brand’s website said the included sponge applicator is an “eco puff” made of “eco-friendly corns” and is “99.9% anti-bacterial and water-repellent,” which makes it safe on skin and keeps puff clean.

This is a liquidy but balm kind of texture. It isn’t as thick as a balm. It just feels like a cushion foundation. But this isn’t a foundation. It has a very light, mint green color to it. It’s so light that it’s almost white but has the green color to it. When applied, it reduces redness. It doesn’t do as well as my more pigmented green correctors, but it does a nice job while being hydrating and lightweight on the skin. It’s something that works well before applying foundation. It is lightweight enough to wear well under foundation. It isn’t a primer really, it doesn’t smooth out the skin or fill in pores. But, it does reduce the redness in my skin so then I use less foundation and concealer. If you have a TON of redness or it’s REALLY red, this might not be enough since it isn’t extremely pigmented. But, it will make a difference. I like it isn’t drying on the skin either.

I’m just not sure how I feel about it though. It works well on the skin. But, I do like to know what’s in my products. I don’t like that they provided barely any product info, and the ingredients on the product box weren’t in English. They also didn’t include them here on the product page. Not even the product photos provided any real info on the product - what it does, who it’s for, how to use it, ingredients, etc. I had to go to the brand’s website to find out more. Yes, it’s a simple Google search, but it’s not really something you should have to do.

Normally, I would just go to the brand’s website to find the list of ingredients when they’re not included on the Amazon product page. But, the Jung Saem Mool website didn’t have them on their website either. I looked for them elsewhere and did find an ingredient list on Korean Beauty Box, but didn’t think they were accurate because they didn’t include centella asiatica, pine sprout, or green calamine powder, which are supposed to be in this product. So, I translated the ingredients from the box myself. But, I’m not that confident in the ingredients provided on the box.(I included a photo from the box, and also included the ingredients at the end of my review in English)

It doesn’t seem like a complete list of ingredients to me. It has the first ingredient as titanium dioxide. It has tocopherol (vitamin E) as the 3rd ingredient. The rest of the ingredient are 7, kind of versions I’d guess you’d call them, of centella asiatica. There’s nothing else listed. It’s kind of odd. The brand’s website said this is supposed to have “2 plants - pine sprout containing fresh moisture and centella asiatica roots.” I saw the “centella asiatica roots” in the ingredients when I translated them. But didn’t see any “pine sprout.” I also saw something about “cica pine water” on the brand’s website, but again, not sure what that’s supposed to be? The brand’s website also mentioned “Natural green calamine powder covers reddened skin tone.” Again, I didn’t see any calamine powder at all in the ingredients.

The 7, I guess versions, of Centella Asiatica are:
Centella Asiatica Extract (5,159,235ppm) - Well known soothing, antioxidant, and moisturizing ingredient. Anti-inflammatory. The main biologically active components are Asiaticoside, madecassoside, asiatic acid, and madecassic acid. All of which are in this.

Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract (0.035ppm)

Centella Asiatica Root Extract (0.03ppm)

Madecassoside (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Madecassic Acid (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Asiaticoside (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Asiatic Acid (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica. It’s less prominent than it’s sister component, Asiaticoside, but it still contributes to the well-established moisturizing and wound healing abilities of Centella Asiatica.

Overall, it works well. It reduces my redness, feels hydrating on the skin, and works well on its own and under foundation. It feels lightweight on the skin. If they provided the full ingredient list, it would be something I’d be willing to purchase. But, right now, I don’t like they didn’t include them and don’t like that they can’t even be found online as far as I could tell. And I just have a hard time believing the ingredient list I translated from the box is the full ingredient list. I don’t know. If the ingredients aren’t a big factor for you, this is nice and works well. If knowing the ingredients are important to you, I’d look elsewhere. There’s other similar products that actually provide a full ingredient list, and a lot of them are far cheaper. I give it 3 stars.

How to Use (from brand’s website):
Use as last step of skin care routine. Dip puff into content and gently apply and dab on skin.

Special Tips (from brand’s website)
Carry it in makeup bag or purse for easy supply of moisture to skin when it dries up.
Use as lightweight skin tone corrector to correct sensitive skin tone covered by masks instead of applying heavy, caking makeup.

FULL INGREDIENTS
Ingredients | Titanium dioxide (CI 77891], Centella Asiatica Extract (5,159,235ppm), Tocopherol, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract (0.035ppm), Centella Asiatica Root Extract (0.03ppm), Madecassoside (0.0025ppm), Madecassic Acid (0.0025ppm), Asiaticoside (0.0025ppm), Asiatic Acid (0.0025ppm)

**NOTE: Just for reference, 1ppm = 0.0001% (or 10,000 ppm = 1%). So…

Centella Asiatica Extract (5,159,235ppm) = 515.9235%
*5,159,235ppm is parts per million, so it means there’s 5,159,235 parts of Centella Asiatica in one million molecules
Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract (0.035ppm) = 0.0000035%
Centella Asiatica Root Extract (0.03ppm) = 0.000003%
Madecassoside (0.0025ppm) = 0.00000025%
Madecassic Acid (0.0025ppm) = 0.00000025%
Asiaticoside (0.0025ppm) = 0.00000025%
Asiatic Acid (0.0025ppm) = 0.00000025%

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Love the shape and shade! Worried how shape will hold up over time though
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
LOKNGXU Eyebrow Pencil

🟧OUTER PACKAGING
This comes in an outer product box that is inside a sealed plastic bag. Ingredients are listed on the box. It is made in China.

🟧CRUELTY FREE STATUS
This has a cruelty free logo (PETA). But, I don’t think they’re actually cruelty free. The brand name on the box says AMIIR. I did a search for the brand name, manufacturer name, and cosmetic production license name and nothing showed up on PETAs website where you can do a search. So, if you’re cruelty free, you might want to look into it some more.

🟧DUAL ENDED
This is dual ended - one end the pencil, the other end a standard spoolie brush. The box was a little smashed when it arrived. Unfortunately, the part with the spoolie had kind of bent and came out. Fortunately, I was able to pop it back in (as you can see in the photos, but can also see the line where it bent some). Once popped back in though, the spoolie worked fine so I was happy about that! The spoolie is nice. It’s not too rough. It works well.

🟧MY BROWS - THICKNESS, COLOR
I don’t have unruly or thick brows, but they also aren’t really thin. They’re a little sparse in areas, but for the most part not bad. I just like to lightly fill in the sparse areas.

I have a hard time getting the shade for me. I have medium to dark brown hair. My brows are like a muted black color. Whenever I get brown brow pencils, even the dark brown ones, they tend to be way too warm and don’t look right in my brows. I’ve found the best luck with charcoal, gray, dark gray, and black shades. Though, some of those are too pigmented and can be way too dark in my brows.

🟧SHADE OF PENCIL - 3# Dark Grey
With this pencil, I was excited when I saw a “Grey Brown” shade. I’ve tried others that were similar in name and the shade worked well for me. But, with this one, in the product photos the hair they showed with it looked more like ash blonde and said “suitable for maroon or coffee color,” which definitely wouldn’t work for me - coffee color maybe, but maroon no way! But, the actual brows in the photo looked like the color would work well. But, then I looked at the photo they had all the shades on the arm to show it was waterproof, and in that the shade “Grey Brown” definitely looked more like a light brown or ash blonde kind of brow shade. They also had a “Dark Grey,” which looked like a charcoal black kind of color - not full on black, but not gray. I was a little worried it might be too dark, but figured I’d have a better chance with “Dark Grey” than with the “Grey Brown” shade given they used the word “maroon” when describing who it would work for.

Fortunately, the color “Dark Grey” does work really well for me. It can be too dark so I have to use a light hand, but I find a light hand is easy with this formula.

🟧SHAPE OF PENCIL
I tend to like precise, small tipped brow pencils. My usual go to ones are the Nyx Micro Brow or Elf Ultra Precise Brow Pencil. They’re affordable and have a really small tip so I can get good hair like strokes and they work nicely.

This is a unique shape. Triangle shapes are usually too thick for me to get precise, thin hairlike strokes. Not with this shape! This is more of a diamond shape. There is an extremely thin line where you can easily get thin hairlike strokes. You can also use the really pointed tip to get thin hairlike strokes.

**NOTE: I will say I’m a little worried how the shape will hold up. I’ve been using this every day since I got it and notice the shape is wearing down…like the defined and pointed areas I love so much. It makes sense that those would wear down, just like any pencil does and will eventually need sharpened. But, it’s not like you can really sharpen this back into that original shape. So, unless you’re careful and try to use it evenly on both sides and tips to kind of make sure it wears the same and kind of maintains the shape….and who has the time and patience for that?!…it’s going to eventually end up being like a chubby angled liner shape. So, we’ll see how much I like it at that point? With the price and how much I like it, depending how long the shape lasts for it might be worth it to me to just purchase a new one at that time. So, I will just have to see how long the shape lasts and go from there.

🟧FORMULA OF PENCIL (HOW IT APPLIES, WEARS)
The formula is really nice! It glides onto my brows easily. It’s really creamy. It doesn’t skip at all, doesn’t tug at all. It doesn’t feel or look waxy. It is pigmented, so like I said, it can be too dark for me. But, it glides on so easily, it’s easy to use a very light hand. It blends in with my brow hairs nicely. When using a very light hand and the thin line, I get perfect hairlike strokes and don’t even need to use the spoolie to blend them in because they look perfect and natural! Though, if you want more of a faded look, the spoolie can do that too! You can also press harder for it to be darker since it is pigmented. It lasts well throughout the day. Usually with really creamy formulas, they just wipe off when I blend my brows with a spoolie and if they don’t, they wear off quick. So, I usually like ones that are in the middle of waxy and creamy - waxy enough to last, but creamy enough to glide on easily. With this one being so creamy, I expected it wouldn’t last well - it would just go away if I used a spoolie in my brows or it would wear off quick - but it actually lasts all day long even through a hot day outside or a day at work running around and sweating!

🟧OVERALL THOUGHTS
If you’re looking for a great brow pen, I’d definitely recommend trying this one out! It has a unique shape that works well, it has a great formula that is really easy to work with, and it lasts well all day!

AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_title: Not enough patches in pack to really end up getting results with dark spot
AEMP3A7IKW37CMWFXNKXWW6HGJHA_1.review_text:
First, I have to say These do NOT technically pierce the skin, though some brands will say they do. I saw some reviews mentioning how they puncture the skin, which will stimulate collagen and help further absorption. That does NOT happen with microneedle patches. It occurs with microneedling (or dermarolling/stamps) when you actually pierce into the skin with a micro needle pen/dermaroller/derma stamp. And, even then, Collagen is only stimulated when the needle is long enough (0.5mm length needles are needed to even get a mild effect of stimulating collagen). With these microneedle patches, the skin benefiting ingredients have been crystallized to form little sharp crystals that are no bigger than 250 microns, which is about a third of the width of a human hair. So, pretty small (250 microns equals 0.25 mm). They simply dissolve into the skin. The main difference between microneedling (dermarolling) and microneedle patches is they don’t actually prick the skin and cause injury. They don’t cause trauma to the skin. Instead, the crystals simply dissolve into the skin. (And this info is from the brand’s website). So, these patches have crystals made up of active ingredients that gently press into the skin and then are the water in the skin activates them to dissolve.

Someone else also said these have retinol in them, which isn’t the case. I put the full ingredient list at the end of my review.

I love microneedle and hydrocolloid patches. I have some post acne marks. I don’t know what it is but pimples and post acne marks just never want to go away on me! I get hormonal breakouts. So, right around that time I get a pimple or 2. I start treating them as soon as I notice them appearing. But, they still usually end up getting bad and taking a week or 2 to go away! By time I get the darn things to go away, it’s time for more! It’s a very frustrating process. From my time before using pimple patches, I have some scars. And, after the pimples finally do resolve, I sometimes end up with a red mark there. So, I saw these and was really intrigued to give them a try! I figured they had a good shot of working because my scars aren’t large or big scars. They’re just little marks, some slightly indented. Most are just dark red, flat marks. But, they’re a pain to cover with makeup! Makeup never wants to stay on them well! I have a skin care regimen I use and some products are specifically for dark spots/post acne marks, but I figured these patches would be more targeted!

I also have sun spots on my temples and cheekbones. Though, they aren’t specific spots, more like a line of spots, so I wasn’t sure these patches would be the best option for those.

These have 500 “serum-infused MicroCrystals” that “deliver a concentrated formula of tranexamic acid, niacinamide, vitamin C, and glutathione.” These were “developed using a mixture of regenerative ingredients renowned for their skin-rejuvenating properties. Restore skin texture, brighten skin and reduce the appearance of dark spots in a matter of weeks.”

If you’re interested in some info on the ingredients, I included some at the end of my review (full list of ingredients marked with 🟢 and info on specific ingredients marked with 🔴)

The patches are nice. They’re decent sizes. Depending on the size of the spot you’re trying to treat, they might be too big, might not be big enough, or might be just right. They MIGHT be able to be cut down if you needed a smaller size. But, I personally wouldn’t want to cut them - I don’t know how they would effect the microcrystals, plus I don’t want to risk contaminating them. It would be nice if they included some smaller ones, or even better would be an option to buy a pack of this size or a pack of smaller ones, depending on the size of the areas you want to treat.

I found these to stick really well IF you’re applying them to clean, dry skin. If the skin is even a TINY bit damp (you applied moisturizer and some got in the area or you accidentally touched the area with your finger before applying the patch), then it might not stick well and end up falling off easily. But, if you make sure the skin is clean and completely dry before applying the patch, they stick GREAT! Stick them on, press the center for a few seconds, and you feel a little kind of poke, but nothing that hurts. After the initial poke, you don’t feel them. I forget I even have the patch on!

Directions say to leave on for AT LEAST 2 hours, but IDEALLY overnight to give the micro crystals time to fully dissolve and release the actives into the skin. Use 2-3 times a week. It says to expect results from 2 weeks for blemishes and 6-8 weeks for dark spots. Continue use until desired result is an achieved. To avoid risk of sensitivity, do not use more than 3 times per week or within 24 hours of previous application

Here’s the problem. You need to use these consistently for a little while (how long would depend on how dark the mark is and your skin) to see results. There’s only 12 patches in a pack! You use 2-3 patches a week for ONE spot, which means a pack will last 4-6 weeks. If you’re trying to fade a blemish, since it says you could expect results in 2 weeks then you have a good chance of seeing results. BUT if you’re trying to fade a dark spot, it says that takes 6-8 weeks so you MIGHT start seeing results by time you finish the pack, but you might not. If the dark spot is extremely dark, it’s going to take even longer I’m sure. They really should offer a larger size pack so you can purchase 1 pack to have enough to heal at least 1 spot. Not to mention the fact, we’re only talking about 1 spot! If you have multiple spots, then you’re really going to run out of patches quickly! If using this for blemishes, you could get a few patches for a few blemishes. But for dark spots, the pack of 12 is most likely going to go all to treating one single dark spot, and even then you might not actually see results. At a price of $34.95 for a pack of 12 (at the time of writing this review), that’s $2.91 per patch, which is pretty darn pricey!

On top of the fact you need to use multiple patches to fade 1 spot, the fact is when using lightening ingredients like niacinamide, tranexamic acid, Kojic acid, etc., these ingredients lighten the skin by suppressing the production of pigment  in the skin cells and will unfortunately only help as long as you are using them. So, you would need to use the ingredients continuously.

I did notice a slight difference using a few patches on a post acne mark. I also wanted to test out these patches on a dark spot and didn’t notice any different with that but after using a few on a post acne mark, I didn’t have enough to use them 2-3 times a week on the spot for the full 6-8 weeks they say it takes to get results so I wasn’t surprised.

Unfortunately, given the fact that you’re only getting 12 patches for $34.95 and you need multiple patches for 1 spot AND need to continue using it to keep the spot away once you get rid of it, I don’t think these patches are worth it. I feel you’re better off getting a bottle of serum or cream with these ingredients in it (preferably one that uses them as ACTIVE ingredients and states the specific percentages of each ingredient so you know it’s enough to actually be effective). I think it would be a more effective way to fade dark spots and keep them away AND give you more bang for your buck. So, I don’t really recommend these. They COULD be effective if you had enough of them and were willing to fork over the $34.95 each time to continue buying them. Whether that’s worth it to you is for you to decide. For me, I think I’ll stick to serums.

As a side note, I did try out some other dark spot microneedle patches-[[ASIN:B09C15YNVL Rael Microcrystal Dark Spot Patch]]and for those you got 6 patches for $11.99 (so for 12 it would be $23.98, which is cheaper than the $34.95 these cost). Those also use microcrystals to dissolve and release skin brightening ingredients below the surface, which include niacinamide, tranexamic acid, and broccoli extract. (I included the full ingredient list of the Rael Patches at the very end, marked with 🟣)

🟢FULL INGREDIENTS
Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Trehalose, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, Glutathione, Madecassoside, Polyglyceryl-10-Laurate, Linolenic acid

🔴SPECIFIC INFO ON THE INGREDIENTS:
Sodium Hyaluronate - Form of hyaluronic acid. Helps skin hold onto water, making skin more plump and elastic.

Glycerin - Great moisturizer for the skin, helps protect skin against irritation and restore skin barrier.

Trehalose - Moisturizer/humectant with water-binding properties and helps keep skin hydrated. 

Ascorbyl Glucoside - This is a Vitamin C derivative. It’s one of the best options when it comes to vitamin C derivatives. It’s really stable and easy to formulate. It’s been shown to penetrate the skin, which is important for an anti-aging ingredient to do it’s job. After it’s absorbed into skin, it’s converted into pure vitamin C and shows all 3 anti-aging benefits (antioxidant protection, collagen boosting, and fading hyperpigmentation) that pure vitamin C does.

Tranexamic Acid (TXA) - Shown to be as effective as hydroquinone but without the side effects! When applied topically, it can help treat a range of dermatologic issues, including lightening discolorations from PIH (dark marks on the skin after a pimple heals). It might also help ease up freckling and sunspots. Brightening ingredients work in different ways, so it’s best to combine brightening ingredients to come at the issue from every angle. TXA works by inhibiting plasmin activity. So, it can be combined with ingredients that inhibit the enzyme tyrosinase like vitamin C and glutathione, both of which are in these patches. You also want to look for ingredients that inhibit transfer of pigment to cells, like niacinamide, which is also included in these patches! So with these multiple ingredients targeting dark spots from different pathways, you’re approaching the issue from every angle!

Niacinamide - This is a powerful active ingredient that can moisturize, support the skin barrier, soothe, and help treat pigmentation, acne, and wrinkles without causing irritation. In other words, it can do the same heavy lifting that other actives do without the redness or dryness they might cause. In fact, it makes skin calmer as it gets firmer and smoother. It’s a precursor to molecules that allow all cells, including skin cells, to repair damage and neutralize free radicals that can cause skin cancer and the breakdown of collagen and elastin. For dryness, it increases the production of ceramides, which protect your skin barrier and seal in moisture. For dark spots, it inhibits the transfer of pigment to cells, improving discoloration. For irritation, it’s both an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory. So it neutralizes and calms the skin’s inflammatory responses to things like UV radiation and cell turnover. And it’s a gentler and more stable antioxidant than vitamin C, another hardworking ingredient, making it ideal for sensitive skin. It’s also good for acne prone skin. Along with the anti-inflammatory effects, it's also been shown to decrease oil production and normalize the lining of the pores, keeping them from getting clogged and enlarged.

Glutathione - Powerful antioxidant that naturally occurs in the skin where it helps defend it against the visible effects of environmental damage. The gradual decline of the natural supply of glutathione in the body is believed to be a key marker of many outward signs of aging. Glutathione is a tripeptide made up of 3 amino acids that work together to brighten a dull complexion while offering skin-restoring benefits. It has value for visibly fading discolorations when used in a 2% concentration due to its ability to interrupt an enzyme within skin’s surface that triggers hyperpigmentation.

Madecassoside - Antioxidant, soothing activities because it’s one of the main of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Linolenic Acid - An omega-3 fatty acid. It can help protect skin from UV damage. It provides photoprotection by converting into compounds that fight inflammation and boost the skin’s response to aggressors. It also protects the skin from UV-induced hyperpigmentation, helping improve uneven skin tone. It also helps promote cell turnover and keep skin soft and smooth, strengthen skin barrier, and provide moisture.

🟣Rael Patches Ingredients
Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Trehalose, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, Glutathione, Madecassoside, Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract, Polyglyceryl-10-Laurate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Butylene Glycol, Linolenic acid, Brassica Oleracea Italica (Broccoli) Extract

They have the same ingredients, except the Rael Patches have 4 extras (these Vice Reversa Patches have 10 total ingredients, and the Rael Patches have 14 total ingredients). The first 8 ingredients are the same for both. Then the Rael Patches have Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract added in as the 9th ingredient, so it’s where the order of the ingredients start to differ but you’ll notice the all the same ingredients from these Vice Reversa Patches aside from the 4 extras in the Rael Patches. The 4 extras are Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Extract (an antioxidant, anti-aging, soothing ingredient that’s a good source of vitamin C, various B vitamins, vitamin E, and numerous compounds that give antioxidant benefits), 1,2-Hexanediol (multi-functional ingredient that gives soft and nice feel to formula, acts as humectant and emollient, can be solvent for other ingredients), Butylene Glycol (main job is as solvent for other ingredients but also helps product absorb faster and deeper into skin (penetration enhanced), make product spread nicely over skin (slip agent), and attract water into skin (humectant), and Brassica Oleracea Italica (Broccoli) Extract (has powerful antioxidants to help protect skin, high in fatty acid content so extremely moisturizing, and called nature’s retinol because it contains vitamin A to deliver benefits of cell turnover without unwanted side effects if prescription retinoids). So, the additional 4 ingredients aren’t too bad! At the cheaper price with the same ingredients (aside from 4 extras), it might be worth trying those instead.

AENQC6O3X4BUEQWSDTBUN2VMM5VQ.review_title: Two 5 STAR and Two 4 STAR Fragrances- some are sure to please every man
AENQC6O3X4BUEQWSDTBUN2VMM5VQ.review_text:
English Laundry Men's 4 Piece 20ml Coffret is a truly wonderful men’s cologne set. You are getting four fragrances- rated 4 and 5 STARS all in one box. The fragrances rated by me are based on my years spent working in a cosmetic factory. I will list each fragrance separately.

ARROGANT- With top notes of bergamot and cedar you get a woodsy freshness to the scent. The middle notes of coriander and lavender bring a warm, clean freshness. At the base are sandalwood, amber and musk bringing a warm, sensual, spicy scent. All together, you get a spicy, warm, woodsy scent with a distinctive freshness to it. This light, sensual scent lasts all day and smells wonderful on almost every man, so 5 STARS.

OXFORD BLEU- The top notes of mint and lemon add a citrus freshness. The middle notes of iris and geranium bring a very light floral scent. The base adds sandalwood and vanilla for a woodsy delicious scent. All together, this scent is light, with an undertone bit of floral and clean citrus and a nice light woodsy smell. This light, woodsy fragrance smells fabulous on almost every man and does last long for 5 STARS.

RIVIERA- With top notes of lemon, bergamot, lime and cedar, you get a refreshing citrus/woods scent. In the middle are jasmine, patchouli, vetiver, lavender and mandarin- most of these were used in the 60's sexy, warm, earthy scents. At the base notes are nutmeg and coumarin to add some spice. This is not for every man, but for a man who likes a more vibrant scent. These scents are very noticeable and not light, being a very woodsy, earthy, warm fragrance with a touch of zest. 4 STARS.

NOTTING HILL- The top notes begin with bergamot, lemon and lime for a clean, natural scent. Then the middle notes have bolder peppercorn and jasmine bringing a rose/herbal scent. At the bottom are cedarwood, sandalwood, amber and a powdery musk for a very potent woodsy, animal musky scent. This is definitely not for every man being very heavy scents. There is nothing light about this fragrance. 4 STARS.

With four interesting fragrances, two being light and two being heavy, every man is sure to find one he will like. Lighter scents always smell wonderful on almost every man and the bolder scents smell great on a man depending on how his chemistry goes with the bolder fragrances. 4 ½ STARS.

Before receiving Jane & Co.'s Roller and Gua Sha, I had never really used anything like it on my skin before. For me, it was simply wash, dry, moisturize and occasionally use makeup.

The roller and Gua Sha that I received is supposedly made of Jade. To me, it looked more like New Zealand Nephrite or even Aventurine. The packaging and product are nicely done, complete with a handwritten note from the proprietress of Jane & Co.

There is a small pamphlet with a set of instructions that includes a contact number where you can send a text to receive a complete guide on how to use both the roller and the Gua Sha. Instantly, you are given a URl to download the free eBook to go with the product.

To use either the roller or Gua Sha you simply chill the implements in the refrigerator or freezer. This extra coolness helps to shrink the pores and ease any puffiness that might be present.

Wash your face as normal to avoid pushing any dirt or impurities in your skin with the roller. Dry your face and apply a moisturizing oil such as coconut oil, jojoba, or argan oil which are particularly nourishing to the skin.

Take your now-cool roller and roll over your face, from the center outward. The included instructions suggest to pay particular attention to the area around the nose and under the eyes to aid in the draining and circulation of the lymph glands in those areas.

To use the Gua Sha, again, cleanse the face, and moisturize with an oil that is beneficial for the skin. Never, Never NEVER use mineral oil on the face (or anywhere else on the body for that matter).

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: slightly tacky feeling on skin after use
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
This smells good, very much like spring break in Cancun or summers at the beach. The lotion is very light weight almost liquid thin so it comes out pretty easily from the bottle. It is absorbed rather quickly in the skin but for several minutes afterwards my skin felt like it was tacky. After 5 to 10 minuets that went away. Not a big issue when I am taking my time getting ready but not something I want to wait for when I am on a limited time window getting ready for work.

Overall, smells good and does somewhat moisturize your skin but doesn't last throughout the day.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Works pretty well and easy to apply
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
This is a pretty cool set of nail colors that do change in color as your hands are warm/cold. Goes on a bit thicker then your standard nail polish. Cure time in a UV/Lamp is accurate, for first coat, I found that to get fully dry you need about 2 or 3 (60 sec) more before apply topcoat or your nails remain tacky for a while.

I haven’t used this brand before but so far I am enjoying it. The polish hasn’t chipped off easily.

Overall, I will continue to use this.

I am pretty much a pasty white girl that really needs to get out and see the sun way more often then I am able to. So sunless tanners are my newest obsession. I really enjoy that this 1 doesn’t smell like I am taking a funky chemical bath. 2 when I shower/ bath I don’t turn the water colors and while this does fade it doesn’t streak making me look like a melted crayon come to life.

Note that if you use a sugar scrub or body wash you will have some variation in tinting on your skin.

I had no rashes or breakouts and this is great for me since my current work schedule has me at work prior to the sun coming up and leaving after it sets.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Yep thats a pad on my face
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
This was only hilarious to use because my guy honestly asked me why I had a pad on my face. Not, really sure why I found that as funny as I did but I laughed for like 5 minutes straight when he asked me.

It was comfortable and it did reduce the puffiness on my face. I liked that it didn’t have any odd smells to it. I easy way to relax for 20 minutes and get nice results.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Does assist in helping with sleep.
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
I think it smells nice and it a great idea to calm kids. At first, I this was working great because our little ones were not waking up in the middle of the night. But after about a week, that seemed to stopped.

I have found that using this a couple of times a week is giving us some better results.. Overall, any help is great help.,

This is a really great quality set for any guy that travels or welcome to adult hood smell amazing and like a dude kit. Either way the bag is well made. All the products are excellent on the skin, smell good and non caused any irritations , break outs, etc.

Price point may seem high but really for everything you get it is very reasonable. The products go a long way this isn’t a one time use set, my guy has taken this set on at least 4 business tips in the last month and will probably get another 10 trips out of it before he starts to run low / out of various product. The bag has help up nicely to crazy airline handling.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: unlimited cosmic power, itty bitty space
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
Yeah, this works wonders. My elbows & feet feel silky smooth after using! No obnoxious odor, no itching, no rashes, no break outs. My hands are super soft from applying to said elbows and feet.

I have calluses on my feet and hands from working out., this magic in a squeeze bottle, has softened them up and now my hands don't feel like "man hands" as one client pointed out to me.

This will stay on a 100% re buy list for me.

These are very well made hair ties,  Colors are nice looking, no smudged / odd designed  meaning ...the patterns look like the actual photos.  These can be washed and dried and do NOT fall apart.  I have thick curly hair and these do NOT get tangled in my hair at all.  Will buy more of this style for workouts.  Overall pretty inexpensive and a fun gift.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Get a good amount for your money
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: These are pretty great if you or whomever tend to lose hair clips a lot.  The colors, are pretty decent yet not quiet at bold as the advertisement shows.  They clip like standard hair clips, perfect for styling or using day to day.  None of the coating has come off and these do not take a ton of force to get them to clip, which is great if you are using on a child's hair.  Overall, for this price point you get your money's worth.

There is a mild menthol scent to this body wash.  What is nice about it, is that it doesn't smell medicated just refreshing.  Your body does get a cooling sensation which is perfect to use as an after workout cleansing soap.  The scent doesn't linger and this foams nicely when using.  Small amount goes a long way.  No skin irritations/breakouts when using.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: No irritation and easy to apply
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: I can't tell if I am seeing results or if my eyelashes are just happy to be makeup free for so long due to current issues with working from home.  This was easier to apply then I thought it would be, but I must admit I thought that it would apply like a mascara not a liquid eyeliner.  Hasn't irritated my eyes, hasn't caused any swelling or itching.  Overall, no scent, no bad side effects, price point is reasonable and I kinda sorta do see some results.

This is a pretty delicate facial cleaner.  The scent, which I thought might be overpowering is very mild and doesn't linger.  This didn't cause any breakouts/ flare ups / rashes.  Worked well on sensitive skin as well.  Washed clean didn't leave my skin feeling dried out at all on the flip side it also did not leave a heavy oily residue of any kind.  Overall, I am enjoying this cleanser a lot.

This is a pretty nice gift set.  The scent is mild and doesn't linger all night long.  I have had no rashes or breakouts while using and my skin feels very moisturized.  The day cream doesn't take long to absorb into the skin and make-up is applied over it without any issues.  The sleep mask doesn't leave a tacky / sticky residue either.  Overall, this is a nice product.

This is a pretty great set to give to someone just getting into styling their hair.  Each brush works well and is rather sturdy.  I have long thick curly hair and am able to use each one without them getting stuck in my hair.  Big big big props for that.  Easy to clean and price point is reasonable.

This is pretty cool, the set has everything (besides clippers) you will need to style your beard/ hair.  The included travel bag is even ruggedly classic looking.  Brush heats very rapidly and doesn't burn / damage hair.  Cord is standard length for any plug in hair appliance.  Brush and accessories are all well made and durable.  overall, Fantastic gift for those they like to ensure their grooming is top notch.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Very soft on the skin and doesn't pinch the head
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: These are very comfortable to wear.  I like that the material feels like a soft plush robe and the elastic inside isn't so tight that it feels like it is squeezing my head off.  Lots of of give to these and they wash well.  Functional and fun to either have or give as a gift.  These haven't gotten tangled in my hair and allow me to push my hair out of the way while I apply make up and then remove without messing up my hair either.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Brushes are a bit softer then I like but still very nice
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: This has a good grip and long handle.  The brushes, there are two different texture types, are softer then I prefer but do function as intended.  I just like a tougher scrubber on one side.  The hang loop is large enough to fit on a hook but not over a large shower stall single turn temperature handle.  Overall, this didn't / hasn't fallen apart, none of the bristles are shedding and the length is long enough to reach my entire back.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Didn't get caught in my curly hair
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: These are better then average coil hair ties.  The plastic coating is smooth throughout the coils and didn't get caught or pull my hair.  They are rather large and have a decent amount of stretch to them, you can twist them 2 or 3 times to get a tight hold.  Also, again, when removing since the edges are all smooth they didn't get tangled or caught in my hair.  While I haven't seen this issue it may come up over time since they are plastic they might loose some of there elasticity over time .

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Easy to apply and no skin irritations
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: This is a pretty nice ampoule.  When looking at it in the bottle it appears a gel like substance, however, it isn't thick when using the eyedropper dispenser.  Goes on smoothly with no oily residue.  My skin did feel tacky for a few minutes while it absorbed.  There is a scent to this, it isn't citrus or fruity I just can't place it.  It's very mild and isn't unpleasant I just don't know how to describe it.  My face does feel soft after using but slightly dry as well.  I have had any irritations or breakouts while using.  Overall, it isn't bad at all and the price point is great.

These are really cool / funky patterned headbands.  The material is that ultra soft t-shirt material.  Very light weight.  The elastic is firm but doesn't pinch your head or give you a headache when wearing over several hours.  Each headband was individually sealed/wrapped in plastic (you can see it in the photos).  The front of the band is pretty wide and the back is still about an 1 to  1 1/2 inches wide.  I have washed all of these twice so far and have had no shrinking or discoloration/ bleeding of the dyes.

I don't like that this is advertised as being 100% aloe when it has additives to it like Phenoxyethanol & Xantham Gum just to list a few. I get sometimes having to add preservatives but one of these is listed as a seriously harmful skin care product.

Now, if you aren't worried about it. Then Yes, this is a thicker gel like cream. The scent is actually very nice and it goes on smoothly to your skin. The absorption is rather quick and doesn't leave a sticky / tacky coating on your skin. Did not stain clothing and when it did get onto clothing washed out completely.

Overall, comes down to what you are comfortable using for YOU which is why I gave it three stars. It isn't for me but it may for others.

I wasn't a large fan of this product. The scent, to me, is very nutty (think walnut shell scent) and did NOT mix well with my body chemistry at all. The oil is thick, like an olive oil, and does spread evenly on the face. Gold-ish colored flakes/coloring is there but it looks like glitter more then anything else.

My skin broke out from using so this just wasn't for me.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Last a good bit of time, not overly flat in matte
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: These are cute.  Thick polishes, depending on how you paint your nails (thick / thin coat) you may only need 1 layer of this polish.  For me, I like to do a single thick coat if possible.  This polish allows that with no major issues.  I did dry / set using a lamp and found that with base coat and 1 coat of this 120 sec was perfect drying time.  (that of course may vary for each person).  I do like the matte look this one isn't so flat that it looks like chalk.  Overall, nice colors, price point is reasonable for what you get.  Polish has lasted over a week with no major chips or peeling.

This is a light weight and pretty great starter shaver for someone. I do like that is arrives with a charge so you can use it right out of the box. You get a charging cable but is is rather short and you do NOT get a wall plug so you will need your own connector.

The side open trimmer is easy to open and use as well.

My largest issue is the noise level of this shaver. It's about double the volume of other brands I have used. Additionally, I don't know if this would hold up if dropped in water or on the floor. Just a FYI the plastic housing unit feel very thin.

Overall, for the price point is a pretty decent starting shaver. However, I don't think you will get years and years of use out of it.

I use these with my little foil wraps (both the home kind and store bought) and they work great. Keeps everything in place and allows me to move about without having to keep my fingers pointed up while I marinate my hands. They clips are firm but not so strong that they cut off circulation to your finger tips or hurt. My 95 year old grandmother used these with me and she is like tissue paper delicate. She had no bruising or other issues.

Overall, these work as advertised and aren't overly expensive.

This, for me, has been pretty soft on my skin. The scent isn't the best, a bit medical/plain but doesn't smell bad at all. The scrub itself is very soft, my skin didn't feel like it was left raw. It felt smooth and clean after use. No breakouts or rashes either. I only needed a small, in-between dime/nickle size, amount to fully wash my fact and neck.

Price point seems reasonable and overall it was nice.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: If you have curly hair these are your new precious
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: These are really well made hair ties.  I was a bit hesitant to use anything with coils in my ultra curly hair.  Most hair ties get caught, pull, or even end up ripping out hair.  These don't do that, the slick plastic coating and coils oddly hold my hair, firmly but my hair doesn't seem to knot itself around the little ties!  Also,  if I use a tie and most ponytail holders slowly slide down the back of my skull throughout the day giving me a droopy tail by mid morning. Again, these ties STAY IN PLACE! even when sleeping I woke up with my hair in a high ponytails... there were still fly a-ways and I looked like I had fluffy hair but lets face it these ties aren't going to change my hair, but they did HOLD IT!!!!  I get to full twists using the Large size, and I really like the Caribbean ocean blue color.  Overall, for me and my crazy hair these are fantastic and I will horde them like the treasures they are.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: I am not sure what this is
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: This is a super thin argan oil  that doesn't feel like or even smell like any other argan oil I have ever used.  This is ultra runny and has a clear yellow color to it.  Honestly, it looks and somewhat smells like vegetable or canola oil.  My hands smell like fast food french fries.  I don't know what this is but I don't think its 100% Aegan oil at all.

This is a really pretty shimmery powder.  Easy to apply to eyelid, around eye , cheeks, nose ect.  Any place you want a little brightness (not to much) added this works very well.  Washed off easily and didn't smear once set with powder or spray.  No rashes or other skin irritations while using.  Very easy to apply.  Price point is standard for the amount but it is pretty versatile so well worth the price point.

My guy really seems to like this face scrub.  He works outdoors a lot with his job so sweat, dirt, grease, sun screen, etc is slapped on his face and in his beard daily.  He says he can feel the difference on his skin and in his beard after using this.  Really helps keep any blackheads or clogged pores from forming.  I enjoy the scent on him, it mixes well with his natural body chemistry.  In general for the price point its a really solid product.

I like this comb a lot. I use it to get nice even parts while braiding the girls hair (one is 2, one is 22 and one is 30 lol) or for myself when wearing my hair up. Nice quality, super easy to clean. If you have thick / curly hair the comb works great for getting those tiny small knots out. I would NOT try to pull this through a large amount of hair at one time.

In general, this is a very nice quality comb and the tail works exactly as I needed/ wanted it to for nice even lines.

I have tried 2 different sets of this bran, so far I like the quality of their products. You get 4 glitter polishes and one standard black polish with this set. It does NOT include a base/top coat.

You can use just as it is. The glitter does really pop when applied over the black or just as a glitter polish. This brand offers some excellent coloring. Often glitter polish has a full look, this is rather vibrant. I did also apply the glitter polish over other brands of gel and had no issues. You need a base coat if you are applying the black (or other color) gel polish on your natural nails, but if you are applying the gel polish on your acrylic or polygel nails you can skip the base coat.

Overall this applies very easily, has standard set times using a UV/LED Light. I got a little over 2 weeks right at 3 weeks before I had any chips or other issues. For MY nails and daily activities that is a very long lasting gel. I am normally happy with 1 to 2 weeks.

Price point is very reasonable for what you get.

The bottles are great. Nice amber color, good thickness and comfortable to hold. Hold a reasonable amount and don't take up a ton of counter space. The labels are even high quality, they have good adhesive and a decorative shape. I like that they are not attached since some of us just dislike using them. If I was just rating the bottle and accessory label I would give this 5 Stars.

However, the Spay nozzle is trash. It's decent plastic but to large for the bottle, the connector point between the sprayer and the bottle doesn't close properly so it leaks if this bottle is tilted and DO NOT turn the bottle over if spaying your hair upside down. Then the nozzle turns , like rotates 360. I don't know if it was designed to do that and if it was then okay, but it's still horrible. One of my spray nozzles broke after 1 use, the pin on the inside of the handle must have let go because if you squeeze the trigger nothing happens it just pushes up and stays in place.

Overall, I just couldn't give it more then 3 stars because of the issues. However, if you just need or want the bottles then its a great deal.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Expensive for "beauty care"  Priced best for crafting
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: These are more firm then your standard issue "Q-Tip" that you get from pretty much any Grocery, Pharmacy, discount store etc.  If you use cotton swabs / q-tips for cleaning or crafts this is the better option since they are so firmly packed.  You won't have the mini fly-a-away's you get when using those.  These have very nice fine edges, and one side "ribbed".  For standard beauty for me these are to expensive.  BUT if you need tiny "lint free" swabs for fine detailing, cleaning or craft design then these are great.  Still expensive however, not having to "correct" lines on epoxy pours or random cotton stands showing up in items these are worth the money.  Overall, these do work either way

I have long thick curly hair, these are able to clip into it without any trouble.  They are made from a light weight plastic/resin and the clips are your standard light weight thin metal.  Neither have broken and none of the mini "twist" hold clips have come off.  Overall, simple to use , look cool , and price well for adding a quick alternative to standard curly hair styles.

These are cute. Perfect party gifts, sleep over fun or stocking stuffers. These are soft to wear and don't fit super snug but stay in place. Probably would be to large for very young kids, the 2 year old mostly played with hers.

They colors are as advertised. No funky smells when opening packaging. You do receive 4 of these per set. Price point isn't bad since you do receive 4. If you are buying for 1 person though might be a bit over the top.

These are mini butterfly shaped cut outs for your nails/art.  You do get two boxes with two different types of butterfly's.  One box contains the holographic or refractive style.  The other box has the butterfly's in neon or dayglow colors.  Each of the boxes has various compartments to hold each individual color.  They will get a bit cross mixes due to static.  These adhere very well, you an use glue or polish with no bleeding of the color.  I also used some of these in epoxy and had zero issues.  Overall, standard material and size, good shapes and very reasonable price point.

You get so many items in this set.  There are two, hard plastic reusable containers of the silver holographic/ refractive butterfly's.  Then you get a massive amount of sticker sheets.  Not all are the same.  Some are 3d real looking butterflies, some are the moth style with detail work, you get the lace style butterfly shapes (I received various types in Black, Cobalt blue, Gold, and Silver)  plus a ton more.  EACH page or sheet is excellent quality.  By far one of the best collections for this price point in variety I have seen in a long time.

This is a nice nail light.  The width of the mouth is large enough to easily get your foot/hand in without scrapping the sides and ruining all the paint you just applied.  Digital screen is easy to read with bright lighting.  Heat/UV is normal and my set / dry times didn't vary by much.  The buttons are easy to press and it stores very well.  Overall, pretty good quality light haven't had any issues.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Can be clear or dark background
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
This is a nice set of polish for anyone that loves shimmering polish. You get 5 shimmer polishes and 1 black polish to use. The shimmer polishes are clear-ish and you can just use the polish for a pastel shimmer or you can apply the black polish as a base and use the shimmer overtop.

The gel scent or nail polish smell isn't overly strong but it is there. The bottles are smaller then some sets but there is enough to do several full sets of nails / toes per bottle. Polish is thick and applicator brush is okay.

This is a cool set. If you don't care for the cat eye design you can still use this polish like anything else. The polish is pretty thick so if you apply a thick coat you can pretty much get away with 1 coat. The magnets aren't super strong, but they don't seem any weaker then other brands that offer a cats eye effect nail product.

Set times are the same as any other gel polish under the UV/LED light. I do find that even after letting this polish cure for 90 sec, if I don't apply a top coat then it always had a slightly tacky feel. Not really uncommon but I have used some brands that don't do that so wanted to point it out.

Overall, really nice set.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Nice scrub, ultra heavy on scent
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
This is a fantastic scrub. Feels wonderful on your skin, washes clean and really works. The scent is really fantastic, but cherry blossom is one of my favorites. This does lean into the heavily scented category though. Not everyone likes or can be around super perfumed items. If that is the case then this isn't for you. It does slowly fade over the day/evening but it is there.

Price point seems reasonable and I do really like the squeeze bottle vs the jars this type of bath product typically comes in.

These are pretty adorable holiday ears! I have a larger head then some lol and a ton of curly hair. This band fits on my head and the ends rest just to the top of my ears (like where eye glasses would rest). It does not dig into my temples. THis is to big for a 2 year old but a 7 year old has no trouble.

You can see a bit of the glue/ building materials when you inspect these closely and the minni ears are not as full as a pair you would get at a Disney park but these are well done.

I typically don't like "earth tone" sets but something about this set is eye catching. The polishes are very colorful and just seem to work. The polish itself goes on well, the applicator brush is decent but square so when the bristles are fanned out it's pretty straight. Not a negative just a FYI. Nice even coating and I would recommend 2 normal coats for the best look.

The set or cure times are no different then any other gel polish I have worked with. I used a matte finish top coat on the green (lime) color and loved it.

Overall, would recommend to others.

If you like shimmer/ glitter polish this is a pretty nice set.  You do receive a base and top coat with 6 glitter colors.  The colors, for me, looked best when applying 2 coat.  I did use the provided base and top coat.  No major tacky/stickiness.  The polish itself doesn't have a bad or high toxic "nail polish" scent.  Set times are normal.  Overall, the colors are really great.

This is cute and works well for cosplay/costume.  Nice coloring on the eucalyptus leaves and the small white flowers while obviously faux do enhance the overall look of the headwrap.  Nice material.  You will need to fluff it up some out of the packaging but looks great.  You can easily use this on small kids.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Nice balance and weight on these tools
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: I like these tools.  For me, the thickness of the tools allows them to be easy to hold and they have nice balance to them.  I don't feel like I need to hold these with a super firm grip.  The brushes haven't shed or lost any bristles.  Nice colors and overall work as designed.  Priced a little higher then some sets but the ultra fine point brush is one of the better ones I have used.

This is so cute!  If your child loves frozen and or wants to get their nail's done this is the perfect little set.  The fan (dryer) isn't overly loud and doesn't hurt the ears.  The polish, is scented but not super strong, goes on easy and is listed as child friendly.  This is NOT gel polish but standard polish and it will peel off over time.  Nice colors and everything needed for little ones to get nails/toes done.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Large kit, lots of re-usable items
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text: You get 3 storage boxes, they are the long 12 chamber plastic kind most Rhinestones for nail art are stored in.  They can be re-used once the flowers are depleted.  Bonus.  The flowers are in 3 sizes L, M and S none are super large all are mini buds at best.  None of the flowers are larger then the small chambers.  The S box did get a lot of cross mixing.  But that wasn't surprising since the dried flowers are so small.  I mostly used these with an epoxy mix but I did also work with nail polish (standard non gel) and had no bleeding of the flowers colors also, none of the flowers disintegrated when touching the liquid or polish which has happened to me with some flowers.  Overall, the tweezers aren't the best and you will need to resort some flowers but they are very nice quality.

I like that these are individually wrapped.  I can toss some in my bag for an over night, my purse or keep one in my desk drawer if I am working late.  The cloths are pretty thick like a high end baby wipe.  No funky or harsh smell when opening.  These don't feel super wet but I had no issue removing basic foundation, lip stick, powder, and eyeliner.  I don't wear mascara often nor water proof makeup so I don't know how well these will remove that type of make-up.  No break outs or over drying out of my face after use.  Would recommend.

These are a nice assortment of nail stickers.  The butterflies have details and look great on nails.  I didn't have any trouble peeling/sticking them.  I did use tweezers for good placement.  Polish, top coat, didn't warp or cause the colors to bleed.  Overall you get 12 sheets for the price of some sets that only contain 4.

These are made from real flowers and do smell good. BUT its a little hard to determine if they should be a tea or a bath enhancer. They are NOT bath bombs. Each mini ball (they are close to a quarter in size maybe a bit smaller) is wrapped in jewel color foil paper. They do each have a fantastic natural floral smell that did not have a chemical scent, to me, in any way.

I have a large 2 person soaker tub. I would need to use pretty much all of these to get a nice overall effect. However, a standard bath tub you could probably use 1 or 2.

For tea or baking these would be better. I am not personally a fan of floral flavored food but many people I know are. In order to bake with these you prep like a tea, strain, press and use liquid for flavor. Set flowers aside and add to batter once it's been poured to maintain shape. OR add to mix if only want the color.

Its a little overpriced IMO but very good quality.

I have the 'confetti' set and I have to say I like almost all of the colors.  The colors with the thread in them aren't my favorite due to the texture but the overall look is cool.  Nice thickness on the polish.  Good applicator brushes and normal dry / set times.  You do get base, top and top matte coat.  Really good sized set for price point.

AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_title: Not really sure what this does
AEOK4TQIKGO23SJKZ6PW4FETNNDA_1.review_text:
So I got this mostly because the art on the box looks like the lady is just tired of everyone on the planet's malarkey and I felt that so I thought why not. Well, guess I should have probably read the box but yeah no. Anyway, I placed this on my eyes and just kind of hoped the world would just stop being all it is at the moment when my 9 to 15 minutes was up.

It wasn't and not much else changed. My eyes still function just as they did before. That is good. I had no burning or other nasty issues, which is also good. But overall not really sure what benefit or negative I have out of this besides a story about me requesting a box purely on the fact that I related to someone's over it look.

This is a simple to use nail polish remover.  I did not need to flip it, just pop the lid and press as shown in the ad.  I was able to remove standard polish (that is all I tried it on) in super quick time and it didn't stink up my area with harsh chemical scent. Update 8.03:
