This one feels very nice on my skin and I love the way my skin is looking and feeling now. I would definitely recommend it! Especially, for those using Retin-A or those with very sensitive skin.

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: A Nail Techs view: Perfect kit for the beginner! Great customer service. 5 stars⭐
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
This Belle polygel kit is a great starter set from beginner to expert levels. It has some beautiful neutral colors, along with a white, and gorgeous glitters. They are all half ounce size tubes that will create a few sets of nails each, or you can mix and match the colors to make them go farther.
This kit includes; Six .5 oz. polygel colors, primer, gel base and top coats, a nail strengthener, cuticle oil, slip solution, dual forms, polygel brush with spatula, nail clips, and alcohol wipes. It comes nicely packaged in a lovely black box with cutouts to hold everything in place.
At minimum, you will need to supply your nail prep and finishing tools and liquids, such as: cuticle pusher and possibly nippers, a buffer, and nail dehydrator/alcohol, but these are things you will want to keep in good supply, anyways.
This polygel is so easy to work with. It is not too hard nor too soft. It's very easily workable with the provided slip solution. Even a beginner will have no trouble using it. Just remember, that if your surrounding temperature gets too cold or too hot, it affects the viscosity of the polygel, so work in a room that feels nice.
I did two nail swatches; one solid glitter and the other a French manicure with a shimmery twist. As I said, the polygel applied so easily, it also cured as expected without any problems, and the end results turned out beautiful.
I have to say that when I received my Belle polygel kit, there was a small issue with my order. I contacted their customer service and was met with such kindness and prompt service. They answered all my questions very quickly and respectfully. They're promptness in solving my problem, and their patience in dealing with my questions, shows me that they really care about their customers. Knowing that they were not privy to my customer status lets me know that they will treat all customers the same.
The colors are all so beautiful, and the glitters really make a statement. This set would make a great addition to anyone's collection and would also make a wonderful gift. Knowing this polygel kit is also backed by Belle, a wonderful company who really values their customers, makes a great product even better. I would most definitely recommend it!

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: A Stylist's View: Has defects and is unusable. Bad customer service.
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
The straight razor (shavette) I received is far from being professional quality nor could it be an heirloom that can be passed down in the family. It is made from cheap materials and has several defects.
The clasp is so thinly made, that it is easily bent just from disengaging it from the spine. There is a gouge on one spine that goes in on one side and out on the other. And, the razor blade does not stay seated properly once clasped. The wooden scales are not neatly finished. The blades that come with it are not the snap kind. They are full double sided blades, making them more dangerous to have to cut them without getting cut. They are also very thin and cheap. There's no way I can shave a neck, sideburns, facial hair, etc., with this defective razor.
I could have overlooked cosmetic issues regarding a razor of this price point. It is the physical defects that hindered its use that are major problems for me.
I contacted the seller, but was told that I could keep the defective product, and "we recommend another straight for you, better than that one in your hand", and I was given the asin number, so I could purchase it. This was not only poor Customer Service, but a lack of confidence in this, their own product. If they don't recommend this razor, I certainly don't either. It really could have gone much better.

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: A Nail Tech's View: A great sampler set. So fun!
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
This is a great sampler set by KRISNICE. You get a black polish to use as a base or on its own, a couple of color changing polishes, a couple of cat eye polishes, and a sparkly red polish. They are all beautiful and the effects all work well. The cat eyes do require a few coats to get good coverage, and a bit of practice with the magnet to get a good design. The good thing about those are, you can always swipe through the design and start over till you get something you like, and then cure. I love the color changing ones the best, but they only show two toned on longer nails. Otherwise, they just change from one color to another, which is still pretty.
The huge thing about this company's sets that I don't like, is they are not labeled. Yes, you get stickers to swatch, but they don't stick! You end up having to glue them on or make other swatches. I really wish they would label or swatch the bottles. I'm starting to not get polish from brands that don't label. It's just such a hassle.
Overall, I love all the colors and effects. You can really come up with some unique nail designs with this set. I love the color change with one layer of the purple cat eye over top. This is a good mix and a lot of fun! I would recommend

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: Simply wonderful ingredients 👇! Feels lovely.
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
This Hydro-Plumping Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a simple, yet a powerhouse serum. It has wonderful moisturizing, anti-aging, antioxidant, and calming ingredients that are top notch. It applies and absorbs easily, and a little does go a long way. Any slight tackiness is taken care of after applying a good moisturizer to help lock in all the good stuff. It has a very light, hardly noticeable scent.
It really hydrates my skin and plumps my fine lines and wrinkles. My skin looks and feels better when using it. I have combination skin, but use Retin-A, which can be a bit drying and sometimes irritating. This serum really calms the irritation, yet enhances the anti-aging effects of the Retin-A.

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: A Nail Tech's View: I really like this gel!
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
The Builder Nail Gels Kit in Clear & Pink is medium to semi thin ~ especially if it is used in warm temperatures. It is nothing like polygel, though it includes a slip solution. The clear is really clear and the pink is nice, also, though I don't use colors a lot. This applies so easily for me, cures as expected, and looks great. I am even able to build an apex.
The brush and other accessories are sub-par, like what most inexpensive sets have. They will do well for a newbie, until they figure out if they like the process. Then, they can replace them with better quality items.
The slip solution is confusing to be in a builder gel kit, though I find it great for wiping the sticky layer off the nails after application. It can also be used to clean the brush handle, and any other sticky places.
I am more than happy with the quality, viscosity, and end results I achieve with this builder gel. You also get a large amount of product to work with. It will last me a while. I love working with it, and would definitely recommend it!

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: Beautiful colors, and so easy to use! May need a wisp of translucent powder...
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
This LUXAZA 6 PCS Khaki Brown Neutral Eyeshadow Stick Set is so gorgeous! All of the colors are beautiful when applied alone, or used together. They are so easy to use and blend with the brush that is on the opposite end of each stick.
The colors are buildable, so you can have a whisper of color or make a bold statement. They also have great staying power, but can be washed away quickly with any cleanser.
My eyelids are naturally oily, so I have to add a wisp of translucent powder over top, so they won't stay tacky. They still keep the shimmer, too, which is not overdone. It is just right for my 51 year young self to wear and not look silly, just elegant.
I love this eyeshadow stick set! From the colors to the ease of use, it just works well. The colors would look beautiful on anyone's skin tone, and they are great for a busy schedule. It is easy to place them all into a pretty cosmetic jar or even a drawer for quick access.
They come nicely packaged and are more than worthy of gifting to any makeup lover. I would absolutely recommend these!

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: Nothing spectacular. I have received more... for this price.
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
This Hair Removal Device by Ulike just as well as a couple of other IPL devices I have that cost much less. It comes packaged nicely, though I kept trying to open the flat two-sided green piece that covers the accessory side. It doesn't open.
The device does look quite fancy, and I was interested in skin rejuvenation, which is in one of the photos (that is mentioned in the other listing that shows this exact same device). The instruction booklet contains about as much as the empty listing page that I ordered it from. That page has no bullet points, only one photo.
They do have another listing for this same exact device, showing the accessories, extra photos with bits of information, and bullet points telling a little about it. I got my information from there.
The device does have the cooling feature, as many others do, which helps it not to zap too badly. It also comes with a razor and eye protection.
What it lacks, that many others include that are in or around this price range, is more attachments for the device. There needs to be at least one smaller light head for use around the lip area, as it's very hard to use the main one with the device being so large.
This IPL device works pretty much as well as any other, with none having the ability to make you completely hair-free at any point in the future. As far as the studies that I have seen, with diligent use, home IPL devices can only offer a little better than 50-60%-ish less hair.
My preferred device, which costs very little more than this one, has several attachments, including some specifically for skin rejuvenation. You do get a fancy box with this device, and it looks nice, but I don't think it provides any more or less than devices that cost much less.
I haven't found one yet that really only takes 10 minutes to do your legs, but if I ever do, that is the one that would probably take the cake! If you like fancy boxes and a sleek-looking device, I would recommend this one.

AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_title: A bit too oily for my skin. Most of the great ingredients are far down on the list...
AES3YWD3ONJOUDRWFIV2ZO44QDAQ.review_text:
This PENEBELLA Anti-Aging Face Cream is filled with emollient oils, and not much green tea, which is something I love in a skin care product. My skin is normal to oily, but also sensitive, and cannot handle all of the oils in this product. It sort of just sits on top of my skin.
I really wish the company would have listed the ingredients, instead of pointing out the great ingredients that are in minute amounts. Aside from glycerin, the other touted ingredients are almost halfway down, or lower, on the ingredients list, or are not so skin friendly. Green tea is wonderful for your skin, but it is near the bottom of the ingredients list. Also, the type of vitamin C, Ascorbyl Palmitate, is not very skin friendly, and can actually be very irritating to sensitive skin, like mine.
This moisturizer may work well for those with very dry skin, but I would have liked to see the boasted about skin loving ingredients closer to the top of the ingredients list. Full transparency is always best, and will make customers happy. Listing some wonderful ingredients that are minimally effective in very small amounts, is a bit misleading. This moisturizer has way too many oils for my skin, is a bit irritating, and is not my favorite...

AES7RASIJQEGKUNG5G6667DTO2GQ.review_text: I was excited to try these press-ons, I thought the cool colors and diamond shaped nails would make for an impressive and easy mani. The packaging was pretty nice, a flip open style case that looked promising. Upon opening the nails, I noticed that the colors were mostly on point when compared to the picture, save for the grey nails that looked a little more lavender in real life. I was happy with the design and colors. The nails weren't too big/small, and had a good assortment of sizes. Now, these nails are THIN. They bend super easily and they really don't hold up well to being removed and re-applied. The nails fell off less than 10 minutes after I affixed the stickers to my natural nails. They don't hold at all. I found they looked rather cheap, flimsy and obviously fake when they were on. The grey color was the worst, the chameleon color and diamond style better. The blue diamond shaped nails were a little thicker, too. They looked the best, I think. I would not recommend this for anyone more than a playset or an emergency kit. I do appreciate the lack of glue, but I couldn't get over the fact that the nails fall off and bend SO easily and that they looked a lot cheaper than other press-ons I've bought for the same price or lower.

I was so happy when these arrived. The stickers looks absolutely beautiful, a first glance I fell in love. The designs and the colors were great; the colors have an iridescent quality in addition to the wide range of colors, it really adds another layer.'

Now, what disappointed me. These don't stick, like at all. There is a small amount of stickiness that lasts for mere seconds before these things fall off their surface (I've tried plastic, acrylic, skin, hardwood, and even carpeting to see). Honestly I was pretty surprised that these didn't stick to my carpet fibers. You can see in my photo that I used these for nail art, and the lifting is visible. I held the stickers down when I noticed them lifting from the nail, but after a 30 seconds of holding the sticker down (onto a top coat, too) the gorgeous little butterflies lifted anyway.

I want to give this product more stars so badly. The three stars I have given are for the aesthetics alone, while the other two stars are missing because the product does not really work the way it is intended to. I would recommend buying these as long as you are aware that you're going to need another product to make these stick to whatever surface you are using, and that lifting of the sticker away from the surface can happen.

This set surprised me, because I wasn't expecting these powders to be anything more than the average. I love that this is portable and take up little space. The colors are a good mix, although I'd be happier with one of the pinks substituted for something more exciting. Overall great color choices.

The brush is excellent, no fibers fell off and the brush was soft and cleaned the nail powder from the nails without marring the nail surface. The little side set of a cuticle pusher and nail files was nice, I really enjoyed the addition of a cuticle trimmer.

The powders are absolutely amazing. These are the first powders I've ever used that came out perfect, nail after nail. It was extremely easy, and the powder so smoothly covered the nail that I didn't even need to buff them before top coat. They were just smooth, I've never had that happen with dip powders before. The color is also nice and vibrant, you don't need more than 3 dips (I wanted a nice, solid pink) to achieve your look. The addition of the brush saver (step 4) was a lifesaver, I feel it's a must have for doing dip nails.

I didn't like the top coat at all. It didn't spread well, felt stiff, didn't give a good shine... it didn't make sense as the rest of the kit was pretty great. I'd use another top coat next time. Also, the pots of powder are kind of small to dip your nails in, but I made it work. I'd definitely purchase the powders again, I would love to see a powder and brush saver set! I can give or take the activator and base coat, but don't recommend the top coat. Great starter dip set.

These hair clips were so cute! My little sisters absolutely adored these ponies, both colors (there were two hair clips included) looked lovely. They're sequin covered, and I was very pleasantly surprised that none of the sequins fell off during use. One hair clip was a sort of rose gold, or rather a gold to pink look. The other was rainbow colored, very cute. They were a tiny bit large for my sisters, ages 7 and 10. However, they didn't slide down or fall off at all, and they were nice and light to wear. I loved the design and would definitely buy other designs if they were available. The only reason I didn't give these clips a five star rating is because they are a little too big for the age group they're meant for. You sort of have to finagle the hair style around the pony hair clips. Otherwise, I'm very happy with these and my sisters were great fans :)

These nails are so beautiful. I have the green design, which is really well done and not too overwrought. The set comes with a prep pad, cuticle pusher, and emory board. I would have loved the addition of nail glue or even glue tabs but they weren't included here unfortunately. The nails applied easily, but they were a tad bit longer than I like. The nails didn't last as long as some cheaper sets that I own, but they lasted a good four days before one chipped. Overall, lovely nails, great design, pretty good quality for the price.

AESCAQQYIK3SYLMLRXPRNPKXIC4A.review_title: Not suitable for thick and wavy hair
AESCAQQYIK3SYLMLRXPRNPKXIC4A.review_text:
I really loved the idea of this hair straightener brush, so I decided to give it a try. I straighten my hair just about every day and I have long, thick and naturally wavy hair. I am always on the hunt for easier and quicker way to do my hair. Ultimately, I am hoping to save some time off my busy morning routine because every minute counts. This brush heats up quickly and it is safer than flat irons simply because there is a lower chance of burning myself. However, I find this tool a little too heavy for me to handle and it is quite impossible for me not to touch those three buttons on the side of the device switching the temperature up and down while working on my hair. It leaves my hair fluffy and does not do a great job straightening the roots because there is only so close I can get to my head. I have to section my hair piece by piece just like I do with a flat iron and it does not get all the frizz out as well as a flat iron. It turns out that I spend more time than my regular straightener trying to get the job done. Sadly, this brush works fine but not as well as my flat iron and not like I have imagined.

I admit that this device is not only well made and very sturdy, it is also of high quality and attention to details. I really want to love this product, but I don't think it lives up to the claim that it straightens my hair fully. I will say that it does straighten to certain degree and does a decent job of taming some frizz, but nowhere near in comparison to what I would get from a straightening iron. On top of that, it does not do a good job at straightening my bangs. In fact, it is too large to reach the roots. Every time I stroke my hair to straighten I hit the button and it turns it off. It will take some serious practices to get used to. Regardless, this is a good product for second day straight hair where I just need a touch up or if my hair is already partially straight. I think this straightener would be great for someone who does not have very thick hair like I do. My hair certainly looks less wavy and perhaps slightly less frizzy, but this tool does not straighten hair for the silky effect that I hope it will achieve. Since everyone has different texture of hair, I strongly believe this will work great for those who have thinner, tamer hair or simply using this brush as a touch-up tool.

Disclosure: I purchased this hair straightener brush at a discount for my honest and unbiased review.

But the best part is how this clipper cuts through any sort of nails "like butter"--smoothly, so so easily. I can now trim my nails in half the time it used to take, and I no longer need to "smooth out" small sharp corners of nail that I used to get because of how the the whole instrument (older, smaller clippers I had) would move during the cutting action. It's very hard to find *any* purely straight-bladed nail clippers (which I find far more versatile than the curved ones) either online or in stores, and among the few available on amazon, I am convinced these can't be beat. The "pro" in its name is entirely appropriate.

Note 1: When you first unpack this product, the gap between the two cutting edges might not seem as wide as you might like, particularly for larger toenails, but then it opens to a better size when you get the push-lever handle up.

Note 2: This is my unvarnished and uncompensated opinion. The company did send me a very polite email a few days after I got the product, urging me to write a review, but not for any sort of consideration. I recommend them without reservation.

AESGMO3NEHWADGMEMZUWF55TG5AA.review_title: Can't imagine a superior model of nail-clippers
AESGMO3NEHWADGMEMZUWF55TG5AA.review_text:
It's sometimes hard to tell from small web photos just how a product will look and feel for real. The amazon picture for this clipper did look quite appealing, but I can say that in real life the item's quality is even higher than I'd been expecting. AESH4UBOA6VWZ36CIYMP4JVYPOLA.review_title: A little large and I did not receive clippers
AESH4UBOA6VWZ36CIYMP4JVYPOLA.review_text: The nails are ok quality. They are thin and flexible. However, if your nails are on the small side, these may be challenging to use. I had to file the smallest size down to use on my pinky nails.  They were decently easy to work with, but I was a little frustrated that the listing was not as described. I filed them with an e file. I began dipping my nails at home due to COVID. I am not a professional, but I am decent at working with nails. I will still use these, but I would not purchase again-especially because I can only use half of them.

AESH4UBOA6VWZ36CIYMP4JVYPOLA.review_title: I wish I would have got the mascara wand
AESH4UBOA6VWZ36CIYMP4JVYPOLA.review_text:
I have tried to use this product for 3 weeks, but I cannot see any difference. There is barely any product in the tube. It is practically dry. You have to reinsert the wand multiple times just to get any coverage on your lashes. I cannot tell any difference except maybe they are softer. I do feel like when I use mascara after this product, the lashes seem fuller. I was really hopeful to see growth.

Once I tried this product on my eyebrows, it seemed to make them fuller (what little product I could get out). I do not think this product is worth the price.

I do like this cleanser, but beware if you have oily skin. It is super oily. I also do not feel like it takes off the dirt as well as other cleaners. My skin feels super soft after. I also think the packaging is super cute, and I appreciate the included applicator.  I love products with hyaluronic acid, so I am a fan of this product, especially for morning use.

I am by no means a professional. I just recently started derma rolling. I prefer to use the micro needle roller first. It isn’t the most comfortable feeling, but you get use to it. I do it while I am watching T.V. To distract myself. While rolling, I put the jade roller in the refrigerator. Once I finish with the micro needle, I apply hyaluronic acid, and then roll with the jade roller. It is SO SOOTHING. The roller has two sides- a large end for the planes of your face, and a small end to get in smaller areas like under your eyes. I only use the micro needle roller once a week-usually on Saturday nights. It does make your face a little red, but it goes away by morning. I use the jade roller a couple times a week, especially after stressful days. Just so you know, make sure to sterilize both rollers or you will have major breakouts from spreading bacteria around. I keep alcohol in a small spritzer to use on both before each use. The  packaging was sufficient, and I would feel comfortable giving it as a gift.

My garbage skin care routine finally caught up to me, so after doing some research, I decided on this retinol serum. I use it in the evening on clean skin. I like that the product is vegan and non gmo. They product has a nice scent and a great  consistency. Since using this product, I feel as if my pores are smaller and my skin is more even overall with both color and lines. I will continue to use this product in my daily routine.

I did not realize how much dead skin I had. Once using this product, it little comes off like little toilet paper rolls (I know gross). I usually use them on my husbands back. These are great to use before shaving to avoid getting ingrown hairs. I also use these once a week before applying self tanner. I use these after I have been in the shower for a few minutes and my skin has softened. Great product!

AESH4UBOA6VWZ36CIYMP4JVYPOLA.review_title: Good for extending but a bit challenging to apply
AESH4UBOA6VWZ36CIYMP4JVYPOLA.review_text: This is a tan extender to use after you have already tanned. It deepens your color and adds richness. The scent is not bad, and it is a pretty large pump bottle for around $30 at the time of purchase. I do apply this product with a mitt like regular self tanners, and I use a beauty blender or brush on my hands, feet, and neck for a better blend. My only major issue with this is it goes on clear so its super challenging to apply it evenly to avoid streaking. However if you already have a base tan, this is less noticeable.

I feel like this polish would be suited for a children's set. The bottles aren't small, but they do not contain much product. The colors are beautiful, but unfortunately I had chipping by the end of the day. Spending an hour on my nails for them to chip by the end of the day is a no go for me. This would be a decent set for someone to practice with since you get 15 bottles for around $20 at the time of purchase, but unfortunately it isn't very good quality.

For reference, I have combination skin that is very picky. I struggle with breakouts, dry skin, and redness.
This is a great setting powder. I tend to do my skin care routine and then do a very LIGHT dusting of this product before applying my foundation. This I put on my foundation, blush, and contour, and then apply the setting spray. I then finish with another SMALL dusting of this product using my moist beauty blender. The trick is to use a very small amount for a pore-less look.

AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_text:
I tested this cleanser out, and here's what I found:

You might like this if:
- You want a light scent
- You want a lot of product
- You want nice packaging
- You want a quality cleanser

You might not like this if:
- You don't want to pay $20+ for a bottle of cleanser

AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_title: Everything you want in a hair tie!
AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:62456b6bbc2e85c69bda48d7185009ee]] I tested these hair ties out, and they exceeded my expectations. Here's what I found:

Pros:
- Sturdy yet stretchy
- Holds hair all day
- Gentle on hair
- Great color selection
- Comes in a nice bag
- Good value for the price

Cons:
- None!

[[VIDEOID:7d7621192ab572360bb43963d12d5e77]] These have exceeded my expectations!

Each little container is sturdy and small enough to stash anywhere, with a little hole through one end so you can make a keychain out of it.

Each colored container has soap of the same color (it doesn't show up on your hands), and they have different scents that are mild and pleasant.

They are easy to use. The sheets tear easily, the soap dissolves quickly and makes a good lather, and a little goes a long way.

My only issue with them is a couple of them didn't come with the sheet sticking out of the slot, so I had to wrestle with it a little to get it opened and adjusted. But in doing so, I discovered that there is a good sized roll in the container! With five in a pack, these will last a long time.

Very handy, and will be great for camping!

It works and feels good on the skin, smooth and moisturizing. I can tell that it is a better quality product than your average hand sanitizer. But I found the smell unpleasant and overpowering, so I don't like to use it.
I also found the little screw on cap to be inconvenient when trying to put sanitizer on.

This is a great set! You get a good sized box full of stuff.
Upon opening it, I was initially disappointed when I saw they went kinda cheap with the eye mask- it's only about half full of the gel beads. It's mostly air. Because of this, I assumed the whole kit would be cheap. But it's actually pretty nice! The packaging is great, you get a big pack of the facial cleansing wipes and five of the face masks, and it all feels great on your skin.
My skin was softer after the mask. I suggest warming it first - I tossed it in its package right into my hot bath, along with the eye gel mask. The mask can be a little drippy ( they usually are), so soaking in the bath with it on means no clean up.
The lip treatment was great! My lips were a little dry and peeling, and after the treatment, they were so soft and moisturized.
Nothing had any unpleasant fragrances, either. Which I appreciate.
I really enjoyed taking the evening to pamper myself with this kit, and it would make a great gift!
Totally recommend it.

AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_title: Not terrible, but not for me
AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_text:
After trying these masks out, here's what I found:

Pros:
- No fragrance
- Very moisturizing
- Easily fits big faces

Cons:
- Cold and slimy
- Very drippy
- Slightly numbed my skin in a disconcerting way
- Gave me breakouts
- Kind of pricey (currently $18 for 3)

Overall, these weren't the worst. I think that if someone had really dry skin, and warmed these up and wrung them out a little before use, they might be absolutely great for them.

The makeup remover pads are decently thick and fluffy, and are soft on the skin while still cleaning. I don't recommend using just water for the removal of makeup, regardless of what the product claims. These will only clean the surface. You need something that will really cut through the makeup and cleanse everything that has worked its way into your pores. But with a cleanser, these will be effective.

The size of the pads are smaller than they are made to look online online. That's not really an issue, but be aware.

The headband is made of a towel-like material, and it is plenty big enough to wrap around anyone's head and not be tight. I like it.

The only issue I have with this set is the price for what you get. Three little pads, a headband, and a flimsy laundry bag don't quite seem worth the current listed price of $19.

Otherwise, nice.

AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_title: A nicer way to clean your face
AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_text:
At first I thought there's no way these are good for anything, but they incredibly soft and pleasant to use. And they actually do a pretty good job of cleaning. When I tested them out with the just water method, there was still makeup residue left behind, but much less than I expected. I use an oil cleanser with them, and my pores are squeaky clean.
They hold up pretty well in the wash, I've had one or two loops come loose. I really like the wash bag they come with. For the price, these are a great buy.

This mask is okay, but there are better ones out there, especially for the price (currently $25).

The consistency is a little on the thin side, but applies smoothly. It dries okay, and the smell is mild and pleasant. It washes off easily, and it did leave my softer and a little brighter.

But it really didn't do much for the overall quality of my skin - the softness and brightness were gone by morning, blackheads were still visible, and existing acne was not improved.

I have personally tested a number of masks that did a lot more for my skin, and some at half the price. This one isn't bad, and may be a great option for those who want something mild, but I wouldn't buy it again.

This mascara and eyelash curler combo has its pros and cons:

The mascara - I actually really like this mascara, which I didn't expect, given the price and the cheap packaging it comes in. The formula is smooth and glides on easily, and the curled brush on the wand is dense enough and shaped just right to get every little lash. But most importantly, it stays on ALL day without running or flaking. I'd say it's pretty waterproof, but also comes off easily with eye makeup remover. I had a brand for mascara that I have been loyal to for years, but this is my new go-to in my makeup bag. And the price is great! My only issue with it is that it dries very quickly, so any mistake you make isn't going to budge. It also means that it's easy to make the lashes stick together if you don't apply it carefully.

The eyelash curler - Actually I only have cons about this one. I hate it. It's shaped in a way that makes it difficult to use. The finger grips are set too far apart, making it awkward to squeeze, and the shape of the press is odd and it to angle my lashes into it. It's basically useless, and I tossed it in favor of my simple revlon lash curler.

This mascara, however, I will be buying again!

This combination brow pencil has exceeded my expectations. I can accomplish any look I want for my brows with just one product: outlining, filling in gaps, softening, shaping, and securing stray hairs.

I tried all three tips, and each one is of decent quality. I really like the tiny brush. It is just the right size and shape to quickly and easily guide over my eyebrows, and the product on it offers just the right amount of tint and hold without making my brows look overdone.

I have been searching for just the right product for my eyebrows, which has become overwhelming because there are a lot out there. But my search is over. I will definitely get this again.

*Though this review is of a product I received for free, I always thoroughly test the product out and give my honest, unbiased opinion as if I had purchased it.*

I couldn't get these to work on my hair, and the struggle just ended with cheap plastic tangled all in my hair. The clips are pretty weak, both the one on bottom and the smaller ones on top, and didn't hold my hair. They feel pretty cheap.

The method also seems pretty straight forward in theory, but more challenging in practice. Figuring out what hair to lift and where to place the clip underneath took some practice, and then the clip kept sliding while I was trying to put the twists in place.

Needless to say, it looked nothing like the pictures. These may just be better suited to thick hair - mine is fine and straight.

I definitely wouldn't get these again.

This is a great set to expand your range of dip powder colors. It has the perfect mixture of bold and subtle colors. The containers are really small, so whether you have short nails or not, save yourself the headache and use these in something larger. The dip powder recycling trays are great for this. You can also pour the powder directly on your nails over a paper plate, then fold the plate to funnel it back into the container.
The dip powder works well, and the price is good, so I think it's a good purchase!

I couldn't seem to keep this foundation from looking cakey or settling into lines. It definitely settles when you don't use the primer. The primer is pretty good - silky, and a little goes a long way. With it on, the foundation doesn't settle much, but it still looks cakey unless you put barely any product on. At that point, it's pretty sheer and doesn't do much.
I liked the shades, and was able to match my skin tone by mixing the two.
The brush that comes with it is also pretty useless. Very soft, and too thin to really blend in the makeup.
Overall, it seems nice, but I just couldn't get it to work for me.

They are fine, but not worth the price. The size of the wipe is about half the size of a baby wipe, meaning you're not going to get all that much cleaning done with just one.

The smell isn't very good. I know they're more natural, but for the price they could have added a drop on essential oil or something.

They say you can use them for body grime and odor, but be careful where you put them. Any skin that qualifies as sensitive may get a burny/tingly feeling that makes you question your decisions...that's all I'm saying about that.

The price is just too high for these ten very average wipes.

AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_title: The nicest part is the box
AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_text: Honestly, I was disappointed in these. The quality isn't great and I feel like the colors were misrepresented. None of them are as bright as they appear online, and the glitter in the sparkly ones is so fine that it mostly just makes it look cloudy. The tubes have stickers slapped on them that don't stay on. The packaging is nice and really giftable, though. It all comes nicely arranged in a gift box. But once you get past that, it's kind of....meh. There are better sets (and colors) for the price.

I was disappointed when I got this because the pictures of the roller part make it look (I thought) like it was made of something soft like silicone. It's a hard plastic, which isn't super comfortable on injured or tired muscles. But when it, I found that it actually works pretty well. It stays cool for longer than expected and really did relieve the pain from a strained muscle I had. I still wish the roller was made of something that conformed a little more, but the shape isn't unpleasant.

This was a total hit with our 4 year old Frozen fan! The presentation is great, with it opening like a big book full of sparkly, colorful nail supplies, and pictures of her favorite characters everywhere. The nail polish works great, with most of them showing up really well on little nails (some of the glitter ones aren't as noticeable, as with any nail polish). They dry pretty quickly, and the dryer helps. They also peel off pretty easily, which can be a plus or a minus. After about a day half of them are coming off. The stickers are tiny, so they should fit anyone! Very pleased with this product.

As far as retinol serums go, this is a good one. The ingredients are pretty straightforward, without much added in that doesn't need to be there. Retinol is high up on the list of ingredients, which is actually kind of surprising given the price. So this one will get the job done without breaking the bank, which is rare in the skincare world. Give it a try! Just be prepared for your skin to possibly look worse before it gets better, or increased sensitivity (common reactions to retinol).

AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_title: One of the better ones I've used
AESI2BA4YODTHOSRFLJCSTAM6XDQ.review_text: This shaver is better than some I have tried. It feels pretty sturdy and cuts easily through some pretty thick hair. The metal didn't feel rough on my skin, and only on or two hairs snagged when I moved too quickly. Not bad. I do think the handle is a bit bulky for the areas it is meant for. I also found the charging cord difficult to put in, which may lead to something breaking down the line.

This is a really good lotion, though I think i bit too heavy for kids. I have chronic severely dry skin, and it works well for me. It's actually so thick that I dilute it a bit with a more watery lotion so it spreads more easily and lasts longer (the bottle isn't that big).
I do think it needs to come in a better container, because it is too thick for the bottle it comes in.

Very pretty drill! I found the power and battery life to be comparable to the other rechargeable drills that I have tried, but this one is definitely the most attractive. And the LCD display with the battery life shown on it is really helpful! I have had a lot of manicures interrupted because I didn't realize that the battery was low. I feel that this one is worth the price, and good for newbies and veterans alike.
I also ordered the blue set of colors and received reds, as other reviewers have stated. I even exchanged them out in hopes it was a mistake. Pretty disappointing. The reds seem fine, though.

AESIZ3ATHVPMZM5NI6ZJOZBH547A.review_title: Would never go back to regular razors...
AESIZ3ATHVPMZM5NI6ZJOZBH547A.review_text:
I've had my eye on this for awhile, and finally got it for Christmas. There were a few key reasons I wanted one. First, wet/dry shaving sounded great, especially dry without wasting water down the drain. Also, the cost of replacement razors for the venus and similar items is ridiculous, so I'd only change it when it got very dull. Plus, I hated throwing away the plastic and adding to the landfills. The reviews of this seemed promising, and I'm glad to say, I definitely agree!

The razor works really well dry shaving, and its so much easier then balancing precariously on one foot in a wet shower. Not too loud, once you get started you forget it's making any noise. According to the package, you need to replace the foils once a year and the razors in the machine every two years. Imagine the money I'll save! Especially if you go thru multiple 8 packs of venus razors a year. It doesn't get as close a shave as the regular razor, but thats not a big deal for me. I'll use this on a normal basis and get out the razor when I need the babysoft feel.

I'm a big fan, and will never go back to using traditional razors full time.

I’ve never tried something particularly like this, though I have tried microdermabrasion with an at home machine. I have hormonal breakouts on my chin and some blackheads on and around my nose. I used a warm towel on my face for a few minutes to open up the pores.  I started on my nose and you wouldn’t believe the crap that came out. Yucky yellow goo. I used it on the lowest setting and that was a fair amount of suction. Maybe after some normal use I will move up to a higher speed but to start that worked really well. My skin felt a lot softer and smoother after use. I like the different heads that come with it. I tried a few of them and they were all very different, so they'll definitely come in handy. The pore cleaner is easy to hold with the silicone handle. Easy to charge and easy to clean! I’m a big fan. This will definitely become part of my regular routine after a nice warm shower.

I have previously used minzon snail cream and really like it. I was excited to get more snail-centric cream! As I get older(late 30s now) I have more dry skin issues. This is very creamy and dense. A deeply hydrating cream for sure. I use it at night before bed so it has time to sink it. It doesn't sink in fast, but that's fine with me. I love the citrus fragrance. Orange-y and fresh but not overpowering. The jar is heavy and expensive feeling, nice packaging overall. I like most of the ingredients a lot, though there are a few I don't love (dimethicone and butylene glycol) which is why It's 4 instead of 5 stars for me.

I use this after a shower and it sinks in within a minute which is great. An easy to use dropper and glass bottle which is my preference over any plastic containers. It has a thin gel like consistency and I didn't notice any scent. The two big ingredients besides the retinol are aloe and witch hazel which are very calming and good for the skin. It has Jojoba oil, which is a 2 on the comedogenic(pore clogging) scale. 0-1 is my goal since I can have hormonal breakouts on my chin, but so far, so good. Its super easy to use because it doesn't sit on top of the skin, you can continue with your other skin care like moisturizers or oils because it absorbs so nicely!

I tried curology but found it really harsh and didn't like the things I read about the company. I also didn't like that it's difficult to cancel and sometimes they just ship and say whoops sorry we already sent your new supply. I didn't have the time or patience to talk to some derm at curology and keep using myself as a guinea pig for their adjustments to the custom product. Anyway.... I've always found zinc helpful for my skin and niacinamide was in one of my curology products so I thought, hey for like 7 bucks, lets try The Ordinary. After using this morning and night for a few weeks, I'm like WHOA. I'm in my late 30's, have had hormonal breakouts for like 2 decades, recently stopped taking birth control and my chin/jawline has been going hormonally bananas. A few cystic and white heads galore. To be honest, nothing upsets me like a bad blemish. It makes me want to wear a mask like phantom of the opera. Super self conscious about it. Since using the Ordinary my chin area has calmed down, is a lot less irritated and red. The spots that seemed ready to go have diminished and lessened. This product is so simple, gentle yet quite effective. I was tired of all the acne things that dry the crap out of my face. I'll definitely keep this in my skincare forever. I love it, I love the price. I'd pay many more dollars to keep my skin clear but I am really super into the affordability. Happiness all around.

I find soaking my nails with clips and cotton in acetone both tedious and laborious. It’s the only thing I absolutely detest about gel polish. This is the second steam gel remover machine that I have used. This one feels like it’s more substantial and well-built than the other one(steam off brand). Comes with 2 plastic acetone dishes and 4 additional finger hole sheets. I like that it has a click on/off button versus the push button which was the reason I returned the last one(Plus it only powered on 20% of the time).

I use my electric nail drill to take off the top coat and wear down the polish a bit. It gives the steam somewhere to penetrate. If you skip this step, it won't be effective. Also, make sure to use 100% acetone. With the right steps, it takes off my gel polish (even with glitter) in 10 minutes. Depending on the brand and how many layers of polish, it usually takes 10-15 minutes to get the polish to curl up and then with a steel tool, the polish easily pushes off.

The timer on this one seems to turn off after five minutes but I didn’t really mind that, you just click it off and turn it back on to continue. This one isn’t as comfortable to rest your fingers in as the other one, but as long as it gets the gel polish off easily I’m willing to deal with it. After 2+ months of use, I’m happy with this! So much easier, faster and kinder to your nails.

I've tried a lot of different under eye patches. These are super awesome! The packaging is really nice, the lid looks like there's drops of water on it. I thought maybe something leaked but...nope. Fake water droplets that looks really cool. They don't slide down, even when I'm going about my business in the house. They stick really well. They come with a nice little set of tweezers so you can pull out each individual patch. No fragrance which is great. I leave them on for 10-15 minutes as the instructions say. I give it a few minutes after removal and the rest of the serum sinks in nicely, it doesn't just sit on top of my skin. My skin feels soft and hydrated under the eye. They're fantastic!

This works great! Gives a nice matte finish for those who don't want the super shine. Definitely has a strong hold, stays through the day, including sports and activities. Smells really good. A great styling wax.

First impression is that the smell is mainly eucalyptus based, but not too strong. The texture out of the can is at first very creamy, which I thought may affect the holding power, but once I worked in a couple of fingertip sized scoops into my hair, I found that the pomade started to take hold and firm up. My hair held its shape throughout the day and was easy to fix with a comb if needed. When washing it out, despite containing oils and wax, regular shampoo seemed to do the trick. Little to no residue leftover in my hair after a shower.

I used the first inception of bubble masks which was a clay cream like texture in a jar. That jar dried up and stopped working. These are so much better! Upon opening, it seemed very saturated so there's no lack of bubbles. Easier to apply, bubbles up and has a nice cooling tingle bubbly sensation. Fit well and adhered nicely, didn't drift at all. I didn't detect any strong fragrance, maybe a light herbally mint - though it does have parfum on the ingredients. That works for me as I don't like strongly scented products. My skin looked calm and felt hydrated afterwards. A great bubble mask!

I sometimes get eye pain from an autoimmune disease. These help me relax and it relieves some of the tension I feel in my eyes. Having something on your eyes also forces you to step away from the screens and just zone out. Sometimes I use the heat eye mask and put on a meditation. It's an awesome way to reboot. I love that I can throw one in my overnight bag when I'm away from home so I can use it to de-stress. Soothing scent as well. I'd get these again!

I use headbands often to keep my hair out of my face when I'm working, doing yard work, hiking etc. I just don't like fussing with my hair too much if I don't have to. These are really comfortable, not too tight. They don't slip off either which is great.  You can double it to make it a thinner band. Cute patterns and super soft material that isn't too heavy. Especially in the summer, the lighter the fabric, the better. I have cotton ones, but I like the softness and light feeling of these better. I'd get more!

I thought this would be a nice moisturizer to use before makeup to make sure my skin is hydrated. I like the tube dispenser, but beyond that, It's awful. It was sticky, never really sunk in and this pink stuff just settled into my fine lines. It said it's suppose to smooth them, not settle in and exacerbate them. I had to wash it off before I put any makeup on. If you're not fair enough this would give you a weird white pinkish cast like sunscreen.

I work with my hands and often they're dry and sad. Don't forget the extra hand washing lately, so I definitely needed some help. This stuff is great!  I use it in the evening sometimes with beauty gloves to really let it sink in while I sleep. I do occasionally use it during the day as well. Sinks in fast, it doesn't stop me from doing my work. Feels like it creates a nice barrier to hold in moisture but isn't sticky or tacky. No fragrance which is my preference. A nice price point as well.

This is an awesome set for a newbie to polygel! I've never done polygel before and was curious if I'd like it better than the traditional tips. I don't love those because of the glue and thickness of them and this is the perfect solution to get length without the thickness. Polygel is easy to work with because it doesn't harden until you cure it, so you can make sure it's just how you like it. It's easy to use the dual forms included with the set. Comes with some cute colors, base and top coat a few nail art things to experiment with and the little uv light. The gel polish colors have great opacity with 2 coats. Really, this is just about everything you need(just grab some rubbing alcohol and acetone) to give it a shot! And, super bonus of the carrying case to organize! A fantastic price for what you receive.

I am super picky about formulas and colors for lipsticks. I'm on a forever quest for my perfect red - my number one favorite so far is cruella by nars. This is a tight second! It's a much different shade then cruella, so it brings a totally different vibe. It's a beautiful true red falling slightly warmer than cool toned. The formula is amazing. I like that it has a matte finish but it's not a matte that sucks the life and moisture out of your lips. It feels very comfortable, not like a heavy lipstick. You can easily get an undone faded look, like you're not trying too hard(compared to going all out with lip liner etc). I love the way it wears too, it doesn't just disappear in certain spots. Great staying power overall. I'd rank this with more expensive beauty brands, it's an amazing formula. I've got my sights set on the color wine stain next!

The premise of these made sense but the execution is lacking. My hair is just a bit beyond shoulder length so I got some hair left out at the bottom that looked nuts after I removed these. They coil up into itself in a roll, so you don't really get a falling curl. More like a jacked up Annie. The silicone at the top and the bottom ripped out my hair when I was trying to remove them. They're too time consuming for me, I'd rather use my curling iron and get the curl I'm expecting vs. these which may leave you with some nutty looking curls.

AESIZ3ATHVPMZM5NI6ZJOZBH547A.review_title: 3 and 1/2 stars: a basic lip balm
AESIZ3ATHVPMZM5NI6ZJOZBH547A.review_text: I've tried a few other products by Hudson and James so I was intrigued by this. I've made a lot of beauty products at home so I'm very familiar with the ingredients. Going into the winter in New England, I need some good lip balms. This feels nice on the lips. Has a very mild orange scent, but nothing artificial. Not sticky at all and I like that it's in a glass jar. I was surprised by the term "cloud" in the name since this was hard and dense. Depending on the temperatures of your climate, both cocoa and shea harden up quite a lot but will melt at certain higher temperatures. Shea butter is easy to whip but this seems like it was just melted down and poured. I thought it would be more fluffy. I like that the ingredients are organic and fair trade but I still can't seem to justify the cost.  Shea butter, sweet orange essential oil and cocoa seed butter are some of the most affordable oils and butter so twenty bucks for this seems very high. I'll use it up but it's not a stand out product for me.

I got this for multiple uses. I can put it on the back of my neck or temples for headaches. I can roll it on my face for depuffing with some facial oil. It's chilly but feels really nice. I would use something smaller for the under eye area but it does the rest of my face nicely.  I thought the material of the roller would be more of a soft, squishy texture but its not. Thats fine, just a little outside of what I imagined. It would also work well on a burn or sore muscles. Its easiy to wash and rinse clean before putting it right back in the freezer. Overall, I think this is an awesome thing to keep in the freezer!

AESIZ3ATHVPMZM5NI6ZJOZBH547A.review_title: A nice set to use before makeup application
AESIZ3ATHVPMZM5NI6ZJOZBH547A.review_text: l really like this set! The size is perfect to try something new without buying them individually and obviously, they're great for travel. The entire set is meant to be used together before makeup application for a good base. I like them all but particularly enjoyed the prime essence and priming water. They both feel very light, sometimes I use them without the primer. As for the primer in particular, it's heavy on dimethicone which is something I usually try to avoid in my primers. While it leaves a silky feeling, I just am not a fan. I think it's just a cheap filler that a lot of products rely heavily on. I feel like my skin can't breathe when there's silicone primers on it. But that is just personal preference. I will use it on occasion when doing a full face. Overall I think this is a nice set so I'm happy I tried it.
These are really nice, substantial bobby pins. They're not thin, so they have good holding power. I really like the mix pack of colors. These will last me a long time!

I just turned 40 (ouch.) so I thought this would be a nice addition to my skincare. It looked interesting with the "magic wand' roller ball applicator. It does help with my under eye puffiness and goes on smoothly. I don't really notice any particular plumping, brightening or difference in my fine lines. I think the roller ball is a bit gimmick-y, but its not bad. Is it worth the price tag? Questionable. It is relaxing but I can use any eye cream with other beauty tools. My favorite item to use with cream is a vibrating metal rod tool that feels nice and cool and does a better job at depuffing. The goal is to drain your lymphatic system...water retention in the face is real.

I expected more organic ingredients, but there are only 3 marked organic. I included the ingredient list below since I didn't see it here on amazon. I've using it daily for almost 2 weeks in the morning and evening, but it pills a bit so it doesn't work well under makeup. I'll keep it for evening use. I like it and I will continue to use it. I don't think it's revolutionary but it's pleasant and easy to use.

Water (Aqua), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil (1), Capryloyl Glycerin/Sebacic Acid Copolymer, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (1), Diheptyl Succinate, Brassica Alcohol, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil (1), Coconut Alkanes, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Citrus Aurantifolia (Lime) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Peel Oil, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Peel Oil, Eugenia Caryophyllus (Clove) Leaf Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Salvia Sclarea (Clary) Oil, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Chlorella Pyrenoidosa Extract, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Fruit Extract, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Extract, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Lactobacillus Ferment, Lactobacillus Ferment Lysate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Punica Granatum Extract, Saccharomyces/Copper Ferment, Saccharomyces/Iron Ferment, Saccharomyces/Magnesium Ferment, Saccharomyces/Silicon Ferment, Saccharomyces/Zinc Ferment, Undaria Pinnatifida Cell Culture Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate, Caffeine, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Glucoside, Citric Acid, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Sclerotium Gum, Sodium Phytate, Squalane, Alcohol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Citral, Citronellol, Eugenol, Limonene, Linalool, Sodium Copper Chlorophyllin - (1) Certified Organic Ingredient

I've tried a few other stamping plates and I think there is a learning curve. Some trial and error but once you get the hang of it, these are fun! Comes with the same tools I've had in other sets, all the things you need to use them. A nice assortable of plates with winter and st. patricks day themes. I like the one with all the dots and different shapes. A nice set at a good price point.

I've never tried this brand before so I was curious to get to testing. Before using on my nails, I did some testers to see the outcome. The confetti ones I did on a white gel color base, one of the glittery ones I did on black. I love the grey with the subtle glitter in it. Everything applied smoothly with no lumps, except for one (not pictured in the testers, but the top left in the company's photos). That one was a bit odd but maybe for someone with more finesse and skill. This set comes with base, top and matte top coat. The glittery ones have good pigment to them, you don't need any color base to make them pop. In my photo, I only did one coat. I was pleasantly surprised by the outcome. I do my own and some friends' nails on a regular basis. They're super excited to do the green for St Patrick's day and the confetti ones for Easter. This is such a great set, with so many options, I'm very happy!

New England winters have my skin feeling parched. especially as I get older(40 at the moment). This Murad cream is more dense than I expected, but not in a bad way. Goes on smoothly and keeps my skin feeling hydrated. A little bit does a great job so this will last a while. My only hang up with some Murad products is the fragrance they use sometimes. Thankfully there is no added fragrance in this cream so I'm very happy. There's a light scent to it but nothing overbearing. No irritations or issues. Recommended for sure if it's in your budget!

I am ridiculously picky about moisturizers. This is definitely up there as a favorite. As far as ingredients, it's not top notch but its not awful. I don't love the addition of dimethicone, especially so high up on the list. Nothing is organic so that's another demerit. I do love how high squalane is so there's pros and cons. My skin is very happy with this so I'm going to stop analyzing the ingredients too closely. It doesn't pill and really seems to sink deep into my skin. Isn't greasy or heavy. Works well under makeup and feel light yet hydrating. The fragrance is light, nothing flowery or offensive. I also like that the big super size jar isn't that bright blue, it's a pretty pearlescent white. This big tub will last awhile but I would definitely get it again.

Ingredients: Aqua/Water/Eau, Butylene Glycol, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Squalane, Glycerin, Cetyl Alcohol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG 100 Stearate, Bifida Ferment Lysate, Lactose, Lactis Proteinum/Milk Protein/Protéine du lait, Yogurt Extract, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Cichorium Intybus (Chicory) Root Extract, Vaccinium Angustifolium (Blueberry) Fruit Extract, Olus/Vegetable Oil/Huile végétale, Camelina Sativa Seed Oil, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Pyrus Malus (Apple) Fruit Extract, Citrullus Lanatus (Watermelon) Fruit Extract, Lens Esculenta (Lentil) Fruit Extract, Sodium Lactate, Sodium PCA, Carbomer, Sodium Hydroxide, Pentylene Glycol, Caprylyl Glycol, Bulnesia Sarmientoi Wood Oil, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Oil, Juniperus Mexicana Oil, Cananga Odorata Flower Oil, Ethylhexylglycerin, Stearyl Alcohol, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Sorbic Acid, Phenethyl Alcohol, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Phenoxyethanol, Parfum/Fragrance, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal

I tried applying this with a brush and also with my fingertip. Much better pigmentation with my fingertip and then I blended it out a little with the eyeshadow brush. It's super pigmented and shimmery, quite stunning! Made my blue eyes pop. The texture was gel like and it was easy to use and also remove later. I'd get other shades!

AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_title: It applies easily to the skin
AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_text: The scrub has a creamy texture and smell strongly of honey.  It applies easily to the skin, and rinses off without effort.  My skin feels soft after use, and it has helped with my break-outs

AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_title: So far I am very satisfied.
AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_text: I have been using this shampoo and conditioner set only briefly. Nevertheless, it smells pleasant, it didn't leave my hair tangled, or oily. It left my hair with a lot of body, and very soft. Of course, time will tell as to how my hair hold up in the long run. For the time being however… I am very  pleased.

I'll admit when I first received this scrub I was disappointed.  It was a small container, and I thought it would be gone within a week.  It has been three weeks, and I barely made a dent!  The scent is lovely, the scrub is luxurious, and most importantly... it works!  My skin is smooth and blemish-free.  That is quite the achievement!

AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_title: Thank you for giving us something that works!
AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_text: This is the perfect complanet to the volumizing shampoo.  A lovely subtle scent, a miraculous ability to untangle those tangles, and leaves my hair soft, light, and even bouncy!

This is my first time trying this product.  I like the scent which is gently reminiscent of lemongrass.  The pump is a wonderful feature.  This does clean well.  It also doesn't leave scum in the tub.  That makes me happy.  I certainly don't want to break my neck first thing in the morning.

I used this shampoo and conditioner this morning, and so far I am very happy.  My hair feels light, and clean.  I didn't discover any tangles, or frizz. The scent is perhaps a little too sweet for my taste, but I cannot argue with results!I absolutely love the pump for each bottle.  It is so much cleaner, and controlled.
Love love love!  the scent is delicate, and delightful.  My hair is left feeling soft, bouncy, and knot/fly-away free!  I am very happy I found this!

AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_title: excellent product, but don't allow cream to sit too long!
AESLFAU7Z4KHLJLC4JPZGPLF6D6A.review_text: the depilatory cream really works!  The smell is somewhat unpleasant, but certainly intolerable. I am just happy that it works as advertised.  I will warn you to be careful, though.  I ended up with some very dry skin on my leg from this cream.  It heeled, so that makes me happy.  As for the inhibitor... It kind of works... it at least slows down the growth of the hair, and wen the hair returns the roots are considerably more fragile.  very pleased!

AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_title: Lashes like you've never tried before!
AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_text: While it does take a little getting use to, these are great lashes that will stay on for hours, without the hassle of glue. Would recommend!

AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_title: Beautiful, luscious lashes at a great price!
AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_text: Loved the length of these lashes and found that they were a little easier to get on than other brands I've tried. Love how they look and will definitely purchase again!
These are great lashes for anyone who wants dramatically long lashes. Extra thick and natural looking!

AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_title: Great lashes at a low price!
AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_text: These are great lashes that feature a wide variety of looks and styles. Would recommend!

AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_title: Luscious lashes at a great price!
AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_text: This set has lots of full, thick lashes that are easy to put on and are worth the price!

AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_title: Fluffy, natural lashes at a great price!
AESOZSRBMQHXUE7YVH66GENDVXJA.review_text: These lashes are affordable, look natural but still give your eyes that little extra pop (without looking too over the top)

AESQ3D5NENZDKGZGS5RNBHE4T43A.review_text: I was very happy to see these came in a pretty little giftable box and had cardboard separators as to avoid breakage. Also, the gold & bronze shades are perfect for fall.

Not sure about this product. This is my 8th konjac sponge. I try different brands. This one is the thinnest one I've ever had, being about 1/3 of the thickness of others I have used. The thinness makes it feel very flimsy, so hopefully it will last as long as it should.

AESQ3D5NENZDKGZGS5RNBHE4T43A.review_title: Everything needed to remove gel polish.
AESQ3D5NENZDKGZGS5RNBHE4T43A.review_text: This review is for the VANALIA Gel Nail Polish Remover Kit. It comes with 2 bottes of of gel polish remover(doesn't smell bad), 1 bottle of liquid latex peel off cuticle protector, 1 cuticle pusher, 1 nail file, and 2 cleaning pads. First use the file to remove the top coat from your nails,  brush the latex onto the skin around your nails, apply a thick layer or gel remover and wait 6 min, then use the pusher to remove polish, and then peel off the latex.  Everything needed to remove gel polished nails is included. It all comes in a cute box. I think this would make a great gift when given along with a box of gel polishes.

This review is for an essence Welcome to London Eyeshadow Palette. You get 12 eyeshadows in both matte and metallic shades. The eyeshadows blend well. I especially like the shimmery golden shade. There is a mirror inside, but no applicator. The case has a magnetic closure and is nicely decorated with a London theme. I think this would make a great gift.

This review is for a jar of STRIDE Foot Cream. This cream helps with rough heels and moisturizes dry feet.

The ACTIVE ingredients listed on the product page are:
Deionized water, green tea leaf extract, cocos nucifera (coconut) oil, dodecane, cetearyl alcohol, polysorbate 60.

The cream while in the jar has a soft, almost wipped appearance. When applying it feels kind of waxy, which feels soothing on my feet. The smell kind if a fresh scent and isn't very strong. I like this foot cream a lot.

This review is for a LOKNGXU Eyebrow Pencil (4# Grey Brown). I like that this brow pencil has an angled tip. The color lasted on by brows all day(I did use a setting spray). I will continue to use this product.

This review is for a MEIQIER Eye Massager with Natural Quartz Jade. I ordered this to replace a similar device that didn't have a Quartz head or blue light(just red). This device has a Rose Quartz tip, heat, massage, red light(collagen production) and blue light(calms inflammation) therapy. It uses USB charging. The eye massager comes with a protective tip cap/cover and looks like a cute lipstick.
I like to use first the red light, heat, massage with my eye serum and then I use blue light, heat massage, with my eyecream. I am using this device only on my eyes(I have full face device with a larger head). It feels very soothing on my eyes and helps with puffiness too. Since it is small and has a cap, it is easy to just toss it in a purse on the go. This device would make a great gift!

AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_text: I bought Oral-B 3000 for my mother and she likes it.  Generally, she does not like gadgets and new technology, but this toothbrush is easy to operate.  I recommended that she does not charge it after every brushing but rather only when the low battery indicator turns on, and she's been following this suggestion.  She tried one of the included small brush heads, but she really prefers the larger double action brush head.  I was especially pleased when she told me that she noticed her teeth getting whiter and her mouth feeling fresher.  That's all I need to recommend this toothbrush.

I gave this headset to my 11 year old son. below is his review. From myself I can add that the manual translation is very lazy and disrespectful to the customers.

"I got the headseat and was very eager to use it. The headset definitely did not disappoint. The noise blocking was nice, and the headset felt very comfortable on my ears. For me the headset doesn't fit perfectly, there is a small space between my head and the bottom of the ear pads. I get uses to it after a while but i wish ear pads would fit all the way around. Other than that, I really like the headset and definitely would recommend."

AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_title: Like the scrub.  Pricy. Watch the expiration date.
AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_text:
I like the scrub. It is rough enough to feel it working, and my face and palms feel super smooth after I use it. The scent is not particularly good or bad. It's inoffensive.

The scrub is on the pricy side (~10x) compared to the St Ive's medicated apricot scrub or Walmart's Equate medicated apricot scrub that I normally use. I ordered a few Higher Education products to try and they have very short expiration dates, some less than 2 months away. I'm not going to use that much product in 2 months, so whatcha the expiration date when you receive your shipment

AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_title: I like this mask.  Watch expiration date.
AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_text:
I like how this mask feels on my skin. It gives a pleasant tingling sensation. It has a clay-like consistency and dries on the skin.

The one I received expires in 1.5 months which is a very short expiration period.

AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_title: Very short expiration date, but it seems to work.  Weird tube / pump.
AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_text:
The cream seems to work to brighten and even out skin tone without drying the skin. I actually like the results. However, the tube I received in July has a September expiration date. Seems too soon. I'd rate it higher if it had a longer expiration term.

I am also a bit puzzled by the packaging. It looks like a tube, but it has a pump top. Not sure why it is packaged this way.

I like this scrub. It has a faint but pleasant smell. It is abrasive enough to make it feel that it is working. My face (and palms) feel very smooth after I use it.

The price, in my opinion, is too high. I'd rather stick with St. Ives scrub I usually use.

AESWZGOSDDULZ2TWG6GLDEU2X5JA.review_title: Smells nice but uncomfortable to hold

We are all searching for the fountain of youth! Okay I don't want to look old and wrinkled! The description very much interested me so I decided I was ready to try it here!! I've never tried anything from the dead sea and when I read that the product was made within a few miles of the Dead Sea, with no mineral degradation during transport. I was anxious to give it a try. I try all sorts of things to keep that youthful glow of the skin but I also am selective about what I apply to my skin. Everything was natural here though, and It is not tested on animals, contains NO Alcohol, Sulfate or Parabens and is non- toxic.

The product came in a 1.1 fluid ounce moisturizing serum. This product contains Glycerin and essential Dead Sea Minerals, known for their exceptional hydroscopic attributes and as a source of beautifying minerals. I read that in the description and thought what in the world is hydroscopic...so I looked it up. "Hygroscopy (etymology and pronunciation) is the ability of a substance to attract and hold water molecules from the surrounding environment. This is achieved through either absorption or adsorption with the absorbing or adsorbing substance becoming physically changed somewhat." They perform synergistically (which means together with) Squalane, Dunaliella Salina Extract, Jojoba Seed Oil and Wheat Protein to help increase the skin's moister levels and diminish water loss for a more vital and glowing overall look. After reading that in the description and researching what some of the terms meant, I decided to put the product to the test. I have aging sking that is somewhat problematic with large pores and a few minor areas of sagging skin. I read clearly in the description that Genesea Perfecting Serum helps to disapate the signs of skin aging such as fine lines, wrinkles and sagginess and that you would see effects of the serum in five minutes.

I've been using the serum for a good while now sometimes under makeup and every night before going to bed at night on clean dry skin. The serum is of excellent quality with no redness, burning itching or negative side effects. It doesn't react against or burn the skin. I don't have a problem with it leaving my face greasy or shiny and it quickly absorbs into the skin within just a couple of minutes. I notice an immediate firming and suppleness of the skin but no discomfort or a feeling of being too taut. There is no build up or product residue left on the skin at all. This product has a nice smell, light and kind of floral smelling, but no bad smell at all. It is quite easy to use with an pump dispenser for the serum. I always prefer a pump dispenser as it keeps the integrity of the product by keeping air and contaminants out. A little of the serum goes a long way, and the product is lasting a good long time.

This product really hydrates my skin and make it look nice and firm almost immediately. This serum really works and is reducing wrinkles and fine lines I have starting in my skin. The skin on my face looks so much more supple. It also seems to keep down oiliness and shine off my face. My skin also looks clearer with less break outs and skin problems. I use the serum on clean skin of the face and I let it soak in. I also add the serum all over my face, and under the the throat and jaw line for added firmness and last I add a good moisturizing cream. While I am applying my eye makeup, I let the serums and cream soak in. The face serum contains ingredient that keep your skin smooth and moisturized.

It seems to me that the manufacturers of the product have researched and thought out the effects of this product and have provided a great combination of products to promote beautiful skin. So far no complaints or problems and all the products I've tried appear to be working very well for me.
