The lace is soft and light enough to work with most skin tones. The hairline is done well. Nice amount of baby hairs, although there are some short hairs that stick up on top. Overall nice wig. Mannequin head is 22in.

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_title: Sleek wig but it has dark lace
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_text: It’s a really nice short and sleek bob wig. The Ombre is blended well and it looks natural, except that it doesn’t have the root color at the nape as well. The hair feels soft and was tangle free when finger combed. My biggest issue is that it’s marketed as having transparent lace but my unit came with medium brown lace color and unfortunately won’t work with my skin tone. Mannequin head is 22in.
These are really nice dreadlocks, but $40 for 10 is pretty excessive. They aren’t $40 for 10 nice. Price them more reasonably and they’d be 5 stars.
The part on this unit is really great! It’s preplucked and ready to go. The hair is soft and feels healthy. Super cute cut. No shedding when I shook it out. Mannequin head is 22in

Simple beautiful unit. The hair is soft, healthy and thick. Easily finger combed with no shedding or tangling. Great natural hairline and large parting space. Lace is light enough for most skin tones. Super pretty curl pattern. A+! Mannequin head is 22in

It’s just like the microcellular water I was using before from L’Oréal, except this gets foamed up before use. I like that. The liquid will last longer. It’s super gentle but effective at removing my premium mascara applied with a primer. Doesn’t sting or burn or leave any residue. Absolutely would recommend!

Great quality wig for the price! Hair is a deep black and looks and feels pretty realistic for a synthetic. I could easily finger comb it. The lace is soft and light enough to work with most skin tones. Natural looking hairline. Perfect for cosplay or for wearing out! Mannequin head is 22in

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_title: Threw away because it burned my skin
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_text: First use I wiped it on my skin and felt an immediate burning sensation. Straight to the garbage.

[[VIDEOID:3083296496c7fd5013225f7ecb591027]] Not human hair. It’s synthetic. It’s looks pretty legit, it’s a very good synthetic wig. But when you run your fingers through it feels fake. And when you burn the hair you discover it’s absolutely plastic. SMH. Buyer beware.

The hair is very nice, it’s soft and healthy. But it’s a thin ponytail. This would work best for provide additional volume to an existing pony, so make sure the color matches!

Edit: I also was able to try to brown one. It’s very nice as well but it’s thin too
The hair is soft and healthy feeling but it’s very thin!
Awesome hair. It’s soft and healthy and thick. No shedding or weird smells either!

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_title: Low quality even for this price
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_text: The Ombre color is cool, but that’s really all this has going for it. Ok for cosplay or pictures I guess but it’s very tangly and plasticy so it’s not going to be comfy to wear. There are no clips inside the cap. Part is bad. I wish they would save money on the extras and invest it in a better wig. Mannequin head is 22in

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_title: A bit frizzy at the ends
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_1.review_text: Not terrible hair, not the best. Pretty average right in the middle bundles. Hair is soft but the ends are a bit frizzy. Good density though.
Hair is soft and true to 150% density. Very nice! Soft and silky. No tangles. Nice lace. Well done. Mannequin head is 22in
It has potential, but better care needs to be given during construction. The hair itself is soft and healthy. But it’s uneven and thin. Mannequin head is 22in
Excellent quality. Hair is soft and silky. Healthy to the though. True to 150% density and is thick. Nice baby hairs. Soft lace. A+! Mannequin head is 22in
Hair did shed when I shook her out but other than that she’s nice. Soft curls. Mannequin head is 22in.

I received a unit with a defective color job on the crown, as evident by picture. Super sad because the rest of the color is on point. Nice shade of cooler brown with properly toned blonde. Hair is soft and straight and true to 150% density. Feels shorter than 22 inches, but the longest layer did measure out. My head is 22 inch and the cap fit fine. Great hairline and part. Like everything else about this wig was really nice but I can’t give any stars with this color issue. If I bought it I would have sent it back. But because it is nice I’m spending some money to have it corrected by my stylist.

Hair is soft and silky, but it’s thin. More like 130% density. There’s too many short hairs at the closure, especially considering this is only an 8in wig. Ends are nice. Lace is great. Cap fits snug on my 22in mannequin head.
I mean it’s decent at this price. Hair is soft and tangle free. Pretty Ombre color. Cosplay, pictures, bedroom fun or testing out a color. Not for everyday wear.
No complaints! Mannequin head is 22in
Hair is very soft and feels healthy. Feels a bit thinner than 150% density, but not by much. Some noticeable short filler hairs at closure. All in all very nice unit. Mannequin head is 22in
Soft and healthy hair. True to density. Nice lace. Nice ends. Great quality unit. Mannequin head is 22in
No complaints here. At this price it’s pretty perfect. Beautiful color. Soft realistic hair. Pretty decent lace tab part. I’m happy! Mannequin head is 22in
Really nice natural hairline. Hair is soft and healthy. True to density. Nice ends. Just needs a little styling and she’s good to go! Mannequin head is 22in
Looks better in person than in stock photos lol definitely a cosplay wig but it’s really cute and fun! Mannequin head is 22in

The color is awesome but everything else about this wig is bad. It’s super thin and not evenly cut. The hair feels dry and kinda brittle. It’s not sewn in well at the hairline and the cap doesn’t fit my 22Inch mannequin head. I can’t recommend this.

Pretty shade of blonde. Hair has a nice texture to it. Lightweight. Decent lace tab part. Ideal for cosplay, pictures, or for trying out the color before making a bigger purchase or permanent change. Mannequin head is 22in

Hair is soft and healthy all the way through the ends. I took off a star because it’s a bit thinner than 150% density. More like 140%. Nice hairline. Lace is soft. Great quality unit! Mannequin head is 22in. Pics in natural sunlight.
The hair texture feels great and the color blend is pretty. But it sits really funny on my 22in mannequin head. Smaller heads only. Cosplay only. Pictures in natural sunlight.
Top half is great. Hair feels soft and full. Bottom half feels crunchy, like there’s product in it.

The unit I received is very nice. It’s true to density and actually longer than the stated 18in. The hair feels soft and healthy. Awesome parting space and natural looking hairline. Mannequin head is 22in. Pictures taken in natural sunlight.
Shed a bit when shook out but otherwise nice. Soft hair. Cute style. Mannequin head is 22in. Pictures taken in natural sunlight.

It’s pretty heavy- but it’s really cute and nicely done. The braids are tight and look realistic. Knots are pretty bad though and will require some skill to cover them. Mannequin head is 22in. Pictures taken in natural sunlight.
These seem pretty mid grade. I question the durability and longevity of them. They appear to be made from a bunch of short pieces.
Soft and healthy hair. Very beautiful color blend that is well done. Nice ends. True to weight and length. Pictures taken in natural sunlight

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_text: One of my favorite amazon wigs! The first one I received had track issues, but the seller quickly rectified. The second piece I received was perfect. The color is a perfect ash blonde shade. Hair is soft. Hairline is very realistic. Baby hairs in front. Roots go all the way through the wig down to the nape. Deeper part than most other middle part wigs on amazon. People think it’s my hair! What’s preventing 5 stars? The hair comb being in front instead of the back as well as the part needing to be plucked. If I could I’d give 4.5 stars. LOVE this one, no Regrets!

I adore this unit! Braids are tightly done and are a beautiful mix of colors. Lace is transparent. Hairline is perfect and realistic. My only complaints are the braids are a bit itchy when touching my skin on my shoulders or chest, there’s no comb at the nape and the wig itself is fairly heavy. That being said, the pros far outweigh the cons. I love it and do not regret my purchase!

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_title: Gray roots and very yellow hair
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_text:
Disappointed. Pros: hair is very soft with a perfect wave. Part and hairline is awesome. Cap is comfortable and lace is transparent. Great manageable length.
Cons: The roots aren’t brown, or if they are it’s a very ashy shade to the point it looked gray. Maybe it was just mine but it looked terrible, especially up next to the yellow blonde. And it’s very yellow. It looked more of a honey blonde on my screen, but it arrived very very yellow. My skin tone works with most hair colors, but not this one. It aged me with the gray roots. Unfortunately I had to return. If this unit was made in any other shade of blonde with better roots it would have been perfect. So sad.

I got this for my husband. He has shoulder length, curly, thick hair. He did not like this stuff at all. It smells nice,  but he said it was hard to spread around and left his hair feeling dry. This might be good if you have short oily hair, but if not I would not recommend for any other hair types.

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_title: Nice unit at this price point!
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_text: Not a bad unit for the price! I was very hesitant on ordering and it’s been in my wish list for awhile but there were no reviews... I got an amazon gift card recently so I figured now would be the time to try it. The hair is soft enough, not incredibly soft but not terrible. It’s a bit on the shiny side but some baby powder can take care of that. The part is excellent. Looks real without a cap on underneath and goes deep. My head is 22 inches and this fit great. A comb at the nape of the neck is a must imo and this has one. I love the pretty colors. The pink is more peachy orange pink than pink pink but that’s ok. It goes from a super dark brown root to the peach pink to lavender to white/platinum blonde. One major dislike, and a reason I took away a star, is that it’s only rooted on top and along the front side of the unit. The rest of the hair underneath starts with the peach pink. Common at this price point but I’d rather pay a few dollars more and have it rooted the whole way through. But this is the only wig with this color that I can find so it is what it is. The lace is light enough to be nearly invisible on me. Not scratchy, the unit was comfy to wear. The hairline could stand to be plucked more naturally if I ever find the time. All in all im happy with it! Thanks!
Came just as described! Not sure how to use all these tools but I’m about to embark on my first at home manicure so we will see. Thanks!

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_title: Short, frizzy, matted hair on original and replacement unit but responsive customer service
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_text: I was really excited to get this wig. The images provided on the listing looked like the color I’ve been looking for. I posted a question asking the seller to provide images of the actual unit and the stock pictures I uploaded are the ones that were sent to me. Before I go any further I’d like to say the seller provided fast and courteous customer service, which is why my rating is 2 stars instead of 1. I’m terribly disappointed in the wig itself. The first unit I received, upon first taking it out, seemed nice and I was excited. There was a comb at the nape of the neck, the part looked nice and the hair itself felt soft and moved nicely. Then I tried it on and noticed a large bump on top of my head, which is what the picture with the red circle is. Turns out at the beginning of the track the hair is all short, frizzy and matted, like it was burned, which is what was causing that bump. I notified the seller and requested a replacement. The seller was responsive to my feedback and seemed genuinely interested in it and concerned about the quality. I received the replacement yesterday and it was even worse... :( The hair throughout the unit was very very dry and ratty. And the same issue was at the top, short, frizzy, matted hair, but more so. Soooo bummed about this. Seems to be some serious quality control issues wherever these units are being produced. This wig would have been so great if it wasn’t for what appears to be an overheating issue when making the waves. I hope the seller can get this fixed, because the colors are beautiful. Unfortunately I had to send both the original and replacement back.

So any product like this is going to take a lot of time to show significant results. I’m 37 with minimal signs of aging (I think) and I like to use these products as a preventive, I have been for decades now. I’ve been using this one for about a week now, in replacement of my morning moisturizer. I really like it! Two small pumps gives me enough product for a liberal application. The product absorbs well. No irritation. I have combo skin and this does a great job at moisturizing my dry areas. It doesn’t sit on my skin so I can go to work and wear my mask without irritation. Seems to be a really nice product!

This unit is horrific! Short filler hairs all over. No combs. Terrible fake looking part. Awful hairline that shows the tracks. Even at the lace front part you can clearly see the cap. My head is 22 inches and it has a very weird fit. Doesn’t stay flat on the head, even with a wig grip. The color is very fake looking and the hair is way too shiny. Stay away from this, it’s garbage, even at the listed price.

[[VIDEOID:d63052b23ca12009436cb817ae056c3c]] If this was marketed as a costume wig I’d give it mire stars. But they’re saying it’s an everyday workplace wig, and that it is not. The hair itself feels soft and is nice, but the part is horrific. You can’t wear this without a hat. The color is lighter and warmer than expected as well. The cap has a weird fit. For a costume or bedroom wig it’s fine, but not an everyday unit in the least bit.

I got this as a gift for an older client of mine. She spent a lot of money on a plastic set last year, and she loves rose quartz, so when I saw this I knew she’d love it. And she does! She says the smoothing coolness of the rose quartz feels amazing on her neck. And it’s pretty to look at!

I picked out this shampoo for my husband. His feedback, he likes the smell, it made his hair feel clean (which is huge because he works at a grimy steel mill), it was easy to spread around and rinsed out clean. I’d recommend!

I’ve never had one of these before and I think I’m gonna have to get some more I’m different colors! I wore it to work today and everyone thought it was my real hair! It’s soft and looks legit. My hair is purple on the ends and if I took the time I could hide it completely. Super easy to put on and pretty light on the head. My only complaint is that’s it’s a bit more yellow than the product image depicts. It looks more ash blonde online. But I still like it!

The idea of this type of hair extension is great. But this particular unit, not so much. If I didn’t have the purple in my hair it would have looked a lot better, as the blonde under that purple is close to the shade of this piece. However, since it’s synthetic I can’t make the blonde match the purple. Not the reason for the low rating though, I know you can’t color synthetic. The hair itself feels fake. It tangles easily and is staticky. One of the clips wasn’t sewed in all the way. When I combed it out hair came out. Also, the pieces that allow you to adjust the wire are metal, not silicone, and could not be opened with pliers. They snapped when I tried. The piece did come with extra silicone pieces to tighten though. Next time I get one of these I’ll opt for a real hair one of better quality.

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_title: Bad quality- short hair except for the back
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_text: So disappointed in this unit and I feel like it’s a waste of real human hair. I had to put a lot of work into it to make it look halfway decent. As it came the curls are super tight and when worn looks like some 80s Gerry curl type thing. Not a good look. Even with the tight curls you could tell how short it was on the sides compared to the back. So I took my flat iron out and straightened it out at 350 degrees. As you can see it wouldn’t go completely straight, but I didn’t want to use a higher heat and damage the hair. I’m ok with it being wavy, but as I straightened it all the tiny broken  filler hairs on top of the unit became extremely obvious. Not sure what they were thinking when they made this. It’s clear to achieve the “16 inch” length they only added long hair at the back bottom of the unit, leaving the sides short. Now the whole reason I wear wigs is because I chemically damaged my hair, and the sides are shorter than my back, JUST LIKE THIS WIG! Ugh. While it looked better wavy, it’s still a hot mess. The hairline part and cap fit funny. Like the hairline goes past the ears. The side combs are near the nape comb. The top part of the lace doesn’t lay flat to the head, I’d have to glue it down. The only way I can make this hair look decent is if I wear a head scarf with it, to pull back and hide the short sides. The hair itself isn’t even all that great. It’s a mess on top and feels dry. The only reason why I’m giving it two stars is because I can make it look cute with the scarf. If I would have paid money for this I would have returned it immediately.

Eh. I’m not all that impressed. I have a few of these and I think they’re fun to wear. This one is a little darker than I thought it would be so it’s slightly darker than my roots, but that’s not the biggest deal. It’s pretty thin. Not much hair on it, so it makes it really hard for me to hide my own hair, and it’s short and on the thinner side right now. Unless I go back to being a full brunette I doubt I’ll wear it because I don’t think I can hide the purple with it.
Pretty headband, has a very princess feel to it. Fit my adult 22 inch head fine. My only issue is that on the end the stones weren’t glued down all the way. Otherwise beautiful piece!

This unit I received is a hot mess. It’s a shameful waste of human hair really. The hair itself is soft and pretty color. But the cap is way small on my 22 inch head. I can’t even fit it on right. The waves and bands look nothing like the product image. If I would have purchased this I would immediately return it.

One of the better $20 and under wigs on amazon. Not for daily use, the scalp isn’t legit enough for that, but great for cosplay, bedroom or with a hat. The hair is soft and not overly shiny. Doesn’t look the best on me but it’s a nicer quality unit at the price point.

This hair on this wig is what I like best, it’s soft and silky. I like the color, although the roots are a bit shiny. I wish it was longer personally, I’d buy this unit in like 18-20 inch length. The simulated scalp is one of the best I’ve seen. It does fit a bit small on my 22 inch head, but I can make it work. I’d recommend, it’s a nice unit.

Great for cosplay, bedroom fun or pictures! Don’t get this expecting to fool anyone though, it’s a cute wig, but it’s not a very realistic one. The roots are unnatural and overly shiny, and the simulated scalp isn’t the best. But the hair is soft and silky. The cap fit well on my 22 inch head and covered most of my sides. Super fun and not overpriced.

Yet another Korean beauty product that has failed to disappoint me! I have combo skin that gets really dry but also breaks out easily. Finding a good moisturizer for my face can be tough. But not since I discovered the magic of Korean products. The hype is real, and this is no exception. I use it at night before bed. A little amount smooths on nicely, making my face feel instantly moisturized without feeling greasy or heavy. It definitely feels like it has more youthful plumpness to it (I’m 37). It absorbs pretty fast, within about 10 min I can no longer feel it on my face. Since using it I haven’t felt any tightness in my skin. It has a nice clean soap like fresh scent to it. It hasn’t caused my skin to breakout either.  I love it and I highly recommend it!

AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_title: Very dry hair and too small of cap
AFDYIK3FNPY2JFBQYUWC6GSBMIRQ_2.review_text: I did not like this unit at all. The lace is super dark. The cap is small and very tight on my 22 inch head. The hair is very dry and feels like it could be yaki hair. There are no roots at the nape of the wig. Really disappointed. I am returning.

Ok, first of all, the roots on this are not brown, they are RED! So weird! Warm red into cool ash blonde. It just doesn’t look right to me at all. I like the color of the blonde, if the roots were actually brown this unit would have been much better. At this price point the hair texture isn’t bad. It shed a bit and is kinda tangly but it was soft. And the waves/curls are nicely done. But The simulated scalp isn’t that great. My head is 22 inches and the cap fit fine. The best things about this unit is the cap fit and the hair texture. But because of the roots I don’t foresee myself actually wearing this, I’ll likely just give it away to a friend.

It’s an ok hair conditioner. Typical drug store quality. My hair usually responds very well to *quality* argan oil. But this left my hair still feeling dry and looking frizzy. I had to liberally apply some smoothing leave in after, twice. But work well for fine hair, but I have thick, course hair and this was just disappointing.

These are awful. The pieces of magnets that line the lash make it extremely noticeable you’re wearing them. They feel too heavy on my eyes to wear. I wouldn’t recommend these. Go for the kind, and only the kind, that have a thin magnetic strip across the entire lash. Sorry, these are garbage.

This hair is super long and fluffy! It’s very adorable. It’s lightweight even though it’s got so much hair! Unfortunately the cap is too small on me. My head is 22 inches and it was really tight and the sides were pretty far back. So it’s for smaller heads only. But the hair itself was soft, the cap well made. Very nice deep realistic part. If your head is smaller than mine I’d recommend!

For the price it’s a very nice cosplay or bedroom wig. I doubt the simulated scalp will fool anyone, but it’s not terribly done. The hair is a super pretty purple color with soft hair texture and nice waves. It has nice bounce to it. My head is 22 inches and it fit great. Cap is well made. I’d definitely recommend this unit, it’s one of the nicer cheap ones on amazon!

Omg I love this unit! I wasn’t expecting to like it as much as I do! She’s so pretty! The hair is very soft and silky and the waves are perfect! Bangs are a great length on me. The part looks so real. The color blend is amazing and everything about this unit looks so natural! It fit my 22 inch head perfectly! No weird smell either. I love it!! I’d definitely recommend this! She’s awesome!

I wish so badly I could give this unit 5 stars. The colors are GORGEOUS. Fun and pretty and can go casual, party, club, bedroom, cosplay etc. the hair itself is very soft and silky with beautiful waves. The lace part is deep and looks so natural. There’s a comb at the nape. Even though there is no lace front they do a great job at the part. My only issue is that it doesn’t fit my more oblong, 22 inch head. The nape comb ends up about halfway down the back of my head, the cap is too small. SUCH A BUMMER. I’d be slaying in this beauty. I wish it fit but I could feel it slipping when I tried it on. If noble could just make their caps a little bigger I’d be so happy because they have some of the best quality wigs. My head is normal size so it’s not asking much! If you have a smaller, or rounded head, GET THIS SIS. You will LOVE it!

This is a very nice unit! I shook it out and it came right to life. The hair itself is very soft. I finger combed it and there was no shedding or tangles. The headband is sewn on nicely and the cap is well made. The color is a very pretty natural black. Nice high end unit at an affordable price. I’d recommend!

I wish my own hair felt as amazing as this! It’s sooo soft and silky. The color is GORGEOUS. Darker roots than blend right into a medium to light brown. The color is not as streaky as depicted in the product image and I’m happy about that. It looks way more natural in person. High end hair, just perfect. Thank you! I’d recommend!

This hair is sooooo nice. It’s soft and healthy feeling. I could finger comb it no problem, no tangles, no shedding, no tracks getting loose. True to length. Really nice lace part. Great shade of lace that should work with most skin tones. Nape comb, which is huge. No short filler hairs. It has a sewn in band that sits at the back of your head that really keeps this unit super secure without glue. This is definitely a high end, well made unit. I’d 100% recommend. I only wish it came packaged better!

EDIT: I was also able to try their 16in water wave headband. It’s very nice too, although not 180% density, especially at the ends. Still full at 150%. Otherwise it’s another winner!
This hair is GORGEOUS! Super soft and silky!! My fingers ran easily through it. The color is absolute perfection. Truly stunning, high end hair. I’d 100% recommend!

This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. Has bounce. Beautiful Ombre burgundy color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. Nice color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. Nice color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. The dreads are on the thicker side. Nice color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

I’d have rated it higher, but the product images are misleading and the unit I received is not the same as pictures. Yes, it’s silver. A beautiful shade of silver too. It’s a short bob unit, but it’s not straight, the ends are curled. And it doesn’t have a middle part as depicted, it just has one of those middle points on top. If the product was pictured correctly I’d have given it at least 4 stars because the hair itself is soft, silky and smooth, there wasn’t any shedding when I finger combed it and the color is beautiful. Shame.
All of the hair included in this package is really nice! The color is beautiful. The hair itself looks healthy and feels soft and silky. So pretty. I’d 100% recommend!
Feels soft and springy. True to length. Nice color. Looks and feels real. Seems to be well made. Pretty crochet hair!

This hair is so pretty! I love the color blend, the roots look awesome. Hair is soft, silky and healthy. I ran my fingers through it no problem- no shedding or tangles. Just gorgeous! I would recommend!

I was interested in this because it has a very 90s look to it, and I’m a child of the 90s. While it’s better than I thought it’s still not all that great. It’s a cosplay or bedroom wig, unless you cover the top part. The itself is soft and has good color, a bit on the shiny side. The simulated scalp and front hairline is bad though. This would be fun for cosplay, bedroom, or to test out the color and cut, but that’s about it. I don’t think you’ll fool anyone with this piece.
This is a gorgeous wig at this price point! The hair is a beautiful multi dimensional red color. It’s soft with no shedding or tangling when I finger combed it. Good density. I’d recommend!

This is a nice unit for the price! The hair is a bit shiny, but mostly so by the headband. In the natural light the color looks pretty natural.. It’s soft and silky with no tangle or shedding when I finger combed. Well made headband wig, I’d recommend!

It’s real hair and it feels soft and healthy. I had no issues with finger combing it, no tangles or shedding. Caps is well made and the headband is silky. Combs inside. Pretty dark brown natural black. Nice unit!

I was expecting a better unit than what I got. This unit needs work. The lace is transparent and soft, the color is pretty. But that’s where my praise ends. The hair is tangled easily. It’s too shiny and it has a plastic feel to it. It was super staticky when I first took it out. There’s no nape comb, and it’s a bit heavy. I think cutting like 6 inches off would make it better. The part and hairline was very disappointing. Mine was not pre-plucked, as you can see in the pictures. I’m too lazy with my wigs to do the work it needs.

She seems nice enough, but needs some work, some time spent in fluffing her up. I wish there were combs in it, but I guess at this price point I can’t expect much. The hair itself is soft and healthy looking.

It’s not a terrible unit at this price point, but it’s not all that great either. The hair is way too shiny, and it tangles immediately. The simulated scalp is obvious and the front line isn’t any better. It would be better if the hair was better quality, but it’s definitely has a plastic feel to it. I’d recommend for cosplay or bedroom use only, and I would t expect more than 1 or 2 uses out of it...

The scissors are made out of stainless steel but when using them you will notice that they wont cut as smoothly compared to more expensive higher quality scissors. The shears worked perfectly fine for me and they did the job well.

Everything else provided in the package is more like the 3 star hotel freebies that are cheap and poorly made. The cape is only good for a few times before it will most likely rip apart and the combs provided were bend on arrival.

These refillable hand sanitizer bottles are so amazing. It makes it more cost efficient to just buy a big bottle of hand sanitizer and fill these small ones up. They come with a keychain so you can put it on your backpacks, purse, or keys so you never forget. They are also small that you can bring them with you. This has been really helpful during the pandemic so that I never forget hand sanitizer.

Overall, I would definitely not recommend this product until major changes have been made. There's definitely a market segment where there is a dire need for a product that can clean pet feet after a wet and dirty walk outside. I have two dogs and live in an area that is muddy and rainy all the time which results in super dirty patios and walkways when we get in the house. When I first saw this product i was actually very interested in first but upon using I was disappointed. The spin speed is in no way strong enough to get rid of dirt and gunk buildup between the dogs feet and just using the dog paw washer is incredibly messy with water spilling out all over the place. Honestly, after trying my best to use this product a few times i'd rather just carry my dogs into the bath tub and cleaning their paws myself.

These are the stamping plates that I use all the time. I stamp over gel nail polish with konad stamping polish, Essie polish, or Sallie Hanson insta-dri polish. When you first pull off the blue protective film, clean the plates really well with acetone. Then, I usually paint, scrape, roll, and then clean everything off without actually rolling the first stamping on my nails. I find the first stamping doesn't go well on a fresh plate, so I just don't waste my time.
After doing that, they stamp fine all the time. I have found at least one image in every stamper bundle that has stamping issues. I just don't use that stamp. These plates have intricate designs that transfer well. If you find that not all of your design is trasferring, first clean the plate really well with acetone. All that built-up dried polish affects the stamp. There are lots of good videos on stamping troubleshooting, too, if you are having trouble.
I stamp with a konad stamper, and scrape with an old credit card or empty gift cards. Metal scrapers will damage the plates.

This is a lightweight cream that is probably more suitable for warm weather. I absolutely love the smell of this cream, it is very fragranced. It has a nice floral scent that reminds me of being in a field of flowers. Sensitive skin may not enjoy that much. But, it does feel very luxurious and silky on the skin.

My cons are that I did not get any dewy effect from the cream and it actually gave my skin a mattified appearance. I think it just may not be hydrating enough if you have skin on the dry side like mine.

While I won’t be using this as my every day moisturizer, I did find that it worked well for me as a makeup base before I apply my foundation.

The other thing I noticed is that there is a slight hint of shimmer to the cream when looking at it in the jar. It is not chunky and can’t be felt on the skin. It almost looks like the cream has more of a pearlized finish.

Overall, I would recommend this cream to those with oily or combination skin. It just didn’t work the best for my dry skin.

The design of the sponges is simple. There is a flat slanted bottom I like to use for patting in foundation and the pointed tip that is great for concealing or reaching small places around the nose, eyes, etc.

The sponges are reasonably sized, but when placed under water they expand greatly! I do think these are great for the money, but for foundation I’m not crazy about the finish it gives. The sponge is somewhat firm, so I feel like it can be hard to really sink the product into the skin, but it is great for concealer or using the sponges dry for powder. Overall, I’m satisfied!

AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_title: Surprisingly, it really makes a difference!
AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_text:
I get "outbreaks" on my hands sometimes. Usually when my hands get bad (even just one hand) I have to apply a cortisone rub a few times a day over a few days to make the redness, flakiness, and itchiness subside.

I was hesitant to get this because the ingredients seem pretty simple for something that is supposed to make a difference in psoriasis. Well I am surprised at how effective this spray is. Instead of touching the cortisone rub at all - I just sprayed this on the backs of my hands. Granted I was working form home for the entire day - so I pretty much sprayed it a bunch of times over the course of the day. The redness got MUCH better. And the flakiness totally went away. The only thing is my skin on the bad hand looked a bit dry - but I guess that is because this is a spray and not an emollient cream or anything. To the touch, my hand felt pretty soft with only the slightest dry patches felt. Anytime I can avoid cortisone (steroids) I consider a really good time.

I am happy with this spray and have a feeling I will always have to keep some on hand going forward. Some might think the price may be a bit much - but if it works...plus if you can avoid drugs - it is probably worth it. Plus the bottle may last quite sometime anyway.

I found them a bit hard to use as well - as I found it a big pain to get the stick through the curler. Left them in for like an hour, ran my hairdryer over them until my hair felt dry and took them out. My hair definitely had some bounce and was sort of curly. So if you are looking for body - these might definitely work. If you are looking for tight curls (especially spirals) - probably look elsewhere. On the plus side - for work the next day - my hair still had some body and felt thicker when I put it up. So again - they did definitely add body to my hair.

Other headbands were a bit snug and sometimes uncomfortable - sometimes the buttons were too high and sqooshed the mask onto my nose. I am now an expert in all these products. : )

With that being said - THESE HEADBANDS ARE, hands down, THE BEST OUT THERE!!!! I recommend you grab some and use them in good health! The colors may be a bit bold - that is totally true. But the fit and comfort is totally top notch. Even with wearing my hair in a pony, bun, or twist these headbands stay securely on. Yet you do not feel them at all - it is literally like WEARING NOTHING AT ALL. No pressure on your head at all - sometimes when I close my office door and take my mask off, I actually have to reach onto the top of my head because I feel nothing and want to make sure my headband hasn't slipped off - and it never does! The buttons are also in the perfect position where you can even put the lower part of the ear loop on your ear if you wanted. The buttons are not too high like some other headbands.

THESE ARE PERFECT!!!! If I could scream it from the top of a building I totally would. I am in love with these headbands and they are far superior to any others that I have tried - seriously and truly. TOTALLY RECOMMEND!!! AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_title: MAGIC!  Works - actually works - and KEEPS WORKING!
AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_text:
As a vegan who is also allergic to baking soda (hives anyone?), I thought I had found a tag-team deodorant solution at a Green Fest a while back. So I stocked up on both - but then the products crapped out on me. : (

I was hesitant to try yet another deodorant as most end up sucking big time and end up in a wasteland... But I did - and I AM SO GLAD THAT I DID! This stuff is AMAZING! It works - it REALLY WORKS!!! And a little goes a long way. I just rub a little under my pits, then I use an old large empty deodorant container that has a large rounded top to really smooth it in under my arms. Then that is it!

Even on the sweatiest, most humid days, where I am running around literally miles and miles - this stuff keeps me smelling fresh. Plus it also acts as a decent enough antiperspirant as well for me. While the rest of me ends up dripping - my pits were pretty fresh. I Really love that! Plus after already like three months - this stuff is STILL going strong. I am up to my second scent - hoping to maybe try one more - but so far Dreamcatcher is light and lovely! LOVE THIS STUFF!!!

In fact it smells just like this hand wash that a male friend keeps in his bathroom. I think guys would probably like this very much - me, not really. The scent is also VERY strong while using - like VERY. The good news is that it leaves just the lightest scent on your cleansed skin - thank goodness. Just very light.

It left my skin clean and soft. Too bad I really do not like the scent as I will likely not be using it again. : ( Sad too as I truly appreciate how it is clearly marked Vegan as that is important to me. If you found my review helpful, why not click the "Helpful" button. Thanks! : )

AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_title: Sketchy...  Ingredients?  Organic my eye!  For tea? - I don't think so
AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_text:
First off for anything touting that they are Organic and then come in a non-descript bag - no ingredients, no country of origin or manufacture - no brand info, etc. that is SUPER sketchy. Seriously doubt these are Organic - no marking as such - but there is no info whatsoever anyway - so who knows what is truly in them.

I put a ball in my glass mug and poured boiling water anyway. There is no "flowering" like you may get from flowering tea balls. It just sort of filled the entire mug with flowers - petals and flowers. Like the entire mug. It was the consistency of a thick stew. You might get a few sips for the space that is left after the flowers expand. I was actually impressed with how much "flower" was there from that tiny and light ball.

I sipped it and was snot impressed with the flavor. Light at that and must have been chamomile as chamomile smells like chicken soup to me and I am not a fan of chamomile or this "tea". It was the consistency of soup, though... a hearty chowder. It was not fragrant in any way either so I think although you get plenty of flowers for a tub - you are defeating the purpose of adding fragrant flower petals to your bath. Plus no ingredients anyway. It seemed like all flowers - it really did - but I am not really sure what is in there. Plus some people are allergic to certain herbs and flowers anyway. This one is a bust...

AFGCJIO7DNVCCZPG4KVMKKXVPJLQ.review_title: Good to not slip from your hair

These headbands are completely necessary for me to live my life these days. I tried other masks extenders but nothing either stayed put, was comfortable, or actually helped with my mask. I have a few different types of mask headbands now - as I wear one every time I leave my house.

This eye massage thing doesn’t come with any directions. Now it’s not rocket science but I would like to know if there’s supposed to be heat in each function - if it supposed to pulse on the blue and the red light etc. I say this because I think there’s only heat when the red light is on. The rest seem to have no heat. And it is very light - very slight heat as it is. It makes me question is there even heat or has my face heated the crystal up. So I was really expecting it to have much more heat. Also with both the red and the blue light it’s not a constant vibration - it’s kind of like a pulse vibration it goes on and it goes off then it goes on and it goes off.

I do like that you can use it without the red or the blue light because the third setting is just a vibration - and that one is a constant vibration. But again that setting seems to have no heat at all.

The crystal does seem to be some kind of quartz. It is a clear type of crystal so I assume it’s quartz because quartz is pretty common.

It feels pretty nice around my eyes and if you hold it a certain way the red and/or or blue light will not get into your eye - you won’t see it while you use it. And I do like that. So this is OK and it looks just like a tube of lipstick.

My eyebrows, eyeliner, and lip color are permanent makeup. Not going to lie. However, there are times when even someone with permanent makeup needs a touch up, and eyebrows seem to require a touch up more than anything else. I love this tattoo pen for touch ups. The strokes applied really do look exactly like eyebrow hairs, and I found them easy to apply. The pen is like a felt-tip pen, so if you can use one of those, you can use this. Sometimes it seems as though the color doesn't want to come out. If that happens, just hold the pen with the applicator side down, and it will work fine. For me, at least, the product has been smudge-proof and lasts till I wash it off. (It is waterproof; you have to apply cleanser to remove it.) The color looks quite natural as well and blends with my real eyebrows and permanent makeup perfectly. This isn't just for people with permanent makeup, however. This is a wonderful tattoo pen for those with natural eyebrows who just want to fill them in a bit, make them fuller and more lush. (Haven't we all over-plucked or over-waxed?) Heavy eyebrows seem to be "in" right now, and if that's what you want, this tattoo pen will give them to you. The only minus I can find right now is that my color is not in stock. Highly recommended.

I bought LightStim for Pain to help with arthritis that developed in my knees after an accident. The right knee healed fairly well, no pain, just a little stiffness, and I can easily live with that. The left knee, however, has severe pain in one area. Cortisone injections help, but that help doesn't last long, and it sometimes weakens the muscles until it wears off, and I believe the muscle weakness is worse than the pain. It's certainly more debilitating. I was tired of taking so much Tylenol, even though I always kept my dose way below what is toxic to the liver.

One morning, I woke very early, and even though I'd taken Tylenol the night before, my left knee was really hurting. I cleansed it, then used my LightStim on the affected area, 15 minutes on two areas. To my shock and surprise, the pain was gone. Now, I know the pain will return. One has to treat an injury for some length of time before the healing is permanent. But I do know LightStim is going to speed up the healing, and I'm doing other things to heal my knee as well, such as taking collagen, using BioSil in my morning orange juice to encourage my body to produce more of its own collagen, etc. But when I have to go out, to the hairdresser, to synagogue, to see friends, etc., I know I can do it with greatly reduced pain if I use the LightStim before I go. And, I try to walk at least 60 minutes a day. LightStim treatments help me walk a lot more easily than if I hadn't used it.

I really don't notice my skin getting warm when I use this device, but I do have to say that after a 30-minute treatment, the bulbs are warm, so I do think it's working. I just hold my device against my knee very gently. Don't press. That could hinder progress rather than help it.

I like the fact that LightStim uses a cord and that the bulbs are meant to last 100,000 hours. I also like the fact that we can use this device as often as desired. It does have an automatic 30-minute shut-off, and I don't use it right away again. I wait at least until the bulbs have cooled. No use tempting fate. I also like the fact that we don't need to apply any gel, etc. Just cleanse the area to be treated, plug in the light, and use it. (Make sure you cleanse the area to be treated. If you don't, any oil will simply reflect the light rather than allowing it to be absorbed.)

I do wish the light were a little bigger, though, so I could treat a larger area at one time, but this is a minor complaint. Also, the goggles that come with the device are mostly junk. Mine arrived broken, but I don't use goggles with red light anyway. Red light is an approved treatment for the eyes, although this device is not approved for eye treatments, and I've never worn goggles with my red light panel when I treat my hair. Don't look directly at the light, however. Not without your doctor's okay. That just wouldn't be a good idea. If you really want to wear googles, just invest in a really good pair, and make sure they block out all light. (If you can still see light with your eyes closed or with goggles on, you know the light is hitting your retinas.)

All-in-all, I really love my LightStim, and I'll be using it daily on my injured knee. It's allowed me to reduce the number of Tylenol I take, and, along with the other treatments I'm using, I hope some day soon, my healing will be permanent. (Still think I'd use the LightStim daily, just for good measure.)

Highly recommended.

AFHVOR6BHMCYEBKXIEUD4YEFHIVQ.review_title: Works great, but... (read to end for final update)
AFHVOR6BHMCYEBKXIEUD4YEFHIVQ.review_text:
It's too soon for me to tell if this is really working but the surface of my nails looks better.

The problem I have is with the applicator. They use a lip gloss applicator and the fuzz started coming off the first time I used it. I am now using bare plastic to apply it. (just ordered some eyeliner wands to replace...hope they fit the tube)

GONNA JUMP IN HERE WITH MY LATEST UPDATE IN CASE YOU'RE TEMPTED TO STOP READING. Still love this product and....YAAAYYYYY....my latest (direct) order has BRUSHES instead of foam/fuzz things on the wands. They earned a fifth star for this. So happy!

UPDATE: Three months later and all the peeling areas on my nails are gone. I've had no more splitting and my nails are definitely stronger (I insist on using them inappropriately sometimes and they no longer show signs of wear and tear at their tips.)

I think the people upset with lack of progress are either not using the product as recommended (twice a day) or just aren't waiting enough time. This is not an overnight fix or a magic "blink and your nails will be longer" elixir. Your nails need to grow normally but, being stronger, will attain length without breaking.

NOTE: I file my nails daily (in one direction) with a fine glass file to make sure there are no rough edges from day to day. I've done this for years, though...it's not the reason my nails are so much better now.

Expensive? Yes. Worth it? Absolutely.

FINAL UPDATE: Since I also use a cuticle oil that supposedly has strengthening properties, I decided to ask the Rejuvica people two questions (separate customer service representatives). This product does NOT penetrate the nail...it stays on the surface. And if you wash your hands, the product washes off. I'm going to stop using this product when it runs out. If my nails suffer, I'll go back to using it but put some kind of protective wax product over it immediately. If my nails continue to look good, I'll just stick with my cuticle oil (Barefoot Scientist).

But I cannot deal with the blurriness that lasts for hours (!!!) and makes my eyes feel extra dry and scratchy. AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_title: Yes, these really work...but keep a few things in mind
AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_text:
After very minimal and barely noticeable success with whitening toothpastes and gels, I finally decided to give Crest Premium Whitestrips a try. Previously, I had found the cost to be prohibitive, but the fact that $5 or $7 coupons are offered in our Sunday paper with some regularity made the price a bit easier to swallow.

Just like the commercials say, I definitely did begin to see some improvement after about three days. I would describe the effect as more of a lightening than a whitening per se: the darker yellow spots on my teeth began to fade and to become less apparent. Now, after using the product as prescribed for a week, the color of my teeth is clearly improved; I wouldn't say that my teeth are bright white, but they are definitely more of an ivory or a paler yellow color. According to the package insert, you can immediately begin a second course of treatment for even better whitening effects, but I haven't yet decided if I want to lay out another $30 in order to do this. Also, I should mention that the effect is not so dramatic thta anyone has noticed (UNLIKE in the commercials!).

Now for the caveats. First of all, I found these strips to be a bit difficult to use. It can be hard to remove the strips from the protective backing without them becoming mangled, and it is very easy to get the gel on your fingertips (which causes a temporary whitening effect). Also, the strips are not ideally shaped for your mouth, and I found that they covered my front eight teeth only. Finally, while the top strip adhered fairly well, I found that the bottom strip was more tricky and tended to slide around, especially if I moved my mouth at all. The only solution I found to this was to wear the strips while commuting to work, which luckily gave me a 30-minute period when I did not need to talk. Otherwise, it can be difficult to find a good time to wear the strips, as the insert information advises against wearing them immediately after you brush your teeth, while sleeping, and while you are eating/drinking.

Unlike other reviewers, I did not have a problem with the taste of the strips: I could not detect anything while wearing them, and after taking them off, I thought that the gooey paste left behind was virtually tasteless. I did experience some sensitivity in a lower tooth which I had capped over 20 years ago. Although this sensation went away in time, it was uncomforable enough to make me cut the lower strip to fit around this particular tooth.

In summary, I did see clear--although not miraculous--results from this product and I would be willing to try the strips again, especially if the price were to come down a bit. Ultimately, I would rate Crest Whitestrips three and a half stars, as there is definitely room for improvement.

AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_title: No noticeable results after over a month - UPDATED 11/9/14
AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_text:
NOTE: I received a free sample of this product to review.

Like the hair on my head, my eyelashes are thin and fine. Without mascara, they are barely noticeable. I have never before tried an eyelash growth serum and was frankly somewhat skeptical, yet at the same time, I was excited at the thought that this product might be beneficial.

This serum is packaged in a tube that looks like mascara. However, the inner wand ends in a tiny brush that is like a VERY thin paintbrush. I would have preferred a slightly thicker applicator; the brush was SO small that it was difficult to see the serum for precise application.

I followed the instructions for this product, applying nightly along my lash line. I used this product daily for over a month (since late August). Unfortunately, I am not able to discern any noticeable results. I actually took photos, thinking that might show more of a difference, I but do not see any changes in the photos, either. (It looks like Amazon has finally posted my photos, so you can see what you think for yourself.)

The only small improvement I have noticed of late is that AFTER applying my mascara, my lashes seem longer than they normally would with mascara--it's almost as if they are somehow adhering to the mascara better than they would normally. I'm not 100% sure if this is a real effect, but that possible sign combined with the fact that I didn't have any adverse reactions to this product is the reason why I gave it two stars rather than one. Perhaps others will have better luck than I did.

UPDATED 11/9/14: Despite my lack of results after one month, I continued to use this product. It has now been over two months, and I believe that I have seen SOME results. At this point, my lashes DO appear longer--I think that's why my mascara has seemed to be working better, as my lashes are a bit longer than before. However, my results have been nothing like the miracles in the photos posted on the product page--yes, my lashes are a bit longer, but the effect is hardly noticeable to the bare eye (I asked my husband, and he didn't notice). Furthermore, my lashes are neither thicker nor more plentiful; this product gave me a bit of length only, not thickness or any other effect. So, in summary, I upgraded my review from two to three stars, but I don't feel like I can go beyond that at this time.

AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_title: Really seems to work for me!
AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_text:
My eyelashes are thin, sparse, and short (like my hair, haha). I had a eyelash grower product that seemed to work for me before, so I thought I would give this one a try. My previous one stressed to only apply once per day, before bed; this one encourages you to apply twice per day. I started with once at bedtime but then began adding mornings too.

This definitely seems to work for me! Now, if you are expecting full, lush lashes, I think that's unlikely--at least that's not what happened for me. For me, this product added length but not really any fullness. And the length is mainly noticeable when I use mascara--my lashes actually hold the mascara and look significantly longer. Still, overall I really like this product and would recommend it!

UPDATE 1/18/19:
I am still using this product, although I think I might be getting to the end. It is still giving me longer lashes. I attached a photo to provide an idea of how it works for me. I am wearing mascara for this photo, but even with mascara, my lashes would NOT usually come all the way close to my brows like they are in this photo! But you can also see that while my lashes are longer, they are still pretty thin/sparse. Given this, I think this product would work best for those who have thicker but short lashes.

AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_text:
This lipstick set comes in 2 sets of 5, Set A and Set B. I wound up only opening the "A" set, as after trying these 5 and finding only 2 to work for me, I decided to give the "B" set away. From the photos, I thought that the colors would be nice and muted, but that's not really the case. The color I am wearing in the photo is "Almost Friday," which is a pretty neutral, nude-ish pink. I also kept "Blush for Me," a light, brownish peach. The red shade, "Red for Me," was very bright and didn't seem to belong to the rest of this collection. But the other shades seemed MUCH less intense than in the product photos. Rather than buying a set of 10 like this, I think most people would be better off choosing individual shades that work best for them.

Two other things to note. When I opened one of the lipsticks, the color cylinder popped out and onto my floor, so I wonder about quality. Also, to open the tubes, you have to unscrew them rather than simply pull the top off. This might be good for some who carry around lipsticks in a bag, but for quick everyday use, it's annoying.

I have been using this product for several weeks now. I choose the option for the "mascara brush" style, as I thought this might be easier to use than the thin brush styles I've tried in the past. My results with this were mixed. First, the product is barely discernible on the brush! It seems only completely dry; more product gets on the wand part than on the brush end. Second, the brush is plastic and feels VERY harsh; a brush with soft bristles might have been better.

That being said, this product has seemed to help my lashes somewhat. The effect isn't very noticeable with bare lashes, but when I use mascara, my lashes do look thicker and longer than they would normally. I have used this product on my eyebrows too and have seen some improvement there as well. I wish this was a little easier to use; I would rate it about three and a half stars.
This matte lipcolor pencil goes on nice and smooth.  It doesn't dry my lips like some other products.  The color is a deep plum, although very natural rather than intense.  I would recommend this.

AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_title: Very thin lotion with an unpleasant initial fragrance
AFIJLAW3HIOMRUFSWNH54IJ3XQAA.review_text:
I love trying different lotions, particularly those that have nice fragrance, but when I received this set, I almost threw it away! I the bottle, the smell of the lotion is horrible - I found it to have a strong, artificial scent similar to alcoholic spirits. I decided to give it a try so that I could write an accurate review. The "lotion" is quite thin, much more watery than any other moisturizer I have used. Just to spread on my elbows requires at least 10 pumps from the tiny bottle. The good news is that once on the skin, the distasteful fragrance does not last; I didn't really detect much scent at all after that, but there may have been a faint hint of rose in the dry-down. The moisturization was adequate, nothing more.

I do like the Nail & Cuticle Oil, which comes in a little roller bottle and actually DOES have a rose scent. But this set is absolutely NOT worth the cost, especially given that the lotion is likely to be completely gone after just a few weeks of daily use. Not recommended.

NOTE: At least one other reviewer ("Jam Blaster") mentioned the same issue with the lotion smelling bad and gave this product just 1-star as a result.

UPDATE, 2/1/21:
Since I don't like the scent of this product, I decided to try it on my feet. Despite the lotion being very thin, I actually found it to work quite well on my feet! I put it on in the a.m., then put on socks; by the end of the day, my feet definitely felt soften and smoother. I think the product is too expensive to purchase for this reason alone, but it does work, and so I increased my rating to 3-star.

*UPDATE* April 18th, 2017 - I was just browsing the net trying to find a light therapy device and I was getting pretty exasperated with too many choices. I happened to look over and see my Dermabraze MD unit on my vanity and thought, I wonder if their company makes other products? So when I Google'd the company one of the first things I saw was a "Fakespot" link, and having only ever seen products with an F rating I thought I'd check this one because I expected it to have rave reviews like mine. I was FLOORED when I saw the grade F! That simply cannot be accurate! I purchased mine in November of 2016, and nearly 6 months later I still regard it as the best money I've ever spent on skincare, PERIOD. I used it on my full face just last night! It gets a regular workout too, between myself, my mother and my daughter. Even my son has used it! I just had to come update my review when I saw that deceitful grade but in a way I'm thankful because I know now that Fakespot can't be trusted. I KNOW THIS DEVICE WORKS AND WORKS FANTASTICALLY!

I'm fortunate to have had a great example when I was a child. My mother always took very good care of her skin. Until I reached my teen years I literally believed that all women used peel off masks, apricot scrub, Noxema and Oil of Olay, lol. Skin care has come a long way, and when I started working in the beauty industry I was introduced to higher quality products and left my mother's favorites in the dust, haha. As far as exfoliating, before trying this machine I'd always stuck with scrubs, chemical exfoliants and microdermabrasion crystal creams. Now I feel like a need a good kick in the rear for not investing in real microdermabrasion years ago! I absolutely love this machine ... it is an investment, but the effectiveness and sheer convenience of it make it more than worth the money. You just can't get results like this with any other method. My favorite thing about it is the suction. Sure, you can use products to manually exfoliate skin, but vacuuming the oil and dead cells that collect inside and clog pores combined with abrasion literally and immediately take years off the skin's appearance. It also allows the high dollar serums and moisturizers we apply to do a much better job. Again, to me this totally justifies the investment. If you're serious about skin care and spend good money on expensive products, you owe it to yourself to prep your skin so your products can do their jobs!

Pros of the Bright Therapy unit:

Rechargeable
Strong, adjustable suction
Different attachments for heavy, light and acute abrasion.
Comfortable to hold, fit's easily in the hand
Has disposable filters allowing you to see exactly what the machine removes every time you use it.

If you're looking for a great quality microdermabrasion system I think you'll be pleased with this one, I can't find a single con to owning it. I absolutely love mine!

AFJOKSJE3KPYSUXT6TCKRRD4RO2Q.review_text:
Cucumbers are supposed to be amazing for the skin. So, I wanted to give these a go.

Pro: - moisten. Very moist.
- mask doesn't rip or tear
- plastic backing for easier application
- gentle, pleasant aroma
- sinks quickly into skin after massaging at end

Cons: - thin
- hard to slide into place...and then doesn't fit quite right
- suggested wear time is 20-25 mins....longer than usual

These masks come individually packaged in robust and easy to open pouches. The mask has a sturdy, plastic backing, which is the only reason it can be unfolded and placed on without any trouble because these are thin. Surprisingly, they don't rip or tear easily, though. After taking off the backing, it takes a little maneuvering to get these to sit in place. Firstly, the thin material wanted to bunch and roll along the edges of the face, and the lack of thickness made it difficult to get to lay flat. Also, the eye holes aren't quite right. I, my son, and my daughter tried them (each with very different face sizes) and all of us had trouble with the eyes. When they were in position, The bridge of the nose wouldn't stay pressed against the skin, but kept lifting up. The suggested wear time is 20 to 25 minutes, which is longer than the 15 to 20 I normally see on masks. Removing the mask, however, is no problem, and there's a good amount of moisture left over to massage into the skin....which also works well

The masks are moistening and have a gentle, pleasant odor (although I can't really place it). These are refreshing and leave the skin shiny. If only they'd sit better, I'd enjoy them more.

A bubble mask was something I hadn't tried yet. So, I was curious.

Pros: - pretty, pink coloring
- quite a bit in package
- goes on easily
- doesn't drip or ooze
- gentle, soapy odor
- fun to have to foam up on face

This comes in the usual, mask, foil pouch and is easy to rip open. The mask-fluid is pinkish and has the appearance of yoghurt. It has a flowery, soapy odor, but this isn't over-powering by any means. It's no problem to spread over the face and doesn't drip or run while doing so. It actually starts to foam the second it hits the skin. This was actually fun to watch (joy in little things) and tingles a bit, too. Even the foam stays in place and doesn't run off of the skin or drip.

It is to be worn for 3 min, and then washed off....like a mud mask (but foam is simply more enjoyable than mud). It rinses off pretty easily and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and a pinkish hue. It's simply a nice experience and a change up from the usual masks and muds.

The cream comes is a white box, light cardboard box with the glass jar inside (this has a white, thick plastic lid. It looks simple and in the elegant direction. Upon opening the lid, there's a plastic cover, which needs to be removed (and tossed). The creams is white and carries a citrus odor. It is smooth and thick enough to easily dip out of the jar with the fingers. It has a definite water-base feel to it.
It spreads onto the skin easily and sinks in relatively quickly. The skin does feel slightly tighter(? I guess I'll call it that) right away. I could tell where I had put the cream on and where not. It moistens the skin, and the citrus smell lingers. I have no trouble putting on make-up afterwards. So, far it seems to be smoothing the skin, but only time will tell how it does on that end.

After hearing several friends praise magnetic eyelashes, I decided to give these a go.
The package goes with 10 pairs of eyelashes, each held into place by a magnetic strip, and each one slightly different than the other. There are two containers of magnetic eye liner and one plastic tweezers.
The eyeliner has a thin brush which makes it simple to paint the black line where it needs to be and keep it straight. I had to go back and re-do the very edges to make sure there was enough to hold the lashes. These are easy to remove from the box with the tweezers and place onto the eyes. I was surprised how well the lashes hold...it's not over grippy but they stay in place as long as you don't knock them around. The felt a bit scratchy along the corner to the nose, although it wasn't really rubbing. This sensation was only slight and soon forgotten.

The eyelashes are easy to remove and place back into the box for re-usage. The eyeliner came off so much easier than I thought it would....with a little warm water. It balls off into tiny chunks and doesn't run or scuff or leave marks behind.

These work better than I thought they might and I will be using them again.

My son loves charcoal soaps. So, we gave this one a try.

Pros: - smooth
- very pleasant, herbal smell
- Dead Sea mud nice additive
- has a nice, homemade cut

Oddity (but not really a con): - seems to be almost moist although it isn't

This soap has such a pleasant odor in comparison to the usual charcoal soaps my son uses. It also doesn't leave as sticky of a black residue in the shower. It is smooth and soapy, and is very nice on the skin...which I'm assuming has something to do with the Dead Sea mud. The bar isn't factory cut but has a nice, homemade appearance. My son really likes this one quite a bit.

We picked this one up for a Halloween costume. It comes packaged in a plastic box, in plastic bags, in a hairnet to make sure it doesn't knot. The hair has an okay quality for its purpose, sits well on the head, and does look like we'd expected. What threw us was that the box claims it's 100% Brazilian hair (what's that?) but it also claims it's made in China. Maybe more knowledge-able wig-wearers will understand that. The hair has a synthetic feel to it and doesn't style quite as well as it could. But, as said, for our purposes it works very well.

AFJQW6LKQZQMT6IIEOO34ETFWENA.review_title: I found these to be perfect for anyone who wants a square cuticle line, rather than a round one.
AFJQW6LKQZQMT6IIEOO34ETFWENA.review_text: A decent product for a decent price.  These are nice and flexible, making removal super easy.  They can be reused, once you clean them and sanitize them with rubbing alcohol.  These are more square at the cuticle area, great for those with a more square shaped nail bed, my thumbs are pretty square.  They come in 10 sizes (10 of each size) and the sizes are reasonable sizing too.  I have dual forms from another brand and half of them are unreasonably HUGE, whereas these are for normal people.  For my thumb I used size 2 and my other fingers fit 4-8.  They came in a plastic organizer case that is way smaller than my other case, so they don't take up a ton of room in my nail station.  The latch on mine didn't close tight, so I had to use a piece of tape, but I'm not taking off any stars because that didn't affect the usefulness of the product itself.  All in all, the C curve was perfect, easy to load, cure and pinch off.  I found these to be perfect for anyone who wants a square cuticle line, rather than a round one. I purchased this thru my Amazon Prime account and did not receive any compensation for this completely unbiased review.

AFJQW6LKQZQMT6IIEOO34ETFWENA.review_title: I got leaking inside the cap, but it didn't come out.
AFJQW6LKQZQMT6IIEOO34ETFWENA.review_text:
This is a nice spray bottle kit, it comes with 2 funnels and a sheet of labels, I found the labels too small for use, each one is approximately 1 inch x 1/2 inch in diameter, and not sure if it can be used in an inkjet printer or not. All 10 spray bottles included all the necessary parts, and the stem that draws up liquid was long in each one, none were short and I really appreciated that. You should be able to spray down to the last drop. I tested mine with rubbing alcohol, for sanitizing my phones. The funnel came in handy for filling the bottle. It made the job so easy! The sprayer does spray a very fine mist. I used it several times to clean some things then left it overnight with the cap on. Next day I tested it again. First off, the cap contained some of the rubbing alcohol inside it, which means the container will leak into the cap standing up. Not necessarily a huge deal breaker, but a negative for me. Holding it in my hand I got the rubbing alcohol on my finger too, so this may waste product just from this. Several drops every 24 hours may not seem like a lot, but if you make your own essential oil room spray then this could be an expensive waste. Lastly, I had an issue with the spray top, the angle is so slight I wasn't sure if I would spray myself in the face of I wasn't wearing eyeglasses. You have to be careful, ensuring you're spraying away from yourself. I did not get any leakage of the alcohol out of the cap, it seemed pretty tight. It did pool in the cap, didn't run down the bottle. I did get a rubbing alcohol ring when I set down the cap on my coffee table tho. Beware of that possibility whatever you use in these bottles.
All in all, a nice kit and I give it 4 stars.

AFJQW6LKQZQMT6IIEOO34ETFWENA.review_title: Cute little lamp, takes up 7.5 " or 19 cm squared of table space.
AFJQW6LKQZQMT6IIEOO34ETFWENA.review_text: This is a nice little UV & LED cure lamp, it is smaller than the other ones I have, so it takes up less space.  It is a bit more costly for what you get, compared with similar items, at $26 that is a slight negative for me.  This does come with little gloves that were to protect the skin, and I'm sure they help a little bit.  I did have plenty of room to cure my full hand, but I did my thump separately.  I find that when you use these lamps it is best to turn on the lamp and slowly insert your hand with the timer started so you don't get those heat spikes.  I did not have any problems with cure time or curing with this lamp.  I will continue to use it and if I have any issues, I will reevaluate my review accordingly.  Dropping a star for the cost.

This is a nice Nautical gift set with 4 pretty polishes.  They are 13.5 ml each, and made in the U.S.A.  Initially I thought I would love Stay Nude the most, but it ended up being my least favorite of the set, only because it is pearl and streaks are unavoidable due to the type of finish it is.  All 4 have a shiny topcoat built into the formula.  The 3 cremes are all very sheer formulas, not super opaque.  The thickness of the formula for all of these is good.  If you like a sheer formula, where you can see your nail bed thru the polish, then these are your jam.  I did several manicures with each of them, and found that if I wanted a sheer look then 1 coat worked perfectly, otherwise 2 or 3 coats for full coverage and less peek thru of your natural nail and smile line.  I did 2 easy coats for each of my manicures.  The blue (Hypnosis) seemed to have the best coverage, and the formula for that was my favorite of the 4, it dried the fastest at 8 minutes to the touch.  They all go on easily, with a regular round brush (not flat) and they dry fairly well, in about 10-15 minutes each layer.  I did find that using my own quick drying topcoat that these wore much better, but from the manufacturer neither base nor top coat are required.  I did not get any staining from these, which I love.  The pink and white will both be really good polishes for doing either French tip or pond manicures when you just want a sheer base, where you do a layer, do art over it, then cover it again, and more art on that layer-it gives a layered effect that is fun to do.  The color palate is a fun one, with lots of options for artwork.  These are not quick drying-more of the typical 10 minutes per layer, and I expected them to be hardened on their own, without the help of a quick drying topcoat, but that was not the case with them.
