AFMJAM4WWPG2INF5EIKZOWU62YRQ.review_title: These fit on small pens like the Dragonhawk mast tour
AFMJAM4WWPG2INF5EIKZOWU62YRQ.review_text: These are pretty small and fit comfortably on my mast tour pen & wireless battery pack I use on it.(one for each) I have to force it over my other pen machined like a rubber that's too small. (I actually have no idea what that's like, I am only guessing)

AFMJAM4WWPG2INF5EIKZOWU62YRQ.review_title: Not bad but I Returned it.
AFMJAM4WWPG2INF5EIKZOWU62YRQ.review_text: Not a bad machine, mine just had a couple deep gouges in it. Maybe factory damage coming out of the machine. I worked in a davenport machine factory where parts would occasionally get gouged by a tool. It happens. I just wanted a cheyenne machine but won't get what I'm looking for in this machine. if I keep buying cheap machines, I'll never know how the good ones work! I'm saving for a premium machine. Once I have the machine I really want, I'll buy cheap machines to test against the good one.

Better than using water & paper towel! I'm only in the practice stages of tattooing so I actually cut the foam in half & stuff a half in the bottom of a tiny plastic dixie cup to save $$. They work great.

Slot of these Chinese machines are made in one factory & distributed to numerous Chinese tattoo companies. You don't need to look around for long to see, but I'll give an example with this machine here. If you check, Hawink & Dragonhawk also have this SAME machine. They all just change the outer appearance, but the inside is EXACTLY the same. So if you're on a budget, your best bet is the Dragonhawk Mast Sai. Same machine for under eighty bucks. Just got one myself & it runs like a champ. So they're ALL good machines. You can just find the same thing way cheaper if you shop around here on Amazon. Sorry Mummy, but if Mast can sell theirs for cheaper & still make profits, so can you.

AFMNVTBM76V35QDPQ6KSFCCDK5YA.review_text: I like this product! It's very moisturizing and a great supplement to keeping my long hair from splitting. There isn't any sort of crazy smell to it. It's just a neutral sort of smell. I would get this for sure. It goes with my green themed bathroom and looks like a luxury addition for the many guests that are always coming for a visit.

I like this product a lot for the vegan ingredients. it cleans without stinging my eyes. My skin feels a little more stripped than I would like it to feel. But at this price point, it's perfect. I'm just really spoiled with my skin care.

Definitely appropriate for someone with oily skin. I will likely use it through the summer months where my workout routine might indicate that I need this. I wear make-up when I work out so I need something that really cleans afterwards. this will do the trick.

The inside and outside are lined with Vinyl. It can be a little warm wearing it but it's perfect for keeping the water out. If you have a conditioning treatment, you can put it on and then wash out the inside given the material that is going on in there. You get two per container, which is great. That way you can always just be washing the old one if you need to. I prefer cloth ones for sleeping. But this could def work if you have some sort of leave in overnight conditioner situation.

AFMNVTBM76V35QDPQ6KSFCCDK5YA.review_title: Good travel brush if Boar Bristle is your thing
AFMNVTBM76V35QDPQ6KSFCCDK5YA.review_text:
Boar bristle is supposed to be lux. some people love it. My hair tangles a bit too much for boar bristle. I need the harder plastic to really pull it through.

That said, if you like boar bristle, this is a nice pocket brush. It is ideal for travel as it folds down very small. I If this was the style of brush that I preferred on the bristles, I would be absolutely thrilled to replace my current travel brush with this one. Unfortunately, I have plebeian hair.

I like this moisturizer, though I'm not 100% sure that it's for everyone. It is light, but it does take a bit more time than usual to fully absorb into the skin. It's vegan though and it has this deliciously eucalyptus clean smell. I think that makes it appropriate for people who have a little of an acne issue or for folks that are men. I happen to really like the scent.

AFMNVTBM76V35QDPQ6KSFCCDK5YA.review_title: Feels great on. Love the whole line
AFMNVTBM76V35QDPQ6KSFCCDK5YA.review_text: This packaging is wonderful and it really moisturizes well. This is key for the winter which is so dry in my area. I'm really thrilled to have this.

AFMOMCGZNUFKCG33DA64LEE65FXQ.review_title: It should be seven in one with the work you have to do to get it to conform to your face.
AFMOMCGZNUFKCG33DA64LEE65FXQ.review_text: This product was just okay for me. I'm an esthetician so I do a lot of facial treatments and using this it didn't conform to your face like a normal sheet mask would slash should I found myself having to use scissors to cut pieces of the Mask so it would lay flat on my face and even then it didn't feel good.
One of the worst peel off masks I have ever experienced and probably one of the worst ones that's on the market today. It does not go on easy and then glitter scrapes your face not so relaxing.

AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_text:
My daughter loves this toothbrush, and I love that she's brushing her teeth more often! Surprisingly strong brushing action (and a little loud, to be honest), on both the speeds it offers. I don't believe it's a true sonic brush, but then it isn't priced like one either.

The battery life is impressive - a full charge overnight the first day, then 3 weeks of brushing every day (mostly!) and it still has charge.
Instructions were clear and detailed, no complaints there. The handle is very slim, some of these power brushes have chunky handles, so this one is a more comfortable fit for smaller hands. Look after the charging cable, it's a small pin on the end that plugs into the handle, not a mini / micro USB shape.

One downside is that the brush heads are specific to this brand; you can buy a new set of four for $10 but after a year of use (4 included brushes x 3 months each) it's probably easier to get everything new.

This foam cleanser is from a company in Seoul, South Korea. Its in the middle of pack with regards to price….some quick research shows that 8 or 9 dollars is ballpark for about a 4 to 5 ounce item of this kind, and remember this has traveled a long way, so there's a cost element to that! You can get more ounces for the same price from household name brands and you can pay a lot more for niche products.

The tube comes wrapped in plastic for protection and there's a foil cap under the lid. Once you're in, the product is like a thick paste, but not difficult to squeeze out. You don't need a lot, a pea-sized amount foams up well once you've added water. The packaging only refers to an 'appropriate' amount, whatever that means, but a little goes a long way. The smell is very pleasant, a natural and subtle lemon. The foam feels like it cleans thoroughly, my face felt less oily. The Vitamin C that's included claims to improve uneven skin but I didn't notice a big change there.

I like this product - its an honest, unpretentious cleanser that doesn't make any unrealistic claims, it smells good and it would work for everyday use, for the whole family. Worth checking out.

AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_title: Easy way to pamper your skin
AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_text:
The roller comes in nice packaging. The paint finishes are a nice color and are smooth. The whole thing has a nice weight to it. The rose quartz stone is smooth and well shaped. The rolling mechanism was a little stiff at first but it has loosened with use and a drop of light oil.

The vibration mechanism works well, but the supplied battery was very weak - things improved with a fresh AA battery. There is a rubber gasket on the screw-in compartment that holds the battery and forms the switch - a thoughtful touch. The stone feels great while using it, it stays cool. I can’t say I have seen any improvement in my skin tone or texture yet but it does feel nice.

AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_title: Acceptable results; good value for money
AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_text:
This self tanner lotion was just okay. The first thing I noticed was that the label on the tube was crooked and had bubbles in it - and where first appearances matter, this was a little disappointing. The 8oz tube will last you through several tans - at $20 it’s a fair price, but it can go as low as $9, which is exceptional.

None of these products has a great appearance right out of the tube, and this is no exception, however this brown gel does provide a decent tan, thankfully not the obviously-fake ‘orange’ that can result from similar products. It does have the typical self-tanner odor to it. I was able to apply the tanner and avoid streaks but my teenage daughter was less successful avoiding streaks and patchiness. This I attribute to operator error. I applied the cream to my arms and shoulders and found that it did stain my clothing, despite the claim on the label to be non-staining.

AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_title: Natural looking hair, good value for 7 pieces
AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_text: Any review of hair extensions by a guy in his fifties is going to be short (and mainly guesswork!) but luckily I found willing volunteers in my wife and daughter, who report that these hair extensions are very easy to put in, even for inexperienced users. It looks like good quality hair - very soft and straight, and has varied shades of brown and blonde running through it. The clips are easy to open and shut, but there was a little trouble with the clips slipping - that may be due to lack of experience using extensions. Once in, they provide a noticeable boost to volume and really pretty highlights. The extensions did come with extra fastening clips, care instructions, and a decorative hair clip. For reference the images show the 16 inch extensions, in Light Blonde/ Highlighted Golden Blonde color.

AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_title: An effective cleanser but awkward applicator
AFMRUDC57F6M2LQATDMSNGXBHU3A.review_text:
This product certainly looks high-end with its black and gold packaging, the twist cap that turns through 180 degrees for on/off, and the raised ‘fingers’ for scrubbing your face, but that part doesn’t work too well.

The surface area of the head is too small, and the little bumps that are supposed to scrub can’t really be felt. Also, the dispensing hole is small, so it takes some effort to squeeze any product out. I found it much easier to put some on my hands and then massage directly onto my face - you’d be there all morning if you tried the applicator.

Other than that, the charcoal cleanser itself is high quality - it’s made in the USA (Seattle), the results feel as good as a scrub even though it’s not abrasive like a scrub, I'm told it does remove make-up properly, and it smells OK - not a strong scent, and I think it smells a bit like playdoh. Overall, I like it and will continue to use, but the brush system may need some rethinking.

AFMTB6XAI3YBCJVTOGKOFJU3LUOQ.review_title: Some Of The Best Sauer Kraut There Is !
AFMTB6XAI3YBCJVTOGKOFJU3LUOQ.review_text: We have strayed from a national name brand of sauer kraut and was that a  big mistake. The store brand was one that almost everyone set aside on their plate and did not eat. We went back to a  name brand and that was Del Monte. The kraut we think is the best on the market. We do nto like that other kinds of kraut such as Bavarian. We want the real stuff, at least to us it is the real stuff. Did you know the whole  14.5 oz can only has 10 calories in it and zero fat. Even for carbs there is only 1g. Now this is where we definitely go wrong as we serve it with smoked sausage, which we know is totally off the chart. Don't do this often---just occasionally. The meal is delicious. I do have a note fro Del Monte. Remember when your cans contained 16 oz of kraut, then you cut back and now it's 14.5 oz. Please quit doing this to us!.Do you realize, and I am sure you do, that I now have about 10% LESS to serve to my family.

This Jade face roller and Jade Gua Sha tool comes packaged nicely.  This roller is a little nicer than the last one I reviewed, therefore the reason for the 5 start.  We enjoy using this one more than our other one.  This is better put together and seems to be a grade or two better.

Another quality product from Mountain Falls.  This Regular Nail Polish Remover does its job.  It is easy to remove old nail polish using this product.  This is a 10 oz bottle of polish remover.  Good nail polish remover.

I already have a single disk callus remover but this triple disk callus remover is much nicer.  This remover has 1 head that rotates to 3 different buffing disks.  There is a rough, medium and smooth grinding disk.  These disk do a great job.  There is a small cleaning brush and a USB cord include.  The device appears to be well made.  The speed on the head is good and does not slow down when using.  I have only charged this device once and it is still running.  This is a good product at a good price.  Highly recommend.

AFMTB6XAI3YBCJVTOGKOFJU3LUOQ.review_title: Daughter Likes This Straightening Hot Comb
AFMTB6XAI3YBCJVTOGKOFJU3LUOQ.review_text:
My daughter really likes this Dan Technology Hot Comb.

There are several features that she likes.
1. The cord swivels 360 degrees. No more tangled up cord.
2. Variable temperature. (200-500 degree)
3. Fairly fast heat up.
4. Easy grip handle. The handle is small enough for her to grip easily.
5. The head still heated the entire time she was doing her hair.

She is happy with this heated comb.

There are 3 clear plastic spray bottles in this set.  All the bottles are the same 8 oz size.  I like the spray handles.  They fit in my hand and are easy to spray.  The sprayer can be set 3 ways.... OFF,  STREAM,  and MIST.  I am currently using the mist on my plants.  The liquid comes out evenly and does not drip out of the nozzle.  The pick up hose inside the bottle goes all the way to the bottom so you get all the liquid.  These are 3 good spray bottles and well worth the price.

AFMTB6XAI3YBCJVTOGKOFJU3LUOQ.review_title: Small Short Fine Mist Plastic Bottle
AFMTB6XAI3YBCJVTOGKOFJU3LUOQ.review_text: These are nice small, short plastic bottles.  The bottles are approx 3" tall.  Each bottle comes with a fine spray mister.  The bottles hold 2 oz each.  These are nice small bottles.  These only come out to be 32 cents each.  They are will worth this cost if you need bottles this small.

I am not impressed with this makeup organizer.  This organizer reminds me of the inexpensive makeup box I use to buy my girls when they were 6 years old.  I expected a lot more from this organizer considering it cost almost $55.  This is a plastic organizer.  The organizer has some scuff marks on the body and then a couple on the clear top lid.  I am disappointed with this organizer especially at this price point.

This package consist of 4 small plastic bottles.  Each bottle holds 1.7oz of liquid.  Each bottle has a fine mist sprayer and a cap to cover the sprayer.  We have used 2 bottles and each one did a good job spraying.  The cap sealed good and there were no leaks.  There are 4 funnels to use when filling your bottles.  Overall, I am happy with these bottles.

This is a small facial steamer that has had good results for my daughter.  She has another unit that must be 3X bigger than this unit.  This unit is approx 5.25" x 3.5" x 6.5" tall.  This is a compact unit.  We were first concerned that this would even work but after a few uses she is very happy with the operation of this unit.  The unit includes the main compact unit, a small hand held unit, a mask, and 4 tools.  I took 1 star away because of the price.  She is happy with the results.
This is a nice set of brushes. The brush is a soft pink synthetic fiber.  The handles are a pinkish crystal handle.  The brushes come in a clear plastic bag that closes to store your brushes.

Both my girls have longer hair and like to get it off their neck during the hot summer months.  My girls have been using these clips for a week and so far, so good.  There are 8 hair clips in this package so they each took 4 clips.  There are 2 styles.  One style is curved teeth clips while the other is more a rectangle with teeth.  The girls have tried both styles and they say both work well.  Only time will tell us if these clips will last but at under $10 for 8 clips who cares.  Both girls are happy with the style, colors and cost.

AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_title: Easily to apply and you get 50 of them!
AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_text:
Just like my title says, they are easy to apply. The instructions tell you to wet the actual strip and then put it on your face, but I recommend keeping the strip dry and just lightly wet the area around your nose. I tried both ways and for some reason, wetting my face just worked much nicer. You also get 50 of them so thats a huge plus considering the price.

Now the big question.....do they work?
Well. When I used it the two times, it dude pull out some small blackheads and looked like it did a decent job. I've always been a little skeptical of these kinds of products and I don't feel like it does that much in general. I kind of use these for placebo and catharsis. It's comforting to see these strips pull ANYTHING out of your skin, so it makes me feel better about it. But it is completely acne-clearing and black head cleansing? Not really.

These are inexpensive, you get a bunch of them, and they are nice to use. I recommend it but if you have somewhat large pores and oily skin like me, don't expect much passed "Oh.....well that's nice." I wish it did more. But these are okay.

AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_title: Reasonable value, Works well on first use
AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_text:
I love that this is double sided and the fact that I can hold it in my hands comfortably. It has the right coarseness that can smoothen calluses and hardened skin on mostly by the big toes and the heel. It can also be used in other parts of the body where needed but take care not to scrub hard as it can scratch really well. Having 4 in a pack is a great perk so I can put one in each bathroom for use.

Questions: The questions will take time before I can have answers which means I will be back for an update: a. How long does each one last if using every other day?
b. Does this shred when in use that can possibly clog drains?
c. Can you put this in the microwave to disinfect?
d. Do both sides get smoother over time so you know when to change it?
e. Will these two blocks separate after a few uses?

I used to have a simple rough oval rock that I used as a pumice for a long time but then my kid took it and threw it in the lake thinking it was just a rock that has no use sitting in the bathroom. I have not found a good replacement since then.

AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_title: OK for first time body scrubber users…..
AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_text:
I’ve tried so many kinds of shower back scrubbers and this one is interesting. The two sided different type of scrubber on each side gives you an option as to how you want to feel it on your back. It has a convenient length and two handles that is good for those who can’t lift their arms to use the single wooden handle back scrubber.

However, this is my problem. I am so used to the loofah exfoliators wherein it is scratchy and makes my back feel really clean. This one, though it makes a good feeling when you use either type of the scrub on either side, still does not have that full satisfaction that you’ve cleaned your back well. It is too soft for me. It needs some more toughness on the bristles or a little rigidity on the bumps so you can feel it better. The length is awesome as I have problems with my rotator cuff and painful to lift up my arms. A little more add to the length will probably be helpful.

As a note, make sure that you soak this at least every 2-3 uses in probably a vinegar solution to disinfect or efficiently clean as unnoticeable grime builds up on the surface and you won’t even notice it.

AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_title: Soft and simple but attractive design
AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_text: hese are very cute to wear and because you have solid colors it will not clash with whatever you are wearing. It uses a very soft material and surprisingly enough, it stays on my head. Most of the time, headbands slide off my hair because they say that my hair is too soft and shiny (I like it that way!!!) . However, it doesn't move when I do yoga or cardio because I sweat a lot and the sweat keeps it stuck where it is and still holding back those little annoying hairs that touch your face every now and then. This soft material also keeps my head cool to the touch and not hot at all. Seems that it is an efficient breathable material., It is also not tight so that it can cause headaches but just enough to be in place.  Have to get used to the design, with the criss cross on top.so you can always make it look nice while you wear it. I washed all of them before I start using them and they came out pretty well.  My only wonder is how long will it last, especially if you sweat a lot and you have to wash it all the time.

Very much more comfortable than the regular curlers that I use because it is soft and out of the way if you do the bun (I think that's the only way to do it). Unfortunately I just layered my hair and trimmed it so that putting it in a bun is a little challenging now. So I had my daughter try it. She liked it very much because she said that it keeps her hair off her face while sleeping. It is also so soft and wearable without it being a nuisance at night. It is interesting to learn how to do it. Got to have the patience to maneuver it and make it right for you. So far the result is not how she wants it but it might take time to get it right and easy to use.

I still think this is a great idea that is comfortable and fun to do for long hair. However, I think it should specify how long the hair should be. It should be past the collar bone , the minimum length is halfway past the shoulder blades to make it work and be effective.

AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_title: Moisturizes very well and leaves no greasy feeling
AFMY3JLTJRCRPPNTFKYUWNRCJWPA.review_text: Love the feel of my skin in the morning, great scent and for me anything with Aloe vera and Green tea extract is a winner. Very nicely secured packaging that makes it look expensive (but it still really is!). The pump dispenser is also cool to use. Approved for purchase next time.

AFMY5CEPFKJXLHTMOJSYC4XABXOQ.review_text:
I don't think there are any creams that would make eyebags disappear. I just look for ones that would reduce the feeling of puffiness. For that, I'd give this 5 stars. But it does not reduce wrinkles, eyebags, etc., which is what it claims, so I gave it 3 stars.
I use it in the morning and in the evening, after washing my face.
It feels cool when applied, and doesn't cause any irritation. It also doesn't give me eye crusts. There is no smell. It doesn't have any bad interaction with my makeup either.

AFMY5CEPFKJXLHTMOJSYC4XABXOQ.review_title: Many 2" stencils, color doesn't apply well
AFMY5CEPFKJXLHTMOJSYC4XABXOQ.review_text:
It comes with 24 different stencils (you'll have to flip the same stencil over for left/right eyebrows), which are for eyebrows that are a little over 2 inches in length. I tried a few that are close to my eyebrow shape and thickness (or thinness), but my eyebrows are a little too weird and short.
It took quite a bit of effort to transfer the color from the tube to my brows/skin. The end result is okay.
It comes with a double ended brush to help with applying and fixing the color and shape, so that helps.

AFMY5CEPFKJXLHTMOJSYC4XABXOQ.review_title: Cleans well, use repeatedly to remove blackheads
AFMY5CEPFKJXLHTMOJSYC4XABXOQ.review_text:
The kit comes with a spatula which makes it easy to spread the mask, mine broke during the first use. I waited 30 minutes to let it dry. It peeled off like charred paper stuck to my skin. My face felt very clean and smooth, though it didn't remove all the blackheads after one use. The aloe gel felt refreshing on my skin.
Overall, a nice kit for facial cleansing.
It is cooling on the skin when I apply it.  Smells like winter mint gum.  Takes a lot of rubbing for it to fully absorb and leaves a slightly oily sheen on my skin.

Smells very mildly of ginger, I smell soap more than anything.  I followed directions and leave it on for 10 minutes before I step in the shower.  The way I use it is to leave it on the sink counter.  I lather it on specific areas and leave it on while I brush my teeth and do other morning routines.  It feels like a clean bar of soap.  After a week, no noticeable slimming, but those areas feel clean and less bloated.

I like the silicone brush, it’s soft and scrubs without scratching. I wish it comes off, was kinda weird holding the whole bottle to scrub my face.
The cleanser looks and smells like unscented liquid soap. It is like cleaning my face with foaming hand soap. It left it squeaky clean, which is nice. Takes away all the excess oil and grime and makeup. My skin felt tight afterwards.
I don’t know about the hydrating part as I always follow washing my face with aloe Vera gel. I have oily, sensitive skin and this didn’t make me breakout.

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: After 2 weeks I can see a nice decrease in fine lines
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: There's really no fragrance which is kind of a bummer BUT the gel is light weight, soaks in well and hydrates beautifully.  I love this product line and tried this as an alternative to the night serum. I love both.  This seems to absorb quicker into my skin. Leaves no greasy residue,  not sticky. Super soft. I highly recommend this and all of their products.  I'm 54 and am enjoying more glowing, youthful looking skin.

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: Easy to use, no fragrance,  deep clean
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: Great on sensitive skin. I love the scrubber. Soft silicone like fingers that massage your skin as you wash. All in one,  I love it.  Easy to dispense and fits well in hand. Cap to keep it sterile.  Great product. Great value for the money. Not harsh but deep cleaning.

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: Dries hard. Re-wet then tears off. Faux fragrances
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: Dries to powder, like clay. Re-wet it then after a minute, it loosened up and could be torn off. Didnt hydrate, just dried out my skin. Didn't notice any lightening of my skin.

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: Fragrance please. This smells like wet dog
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: While yes, it deep cleaned my skin it also dried it out terribly.  Great lather but I couldn't wash it off fast enough. I nearly vomited. Its truely awful. Wet dog and day old beach seaweed aroma. I won't use anymore of this product and I had to use another cleanser just to remove the smell.

The fragrance is not over powering,  just enough. It deeply cleaned my hair of buildup from styling products. Literally squeaky clean. This is not a shampoo for daily use but its fantastic for WOMEN with dull, lifeless hair to remove buildup. I love it. I will happily buy this again. (Shake well before use)

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: Moderately hydrating after first use, easy to use
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: I needed a mask for my very long, dry hair. Avocado is so good for your hair and I'm overall, pretty happy with this product. I left it in longer than suggested bc my hair is so dry. When I rinsed it out and towel dried my hair, I could see the curls coming back. The longer I use it, the more it nourishes my hair. I will absolutely get this again and again. Would be nice to have a yummy fragrance but I'm still loving my hair after using this.
Could not be easier to use. Wet brush and start painting. Deeply pigmented,  long lasting.  I love these and will absolutely buy them again.

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: After a month of use I can see a visible difference
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: I use this every day. While I'm brushing my teeth and getting ready for my day. It cane with no instructions but its fairly easy to figure out. Too, just come back to the product description online and read how to use it. Charged pretty quick and lasts about 4 days on one charge.  The laugh lines and frown lines are slowly loosing their depth and overall, my skin tone has evened out quite a bit. I'm happy with it. Its quick, very convenient and does offer results with disciplined use. Try it!!

AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_title: I love these.  Easy to melt and use
AFN6RQAVUB7FV3C7IYGDHQW3BZPQ.review_text: After 2 months of use I can say I'm very happy with this brand. I will try another fragrance from them this time just for a difference. the pellets melt evenly in my pot and went on easier. I DO use an exfoliator in conjunction with this wax to prevent ingrown hairs but I'm happy with the fragrance and am excited to try their others. After 6 weeks I noticed my leg hair decreased in size and stiffness so that's a huge plus. Awesome company. Awesome product.

The smell is more strawberry rhubarb but it's like a facial cream in texture. Ultra smooth going on. You can feel the moisturizing as you use this. Zero irritation on sensitive skin. Highly giftable. Great packaging, durable, tight lid container.  Ample product so it's a great value for the money. You can use it with your fav scrubby for enhanced sensation and exfoliating. Leaves skin clean and glowing. Skin feels nourished, refreshed. Good stuff!!!

AFN7RCN7BG2WH2ML4CF5HND5DYUA.review_text: Good wig. I personally wouldn’t wear as an everyday wig, without a hat. It is soft, but you can tell this wig is synthetic by touch. The shine looks more natural, shine is not terrible. I would definitely use if I needed a wig for a costume. This wig does shed if you run your fingers through it, but it isn’t terrible shedding.

These lashes look and feel great. They are easy to use. Make sure to shake the liner before application, and to let it dry before applying lashes. Great ting ready has never been so easy. Who need mascara, and no hassle with messy glue.
Great hair clips. Awesome colors. They seem to be very durable. Hold hair up great. Great material.
Super cute patterns. The colors are very vibrant. Fit well. They are comfortable to wear and stretchy.
These are great hair ties. The have great stretch and look just like other brands. Holds my hair just fine.
Beautiful wig. Nice length and fits comfortably. It is lightweight.
These hair clips are beautiful. Perfect when you want to dress up a simple style rather than using the regular plastic ones.
Great brushes, very soft. However, the pink brush holder/cleaner came dirty and perhaps used.

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text: This is another great brush from Sigma! I now have 4 Sigma brushes and all four are of outstanding quality. This little brush does exactly  what Sigma's website says it will do (see the video on their site) and I highly recommend it. I no longer see any reason to pay $40 and up for one makeup brush when Sigma offers such a large variety of brushes at half the price!

Swisspers is my usual brand but for some strange reason I decided to give these a try. They're "ok" ...they are soft and absorbent but they tend to shed fibers even when wet. As I use these around my eye area that is not a good thing! Will return to my usual rounds.

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_title: WORTHY OF A TRY FOR STAYING POWER ALONE PLUS- No Racoon Eyes!
AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text:
First off I wear contact lens and so far I've had no adverse reaction. I've only tried it once and it stayed put for 24 hrs, even though a shower! Now that's what I call really waterproof! I don't normally sleep in makeup of any kind but wanted to give it an "all night" durability test. Woke up the next morning....was still there! Expected at least some "mascara" marks on my pillowcase but there was nary a mark. But my biggest surprise came when I awoke without "racoon eyes"!!! I usually wear "tubing" mascaras as other formulas end up under my eyes within a few hours, I actually expected this mascara to do the same.

Volume and length? It definitely added length. I use Latisse so my lashes have stayed long as I've aged and this mascara provided additional length. As to volume, not so much. However, I only used one coat so it may indeed give the volume advertised with another coat. I really did not notice any "fibers" and being a lens wearer perhaps that's not a bad thing. The formula is not thick so it applies smoothly without leaving clumps. It was fairly easy to remove with a cotton pad soaked in micro-cellular water. All in all, if you are looking for staying power this mascara is worthy of a try.

The packaging is unique! Hans Holbein's portrait of a young Princess Elizabeth [later Queen Elizabeth I] just caught my eye. I found the square shape vs round tube a lot easier to hold and the brush is a standard design found on many other mascara brands.

I just started using this filler and at this time I don't feel its had the appropriate time for me to see any change in the depth of my fine lines. So this will be a 1st impression review that I will revisit after I've used this for a few weeks.

[From the box/packaging] This product is made by the Korean, Daewoong Pharmaceutical [DN Co.] Company which according to the company's website is a global healthcare company that strives to contribute to the beauty molding industry in Korea and around the world.

The gel has an easy to use unique packaging that doses out just the right amount needed to pat over wrinkles and fine lines. The gel, when first applied, feels slightly sticky but does not remain so on the skin and it worked well under foundation with no pilling or reaction.

Being a skin care/cosmetic junkie and always a bit skeptical, I did a little digging into the ingredients. It does contain proven HA [hyaloronic acid] which is a good start in my opinion. I did find one ingredient I wanted to know more about namely:

EGF [epidermal growth factor) a/k/a SH-OLIGOPEPTIDE-1: - From the INCI website - Epidermal growth factor is a protein that stimulates cell growth. I encourage you to research this ingredient for additional information for informed decision making.

Right now, I'm skeptically giving this 3 stars for seemingly falling into the Cosmeceuticals [cosmetic products that claimed to have medicinal or drug-like benefits]

11/29/20 Update: I've used this for a few weeks now and my smile lines, although not doing a disappearing act, they are less noticeable. I've not had any adverse reaction to this gel and have added a star due to the results I've seen. Note : a little goes a long way.

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_title: PERFECT ALTERNATIVE FOR EYESHADOW SCOTCH TAPE TRICK👍👍👍
AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text: Although this tape is designed for eyelash extensions, I wanted to see how it worked when applying eye-shadow. I use the makeup artist's Scotch tape trick for applying eye shadow [see Dominique Sachse's, Caught on Tape U tube video] and love the effect. However, Scotch tape doesn't stick to skin evenly/smoothly leaving gaps and when its peeled off it takes some foundation with it. I was hoping this would work better and I've not been disappointed.  It's easy to apply and goes on smoothly with no wrinkles or gaps and it removes without taking foundation with it. Leaving you with a nice winged effect to your shadow. Now that I think about it, it should also work for winged eyeliner.

These are natural looking lashes that were easy to apply. The magnetic liner's brush is tapered to a point allowing me to make a thin less noticeable line that stayed put all day. The lashes removed easily and the liner was gone with one swipe of Micellar Water. My only complaint is that it did seem to take a while for the liner to dry, but then I'm a newbie at magnetic lashes so this may not be out of the ordinary.

We needed to replace our worn out nail clippers and these have been a good choice. Made of stainless steel they're lightweight yet strong and open and close smoothly. The blades are sharp enough for even clean cuts and the angled pair are perfect for pesky hang nails. The nail clipping slots are something I've never encountered before but its a rather ingenious idea!

Thanks for reading this review and I hope its helpful

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_title: NOT A SKINCARE GIMMICK GIVES AMAZING RESULTS
AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text:
My first thought was that this was another gimmick but being a skincare junkie had to try it. I'm so glad that I did as it exceeded my expectations to the point that I've overlooked a few things I'd normally dock it on.

First use: My usual routine is to wash my makeup off and immediately apply HA [Hyaluronic acid] to relieve the resulting dry tight feeling. I filled this sprayer with HA serum and at first, didn't feel anything but cool air hitting my face and wondered if any serum was even coming out. Then suddenly the tightness was gone and my face felt like it was covered with a moisture mask. When applying HA with my fingers it always took a minute or two to soak in, not so with this sprayer the results were immediate! Although the Nano mist is so fine its impossible to see, the end results is an amazing feeling of soft fully moisturized skin.

With this sprayer you can chose to use serums, toners or water so your not limited to only water like other Nano sprayers. This sprayer is well made and the USB cord is included, the liquid chamber is small [perhaps two tablespoon capacity] easy to fill and it only used a tiny amount of serum to cover my face and neck.

The only Cons are the USB port's location on the bottom so it must be laid on its side to charge {that's weird} and the instruction booklet could use a little help. But, as stated at the beginning of this review I'm so impressed with how my skin feels I'm forgiving the aforementioned transgressions and giving this a 5 star rating.

Honestly, I don't normally get excited about skin care tools but this one is an exception and its made me a Nano spray believer. Highly recommend.

I hope you find this review helpful.

My husband recently switched from liquid shampoos to bars and now prefers them. He made the switch after trying several liquid shampoos that not only didn't help his thinning dry hair they irritated his scalp.

Garnier, being a well known brand, I wanted him to try this one and right now its his #2 choice from the 4 he's tried. It hasn't irritated his scalp and he's so far happy with how his thinning, fine hair looks and feels.

Thanks for reading and I hope this review is helpful

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_title: LIGHT AS AIR / STOPS SHADOW CREASING / WORKS WELL ON OLDER SKIN
AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text: OMG am I glad I tried this powder. I'm 70 and my once oily skin is now normal so the addition of HA prompted me to give it a try. Its so finely milled that it goes on light as air and disappears into your foundation. I only use a tiny amount of powder on my T-zone, but with slightly oily eyelids, shadow tends to crease even with primer so I tried it on my lids. After my eye cream and primer, I dusted it lightly over my crease area and applied shadow. My shadow stayed put with O creasing! And, unlike other powders I've tried on my lids, this one didn't enhance my slightly crinkly lids! This one is worth the $$.

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_title: MAY TAKE SOME TIME TO SEE RESULTS ON THIN BABY FINE HAIR
AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text:
I'm on the fence regarding the merits of this conditioner. I have aging [I'm 74] thin baby fine color treated hair with only normal seasonal hair loss. On the first try, I washed my hair using my normal shampoo and applied the conditioner following the directions, leaving it on 3 mins then rinsing it out. After one use, I'm not overly impressed with its ability to add thickness to my strands but it did leave my hair soft and didn't weigh it down.

Its a thick cream with a pleasant odor and on short hair [pixie] a little goes a long way. I plan on using it over the next few weeks hoping eventually it will thicken and volumize my thin hair and encourage growth. If I see a major difference I'll revise this review. The bottom line is that for some, it may be worth trying.

AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_title: MOISTURIZING GIVES LIGHT VEIL OF COLOR WITH A MATTE FINISH
AFNACT4MLU243POBVE666TFVUPGQ.review_text:
This is another interesting Korean skincare product. The description and images leaves the impression that this is a powder product, in reality, the texture is closer to ELF's putty primer. When I applied it to dry bare skin using the puff it pilled slightly, I did get better results blending it with my finger tips. It leaves an overall light green veil of color on bare skin that's not overly noticeable and leaves a matte finish. Don't let the matte finish fool you though, it melts into your skin leaving it moisturized without feeling greasy.

My skin is only slightly sensitive and when irritated doesn't react with major noticeable redness or heat. It did calm the redness I sometimes have around my nose and chin. I've not yet tested this over or under foundation and wonder if it would work well as a primer? More information regarding the benefits, ingredients and use are on the company's site.

AFNAPXQMTWYMFHY5CAGMEFVWQFPQ.review_text:
I have been wanting to try magnetic eyelashes and these were interesting. I think with more practice I could get the hang of it. Also my lids are not tight as they were when I was younger and so it does take a little bit more figuring out with applying the magnetic eyeliner. I used what were the smaller thinnest one and once I get it a little better figured out, I will probably need to trim them towards the center, but I didn't want to do it until I can get better practice to make sure I have it correctly. They definitely do make a difference as you can see with only one on.
On one eye, I had put on a lot more magnetic liner as it was my first one and was trying to figure it out and taking it off was quite difficult. It had said to do two-three layers and I felt that was too much for my eye because I probably had about 3 layers in some sections and I couldn't get it all off at night because my eyelid was starting to get irritated. I used coconut oil and warm/hot water with a facial brush and cotton pads and it was difficult to get the eyeliner off.
Due to the pandemic I don't have many places to go and with all the work it took to do it & get it off, not sure how soon I will do it again. I didn't want to mark it down any further because I am not sure how much different it would be with someone who didn't have saggy eye lids. :)

I was hoping that this would be a little better type of brush and was disappointed in several areas.

Pros:
It is well-made
Comes with a hole that will allow you to hang up
Comes with a clear hook to install and hang up in shower
Like that it has bristles on the sides that are in a curved shape that make it easier to scrub things like elbows and knees.
Cons:
A heavy brush, which I am sure it is due to being two-sided and needs to be a little thicker to allow you to use two sides. I was hoping to use this as a travel brush but it is too heavy to pack.
The shampoo brush has smaller "bristles". I have a shampoo brush that has bigger bristles to help with longer hair. This might work well for someone who has short hair.
I marked it down to 3 stars due to smaller shampoo bristles and the weight. I own other scrub brushes and they are not so heavy.

I had some other socks from another company and the socks were a little tighter and warmer. I am not a fan of having socks or anything on my feet when I sleep because I am a warm/hot sleeper. I like these because they are not super heavy like my other ones. I was able to sleep with these a couple of nights a week. I put moisturizer on my feet and then put them on and they help keep my heels moisturized and not cracking.
I live in a very dry and hot climate and my heels crack easily and then hurt. I was hesitant to get ones like my previous ones because they were so hot but they were pretty old. If I need any more, I am going to get more of this brand.

AFNAPXQMTWYMFHY5CAGMEFVWQFPQ.review_title: Be careful of the purple on your scalp
AFNAPXQMTWYMFHY5CAGMEFVWQFPQ.review_text:
The only thing I will say is that it immediately took out the brassy tone in my hair and has a nice smell.

Cons:
It left my scalp purple. I am not kidding when I say that I rinsed my hair 3 separate times and still found my hair/scalp purple. I don't have a mirror in my shower so I just kept rinsing out leaning over the tub. Finally after the third time, I said forget this and got back in the shower and washed my hair with my regular shampoo and conditioner. I still fee like there is a tiny bit in areas and my whiter blonde has a little purple tint. It was also very dry feeling after the three rinses. My hair felt like straw.
I am not sure if the scalp dying was because I used a shampoo brush and didn't have it immediately rinsed out as I was putting on a face mask. I had accidentally went to put in the conditioner and realized after I put it on the top of my scalp that it was the shampoo and waited till my face mask was done drying a few minutes later to rinse out.
It really was drying even after I used my regular sulfate-free shampoo and conditioner and put in my super moisturizing leave-in conditioner. I might try it again if I have a color that turns out horribly and I need to tone it down. I was just surprised it how much it toned it down and my darker blonde now looks too dark/dull, unless it is still got some purple in it.
So if you use it, I probably would not use a shampoo brush and I would not leave it in at all. Not even the conditioner which says to leave in a few minutes.

I am super happy with these clips. I have so many issues with most hair clips with my long and thin hair and I have none of them with these. I have been searching for a couple of years for ones that will not only hold but not hurt or feel too heavy which will give me a headache. These easily do the trick.
I like the colors - I prefer muted/matte ones and these are perfect. I like that I can do many different hairstyles. I can use it like an 80's banana clips, but it looks even better/fuller. It looked like a very full pony tail. I was also able to put most of my hair on top and keep it up on top and full. In either of these hairstyles it not only kept it up, but it stayed tight and didn't hurt or bother me. I forget it was even up.
I have bought so many clips and NOTHING has worked on my long, thin hair and if you have similar issues with clips, I highly recommend giving these a try.
I I also think it is great for the money. They are not super heavy plastic so not sure how durable they will be long term, but they are around $2.00 per clip and I feel like they should last a little bit. Although, I am planning on ordering more for back-ups, because whenever I find something I like they end up not making them anymore, which is the issue with my last favorite clips. :)

AFNASIJBKRVBVQWUALQCG37I4OTQ.review_text: Everything that came with this product is good. The glue works well and the liner is very pigmented and easy to use. The lashes are so cute and really easy to wear also! Once trimmed to the proper size you can't even tell they are on and I love them so much. Sadly I didn't take any pictures but take my word when I say they are so pretty!

These are the PERFECT natural lash!!! I’ve recently been wearing no makeup except lashes so I’ve been trying to find a good comfortable lash that doesn’t look too over the top since I have no other makeup on and these are definitely it. I highly recommend these if you want something to give you that extra oomph without being too heavy or over the top!

These are so big and fluffy and when I wear them I feel like I could just fly away. If you like big lashes theses are definitely worth the buy! The glue also holds all day with no issues and is actually pretty easy to remove too!

AFNASIJBKRVBVQWUALQCG37I4OTQ.review_title: Super comfy with style options for everyone
AFNASIJBKRVBVQWUALQCG37I4OTQ.review_text: [[VIDEOID:f9d1df0a80f06f3a10c347d143f6bf49]] These exceeded my expectations honestly. They are all so cute and they were so easy to wear! I got so many compliments when I wore these lashes I think they might just be my new favorites. There are so many different style options as well so there’s definitely something for everyone!
These are so long and wispy and almost fairy like to me. They’re super cute and really easy to wear!

AFNBJTD3REIUMVTPE3CV5F4VVGAQ.review_title: Really does make me look and feel younger - I liked it so much that I purchased this pack after using a box of 5
AFNBJTD3REIUMVTPE3CV5F4VVGAQ.review_text:
I originally purchased a single box, and I liked it so much that I purchased this set of three boxes. I have been reviewing different face products for over four months, so my skin has been regularly pampered. However, I noticed a difference as soon as I used my first mask. After three days I could still tell a difference. My pores were (and still are) noticeably smaller. My skin was firmer and, a full hour later, I noticed my fine lines were less pronounced. The inflammation around two problem areas that were popping up on my face cleared up, and I have fewer problems with blemishes if I use the masks on a regular basis. I used three masks, and then I stopped for a month. I used one two nights ago, and I was still astonished at the results. The mask really did make me look and feel younger.

These masks are not reusable, but they aren’t near as expensive as a reusable mask I tried a few months ago. I make sure my face is clean and use a toner or rose water before applying the mask. The one drawback to these masks is you need to lay down and be still for 30 minutes. However, I found that it is a perfect time to catch up on a show while I sat in a recliner. I am keeping my masks in the refrigerator as you are supposed to refrigerate the mask for 20 minutes before using it.

I am 58 years old and have combination skin, as well as some fine creases around my eyes and mouth. The instructions say to use a mask three times a week, but I will probably use one once or twice a week.

AFNBJTD3REIUMVTPE3CV5F4VVGAQ.review_title: 24-year old daughter's skin glows and looks healthier
AFNBJTD3REIUMVTPE3CV5F4VVGAQ.review_text: My 24-year old has been using this moisturizer and Skederm's Shiftage Snail Serum for a little over a month.  She has been raving about the serum, but I think her dramatic results are probably the result of both products together.  Her skin glows and looks healthier.  Her blemishes also cleared up almost immediately.  She is honestly getting compliments about her skin tone.  She has tried several brands of beauty products over the years, but she hasn't gotten results like this before.

I have been using the Hair Lab Conditioner and Shampoo for a few weeks which isn't enough time to see if it works.  However, it performs similar to other hair loss shampoos I've used.  This is a nice conditioner and I love the peppermint oil.  My hair looks and feels nice.
My 24-year old daughter is very happy with this cleanser.  I knew she would like the rose water and aloe.  We both might buy it again.

This is a nice lotion.  It is quickly absorbed and my skin feels silky after I use it.  I like the scent.  It is appealing but not overpowering. This lotion is made in Germany, and I'm thinking of trying their other products.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
Let me start by saying ... I LOVE the look of these tools. The rhinestones inside a clear handle gives them such an attractive and high quality look.

The bristles/brushes are all different sizes, same thickness. Would be nice to have a variety of thickness as well. But they are soft and work great when drawing lines or mostly any design.

The metal part at both ends make them feel sturdy and durable.

My only complain is that the 2nd size dotter (the pink one) is not as soft as the other. It's a bit sharp which does not work when trying to use it, but other than that all good. This is the only reason I give them 4 stars.

I highly recommend this set!!

This is a good mascara. The brush is a little curve so it can help with the application.

My first impression wasn't that good, since the mascara felt so thin that looks like I wasn't really wearing almost anything. It dried so fast that when I tried to apply the second layer, it wouldn't let me because it was already dry and the brush wouldn't run nice and soft through my lashes. However, I added 2-3 drops of castor oil (you can also use almond oil or any other natural oil that you like) and it was a game changer. I instantly felt the brush was running smoothly on my lashes, and was able to apply a second and even third layer with no problem. Lashes looked way better (not to mention they were also being lubricated with the added oil).

Pros:
- Does not smudge
- Easy to remove with makeup remover or even in the shower
- When removed, it comes out in small flakes which is great because it does not leave you with raccoon eyes

Cons:
- Very thin mascara (although this might be a pro for some people)
- Felt a little dry at the beginning but manage to "enhance" it with castor oil (as mentioned above)

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Stylish, nice colors and functional nail files!
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
These nail files are really nice, stylish, colors are super cute and each nail file comes with its own hard case.

Material is soft, curve and sparkling on one side and "rough" on the other side. The nano glass side is gentle enough for your nails.

You can polish, buffer or just trim your nails and will have great results. It is highly recommended to rinse your nail files after each use, warm water (a bit of soap if desire) will do the trick.

The only reason I am giving it 4 stars is because they are too thick that it is difficult to use it when trying to file your nail from the bottom.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Good portable set of spray and pump bottles
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
This is a good set of spray and pump bottles. Full disclosure, they are small: 100ml/3.4 oz for the spray bottle (which is the approved size when using in your carry-on on a plane) and 60 ml/2 oz for the pump bottles.

Pump bottles have a removable lock cap.

My only complain (reason why I am rating 4 stars) is that one of the spray bottles came crushed, but I got 2 other spray bottles in perfect condition. Package was not damage at all, so I am not sure at what point of the delivery process was smashed like that.

Any way besides that, they all work great, totally worth the money!

This nail drill is an excellent choice when doing your nails or re-doing them!
I have used it with gel nail polish and acrylic nails and works wonders.
USB cable only, no adapter included, but you can use any other you already have (~5V needed).
It is really powerful compare to other non-wired I have tried. You can regulate the speed as well. Super easy to operate, on/off switch and rotating button for adjusting the speed.
I like that it comes with all kind of bits, sanding bands and cuticle remover bits which are easy to swap.

This is a good set of gel nail polish. Bottle size is average from other brands I have tried (usually between 6-8 ml), these bottles contain 7.5 ml. Gel is thicker that most brands, which is kind of good and bad at the same time. Good because you can get a great coverage with 2 thin layers. However, it is a little more difficult to apply, especially the white one that is super thick, but you will get a perfect white!

Like any other set that does not come with base and top coat, make sure to get them before trying to use this nail polish on its own. They won't last if not using base and top coat.

Not a fan of bottles that do not include the sticker with the color, just the number, so you either apply it to the bottle and cure them or get some nail watches, cure them and have them handy when choosing colors.

I have not tested the durability of them (it would depend a lot of the quality of your base and top coat and how well you prep your nails). But so far, I am please with the texture and color set.

Nice to have nowadays! Conveniently individually wrapped. They claimed to be unscented refresh, but they do have a slightly non-pleasant scent. Wipes are light beige with tiny brownish dots, nothing wrong with that but just different to the white plain wipes we are used to see everywhere.

Package (both box and each wipe) is nice and high quality. Price seems to be a little high. But given the fact they are all natural (paraben-free, cruelty free, plant-based, aluminum free, etc.) and conveniently individually wrapped in case you need to get one handy in your pocket or pursue and don't have to bother with a hand sanitizer bottle (even the small ones), I think it's worth having them as an emergency. Definitely not for daily use (or several in a day).

I love this set!! Microfiber is the best especially for wavy/curly hair. It helps minimize frizz and it is very absorbent.

I found very useful the turban for whenever I am doing my makeup or I am just at home and don't want to touch my hair to avoid getting tangled or frizzy. I haven't really used it after a shower.

The twist head towel is great for plopping your head for some time after shower. My routine using this has been: right after shower, apply leave-in, curl cream, and plop for 20 min using this twist head towel. After that, I remove the towel, apply gel and diffuse for 15-20 min. Also, I wear it "backwards". I know the button should be at the bottom of the head, but I found using it at the top also works for me.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Slippery than regular liquid hand soaps
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
This liquid hand soap is different from other/regular ones. It feels similar to slime, thinner than regular slime though, but definitely a slippery sensation. It might not be pleasant for all people. I had no problem at all.
1 pump is good enough for thoroughly washing your hands.
It does smells like lemongrass, not too strong, but you can definitely tell it is lemongrass.

Nice wig for cosplay, Halloween costume, or in case you want to totally change your hair for a day!
I don't think this is a daily wig, but it is definitely good quality.
It comes with a mesh to help keeping your hair inside the wig. Also, it has straps to adjust it.
Hair is soft but has a little static, I will be applying some leave-in to help with that.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Good set at a nice price
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
Good set of hair claw clips, 6 in total, 2 of each color blue, gold and kind of cooper. Colors are exactly as pictures in the description, matte finish. 10 hair ties are also included that will not pull your hair.

They are medium size and do grab a good amount of hair which do not slip down the hair.

Plastic feels a little flexible in comparison with other hair clips, which could be a sign of durability.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Different container, soft hair, CGM approved
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
I was a little confused when I got this leave-in because I was expecting a bottle with a pump and instead I got a tub with product all over the place.
This leave-in cream is very runny, fruity scent a little too strong for me. Although after I applied it into my hair, it wasn't that bad.
I have incorporated a few times now into my regular routine (shampoo, conditioner, leave-in, curl cream and gel) and it has worked well so far. Hair feels soft and define. The way I applied it was on damp hair, making sure product was evenly distributed.
One thing to consider when using it, is not to apply too much product on your hair, I used about 2 dime size on all my hair. For thin hair I would recommend half of it, otherwise hair will look very greasy.
Lastly, ingredients are very good for your hair. AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Flexible brush, great for detangling wavy/curly hair!

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Great mascara, great price, environmental friendly company!
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
I absolutely love this mascara, it was easy to apply, no issues with the bristles. It does not flake or smudge. When I removed it, it was very easy, I did not even needed to use makeup remover, I just got one of my reusable pads, got it wet, rubbed my eyes a few times and done.

In addition to the above, it is hypoallergenic and package and overall the ingredients are environmental friendly. This brand does seem to care about what type of ingredients are being used and our planet.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Effective, nice scent, great touch dispenser bottle
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
When I think about nail polish remover, the first thing that comes to my mind is the strong not-so-pleasant acetone scent. However, this nail polish has removed that association. It has a sweet smell that is not strong and somehow pleasant.
I had no issues while removing purple nail polish from my toes. It did not tinted my skin like other acetone based nail polish removers. It also left my toes a little oily, which is also something totally different to what I am used to after removing nail polish because it's usually the opposite.
The touch dispenser bottle is awesome, just push it down and your cotton ball will get wet avoiding spills. I don't want to go back to the regular bottles after this one!!!

Nice soap with a fresh smell. One pump is enough and lathers nicely. It left a nice sensation on my hands after using this soap, not dry at all.
Pump works great, the bottle has a nice design. It contains good ingredients, however I cannot justify the price, I mean $29.95 for 8.45 fl oz?

Great selection of lip liner. Some of the shades are very similar, however that allows me to match almost exactly my current lipsticks.
They run smooth while doing my lips, no scent or flavor at all.
Only reason why I am dropping one star is because the caps do not stay put!! It is so frustrating (almost dropping to 3 stars) to keep looking for the caps only to realized they made a mess inside you makeup bag. I took them all and put them in a pencil holder, otherwise I would have loose my mind by now.

This product is a great option if you want to do the Korean 7-skin method, which consists on cleansing your face and then applying 7 layers of a toner or a lightweight, watery essence to your face and after that moisturize your face. This will help your skin to keep moisturized throughout the day and be radiant and bouncy all day long. I do method once a week and every other day do 3 to 5 layer depending on how I feel/see my skin.

Full Ingredient List:
Sedum Sarmentosum Extract, Butylene Glycol, Water, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glycerin, Glycereth-26, Polyglutamic Acid, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Ceramide NP, Xylitylglucoside, Anhydroxylitol, Xylitol, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Citrus Tangerina Peel Oill, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia Oil, Glucose, Phospholipids, Diethoxyethyl Succinate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer, Hydrogenated Lecithin, C12-13 Pareth-9, Disodium EDTA, Chlorphenesin

I am a big fan of nail wraps because of all the different designs and how easy it is to do your nails. However, I was disappointed with these ones on the 3rd day.

Application was pretty straight forward like many others. Comes with a small nail file and alcohol pad to remove all the oil from your nails. I had to use my own wood stick to push the cuticles back. They looked great on day 1 and 2, however, after that, 2 nails started chipping and one (the ring finger) had a hole on it! Now idea how that happened, I'm not doing anything rough/tough with my hands!

Anyway, they do not peel off however they seem to be very thin that are not durable at all. There is no way these wraps will last 14 days as advertised.

Also, on the instructions, they did not recommend applying a top coat once done, since the supposed to have that top coat already. But it might be worth adding a top coat layer on your own to make them last a couple of extra days.

Each tube comes in a gift box in case you are giving them away. All 4 tubes come sealed.
Size is perfect to keep it in a drawer, in your purse or backpack.
I keep one in my night stand to use it at night since aloe is really good to moisturize and keep hands soft. This way I let the hand cream being absorbed all night and wake up with soft hands.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: One of the best face rollers I have ever tried!!
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
This is now by far my favorite face roller. I have tried quite a few face rollers including materials like rose, and green quartz, stainless steel, regular single rollers and 2 rollers such as this one.
This design in particular is very easy to roll throughout the face. It is not as heavy as a similar design I have but with rose quartz spheres.
Feels cooler for a longer time since it is stainless steel and more importantly, it is not porous which avoids bacteria contamination on your face.
I use this roller almost every night while watching TV, which feels very soothing and relaxing.
Great gift for anyone!

I like having these type of toner pads (anything with cica) for when I start seeing hormonal acne appearing on my cheeks and jaw area. In a matter of 4-5 days I see significant improvement.
Little tweezers are included to grab only the pad to be used and avoid cross-contamination.

These pads contain great ingredients, especially no synthetic fragrance that is very common in tons of skin care products and is high hazard. It also does not have other "bad" ingredients such as parabens or sulfates.

I highly recommend using them consistently to see better results.

Expiration date: 04/14/2024 (~2.5 years from the date received).

This is an awesome product. It is a mix of cold press oils plus other extra ingredients that makes the whole mix very moisturizing. It is great for skin and hair and I will breakdown the reasons for each one.

Skin:
One pump is enough for your face. First time, I tried 2 pumps and it was very oily and took sometime to get absorbed. Since it's greasy, I only use it during my PM routine, to avoid excess of oil during the day and greasy look.
I ran the ingredients through the EWG database and they are all EWG 1, meaning they are low hazard for the skin. There are also no paraben, sulfates, or any other bad ingredients that are high hazard for skin such as fragrance that is a very common and very bad ingredient.

Hair:
I have followed the Curly Girl Method (CGM) for over a year now, which recommends avoiding ingredients that are not too good for scalp and hair such as sulfates, drying alcohols, non-water soluble waxes, parabens and silicones. None of these are included in this product. I have been using this oil as pre-poo, which is basically adding 2 pumps into my scalp and 2 more into my hair (wavy, length half way back) before taking a shower and leaves my hair soft and moisturized.

With the above explanation on ingredients I avoid for my skin and hair, it is difficult to find a product that meet both requirements, but this product does!!

There is no doubt Korean beauty products are the best. These cleansing pads are such a great addition to your night beauty routine.
It comes in a great quality bottle, comes sealed, includes some tweezers to avoid contaminating all other pads.

It has a sweet fresh scent that is very pleasant. One pad is enough to remove makeup, eyes included. Once you are done, it leaves a slightly oily feeling which is absorbed pretty fast. I thought I wouldn't like that feeling since I am not a big fan of greasy feeling on my face. However, this is very light and helps moisturizing the skin.

Regarding the ingredients, I am happy to see it does not contain any synthetic fragrance that is high hazard for the skin and it is a very common ingredient in skin care products. It also contains jojoba oil that is very moisturizing and Centella Asiatica (Cica) that soothes and brighten the skin. Not to mention Eggplant extract that has antioxidants.

The only callout would be to include a way to keep the tweezers attached to the lid, this way you don't have to put them on top of the wipes or keep them outside the closed bottle that could possibly get lost.

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Another great product of Skinesque, although questionable time saver
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
I have mixed emotions about these prep sheet masks. On one hand, this is a skincare brand I like a lot after trying 2 other products from them. They have high standards on their products, as well as in the ingredients used. The actual sheet masks work like charm in prepping the skin. However, I am not exactly sure they are saving me time. Overall I feel they are adding those 3 extra minutes to my routine, which may not sound liek a lot of time, but in the mornings, every minute count! Usually, after cleansing my face, it takes me 1 to 2 minutes applying toner and moisturizing cream, including the time to let each product be absorbed. When using these sheet masks, I have to leave them for 3 minutes and wait about 2 minutes to let the remaining serum be absorbed.

What I absolutely love about this product:
- Comes in a nice container not too big that can easily fit into your sink/beauty area.
- Tweezer are included as well as a place inside the same lid to attach it!
- Scent is absolutely enjoyable, it is a sweet fresh scent that is noticed since you take out the sheet mask. Surprisingly, there are no synthetic fragrances added.

Overall rating:
Presentation: 5
Quality ingredients: 5
Time-saver: 4

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Get the job done, nice scent
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:
I am not a big fan of makeup remover wipes, even less the ones that come individually because they just generate unnecessary trash. I prefer reusable wipes that work just fine with water. However, there are some situations where you will definitely need them in this presentation.

While taking a look at the ingredients, I noticed the second ingredient is "cyclopentasiloxane" which is a silicone, EWG 3 (low high hazard) and was a bit concern since silicones tend to clog pores and are difficult to wash off. However, after a bit more research about this particular silicone, looks like this is a low molecular type of silicone that washes off easily and won't clog pores if it is wash after you use it. So make sure to follow up your regular beauty routine of removing make up and cleanse your face. Haven't had any breakout after using these wipes.

Only reason why dropping one star is the price.

I have tried many many face sheet masks. While I did not notice anything special about these ones while using them, I can still think they are a great option because: 1) They are affordable ($2 per mask) and 2) Ingredients are all safe and clean (more details below).

I have used them at night, right before bed, usually leave them on for 15 minutes. Once I removed them, my skin feels fresh. The following morning, I feel my face moisturized and soft. There is enough serum to apply on the neck and chest area. There is no need to rinse after using them. Great option to use after a facial. It covers pretty well all face. I had to fold the nose area because of a recent nose ring, but it does cover the nose as well.

Regarding the ingredients, I use skincare ingredient analyzers that follow the EWG, which individually rates ingredients from 1 to 10 (lowest to highest hazard). I was impressed to see all ingredients are rated EWG1. Another interesting fact around ingredients is that there are no parabens, sulfates, silicones, alcohols, allergens and fragrances (a very common ingredient that is highly hazard).

Expiration date: 2025 (3 years after received)

AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_title: Paraben on the ingredients? No thanks!
AFNCHMAKUAJOGVCKOA4XGLINHPDQ.review_text:

Overall rating due to broken pump: 4.5 rounding up to 5

Just out of curiosity, after cleansing with the C'est Moi, I did a second once over with a cotton ball soaked in Micellar Water - my face was already completely clean; no makeup had been left on my face at all, but I did feel that there was a slight residue sitting on my skin. I didn't feel squeaky clean like I prefer, which lead me to believe I would be better off rinsing, but that kind of defeats the purpose of a cleansing water, in my opinion. OMFG this brush is amazing! I have 3B style curls and I'm also biracial so my hair is really porous and a bit on the fragile side. In its curly state it's a pain to care for but the traditional blow dry and flat iron method is both tedious and damaging to my hair.

When wet to straight irons came out, I immediately hopped on board because it just made more sense that heating my hair while wet would be less damaging to it. Through this I got hooked lol. But even with that it is a bit tedious.... though it did help me figure out that I could flat iron my hair dry and skip the blow dryer.

My boyfriend has one of these brushes and I tried it as a quick way to straighten my hair in the am. I was SUPER impressed! But it had some design flaws that made me seek my own, and landed me here.

From what I've seen comparing this brush to the more popular Rinfy and his brush, they've reallly improved upon the original design concepts. Most notably, the buttons are on the front of the handle and not the sides, down near the cord instead of anywhere up near the head. This along with the way they're shaped to be concaved makes it highly unlikely they'll be pressed by accident. But even if you do press them by accident, the device automatically locks them about 30s after the temperature is set. If you want to change the temp or turn it off after that, you need to click the power button twice to unlock them.

The teeth are not only steep enough to accommodate my thick hair, but there's also way more of them packed more densely together. This seems to make this brush MUCH quicker at straightening my hair, and it can also get it board straight. The other brushes have only gotten it as close as a little wave.

Since my hair is so thick, I also have to place my hand on the bristles while I pull the brush through so it gets all my hair in it. This is the only model I've tried which hasn't burned me even once while using it so far. The teeth are so densely packed that there is no way for a finger or the side of my hand to slip down past the safety portion of it.

Quick heating? Honestly I don't know why anyone tries to claim that.... I've never seen any heated hair product heat up quickly. My stove doesn't even heat up quickly. I hardly expect my straightening iron or brush to defy the laws of physics so I don't have to wait a few minutes for it to heat up. That's why I turn it on BEFORE I'm ready to use it. 😉

All joking aside though, this really is a fantastic brush. It even FEELS high quality. Nice weight, premium plastics, slick design. It will fit right in with other hair devices no matter how pricey they are.

I'm 30 years old and have been trying to do a lot of preventative skin care (especially since I live in Florida and get quite a bit of sun on my skin on a regular basis). One reason I was drawn to this particular neck firming cream was the royal jelly ingredient. I'm new to learning about the benefits of royal jelly, so for those who haven't hear of it before, royal jelly is a substance secreted by honeybee workers and fed by them to larvae that are being raised as possible queen bees. When used externally, royal jelly increases the skin's moisture and collagen production, which slows the process of getting wrinkles. There are tons of other beneficial oils in this cream, all of which can be found on the ingredients list on the product page.

This neck firming cream is very thick, but absorbs quickly into the skin, and does not leave an oily residue. After washing my face and neck area, I put a dime-sized amount of the cream in my palms and then applied it to my neck, distributing it evenly with circular motions. This cream has a very light and pleasant, almost gingery scent. The reason I am rating this 4 stars instead of 5 si the fact that I did get a few blemishes on my neck after using the cream. I am not sure if this was a result of an ingredient, or my skin just getting used to a new product. I have been suing this for 5 days now. My neck did feel very nourished and moisturized after using this, so I will continue to apply this cream unless more blemishes appear.
