It’s very wobbly but it does it’s job for the most part. It doesn’t create a beautiful ombré

AGCPEDYIF2QXKNLBIOOEKEHJ5V2A.review_text:
“Skincare Travel Bag Included” uh…not really. The travel bag is huge and I definitely won’t use it as a travel bag. It’s 10x the size of the syringe cream. I’m trying to pack light when I travel and the travel bag is bulky. As other reviewers mentioned, the syringe is nice looking and different but not needed. I rather reduce the cost to produce in a jar or tube.

As for the eye cream, it has a nice and refreshing cucumber scent. I like the scent! The eye cream syringe is easy to use. All you have to do is take the cap off and push the plunger to dispense. I use the eye cream for over two weeks and it helps with dark circles and puffiness. I’m sure if I use this longer, I will notice a more subtle change. Great company as it provides 60 days money back guarantee.

The gold collagen eye mask is very nice. It’s clear with gold specks and has a very light fragrant smell. The gold eye mask is packaged well and comes with a small spoon. I like the fact that it’s in a jar and not individually package.

The gold eye mask works well. It doesn’t slip and stays in place while I had it on for 20mins each time. The main reason I use the eye mask is to reduce wrinkles, puffiness and dryness due to aging. My only complaint is I noticed the eye mask dries up quickly.

AGCPEDYIF2QXKNLBIOOEKEHJ5V2A.review_title: Spray on twice a week.  Easy Peasy!
AGCPEDYIF2QXKNLBIOOEKEHJ5V2A.review_text:
The hair growth serum spray arrived in a nice package and the bottle is well made. The spray bottle is also easy to assemble by twisting the spray top on. Per the instructions, you use twice a week on dry or wet hair and you spray directly on the scalp. It was quite easy to use. The serum has a very nice scented smell. It makes my hair smell good. It is not too strong but has a pleasant smell.

After giving birth to my three kids, my hair has thinned out dramatically. It use to be thick and full. I was excited to try this to get my hair back. It hasn’t been a full 3 weeks but I have noticed my hair doesn’t fall out as much when I brush in the morning and after a shower. I spray at night after a shower and noticed my hair had more volume and shine in the morning. I’m excited to see more results.

**The Expiration date printed on the package is 4/2023. Plenty of time to use.

AGCPEDYIF2QXKNLBIOOEKEHJ5V2A.review_title: A multipurpose tub that is collapsible.
AGCPEDYIF2QXKNLBIOOEKEHJ5V2A.review_text: The collapsible foot tub is not only used for soaking your feet. You can use it for so many different things around the house. I use it to wash my windows and it works great. The collapsible feature is great for storage and takes up very little space. The handle is strong and durable to carry water around the house.  I haven’t used it for a foot spa yet but I can’t wait.  It also included two-foot spa accessories.

I’m not a huge fan of face masks. It’s messy and takes too much time. As a mother of three kids, I don’t have a lot of time for myself. The exfoliating scrub and hydrating mask's selling point for me was you only need to keep it on for 2 minutes. I use it during my bath time making it convenient and easy to wash off.

The mask is nice and cooling. It was easy to apply during my bath and rinsing off was easy peasy. The scent was meh! Not a fan of the strong smell. My face felt smooth, soft, and hydrated after application.

AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_title: Be careful with these tools if you dont know how to use them.
AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_text:
Its one of the grossest things in the world, blackheads. But lets face it, some of us women are so fascinated by them! We love to pop and pull and squeeze and get all the gunk out of not only our faces, but our spouses. Eeeewww. Until not long ago I did not realize how much popping pimples is so bad for your skin! Leaves holes and scarring and no wonder I have such big pores... So after learning that I was so excited to try out this Deluxe Premium Blackhead & Blemish Remover Kit by Mac Professional. This set comes with so many different tools its hard to know where to start. There is one tool in particular that is the coolest, though a bit dangerous. It has two heads that screw into each side for safety and can be removed and screwed on the sides, and has a lancet and another head. Its extremely sharp and you must be careful with it, this is a "professional" set so I really don't use more than the ones just to remove blackheads, very nice set, and I love that it comes with a case that has inserts to safely store every piece. I received this product at a discounted rate

Thanks <3

This Lady Passion For Women, Eau De Parfum is supposed to be inspired By Paris Hilton perfume, however i do not have that perfume so I really can not describe the difference. However, I can tell you that this Lady Passion perfume smells nice. It has a very distinct citrus smell, almost grapefruity type smell. Its nice on the nose but not really my favorite kind of scent when I want to wear a perfume. It comes in a very large 3.3 Fl. Oz./100 ml glass bottle that should last you a while, however I did notice that the scent dissipated quite dramatically from me as the day went on and if I wanted to keep the good smell to be continuously noticeable I would have to reapply, but its price is very affordable. It comes with an easy push squirt application nozzle. I received this product at a discounted rate

Thanks <3

At first I did not know if I really liked this Diva Scent For Women, Eau De Parfum, but after a few days of wear it is really starting to grow on me. It is supposed to be inspired by Juicy, however I have not ever tried Juicy before so I cant tell you how close it is unfortunately. I can tell you, however, that it smells very fruity with a milk floral scent. Very sweet and refreshing and very hip for the younger women. Almost like a fruity dryer sheet, but in a good way. It comes in a rectangular clear bottle and the perfume itself is pink and very girly, it even has a pink bow around the spray nozzle. I think this 2.8 Fl. Oz. / 80 ml bottle should last quite a while, and after 3 good sprays in the morning I cold still smell it on my shirt at the end of the night. The only thing I did not like was that the golden cap was on so tight that I actually pulled off the bottom piece when trying to get the lid off, other than that I really like this perfume. I received this product at a discounted rate

Thanks <3

Wow. This Super Star For Women, Eau de Toilette by Watermark Beauty is strong. Not my favorite by far, but lasts well throughout the day. That being said when I spray myself it is so strong I have the need to want to wave away some of the scent it really invades your nostrils. The first whiff is overwhelming of alcohol, and needs some time to disperse to make it smell better. One spray should do just fine, so this 2.7 Fl. Oz. / 80 ml will last for a long time. The bottle is very cute, and the pink liquid in the clear glass makes it look very feminine. It even has a plastic top that looks like crystal, very cute. Inspired By Juicy Couture Perfume, but I cant imagine Juicy would smell like this.Overwhelmingly floral, its okay, but its more like something my grandmother would wear. I received this product at a discounted rate

The biggest issue with all of the colognes by Watermark Beauty is the fact that they do not last strong or long. You need to reapply to make sure you still smell good by the end of the night. That being said this leopard For Men, Eau De Parfum smells amazing. Its very manly and I love the scent of it on my fiance! It reminds me of a water fresh shaving cream or aftershave and is very nice smelling, sort of aspin-like, light and not too strong. The bottle is relatively large and at 3.3 Fl. Oz. / 100 ml even if you have to reapply during the afternoon it should last a while. The bottle is sleek and modern looking with its flat black matte surface. The black clear lid does not snap on well however and comes off easily. The spray pump makes it easy to apply, and its definitely one of my top 5 scents that my fiance owns. I received this product at a discounted rate.

Thanks <3

AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_title: Great smell, I only wish it lasted longer.
AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_text:
This Black Intense For Men is so refreshing. A bit intense when first sprayed on, but very mellow shortly afterwards. It reminds me of a lot of scents that say "refreshing" or "water." I absolutely love the smell. Its not even super manly either and could almost be worn by a woman without much notice. I definitely love this smell on my fiance and I think it is my most favorite of all the polo inspired scents by Watermark Beauty. Of course like most of the other ones my biggest issue is that they not not last all day long. They start puttering out about halfway through the day and will need to be re-applied, and also like most others it comes in a large 3.0 Fl. Oz./ 90 ml bottle, so it should last a while even with a second application every day. It is inspired by Black Cologne but I have not had the chance to smell it so I cant tell you how close they are, nor do I care because this scent is amazing. Recommended! I received this product at a discounted rate

Thanks <3

AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_title: Fit me well even though I am  plus size with a large head.
AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_text:
This ShungHO Hairband Cap Woolen Braiding Knitted Headband is much better quality than I was even expecting. It came in just a clear plastic cover. The braiding and knit of the yarn is very nice, with no frayed or loose hanging ends that I could see. The braiding looks super cute, and would go well with some braided boot socks. It does feel like wool, so it is a bit scratchy but not uncomfortably so. It was thicker than I expected it to be and keeps your head nice and warm. I did notice it seems to ride up on the back of my head a bit which I do not like, but that is no problem of the product, just the nature of the design. It looks a bit strange with your hair down but looks pretty cute with it up in a messy bun. I think I would have liked it a bit more if it was a bit less wide, because it covers so much that it looks a bit strange. I do however, like the fact that it covers pretty much half of my ears as well, to keep them nice and cozy during cold evenings and frosty mornings. Quality product.

~Thanx~

AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_title: Honestly couldnt get it into my routine long enough to see if it truely works.
AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_text:
So far I couldn't get this product in my routine for long enough to see how well it works at all. I don't want to give it a bad review because of my lack of ambition with it, but I don't want to lie and say that its an amazing product either. This Biotin Infused Zenlash Eyelash Growth Serum is definitely easy to use. It comes in a little wrapped bottle similar to a mascara bottle, except the brush looks more like a detail nail polish brush. The idea is simple, you brush it on your lash line everyday and wait and watch. It was a bit hard for me to get my lid closed all the way and brush this one, but I am not one who uses make up much either. If you do use make up it will probably come a lot faster for ya. I did accidentally get a bit in my eye before and I was happy to see, though it doesn't feel good, it didn't irritate me much either. I really wish I could say that I saw a huge transformation, but after only managing to use it for one straight week, I didn't see much difference.

~Thanx~

AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_title: Easy to use and wash out, not for long hair
AGCQR2QLP3XWU64TBYFJCAZWQQKQ.review_text: This product is actually really cool and just as easy to use in real life as it seems like in the pictures. Comes with a silvery tone putty type substance in a little container all you have to do is put your hands in kind of rub it around your hands and then run it through your hair. It was really the easy to do on someone else but takes a little bit more time to do on yourself though if you get some on your skin or ears or wherever you can just take a wet damp towel or a white or something like that and wipe it right off. In the picture that shows you doing it too long hair but I tried it on my long hair and absolutely did not work I could not pull a comb through it and it was hard and strange and it definitely works better on men's hair that is short. When it was dry it got kind of hard like a gel or something like that. It's really easy to make it look nice you just have to continue working it through the hair until you get the desired color and style that you want. We tried it on a beard as well and it didn't look as good on the beard it kind of looked better on the medium to short hair but not super super short like a beard. We even used it and my boyfriend's hair who is African-American and it came out pretty cool. Kind of makes you look like you have silver gray hair. It was really easy to wash out renting it out just with water gets a lot of it off but a little bit of shampoo get it out in just a second. I don't recommend going to bed with this in your hair as it will leave silver glimmery stuff on your pillowcase to make sure you wash before going to sleep or laying down on anything.

I hadn't had much experience with waxing, however I have tried wax pearls before and that definitely wasn't working for me, and though I usually just stick with good old fashioned razors but I thought I would try these easy to use wax strips. They are pretty easy to use too! The instructions are on the back of the box and they even have pictures for you to follow. To heat up the wax strips all you have to do is use your hands and rub them and the heat from your body allows the wax to warm up enough for you to pull the paper apart. You simply stick the wax strips on the area that you want the hair removal. It didn't really say how long you should leave it on before removing it but I feel like it needs to cool a bit to get a bit harder before you pull it off. One of my issues is that I didn't feel like it pulled off all the hair that I wanted to be gone within that area that I put the strip. If I am going to go through some pain for this hair removal I don't want to have to do it multiple times on the same area of skin. To finish up you are supposed to open the post cleaning wipes, however they left my skin oily and feeling kind of greasy and I didn't like those. I preferred to finish up with some of my own CBD lotion. Overall I think it worked, but not well enough for my liking.

AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_text: the color of this make is so unreal I couldnt believe it. the price was good so I ordered it, I went back and looked at all of the shades and none of them look real also really light I am a light blonde and I still looked like the bride of frankenstien not worth the money to send back they need to fix the colors to human shades the mineral veil is nice will buy again sorry
Feels very nice , the scent is a bit earthy which I much prefer to perfumy

So far I havent seen a change. Sometimes I feel rush when ask for a review for skin or haircare. Takes time to see growth or reduced wrinkles. Please dont rush us . If I see results in the future I will edit my review. Thanks

AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_title: Covers and  colors thinning and greying hair
AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_text: I like this product a lot.  Good color and blends right into my hair. It even colors my greys ,it rubs color into them that was a surprise to me . Ive had an inch of grey and when Ive been hiding a bald spot or thinning spots it just deposits color right into my hair. Woohoo . these products are a little itchy when they get on your scalp.

AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_title: Fine mist out of pretty bottle
AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_text:
I'm replacing all my pump and spray bottles with these beautiful cobalt blue
glass bottles. The sprayer version is easy to hold and spray. The sprayer is top notch even better than I was expecting . I filled one with my zero odor and I get a great fine mist . No drips or wet floor. I took the sticker off the plastic bottle and put it on my glass bottle. It came with a chalkboard type label, but I wanted my lable on this one.

AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_title: Needs a different sprayer that works
AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_text: Ive been ordering glass bottles and moving my products into them. I get refill size and transfer.  These 2 spray bottles were a little thinne not bad, but still sturdy enough and the spray top where the sprayer is spins loosely 360 degrees.  ?? I just filled it with my gallon of orange cleaner and I had to take off the sprayer and toss it in the garbage!  The flaw is the spinning sprayer that allowed my expensive orange cleaner to pour out of the top all around the nozzle.  cheaply made  but all in all a good glass bottle with a terrible srayer . If you just need a bottle with a screw top your good. If you have a different sprayer you can take off a plastic bottle great. Thats what I did. I took the label off my orange cleaner and stuck it on this bottle and it looks so nice. So my sprayer and label made a great usable bottle.

AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_title: It's  rechargeable , gently dries and curls lashes
AGCSHYPXXTY5BUYD2JAVVJWVFX3Q.review_text: I love that this handy dandy eyelash dryer is rechargeable. So when I received this I was sceptical.  So I put my mascara on put this at the base of my lash and turned it on while pushing my eyelash up gently.  Warm air gently dried them curled up. It shut off when finished.  No hard squeeze with an eyelash curler needed ! This tool gently does the job. I love this tool. Easy to hold and use.

This is a very nice case, as you can see in the picture it holds  full size items. I haven't decided what all I want to put in it but when I do it holds plenty. It could be used for different purposes.

This face mask didnt work like what I see in demonstrations on YouTube. It work but much more slowly. It burned
around the sides of my nose down by my mouth and after a couple of days made scabby tissue ,it was pretty raw. I guess I have sensitive skin. I can use it but will avoid this super tender area. It worked to lighten the top of the nose blackheads. I definitely think 2 times a week is the max for using to avoid my issue.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Works quickly and effectively, but is overpriced.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: This nail polish remover works very well. It quickly and completely removes nail polish from fingernails and toenails. It’s nice that they included vitamin E and panthenol in the formula. However, I always wash my hands and feet after using nail polish remover, so I don’t think the added panthenol and vitamin E stay on long enough to provide any significant benefits. This product works well enough to deserve 5 stars, but I detracted a star because of the retail cost. There are more affordable nail polish removers that work just as well as this does. The additions of panthenol and vitamin E do not justify the high retail price.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Absorbs quickly and improves the look and feel of skin’s surface.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: This serum comes in a thick glass bottle and a convenient dropper that makes it easy to apply. The color looks cloudy so I shake it up before each use. It has a thin and watery gel-like texture that is easy to spread evenly over my face. It absorbs quickly into my skin and does not feel sticky nor uncomfortable. It has a sweet scent that is not overpowering. This serum makes my skin looking and feeling smoother than before.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Hydrating face oil for soft and smooth skin.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: This face oil makes my skin feel smooth and soft. It applies easily and does not feel too heavy nor greasy. This softens the appearance of the lines on my forehead and around my mouth, making them less pronounced. This has a very light and pleasant scent.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Water based mask that does not dry on skin.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: This is unlike any clay mask that I have ever used before. This product is water based and does not dry on my skin like most clay masks do. After I apply this to my face and leave it on for about 15 minutes, it still feels moist and slick when I go to rinse it off. The texture of this mask is more gel-like than it is clay. It feels lightweight and does not leave my skin feeling too dry and tight. This mask is effective enough for use during the winter, when my skin tends to be more dry. The product packaging looks attractive, but I wonder if they intentionally misspelled the word “moisturizing” as “moistorizing”.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Luxuriously creamy lather that cleans and removes makeup.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: This is one of my favorite facial cleansers. I love how this lathers into a rich and creamy foam. This does an excellent job of cleaning my skin. It completely removes makeup, including mascara. This cleanser leaves my skin looking clean and feeling soft and smooth.

Despite the high price for such a small amount of product you get, this mud mask really does work wonders for my skin. This mask is easy to apply. After spreading this over my entire face, I leave it on for 30 minutes before wiping it off with a wet washcloth. This mask leaves my skin feeling baby soft.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Works best when removed before it completely dries.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: This clay mask is nice because it is sheer enough so that it doesn’t harden and become too stiff and uncomfortable. It is lightly scented with a clean fragrance that smells pleasant when applying this to my face. The directions state to leave on for 5-10 minutes, and then to rinse it off before it is completely dry. I have noticed that if I do leave this mask on long enough for it to completely dry, it develops an unpleasant scent that smells like sulfur  when I go to remove it.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Blends to match medium to fair skin tones.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: I use this CC cream as my foundation makeup on days when I want to quickly and effortlessly enhance my complexion and blur imperfections. It dispenses from the tube as a gray color, but the formula contains encapsulated pigments that change color on contact with skin. After applying this to my face, the cream takes on a beige shade that blends well with my skin tone. At first, I thought it would be too orange for my fair skin, but the color really does adjust itself. This CC cream provides light coverage. I use a moisturizer under this because it does make my face feel a little dry.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Lightweight, comfortable, and doesn’t look fake.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: These hair extensions are lightweight and comfortable enough to wear for an entire day. I have brown hair with blonde highlights. I ordered these in the Ombré Chocolate Brown to Caramel Blonde color. This color matches my hair perfectly. These extensions make my hair look fuller and longer. I like how realistic and natural these look.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: High quality hand lotion that smells good and comes packaged for gifting.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Good quality and price for anyone learning to braid hair.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Gender neutral skin care set that is suitable for moms and babies.

AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Gorgeous and comfortable butterfly hair clips.
AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_text: My daughter and I cannot get over how pretty these butterfly hair clips are. My daughter loves to wear all 12 in her hair, at the same time. AGCV6N4LVTEQVYSE3LXR3J2QB3EA.review_title: Large and sparkly unicorn hair clips.

AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_title: orgasmic-like bliss -- Laura's best scent yet
AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_text:
A delectable, delicious, sexy-yet-sweet scent. It has a soft, powdery quality that is evenly tempered by equal hits of sensual amber and smoky vanilla. Not boozy at all, and not frostingly heavy either.

For those who thought LM's other vanilla scents too were cloying and a diabetic sugar nightmare, (yeah, i'm looking at *you*, Creme Brulee) I highly recommend Ambre Vanille as a more grown-up substitute. It's a more chic, sophisticated fragrance that never veers to teeny bopper territory yet will leave suitors mouthwateringly longing for your sillage to return. It would be the perfect layering product for Histoire des Parfum's Ambre 114.

If you loved LM's pistachio body souffle, you will love this as well.
The best part about her souffles is that they last as long as an edp. i used it as a hand cream and i can't stop sniffing myself. I'm in love...

AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_title: A beauty industry expert's professional opinion
AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_text:
Not all Obagi products are made at the same place -- but i found out that this formula is made by one of the top skincare labs in the US--one that manufactures high-end dermatologist and clinical skincare brands on the market today. So knowing this, i knew there would be *some* efficacy to this product. I actually LIKE that ingredients are straightforward and not full of fluff:

Water (Aqua), Dipropylene Glycol, Ethoxydiglycol, Caffeine, Malonic Acid, Zinc Carbonate, Arginine, Laureth-9, Copper Carbonate Hydroxide, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin

To be honest--if you're looking to reduce eye puffiness and dark circles, this won't do much. If found no visible evidence of that in my use. BUT--it's really good at minimizing fine lines, plumping up the skin, and returning elasticity to the skin. That's why it's called "Elasti-derm", to help coax the skin into being more hydrated, refined, and pliant, thus reducing the signs of lines. Obagi's main active to do that is malonic acid, and I give a big thumbs up to the addition of arginine-- a powerful delivery vehicle to help drive the malonic acid further into the skin for more efficacy. As many in the skincare industry know, anything with arginine helps make the active ingredient even more "active".

The stainless steel ball is not just a "feel good" gimmick -- it actually helps to massage this serum into the delicate eye skin, further pushing the ingredients into the dermis. After using an entire bottle of this product, i definitely experienced a reduction in the signs of my fine lines. the skin was plumped up and the lines less visible, plus the texture more refined. Used in conjunction with a good eye cream and alternating with Vitamin C serum, this is a great addition to any anti-aging regimen. I would surely purchase again.

I take off one star because I do not like the plastic packaging, as glass is the safest material for stability, and plastic has a tendency to shorten the shelf life of a formula. Plus plastics are not as safe we think.

AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_title: Cue the squeals of delight: rose-shaped cleansing foam is basic, but big on the cute factor
AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_text:
OK first of all, I did not pay an outrageous price for this. Only $16 usd at a Hong Kong drugstore chain called Mannings. This foam is pure visual pleasure -- shake the pressurized can, and press down on the sides to expel a rose-shaped dollop of cleansing foam. Cue the squeals of delight and instagram envy from beauty junkies.

The foam itself does not remove makeup -- you'll still have to use a cleansing oil first. It's more of a 2nd step cleanser in your dual cleansing routine. If it were not in the shape of a rose, i highly doubt re-buying this --the performance is quite ordinary/basic. But the ROSE! adorable.

For me, the visual gimmick wore off after a while, and I found myself using a normal cleansing foam in a tube, as it was faster and easier than using two hands to pump out the rose each time. Fun to experience one time, but not a re-buy for me.

AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_title: A more affordable version of Bliss' Lemon + Sage Body Butter
AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_text:
FACT: The founder of Bliss is *also* is the founder of Soap and Glory, so it makes sense to replicate the success of Bliss' Lemon & Sage Body Butter with this *verrrry* similar-smelling body cream. Despite the name, Orangeasm doesn't smell like oranges--- it's fragranced with Bergamot and Lemon (the description states "green mandarins" for those not-in-the-know, to indicate that it's not a juicy or sweet scent -- but more rindy and zesty type. Refreshing and energizing, unisex, and a near-scent-twin for Lemon & Sage. The texture smooths and absorbs just like Bliss', and rapidly soaks in to hydrate without leaving any greasy trace. A definitively more reasonably-priced version of a bodycare classic.

Ingredients: Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Butyrospermum parkii (Shea) butter, Cetearyl alcohol, Glyceryl stearate, PEG-100 stearate, Vitis vinifera (Grape) seed oil, Prunus amygdalus dulcis (Sweet almond) oil, Mangifera indica (mango) seed butter, Theobroma cacao (Cocoa) seed butter, Dimethicone, Olea europaea (Olive) fruit oil, Phenoxyethanol, Dipropylene glycol, Limonene, Parfum (Fragrance), Caprylyl glycol, Sodium polyacrylate, Carbomer, PPG-20 methyl glucose ether, Citrus limon (Lemon) peel oil, Ethylhexylglycerin, Menthyl lactate,Xanthan gum, Tocopheryl acetate, Mica, Potassium hydroxide, BHT, Butylene glycol, Panax ginseng root extract, Citrus reticulata (Tangerine) peel oil, Linalool, Camellia oleifera leaf extract, Citral, Tetrasodium EDTA, Pogostemon cablin oil, Alpha-isomethyl ionone, Citrus aurantium amara (Bitter Orange) leaf/twig oil, Glyceryl acrylate/acrylic acid copolymer,Citrus aurantium dulcis peel extract, Schinus terebinthifolius seed extract, Polyester-3, Gelatin, Acacia senegal gum, Citrus aurantium dulcis (Orange) peel oil, Pelargonium graveolens flower oil, Gynostemma pentaphyllum leaf extract, Benzoic acid, Sodium benzoate, Potassium sorbate, Denatonium benzoate, Dehydroacetic acid, Lavandula angustifolia (Lavender) oil, CI 77891 (Titanium dioxide), CI 19140 (Yellow 5), CI 45370 (Orange 5), CI 16035 (Red 40).

AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_title: high coverage, invisibly lightweight feel, long-wearing
AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_text:
The key points of this foundation:

-A thin, weightless, almost invisible veil that doesn't suffocate skin
-High coverage in a few drops
-Extra Long-wearing due to volatile carriers (i.e. like a L'Oreal infallible)

Because it's so thin, it doesn't have a lot of hydration so if your skin is extra dry, be sure to prime and moisturize first.
However it provides flawless, high coverage to mask all blemishes and discolorations. Long-wearing even in high humidity.

The only thing i don't like is that you have to shake it before use, which is a small qualm. It comes in a dropper style GLASS bottle (not plastic!).

AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_title: Comparison vs. SKII Facial Treatment Essence
AGCXLRMTTQO4VGIB3RWMXECECWTQ.review_text:
The AMAZING thing about this 'miracle water'? it actually doesn't bead up like water on your skin, but SINKS in and ABSORBS into your pores, what we in the beauty industry call "high skin affinity". Your skin just DRINKS it up. You use it as the first step after cleansing and toning -- this mineral rich, fermented water will act as your "reservoir" BEFORE you pile on the serums and creams, locking in all the hydration so that the essence stays in your skin and doesn't escape.

I have gone thru 5 full-size bottles of SKII over the years and every time i use it, my skin feels rougher and rougher and the hydration level doesn't seem to go up. This doesn't happen with Cremorlab. Moreover, Cremorlab's essence absorbs better than SKII. (SKII can bead up slightly, so you have to work harder at pressing it into your skin). Both SKII and Cremorlab have fermented extracts and good-for-you water-based ingredients; however SKII costs $100 and Cremorlab only is $40 -- and i like Cremorlab's performance more.

AGDYFDP4Q23S6M3U2W3QS5KBDROQ.review_title: Sampler set is a great way to try English Laundry.
AGDYFDP4Q23S6M3U2W3QS5KBDROQ.review_text:
There are four bottles included in this nicely packaged set. The set comes in a dark brown "textured" heavy cardboard box, wrapped in a clear plastic sleeve. I mention the specifics of the packaging, because the pretty packaging makes it gift-ready. (Just add a bow or a ribbon, a name tag, and you're done!)

Despite the fact that I'm calling this a "sampler set" the 20 ml bottles are good size. (Not tiny little things.) There's plenty of product to use each fragrance for awhile. (You can really get to know the aromas this way. It's not a one-and-done type of sampler.)

All four fragrances are pleasant, clean, and crisp. My partner likes Oxford Bleu and Riviera the most. He says these have a "fresh" smell to him. (I agree!. The Oxford Bleu is my favorite.)

If you're not familiar with English Laundry scents, this set is a great way to try several of their offerings. If you already love English Laundry, here's a chance to enjoy some of your favorites.

This manicure set comes boxed, and tightly wrapped in plastic. It seems like you get a lot with this little set. The implements include scissors, 2 pair of nail clippers, a file, etc.

All the implements are rather "lightweight", meaning just that. They don't feel like heavy-duty metal. And maybe it's because of the light weight, but they don't seem especially sharp. They do an okay job clipping the nails, but just okay.

Still, you get 7 tools for just over $7 dollars, so if you want just a basic manicure set, or something to travel with, this set will be good enough for that.

I've tried many brands of purple shampoos/conditioners in the never-ending battle against brassy tones.
This is one of the better brands.

First of all, I love the scent. It is vaguely floral, definitely a feminine scent. It smells wonderful in the shower, but I like the fact that it fades quickly once you rinse it away. It doesn't linger all day, meaning it won't compete with any other fragrance you are wearing.

Second, I like the fact that this set is gentle, and non-drying. (Some other brands have left me with straw-like hair after a few uses.) This combo cleans gently, and leaves the hair feeling silky.

Third, the toning is effective. There is a visible difference after just a couple of uses. I saw the yellow/orange tones had faded after the first use, and after the second, my hair was shiny and showed highlights, but there was a marked difference in the amount of brassiness.

Fourth, I like the fact that the shampoo is natural (made with botanicals) and is sulfate and paraben free. It is also cruelty free, another big plus. The pump bottles are also great, making the shampoo and conditioner easy to use in the shower. They are plastic, so no breakage issues.

Finally, the price is right. The shampoo and conditioner bottles each contain 16.9 fl. oz of product. A good buy.

Bottom line, this is a solid 5 star set. Recommended!

AGDYFDP4Q23S6M3U2W3QS5KBDROQ.review_title: A Thick and Rich Eye Cream.
AGDYFDP4Q23S6M3U2W3QS5KBDROQ.review_text:
EDITED REVIEW as of 9/25/21.

I came back to edit this review and to lower my rating from 4 stars to 3 stars. Here's why:

After a few weeks of using this cream, I started to develop some sensitivity to it. When I say sensitivity, here's what I mean: 1) The scent bothered me more than it did when I first used the cream. In fact, I started to sneeze most evening after applying it. 2) I'd used the cream on other areas of my face, and noticed minor breakouts in those areas.

Basically, I think the cream was just too oily for my skin. Even around the eye area, which has virtually no oil glands, the non-absorbency of the cream left me feeling sticky and greasy even though I gave the cream plenty of time to absorb.

End of Edit.

***************************************************************************************************************************

Everything else I said in my original review still stands. But the above edit may help you decide if this is the right eye cream for you.

If you're looking for a natural, plant-based eye cream that is ultra-thick and rich, you'll find it in this 2 oz. jar.

The jar will last a VERY long time, because you only need a tiny amount of this cream to cover the undereye area and the corners where crows feet form.

I'd advise putting the cream on a couple of hours before bed, since it takes quite a while to absorb into the skin. (If you don't wait, you'll end up depositing most of the cream on your pillowcase.)

I've also used a small amount of this cream on other areas of my face (nose to mouth lines) and the results were the same as around my eye area.

So what were the results? The skin around my eye area looked smoother and brighter after one night of use.
The results on other parts of my face were less noticeable, but I believe continued use of the cream will improve the results in both the eye area and on the face.

I'm rating the cream 4 stars instead of 5, because of one major issue I have with it, which is: THE SCENT.
The cream has a rather strong minty (?), menthol (?) medicinal smell that takes some time to fade away.
Since I prefer NO SCENT in eye/facial products, I deducted one star from my rating.

That aside, if scented products don't bother you, and you want a thick, rich eye cream you will probably enjoy using this one.

AGEAJ3SCOEQVBB6CZ2L3VOSZNR6Q.review_title: My skin feels good - not greasy. It's easy to dispense from the bottle. And 2 compliments from friends after using it for 1 week
AGEAJ3SCOEQVBB6CZ2L3VOSZNR6Q.review_text:
I bought this to begin (and win!) the fight against the wrinkles that are appearing around my eyes (crow's feet). I guess the best solution is not to laugh, but then what fun would life be...

What is Hyaluronic acid? According to WebMD, "Hyaluronic acid works by acting as a cushion and lubricant in the joints and other tissues. In addition, it might affect the way the body responds to injury."

(+) Does it work? I've used the Hyaluronic serum every night for a week now. Not sure if I can say 100% that I have noticed no fine lines around my eyes, but I've had 2 friends remark that my skin is looking great. As we women know, that's a good endorsement right there.

(+) Texture: As you can see in the photo, the Derma-nu serum is a clear, slightly viscous consistency that goes on clear. You can feel it on your skin for quite a few minutes afterwards. It does NOT leave your skin feeling greasy (big pet peeve of mine) when you wake up in the morning.

(+) Smell: This is not a scented beauty product. There is a very slight almost medicinal scent - that's the best way to describe it. It is not unpleasant, it is extremely mild, but it smells like it has some ingredients that 'have a purpose', vs. beauty products that have fragrances added.

(+) Packaging and ease of use: The pump is well made - it dispenses a small amount of serum, which I am finding is enough for applying to the corners of both eyes. I'm having to "prime" the pump about 2-3 times before it dispenses the serum, so be careful, you don't want to double pump the serum unless you are OK putting possibly 2x the amount on your face than you might have intended.

(+) A little goes a long way. I travel a lot, so the compact bottle and efficient dispensing from the pump are bonuses for me.

(/) Organic. The bottle indicates that 72% of the ingredients are organic. It doesn't clarify which of the ingredients are/are not organic. It would be nice to see this get to 100%.

Bottom line: So far, my skin has felt good, I've had a few compliments, and I'm pleased with the way Derma-nu packaged the Hyaluronic serum so that it is easy to dispense.

I have many Majestic Pure products (from skin care products, to hair care, to essential oils), and have always been very satisfied. I am also pleased with the retinol cream. Having very sensitive skin, I tend to use products containing retinol quite sparingly (aka, every few days, vs. daily) as they tend to cause my skin to become quite irritated or scaly after a few days of daily use. I’ve been using this around just my eyes every evening (about 1 hour after applying a hyaluronic acid serum), as my skin is so sensitive that using anything with retinol on my entire face seems to really cause a lot of scaliness. And, this is where the fine lines are really beginning to show.

The results – after using a cream with retinol in combination with hyaluronic acid serum for 3 weeks, I’ve been noticing a definite reduction in the fine lines. They are still there but they were becoming really noticeable.

The cream has ingredients that are highly moisturizing (again, which I like to follow up on a serum with). The consistency is pretty thin (not thick and creamy like a lotion), and there is no noticeable fragrance. It seems to absorb quickly and is not oily.

Some note on the ingredients:

Retinol 2.5% - Retinol is another name for Vitamin A, which is an antioxidant (helps reverse the damage caused by free radicals, apparent in wrinkles and aging), encourages the production of collagen, and elastin.
Jojoba Oil - closely resembles sebum (a waxy substance produced by our skin glands), packed with vitamins and minerals - Vitamin E, B, copper, zinc, selenium, iodine and chromium.
Green Tea - Tea is high in anti-oxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, whether ingested or applied topically. Green tea contains tannins which can reduce puffiness and inflammation of the skin. It also contains polyphenols, which can combat free radicals (which contribute to aging). The catechins in tea can combat the bacteria that contribute to acne.
Propolis - Propolis, “bee glue or bee penicillin” is the resinous material gathered by honeybees from flowers and leaf buds of various plants. It contains dozens of anti-oxidants,
Shea Butter - The moisturizers in shea butter are similar to those produced by the skin’s sebaceous glands, making it one of the best choices for super-dry or cracked skin. Shea butter also contains anti-inflammatory compounds – great for applying to inflamed or irritated skin (think eczema, chapped skin, bug bites)
Vitamin B5 - A humectant (a water-binding substance that attracts and retains water). Particularly good for the skin as it stabilizes the skin barrier, increasing hydration and improving softness and elasticity.
Vitamin E - A powerful antioxidant, that neutralizes the oxidant effect of free radicals, which are molecules that damage collagen and cause skin dryness, fine lines and wrinkles

*I received the retinol cream for evaluation and review

AGEAJ3SCOEQVBB6CZ2L3VOSZNR6Q.review_title: enjoying this - great in tandem with a thick skin cream
AGEAJ3SCOEQVBB6CZ2L3VOSZNR6Q.review_text:
My mother asked me to find her a moisturizer with matrixxyl and peptides. Very specific and she didn’t want anything that did not have at least those two ingredients.

The reason is a conversation with her dermatologist. Matrixxyl is made of 2 peptides, palmitoyl-tripeptide and palmitoyl-oligopeptide, which stimulate collagen and elastin production in the skin. And peptides form a long chain of amino acids to become proteins, penetrating the top layer of skin cells and signaling the cells including collagen.

The Cazbe serum works really nicely in tandem with my mom’s Ponds cream (she has used Ponds as long as I remember). The serum absorbs pretty rapidly and unlike other serums, doesn’t seem to leave her skin feeling sort of ‘tight’ or dry. After a few minutes (she will put the serum on before brushing her teeth, and then follow with moisturizer after teeth), she will apply the Ponds cream to completely moisturize her face. I’ve tried this a few times and find I can only really use it around my eyes – it dries out my cheeks and chin. If used just around my eyes, it feels a lot better.

Her skin is looking beautiful. I think in combination with a really solid cream to sort of ‘seal in’ the benefits, after washing your face, and just before bed, it’s a great part of your beauty routine.

* we received the serum for evaluation and review

Lavender is my #1 go-to essential oil. I think I use it in 90% of my blends, whether in the diffuser or in topical blends (or sprays, etc). The only thing I definitely don’t use it for is my home-made cleaning products where citrus oils are the only essential oils.

I love blending lavender in particular with chamomile, as it has an almost instantaneous calming effect. Also love to blend it with bergamot, ylang ylang, mandarin, and a drop of lime.

The bottle is very large, a dark brown color to protect the oil from UV rays which can damage the oils and decrease the shelf life. My favorite way to dispense oils is with the eye dropper (the euro droppers found in smaller bottles tend to gush several drops at once, so that’s definitely not my preference) – you can really control how many drops you dispense with these eye droppers.

Arrived well protected in bubble wrap and there was no leaks.

I absolutely love this Calendula soap with coconut oil. The scent is so light. The bar is relatively small. My skin feels so good and refreshed when I use this soap. My skin tends to be dry and this soap works so well for me. Love it.

Love these Tirtyl soap sheets. Of the many necessities I carry in my purse I love to have the soap sheets. Often when I am out and about there is no soap in the bathrooms. These soap sheets really fill the bill. The sheets are all scented and lovely but I really love the jasmine and patchouli. What a delightful scent. AGF5D2UWW67AXTL7L5XCRO67FR7A.review_title: Very Soft!  Small bundles. Get two for med to big size head. 1 pack os enough for small heads.
AGF5D2UWW67AXTL7L5XCRO67FR7A.review_text:
I received this shipment with In 2 days because of Prime Membership. When I first open the package, it appeared small to me. This has got to be the smallest I ever received. I assume that it was the way they packaged it. I was wrong. The bundles are small. Appear more when separated. I have a small head, so this 6 pack was barely enough for a nice full head. 1 order gives you 6 small packs. It is very soft hair though.

Edit:
So I bought A second pack. Look like you will have to buy 2 for a full head for any one with med to big head. Especially if you have a large head. If you are looking for a heat resistant hair to recurl, or straightened, this product is not for you. Lowest temperature I tried do far was 180. It burns/melt easily. Stick with the hot water (like other synthetics.) Other than that, it is a bit soft without having to do anything to it. Like other synthetics, it does frizz over time. No smells and it does go past the ears, touching the side of my jaw/tips touch shoulder.

All in all, nothing remarkable

This is very nice. I was hoping it would be more of a two tone than a mix. I wanted 1b ombre to 30. But it is a mix brown and black at the top making it appear brown instead. However, I do love the waves. It is gorgeous. The hair texture is softer than I expected. A huge plus. I dont like how much it sheds though.

I still like how soft it is when I seperate The strands. Seems pretty consistent.  Exactly as descriped. My favorite part is the black color of the hair is actually black. Not a mix color of brown. I had no problems with the hair. It does frizz but I make it look more natural. I do like sperating the strand to have a fluffy look. However after the 1 week of wearing, it started to go back to it original tight curls. I either leave it or I seperate them again.

AGF5D2UWW67AXTL7L5XCRO67FR7A.review_title: Beautiful color but the wig won't last long.
AGF5D2UWW67AXTL7L5XCRO67FR7A.review_text:
I love the color of this wig. It felt very soft when I first got it. I wore and took care of it for 2 weeks to see how long it can last with care and test out the limits.

If you are looking for a wig to wear one time or maybe twice, then this the wig for you.
This wig barely made it past 6 hours of wearing it. It feels great but the hair tangles EASILY.
I had to detangle this wig every day after wearing it. At the end of the 5th day I had to wear it in the pony tail to hide the tangles. Then it just got worst.

This hair is not made for pony tails or an up do. It AUTOMATICALLY TANGLES. It is the worst.

It had no cumb inside the wig to attach. It only have the head band in the back to tightens it and to keep it in place.

The cap is not that breatheable! I would not advise wearing this wig all day.

The color was beautiful and the texture of the hair is so soft and smooth that it was so feathery. At least it look like real hair. Again this wig is for a 1 time only or 2 time wear.

The item was poorly packaged. I do not believe I had gotten all 45 pieces. The container it came in was also cracked and perhaps thats why the bead all fell out?

Other than that, I did enjoy wearing them. Hieveer the gold did change colors after a while of wear. It ended up looking like the brass colored bead. The silver stayed silver.

These beads are not for thin braids. Perfect for meduim and large braids. I wore them with thick Senegalese braids.

They are very sturdy. These metal will not break anytime soon. They may can crack a tooth if you're swinging your hair and have it hit your face.

Sturdy can because of the thickness. It isnt too thick though. Average. They do have spaces between the designs wear hair can be seen through.

If It was not for the poor packaging and quick change of color of the gold beads, this reveiw would have been rated higher.

AGF67GHUIMKCVTWDMJ5KN74X6MMA.review_text: I don't like the sponge on one side, its hard to rinse out and could habe more texture on the rough side. Was also to short. I have limited range of motion in my arms so this would be better if was 6-8 inches longer.
Soft against the skin, stays put without needing to tuck the mask in clips. Wish it had a deeper nose part but still overall very nice. I use it with all types of masks from cloth to disposable.

AGF67GHUIMKCVTWDMJ5KN74X6MMA.review_title: Easy to use clean and wear!
AGF67GHUIMKCVTWDMJ5KN74X6MMA.review_text: Sits over the nose enough to take the pressure off a mask pushing on the tip. Easy to talk, nothing touches your mouth. Much easier to breathe without affecting the mask itself. Works with cloth and disposable masks.
