AGF67GHUIMKCVTWDMJ5KN74X6MMA.review_text: They have a very odd nail bed shape two oblong and look extremely cheap even for fake nails

AGF6TCJ5DIUYHXKWWLFKAY2HUIXQ.review_text:
So excited for my daughter to wear these for her first trip to Disney! 8months old and they look adorable on her! Fits great!

UPDATE - my daughter wore these to Disney World and we received SO many compliments on them. I actually prefer these for her age over the overpriced options at the park.

AGF6TCJ5DIUYHXKWWLFKAY2HUIXQ.review_title: Great product, face stays looking fresh all day
AGF6TCJ5DIUYHXKWWLFKAY2HUIXQ.review_text: I am typically low maintenance with make up but wanted to try this product as I live in the sweltering heat of south Florida year round. First thing I noticed is this is a very nice sized bottle, almost as big as a standard can of hairspray.  I have been using this product for a week now and have definitely noticed a difference. My pores are less noticeable and my makeup lasts much longer than without the product. My face looks and feels smooth all day.  It’s so easy to use too!  All you have to do is shake it up and spray your face several times before applying makeup.  I haven’t noticed a scent to it and barely notice the product at all when I spray it on.  Now I just wish I had a travel size to take with me on upcoming trips!  I definitely recommend giving this a try!

AGF6TCJ5DIUYHXKWWLFKAY2HUIXQ.review_title: Helps when wearing mask all day
AGF6TCJ5DIUYHXKWWLFKAY2HUIXQ.review_text:
I work in a school that currently requires everyone to wear masks when on property. These mask brackets have really helped me feel more comfortable to wear a mask all day. I also find it much easier to speak and be heard with this bracket.

These are the second set of brackets I have tried and I feel like these fit my face much better than other ones. It took some getting used to as it doesn’t clip into my non pleated masks and sometimes moves around, but I am definitely liking using these better than nothing. I have shared extras with coworkers and they have all found them to be helpful. I would recommend.

This headband is so cute!  It fits my adult head and my 2 year old’s head well. It is extremely comfortable to wear and doesn’t  dig into the sides of your head. The headband is covered in satin so it’s soft. It can fall down pretty easily because there are no combs to hold it in place but I’ll take that inconvenience for the comfort!  It is decently made, not real high quality, but for the price it’s fair. Much cheaper than buying ones inside parks!  I definitely recommend this!

This hairbrush set is perfect for my 3 year old daughter!  She loves mermaids and unicorns so was very excited to get this hairbrush.  The hairbrush works very well in her hair and easily detangles the hair. It is easy to hold and seems very well made.  The brush comes with coil hair ties. I have never used these before but they are just the right size for my daughter’s hair and they are great!  They hold the hair well and don’t damage it like rubber bands do.  There is also a small jar of butterfly clips which my daughter likes. These are not very well made as we already had one break but they are a nice bonus to this set. I definitely recommend for a younger child!

I ordered these color hair pieces for my 3 year old daughter to have fun with. She was very excited to add some purple to her hair!  I cut the extensions pretty easily to match her hair length. You bend the small comb clips to open them and then clip them in the hair. The clips did not stay in place in my daughters hair.  They were also extremely noticeable which was disappointing. My daughter has thinner blonde hair which probably makes it harder. These would work better with thicker and darker hair. I personally think they are over priced for the quality. I would not order again.

I ordered these hair clips for my 3 year old daughter who loves butterflies. This pack comes with 12 different colored butterfly alligator clips.  The alligator clips are fully covered with a matching ribbon so they do not get easily tangled in hair or damage the hair.  The clip is sturdy and stays put when in the hair.  The butterfly wings are made of two layers of a very thin fabric.  They are transparent but the colors are beautiful. The butterfly bodies are different glitter colors which adds just the right amount of sparkle to these clips. I think these clips are very pretty and so much fun for a young child or an adult who enjoys butterflies. They are not the highest quality but I think priced appropriately for a se lot of 12.

I ordered this bow for my 3-year-old daughter.  She was very excited to get it as she loves the fun rainbow sequins on it.  The bow is a little large for her, but she can wear it fine with a ponytail.  There is a metal alligator clip on the back that can pull at the hair, but if you are careful when putting it in and taking it out it is fine.  I really like this bow, but I believe it is a bit overpriced for 1 bow.  I would not pay the current price for this single bow, maybe for a 3 pack or more.

I ordered this clip for my 3-year-old daughter.  She loves unicorns and loves this clip with the multi-colored sequins.  It is a little big in her hair but it works fine with a ponytail.  The clip is a metal alligator clip which can pull at the hair, but if you're careful it's fine.  The clip stays well in the hair.  I think it's a little overpriced for one hair clip, but it is a fun clip.

I have tried many different crowns and I am really liking this one because it’s very unique compared to others. The purple color and leaf details make it stand out. The purple looks more like a brown to me but I like it. Jewel encrusted leaves and vines make up the main part of the crown and tear drop shaped jewels spike out from the top. This is not a full circle crown which makes it easier to fit on the head and keep in place. There are holes on each end to fix the crown in place. This crown is not too heavy but does have some weight. It seems to be well made. I would recommend it. Great for a special occasion or costume!

This is such a fun wig!  It was simple to get on and off. The colors are perfect for a fun night out or for a princess/unicorn party. It has a slight wave to it which helps make it look more natural. I would recommend

AGF6XRUCF3FQVO25NEYQF6O5RSOQ.review_text: 3rd day after installation, and the hair is very soft and no tangles yet.
The wig is okay, but its nothing like the picture.
Very soft, just a wee bit overly thick.
Very rough and scratchy; easy to tangle before even installing
Soft, natural curly afro look. Love it!
This wig is awesome! Great fit, awesome softness, washes and dyed well!

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: These were one of the easiest mask type products I have used.  The application process literally takes seconds.  Peel off and place on face and they stay there.  I left them on for 15 minutes and could definitely tell the difference afterwards.  As the package describes there is a little residue left when you take them off which yu just dab in.  Over all I was pleased with the effect, but not pleased enough to want to pay $7 for just the one set.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Great Value WIth Good Color Options - And It Lasts!
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This set is great for anyone possibly looking to try a slightly different look.  12 individual, full size lipsticks all in fall / Halloween type colors.  For truer color, as with many lipsticks, several layers work better.  The color lasts really well even through eating and drinking, but comes off easily with remover!

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Dryer Than Some Of The Other Options Out There.
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: I love these easy eye treatments and have used several varients.  This is a little dryer than some of the others used and definitely pulls a little more.  The results are OK but I think it loses a lot from not having the extra moisture left to dab in when you remove them.  Personally I prefer them with a more gel type feel.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: It Works But Is A Little Tight!
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: I wear a lot of wigs for cosplay purposes and am always looking for anything that can make life easier.  This definitely helps grip the wig in place although I did use it with wig clips as well.  There was definitely less slipping around the front area, which can be an issue with them sliding back.  It was a little tight for me and I don't have a big head.  2 hours of wearing it and I was ready to pull it off. For short term use it is a nice addition to have - for if I am just going to be doing a quick set of pictures or a short video, this would never last on my head for the day though,

I love these headbands.  Perfect to get me in a good mood while I am doing my make up.  Anyone who follows my facebook page would know that Cat Ears are a HUGE part of most things I wear so these are perfect!  Various colors are included. The grey and pink are definite favorites.  Would be a great present for cat lovers, or anyone who wants something FUN while they are getting ready / doing their skin care routine etc etc.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Nice Packaging and a Vibrant Color
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This lipstick is the sort that is great to pull out of your purse in places because it just looks super classy.  The color is nice and vibrant and it doesn't dry out your lips.  The effect is quite matte so I will confess I added a staying gloss over it - but purely for visual effect. My skin tone was failing to pull off the flatter red. It didn't need it for moisture.

I used the copper and the white/silver to create the effect in the picture. I love that the color was long lastig and definitely shimmery.  It didn't flake off as some glitter based ones do.  I found the best effect occurred if I let a layer dry and then added more - to build up the shine but if I didn't wait long enough between layers it did get a little clumpy.  Overall a fun addition for the holiday / party season.

The color on these are strong, but they feel a little waxy for my preference. That being said they do stain quite well and there was a variety of red shades which means there would be something for most skin types. Just not one I can see me using on a regular basis.

These are really good purple options. The crayons make it easy to use for underlining the eyes. It was a little tricky to use as a shadow, with more being needed and it definitely took more work to do that, but as a general addition to my make up I was pleased.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Nice options but not too sturdy (one of the gems fell off)
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: I needed a peacock clip for my vikings cosplay and this worked really well. Having the 3 separate pieces allows for lots of variety and styling options. The only downside is that the glue on one had completely dried up and the gem had fallen off in the packet. Super glue handled that but it did stop it from getting 5 stars.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Cute - but not the easiest to style!
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This wig looks super cute once you get it sorted. The bangs are long, and needed trimming, which is pretty normal for me, but this one was a little trickier to get adjusted correctly and I ended up using extra clips to secure it. Short wigs are often harder to work with because there are less places to hide the mistakes, but overall I ended up with a very cute look.

These are very convenient to throw in your purse when you are on the go, especially with everything going on at the moment. Working out at just under $1 a use they are pretty good value for money. They don't have a harsh scent and they aren't drying on your skin which is always a plus. A good product!

I love magnetic lashes - they have totally changed how I feel about False eyelashes and I use them ALL the time. This set comes with two liquid liners which I love! The lashes stay all day with no issues at all and the variety of styles means you can have them looking more natural - or super dramatic.  The only thing I would say is that they say reusable - and I know people that do wash and reuse them but my eyes are sensitive and so I only use each pair for a single use.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Very Soft but not good  for longer / thciker hair.
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: My daughter has thick hair which sits a couple of inches below her shoulders and takes forever to dry so I hoped these would be a good solution. Sadly although they are super soft, they don't absorb enough if you have longer / thicker hair.  My hair is shorter and thinner than my daughters and although it worked better on that - it still wasn't much better than a regular towel.  Very cute - but disappointing results.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Great Pins At A Great Price
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: As someone who works with wigs a lot, having various color options is important to me, as these pins generally are only good for one use (although I have used these for a couple of uses before having to ditch them).  Having all the colors in one set is great and very convenient for someone like me - or if you have more than one hair color in the house.

This has taken up permanent residence in my freezer. It is great when I just need a quick refresh, oh my eyes are tired, or I have a headache.  I have other rollers too but this is larger than most of them so you can hit more area at once.

These are great! I am a big fan of the liquid liner over the pens. Super easy to use and you can have professional looking lashes in 2 easy steps. This set has a nice variety of lash styles from every day to super dramatic which is nice. They say reusable - I don't reuse mine because my eyes are super sensitive so can't comment on that part but I have seen that lots of people do reuse them so it is probably personal preference but I couldn't say how many uses you might get out of each pair.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: A Good Primer - But Heavy For Regular Use
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This is a great kit, for when you REALLY want your make-up to be on point. The primer gives a really great base and helps the foundation to look smooth and not crack, the ONLY downside is that for me, it doesn't allow my skin to breathe enough and I end up with breakouts if use it more than on the odd occasion which is a shame.  That being said a little goes a very long way, and on the days when I need my make up to be extra perfect then this gives me great results!

These tweezers are fabulous. They grip even the smallest of hairs with no issues. The larger ones are so good that I haven't really needed the smaller ones (although I did try them just so that I could compare for the review). Very impressed! Highly recommend!

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: The Rose Quartz Roller Is Nice ....
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: The Rose Quartz roller that comes with this is really nice., and I use it ALL the time. The micro needling kit - not so much. I am assuming that these are supposed to be one use and disposable (as there are NO options for changing/replacing the needle heads) - which could be a good thing in that at least you know for a fact it's clean. I read a lot about this and generally feel that it should be left to professionals! There is no way to tell what shape the little needles are on this (which from reading is pretty important), and there are LOTS of things that can go wrong. I am all about doing stuff at home - but I personally don't think a disposable micro needling kit is one of those things.

This is an absolutely stunning piece that photographs beautifully!  If you try and use it in more of a headband style it is a little pinching but it sites beautifully on top like a crown and looks way more expensive than it is.  Perfect for brides, cosplay, or any time you need a fabulous crown! This is a Tiara style - not a complete ring - which makes it much easier for styling purposes. A wonderful piece and a new favorite!

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Too big for my little mouth!
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This was just too big for my mouth - no matter how much I squished it.  I can't really say as to whether it would work or not because I couldn't really try it and nobody else in the house thought it looked like something they wanted to try. I am an adult - so feel that this should have been able to be small enough for everyone- but it was not!

In England when I was younger, if your eyes were tired or puffy my mum would always tell me to put used tea bags on them. This is what these patches are like! 15 minutes wear and your eyes really do feel better - especially if you are suffering because of too much screen time. Don't be put off by the fact that the instructions aren't in English. Just take out a new pair, place on closed eyes for 15 minutes, and discard. You won't regret it!

I LOVE Scrunchies - I am so excited that they are making a comeback and this is such a fun way to store them. I mean yes it is a little annoying if the one you want happens to be at the bottom - but not really a big deal. I think it's great that this comes with 8 scrunchies already - that in itself pretty much pays for it - but you can add lots more! If you are a scrunchie person then this is for you. I have mine on my dressing table and I love it!

This definitely moisturizes, there is no question about that. I found that because of the texture (it's almost whipped) that you end up needing to use more product than with many of the options. Not sure that my skin would be stressed - but it definitely goes through a lot with the amount of make-up I put on it.  It is supposed to be fragrance-free and there's definitely not a perfume element - but maybe there should be, It smelled weird to me. I can't put my finger on what it was exactly just that I didn't really like it, but I can be picky over scents so that might just be me. Overall it was good - but not great - but also it's a mid-range rather than a higher price product which should be taken into account.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Beautiful But Heavy & Not The Easiest To Wear
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This crown is absolutely gorgeous. The detailing is really lovely and it sparkles beautifully. It comes packaged in a lovely blue box which conveniently could double as storage for it.  As with many complete circle crowns the wear and fit is an issue. This is definitely on the smaller size - and it is a little tricky to get it pinned in an acceptable position. The other note I have is that it is really heavy, on the plus side it doesn't feel like it will fall apart with the slightest movement - but between that and the size - sadly it probably won't become one of my regular pieces.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: A Little Hard - But Great Color!
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This set of lip liners are a great set of Reds - and the colors are great. The only problem for me was that they are a little hard which means sometimes they are a little scratchy and harder to get the perfect lines. For the price though you are getting a good selection with pretty much any shade of Red liner you could need.

I have lots of crowns that I use for various costumes. Full circle crowns are always harder to work with but this was made extra tricky from the fact that there is a very badly placed seam at what should be the front. Although it is sparkly - it is definitely not as well made as many of the others that I have that have been in the same price range. It is described as "Rose Gold" but it is definitely more "Gold Gold" in reality. Overall lackluster and disappointing.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Cute Color - Bangs Are A Little Long
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: This is a cute pink wig. The short waves make it pretty easy to wear but the bangs on it were super long and I had to trim them quite a lot to get it to look good. It is comfortable and would be great for cosplay but I couldn't quite get it adjusted enough for it to become one of my gotos that I would actually wear as a daily option.

This lipstick is a really nice vibrant red color and stays on well without being drying. It did have a little bit of an unusual taste, not unpleasant, but enough that I noticed it hence the 4 stars. Other than that the coverage was great, it didn't smudge, and it looked fabulous. I will definitely be wearing it often.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Great Set - Especially For Eye MakeUp
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text: I use a LOT of makeup brushes - and yes part of that is because I GET a lot of makeup brushes and I am not a fan of cleaning them but it also means that I try out a lot of different brands.  These worked REALLY well for my trickier eye makeup looks. They are soft but they hold the color well and disperse it evenly without much effort. The brush cleaner is a nice addition but being honest I probably won't use it. I do have an automatic brush cleaner if I need one and that will always be my go to.  For beginners or those looking to get a but more technical these are a great brush choice in my opinion!

I have a lot of wigs and crowns and this is the perfect thing to use for styling them! This is the second one I have, and this one allows for earrings to be placed as well (which I personally don't use but I can see how it would be handy for a store display, or if you were taking pictures for selling jewelry). I have named her Rachel, to go with Monica that I already have, and she is definitely a talking point. Great quality, and whilst not the sort of thing everyone would need, cosplayers I think would find her very useful!

I am not a big traveler but this definitely has the essentials all ready to go in an FDA-approved clear bag. The items are decent quality but probably the most useful things are the bag it all comes in, and a little card that tells you all the things that you should be wiping down, a couple of which I hadn't thought of. I also hadn't thought of taking my own pillowcase before but having seen that it makes total sense. Yes, you could probably get all the things in it a little cheaper, but for convenience, this is a win. (I am also noting it as a possible stocking stuffer present for those people that are difficult to buy for and this would be an alternative to those who chocolate of bath products won't work for).

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Surprisingly Good For A Costume Wig
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text:
So I wear and review a lot of wigs and I have started breaking the review down into sections that I think will be helpful.

Color - The color is very similar to the person pictured wearing it in the examples but not the one that is on the mannequin look. This wig is very light silver / grey. It is not that fake, overly shiny texture, and is the same solid color throughout.

Styling- This has an adjustable headband and is fairly easy to fit and style. As it is a costume wig you have to be careful if you are looking to pull it back for anything as the amount of hair in the wig is really designed more for it to be worn as is (which is normal for this kind of price point)

Comfort - This wig is light and comfortable and there is plenty of airflow. This was a little weird around my ears (because my head is a little smaller) but nothing too difficult. This would be suitable to wear all day although I personally wouldn't.

Overall - I really liked it but for what it was - a costume wig. If you are looking for something for a Halloween type look this is perfect.Great for pictures and videos but not one I would probably wear out (other than possibly to a costume party if it completed the look) just because I have others that look way more realistic.

I only recently discovered the trick of using white liner rather than black for some interesting looks. This is a good liner - it doesn't irritate my eyes at all and is definitely good value for money. My only issue is that even with several coats it doesn't look as white, or stay on as long, as some other brands that I have used. Having a 12 pack means though that as I often lose things I have extras on hand which is nice.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: It Does Dye - Beard And Skin
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text:
What you get - 10 packets of dye (no mix needed)

Pros - the dye is ready to go. Put it on - leave it - rinse it out. It does dye the beard - VERY dark - it definitely works.

Cons - the process takes longer than it says on the packet (even the instructions have a longer time than it says) and it dyes the hair AND THE SKIN - which is impossible to avoid as it gets between the beard hairs. The stain on the skin has to fade - nothing got rid of the excess dye on the skin leaving a very fake looking result.

Overall it was a pass from us - will not be using any more packets.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: No Grips On The Colored Pins but they are cute
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text:
What you get - a cute tin with 100 bobby pins - 50 multi-colored and 50 black

Pros - if you wear a lot of wigs or you want your hairpins to stand out these are fab. Honestly, I wish the whole box was the colored variety rather than just half of it - and the tin is really cute. The pins are a good size too - not the mini variety.

Cons - the colored pins don't have the litter rubber protectors on the end so they tend to snag a bit. For the price I think they could have had them all colored - not half plain black (which interestingly did have the ends on them)

Overall I will probably continue to use the colored ones as they blend in better with the wigs I use, but wish they had the ends on them.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Cute Idea But The Horn Isn't Centered With The Ears
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text:
What you get - 3 Unicorn style spa-style terry headbands.

Pros - these are cute and make a change from the normal bow or cat ear styles.

Cons - The ears don't sit equally either side of the horn and they aren't moveable. The bands are also smaller than others I have. Even though they don't say they are designed for children I feel that these may have been designed that way.

Overall - a little overpriced for what you get but might make fun teen party favors if they are having a spa or make up party.

What You Get -
12 oz Rose Gold "Beauty begins the moment you love yourself" insulated tumbler with lid.
(Straw and cleaner too)
Scented Candle
Soap
Bottle Opener
Wine Bottle Stopper
2 Flower Petal Bath Bombs
Greeting Card

Pros - This is a really nice, complete gift set. You can send it directly and it comes nicely presented and all the things look really pretty in the box. Because of the bath bombs and soap it also smells lovely when you open it.

Cons - It has a greeting card in it to "Add your special message" but if you send it directly from Amazon obviously you can't do that (they suggest adding your own on the Amazon gift option). Also the card is inside the box - so if you had it shipped to you to give to someone you would still have to open it in order to fill it out.

Overall - this is on sale at the time of the review for under $20 and for that price it is definitely worth it. The cup and candle alone would be worth that.

AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_title: Convenient but I couldn't reuse them.
AGFAOH3NMW2D7YV3QVZSTXMTSKIQ.review_text:
What you get - 4 pairs of ready to wear lashes with adhesive strips already on them (Can be cut to size).

Pros - no magnetic liner or glue to worry about. These do give a pretty decent effect although takes a little practice to get them on.

Cons - I didn't feel they stayed on as well as magnetic lashes do. I wore them for an hour show and they barely stayed. When I removed them there was no way that I would be able to use them again. They just weren't sticky enough.

Overall - might be OK for teens, or people that don't do well with magnetic liner oe eyelash glue but for me they weren't secure enough. For the price though it could be worth a try if you don't normally wear lashes and want them for a special event.

What you get - 10 horror style mouth covering temporary tattoos

Pros - the designs are fun and spooky - definitely fit the Halloween bill and look like they would be a great addition to many horror costumes.

Cons - they have to go over your whole mouth which firstly makes it almost impossible to apply well (you know how temporary tattoos can be tricky - this is that but more so because it's over your mouth. If by some miracle you DO manage to get it on and in a good placement you then can't move your mouth at all. No talking, eating, or drinking. I have seen suggestions about cutting a slit in the tattoo - but that just makes it move and fall apart so it's not worth it.

Overall - you get 10 for a cheap price - probably better to put them in a separate area other than the mouth and go for a weird look rather than use it like a mask.

I have an aunt in another state who is a hair dresser. Years ago, she asked me if I wanted to perm my lashes when she came down to visit. I thought she was crazy! This was like 10 years ago. I never heard of such a thing and I didn't do it. Well I don't know what happened recently for this to suddenly now become popular. One of my friends and I were talking about lash extensions and lattisse. I was telling her how my eye lids turn red when i try to use lattisse. I even tried the RF brand and same thing! Anyhows, then i've been doing exentions for about a year now but I am finding that my lash is getting worst and worst.. like when my extensions fall out, I barely have lashes! I used to have average lash that  I could curl. But now it seems like I barely have anything. So this is why I decided to finally consider perming my lash. So perming the did not make it longer by any means! What it did though is made it look like I had lashes that were longer but it curved up! My lash tends to grow straight. It may have have to do with the fact that I have asian eyes. So the curling has always been important when I used to wear mascara. The thing is I hate that sometimes it poked at me and the curler would yank some lashes out!  Also I just hate it doing it every day. With perm lashes, you don't have to do this. However, I don't know if I could have done this alone. I had to get a friend to help me. She said it was pretty easy. What took the longest is us reading things over and over to make sure we weren't going to make me blind! I think it took about an hour or so? I can't recall exactly as we didn't time it.  The reason I am giving it 4 stars is that you really cannot do this by yourself.  Now it may not look drastic to most people bc they don't usually notice your lashes. But you would b/c you know how they look before. Then add mascara and you can definitely tell.

AGFE4BOYY6OUVCSVDD3URJCCRQYA.review_title: Decent brush which is easy to clean. My cat loved it, not so much for my dog.
AGFE4BOYY6OUVCSVDD3URJCCRQYA.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:6a6138d9c3058753871db81bb93907cd]] The bristles on the brush are thin and wiry, the rubber tips are very small (except for ONE tip which is larger than the others).

It was a little difficult to brush my dog's tough hair, but my long haired cat was easier. She runs up to me with the brush and moves her head around against it. She is brushing her own hair, she loves it.

It is very easy to clean the hair and fur off the brush. And there is a handy cover to prevent damage while storing.

It is not the sturdiest feeling brush but it definitely does the job fine.

AGFE4BOYY6OUVCSVDD3URJCCRQYA.review_title: It's okay, feels more "natural" than most others
AGFE4BOYY6OUVCSVDD3URJCCRQYA.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:42193674753cf3069b293c00ccb4e893]] The first impression of this, it feels more like a natural clay-ish, almost like a mud for facials consistency rather than the typical shampoo-like beard wash you might be accustomed to.

The scent is subtle, it's kind of earthy. Not a perfumed or heavy scent.

It lathers up pretty much like other kinds of soap or shampoo and rinses off clean. It doesn't leave a sticky or slick residue.

It's fine as a beard wash. I didn't feel like my beard was any more soft or easy to manage. It's an alright beard wash, not one that I was excited about. If you like more earthy and natural feeling personal wash ingredients, you might like it more.

I have many thoughts on this wig. We ordered this to compliment my daughter's Mad Hatter Halloween costume and honestly, it looked like a hot mess when it arrived. The bangs were going everywhere, the curls were tangled, there was no part...it was awful.

My daughter, who is 12, has long, VERY thick blonde hair. When the wig arrived, we tried it on with her hair down to make sure it fit. It did. Fast forward to Halloween...I braided her hair and pulled it into a knot at the back of her head. Lo and behold, the wig wouldn't fit...it just kept sliding off her head. That was my mistake...I should have tested it with a bun when it arrived. Having said that, my daughter is incredibly petite...her doctor predicts she won't surpass 5' when she's full grown Obviously, her head isn't that large. My point? If you're an adult or are purchasing this for a teen or big child, it likely won't fit. I finally had to put her hair in a low bun at the nape of her neck to make it work.

Unfortunately, because her natural hair was so low, we couldn't do the up-do we had planned because her bun showed if we did. We ended up leaving it down, brushing it out, putting bobby pins in strategic places to help it frame her face and to contain it, and then I hair sprayed it in place. Styling was especially difficult because the wig is sparse. It's a lot of work to hide the netting underneath. The netting is a yellow-beige color and stands out like bright white against the purple and teal. We finally got it looking decent though, and she actually got many compliments on it throughout the evening, hence the higher star rating despite all the complaints.

Once the wig was brushed and styled, the waves looked beautiful. Just don't buy this expecting it to look great out of the box. It won't. It takes work.

Let me start by saying, I did NOT order this from Amazon. I ordered it from Sephora. The reviews here regarding whether this product was a fake or not made me a little leery. So, I'm reviewing the real Josie Maran Vibrancy foundation and not the Amazon version, real or not.

As usual, I ordered the lightest shade, RG5. It's a nearly perfect match. It's described as being for fair skin with neutral undertones. I typically prefer foundations with pink undertones, but this actually worked really well for me.

The consistency is on the thin, runny side, which isn't surprising since oil is an ingredient. Having said that, this foundation sits on the skin so beautifully. It looks like real skin. It's definitely not a matte foundation, so if that's your preference, this is not the foundation for you. This foundation gives you more luminous, dewy-looking skin. I don't typically care for dewy foundations, but again, I was surprised to like this one. It just made my skin look healthy and plump. It didn't look at all heavy, which is great because it didn't settle into my fine lines. I did notice it took a while to set. Again, not surprising considering the oil content, but you'll want to make sure you set it with powder before trying to blend blush/contour/bronzer, etc. Otherwise, you'll likely look pretty streaky.

Many reviewers here have mentioned a smell. I didn't notice that at all, which is another reason I think the product people are buying here might not be legit.

The only reason I gave this 4 stars instead of 5 is because my t-zone gets oily fairly quickly while wearing it.

I'd recommend this for more mature skin and dry skin types. If you're oily, you can definitely still wear it, you just might have to blot a bit more than usual.

Overall, though, a great foundation. Just make sure it's what you're looking for. It's a very specific look.

I've tried quite a few different tweezers, but my favorite is an old Revlon one that I've had for more than 15 years.  To me, it's not just about the angle or the point - it's the gripping power.  This LeiCare set works well and have become my go-to splinter removers.  They grip well and for the price (currently $6.99 for both tweezers and the case), I think these are a good deal.  My only complaint is with the case.  It's basically cardboard so while it's held up so far, I don't think it will last long.  If you lose the little "straps" that hold the tweezers closed, the case won't close.

Changing weather always affects my scalp in a bad way.  I also lose hair easily so I was worried a scalp massager might cause more hair to break or fall out.  Not so!  The "teeth" on this scalp massager are long enough to get down to the scalp but are soft and gentle.  Even my 3-year-old daughter can sort of use it herself in the shower.  And she doesn't complain at all when I use it to actually shampoo her hair.  This massager also increases the lather a lot!  It really makes a regular everyday shampoo feel luxurious.

I've been using this sonic facial cleaning brush for a few weeks and tried out both the brush and the silicone heads.  I feel like the brush is more intense and the silicone head is more gentle on the skin.  I can really notice a difference after I use the brush.  My skin is much smoother.  I assume it's because it's exfoliating and removing the dead skin.  There are 2 speed settings and I've found the lower setting doesn't do much so I use it on the higher setting.  I like that it can be used in the shower since I wash my face in the shower.  I just wish it was rechargeable.  I haven't had to replace the batteries yet, but nowadays it seems that most electronics are rechargeable so I guess I'm used to that.

I was surprised at the packaging when this tea arrived.  It's pretty elegant, especially for tea.  I would expect a high-end candle to look like this, not a canister of tea!  It's beautiful, but again, for tea.  The box is nice with a soft, thick elastic band to keep the top on.  The jar is a light purple glass with a plastic lid.  They did slap a warning about the horrific smell when you open the cap.  It's pretty bad and strong.  However, I bravely pushed on and made a cup.  It doesn't really smell that bad once it's steeped.  I steep it in 195 degree water for 7 minutes.  It does seem to take the edge off, but the flavor is really just okay.  At $68 (currently) for 50 tea bags, I think the packaging must be really expensive.  I usually drink Yogi Bedtime Tea because it's readily available at the grocery store and I love the way it smells and tastes.  While I think this WelleCo tea seems to be more effective, I really would prefer to just drink a cup of nice-tasting tea before bed.

AGFYQTZJRLLJ7EJWHUAY3XPGYNCQ.review_title: The plates alone are more than worth the price.
AGFYQTZJRLLJ7EJWHUAY3XPGYNCQ.review_text:
This is such a good deal! The stamping plates alone are *well* worth $3.99, even with shipping added. I have always found Born Pretty plates to be good quality, and these are no exception. All the designs I have tried so far (most of them) have been well etched. The plates have sturdy plastic backings that extend slightly beyond the edges so you can grasp them without worrying about getting cut. It's nice to have such a variety of different style designs to work with.The scraper is credit card style, which I like, but it is a little thinner and more flexible than I am used to using. I like a bit more body than this one has. Still it is usable. The stamper is small but nice. I like the transparent style so I can see where I am placing an image. I had a little trouble picking up polish with it at first, so I primed it by repeatedly stamping it on a lint roller, and now it works just fine. All in all, I would say this could be an excellent starter kit for anyone wanting to try nail stamping.

The template with cutouts is something I hadn't tried before. The way it works is that you apply polish to the stamping plate and scrape it. Then lay the template on the stamping plate, and stamp on/through the opening. You need a fairly soft stamp for this to press down through the opening. (The one in this kit works fine.) Then you stamp your nail. You have to work fairly quickly to get it placed after scraping the polish (or use polish that dries slowly), but it does work.. I will say that the cut out areas are a little bit on the large side for my not too long nails. It might be fun to try using it to make decals, but I haven't gotten so far as trying that yet.

So as a starter kit, or to expand your plate collection I would recommend this item. Note: I have no affiliation with the seller, and purchased this with my own funds-no promotional discount.

AGGD6CXA3JFPIPECTSBFB43YZQAA.review_title: Very relaxing, all natural. Clinical but clean scent. Pricey for size!
AGGD6CXA3JFPIPECTSBFB43YZQAA.review_text:
On the fence on this product for one reason: price!! Don't get me wrong - I love a good bath and maybe I am crazy but I will pay up to $20 to my favorite retailer for their beautiful CBD bath bombs (which yes, also includes a crystal) but as an avid bath salt user from basic to boutique; I cannot for the life of me understand what is in this product that justifies that price point. I compared to some of my premium brands too; just to see what this might have that they don't

After a long spin class followed by 30 minutes of strength workouts I was feeling the muscle burn so I added this to my bath and soaked for 20 minutes. The smell is not my favorite but it is one I am used to from some of the other brands I use and it is consistent with the natural ingredients. It is hard to define but I would say it has an almost clinical smell. It reminds me of a very clean hospital - not bad, just not my personal favorite scent. That said, they do use all natural ingredients so for that I am willing to pay more and I will say it was very relaxing, and helped with the muscle soreness.

You do also get a rather large crystal in the bag -I like crystals but here is a watch out just in case you are not bothered one way or another - the crystal weighed 1oz so you are getting 8oz salts which is enough for one bath with 1/9 of the bag weight being taken up by the crystal.

Now to be fair, the ingredient list does show all natural with no fillers that you might see in cheaper products such as coconut oil or unsourced scents and I really do feel crazy relaxed after this bath! Just wish it was maybe enough for 2/3 baths !!

Has a great scent so that’s the first thing I noticed. Smells masculine like a fresh cologne but certainly not overpowering . Scent mutes a little once applied so it still smells nice but won’t bother you either .

Has a nice amount of hold and it’s a good semi matte with just a hint of shine. It has a good amount of hold that is buildable with the right amount of product and it washes out easily with no residue.

Impressed and would buy again

I just wan't ya'll to know.. I have never given myself a gel polish manicure in my LIFE before yesterday. I had been wanting to for the longest time, but I wasn't 100% prepared to make the commitment to purchasing the light and the top coats and the bottom coats and the paint, etc, etc..

First of all, the lamp works. You set your timer and once you do that, all you have to do is put your hand it and it starts automatically. Awesome! Like a real salon. I was able to do my hands in 45 minutes. It would have been even faster but I did a test run on my thumb before doing them all at once to make sure I didn't mess anything up.

What has really impressed me though is the Microneedle Derma Roller. I only use it a few times a week but I really feel like it has helped with my dry flaky skin around my t-zone which has always been a problem for me. My face has never looked better!!

If you are an ashy kind of gal then you need some body in your life!

I'm always up for trying something new so I was excited to try this ULTRA LIGHT FULL SPECTRUM BODY OIL.

I think it works best if you put it on while your skin is still damp right out of the bath or a shower. I also try to exfoliate a little bit especially on my legs and other problem areas like elbows and knees.

It's lightly scented which I like because if it's too overpowering it can really flare up my allergies.

I wouldn't use something like this on my face because I do tend to be on the oily side. But for the body it really works great!

I'm not even going to lie to ya'll... I wear my mascara thick with multiple layers. This makes it SO hard for me to get off. It's not unusual for me to accidentally pull out my eyelashes trying to get my mascara off. This has left my eyelashes looking very sad. I decided to give this a go and I think I see results. My problem is I am defeating the purpose by wearing too much mascara! I think I just need to invest in some fake lashes.

I don't know what it is about goat milk soap/cleansers, but they are so luxurious! This is no exception. It has kept her face clear from blemishes without drying out her skin.

This is a must-have especially during the winter when the wind hits your lips and they become dry and chapped. It gets all the dry flaky dead skin off of your lips leaving them super soft and supple. Not the mention the product itself smells and tastes great. 10/10!

AGI6FVF3S3IYOHN6NAYOHOBY5NTA.review_title: Does not feel like it can straighten hair at the roots but love the low heating temp.
AGI6FVF3S3IYOHN6NAYOHOBY5NTA.review_text:
I have tried a number of these brushes. What I like about this one is that it goes down to 80C (176F). It was so cool that I was not sure it was on. I have fine hair, high porosity that is 5 months post-straightening relaxer. And, I find that light heat with a silicone-based glosser helps to gently close the cuticle and to keep my roots from tangling. What I don’t like is that this brush design does not have the round guiding bristles around the edges that help to pull your hair into the hearing plate. So, it feels like you are brushing your hair with your elbow and that it is not penetrating to the roots. You have to grip the hair with your other hand so it feels like you are only getting the shaft of your hair. So, the brush is best for people with longer hair who do not have curly roots or those who need the super low heat setting as an option.

If you would like to be able to rake the brush over your roots to tame curls at 250 F and up, other bushes to consider are https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07FGV9NQG/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o01_s00?ie=UTF8&th=1 or https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B071HFQGJX/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o00_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1. Note - My glamfields brush malfunctioned after first use which is why I ended up trying this one, but I decided to give Glamfields another chance because it is great when it works - never had results like that before. The BuTure mini is like the Glamfields brush but smaller. Both feel better (more like a real brushZ) than this one.

AGJCZ3TS5CHMAP4DVRV2752DQ3NA.review_text: I am loving the newer generation of IPL devices that are a fraction of the price of the original ones that came to 9-10 years ago. AGJCZ3TS5CHMAP4DVRV2752DQ3NA.review_title: Looks cool, but lacking in a few areas
AGJCZ3TS5CHMAP4DVRV2752DQ3NA.review_text: This razor has a refreshing redesign to the traditional razor handle. However, the futuristic look does have some drawbacks. For example, the wider handle might make it more ergonomic, but it now no longer fits in any of my shower razor holders (caddy or wall mounted) since it won't fit in between the two prongs. I like that it comes with a protective blade case that has vent cut outs to allow aeration to the blades. When it comes to shaving, the blades are sub par and don't cut everything in the first pass. Hopefully they can address this and change the blades to something more efficacious.

This brush is great for detangling hair. The two bristles system seems to make a difference. I also love the weight and feel of the brush.

This has a fun design, masquerading as lipstick. However, it when it comes to efficacy, it falls short for me. The vibration and heat are weak compared to other facial devices. It is mostly made of lightweight plastic, so I'm not sure the quality is there or the lifespan.

One significant issue that this listing did not address is compatibility. IPL's are not effective for all skin and hair color types. Please research online as there are several infographics on how effective laser therapy is on each color type. This is the main reason why some reviews rave about the results and some are so disappointed.
That being said...
This is the most compact IPL device that I've tried, but it packs all the new features you are looking for. I personally have not reached the intensity where I need the cooling function, but it's nice knowing it's there when I reach that point. I do like the compact size, but wish there was more grip to the exterior. Everything is smooth and I came close to dropping the thing the first time I used it. So be careful handling it. One of the newer trends on these devices is to have the invisible screen, instead of a visible LCD screen. When you turn it on, the data lights are under the gold rectangle and illuminate to show the functions etc.
I personally have had great success with IPL devices, since I fit the designated hair and skin color. Hair hardly, if at all, grows back in the targeted areas... but it does take some time to see results. You will notice reduced grow back rates after 2 weeks, then more significant results after 4-6 months.

Stating in the title that it's a "Metal Facial Roller" is misleading because there are models where everything is indeed metal. In the description, it also says "our facial roller tool is High quality metal material". Ummmm... that's JUST THE HANDLE. The models we've tried with plastic balls had the fake metal paint water off, and some of them even crack after a while, so this is important in determining quality of the tool and the price that it should command. Most of the ones with plastic are priced around $8-10, while the all metal ones are $24-30. That being said, the price of this one might seem like a good deal if you think it's an all metal model - but it is actually overpriced for the plastic-ball-model.

AGJS5RN6QYCYPGH42JZGQFFOSXKQ.review_title: Perfect for key chain, purse strap, belt loop
AGJS5RN6QYCYPGH42JZGQFFOSXKQ.review_text:
These little bottles are exactly what I wanted for hand sanitizer on the go. The silicone bottle is durable and thick, but so easy to squeeze. It isn't going to break and crack like a hard plastic bottle. The cap fits securely and the snap-top stays in place. The carabiner is small, but it's strong enough to keep the bottle where it needs to be as long as there isn't serious weight constantly pulling on it. So far, so good.

The thing I worry about most with a little bottle like this is what happens if you put a lot of pressure on it (sit on it, lean against the wall when it's in a pocket or on a belt loop, etc). I was concerned that the flip top would pop open and I'd end up with hand sanitizer all over the place, but I tested these little guys full of liquid before filling with sanitizer. The pliability of the silicone doesn't allow a burst of pressure to push off the flip top-- not even close. Plus, the top screws tightly into place. It's not going anywhere.

I've been using one of these hanging from my purse strap for the last few days and it is super easy to flip the cap, squeeze out product, and flip the cap closed with one hand. Wish there were other color options, but the functionality and design of these override any concerns about color. I'm so glad I ordered these! They are totally worth the price.

AGJS5RN6QYCYPGH42JZGQFFOSXKQ.review_title: I liked the idea better than the product
AGJS5RN6QYCYPGH42JZGQFFOSXKQ.review_text:
With four cats and a large dog, I am always looking for good grooming tools. I liked the idea of this brush, but the actual product really wasn't all that. First of all, this thing is much larger than any other slicker style brush I have. This is a great feature for my large dog, but it was just ridiculous trying to groom my cats with this large, unyielding wire brush. So, not a good choice for the cats.

Unfortunately, not a good choice for my dog either, as she has a short coat with little to no undercoat and she was really uncomfortable with wires dragging on her skin. She's more of a rubber curry comb type gal, I guess. Besides the size and wire bristle problems, the plastic itself felt a little brittle and cheap and when you add in the mechanics of retractable bristles... I think higher quality material would have been a better choice because that slider for the bristles is very basic. Finally, while I loved the idea of the easy-to-clean retractable bristles, they really aren't necessary and if those wires become crooked or bent it will cause all kinds of problems with the retraction. I've made it decades by just pulling the fur out of my slicker brushes-- it literally takes 2-3 seconds-- and while the thought of retractable bristles is nice, it totally isn't necessary. It's not a practical tool for me and doesn't work for any of my animals due to its size and the wire bristles. It also doesn't seem terribly well-made nor is it made of high-quality materials, and for the price it should be.

AGJS5RN6QYCYPGH42JZGQFFOSXKQ.review_title: Look great, easy to apply, hard to remove
