AGN5KJZU3FYSKVWXWM66LXYWL5CQ.review_title: Nice medium sized lotion or sanitizer bottles
AGN5KJZU3FYSKVWXWM66LXYWL5CQ.review_text: These are nice medium sized hand lotion or sanitizer bottles.  They have flip tops that have a positive snap when closing and that is a benefit for me. My granddaughter loves this fun Christmas headband.

AGN5KJZU3FYSKVWXWM66LXYWL5CQ.review_title: My wife did not like these hair ties.
AGN5KJZU3FYSKVWXWM66LXYWL5CQ.review_text: My wife did not like these hair ties. They tangled up in her hair and we had to cut it out.
My wife likes the look of these Bobby pins. They hold her hair well.

My wife likes these rubber bands. Her hair is shorter so they work nicely to secure her hairstyles. They are very lightweight. They don’t stretch out too much either. It doesn’t pull her hair out or tangle her hair. The bag they came in is nice too. She loves these.
These little clips are very sturdy. My wife loves them. They are simple not gaudy. They hold your hair.
My wife didn’t like how these head bands are not flexible. She doesn’t believe these fit comfortably on adult heads. They don’t stretch and are too tight.

My wife was looking forward to wearing these to work since she has to put her hair up. Yes, her long thick hair fit into the hole. When it was time to twist a pretty bow, it wouldn’t twist tight enough so she couldn’t utilize these items.
My wife loves these Scrunchies. She can wear them casually or dressy. They are both classy and elegant. They hold your hair tight and comfortable.
This bath bomb set is beautiful. My wife was so happy with this. The rose petals add romance to a luxurious bath scented with lavender and rose.

My wife states that these  curlers are comfortable for her to sleep in. She prefers to wash her hair at night and roll it. Her hair is shiny and not frizzy. The curls are radiant, bouncy and light. The curls last for several days in her straight hair. These are simple to use!

This soap works great. It has a quick lather and rinses away easily. One sheet does the job right. The light fragrance is a nice touch. I like the tin it comes with. It is easy to toss into a bag and go!

My wife loves this 4D Silk Fiber Mascara. She states this eyeliner adds beautiful length and incredible thickness to her shorter lashes. It’s simple to apply.  The mascara remains on her lashes until the next day but must be removed with make up wipes.

My wife is new to having gel nail polish at home. She usually goes to the nail salon to have her gel polish professionally applied. This set is very nice and there are only two colors out of five that she will not use, because the colors she feels are too young for her. The gel polish is fairly durable and peels off easily when she wants to remove it. The kit comes with two different top coats... one is very shiny and the other is a matte finish. My wife highly recommends this set.
This shampoo works well and has a great lather. It smells nice and doesn’t cause any headaches. It rinses out of my hair easily. It doesn’t leave a greasy texture. My hair is smooth and shiny.

My wife likes this item. She uses it on her bottom lid on the waterline. It is a natural look with a nice touch of sparkle that is not gaudy or overpowering. The liner is long lasting and removes easily.

AGN5R4K2X2CIV3WBSWHNDRUWTWQA.review_text:
This hose head is really made well. It’s solid metal and has a nice heavy duty feel to it. I was a little confused at first because it comes with that smaller screw in attachment already screwed into the base. I almost though I got something that wasn’t for a garden hose but you just need to unscrew it an take that piece out if your using with a standard garden house.

The water stream comes out very strong and it is adjustable by turning the head. It does have the little metal clip so you can lock it and not have to keep holding the handle down. What I really like though is the water pressure aspect. I’ve been using those expandable garden hoses and they tend to not give you much pressure. This head really gives you the extra pressure and makes it so I can reach the further spots of the yard. I’m very impressed with this. All around it’s a well made product.

NEOGEN DERMALOGY REAL CHARCOAL PAD 5.07oz / 150ml (60 PADS)

These wipes are absolutely amazing! I was super impressed by how refreshing these feel. Despite the charcoal, they are rather smooth but do exfoliate to a degree.

First off these are very well packaged. They come incredibly moist, not dried out at all. Hard to believe there are 60 of them in the container but there are. Despite it being a little small one wipe is more than enough for a single usage because of how much moisture is in each wipe.

These work really well on dry skin. They don’t feel oily but they certainly feel like the ingredients are being absorbed by my skin. They have a faint scent that is pleasant and just as refreshing as they feel. The price is fair given how many you get and the quality of them. All around this is a great product.

FOR BELOVED ONE Melasleep Brightening Lumi's key Bio-Cellulose Facial Treatment Mask (33g x 1PC)

This is an impressive gel face mask. I love the feeling of this mask. It’s a heavy gel mask that is anything but dry. It’s extremely refreshing.

I will say the directions are brief. When you take it out it’s tri-folded (the one image above are the two outer layers and the mask was in between those). It does rip if you aren’t cautious with it. There are 3 layers. Once you gently unfold it you peel off the first layer. Then apply to the face and after doing so peel off the outside cover. It is much easier if you pull out the eye holes and mouth hole before placing on your face. It does have a fair amount of staying power once it’s in place for a minute. Directions state to leave it on for 10-15 minutes. I left mine on for probably about 20 minutes.

The end result was great. My skin felt clean, rejuvenated, and soft. I really am impressed with the results given my hesitation to try a brand I wasn’t familiar with. I wish I had more of these because I would love to use them on a regular basis but the cost is a bit unrealistic to me.

Thus the one negative with this mask. The price point is very steep. I’ve had many masks that worked very well for much less. Now I did have a particularly great result from this mask so don’t get me wrong it may very well be worth the money to some. I’m just not one of those people that could justify it to myself. However, I do love the feeling I have after using it. I am not going to knock the product rating for the price point because that is really the only thing that I don’t like here. The product itself is really good and I’m happy with the results. I would just reiterate that the listing is for a single mask.

Spa-Da Immunity Support Soap 6pk | 7 Essential Oils Clinically Evaluated to Boost Immunity and Protect | Moisturizes with Sweet Almond Oil | Healthy PH for Skin Microbiome | Handmade in Ohio-

Pros-
Great for exfoliating
Hydrating
Skin feels great after usage
Made in the USA

Cons-
The scent is very strong of clove (too much so for me) It's the only scent I can smell from the soap.
Breaks down very fast
Fewer suds than traditional soap ( more suds than I would have thought but still less)

I was a bit thrown off by this soap. Before getting it I was thinking it was going to be like regular soap but when you see it it’s anything but regular soap. My roommate and I were both a bit confused thinking perhaps these were bath bombs because the look is similar to bath bombs more than it is to bar soap. I had to revisit the listing to double-check that it is meant to be used as soap.

Usage is interesting. It does break down very quickly though it stays intact long enough to use as bar soap. You just don’t get many washes out of each bar. With water, it does suds up a good amount which I like. It also gets a bit milky looking and the gritty texture does exfoliate too.

After using it I like the feeling of it on my skin. My skin feels a little tingly, refreshed, and soft. So it does work well for me as a soap but it just doesn’t last long.

The scent is not my favorite at all. Some might enjoy the scent but it’s very strongly clove-scented. It’s a bit too overbearing for my tastes. The scent also seems to last on my skin for a little longer than normal bar soap would. If I was more fond of the scent this would be a good thing.

Overall it’s a decent product but it’s not really for me. I just don’t love the scent and it’s a bit too different from normal bar soap for me. I love the exfoliating ability of this soap. That is the one area I really liked and I would buy this if I found a scent I enjoyed. The price is reasonable given that you get 6 bars. I would say they last maybe 1/3rd to 1/4th of the length of most bar soaps and that might be a stretch.

For Beloved Girl Extreme Moisture Mineral Cloud-Silk Facial Treatment Mask for Sensitive Skin, (25g x 1PC)-

I actually liked this mask quite a bit. It’s not quite up to par with the other mask I’ve tried by this brand (the other was a completely different style of face mask though). This is a good sheet mask. It is rather thin however it didn’t rip at all when I applied it. It is a little tricky to put on though. It comes with a plastic frame to help guide it when applying. I still did have that issue where the mask rolled up a little in the corner when I peeled off the plastic frame. I had to try to unravel the sections that did this after it was on my face which eventually I was able to do.

Pros-
Refreshing and hydrating.

Does moisturizes very well. They put enough of the product in that I was able to apply the extra over areas the mask didn’t cover.

My skin felt very soft after using this.

Cons-
Difficult to apply evenly. It’s not too much worse than the average sheet mask though.

I don’t like the full ingredients list isn’t available or at least not easy to find. I see they highlight the “key ingredients” but not the full list.

Overall I do like this mask because the results were very good for me. My face felt cleansed and hydrated. I do think it’s a little on the pricey side for the type of mask it is but it’s not by much so I would reorder this. The ingredients not being fully transparent is something I wish they would change. The results were good for me though.

Winky Lux Orchid Gelee Serum | Skin Brightening Serum | Hydrating Serum with Hyaluronic Acid & Ogliopeptide (30 mL / 1 fl. oz)

(Written by my Roommate)
The first thing I love about the Winky Lux serum is the smell! It smells very floral and light. It feels good, I use this in my skincare routine before a moisturizer, after I get out of the shower. It feels okay on my skin, whenever you dispense some product out- it appears some of the flowers come out and they do not dissolve very well or rub into the skin. They come out in small flakes. That’s the only downside of this I would say. I did use this on a dry patch of skin I had, and it recovered within 3-4 days. I would buy this again.

Ingredients: Aqua/Water/Eau, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Panthenol, Propanediol, Betaine, Phenoxyethanol, Acrylates Copolymer, Ethylhexylglycerin, PPG-26-Buteth-26, PEG/PPG-20/6 Dimethicone, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Sodium Hydroxide, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl P-Cresol, Sodium Phytate, Parfum (Fragrance), Calcium Alginate, Agar, Gellan Gum, 1,2-Hexanediol, Propylene Glycol, Dendrobium Nobile Extract, Sodium Hyaluronate, Citric Acid, Benzyl Salicylate, CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), CI 73360 (Red 30 Lake).

AGNGL5CYYEB5CZLIRD5F5XSX2H4A.review_text: Heats more than expected but doesn't burn or hurt. You have to carefully make sure the lashes are straight and not going the wrong way or they will stay that way. Best idea is use a regular curler and set the curl with this. Handy little tool. Glad I bought it. Won't use it everyday, just special occasions.

This mascara was a big surprise. It performs like a very expensive mascara at a drugstore price. No smudging, flaking or clumping. Washes off with pure water and a bit of rubbing. Add some cleanser and it's effortless to remove. I can fall asleep with it on and no black eyes in the morning, just a few flakes from sleeping. It offers full volume and lengthens well. If you use a curler, you can get a very dramatic effect. It's buildable for more false eyelash looks without being clumpy. The wand is not straight. It is like a smiley face curve. But with a twist of the end, it curves into a "u" shape to get different angles. I would love this even with a normal straight brush.
The only complaint is that it dries out faster than others I've used, but is about the same as tarte waterproof in this regard. My favorite mascara so far! I will be ordering extras in case it's discontinued.

Did not like. It added thickness and darkened my lashes. But it was really clumpy. It went on like a mousse, kind of fluffy. I think thats what made it clump. It also clumped the lashes together besides leaving balls of mascara clumps on the lashes. I hoped for better based on the reviews, but it didn't go on nicely at all. It was sweatproof, yet it did smear over night just a bit. Honestly, it looked exactly the same in the morning as it did when I first applied it, besides the slight smudge under one eye. So I have to say, that's pretty bad to look like you slept in your mascara when it's been freshly applied. Big thumbs down on this one.

AGNGL5CYYEB5CZLIRD5F5XSX2H4A.review_title: Hard to remove and only use one coat or it will glue up on you.

Pass on this one.

You can't do more than one coat though, cause it makes your lashes stick together really badly and you have to remove it and start again. AGNJID7V5HC2MUMHJWCFWSA3NKNQ.review_text: These masks are really nice and make my skin feel fresh and hydrated. They are also vegan and cruelty free which is great (my cat approves, see pics lol). AGNLPA354S3FXAGZ3FQP37X2MLZA.review_title: Spray Nozzles Leak, Glass Is Durable
AGNLPA354S3FXAGZ3FQP37X2MLZA.review_text:
We are the home where spray bottles go to die. My oldest 3 (10,8, and 6) help with cleaning around the house and they do their fair share of abuse to spray bottles. My 4 yr old likes to hide the spray bottles. This means that I (frequently) buy new spray bottles and have tried quite a few.
These are the first glass spray bottles that I've tried. I've always been leary of glass because I was afraid it would break, but hey, with all the plastic ones we've managed to destroy I figured it was worth a shot. The glass part on these is super heavy. And surprisingly durable. These have lasted quite awhile now and that includes being dropped on laminate and tile floors. I'm impressed. The blue color is pretty striking too.
Now for the bad. The nozzles leak terribly. When you spray them they drip all over your hand and make a mess. We've just kind of dealt with it because we use natural cleaner and I'm not worried about the chemicals, but obviously you don't want to buy something that works like it's already damaged. Maybe a different spray nozzle will fit the tops of these bottles?

My mom always had an aloe plant growing up that we used on our sunburns. I still think that's the best way to go, but I also kill every aloe plant I have so this is a pretty good 2nd. It feels very similar to the aloe straight out of the aloe plant although it is stickier. It works well on burns. The nozzle works great and the bottle itself feels pretty well made, so no leaks or issues there. I like the pump aspect of the top. Nice to have hand.

This is a super cute set. The colors are cute and great colors to have. The gloss itself goes on easily, has good flavor, and feels good on. I (and my daughter) haven't had any issues with reactions or anything like that. I would say this set is definitely geared more toward girls than for adults (though you could totally wear it if you just want a gloss on for an hour as a woman.) It's not long lasting, but my daughter doesn't really care about that.

AGNMJIU3VXBRQMQG6JJQYPQBI2ZQ.review_text: Great mask to use after a long day. The mask is well coated with the honey tea tree serum on a mesh-like sheet. I use the extra serum in the package and apply it on my neck and arms. It's soothing and refreshing, and the scent is not to strong. It made my skin feel soft and supple. It didn't irritate my skin at all. Next time, I'll put it in fridge prior to using for a more cooling experience.

It does lightly scrub the back a bit. Lathers and spreads the body wash well, however, it is sort of heavy and a pain to use. I’ll still use it but not on a daily basis. I hang it over the shower door because there’s no where to rest it in the tub area

I like the cooling effect it gave when I applied it to my skin. It comes with a big spatula that you use to apply and remove the gel. I use this 1-2x week to give my irritated skin a break. Had to refer back to their amazon product page to get the directions on how to use and for how long. I apply a good amount to my face and leave it on for 20 minutes. The gel smells very herbal and has tiny bits of artemisia leaf in it.  The mask did help reduce the redness on my cheeks and nose. It left my skin feeling moisturized and refreshed. Definitely recommend for people with irritated and oily skin or after a long week of wearing a tight N95 mask.

AGNMJIU3VXBRQMQG6JJQYPQBI2ZQ.review_title: Biodegradable wipes but not the packaging
AGNMJIU3VXBRQMQG6JJQYPQBI2ZQ.review_text: These wipes are okay to use when your hands are feeling soiled. They're saturated and well stay pretty wet for a few minutes or so.  Unscented and doesn't leave my hands dry or sticky. The size of the wipe is a little smaller compared to other hand wipes. The wipes do have phenoxyethanol, which can contain trace amounts of 1, -dioxane (carcinogen) but apparently it's safe at low levels (FYI). It's stated on the box that they try to be zero waste, but honestly... not really. They come individually packaged in a plastic bag and in a box, which are both not biodegradable. It would've been better if the wipes came all together in one packet instead of individual packs. It would've reduced some waste. The wipes are expensive at $.90 each. Not worth it in my opinion.

This body wash isn't the best. You need at least 5-8 pumps for it to somewhat lather and coat the skin. I use a body glove with this wash by the way. The scent smells okay, however, it does smell like stuff you'd use to clean the bathroom or other household objects. Haven't had an allergic reactions to it. It doesn't really moisturize but doesn't strip the skin and dry it out. Great that it is vegan and plant-derived but there's nothing special about this body wash. I wouldn't recommend it.

It’s a great vitamin C ampoule but you need to use it within 3 mths. I keep it in the fridge to extend the life of this serum. It’s slightly thick like oil and has a very pale yellow hue to it. The scent of this stuff is faint and subtle but doesn’t smell bad. It’s kept in a dark glass bottle to prevent light when effecting the serum. It absorbs into the skin well and it has helped with my skin complexion. Great stuff!

Love these hair ties. You get a great assortment of the spiral cord, regular cotton ties and one small pink scrunchie. They do a good job of keeping my thick hair up without tugging on my hair. Usually I need 2 of the goodie brand hair ties to keep my hair up the way I want but just one of these ties does the trick. They’re are a tad tight to keep on my wrist but the ties come in a nice carrying bag. With goodie hair ties I usually stretchy them out after 10+ uses. Hoping these will be durable. For the price, it’s a great deal!

I’m loving this sunscreen so far! It’s lightweight and leaves a nice matte/satin finish on my skin. It actually doesn’t make my skin oily nor leave a whitecast. The product feels like a lotion that glides on easy and absorbs well into my skin. There’s almost no scent to it, which is a plus. It contains pretty good ingredients to prevent water loss and keeps the skin hydrated and reduces the look of wrinkles! Definitely will be my go-to summer sunscreen!

The lotion is just okay, nothing too special about it. The consistency is definitely like lotion and more on the thinner side. I prefer a more creamy texture for hand creams. The scent is okay, more like a powder green tea type scent. Easy squeeze bottle and screw on cap. You get 4 nicely individually packaged lotions that would make a great gift or stocking stuffer. Wouldn't get this again.

[[VIDEOID:f5186c2a8d0ee855988958b8d347349f]] The packaging is nice but I’m not a fan of the shape of the lipstick. When twisting to get my product the lipstick would retract back. It’s weird to apply it at the corners of the lips. Also, when I opened the cap, a bit of the lipstick corner smudged against the lid. It glides on easy, isn’t sticky and it’s very moisturizing the color is vibrant. It’s not an all-day lip product because this can easily come off when eating or drinking. For 13.99? Nah..not worth it. It’s cheaper and better long lasting lipsticks out there

Just super soft skin with a scent that never fails to boost my mood and I like that the smell stays with me through a lot of the day instead of fading 20 min after using. I did receive this at a discounted price, but I would and will pay full price for this product, and not only because it's the best smelling lotion in my opinion, but because it's super effective and the tube goes a long way since you need a lot less product than you think you do. AGNTJQ2C66IPH76GICZOP4DYBA3Q.review_title: Really didn't expect it to make as big of a difference as it did
AGNTJQ2C66IPH76GICZOP4DYBA3Q.review_text: I am very religious about my skin care and surprisingly I have never used a jade roller until now. I use a derma roller, a facial stream mister machine, a24ct good vibrating and and LED light therapy. I guess I figured I didn't need ANOTHER skin care device.. But I've been proven wrong. I've been using it once a day now for over 2 weeks and they really do show results. But only the immediate and temporary lifting effect you get right after using but now I can clearly see the contours of my face much more clearly, and sharper than before. My skin now looks tighter and almost like a had a mini face tuck.  I admit that I honestly did not think a jade roller was really something that would live up to the hype about it in all the beauty and skin care blogs /magazines, but I underestimated it.  I know a lot of people put their in the fridge prior to use, but I find the stone itself is cool enough Ashdod my skin without putting it in my refrigerator.. The stone is very delicate and easily breakable and I can just imagine my Daughter or Fiancee accidentally knocking it into the kitchen floor.  I love that it has 2 sides.. A large roller and a small one for areas such as your eyes and around your mouth. I have no complaints whatsoever with this particular roller.. It shows results, glides over my skin smoothly.. The roller never skips it gets stuck, and it even came with a little diagram showing you the best direction to roll in on each part of your face for optimum results. So, if anyone has been curious about jade rollers, I recommend you give it a try. Just follow the diagram to see best results and follow the care instructions so that your roller lasts as long as possible (just includes cleaning of with a damp washcloth and doing with a terry cloth before putting it back in the box. You'll immediately notice just how much faster your skin care absorbs fully and deeper into your skin. I always use either the Sunday Riley C.E.O. Glow Face Oil, Loreal Age Perfect Face Oil during the day and either the Biossance Squallene Oil or S.R. Luna Sleeping Night Oil as my last skin care step before using the roller and the time difference is it if this world. I used to get super impatient waiting for my face oil to absorb so I could start applying makeup or finish my night routine,but the recommended 10 min a day with the roller and there's not even a trace of an oily residue in my face! AGOJ45XJ42CHCMELYK7Z6EZNYE4Q.review_title: Love this mirror! Great price & awesome quality!
AGOJ45XJ42CHCMELYK7Z6EZNYE4Q.review_text:
I recently stayed at a high end hotel that had a mirror just like this in every single room. I loved it so much that I came home after my travel and starting looking for one. I found them at several home type stores, but the cost was over a hundred for each one I found. I held off thinking eventually I will find one at a better price. I came across the Kenley Wall Mounted Magnifying Makeup Mirror on Amazon at half of what I had seen elsewhere.

I had the opportunity to purchase the Kenley mirror at a promotional price in exchange for an honest and unbiased review. I immediately
jumped at the chance.

The mirror came a few days ago. I waited till today to install when my husband could help me. The mirror came with almost everything you need to install the mirror - including the screws and anchors. For tools, we used a level and a cordless screwdriver. The installation instructions were easy to understand and they included drawings. We were able to install the mount in about five minutes.

The mirror itself is very nice and well made. One side is regular and the other is 3 times magnifying. It is a chrome silver. There is a LED ring in the inside and in between the mirrors. It requires 4 - AA batteries. You have to unscrew one side of the mirror to install the batteries. It is easy to unscrew and screw back on. You do want to make sure that the mirror is screwed back on tightly. The LED lights are turned on my a switch on the outside of the mirrors.

The LED light is great, with the combination of the either mirror. Plucking my brows was easier than ever before on the magnifying side with the LED light turned on. The mirror both turns and flips. The bracket has an extending arm, so that you can manipulate the mirror to wherever you need it to be. It folds up nicely to be stored against the wall. The mirror is also the perfect size for a mounted mirror. In my picture below you can see the mirror is size relation to an outlet in my wall.

This is exactly what I wanted, from the moment I saw a similar mirror at the Hotel Philips in KS City. I strongly recommend it!

AGPCJNECQMG7LPLITZVHXP3F2HUA.review_title: Color Kit 3- Beautiful colors, long-lasting finish, but poor marketing job
AGPCJNECQMG7LPLITZVHXP3F2HUA.review_text:
Manicures and pedicures are a routine event in our home, especially with restrictions on public outings. With younger children, picking nail polish is a given, so despite the gel’s potential to last for up to two weeks, they manage to remove it in just a few days. For them, though, it means another nail session and new colors, so no big deal. The gel nail polish was hopefully our answer to increase the duration and longevity of their finished nails.

Anzuo Gel Nail Polish offers attractive color kits. We received the Kit 3 set, which contains black, red, white, and three shades of tan to brown. Like others have commented, the lids only contain numbers, and the kit includes stickers where the user has to create the swatches. This is an inconvenience, but not the end of the world. We found it to be a good test to see how the gel polish would actually apply and then finish.

The gel was rather thick, even after keeping it at room temperature, and rolling it to ensure sufficient mixing. With thinner and increased coats, the polish results in deep, beautiful colors that we really enjoy. The white looks like white-out, even with a top clear coat, though. The black and red are the favorites in our home.

The main problem we experienced and shared with others is the inconsistency and deficiencies in the product’s marketing. There are typos, poor translation and grammar, and worse yet, is the inconsistency in the cure times advertised by the company on the Amazon site and the actual shipping box. The box says cure time is 10-30 seconds by LED/UV lamp, but the website says time frames up to 120 seconds. That is a huge difference that seriously impacts the quality and life of the nail finish. We cure using time frames of 60-120 seconds, depending upon the wattage used by our lamp. With these longer cure times, we have been able to keep the polish looking well and intact for over a week now, even on our children’s nails.

If you can overlook the need to label the bottles, disregard the spelling and grammatical errors, and then utilize your own cure times, the Anzuo gel polish is worth using.

Good liquid latex is every nail artist's best friend. I decided to purchase this jar after using up my supply of prepared/bottled liquid latex varieties, and I am so glad I did. Prior to discovering Liquid Latex Fashions, I was buying liquid latex marketed as "nail art tape". In terms of package price and the consistent quality of product, I find that this is the much better option. As long as I continue to stamp, water marble and do gradient nails I will continue to use THIS. Here are the highlights as to why I think Liquid Latex Fashions is superior to all the rest:

* Package size is 4 ounces and an ample supply for simple nail art. It is smaller in real life than what it appears in the ad photos. I have been using this as my go-to for the past six months and have barely made a dent in it. I suspect that it will probably dry up before I can get through it all.
* Product is simple to decant - the large mouth on the jar makes it easy to use an infant medicine syringe to draw the liquid up and dispense into a clean nail polish bottle. (You can get the plastic medi syringes for free at the pharmacy counter - all you have to do is ask.)
* Consistency is thin/watery, which is easy to apply and dries very fast. It turns to a dark pink when it's dry. One layer works great for me, but you can add more layers if needed.
* It peels so good! Always a clean peel in one solid sheet - no bits and pieces of latex that break off. You can literally roll your fingertip across the edge and peel it off in one whole piece. No more fighting with latex removal after doing a gorgeous gradient!
* FYI: Ammonia free does not mean odorless. This product does not smell good at all. If you've used any type of liquid latex before, you know it does have a distinguishable smell. It is somewhere between fish oil and cat urine. Or a mixture of both. Yeah, it stinks to be perfectly honest. Just be forewarned.
* Pricing of this is so much more economical versus prepared varieties. In fact, I wouldn't be surprised if some folks weren't just repackaging this and slapping their brand labels on it.
* The bonus to THIS particular liquid latex - it's black light reactive... so if you plan on going to an all-night rave anytime soon, you can wear this and you'll glow all night! lol ;)

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Highly recommended and I will most definitely repurchase when I hit tub bottom. Thanks for reading!

Seriously though, one more thing - In order to keep the latex fresh and from drying up, you should make sure to wipe any excess latex from around the neck of the jar. Keep the lid screwed on tight when not in use, and store it in a cool dry place.

This set of bottles from MOSTOF checks both of those boxes. ✔ I tested them specifically against 2 different types of liquid (not gel) sanitizer. Initially, I chose this particular set for the larger sized funnels that are also included, and the fact that it comes with (10) travel sized bottles.

None of my bottles leak and they spray a fine, even mist without leaving droplets. After seeing the spray function in action, I decided to use a couple of these for facial mists and essences. Ultimately, I had to dock a star from my rating because the bottles came filthy inside, 😬 every one of them is heavily scratched up, and one of the bottles I received doesn't sit evenly. ➡️(see photos 3&4: defect (warped) bottle is on the right)⬅️

+ Convenient PRIME shipping
+ Bonus sheet of labels (they're small, but they work)

CONS:

AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_title: Transfer resistant formula 😷 with excellent coverage! Unlike any BB cream I've ever tried!

The Fromnature BB cream by Cosmocos is unlike any beauty balm I've ever tried. It has much better coverage, and a thicker consistency than any other BB's I've used (which, until now, have all been Western brands). It almost covers like a foundation, but feels extremely lightweight like a BB. It does dry down really fast, and it was a bit darker than I expected. I am light neutral in complexion and chose the shade "light beige". I believe I was able to make the color work for me, but I'm not sure if it'll suit all light skin tones. 👻

This BB has a beautiful satin matte finish, but did have a tendency to cling to my dry patches, so be sure to start with an exfoliated, well moisturized, and primed face. I did not use any primer with this product, (since it's marketed as a BB cream), and without the aid of a pore filling primer this product did eventually settle into my fine lines & large pores. I am really impressed with the staying power of this product though, even without primer & setting spray! After a full day of masking against covid in the South Florida heat, there was no transfer to my face mask. 😃 That's a huge, HUGE plus! With that being said, I highly recommend using a really good cleanser to efficiently remove this product at the end of the day.

PROS:
+ Great coverage that can be built up
+ Very lightweight on the skin
+ Excellent staying power
+ SPF 50
+ Transfer resistant! 🙌
+ No photo flashback!
+ Fragrance free!
+ 1.67 oz of product (vs. the U.S. standard 1 fl. oz)
+ 2 sample hair care products included as a bonus! ❤
+ Convenient PRIME Shipping

CONS:
- Dries very fast and can be difficult to blend
- Clings to dry patches
- Settles into pores & wrinkles (without primer)

TO BE CONSIDERED:
* Warm yellow undertone may not suit everyone

Side Note: There was one other thing I wanted to mention... When I took the manufacturer safety seal off of the tube, I had a volcanic eruption of BB cream that I wasn't prepared for, which made a mess of my tube. If you're like me and don't want to waste precious product, just be aware that it might come spilling out like lava when you break the product seal. 🙃

AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_title: Pretty packaging, lovely scent 🌹 The best of Touch in Sol No Poreblem primers in a sample size set
AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_text:
This is a really nice travel sized set of the Touch in Sol No Poreblem primers, which comes in a cute box, suitable for gifting. The products are deluxe sample sizes, which is a perfect way to try out the line and find your favorite. 🌹

I will start off with the Priming Water and Priming Essence. Both of these products come in dropper style ampoules. Neither of mine were filled to the top. These bottles are already on the smaller side, so it was especially disappointing to see missing product. For that, I've docked a star. [see photos attached, including one with a nail polish bottle for scale of sizing.]

Both the Essence and Water feels like a light oil in texture. They spread easily, absorb quickly, and are meant to be used as the last step in your skin care. The No Poreblem primer in a tube is your silicone based makeup primer. It has that familiar silky finish, and does do a good job of blurring the pores. This is not so much a pore "filling" primer; this one works more to smooth them out, and creates a nice base for your foundation.

All of the products in this set have a light rose scent, which smells divine. I am not usually fond of most rosy florals because they are always either too strong, smell artificial, or very old lady-ish. This scent is none of those things. Touch in Sol has nailed the rose fragrance - it's lightweight, very fresh, and I really enjoy it. As someone who is skin sensitive to added fragrance, I had zero reactions to any of these products. 🌹
The ingredients lineup on this CureCode Neuromide Ampoule is impressive, but the integrity of this product is questionable since the safety sticker was broken.

AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_title: One coat coverage, buttery smooth formulas & special FX finishes! 😍 Amazing set of polishes!
AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_text:
This set of gel polishes from Pine Gel really blew me away! These cover in one easy coat and have a nice glossy finish. The glitter polish was a little bit thick, but it's packed with glitter so I guess that's to be expected. This set of six shades contains (1) Glitter, (3) Crèmes, (2) Magnetics, and a cats eye magnet wand needed to work the magnetic polishes. All of the colors cure for 60 secs in an LED lamp or 90 secs in a UV.

The crèmes are all buttery smooth in application, and self level beautifully. Each dry down to a nice glossy finish. The magnetics are easy to manipulate with the enclosed magnet stick. I was able to do a double cat eye line on my first try! (These are gonna be a lot of fun to play with using different shaped magnets for different effects.) Both magnetic polishes covered completely in one easy coat. The glitter shade is jam-packed with small royal blue glitters and is accented with a sprinkling of medium sized blue hexagons. The depth and sparkle to this polish is incredible. The glitter load makes this shade a little bit thick - but it's still workable. None of these gel polishes have a bad odor. None of them gave me any issues during application or the curing process. I cannot speak to the wear time, as I always use a peel-off base coat or full coverage tips, with gel polish products.

Because these are so rich in pigment, (and a lot of them are dark colors), it is best to work in thin coats. They do cure with a sticky layer. All of these (except the glitter) cured for 60 sec in my LED lamp. With the thickness and opacity of the glitter polish, I did a double cure on that one to be safe. All swatches in this review are ONE coat and are shown WITHOUT top coat.

I think the coverage, formula, and finishes of these polishes is amazing and absolutely worth the price. I highly recommend these! Thanks for reading. :) If my review and photos were helpful to you in any way, please click the button below to let me know. Thanks!

AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_title: A beautiful assortment of rainbow colors in a variety of finishes! 🌈 Stellar formula!

AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_title: The LED aspect explained & my experience with these masks 🎭 (spoiler alert: I LOVE them!)
AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_text:
THIS IS A LENGTHY REVIEW, BUT I THINK IT'S WORTH THE READ:

Avajar is a k-beauty skincare manufacturer out of Seoul, Korea, closely affiliated with the K-pop group, Super Junior, who is the face of the brand. Avajar, as a company, has been making face products since 2019, with a focus on offering quality ingredients at a fair price. In this particular product they have created (a series of) sheet masks that contain the same cream as their LED Ring Light Cream Moisturizer. The original LED Ring Light Cream Moisturizer is pictured here on the sheet mask packaging. That moisturizer actually comes with a mini LED light on top of the jar, which was designed to be used as the product applicator. The LED cream in a jar was a top seller for Avajar, and so they expanded on the delivery system to include sheet masks. With all that being said, these masks do not come with an LED light (but if you already have one of your own, you could certainly use it with this product). I just wanted to pass this info along to clear up the confusion surrounding the marketing terms used on these masks.

For context: My skin is dry and dehydrated, very sensitive and product reactive. I have not experienced any issues from using these masks, outside of some temporary erythemia (a.k.a. skin flushing, which I experience regularly). These masks are formulated without any artificial colors, fragrance, silicons, and parabens. This is not to say these masks are fragrance free, because they absolutely have a scent. The smell is rather herbal to me, which I believe is attributed to fruit and flower essences used in the cream. All Avajar products are made in a cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practices) certified lab. However, I do not see any claims of cruelty-free status, neither on the package nor on their website.

I do self care Sundays every week and will wear a sheet mask for 30 minutes while I relax in bed. Putting this mask on is pretty messy. You'll want to apply it over your bathroom sink because the cream is on the watery side and will drip everywhere. There is a generous amount of the cream essence inside the package and on the mask. The sheet mask material is super thin and hugs the contours of my face well. It's a nice size and sticks well, so you can actually wear one and move about, without having it lift or slide all over. After 30 minutes I peel the mask off and massage the remaining product into my skin. There isn't any stickiness and the cream absorbs nicely. My skin feels baby soft, supple, and deeply moisturized each time I use one. These masks come in a box of 5 and there's 3 formulas to choose from - Hydrating {blue} (which is the one I got), Whitening {yellow}, and Nourishing {red}. I have really enjoyed using these in my weekly sheet masks rotation. The price is extremely reasonable for such great quality. I love the results I've gotten and I recommend them entirely! I just purchased the Nourishing set and will definitely repurchase these hydrating masks when I run out.

PRO'S:
+ Adds moisture to dry, dehydrated skin
+ Soothes and calms skin irritation
+ Skin feels soft, supple & deeply nourished after use
+ No artificial color, fragrance, silicon, parabens
+ Mask material hugs facial contours
+ Masks don't slip & slide off the face
+ Fast absorption - refreshes in 20-30 minutes
+ Comes in a pack of 5 at a cost of $1.55 a piece
+ Perfect for a relaxing self care session
+ Conveniently shipped on PRIME

CONS:
- None

AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_title: These flakes dissolve faster than any salt I've ever used 🦆💦
AGPGFFJDCKXPNBWCC5YP2ZUDPNGA.review_text:
First off, this bag of Magnesium flakes from Horbäach is huge! I've pictured it next to a full sized bag of Dr. Teal's Magnesium salts, for reference. You definitely get a lot of bang for your buck here. This bag of Magnesium flakes is fragrance free, so you have more options as well. You can scent the portions individually, (if you so choose), by adding a few drops of your favorite essential oils, or you can simply use it as-is. The flakes dissolve quicker than any of the commercially prepared salts I've ever used, which make these perfect for soaking. Skin is baby soft after a 20 minute bath, and muscle fatigue is greatly reduced. Magnesium Chloride soaks have helped my husband's charlie horses become far less frequent. Unfortunately he can't absorb Magnesium from his diet, so we have to supplement. Without this and high quality vitamins, he would suffer.

There are some things I didn't realize when I ordered this product, but I found to be very interesting after researching the difference between Magnesium Chloride vs. Magnesium Sulfate:

Both compounds contain a similar level of elemental Magnesium, but the key difference between Magnesium Chloride (flakes) and Magnesium Sulphate (salts) is the purity of Magnesium Chloride and the rate of its absorption within the body. It is reported that Magnesium Chloride is more easily absorbed and utilised by the body, compared to Epsom Salts.

This seems like a much better choice for our needs. I'm so glad to have discovered that something better like this exists, to help his condition.

I am not sure if my face was damp enough or if I didn't use enough product but the bubbly effect eased up & then the product dried a bit. AGQ5ERLI2VUZVYLQV5WYJ5TLGVYA.review_text:
The Philips Norelco Arcitec shaving system is designed to look good and feel good in your hand. It also has handy packaging, coming with two handy storage/charge mounts: one designed to stand up in your bathroom and another secure case for travel. Both mounts can be plugged in and charge the system. The only thing I don't like about these mounts is they don't have a space to carry the cleaning brush. Still, I haven't had to use the cleaning brush yet, since one of the best features of the Arcitec is that it can be cleaned in the tap: you just flip open the blade covers and run water over them. It cleans nicely. There is a very nice lcd display that shows how much battery time remains -- and the nice thing in terms of design is that you can't see the display unless it's on. Otherwise it hides completely beneath the chrome like finish of the handle -- no ugly lcd display turned off.

Enough about design: it looks great and feels great and has nice features. What about function? Does it shave well? The answer to that is a bit more complicated. The simple answer is: it gives a very smooth shave, IF you already have a fairly smooth shave. If you shave at least once a day and preferably twice a day I find that it keeps the face smooth and polished, and feels very even across the skin and shaves quickly. If you let it go for a day or two, however, and begin to show some stubble, the Arcitec doesn't like that. It can run over fairly short stubble over and over again before it finally trims it. Even the (fairly modest) click out trimmer can't cut significant stubble to a length that can be easily shaved by the Arcitec. This is unfortunate for me, since I like to let it go a day or two between shaves. I did, following the directions on the razor, give it about three weeks of solid shaving every day and that certainly did the trick keeping my skin feeling (almost) like a baby's, but I found after a few weeks I wanted to skip a day, and then tried to shave with the Arcitec and needed to pull out my disposable razor to finish the job. (I should mention that I once had a much cheaper razor -- you know, the $30 variety -- that I got for Christmas several years ago and it did seem to have greater tolerance for longer stubble. With that I could get away with shaving every couple of days.)

So, to sum up: this razor is very well designed for the basic application of shaving at least once a day. Very good for the distinguished gentleman, let's say. But for those a bit rough around the edges (or, as someone might put the point less charitably) for those who are too lazy to shave every day, it may not be the ideal choice.

AGQ5ERLI2VUZVYLQV5WYJ5TLGVYA.review_title: Works great for me -- I like the smell of the lotion, and the smoothness it brings to the shave
AGQ5ERLI2VUZVYLQV5WYJ5TLGVYA.review_text:
This is another excellent shaving product from Philips -- it cuts like an ordinary shaver, but with the added benefit of lubrication that helps it to shave smoothly. My skin doesn't get irritated or dry, and the lubrication seems to help the shave to go more quickly. I've tried other brands of shavers and this one seems to work the best.

This package comes with a squeeze bottle full of a very pleasant smelling lotion, that you inject into the back of the shaver. Then, when you are shaving, you just press a button and it releases enough lotion to lubricate about one third of the face. When it starts to feel like a dry shave, you press the button again and finish up.

I have found that the amount of lotion you can inject into the shaver is enough for about 5 to 6 shaves. The shaver comes with a small sample bottle of the lotion -- and I guess one drawback is that you have to keep buying the lotion, unless you want to use this like an ordinary dry shaver. I've tried that too and it seems to work as well as any other shaver I've tried. I prefer, though, to use the lotion. It feels good and has a nice aftershave smell that my wife also likes -- that's good enough for me.

Because the system is water resistant, you can shave in the shower, and you can wash it off in water when you are finished. The extendable trimmer isn't very useful, but I've never seen a shaver where they are. It comes fully recharged and after about two weeks of using it about every other day it is still working well -- I haven't charged it yet. I do wish there was some kind of indicator on the unit that would let me know how much charge remains, but all in all I am quite happy with this.

This is a thick, rich cream that, for me, has worked wonders on dry, scaly skin. My hands needed some serious help and after using this cream for just a few days, I have seen much improvement. My skin is much soft, the cracks are disappearing, and they feel moisturized. The cream is thick, a little goes a long way, and I’ve found it’s best to really rub it in, not list skim it over the skin and leave it. I have also been using the cream on a particularly itchy patch of skin on my back, again, with excellent results.
There is no scent.
The cream is made from several natural ingredients, most notably Manuka honey from New Zealand, something new to me, but that has been used for centuries in New Zealand. I’m glad it made its way to me in the USA!

When I opened this package, I had no idea what I was looking at. Inside the Amazon packaging bag was another bag, a plastic bag with a bubble wrap lining and a ziplock type zipper. Inside that, was what looked like a syringe. Honestly, I was at first convinced I had the wrong order as I had no recollection of ordering anything matching what I was seeing. Upon further investigation, I discovered it was the Play Pretend brand of under eye cream. Yes, the Amazon product page does state the the cream comes in a syringe-like tube, and yes, it does state that it comes with a skincare travel bag, this wasn’t what I had envisioned.
On to the product…
Once I figured out how to open and operate the syringe (hint: remove the large, clear cap, remove the white tip, turn the plunger to unlock) to dispense the under eye cream, I applied some to my face. The scent is strong, like cucumber with an underlying perfume smell. Not unpleasant, but kind of strong for me, someone who is overly sensitive to scents. My problem, I know, and most people will probably really enjoy the scent. The cream is white, smooth, goes on evenly and is absorbed quickly. There is a bit of a cooling sensation which I found pleasant.

The travel bag seems unnecessary to me. It’s really not much more than a heavy ziplock bag lined with bubble wrap with a large logo reading “Skin Set Go.” If someone needs a bag, great, but I have several and I don’t think I’ll be using this one.

According to the company’s website, Skin Care Go products are made in the USA in small batches. Good. A lot of natural ingredients go into the product, which I like, but the complete list of ingredients from the company’s website is as follows:

Water (Aqua), Carthamus Tinctorius Seed Oil, Polyacrylate-13, Glycerin, Propylene Glycol, Polyisobutene, Squalane, Sodium Hyaluronate, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Retinyl Palmitate, Tocopherol, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Butylene Glycol, Polysorbate 20, Acetyl Octapeptide-3, Caprylyl Glycol, Potassium Sorbate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Fragrance, Yellow 5 (CI 19140), Blue 1 (CI 42090).

The final verdict:
The product is nice, and while I’d personally prefer something less heavily scented, I like the way the cream works and what it does for my skin. It’s very hydrating and brightening, with nothing that irritated my skin. I understand the idea behind the syringe dispenser: it’s unique, it’s fun, it’s memorable. However, there’s a ton of plastic used that isn’t necessary, and with the design, I don’t know how I’ll know when the tube is nearing empty.
Overall, this is a good product, does what it says it does, and if you’re looking for something a little unusual, give it a try.

I’ve been trying out a couple of different lash serums over the past month. With my husband also using it (on his brows), while I use it on my lashes, we’ve been able to try different brands to see if there are any differences in results. This serum, by Kimuse, is very similar to the others in consistency (a thin liquid) and in how it’s applied (with a very thin brush). I have had no negative reactions to the serum, and no irritation to my eyes even when I’ve slipped and gotten some in my eye. This serum boasts results in as little as 3-4 weeks, while most others are more conservative at 6 weeks. In the few weeks we’ve been using the serums, neither of us have noticed any dramatic changes as far as lash or brow growth, but I do think I’m losing fewer lashes which is a definite plus. Honestly, I’m not sure if any serum is going to provide dramatic results, but we’ll continue for at least a few more weeks and see what happens while hoping for the best.Hopefully, I’ll be back with exciting news!

Update: After using this, as well as other, lash growth serums for several months, I have noticed a definite improvement in the length of my lashes. I have not noticed as significant an improvement in the thickness, or volume, of my lashes, however. I believe that these types of serums do help promote growth, and I haven't been able to detect much difference between brands except that a couple of them irritated my eyes. Therefore, my conclusion is that this is helpful and the real determination of what works best will be what's most comfortable for you to use, so read the ingredients and watch for any possible allergy triggers or irritants.

Foam is my favorite type of cleanser for all face/hand/body.
I especially love a gel to foam type as I feel that cleans deep into the skin.
So now, this is a bit different from others in that you have to invest at least 3-5 mins to use it properly. But I think that’s what makes this work so great.

Now when you put the pink gel on your face, don’t rub it too much. Just try to gently spread the gel fast. Then just wait without re-touching them. You will feel a bit of tingling sensation and can see it turns to lots of foams.
Then you can wash them off with warm water, and feel a soft and clean face of yours!
I might be biased as I love foaming cleansers to begin with, and this one has no unpleasant smell with a pretty pink color.
If you have never tried foaming cleanser like this, please give this a try and follow instructions closely to see the desired effect!

While I don't like any fragrance for my skin care products, this one didn't bother me ( probably because this reminds me of being at spa I guess.)
This oil isn't too light so it's good to massage in that if oil is too light and dry out too quickly, it's hard to use as massage oil in my case.
Overall, a decent one in my opinion but again I haven't had much experience with facial oils so I cannot confidently say this one is better than others in all aspects.

AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_title: Unique foaming soap, that is a cost effective choice  IMO.
AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_text:
The first time using castile soap, and it feels quite different from other foaming cleansers I have used. Usually foam gives you that creamy, soft feeling while washing your hands/face. Instead, I felt everything from my skin being sucked out by this castile soap and leaves clean but rather matte feeling ( not saying it dried out my skin, but feels like nothing is left behind kind of way). . But after a min or so, the skin feels quite soft. I only got this as an extra soap on my sink for an extra bath rather than as a regular face cleanser.
The most important factor I always consider for my review is cost effectiveness and for the price I got (it’s $5.99 at the time of delivery), I cannot complain.
It’s going to stay on my wash stand as an extra cleanser.

AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_title: A decent, cost effective toner pad that didn’t work for me.
AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_text:
I have tried many toner pads and this one stands out for its cost effectiveness in terms of quantity (and also quality based on its product detail page) vs price (especially the 20% off coupon offered at the time of this review).
The bottom line is this one seems like a decent quality calming pad that can be used not only for wiping impurities off your face like normal pads but also for calming and moisturizing skin by leaving them on your face for a while.

However, I wouldn’t go far as gentle enough for extremely sensitive skin.
I have an oily combination skin that gets rather sensitive depending on my menstrual cycle.
Now after I first tried this pad by wiping my face (to test the first impression), I felt a tingling-like sensation and my skin felt a bit uncomfortable. Well, my skin’s sensitivity was a bit at peak due to my magic cycle, but still my skin doesn't usually respond this way to gentle skin care products.
I will have to wait and try after my cycle ends, but for now, this one isn’t really on top of my toner list.

AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_title: Cost effective, convenient way to prep your skin in a hurry.
AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_text:
I have heard of this type of sheet mask, when it became popular as ‘1 Minute Mask’ in S.Korea a couple of years ago. I have heard many good reviews on similar ones but I have always remained a bit skeptical.

But when this showed up on my recommended page, I was tempted to try them myself.
Well, this actually exceeded my expectations (which was quite low to be honest).

First, it’s conveniently packaged into a container that you can simply pull it out of with a tweezer.
This mask cools down your skin after washing your face, and prep the face well for makeup.
If you are in a hurry in the morning to get ready, this will definitely come handy as you can skip all your skin care routines with 3 min masks.
You can also use it when you have to get ready for a night out and you want to prep your skin the best you can in a short amount of time for makeup.
If you have enough time, you can leave it around 10 mins or so, as it didn’t dry my skin out when I left it on my face a bit longer than suggested 3 mins either.
Of course, it won’t give your skin drastic results like $10 per sheet skin mask would, but this one is perfect for a quick fix for sure. Especially for less than $0.90 per sheet? I would say its cost performance definitely deserves a good rating!

Only issue I have with this mask is that I noticed the essence leaked a bit around the container when I opened the package (hence 4 stars instead of 5).

AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_title: It tears easily.  Nope from me.
AGQMAOHZFQX3JMJIEND3IFN65L5Q.review_text:
This is probably about the 100th brand I have tried for an eye mask if I exaggerate a bit.
I use under eye patches almost everyday, sometimes twice a day not only for under eye but also for my neck lines and forehead.
So I am not kidding when I say I have tried 10s of different brands of under eye patches from Amazon.
To be honest, under eye patches are for a rather temporary fix, in that you have to use them everyday or for a long period to have more permanent effects. But that’s how all skin care products work in my opinion. I use it to reduce very fine lines under my eyes (you can’t really see it unless you look in the mirror closely but it bugs me), and prevent my neck and forehead lines from getting worse (and hopefully to improve).
This one didn’t stay well at all on my neck, and I felt it dried out too quickly.
FYI, I don’t have dark circles, so my rate of effectiveness is solely for fine lines and such.
For my neck lines, I think most eye patches are at par in terms of quality, to be honest. Of course, from time to time, there are brands with quite inferior quality to others. I wouldn’t know about this one, as it kept falling off.
The last straw was that it just ripped apart when I tried to move the slipped mask back to the intended spot. It was annoying. After a couple of times, I just took it all off from my face.
The bottom line is that this product doesn’t have any price advantage to overlook its rather inferior quality compared to similar quality eye masks in this price range either.
I got so many other eye masks right now, I am not going to use this one unless I run out of eye masks between shipments or something (highly unlikely though).
Overall, 2.5/5 from me based on my experience of trying this mask for the very first time, and I won’t be recommending this.

AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_title: Definitely casual and a bit tricky
AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_text:
What I was expecting to get with this was not what I actually got...
Still, the real problem is that this hair accessory requires a lot of work, yet produces only a very casual result.

The set itself consists of: scrunchy with hair attached to it, a small black elastic tie, and some black hair clips.
In order to use it, you put your hair up in a bun with the elastic tie, pull the scrunchy over the bun, then secure it with the pins as needed.

The biggest issues I had with this set were the overall quality and the difficulty of use.
It also won't be much help to those with very thin/sparse hair because it only makes the end of your hair look longer/thicker, while doing nothing much for your scalp or hairline.
You also need enough hair to form a small bun to begin with, which limits the number of women who will be able to wear it at all.

The color I selected was a light brown that matches my hair well enough to wear,
though not well enough to make it disappear into my hair style completely.
Since you are ordering from a photograph, you have to simply use your best guess to decide what the right color for you would be.

Other concerns include that fact that the scrunchy shed several strands of hair pretty quickly and the accessories are very chintzy.
More likely than not, you will need/want to use your own pins to secure your bun before you add the scrunch element.
Personally, I had to fuss with this a lot to get it to look right and stay put; however, I am not naturally gifted in the art of coiffuring, so that may be a reflection on me, as much as the scrunchy itself.

In the end, I would definitely not recommend this for a formal occasion because it does look very tousled and I doubt that is something you can change.
If you are someone who likes to play with your hair, this might be a fun way to create the illusion of fuller hair.
Personally, I would rather this set either be easier to use, since it would most likely be used on casual days, or be more amendable to formal hairstyles, so that investing the effort of getting it to look good would feel more worthwhile.

It took a while to get this review together because there was a lot to unpack with this steamer and all the little extras that came with it; however, what stood out most was how fast and powerful the steamer itself was.
If you were thinking you'd be waiting around a few minutes for this thing to start producing steam, chances are you will be pleasantly surprised by how little time it takes for the device to start pushing out huge clouds of steam.

While the instructions that come with this set are detailed, using the device itself is fairly straightforward.
Simply be aware that the steamer needs to be plugged in to work; moreover, you will probably want to sit during its operation so that you can lean over it for a few minutes at a time.
That means you'll want to find a place where you can use the steamer comfortably, like a vanity or desk.

Other things to keep in mind as you consider buying this.
- The handheld, portable, rechargeable device is a mister, not a steamer. This wasn't completely clear on the product page, so I want to make note of it. Basically, the mister is a nice thing you can use to cool down and refresh your skin on the go.
- Packaging suggests two different types of water for the steamer and mister respectively.
- steamer = distilled water
- mister = mineral water
- The steamer's cord is about 2.5 feet long, which is something you will want to consider when decided where you will be most likely to use the steamer.
- The little extras like the headband with ears and the pore clearing tools make this a great gift to give someone who enjoys getting and giving facials.
- The manufacturer warns that acne which is hormonal in nature will not respond to the steamer
- The instructions also advise you not to use the steamer everyday, nor more than 10 minutes at a time. Accordingly, this is not something that is likely to add a lot of time to your daily routine, but rather something you will use once or twice a week.
- The steamer itself is cute and compact, so you're not giving up a huge amount of space if you get one, nor do you necessarily have to hide it in between uses, unless you want to.
- The steam produced is hot/warm and there is no way to control the temperature; however, you can easily regulate how you experience the heat simply by adjusting the proximity of your face to the steamer.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this facial steamer set as a purchase for yourself or as a gift for someone else who enjoys giving/getting spa treatments at home.
I personally like the effect it had on my skin; I felt as though using it has helped with both the cleansing and hydration of my skin.
Once you get through all the instructions, procure the right type of water for your steamer, and identify where you want to set it up, you will be rewarded with an easy to use machine that produces copious amounts of steam very rapidly

This drill is POWERFUL!
And I mean that both in the sense of how fast and strong the drill is, as well as how long the battery pack lasts.

I have a rechargeable nail drill that I like, but it doesn't always work as fast or as long as I hope, so I was curious to see how this would compare.
Well, I was blown away.
This is like a rechargeable drill on steroids.

To be clear, there is still a wire connecting the drill to the power source/control panel.
While that cord is not a huge problem, it does handle differently than the rechargeable nail drills that are a single unit.
That being said, for me the trade off in power you get makes the two piece design well worth it.

One thing to consider before committing to this nail drill, which is AMAZING, is that as the saying goes, "With great power comes great responsibility".
Put another way, you need to be very careful when using this nail drill, particularly on the highest setting.
This drill can turn fast enough to: quickly heat up your nails, file right through acrylic and natural nail material, get away from you and damage the skin around your nail.
Basically, you need to respect the power of this drill when you are using it, particularly when you start out learning how to handle it.

Other things I really like about this drill:
- The remaining charge is digitally displayed on the battery portions, so you know exactly how much power you have let
- You select the power level with a dial; this allows you to adjust the rotation of your drill very precisely
- You get a wide range of attachments that cover almost anything you would want to do with your nail drill
- Charges with a standard USB cord, which is included (you need to provide an adapter or USB port)
- You change the nail bits by locking and unlocking them with a twist release; I find this is easier and makes for a more secure hold of the bits than the drill bits that rely on a simple push/pull mechanism
- Reverses direction quickly and easily

I definitely recommend this nail drill if you are in the market for one.
It is extremely powerful, has a broad range of speeds, allows you precision control of speed, has a long battery life, let's you know exactly how much charge is left, and comes with a great selection of accessories.

AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_title: Got a perfect color match with decent coverage
AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_text:
I included a half make-up, half naked skin photo, taken with my phones portrait filter off, to give you some sense of how this foundation looks.
I was fortunate in that the time I spent studying the shades on the product page paid off with a pretty spot on color match for my skin, which had me very excited.

Regarding how the make-up went on, I actually found I got better results applying it with my finger than I did with the included make-up sponge.
I know using a sponge is better for your skin, but I found it just kept blending the foundation right off my face.
Whether that was a result of how I applied it, the foundation itself, and/or the sponge is up for debate.
Since you get two sponges included with the two bottles of make-up, you can experiment and decide what application method works best for you.
Side note, this is way too thick to be air brushed on and can't be diluted, so if you use an airbrush, this foundation probably isn't for you.

Regarding how the foundation looked and felt, I would say, standard.
This reminded me of pretty much every good quality foundation I have ever tried.
- It looks best after you first put it on
- It covers many, but not all marks and discoloration
- As the end of the day approaches, it starts to look "fatigued"
- It will wipe off on hands, clothing, etc... if you rub your face
- You need to put some effort into getting all traces of the foundation cleaned off at the end of the day
- For best results, you'll probably want to pair it with a spot concealer and finishing powder

Overall, this is a solid foundation that performs well, but is not exceptional.
If you get a good match to your skin tone like I did, I suspect you will be very pleased with this make-up set.
In the end, I would definitely recommend this, so long as you understand this is not the ultimate fix all your problems, find your prince, do your taxes, and make you smarter miracle in a bottle all foundations claim to be, but instead, a quality make-up that will give you good coverage.

AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_title: Ideal make-up when you are on the go
AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_text:
This makeup is very different than any other I have used in terms of how it is stored and applied; however, I really, really like it.
If you are someone who travels or likes to touch up your foundation throughout the day, this might well be the perfect makeup for you.
It comes in a very well designed compact that holds the liquid foundation in a sponge in its own closed compartment.
The applicator sponge sits atop the cover to that compartment, so the entire thing is spill proof and well protected.

Applying the makeup I found that it blended very well using the included applicator sponge.
The coverage level is medium, evening out skin tone and obscuring imperfections, but not covering major discoloration.
Put another way, if you have a mole or blemish you really want to cover up, you would probably still want to use a spot corrector.

The foundation itself has a matte finish with a nice feel.
I've found I can wear it on its own or with a powder finish.

Color matches are always tricky, particularly online; however, I managed to get a pretty great one.
Unless I have been getting a lot of sun, my skin is pretty pale.
I'm basically one step up from ivory skin, which this Beige Color blended with extremely well.

To show how well it blends and how matte the finish is, I applied it onto one half of my inner forearm, then took photos in two different light settings.
In the photos, the bottom half of my forearm has the foundation on it, but it leaves almost no line and no shine.

As far as staying power is concerned, I would rate this is above average.
It stayed on well for me all day when I was not sweating, but would come off a little on anything that directly rubbed against my skin.
I also found this to be a gentle foundation that did not irritate my skin.

I can happily recommend this foundation compact.
I was truly pleased with both the design of the dispenser, which makes it perfectly portable, and with the performance of the makeup itself.

This cream has a very light fragrance, more botanical, than floral. The cream comes in an attractive little pot shaped jar and is made in the USA and contains imported materials. The ingredients are listed on the box, but printed in such a fashion that I couldn't read them even with my trusty magnifier.
For me this cream did not irritate, did not feel greasy, and left my skin feeling dewy. The illuminating factor I really couldn't notice. Over all a very nice facial cream.

This is a cream that is somewhat gel like, it is made in China and is clearly labeled. The ingredients are clearly labeled on the package along with cautions for exposure to sun. It is too early to report any significant changes or improvement in my skin, but the product does not irritate my skin.

AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_title: Takes some getting used to, but holds hair well
AGRKJRPX6I5DQPODOC4YJ7CT4XWA.review_text:
When I first began using these I really struggled with getting them on/off, particularly when trying to put my hair up in a ponytail.
The problem was that when I was pulling my hair out through the circular clip, it would get caught on the prongs spread out along the inside
After using these a while, however, I am getting better at putting the clips in and taking them out.

One trick I figured out pretty quickly is that twisting my hair before pulling it through the circle prevents it getting caught.
The other thing I have learned is that this is excellent for putting my hair up in a bun.
That's probably my favorite use for these because I get a nice symmetrical look and a very tight hold that keeps my hair up all day long.

Overall, I am very glad I stuck with these because, the longer I have them, the more I like them.
The clips which start out as kind of stiff and hard to open, also get easier to slide open and closed with repeated use.

In the end, I cannot promise these will work for every type of hair out there.
I can, however, confirm that they hold my long, fine, straight, and very slippery hair in place well.
That's a huge deal for me since my hair is exceptionally hard to keep up with scrunchies, clips, bands, and ties.

If you like the look of these clips, I do recommend getting a set, but caution that patience and practice will be needed before you are able to make the most out of them.

I feel like this is going to work best for anyone with oily hair who wants to absorb the oiliness to give their hair more lift.
Where I think this really falls down is in holding hair, as well as clearly and consistently describing what it's for.
