So if you want to make a man in your life happy this is the thing to buy. Chapped lips are no fun. This solves a big problem year round and is minty fresh too.

~The Rebecca Review

AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_title: Sparkly Gloss - Mildly Flavored - Not Overly Sweet - Not Sticky!!!
AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_text:
As a fan of the philosophy lip glosses I used to use the vanilla cake one which I miss not being able to purchase on its own these days. So this is my second favorite and it is nice and sparkly, mildly flavored, not overly sweet and definitely not sticky. What is not to love?

I use a lip balm first, apply a lipstick and then put this on top to hold the look together. It lasts quite a while or until you eat something, then you need to reapply. But I put this on before I go out and it lasts for hours. So I hope this flavor is going to be around for a while. :) I will admit that sometimes I even wear this one to bed! Love, love love!!!

~The Rebecca Review

I enjoy using Zum Bar Goat Milk Soaps and this one is no exception. It is very nicely scented and has a slight exfoliating action due to what appears to be bits of seaweed in the soap. I can't guess what the essential oils are in this soap but they are heavenly. I noticed the scent of this soap is very calming. Love it!

~The Rebecca Review

AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_title: Smooths, Strengthens and Glosses Each Strand
AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_text:
Garnier Fructis Grow Strong Shampoo has the wonderful fresh scent of an apple orchard. It is moisturizing like a cream shampoo and in combination with the conditioner these products smooth, strengthen and gloss each strand.

After the first use I could feel how my hair was thickening and getting stronger. But by the third use of both the shampoo and the conditioner I could really tell a difference.

I love the scent and how it makes my hair endure styling, blow drying and straightening. Your hair will be shinier too. I love these products as much as LUSH shampoos and conditioners and that is saying a lot!

~The Rebecca Review

Are you looking for the ultimate in squeaky clean skin? This citrus-based mask cleanses pores like a dream, removing oil and dirt while softening skin too. You will need to moisturize after using this as your skin will feel a little tighter and drier. If you have oily problem skin, this will impress. Leave it on 8 minutes for the best effect. The texture of this mask is a little like firm whipping cream instead of clay. It is easy to apply and remove with a little extra care. You will immediately notice how absolutely purified your pores look. Impressive!

~The Rebecca Review

AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_title: Body Lotion That Also Works As A Hand Cream!
AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_text:
I keep a bottle of this lotion in three rooms of my house because I love it that much. I have one in the bathroom on the counter, one in the kitchen and one on my bedside table. That way any time I need a hand cream this is available. I also use this as a body lotion. This is the one Zum fragranced cream that smells the best to me and the scent dissipates quickly after use. To be honest my hands look ten years younger when using this particular lotion. There are a lot of essential oils in it so I think it is antiaging. I also love the particular scent of the Bulgarian lavender.

~The Rebecca Review

If you are looking for Harvest themed movies the first two in this collection are perfect. Harvest Love is about a woman who find herself again when she goes home for a vacation. The love story has the usual conflict at the start but the characters fall in love slowly and with a lot of restraint. No kissing until right at the end! Made me want to try pear desserts. Harvest Love is very innocent but has a little romantic dancing at a festival. I'd say it should be rated PG for this.

Pumpkin Pie Wars was really cute and I loved that the women in the movie all ended up friends again in the end. Basically you have two best friends who have a falling out and it takes years for them to even speak to each other again. The happy ending in this can't be beat! Plus lots of baking competitions and romance. A little kissing but that is it.

Truly Madly Sweetly made me feel uncomfortable for the most part because the characters were always in conflict. While the ending is happy I just felt like I would probably not watch it again. I don't mind when characters don't like each other at the start, but to be fighting for different goals basically the whole movie was not as enjoyable to watch. I also wondered what would really happen in their circumstance if the ex wife decided she wanted her husband back. It all felt a bit too risky for me.

But no violence, swearing or anything objectionable in any of the movies. The G rating seems true for the last two of the movies at least. PG for Harvest Love.

And I must admit my big strong husband came and sat right next to me while I was watching Harvest Love. These movies are enjoyable for men to watch too. Apparently. ;)))) He watched all three. But his question was..."Why are all these movies the same just with different actors?" I told him they are just what women love to watch over and over again. It is the romance we crave. So we enjoy watching two characters fall in love.

~The Rebecca Review

AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_title: Soothing Comfort - A Hand Cream That Exceeds Expectations!
AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_text:
Goop Beauty's hand cream is soothing and deeply moisturizing. It absorbs quickly and leaves hands looking nourished and hydrated. The skin on your hand will almost look a little plump, reducing the appearance of wrinkles. I had high expectations for this cream after trying the lip balm and I was not disappointed. The tube is fairly small, but perfect for a purse or pocket. I have my tube on my bedside table for use before bed. This is one of the best hand creams you will ever use. The secret? Shea butter as one of the top ingredients. You may want to get more than one tube! With all the handwashing we've all done in the past two years it is nice to have a cream that is protective and healing.

~The Rebecca Review

AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_title: A Surreal Dreamy Experience – Say Goodbye to Anxiety and Hello to Confidence!
AGWDYYVVWM3DC3CASUZKXK67G6IA.review_text:
Today I tried out Liquid Trust for the first time. I put some on before getting in the car with my husband. He sort of looked over at me at one point but I don't think he knew why. Two sprays on my wrists was all it took to see real effects. It made me feel sort of dreamy and not talkative. Like I just felt very relaxed and happy. We did not argue in the car for the first time in weeks probably because I was not talking up a storm as usual.

People at the grocery store seemed to be smiling at me as I was walking around pushing my cart. I will say smiling may be an effect because when I saw my husband walking down the hallway at home before we left I smiled spontaneously and felt very happy to see him.

My cat Wolfie thinks I'm great now too and when he smelled this on my wrists he got really affectionate and marked my wrists with his cheeks. A sure sign of approval.

This has a slight powdery musky scent if anything. It is barely noticeable and my husband who hates me to wear perfumes did not complain at all! The ingredients are SD alcohol, purified water and oxytocin.

So I feel this oxytocin perfume calmed down my anxiety in general which made other people around me more open and friendly.

To be honest this was a surreal and dreamy experience. I felt calm, yet open and loving and very relaxed. When I keep sniffing my wrists after using it I feel a sort of calmly ecstatic in love feeling.

I'd say this is the real thing. It also did not cause any sensual feelings and no one was attracted to me or me to them, this just reduced anxiety and made me more accepting. I did notice however that I was hyper aware of every man in the store. So it must trigger some protective elements in the brain.

I'd recommend this to married couples who are looking to deepen their intimacy and who want to stop being irritated with each other and get along better.

I avoided anyone pregnant while wearing this as advised!

I am not a doctor nor is this review medical advice. Please consult with your doctor before using. I also don't advise using this for nefarious or deceitful purposes because the karma would not be good! Use at your own risk!

For people in love in a committed marriage relationship, this Liquid Trust can help keep you calm when needing to talk. I'd suggest both people wearing the perfume on their wrists. The scent is sort of unisex and not overly strong. Very mild really, barely noticeable.

So a good experience and it does what it says it is supposed to do. The anti-anxiety or anti-cortisol effects are very apparent. Don't you just need a break from stress now and then? Now you can spay this on your wrists and sit down and feel dreamy, happy and secure. For some confidence might be a nice side effect. That is probably why salespeople use this.

~The Rebecca Review

If you use this body scrub after you use soap it leaves a nice layer of moisture on your skin. I mostly feel the silica and rice powder when using this in the shower. It rinses nice and clean and leaves skin refreshed and renewed. This has lovely mango seed butter in it too. I used about a third of this tube in one full-body use. Think of it as a nice spa treatment!

~The Rebecca Review

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text: I love the weight of this comb! It's super nice for parting because shown in the third picture the rat tail is nice and dull. I've owned a lot of styling combs in the past that feel like a needle on my scalp. The teeth on the comb are spaced perfectly so there isn't a crazy amount of snagging when combing through wet or dry hair which is so nice. If you're tender-headed and looking for a good comb to style or cut hair this one is excellent, especially value wise.

I can see why some of the other reviews might disagree that these are not good quality but you have to consider that they're literally rubber bands. These elastics are absolutely adorable for both kids and adults alike. For the price you really can't beat how many you get AND the pouches they come in. Oh that poor bird, I love him! I tried to show in my second picture just how far you can stretch these until they may snap or lose shape. I think these elastics would be better suited for someone with fine hair or just smaller sections. They're certainly disposable which is something you should keep in mind. Please try to cut them before throwing them out too to be earth friendly.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Super fancy magic awesome bath time
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text: I don't know how long I've been telling my boyfriend "we need a bath pillow so I can full potato in the tub for hours". It's so adorable and travel friendly too! I swear after covid is over I'm taking this bad boy to a hotel to soak with too. Its become my new bff. I love that they included a hanger so I don't have to keep it in the tub the whole time and risk mold. I think it's washer friendly too but don't quote me on that. Inside the pillow part there are some kind of beads that really massage your neck as you lay back. The design will surely fit all different types of tubs, we have a deep soaker and it fits perfectly. You even get an adorable travel case too as a bonus! Couldn't recommend enough.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Tugged at skin and gave me a rash
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
I was hoping to find something to take off my makeup easily at night for those lazy nights where I can't be bothered. Normally I have a five step routine (I know it's excessive). I have very sensitive pale skin and tried to gently wipe off my foundation to start with and felt it just tugging really hard. The fabric itself is extremely soft, like a baby blanket. I thought maybe if I wet it and tried it would help, alas my skin broke out and I had to put it down.

The packaging is great, the seller seems like an excellent business person and really wants to take care of you as a customer. I feel bad taking off a few stars for that reason. These wipes might be good for someone with more hardy skin but I unfortunately can't use them.

This kit felt very cheap and dangerous. You really get what you pay for. The combs teeth were bent on both sets and very flimsy. The thinning sheers appear to have either been used or just made really poorly. They ripped my hair all the way down, and the scissors were not aligned at all so I couldn't use them. The blades on all the tools were very ragged and just felt cheap. I would not recommend this set to anyone with safety in mind.

While a lot of people have an issue investing in skincare I think it's one of the luxury things I like to splurge on. In my quest for switching to more natural skincare I came across this brand and wanted to try everything. This serum absolutely feels luxurious down to the packaging. The serum is lightweight and does NOT clog pores at all. It dries within a matter of seconds without leaving the skin feeling tacky. I notice an overall tightening due to the retinol in the product which lets me know it's working. However, the rose scent is painfully excessive. I have to hold my breath while applying because it will cause me a headache until it dries down, for that I had to take off a few stars. Overall the serum does seem to work well enough to replace my drugstore brand retinol.

[[VIDEOID:1231ac12d6a6c6d773db870b6eaa118d]] I picked up four of this brands oils so far and a few are hit or miss but this one is one of my favorites by far. The scent is light, clean, and with a very fair hint of floral. Honestly, it smells like playdough and I'm not sure why. The ingredients are clean and I haven't noticed a single breakout regardless of how thick this oil is. As seen in the video it leaves a gorgeous dewy sheen to the skin so I would recommend this for either nighttime or for those who really love natural glowy makeup looks without foundation. My skin drinks this stuff right up!

There's something deeply comforting about the scent of this. It's almost like a woodsy scent. The oil soaks right in like a dry oil so I love to apply this right out of the shower, my skin drinks it up. All you need to use is about two drops for the entire face, so cost wise it works out pretty well for a whole ounce. The packaging is really beautiful as well. This would make an ideal gift for a skincare lover.

You really get what you pay for with these oils. The ingredients are absolutely reflected in the price. I love that you can clearly see everything in the bottle unlike some high end brands that hide their ingredients. Natural skincare is the way to go these days with everything else being a mystery. This oil applies like a dream and soaks right into the skin. Even with makeup on top it leaves a beautiful glow underneath and doesn't slide around. The oil is a drier formula that won't slip or slide and absolutely repairs over time. I've noticed my cheeks are brighter and overall complexion is smoother. The scent is to die for with a musky woodsy kind of scent with very light floral undertones. Would absolutely recommend for a holiday gift!

Everything but the color is perfect. Admittedly I’m extremely pale, I can’t even find a MAC shade to match me; but this was SO yellow. The scent was fruity, almost reminded me of watermelon? And it applied beautifully with both hands and foundation brush. If there was some way to make this shade paler I would ditch my current foundation for this. It didn’t feel oily or cakey and felt like I was wearing a moisturizer.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: The absolute best of, award winning for a reason
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
I’m normally not a fan of primers at all but this really helped my foundation not cake or break up around my t zone for the entire day.

The kit includes the regular primer, a primer water (for after foundation), and a primer essence (also for after foundation. I’ve been really loving the primer essence for setting my face. I apply about a full droppers worth into my palm, rubbing my hands together, and gently tapping over my face and neck. I really prefer this over setting sprays which feel awful when they blast you in the eyes. All three products have a light almost fruity scent which may not be great for some people but I haven’t had any adverse reactions or breakouts. This would be excellent as a gift for the makeup lover for the holidays.

I would absolutely use this in a heartbeat if it were my shade. It's the perfect neutral tone but too dark. It sheers out to a beautiful dewy finish. With the sunscreen included you save the extra steps. I love cushion foundations and this one feels really luxurious. You even get an extra refill included! There is a slight scent but it's more sunscreen than anything. I tried it on for a few hours and had no breakouts or irritation. Again, this would be my go-to cushion if they had a slightly wider shade range.

I really wouldn't recommend this for a few reasons. I'm glad I used it on my hand first because if I used it in the shower or bath it would've ended horribly. The formula is essentially oil and sugar and the oil is extremely greasy and slippery. It took me three times of washing my hands to fully remove the oil. The scrub itself was really nice but even with that said the scent was so strong I developed a headache almost immediately. It's overpoweringly sweet and too much. I wish I could get past these issues because I would love to use it on my legs. I think it could make a nice foot scrub though if you're careful and wash down the bathtub after. Please be careful using this though.

Absolutely love this chunky pencil stick. It's a perfect dupe for Chili with maybe a bit more brown. While it's not ultra long lasting it applies smooth, and is easy to re apply. My only issue is the price. I understand this is an all natural kind of product and indie but 25 is a little steep for a pencil. You will need a special sharpener for this as well because it doesn't come with one on the other end. If it did I would justify the price.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: A must have for the winter
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text: The before and after pictures do all the talking here. These days I'm constantly washing my hands and never really take care of my nails or hands anymore because why bother? This -stunning- kit was nice and heavy and felt extremely high quality. The bottles are actual glass (which means you can recycle them!) The roller on the oil is really well made too, it never got stuck like some cheaper ones do. I used this kit for about a week and the results were really amazing. My only complaint is the scent of the lotion is EXTREME. I mean I didn't think you could combine rose, frankincense, geranium, AND ylang ylang...but they did. It's really strong and hyper floral so if you're sensitive to scents I might skip out and just get the oil. The lotion does however apply really nicely and sinks in quickly.

I am always losing my headbands for when I go to clean my face. I swear the laundry monster eats them. This brightly colored novelty headbands are adorable for all ages. They don't snag at your hair or have any hard bits that could hurt a sensitive scalp. My personal favorite is the pink bow because it looks hilarious when I have a face mask on. I think these would be a great gift for a makeup lover or even a little kid who could wear them as a part of a costume.

I thought I was going to gift a few of these but I think I'll keep them for myself and put them in my bathrooms for guests. The packaging is super cute and the product itself displays really nicely too. I'd say it's a fairly lightweight moisturizer that when rubbed in melts like an oil. My cuticles were instantly revived. If they made a jumbo size of this I would use it on my whole body. The scent is great and I didn't need to reapply frequently because it really sunk in.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Still recovering from how much this dried my hair out
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text: The shampoo is super pigmented and worked pretty well. Maybe too well though, it stained my forehead and now my brunette hair with highlights just has a weird burgundy purple cast to it which looks awful and kind of ruined my hair color. The conditioner was really terrible though, it felt like just applying another shampoo. My ends were extremely dried out and frizzy after using and I had just had a haircut so they weren't unhealthy. I wouldn't purchase this as a set.

If you have smaller hands this will be difficult to maneuver. While I was using it to attempt to remove my fake tan in the shower it rolled all around and slid around making it difficult to actually target areas. I ended up getting frustrated and balling it up in my fist to use it like a loofah. Being so used to traditional green scrub cloths this hardly did anything. It didn't really remove dry skin or my tan for that matter.

I've been using this multiple times daily and it has a permanent home on my desk because of how much it helps relax my jaw and tmj. I'm absolutely in love with this roller because it doesn't squeak, doesn't tug at the skin, and because it's made of all metal it cools down quickly just by sitting out.
If you're looking to get an extra de puffing effect I highly recommend getting a glass of ice and putting the tool in there for a couple of seconds. When the temperatures got to the hundreds here I was reaching for this all day. I used it not only my face but my neck and shoulders and it was absolutely heavenly.
I personally love the extra long handle so I don't apply too much pressure when rolling away. I do use it "upside down" and pull rather than push which I'm not sure if you're supposed to do but it feels a lot better that way.
This tool should last a lifetime if cared for properly so the price doesn't bother me as an investment piece.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Most expensive mask to break me out
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
This two part mask is great in theory. Each mask targets specific areas of the face for their specific needs. Immediately upon opening the package I noticed it was jam packed full of serum and used what was left on my arms and chest area. In a way it seemed a bit wasteful to include that much serum when a lot of people won't end up using it. I guess if you had some spare containers laying around you could pour it in them.
The forehead portion of the mask broke me out the next day after using it for some reason even though I stuck to my regular skin care routine right after and didn't use any additional products. I would still be willing to try other products from this brand though because I see so many celebrities using it.

In just three short days my feet have turned into the most terrifying science experiment. I'm extremely impressed with the results of these. Just like a professional chemical peel for your face this is one of the best foot peel masks I've used. It does feel a little strange keeping them on for thirty minutes and squishing around the house but that was the only non enjoyable part. Remember to soak your feet in warm water nightly to get the full peeling effect and speed up the process. I'm on day 5 so far and the peeling is almost over.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Like the holidays in a jar
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
My only wish was that the jar was bigger! I tried just a tiny bit on my hands at first and before I knew it I covered my whole body in this stuff. It melts beautifully into the skin and makes you smell good enough to eat. The scent is a perfect balance of chocolate and mint! My dry winter skin absolutely loved this formula and it really helped calm my skin after shaving.
I also adore the fact that the jar is reusable and recyclable. Will be repurchasing for sure!

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Hands down the most beautiful red I've ever seen
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text: My lips look like beautiful rubies. I have such a tricky time finding a good red that works with my skin tone being so pale. I could see this working for just about everyone and going viral. The packaging is absolutely decadent and screams luxury. I happily display it on my vintage style vanity because it just looks like it belongs there. The shape may not be something you're used to, but the vintage shape of the lipstick works as a lipliner and does all of the hard work for you. Everything about this company and lipstick deserves five stars.

While I enjoy the versatility of this product, the logo was very intense and visible on the front of the warmer. It has a pretty blue light that surrounds the bottom when turned on and a great screen to let you know the temperature. I found it heated up very quickly and was an even heat that worked great for wax. I do wish the pot inside was coated or easier to clean between uses.
If you do use this warmer for its intended use it works really well to keep massage oil heated for lengthy periods and the knob makes it easy to adjust even if there is product on your hands.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Great worn alone, not flavored as claimed
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text: [[VIDEOID:9631aea0bf38c5a9cf1cb4863ad4559e]] I might be the only one who didn't like these. I just didn't notice much of a flavor at all and the texture was more like an oil which drove me nuts throughout the day. I kept worrying about it sliding around and moving my lip color underneath. I personally prefer a more sticky gloss. I did like how fine the glitter was so it didn't bother my lips or create any tingling effect. The scent was by far the best part and I loved the strawberry.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Powder melts right into your skin
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:1b48e5f44530360af4ad88d510fc701a]] I didn't know it was possible for skin to love a powder this much. It has to be the most beautiful setting powder I've ever used. It works with a multitude of products without ever looking chalky or leaving a white cast. My favorite use is putting a light dusting under my eyes to set my concealer. It's probably one of the only powders I've found that doesn't settle in the fine lines around my eyes or my mouth or enhance any dryness or texture.
There isn't a scent either which is an added bonus. Even though the trial size looks fairly small, the amount you use compared to other setting powders is so minimal that it will last you a fairly long time.

Such a gorgeous color that can work for everyone. It reminds me of the orange glowing sunset when the next day is supposed to be hot. The glitter in the lipstick is such an amazing addition to the already beautiful color. The gold really shines in the light without looking dated. Using this without liner as an ombre lip is great for those who want a more subdued look.
Even with ultra fair skin this shade doesn't look overdone because the pigmentation is nice and light. It seems to last really well even though it's more of a glossy hydrating formula.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: Works well but didn't like the dispenser
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
This combined with the moisturizer has made my skin absolutely glow. I've been using just one pump for my whole face and neck both morning and night.
The scent in the serum is so light that it doesn't cause any irritation to my skin which is so rare.
The packaging is beautiful and looks gorgeous on my countertop. I do however have some trouble with the dispenser pump because it gets finicky and will only pump out product from one side. The component is made of plastic which is why I'm not giving it five stars. For the price you would expect glass or some sort of refill that was more eco friendly.
For those that have arthritis, the pump can be tricky to use because you have to press down fairly hard. Hopefully this is fixed in the future because it's a lovely product.

AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_title: This has given me an incredible glow
AGWF6BTLJVQQ2N2R5PKNJOLY65GQ.review_text:
I am fully dedicated to how amazing this moisturizer is. I've been using it both morning and night with the serum from the same brand and the results speak for themselves.
Of course I'll always have one or two hormonal breakouts, but this has decreased my other acne, evened my skin tone, and really calmed down my overall redness.
I'm in my early 30s and just now getting more serious about anti aging skincare because I'm trying to avoid fillers for as long as I can.
This moisturizer is extremely rich and I only need to use a tiny fingertip size for my neck and face. It works great under makeup and doesn't feel greasy or heavy.
As far as the price tag goes, it's a lot...I personally don't think I could afford to purchase on a regular basis and really wish that it was more affordable because I feel like a lot of people would benefit from this cream.

AGWHCKXAEZT222ZZXS5JC4DH3BGQ.review_text: It's called "the perfect bob" and that's exactly what it is! Perfect length, perfect texture and thickness too. I've slept in mine for over 2 weeks and it still looks new.

AGWHCKXAEZT222ZZXS5JC4DH3BGQ.review_title: Needs black polish to bring out the shimmer
AGWHCKXAEZT222ZZXS5JC4DH3BGQ.review_text: The colors are vibrant and beautiful ONLY if you use a coat of black polish underneath and that's not mentioned in the description. You'll get an alright looking shade if used alone but if you want it to look EXACTLY like the picture I suggest applying a coat of black polish on your nails first and then the other color. If you do it that way the results are beautiful!

The pencil was not smudgeproof or sweatproof. I actually was able to fix mistakes by simply wiping them with my finger. And the triangular shape of the pencil is worse than a circular tip! Its impossible to make sharp, clean, accurate lines with this tip! I hadn't even completely outlined one brow before the tip became blunt and wide, making precision brows impossible! I would NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT TO ANYONE WHO WANTS A NICE BROW WITH LITTLE EFFORT!
Never have I found a more secure bonnet for long hair that doesn't slide or move slightly in your sleep. The fact that you get 2 small and 2 long is great. I recommend to anyone.

AGWJ6THRBN2L7LOFRGT5VEBRM3OA.review_text: These are beautiful colors! I love the effect they take on when layered on the black gel. Try to keep the coats thin and the gel last longer, I've noticed mine will last over 2 weeks, but by that time my nail grows out and I will remove it.

This was such a horrible experience. While in the shower I tried to squeeze the scrub out of this tube, and I really had to wrestle with it. I was twisting and bending the tube, but the scrub is much too thick for the small opening. It smells nice and I was really looking forward to it, but even after removing the whole cap, it took much to long to get enough of it out for my legs. This formula is also way to oily and slippery. Not only does it leave the shower extremely slippery, but it also leaves your skin saturated with an oily residue. I never experience this with my regular scrub. I won't be buying this in the future.
I was looking forward to this wash, but the lemon scent is much too strong for me. I avoid using it because of the strong scent.

AGWYBTJM4LHS74LEIA27N2BYQ5YA.review_text: I mainly use this oil for conditioning my goatee and shaving my legs (I’m a cyclist) but I’ve also used it to moisturize really dry areas. The oil does a very good job of conditioning and softening my beard and preventing fly-aways. You need to use it consistently and it takes a little time for it to really take effect but I truly does work great. Your beard will be softer without looking oily. It’s also scent free which I strongly prefer. Another review said it has a lemon scent. I’m not getting that and typically I’m pretty sensitive to odors. If there’s a scent it’s very subtle. I also use this oil for leg shaving. It makes the shaving process faster and safer (little to no cuts or nicks). Oil is preferable to cream so you can see what you’re doing and where you’re shaving. It’s thick enough to not require much product but not so thick that your razor is instantly gummed up. I’ve also used Pacific Shaving Company oil (too thin) and Shave Secret oil (too thick). Since this is an oil, I don’t often use it for moisturizing but it’s very effective in that capacity particularly if you have a very dry and stubborn area. I’m giving this product 5 stars because it works great for all it’s intended uses but the reality is that I’m unsure how often I will purchase it due to it’s high price. I will have to wait and see how long a bottle lasts. So far a little bit goes a long way so it very well may end up being worth the high price.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Effortless Auto-rotating Curling Iron with Three Sizes
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The automatic hair curling iron is an excellent tool! I have tried an automatic curler from a differet brand but this I love because it comes with three different curling irons for the different curl thicknesses. Instead of having three separate curling irons, you have one device with the option to switch out as you choose.

It's an easy set up. You just push down the curl iron of choice into the barrel, then rotate the tip of the wand to lock it in place, then change the heat temperature from the bottom knob. You will notice the color change to red when it heats up, but the color will stay green when plugged in even if you "turn it off."

Most curlers are already heavy and tiring enough to hold and rotate up in the air, but this hair styling tool eliminate the need. All you have to do it hold it up and make it rotate. You slide a section of your hair in between the crowns and press the rotate the button to the left or right, depending on the direction of the curls you want to shape. One thing I love about this device is that, instead of having to clip the hair with standard curling iron that literally leave the end of your curls "clipped," this allows for more natural look as it curls it to the end.

I was absolutely happy with the results and the effortless time it took to style my hair. The curls also lasted throughout the day with no problem.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: I have long and thick hair and it's always a hassle to dry them. First of all, many claim that their product works for long hair but when I try them I usually get a good length of hair sticking out. The towel is never long enough to cover the length of my hair. However, I was so happy to find that this microfiber towel covered my entire hair. The towels are absorbent and keeps my hair drying nicely without the use of a hair dryer, which tends to create a lot of fizz. The only thing is that because the towel is longer and larger than usual, it tends to slip. I recommend wrapping the hair before tying on to the button to keep the towel tightly wrapped around your hair. Other than that, I have no complaints with the product.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Slim, Comfortable Headbands For Every Color of Your Outfit
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: The headbands come in 12 colors. There are so many colors to choose from. I have been wearing one to match my outfit each day. The headbands are thin and have the different colored fabric wrapped around them. Some headbands when wearing for the whole day make my head hurt, but these headbands were comfortable to wear, not tight around my head and kept my hair in place and looking fabulous.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Pretty Set of Scrunchies for Bridal Party
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
I ordered the set of scrunchies for a friend's bachelorette party. The order comes with 7 scrunchies total. There are six pink for the bridal party and one white for the bride. The pink is a dust rose color more than the pink but it's very attractive. The set is adorable and can be used for many different occassions.

The material is soft, shiny and looks super chic. Because the material has a sheen, you need to tie it pretty tight so your hair stays in and there is no slippage.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Good Face Mask for Moisturization
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The order of the face masks come packaged in a box. There are 24 face masks individually packaged. The mask comes with a clear plastic layer underneath that's folded up with the face mask. This allows for the face mask to be easily removed andn opened, because other products just have the face mask folded up by itself and it's always a struggle to unfold them.

The face mask is a perfect fit for my face. There are plenty of face masks out there that are oversized or does not have the slits in the right place to fit the face form, but I could tell the fit would be perfect the moment I put them on.

The face masks are soaked in hyaluronic acid and there was plenty left in the package after the face mask was removed, for me to squeeze additional gel onto my face. I left the face mask on for about 15 minutes. The area around my nose and cheeks still had plenty of moisture on it but the edges near the chin were dried up. The face mask seems to harden in the areas that are dried up.

After the application, my skin did not absorb all the serum and it was still wet. I gently tapped around the area to get it evenly spread and dissolve. The skin felt moisturized. It wasn't sticky nor did it dry up my face. I am satisfied with the result and the product.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Vitamin-C Serum for Face
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The Vita-C energy boosting serum comes in a black coated bottle. I can't see how much product is in it because bottle is completely black but the small bottle weighs heavy. There are descriptions in both Korean and English on the packaging.

The bottle has a rubber washer on the top of the bottle that keeps the eye dropper in place and seal the product tight. I liked the design of this as I have not come across this in other products.

The serum itself is clear and has consistency that's between liquid and lotion. I applied it after washing my face and applying toner. I only needed a few drops for it to cover my face. I did not smell any particular scent on the product. After the application, the serum took awhile to absorb on my face. It was semi-sticky but not to the point where I felt bothered by it. My face didn't feel dry or stiff afterwards. It felt smooth and hydrated.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Beautiful, Elegant Pearl Headbands
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The order of the pearl headbands come in six, packaged individually. Each headband have different sized pearls and design on them. They are so pretty and elegant. The headbands are versatile and can be worn for both casual and formal occassions. You can wear multiple headbands together or separately.

The headbands fit comfortably. They're not too tight around my head which is average sized. I have not had to take them off during the day, where some headbands leave me with headache and pain behind the ears. Depending on the headband style, the end piece either has the pearl or velvet wrapped.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Spiral Hair Ties in Neutral Tones - Stretch Way Too Easily
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: The order comes with 18 spiral hair ties in various colors of neutral tone. I perfer the spiral hair ties over the regular black scrunchiis. They do not leave any crease in the hair and also feels much more comfortable to wear. However, these hair ties are on the lower quality. They stretch way too easily and does not retain the elasticity for too long. After a few uses I ended up using a new one. I lose hair ties all the time so it's a good replacement until I have to buy a new pack.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Lightweight, High Absorption, Moisturizing Essence for Foundation of Skin Care Routine
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The Celimax The Real Sedum Aqua Boosting Essence comes in a clear bottle of 150ml. It's a good size bottle that will probably will probably last me 9-10 months. The packaging is attractive and highly simple and modern. There's almost no scent to the essence, maybe a very faint scent of citrus if I were to pinpoint, which is ideal for people who have sensitive nose.

I am not a chemist so the ingredients described have no meaning to me. Though, the essence contains hyaluronic acid which is the main ingredient in the toner that I use for final stage of my daily facial cleaning process. The toner is a lot thicker in content and leaves my skin sticky whereas this essence is very water based and feels amazing after applying. My skin reacted and absorbed the essence right away and left my skin smooth and moisturized without feeling any stickiness. Even my hands got moisturized and I do not have to wipe or wash away after the application. I learned through reading the product description that this essence contains low molecular weight hyaluronic acid, which with its small molecular structure makes it easier for it to absorb into the skin. This speaks true to the application because I use the essence right after I wash my face and this sets the base for my skincare routine and helps maxmize the absorbtion of other products.

Without reading too much into it, this is a five-star product that is lightweight with almost no scent, keeps your skin moisturized and hydrated, and prepped for your daily skin care routine.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Shampoo Bar - Shrinking Fast
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
This oat delicacy shampoo bar for fine hair has many positive aspects. I love the smell. It's plant based and environmentally friendly. It's a Garnier product.

I have been searching for an item like this because I travel a lot and shampoo my hair daily. Unfortunately, I have a lot of hair and because I like lots of lather and shampoo my hair so often this bar is shrinking fast. They advertise it for two months but I just hope I can get a full month out of it. I love everything about the shampoo bar minus the longevity.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Quality Face Roller/Massager - Good Weight
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The Sand & Sky Face Roller/Massager Tool comes in a beautiful package. The face massager tool is made out of metal and has a good weight compared to the plastic ones I've used in the past. There are two twin balls that you roll across your face. They pull and push gently against your skin as you roll. It's an intersting sensation. These balls are also made out of metal and provides this cool sensation on your skin.

I use the tool after the base of my skin care routine is applied. It helps my skin absorb without me having to pat on it numerous times. The face roller also helps sculpt your face but also get circulation flowing on your face without having to go visit a massage salon.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: 9 Soft Brushes in Pastel Color
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: The order comes with 9 brushes in different shapes and sizes. Each brush comes invidually packaged in paper wrap. The handle of the brush is beautiful pastel blue. The brush bristles is also in pastel blue with pink gradient to the tip. All of the brushes are very soft but I do wish there were some firmer ones to be used for my lips or eyebrow. So far, none of the bristles have fallen out and remain in good shape. It would be nice if it came with a travel case that held all the brushes. It's a great brush set for anyone.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Korean Exfoliating Scrub - Better than Loofahs
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The order of the Korean exfoliating bath wash cloth comes in 6 pieces. There are four with the same size and two that are a little bit longer in length. If you are familiar with the traditional korean scrubs, they are sized much smaller (See attached photo for size comparison. Dark green vs light green from another brand). I love the ones I ordered because I can fit all of my hand and it will cover more surface area than the old one I use. I can scrub away fast and more with this product.

The exfoliating bath wash cloths are very lightweight and dries easily. Traditionally, I use them after sitting in the sauna or a hot bath. The dead skin easily peels away using these scrubs. Because I don't live near a Korean sauna, I just use these on the daily in the showers. I prefer using these over any loofah. You feel so refreshed and clean.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Wooden Brush with Steel Bristles - Love the Brush Cleaning Tool
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The order comes with a single hair brush packed in a box. The brush has a wooden handle that is polished and anti-slip. It looks very attractive and feels great in my hand. The brush head has steel bristles on the round head. My hair easily detangles with the brush but also the bristles are firm enough to massage the scalp without irritating. It's so soothing and relaxing. The bristles are on an air-like cushion that helps them flow through my thick hair. The area has an air ventilation hole in the middle.

The order comes with a black cleaning tool, which is an added bonus. It's a much needed tool because I lose a lot of hair with brushing and it gets difficult to remove all the hair especially when it gets stuck in between the bristles and becomes a hassle to remove. No more using a second brush to clean this steel bristle brush.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Dual Tip Eyeliner - Fine Lines for Felt and Brush Tips
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: The order comes with one (1) liquid eyeliner. The eyeliner has dual tips on both ends, which provides a selection of either the felt or brush tips. Both brushes have fine tips so it's good for drawing precised lines. It glides on pretty easily. I do need to apply a couple layers because it applies pretty thinly. Also, the color can sometimes thin out and it not completely jet balck unless you press down on it.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Difficult to match hair color and style
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The order comes with one (1) hair buns scrunchii. I ordered the strawberry blonde color and also ended up ordering another color, brown black. The strawberry blonde color is more of a brown color with a hint of red shades. I feel it's difficult to match color on this. The brown black is closer to the natural black color, especially if your hair is sunkissed.

The hair is soft to the touch. The hair is bunched up around the scrunchii. You can loop and tie it around your hair to add volume to your hair. The hair is a bit curled so again, it can be a little bit difficult to match the hair style if your hair is not normally curly or you've styled it curly.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Gel Mold Remover - Doesn't work so well
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
The order comes with one (1) mold remover that comes in a bottle. it comes with a cone shaped cap that you replace so you can dispense the mold remover gel. It allows for you to get to the corners and edges where the mold builds up and it's hard to scrub unless you have a thin brush to work with.

The gel is clear and you squeeze the bottle for it to come out. It's pretty much the gel sitting on top of a molded sealant in my showers that is supposed to slowly kill the mold and you remove it by wiping it down a few hours later. The gel clumps and it stays there. I have seen it work slowly but it does not remove much of the built up mold.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Silicone Cover for Brushes - STRONG GRIP
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: The order comes with 9 pieces of the silicone makeup brush covers. There are two (2) different sizes for covering different type of brushes. One type for larger brush for like foundation and the other type of smaller brushes like eye shadow. The cover provides good protection over the brush but also protects the bag that would hold this brush from leaving powder or color marks. The protection part is good but I had mad struggle trying to get the silicone cover on my make up brush. It's not easy and it has an extremely strong grip. Once its grips on something it is so hard to remove or slide down to use the brush.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: One-Step Magic Straightening Perm Kit
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text:
I have semi-curly but puffy hair that I need to tame at least once every 3-4 months. Otherwise, I have to straighten my hair every day to look decent. I have been using this Japanese product which is a 2-step for the straightening and neutralizing. It usually takes a total of 3 hours or more to go through the entire process, with 45 mins session for each treatment steps and then the drying and straightening hair in between. I was really intrigued with the one-step because it saves so much time.

The order comes with magic straightening kit to do at home. There are instruction manuals in both Korean and English. It gives you step by step instructions that are very clear and easy to follow. The bottle already comes with the treatment. All you need to do it apply. Before you do this, there are hair treatment packets to use prior and after the treatment to protect your hair from excessive damage. The kit also comes with plastic cover for your shoulders and a brush for application.

I applied it over the top area because my hair is pretty long and really you should only target the new hair growth if you've done the treatment previously. If it was my first time I probably would not have enough treatment for my long hair. I would need to order two.

The instruction states to check after 10 minutes. Every hair is different so you will have to assess if you need to leave it on longer. The instruction specifies the duration and also guides you on how to check if your hair is ready to be washed out. If you pull one strand and you notice the curls are gone, then it's probably time to wash them. I left mine on for 40 minutes. I don't recommend it but I needed to from past experience because my hair is crazy. You rinse out the treatment but it tells you not to rub them. Just wash them through gently with your fingers. I applied the hair mist after washing it out, because you can feel the hair stiffen. Then I proceeded to blow dry and straighten the hair.

I washed my hair again after 2 days and sure enough the treatment worked. I do feel that because of the dryness, I still need to straighten the hair some, but definitely better than having to sit every morning and straighten the entirety of the hair.

For an avid magic straightening perm treatment user, I do recommend the product. I suggest getting additional product to make sure you revive your hair after treatment.

AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_title: Beautiful Design but so difficult to put on - clip is plastic and grip is weak
AGXMWJK3YL4SV5FJ27JEJZPZHRBA.review_text: The order comes with four (4) hair clips. Each clip has a pretty design, with pearls and gems on it. There are three small clips on top of the main clip that holds sections of the hair for the braided hair look. I honestly have the most difficult time using it. It's hard for me to get the main clip to clip the back section and then pull sections on top to clip each smaller ones. Definitely not a simple task to do by myself. I also am not able to see if I did it correctly. The clips are also just plastic and the main clip isn't as sturdy or feel like it grips hard enough.

AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_title: motion part works, but strong scent
AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_text: This appears to actually deliver on the "motion sensing" part. The scent seems to be reactivated by arm movement. I don't know how this works, but I'm guessing it has to do with friction and how the product layers on to your body such that you "scrape" off some of it when you're active. If you've frequently found yourself with body odor issues during or after exercise, this can be a very good thing. My main problem is that I'm not a fan of the strong scent. It's just a bit overbearing for my tastes. There are other similar deodorants in this series (the "Cool Rush" version smells better to me) which I'd go for. That being said, at $7 a stick (the current price), this is also pretty pricey and I'd need to really be worried aobut workout-induced odor to put out that sort of cash on a single stick.

AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_title: soft, comfortable, and effective for eye comfort
AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_text:
I was interested in using this as a cool eye pillow to help deal with swelling and irritation around my face and eyes due to allergies. I followed the instructions on the package, put the mask in a plastic bag, and placed it in the freezer overnight. The pillows exterior is super soft and comfortable even on sensitive skin (I'm 51 and my skin is thin and quite sensitive). The interior is flexible without being too bumpy so it lies smoothly and without too much weight on your face. Mine stayed cold for quite a long time, though it does help to flip it over to the cooler side after awhile.

The lavender scent at first is quite strong, but it doesn't tend to dissipate very far. My husband is sensitive to floral scents and I asked him if he could smell it from across the room and he could not. If you want it to not smell so strongly, you can store it outside of a plastic bag. If you want it to retain more scent, then you can store it in a plastic bag.

Note: I was provided with a sample of this product in order to assess it.

This is a medium-sized mitt with a layer of very rough, but strong fabric on both sides and an elastic band at the wrist to help it stay on. The fabric is held together by solid stitching which was flawless on my mitt. It is super strong despite being thin. The fabric is rather surprisingly rough when you rub it against your skin. It's like sandpaper that does not do any damage. It leaves your skin feeling smoother and cleaner after use because it so vigorously rubs off outer dead skin cells. If you have thin or super sensitive skin, I'm not sure how this would feel. I'm the sort of person who scratches hard, so I loved this. It felt effective and it felt invigorating. The type of rough stimulation likely stimulates blood vessels close to the surface of the skin. I wouldn't be surprised if it had positive effects in terms of cleaning through increased blood flow.

The only point about this which I was not happy about was the inner seem around the elastic band at the bottom (see photo). The interior is stitched well, but it is also sealed at the edges with what seems to be melted plastic. Mine had sharp edges that I had to trim off with scissors in order to stop it from digging into my wrists uncomfortably. This ragged edge should be more refined. Though cutting it off isn't difficult, I'm concerned that cutting off too much will result in fraying the elastic resulting it in eventually unraveling so one must trim lightly and carefully.

Note: I received a free sample of this product for my assessment.

AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_title: seems to slow/reduce growth over time
AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_text:
I've tried some other types of these laser hair removal devices and the main difference between this one and the others is that the front piece is cooled to make it cold enough to offset the heat from the laser treatment. You still feel heat from it though, but the cooling effect of the front plate mitigates it to a fair extent.

In terms of effectiveness, I found that this slowed down or thinned hair growth after about three weeks of use. It's important to follow the instructions though as you have to have hair down first. It won't work if there is visible hair growth. The area of effect is a narrow band so it's not ideal for legs. It mainly works well for facial hair or small areas. Also, since laser treatment only works during active hair growth, it's necessary to keep treating repeatedly so that you hit a hair growth cycle.

There is a disposable razor and a pair of wrap around sunglasses included to help you with the treatment. The sunglasses are pretty good, but I still closed my eyes and shielded the top of the laser treatment gun with my hand when using it as the flashes are fairly bright and visible even with eyes closed and sunglasses on. It does take some time to start to see results though so you have to keep at it. This is easy to use though, and it has a lot of flashes available before the light cartridge runs out.

AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_title: works for dry/tired eyes, but must remain tethered to power
AGXNNDGBBN7K2RJQQW7UBR347SZA.review_text:
In terms of living up to its promise, this does work for dry and tired eyes. You spray the back of the mask with water (a spritzer is included) and warm it up. It creates a moist compress for your eyes which is very soothing. There are also fragrance-infused inserts that you can use (or not) to create an aromatherapy experience. I think they can be refreshed with essential oils when they wear out in the future since they fit inside the mask and don't come into direct contact with your eyes, but I'd only use oils that are safe for direct contact with skin anyway.

This can get pretty warm, but it takes quite a bit of time to warm up so I'd suggest plugging it in and turning it to the highest setting about 10 minutes before using it. After it's warmed up, then I turn it to the desired temperature. The controls are easy to use and intuitive. The only negative point is that the mask has to be tethered to a USB power source while you're using it which makes it harder to lie down while using it unless you have a power supply near at hand. The wiring is also on the fragile-looking/feeling side, but, so far, mine is working fine.

The mask is soft and comfortable. The material is satin-like and rests directly on your eyes. The pressure can be adjusted using the strap, but depending on the shape of your face, it'll rest more or less directly. Until I got used to it, the pressure on my eyelids felt a little strange, but I adjusted and now it is fine. I also think this helped a bit with sinus pain by applying warmth to certain parts of my face.

AGXOFM2VCOCBTNMGPIAFYPV22JNA.review_text: I simply did not care for this product it did not curl my hair nor make it an even wave. I say this because parts of my hair was a ugly “wave” and some not wavy at all. The idea behind this needs to be rethought. Wasted my time more then once of trying.

AGXOFM2VCOCBTNMGPIAFYPV22JNA.review_title: So cute but they do look fake :/
AGXOFM2VCOCBTNMGPIAFYPV22JNA.review_text: I love ethe feeling of the hair, but these looked fake when I applied them on. I will try to trim them to make them more realistic.
Super cute! This does keep my hair dry and I have had no hair issues.
So pretty!! And they clip on good and don’t feel rough on the head.

AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_title: A great nighttime facial oil to add to your beauty routine.
AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_text: The seller sent me a sample of this oil to test for my fashion and beauty blog. I love this stuff! I use it at night after I apply my face serum. I put three drops into the palm of my hand, rub my hands together and smooth the oil over my face. It doesn't clog my pores and does not leave my skin greasy. If you find a good night serum to use along with this your skin's texture will improve in appearance. Since using it I've had friends compliment me on how good my skin looks. I don't recommend using too much oil 2 to 4 drops should do it.  I have a large face and 3 drops do me just fine.

AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_title: The first product to ever make my hair feel silky.
AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_text: I recently did a blog post on this product because the company gave me a bottle free of charge to do a blog review and video review on. It is good for skin but I used this on my hair. I have kinky curly, afro textured hair and it can get dry if left untreated. I don't have trouble finding products that can moisturize my hair. I even make my own oil blends to help keep my hair moisturized. This oil gave my hair a nice sheen (my type of hair does not shine it is too textured for that) when used between washings. When I used on freshly washed hair before I set it and then styled it the next day, it made my hair feel soft and silky. I can honestly say this is the first product that ever made my hair feel silky. For that alone I give this 5-stars. I think I will straighten my hair sometime soon to see how it works when my hair straight.

AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_title: You can take a break from foundation using this. It's darn near a BB cream
AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_text:
I received a complimentary bottle of this tinted moisturizer to review for my blog. I am not the type who likes to wear foundation all of the time. I completed a 3-week foundation challenge this month and my face needs a break from foundation. However, I still want to have a little color to help even out redness. That is where tinted moisturizers come in. It is hard to find one with zinc oxide in it. If you have photoallergies related to sunscreen then you know how important it is to have sunscreen with zinc oxide in it. It goes on light, absorbs fast, and leaves my skin with a dewy glow. I like to use this on my face, neck, shoulders, and ears. I apply my makeup and I am good.

The tint is a medium shade but if you can foundation shades in the tan range, this will work for you

AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_title: Right now it is tied as my favorite retinol product. It beat ROC products for me.
AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_text:
I received a complimentary bottle of this serum to review on my blog. I really love it. I had finished my old retinol serum, which I liked and was ready to purchase another bottle until I was asked to review this serum on my blog. I like that this product is light. It has the same lightness as OZ Natural's hyaluronic serum. A little goes a long way. Two pumps of the serum is the most you will need. The serum absorbs quickly into the skin. Allow a full minute to go by before you apply another product over it. That initial absorption you see is just ti drying faster on the top layer of skin. It takes about a minute for serums to absorb deeper into the skin. Allowing this time prevent the pilling when you a moisturizer too soon.

Give this product about four weeks to see any real results. Retinol products take months of use to see any impact on deeper issue like lines and wrinkles. Initially you will feel a surface difference where skin my feel smoother or even softer. A couple of weeks later you may see some lighter scars fading. If you are battle crow feet apply a little of this serum at the corners of your eyes (don't get the product in eyes though) before you apply your eye cream. The two working together will give you better results.

AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_title: Great for dark circles, hydrating, and puffiness. Not good at reducing fine lines or wrinkles.
AGXWPQTZP4OZ7KTNATRIXYIMLI7Q.review_text:
I like this eye cream but it is not the best I've tried this year. The big things it does do is lighten dark undereye circles and reduce puffiness like a champ. What I haven't seen it do is work on fine lines or crow's feet. My corner lines/crow's feet look the same as they did before I began using the complimentary bottle I received for review.

What is love is that it has rosehip seed oil in it. I find this oil to very moisturizing and skin-loving. This allows the cream to be very moisturizing. I will put here as I just wrote for my blog review, this cream is ideal -- in my sole opinion -- for people who do not yet have fine lines or crow's feet. It is a good preventative product.

AGYAYA64QSPPDNZ43TOZSAR2IJ7Q.review_title: A wide assortment of grooming tools
AGYAYA64QSPPDNZ43TOZSAR2IJ7Q.review_text: Twice a year, I send a pretty big package overseas to a soldier that is assigned to me that I "adopt". I always send over a manicure set but upon opening this, I found it to be much more. I think this would be closer to a grooming kit then just a manicure kit because you can do your hands, nails, and there are also tools to do your face and eyebrows. The case has a durable interior shell with a padded exterior and a click, push-in lock. Along with the case, this would make a nice stocking stuffer, small gift, or something to add to your kid's college bound supplies. ***Warning: There are some VERY sharp tools in this case that could be considered as a weapon. Keep out of reach of children.***

AGYQ2352CRFD44FYJJ7P42ZFUMVA.review_title: It’s a light cream, nice for the eye area
AGYQ2352CRFD44FYJJ7P42ZFUMVA.review_text: This eye cream has mostly natural ingredients, like aloe vera, avocado oil, jasmine oil, along with some other skin enhancing ingredients like hyaluronic acid, retinol, vitamin B3 and panthenol. They also added caffeine, which is great as a stimulant for de-puffing the under eye area. The cream is light, and you only need a very tiny bit to cover the area around your eyes. It does de-puff my eyes somewhat, but no eye cream ever completely gets rid of the puffiness under my eyes. My lines are smoothed out with this, and the area around my eyes looks more moist and plump. You only get 1/2 ounce of this product, but a little goes a long way. I’m sure that with daily use, I will see more benefits.

It’s human hair, so it can easily be straightened or curled, just as you would style your own hair. What’s important is that the hair quality is magnificent! It’s very soft, sleek and shiny (but not too shiny). It’s very easy to put on. Just make your own ponytail, slip it on over the top of your ponytail, and wrap it around. It comes in a nice box, perfectly sealed. No bobby pins or hair ties are included. You will need to secure the ponytail onto your hair with bobby-pins of your own, though, or it could slide off from the weight of the ponytail. Once on, it looks like your own ponytail. It’s a very easy way to add some volume to your ponytail and change your look. It comes with some do’s and dont’s regarding this type of ponytail.

You get two of these headbands in a set. Each headband is very soft and very long, so you can wrap even the longest hair around it to create beautiful, soft, wavy curls! You wrap it around your head twice and tie it at the top. It’s comfortable enough for sleeping. This set comes with one storage bag, two hairpins that you use to secure the headband at the top as you wrap your hair around it, and ties to secure the hair at the tips. It also comes with full instructions on how to use it. They even added one complimentary regular headband that you can use after your hair has been styled! The interesting thing about these curling headbands id that the cushiony part is not at the crown of your head, because you don’t really need it there. This allows the headband to comfortably tie at the top of your head. Whichever color set you get, this is a great deal!
