A nice little gizmo.

Included in kit:

Battery operated Dooper handle (AA battery, not included)
Four interchangeable attachments: Bikini trimmer, rotary shaver, foil shaver, nose/ear hair trimmer
Two cheap cleaning brushes
Protective cap for bikini trimmer
Protective cap for nose hair remover
Cheap plastic bag to hold Dooper

Shop around, as this device is available under multiple listings on Amazon. Be sure to compare prices.

AH3OJBOMJC4VDM7H3WPKDYMOXWNA.review_title: 7 head shaver. Waterproof. The on/off button is easy to accidentally toggle when using
AH3OJBOMJC4VDM7H3WPKDYMOXWNA.review_text:
First off, I'm going to review this for face/beard shaving. I don't have a bald head (yet, anyway), so that isn't my focus.

I have used rotary floating blade shavers for decades (usually Norelco). They work best on my face, especially for the neck region. These shavers have always featured three heads.

Well, here we have seven heads. Seven heads!! I have used very similar shavers to this one with five and six-head shaver attachments. This is one more. The question is: Why do the high-quality venerable brands stick to three heads, and these shavers use so many more?

The answer isn't quality of shave. In fact, I was impressed at how well this shaver cleared the stubble on my face at the end of the day. It was comfortable, and managed to navigate the nooks and crannies of my face and neck as well as my low-end Norelco (if not better). But it's no match--not even remotely close--to my top-of-the-line Norelco (though that costs about 4x as much, so that's probably not a fair comparison). But--and this is huge--the ergonomics of the shaving heads leave something to desire. First off, there's very little reservoir under the cutting heads for shaved hair (see photos). This means you'll need/want to wash the head (it's water immersible) after each shave. Second, the middle head of the seven doesn't pop up. To remove it, you have to twist it off. It's a bit of a pain--and there's even less room under this head for hair than any of the others.

The third issue I have with the cutting heads is that there's no obvious way to replace them without simply replacing the entire shaving head assembly. Based on my experience with other shavers quite similar to this, expect the blades to get dull after a bit of use, and factor in the cost of an entire replacement head unit when they do.

In terms of seven vs six vs five heads? Well, the motors in these shavers are effectively the same. So if you have seven heads, the amount of power you provide to each head is less than it is in a five head design. That's going to affect the maximum speed and also the ability to easily tackle heavy stubble. Given that I don't sense a huge amount of improvement with seven vs five (or six) heads, I'd be inclined to veer towards fewer heads.

In general, I'd suggest that you can interchange the 7/6/5 head assemblies if you want to get a replacement.

In the kit you get:

Seven head cordless shaver with LCD readout of charge remaining
Waterproof (IPX level not indicated)
Nose hair trimmer attachment
Hair clipper attachment
Two face cleaning attachments
Three length guides for the hair clipper attachment
Charging cable (requires USB-A power source). The charge port on the shaver is a standard USB-C port.
Small cleaning brush

Shave is controlled via a simple on/off button on the back. Given how you would normally hold this--palmed (see photo)--I found it annoyingly easy to accidentally push the power button when I was using it.

The non-shaver attachments are a mixed bag. On the plus side, the nose hair trimmer works very well. This is in contrast with the nose hair trimmers that come with clippers, which are worthless. The nose hair clipper here works as well as the dedicated nose hair clippers I've used. On the minus side, the hair clipper is quite mediocre--it operates at a low speed and struggles with any amount of hair. It's about as good/useful as the clipper that's integrated into some shaver handles. Those can clip a bit of trim hair, but they are an exercise in frustration for any serious hair removal. Same here. The face cleaner attachments are probably OK, but I can't imagine using them.

On the whole, I'd consider this a decent little kit useful for shaving your face and for nose hair removal. The remaining attachments are, in my opinion, not very useful. While it does a good job of shaving out of the box, my experience is that the heads get dull somewhat quickly, and you need to buy a not-inexpensive replacement assembly. Also, cleaning the assembly is a nuisance.

Pros:
** 7 head shaver does a good job on face
** Waterproof (IPX level not indicated)
** Nose hair clipper works well
** Li-Ion battery: 2 hours charge for 90 minutes use
** Charge port on shaver is standard USB-C, so you can use charge cables you have at home
** Can lock the power button for travel (by holding for 3 seconds)

Cons:
** Too easy to push the power button when palming the shaver in the hand during use
** Hair trimmer has limited usefulness
** Face cleaning attachments not very significant
** Shaver head assembly doesn't provide much room for hair and will need to be cleaned after each shave
** Middle head of shaver attachment difficult to remove for cleaning
** Must replace entire shaving head unit when one/more blades get dull
** 7th head in shaver assembly does not float like outer heads

Note that there is a dizzying number of similar 5/6/7 head shavers sold on Amazon. As far as I can tell, having reviewed many of them, they are all made by a handful of companies and work pretty much equivalently well. The snap-in attachments even work across different models and brands. There are variances in features like level of waterproof and how the power switch works (and the body shape), but the function is pretty similar. So shop around for price.

AH3OJBOMJC4VDM7H3WPKDYMOXWNA.review_title: IPL hair removal tool adds active cooling (ICE). Relative low-power (36W)
AH3OJBOMJC4VDM7H3WPKDYMOXWNA.review_text:
The market for IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) devices for hair removal has exploded in the past couple of years, and you'll find a myriad of options on Amazon.

I've tried a large number of these IPL devices at this point, and I can say that these IPL devices all work pretty similarly, with only a few differences separating them. If you are looking for hair removal, then the most significant differences mostly amount to ergonomics (shape of the device and positions of the buttons) and whether it integrates "ICE" functionality to actively cool the region to which you're applying the light.

This is a mid-priced unit that adds ICE Cooling functionality and works reasonably well.

Specifics of this IPL device:

** Only performs hair removal
** Includes ICE skin cooling functionality
** LCD screen shows the number of flashes left and power level (1-5), plus whether ICE auto modes are on/off
** Rated for 36W (low end of power for a home IPL)
** Oblong shape
** Rated for 999,999 flashes

Operation is pretty trivial:

1) Attach the power cord to the IPL device (the device is NOT battery operated--you must have it plugged in).
2) Turn on the device via the power button, which is a button in the middle of the top of the device.
3) Choose the power level to use (you have five levels, and you cycle through them using short pushes of the power button). The level will be indicated on the LCD screen.
4) Place the front end of the device against the skin you are trying to treat and push the flash button (big button on the top of the IPL). There is a ~1s refractory period after flashing before you can flash again.
5) Ice technology, which actively cools the metal region that comes in contact with your skin.

The light is extremely powerful and could damage your eyes with continued direct exposure. Therefore, you should never look directly into the light and a cheap pair of folding protective eyeglasses are included in the box. The light is triggered by sensors in the front of the device. Using very slow-motion photography, I was able to capture a ~1/100th split-second snapshot of the light (see photos). But the light duration is extremely short.

You run the tool over the area where you want to remove hair and make sure you expose all the hair follicles in that region. You will not see any immediate results. The light signals your hair to stop growing, but it requires multiple treatments over several weeks before you will be expected to see results. Eventually, you should find a substantial reduction in the hair in the treated areas.

In the box, you get the tool, a power cord, a pair of eye protection glasses, a cheap disposable razor, plus instructions.

A word about the "ice" functionality, because this listing provides almost no detail (nor do those for other IPL devices):

Ice functionality is another term for "Local epidermal cooling."

This is given various names in listings, one of the most common is "ice function" or "ice-cooling". This is local cooling of the epidermal region (surface skin) in the region where the IPL light pulse is being applied. The high-powered light can be irritating to some people, and cooling the skin in that region can reduce the immediate irritation. (It does not improve/decrease the efficacy of the treatment). This cooling effect is achieved via a Peltier junction semiconductor and a good thermoconducting material at the head of the IPL device (frequently sapphire or aluminum) that transmits the cold that the semiconductor generates to the skin. (A heatsink and fan inside the IPL device remove the heat that the Peltier junction also produces).

Epidermal cooling is not required for efficient use, but it may make it less unpleasant to use the device for some users.

This IPL device is lower-mid-priced relative to other IPL devices on Amazon, but it does add the "ICE" cooling functionality. The rated power is 36W, which is on the low end of the range of power you typically see for these home IPL devices (between 30W and 60W).

Summary:

Pros:
** Integrates epidermal cooling (ICE)
** LCD readout

Cons:
** Not the cheapest IPL device you can buy
** 36W rating is at the lower end for these types of devices

AH3OJBOMJC4VDM7H3WPKDYMOXWNA.review_title: Adorable, well-made, compact and portable device for face cleaning/massaging. Pricey though.
AH3OJBOMJC4VDM7H3WPKDYMOXWNA.review_text:
This is a silicone face pusator/massager. One side features soft silicone bristles that are useful for working any topical application into your face. The other side features a few ribs and can be used for simple face massage (no creams/topicals).

You turn it on by pressing the power button on the back (massage side). You turn it off the same way. There's a travel lock you enable by pressing the + and - buttons simultaneously for three seconds. You disable the lock the same way.

The device integrates a 300 mAh LithiumIon battery. That's not huge, but it's big enough to give a rated 300 minutes of run time. So it's enough to throw into your travel bag or purse (after a full charge) and not worry about running out of juice.

It fits reasonably well in the hand. The vibration intensity can be adjusted in 8 levels using the + and - buttons. Personally, if I'm gonna use this, I'll be using the highest level, and at that level it dusts up a good amount of lather (if the topical you're using can lather). If you have sensitive skin, the lowest level is quite low--just a low hum of buzzing.

Honestly, this is a sweet face cleaner. There is a caveat here, though. And that is that this device is quite pricey for what it is (silicone with a moderate-sized battery and a small buzzing/vibrating unit inside). So whether it's worth the price will be a matter of personal preference. It's perhaps closing with a note that this comes with a two year warranty, unlike cheap similar devices, which usually with a blink and you'll miss it warranty.

Pros:
** Cute and stylish
** 300 minutes run time on a full charge
** At highest level, capable of a getting a topical (or soap) lathering well
** Lowest level is low enough to satisfy those with sensitive skin
** Travel lock-out mode
** Two year warranty

Cons:
** Expensive

The Laloirelle Deep Hydration Face Oil is a combination of many herbal ingredients and oils which are beneficial for skin moisturizing and rejuvenating. I am not sure whether having all these ingredients in one single bottle can be effective in deep hydration of the skin and/or taking full advantage of each ingredient or not, but I noticed long-lasting hydration from this oil on my skin, especially when I use 3-5 drops 1-2 hour(s) before going to bed. The combination of red ginseng and Shiitake mushrooms is great for soothing my dry skin and repairing the effects of sunburns.

My only concerns with the current facial oil are its slow adsorption and also the price. The oil sits on my skin for about two hours until it absorbs completely. So, I have to use it only at night. I have seen a faster absorption rate for other facial oils that I have used so far. This can be due to the different oil combinations in this product. Another issue is its relatively higher price compared with similar products in the market.

Other than these two concerns, the Laloirelle Deep Face Oil can be a great choice for repairing, moisturizing, and rejuvenation of dry and dehydrated skins and has long-lasting hydration on the skin.

AH4TB6XJJKH3WLSX2D56JYJ4Z4ZA.review_title: Great for resin and nails alike
AH4TB6XJJKH3WLSX2D56JYJ4Z4ZA.review_text: These flowers for nails are nice. They each come in their own container and there is a variety of shape sizes and colors. The one thing I noticed is that they totally feel like plastic flowers you’d find at a dollar store. I thought these would be dried flowers but regardless they are nice and usable for nail designs and resin alike.

This polygel kit is great for beginners and avid polygel users alike. It includes 7 different polygels but 5 of those 7 are around the same shade. I definitely like that this kit includes a small UV lamp along with both dual and nail forms. The dual forms on this kit are very curved which are not really my style but if you enjoy dual forms but do not like it as curved you can easily buy them on amazon separately . The polygels in this kit are on the skinny side. I think these are definitely worth it on sale and would recommend you buy them then.

This jiadel gel polish set brings some gorgeous unique colors to my collection. It is very pigmented, I only swatched it once and it was full coverage. Some of the polishes in this set are very unique like the ones with fur or hair on them, I’ve never seen polishes like that before. They apply smoothly and are a nice good thick consistency. Do not let the size of the bottle fool you, these gel polishes may be packaged small but they pack a good punch. I definitely recommend this to beginners or people who like adding unique shades to their collections.

This compact mirror is very stunning. The color, the finish, the quality is all great. I love everything about this mirror. I use this mirror everyday for makeup to go. It is perfect and very sturdy. I have dropped this mirror twice and it hasn't broken. It has only one scratch which is impressive. This will definitely make a cute thoughtful gift. I recommend this mirror it will make anyone happy.

AH4UJ5TB2Z26ZYO2NIBATDXD33CQ.review_text: These are beautiful. Unfortunately they only open one side. I can only clip my girl's left side unless I'm ok with the butterfly being upside down. With 12 clips, I was hoping half right and half left.

Not a fan of this type of containers. I was on the edge of breaking my nail trying to take out the plastic thing. I guess that means it's a tight seal. I only needed one pump for the whole face. My face felt super soft after applying and still soft the next day. There is very mild scent. A little goes a long way so I may be able to justify the cost.
It's easy to break the ampoule with the tool but the liquid doesn't flow well to get it out. It did make my skin feeling soft and hydrated.
It's very moisturizing but I wasn't a fan of the scent.
It's a gel cream with rose scent. The scent is not overwhelming. Not sure about the "glow" .
It is very moisturizing. I like that there's no fragrance. Great for winter.
It helps tangled hair but too greasy for me.

AH4VTTVFXMVFHQWLXNM4KBBLOAAQ.review_text: These are by far the best eyelashes I have ever tried! They are my to go to, they are just so soft and easy to apply. I would highly recommend getting these. Thank you! I will be making more purchases in the future!!
If your looking for some lashes that don’t feel heavy on your eyelids and make your eyes pop more, then these will be for you! The quality on these lashes are so good. I highly recommend.

[[VIDEOID:3d60ee897e20e02f814a0aea3514b11]] Let me start by saying, in person, these lashes look better! I took these pictures yesterday when I received them. They are super fluffy and they have a feeling of soft touch. I'm wearing them at the exact moment and they feel light on the eyelids, which is good for my sensitive eyes. Definitely suggest getting a hold of these!
I loved these lashes. They are soft and give you a lot of volume and aren’t too heavy on your eyelids. They come in 30 pairs which is a lot for a good price. Would definitely buy more.

Okay soooo what I first noticed about these eyelashes are how soft they are! They are not too long but not too short just the right length, I love how the band itself is not to heavy nor thick so it doesn’t feel heavy around your eyes. They look great.

Normally the eyelashes I order from Amazon usually have thick tape and makes your eyes feel a little heavy and not to comfortable. Surprisingly these were not bad at all, they are soft, and not so heavy on the eyelids. They make your eyes pop more, with all the volume that these lashes have. Not to mention you get 40 lashes for the price, you can’t beat.

[[VIDEOID:ae81a1f88f878f26126fb47813da2392]] These are one of the cutest lashes I have gotten. They are super fluffy that give you that exaggerating look. But they also feel lightweight in the eyes. I just wore these for my Halloween outfit and I got so many compliments I would post a pic of me wearing them but I look drunk in most of them. Love these though.

AH52452NXXPKFMO66MPSF5NFNUHA.review_text: This is a decent shampoo that lathers up well and rinses clean. The smell is pleasant but not overwhelming. I wouldn't call the feeling on the scalp invigorating, but it does feel nice and fresh. After rinsing, it leaves the hair feeling clean and non-greasy. The price seems to be a bit much for a bottle this size, though.

This 2-pack of aromatherapy candles is terrific. Each candle is in a tin with a cover, so you can burn one for a while and then cover it for the next time. The 2 tins come in a nice box so this set is very suitable for giving. Each candle has 2 wicks and the product page claims 40 hours of burn each. Based on my experience burning each for about an hour, I don't doubt it.

Now the scents - they are wonderful! You have lavender for when you're in a floral mood and balsam fir for a woodsy mood. Both of them are not too strong so they're not overpowering. My wife and I like them both. They smell very natural and true to their names. When burned, they create a very nice ambiance in the room. These candles are a bit pricey but they'll last a long time. I like them.

This is a hibiscus essential oil transformed into a spray. It has a very nice floral aroma and I tried it in 2 ways. As a room spray it's just ok. I say that because the scent just doesn't last long. As a linen spray it's better. It seems to last longer that way and would be nice at bedtime to spray a little on sheets or pillow cases. I can't comment on the value since there is no price listed on the product page. It comes in a 100 ml spray bottle that has 2 protective caps to protect against leaking and it comes in a nice gift box. This is worth considering if you like heavily floral scents.

This is a nice kit that contains several good-to-have items for a plane flight sitting in close quarters. Included are decent antibacterial wipes, very soft tissues, and ear plugs. Also included are an eye mask, pillowcase, and a resealable quart bag that is more durable than a zip lock bag. This is a quite useful kit to pack with you for a plane trip.

This razor has a very substantial quality feel to it. The angle of the head is a little different than others I have but I find maneuvering with it easy enough on most parts of my face. It gives me a nice close shave on my face and chin. Although it's a bit heavy, I don't find that an impediment. The included base holds the razor upright and is nice looking, with the same substantial feel as the razor itself. The included shave cream is ok.

On the downside, the head is quite large. That made it hard to maneuver in the area between my chin and lower lip. I also couldn't find any information on how to get replacement blades, a must for a manual razor. I looked on the Suprent web site and found the razor but not any blades. Hopefully, that will be corrected soon. Since the design of the blade cartridge is unique, I imagine the cost of the blades will be quite high, as is that of the razor.

This razor set is a nice combo of razor handle, 4 blades, and a tube of shave gel. It would make a nice gift for someone who shaves with a blade. The handle has a pretty nice feel. It's a bit wider than most handles but fits well in my hand. It's easy to maneuver around my face. The blade cartridges come individually packaged, each cartridge in its own protective cocoon. They're easy to put on the handle. The blades themselves are sharp and cut pretty well. The back trimmer worked well for my sideburns. Also included is a cover that snaps over the head to protect the blade. This works well for travel. Blade refills are $9.95 for a pack of 4 the web site says. All in all - decent razor worth considering.

AH5BEMAKZE5RJ3JSHUYOJ7S2WKBA.review_text: Presentation is nice and product is good. It’s very light on the eyes but definitely adds definition and makes a difference. I like how light the brush is and nicely it applies to the lashes. It does not bleed either!
Great use!! The fact that there’s too is such a plus. It goes up to 425° and heads quick! I’m very pleased and it glides throufh the hair.
Love the bulk and they size of these. Perfect for travel and multiple uses!
Gave this to my daughter. She loved to watch it foam up and get puffy. Can’t tell if it made a difference in her skin, just wanted something fun for her to do!
These are so easy to work with! They show really well on the nails and have so many different styles and color!

AH5BEMAKZE5RJ3JSHUYOJ7S2WKBA.review_title: Can be used for any and everything!
AH5BEMAKZE5RJ3JSHUYOJ7S2WKBA.review_text: I love the amount that you get. I literally can use these for all my household or personal needs. Travel, or just for small products I've made at home for myself. the bottle is small but wide so can fit a lot of liquid and is travel sage and friendly.
It’s a nice set of colors but it’s so thick to apply that kind of made the application hard but also a pro because you don’t need multiple coats. Colors were earth toned and very nice.

This didn’t work as well as I would have hoped maybe have to practice a few times. I like that it comes with the metal plates with the designs but trying to stamp them they didn’t always get onto the nail.
I love that this set comes with everything you need. I don’t have to find a million other items to do my nail routine this has everything needed to complete the perfect nail maintenance.
I love the tools this comes with. I utilize all of them and they’re easy to clean and also have a nice look/aesthetic. The brushes are the perfect width and style.
I love the variety of this kit. It comes with so much to use! I wish since it included foils it came with adhesion glue but everything else is a plus.

This has such nice colors and glitters! There are only about 2-3 regular colors. The rest are glitters and I did notice there were a few that looked like duplicates but will have to see how they apply once in the nail. I love the variety of the set and you don’t need to do multiple coats. I also like that the bottles have a little clear circle to preview the color!
This has everything you need. A large variety of different eyebrow shapes and the pen has two different colors for eyebrows. It applies well and easy.

AH5DZ3X7JLNNTZU6QNP72JXJ5NQQ.review_title: Jade Rose Quartz Roller for Face 2 in 1 Gua Sha Set
AH5DZ3X7JLNNTZU6QNP72JXJ5NQQ.review_text: I'm not sure what I was expecting when I received this Jade Rose Quartz Roller for Face 2 in 1 Gua Sha Set. It seemed kind of gimmicky but I have read about jade rollers on blogs before and decided to try one for myself. I guess it feels nice on my face, especially when it's cold but beyond that it doesn't do a whole lot. There weren't really any instructions for using the little scraper part so I don't even know what you're really supposed to do with that. I have not seen any difference in my skin's tone, texture, smoothness, elasticity, or anything like that. The quality reminds me of something you would see at an ethnic discount store. I don't know, maybe I'm not doing it right or maybe I'm missing something but I don't see the point of this product.

These NEOGEN DERMALOGY REAL CHARCOAL PADS are easy and convenient to use. They are a nice size and are very moist. One side is exfoliating and the other is more cleansing. They leave my skin feeling clean and hydrated. I don't know how effective they are for drawing out impurities but they do work well for cleansing. I have not experienced any irritation or sensitivity after using these.

I don't know why these types of hair ties are popular. These Teleties - Spring Collection Hair Ties were super awkward to use- like tying your hair back with a phone cord. I can only wrap it around my ponytail twice but it is not at all secure. It also rips my hair out when I take it out. I am going to stick with my traditional elastic ties.

I am not a fan of this GLO Science Teeth Whitening Pen. The clicking mechanism is super annoying- a twisting mechanism would have been so much easier. The thick, bulky, silicone tipped applicator is annoying as well and a lot of the gel gets left in its little bumps and grooves. It doesn't apply smoothly or evenly at all. I have been using it twice per day but have not seen any results. The taste of the gel is absolutely horrible- there's like a weird floral perfume quality to the taste. Do not like.
My husband did not like this American Shaving Co Beard Wash and ended up throwing it away after the first use. He said it was runny and he didn't like the scent.

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text:
After a shower and with wet hair, you apply this cream, and your curls form with a soft set (not hard and crunchy) that look defined and bouncy. It’s light, so you won’t add so much weight that curls turn to waves, and the scent is subtle and delicate.
Having said that, this is comparable to cheaper products I use like L’Oréal Curve It Curl Taming Cream, and that’s Much more cost effective (current price of $3.99 Prime).

The colors are pretty nicely saturated (not too transparent or thin) and the shimmery ones look very pretty and subtle--not glittery, just picking up some light. The similarity of color warmth and tone make these ideal for making gradients and smokey eyes, with darker tones near the eyelashes and along the crease, a saturated mid-tone along the crest of the eye and diffusing from the dark/shadow areas, with light highlights under the eyebrows and toward the nose. Nice results with pre-matched, complementary colors.
Not only will this trim nose hairs, but it does so without pulling, which really helps. Only needing one AA battery, this small and portable trimmer travels well and doesn’t take up much room.

I absolutely loved the jade roller and the scraping tool! It feels very gentle on your face and your neck, and there are instructions inside the box on how to use the rose quartz roller, with video links and care instructions for the natural rose quartz (it says jade, but this is rose quartz).
I looked up some videos on YouTube and there is some conflicting information as to which way to use the roller. For the neck, I understand the lymphatic ducts are towards the bottom part of the clavicle, so to me it would make sense that you would roll downward to get the drainage closer to the ducts. In any case, this is a great massaging, relaxing, and skin care tool that looks beautiful.

I absolutely loved the jade roller and the scraping tool! It feels very gentle on your face and your neck, and there are instructions inside the box on how to use the rose quartz roller, with video links and care instructions for the natural rose quartz (it says jade, but this is rose quartz).
I looked up some videos on YouTube and there is some conflicting information as to which way to use the roller. For the neck, I understand the lymphatic ducts are towards the bottom part of the clavicle, so to me it would make sense that you would roll downward to get the drainage closer to the ducts. In any case, this is a great massaging, relaxing, and skin care tool that looks beautiful.

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Very light scents, great travel products
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text:
Here’s a rundown of each of these great travel products:
*Lip balm: incredibly smooth finish, mentholated, neutral minty scent
*Scrub: wow! It smells amazing, herbal, and refreshing. The exfoliating stuff is great for preventing blemishes and keeping your skin smooth.
*Facial cleanser: where I loved the other products, I just like this. It absorbs nicely, but it just has a standard generic sent. It is, however, subtle scent, even if it is similar to many other types of lotions.
*Body wash plus shampoo: awesome, fresh scent with herbal notes. Very invigorating, smells amazing.

The very light smell of this is not that bad,  but there’s something kind of weird that lingers, like a weird chemical odor. I mean, everything is chemicals, but I mean it doesn’t smell like any particular oil or plant or herb or spice. It smells kind of plasticky? It absorbs nicely and offers a smooth finish, but I’m just not quite sure how I feel about the fragrance. It’s not bad, and it’s light, so I guess it’s fine. Not the best, not the worst.

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Smells like a freshly plucked Rose
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text: I love the scent of rose, and this face cream cleanser smells just like a freshly picked flower. Absolutely lovely for removing your make up in a way that is moisturizing and leaves behind a beautiful scent.

I absolutely loved the rose quartz roller! It feels very gentle on your face and your neck, and the cold of the stone is soothing and reduces inflammation. I looked up some videos on YouTube and there is some conflicting information as to which way to use the roller. For the neck, I understand the lymphatic ducts are towards the bottom part of the clavicle, so to me it would make sense that you would roll downward to get the drainage closer to the ducts. In any case, this is a great massaging, relaxing, and skin care tool that looks beautiful.

As for the little bottle of tumbled rose quartz chips? No idea. Decorative?

I only recently discovered face mist, and it has been such a lovely little treat when I’m feeling stressed or tired. You get a splash of refreshing aromatherapy that lifts your spirits, and in some cases, can moisturize or invigorate your skin a bit. The spray had a hint of rose and sandalwood in the fragrance, coming together to create an earthy and lovely smell. Nice!
I just got married, and this went to some of the girls who helped out. I absolutely love these post-party favors. They’re useful, cute, and a fun way to say thanks.

This was relatively easy to use and had OK results. Context: my hair is dark dark brown at the root, but I have fashion colors that have faded. The previous color was blue, but part of it faded into various shades of brown, so the underlying color is a little bit uneven. Having said that, because this cream is not very opaque, you can see a lot of the underlying color beneath, so if you are trying to cover anything, this isn’t going to do a great job.
The product pictures definitely don’t match the results regardless. Unless you have very light blonde hair, this is only going to provide grayish highlights. That is even taking into account the fact that I was quite generous with this cream. This is the first time I’ve tried a product like this, so I’m not sure how the other brands do, but this was just OK for me. I wouldn’t recommend using this for anything other than some colorful highlights on short hair, maybe not in a color that contrasts too much.

These no-frills toothbrushes are pretty basic, but they get the job done. The eco-friendly recyclable packaging, plus the bamboo body for the toothbrush, make these a thoughtful choice for those avoiding heavy plastic use. The bamboo will discolor over time, but I haven’t had any health issues related to that. It can look a little mildewy—no big deal. Considering you get a little toothpaste with each box, the price per brush and paste set of $2.60 is pretty reasonable.

This is a great set of basics to cover most household needs right now. Happy with the scissors and everything else—DIY life! It’s amazing what you can do with a few simple tools and some tutorials as bd practice. It’s good enough for looking a bit tidier on Zoom!

I was concerned that one of the bottles had some bubbling in the plastic, but it turns out it didn’t affect anything, so everything is ok (photo shows this). As for the spray, it produces a Very fine mist — perfect!

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Creamy moisture that stays locked in
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text: This creamy formulation is great for very dry skin, providing lots of moisture that stays locked inside. The ingredients are natural, cruelty free, and don’t irritate my sensitive skin, and it seems to be fragrance free as well. Nice way to pamper your skin

I was so excited about this, and with the price tag, I had high hopes. Unfortunately, it caused a pretty dramatic reaction, and my face began to itch and burn. I hate to say it, but for people with sensitive skin, sometimes a long list of natural ingredients isn’t really the best thing. Or at least it wasn’t for me. I feel very uncomfortable and I’m going to go wash my face now. Also, it smelled weirdly chocolatey, which is not something I expected at all, but it’s not a good smell in my opinion. (But if you like that, then you might appreciate this. If you have sensitive skin, this might not work out for you.

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Only had one set of 12 colors
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text: I’m not sure what happened, but this is a photo of everything that was included with my kit. It only included one set of 12 colors, and without the others, this actually isn’t very useful to me. I can’t give this more than two stars when it doesn’t have what it said it would. I hope they fixed this, which it appears they have from the other reviews. Shame. It was otherwise fine.

The rich blue pigment looks stunning for your eyelashes, and it can also be applied to the eyebrows. My only criticism of this is that the new style applicator brushes don’t do as good a job as the longer bristled ones. I have no idea why so many companies have switched over to this design. Also, the liquid is thin enough to be a little messy sometimes. Once you get used to everything, the brilliant color looks great.

This wig is absolutely gorgeous, with a great length and plenty of fullness for a sexy, luxurious look. You can’t tell in my pictures, but in bright light, you can see that hint of burgundy red, and in dark or light, it looks like a natural brown black. The only downside is that the part looks a little bit fake, but other than that, it’s a beautiful wig at a reasonable price.

This four pack of lip color features a fairly limited palette for those who like warm, deep reds. I wouldn’t say it’s the most matte lipstick I’ve ever seen; rather, it has more of an eggshell finish, but they look good for the price and are quite opaque.

At the current price of $15 for a set of four, you pay 3.75 per tube. The fragrance is light and vaguely like green tea, but not quite as herbal (too bad—I adore green tea), but it’s still good. As for the texture and moisture—a tiny bit greasy but very moisturizing, perfect for dry hands or feet. Korean skincare is terrific, and these make a great gift with cute little gift boxes.

I’m happy to say that these looked the same as the product photos, and they are individually packaged so that you can give each one as a gift to six different people, or keep them all if you want. Nice amount of fluid, fairly easy application, though you might need to apply it twice to get the right opacity, and once it’s dry, it stays put without smudging.

Wow, these are So much better than using your brush or those plastic scrapers. My tongue has never felt cleaner; furthermore, the next day, morning breath isn’t so bad! Your tongue is so clean from the night before, that your whole mouth just seems more fresh the next day. Absolutely wonderful! Highly recommend.

This ornate crown in rose gold, tones of amber, and hints of ivory and bronze creates an elegant, striking look that will have the wearer feeling like royalty. The size and proportions make it a grand statement piece that matches with a variety of looks, particularly those with warm or earthy colors. Great quality, doesn’t tangle with hair much, and a bit of weight to make this an absolutely gorgeous accessory.

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Nice weight and design, works well
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text: The current price of $17 isn’t bad for something sturdy that can last far longer than plastic equivalents. It comes with 10 razor blades, which because they are double sided, can be reused more often, as well as being able to manually sharpen the blades if you really want to go all the way with sustainability. Speaking of which, this is a superior choice in those terms, as the blades do not have plastic components and involve minimal packaging when ordering refills. Good product—see pic!

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Quite small, but works as expected
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text: I love witch hazel for cleaning my skin and helping prevent breakouts. This works as expected, though the wipes are quite small, and as far as the packaging goes, the hole to take the wipes out is tiny, so it’s a bit of a pain to get your fingers in there. Otherwise good wipes!

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: 3.5 stars; awful flavor and smell, 4 coats gets a good opaque color
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text:
There’s such a strong, sweet, artificial vanilla flavor and smell to this that is cloying and sickening. Yuck. I hate it.
Once it sets (about 2-5 minutes, which is longer than most), it looks matte and stays in place very well. It took 4 layers to look fully black on me.
Would be 4 stars if it didn’t taste and smell horrible. 3.5 stars

AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_title: Gentle, moisturizing cleanser with a woody scent
AH5HSMUMRJRDWBPFDQ6G3EAAOSFQ.review_text: This patchouli beard wash is awesome, and I’m not gonna lie, it’s also pretty good for the downstairs beard, if you know what I mean. The fragrance is woody and just strong enough to notice from up close, but not so strong that it follows you around everywhere. Gentle on your skin, and leaves hair looking, smelling, and feeling it’s best.

I’ve gotten similar ones to these before that barely make it through one day, and slightly better ones that can be reused for two or three days. These are probably the best ones I’ve had so far, lasting 3 to 5 times, depending on how thick your hair is and how tight you make it. Nice multipack, especially if you’re on the go, and because they’re small, you can always have a few extra. Comes in 4 resealable bags of 250pcs for easy use and storage.

AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_text: Emilia Baby Body Lotion will really make your skin as soft as your babies! I just had to try it on myself because I have eczema and they said it is hypoallergenic. I can tell you that it doesn't irritate my skin ad the softness is really noticeable...and that you might not be able to notice on your baby because a babies skin is (usually) already soft. I am an adult that has allergies to a lot of things that show up in skin irritations, and I do not think that you can go wrong with buying this lotion. This is a great one for your newborn, baby, and the whole family. The only con would be if you don't like the smell of baby powder. It smells like a creamy baby powder, and I like it.

These amazingly do the job of wiping makeup off my face without any products but warm water! It's gentle on my skin too. They are so soft, thick, and I want a blanket made of this material! I just want to hug it because it feels so nice.

AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_title: They are a little bigger than advertised. I measured 4 ounces!
AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_text: These are FOUR (4) ounce containers! These are a little bigger than we expected. They will take up more room in a carry-on quart sized bag than I want. However, the bottles and everything that came with them work well as expected. I just wish that the seller would verify information before advertising. I took off only one star for the advertisement disappointment, but I kept the other four stars because the set works well for the size that they are.

These can go on an airplane or be carried anywhere because they don't leak. I like that they included pumps aw well as spray bottle tops. Each one is interchangeable when you get them. My pump straws were too long, so I put them in the taller bottles, and put the spray tops on the smaller bottles. The pumps have a neck brace so it can't be pushed down by accident. There is a little funnel, and three lids for the sprayers. However, I did measure the size of the larger bottle with liquid and it holds more than the 100 ml that they advertised (3.30oz). They actually holds about 4 ounces, so keep that in mind if you are limited on space when traveling. The pumps and sprayers work well - they will be used on a future vacation.

These hair ties are exactly as advertised. You get 10 ties in 5 different colors. They have beads that resemble pearls attached to them. I wondered if they would look nice or if they would be too twisted to see the pearly beads on the outside. The result is that they look absolutely perfect!! You don't even have to do anything special to make them look nice. Just put it on as you normally would and the beads show well along with a nicely colored scrunchy hair tie! Good value!

AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_title: Leaves skin SO Soft, BUT Propylene Glycol is the 2nd ingredient (water is 1st)!
AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_text: This moisturizer leaves my boyfriend's skin so soft feeling. The scent is light and very likable! When the container arrives, it is in a box that looks really nice. After you unscrew the cap of the container, there is a plastic moisture cap that lays on top. That is good to keep on the container because it keeps keep moisture inside. It has a little finger handle on the top so it is easy to remove. It's a great product but it costs a bit too much as there are other products that can do the same for a lot less.

AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_title: Versatile, but watch out for short springs that come loose!
AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_text: These work as advertised. Big enough to fit my large fingertips without hurting them. They are a hard clear plastic with a metal rod and a metal spring. Make sure when you get yours to check the back end to see if the springs are aligned in the slots. If not, slide them with a fingernail or tool until they go into the slot. The batch that I received have metal springs that barely make it into the slot, which makes the spring pop-out if I open the clips all the way. If the springs were long enough, these would get a 5 star rating from me. As they are, I cannot recommend them. However, I do like that they come individually wrapped so they could be gifted in sets of 5 or 10 and the receiver would know the clips are unused.

AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_title: The hot comb can be used for people with any color of hair, not just "Black Hair, Beard and Wigs"
AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_text: The anti scold comb protector is the best addition to this type of hair straightener. It keeps your head and ears from getting burned, while it lets your hair glide through the hot slits of the comb. The hot comb can be used for people with any colored hair. I know because I tried it on my slightly wavy thin light colored hair, and to my amazement, it worked! It has a digital display and a 360 degree cord (it can spin in circles without tangling). The temperature control knob is right where I place my hand, so I have to make sure that I don't hit it by accident. Other than that, it performs well, as advertised.

AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_title: Made well. Comfortable. Stretches without breaking.
AH5IAJUPHMPM5YWPCZAXELP22QYQ.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:649d342f2c61e6aa9312654e4b54ed54]] The first thing I noticed when I received these is that they look exactly like the add photos. They are crafted well with a good choice of soft fabric for the covering.

CONSTRUCTION: Inside of the fabric there is a skinny headband that can stretch to a huge width without breaking, and it goes right back into the shape that it came in. The skinny headbands have a semi-stiff, but flexible piece (like thick stiff felt) around them to support the fabric to the width that is shown in the photos.

Please watch the video that I uploaded to see the flexibility and the other things that I mentioned that is not written here. These are a really good product! As I am writing this we are still wearing masks due to the covid-19 pandemic. These headbands are really helpful in keeping my hair out of my face and off of my mask when shopping. Having a comfortable headband is important to me when I also wear glasses and a mask.

AH5KP6N5BUJ5W25FAFUJXZKJ26EQ.review_text: Not at all what I expected by the reviews. Yes, it does straighten OK, though not as good as a flat iron, and it's pretty quick about what good it does. I always get compliments on it. It arrived quickly and was packaged great!😊

WOW, I am already very impressed with these just upon opening the package. The brushes are pretty big and a little bulky but it's still easy to apply. I will give an update after wearing them awhile if there's an issue but So far they look like really fun colors and a great value for what I paid with Prime and fast delivery. This could be one of my best amazon purchases in awhile yayy!! 😊 I'd highly recommend considering you'd pay this much for just one color usually.

Another winner from Diva Stuff if you have very dry or mature skin. I'm 53 and have pretty decent skin except it's dry on my cheeks and under eyes. This cream is really interesting! It IS very heavy and rich,  so if you want a light moisturizer this isn't for you. Otherwise,  if you need something extra heavy for dry skin I say for the price,  go for it.!!

I love ALL diva stuff products this one included. It IS a little strong around my eyes in fumes right at first but doesn't last long. Does it make me look 20 again, nope but it helps! I get compliments on my skin a lot at 54 :) ;)

AH5KVRRSAHJJ7S6DN2NUAGFKAB7Q.review_text: Worth it! A very nice product and very reasonably priced. Love the hydration it brings to the skin.
Great product and seller! Get it here!!!!
I love this product! I also use the Vitamin C Serum from this company and I won't go a day and night without it. At this price the results are "WOW". This brand is my go to now!!

This mask was a little more pricey than others but I wanted to try it anyway. I used the first one in the morning as I was scheduled to attend a gathering early that evening. I liked it, it was cool and felt refreshing. I am in the south so having something cool is always a good thing. I would just like to add that this mask I believe works better if you can  possibly recline a little for it to stay put. I purchased this product as I have recently discovered the amazing properties of incorporating  an "Essence" into my skincare routine. I seriously thought this was just another step to make women spend more of their money. I stand corrected. I honestly thought there is no way that is going to increase my moisturization levels. The first time I purchased one on the market was because I was adamant about returning It if I wasn't 100%, except it did work just like they said. I will not go without it now. It gives you moisture without a heavy oil type of effect. It appears to draw in exactly what your skin needs to balance. Yes, it is that good. Hope it works out as well as it did for me.

I recently came across this on Amazon and decided to try it. It had a sale price and I was having issues with very dry skin. For the price I did not expect "amazing" results. Well, I got amazing. I really enjoy using this. My skin stays hydrated and feels wonderful. I know I sound like I am gushing over a bath product, but this is truly good.  Also, I suffer with migraines and have to be selective with scents. Many items will act as a trigger. This is my second favourite reason I fell in love with this. Very mild scent.  I really am happy with my purchase (the Activated Charcoal) and returned to look at what other scents are available. Would make a great gift.

AH5LL52AXK4T5V2HTIW362T7ZFPQ.review_text:

I read the ingredients before I ordered and was maybe expecting a nice almond scent, since almond oil was one of the first ingredients but no it smells a bit more like minty something.

I do think the cream works very nice but the container is small and won’t last a real long time.

I ordered to use especially in the summer time when I am wearing sandals all the time and my feet get so dry .

[[VIDEOID:8522f9386c54241244ac40c04f958706]] I finally am going to work towards getting rid of my unwanted hair, I have thought about it for years but the cost to get it done was too expensive and time consuming for me.

This is simple to operate, fast and I don’t find it painful , you can set it to the settings that is best for you.

I started on setting 2 and have slowed progressed to 3 , I use it twice a week, on my 7th week I will do only once a week (all layers out in the instructions).

This is a process that will vary from person to person depending on the settings and you pigmentation.

It does now work for people who are very blonde /or fair skinned , or dark skin or tattooed.

I have noticed after a few weeks my hair getting thinner already.

Even after you get rid of you hair you will still need to work to keep it that way for a while, there is a time line in how often to use it and how many weeks in the instructions.

I believe this is definitely the way to go if you are not interested in going to get this done at the much higher expense.

Be sure to wear the included eye protection 🕶

AH5NVAXZVYYXHQLJITUIHC3APGUA.review_title: Help create uniform left and right side brows
AH5NVAXZVYYXHQLJITUIHC3APGUA.review_text:
I ordered these because I have only half brows and meet to finish them by penciling them in, and this can be difficult to make both sides match up.

With this set you can pick the stencil that best matches your natural brows and then use the pencil to create brows. I didn’t use the whole stencil because most of them would create a pretty large brown but I use them to create the shape and make them both uniform. You pick a stencil then do one side then flip the stencil to do the other stencil.

Works pretty well but you will probably need to do some of your creativity to make them look more natural.

Over all these are pretty helpful especially when you have the need to draw on brows daily, it speeds of the process and makes sure your aren’t leaving the house with 2 totally different brows.🤨

Perfect spray for a non wash day or even a wash day.

Great product

AH5NVAXZVYYXHQLJITUIHC3APGUA.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:a6ba862147ed74d78f8f3fda6a92fedd]] I must say that this double ampoule leaves my skin feeling very soft, moisturized and looking smooth and plumped.

It has quality ingredients and many that I have not used before and I was excited to try.

The scent is lovely and super faint.

I have been using this for a while now trying to see if I could justify the price, though my skin looks and feels very nice and I like this double ampoule and it’s quality ingredients, I have not seen enough difference between this any other quality ampoule I have used , I do know you are getting two ampoules and you are getting a total of 2 oz (1oz each) but I must say it is still a bit pricy but very nice.

This does work to make my fine hair feel and look fuller.

I do really like the smell of these products.

My fine hair does feel and look more voluminous but along with that it does feel a bit dry but that is expected especially when using root lifters.

I especially liked the conditioner that felt nice on my hair.

Do expect your hair to look and feel fuller, smell very nice and less limp but don’t expect super soft hair because that is just how most volume adding products work.

AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_title: Great for smoothing and straightening hair!
AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_text:
Pros: This brush is so light weight and makes it so easy to create a smooth, straight look with your hair. It does not tangle at all and is easy to use.
Cons: The brush made my hair a little flat, but I have thin, fine hair that requires work to create body.

This Cancun Collection Cacao Bronzer is a fabulous alternative to getting a natural suntan from a tanning bed or from the sun due to harmful UV rays. It is also a great alternative if you do not like using self-tanners that can smell. This applies easily and blends with all skin tones. I have fair skin, but this even works on my skin color too. The bronzer blurs imperfections and stays on until you shower with soap!  I recommend this product!  See my pictures for more information.

This MD Complete Bright & Healthy serum has all the ingredients recommended to treat fine lines, wrinkles and dull texture (Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Vitamin B, Retinol and Omega-3). However, I did not find this to be moisturizing at all and it actually dried my skin out - making my fine lines and wrinkles more noticeable. The product indicates this product is great for someone in their 20’s or 30’s - maybe that’s true, but this is not an effective product for someone 40+ dealing with aging skin. I cannot recommend this product for aging skin - maybe it’s effective for younger skin to prevent aging 🤷🏼‍♀️ - but it is not restorative if you have aging skin.

This Puretize I stand hand sanitizer contains 70% ethyl alcohol and is free of dyes and strong perfumes. It has a bit of an alcohol or medicine sent but it is not overpowering. See my picture for a list of ingredients. Even though it is 70% alcohol it did not leave my skin feeling dried out. I think this is a great value for two containers it would be great to use in an office, church, school, or even at home! Overall, I like this product and recommend it!

AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_title: Good emergency backup saver - no close shave
AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:f269f4bbb908ea03a9ffb408f24f4cd3]] This Sunsonic electric shaver for men is simple to use. It comes fully charged. To recharge it, you simply plug the cord into a usb charger and into the shaver. It does not provide a very close shave though. If you prefer a close shave, this may not be the best option for you.

If you are looking for an inexpensive electric shaver to keep in your car or in your office for emergencies, or if you are looking for one to travel with, this is a good option. The shaver also comes with a pop-up trimmer. Simply push a button on the back of the shaver and a trimmer pops up so that you can shave your neck and around ears. See my video for additional details.

This Derma Clear B5 Cica Cream is not oily/greasy at all. It makes my skin feel incredibly hydrating and makes my skin so very soft. It’s unclear from the packaging if this product is specifically designed to use on your face or all over. I’ve used it on my hands, elbows, and on dry spots all over my body and was pleasantly surprised at how well it worked. I didn’t notice any scent when using the lotion. My only reason for taking a star away from the rating is because of the cost of this product. You only get 1.69 fluid ounces of product, so it’s not a great value. However, I do think the product is effective!

AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_title: A little goes a long way!
AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_text:
This Pretty Frank natural deodorant has a pretty strong Jasmine scent. The instructions say to use a piece size amount. I didn’t read that at first and applied too much making the smell over powering. If you use the appropriate amount, the smell is not too strong. It helps keep you fresh smelling all day! Keep in mind this does not have anti-perspirant in it so it will allow you to sweat. However, it should help prevent odor. I like the fact that this is aluminum free, paraben free, toxin free and petroleum free. it is also free of imitation perfumes.

So far, I like using this product but need to put it to a test on a hot humid day while exercising! If that does the trick, I will update my review to five stars. The weather in my area is very stormy, so I am unable to give this a full testing! However, this has worked for me so far wearing this under normal daily activities.

This BH DERMCENTER Retinol Serum is made in the USA. This serum is paraben free, vegan, non-GMO, and gluten free. A little of this serum goes along way. It can be used daily under your moisturizer. It contains retinal which is supposed to restore collagen to your skin, lighten dark spots, and hide fine wrinkles. Only time will tell if this serum lives up to its claims. However, I like the way it feels on my skin and it was non-irritating. Overall, I recommend this product.

AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_title: Supposed to promote a more youthful appearance
AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_text: This Rose Quartz Roller with Derma Roller 0.25mm is a great value for this facial kit. It’s giftable and is believed that the microneedling treatment and pink jade roller is supposed to stimulate collagen. I’ve only used both for a few days so I can’t say effective this product will be, but I’m willing to give it a try. The jade roller is great to use when applying your favorite face serum. It glides and rolls smoothly. The microneedling treatment is not too painful when you simply apply a little bit of pressure. It did not cause bleeding because I used it gently as directed. You do need to be sure to only use it on clean skin and wash it after each use. I am hoping to see more vibrant skin after using these tools for a few weeks.

AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_title: Foaming cleanser that brightens skin on your face
AH5ONINJRNZ674DXUMV4RMYIFYVQ.review_text: [[VIDEOID:54b0aa506bf0c71a7c1b9f3ed89e41ee]] This O!GETi vitamin C foam cleanser is a rich and thick cleaner than foams nicely on your face to help remove impurities. This leaves my face feeling very soft and looking brighter. This product includes Centella, Panthenol, Tangerine extracts, and vitamin c. It is a gentle cleanser that does not dry out my face. This does include fragrance that is not noticeable at all, and it does not irritate sensitive skin. Overall, I like this product I would recommend it. This product is made in Korea.

This 2-piece Waterproof Mascara is a very good value. The mascara is not a super “wet” formula - its a bit on the dry side which has its pros and cons. Pros: Will not weigh fine/thin lashes down or flatten them like some super wet mascaras will do. It is also buildable. Cons: If takes multiple applications to add real volume and thickness to your lashes.

This mascara did not cause any irritation or sensitivity and it stayed put all day long (even when sweating). It’s also easy to remove with a waterproof eye makeup remover.

I didn’t notice this mascara helping curl my lashes. I still had to use an eyelash curler to give my lashes curl.

Overall, this is a pretty good mascara. See my pictures for details.
