I will not buy anything else, EVER!

"Jeff's Wife"-  Great plates and images that stamp beautifully, as always from Cici & Sisi. I do have two issues. One is that four of the six sleeves are cracked in the corners, like it's old, dried out plastic but I guess it's nothing that some packing tape can't fix. I've never had this issue with the other five sets from them. The other issue is the holder feels a bit more foam like instead of the pleather like the previous ones. But those issues have absolutely nothing to do the stamping ability of the images which, in the end, is the most important thing!

Well built and compact. The charger base works well.

So far the 'waterproofness' has endured splashes, but don't dare try to dump it in a tub of water.

The brushes work well and are replaceable. They should be available on Amazon.

The case is a cool and shiny white patent leather.

"Jeff's Wife"- These are so good! I only wish I had the original versions to compare. I've only heard negative things about the original stamping polishes from BM so I don't own any, I've only used MdU. But when BM reformulated their stamping polishes I gave them a try and I now own all the new collections so I gave these a try too. Boy am I glad I did. These DID NOT DISAPPOINT! I don't own white stamping polish, I use Sinful Colors Snow Me White that has been open for 3 days, it works but it's still not proper stamping polish. The black I use is MdU, the absolute holy grail of stamping polishes. But I have to say that these are beyond good! This black is comparable to MdU black in every way, except the smell. These have just become my favorite! I don't think I will be ordering from anyone else anymore.

"Jeff's Wife" - This is not true to color, it dries quite a bit darker, as you can see from the pic, but since I only use it for nail art I don't care but some of you might. I bought the pink back in Feb. 2015, still using it just got tired of the color, and this one seems slightly less opaque but maybe it's because that one is pink on pale skin but a second coat fixes the opacity, (only 1 coat in the pic). It may leave a few specks of the shimmer on your skin when you peel it off but they wipe away effortlessly.

If you're new to nail art and want to use this for that, I do suggest you transfer some to an empty polish bottle (cleaned with acetone or brand new doesn't matter) using a syringe with some sort of tip, an eye dropper or even a straw, this will keep the large bottle from drying out. This 4 oz bottle will last you a very long time, I still have about half the bottle I bought in Feb. 2015, and costs a fraction of the price as those other brands marketed specifically for nail art.

"Jeff's Wife" - I got these when they were an Add-On Item for $3.99, definitely worth the price. The stamper works great, I didn't even wash it first (even though you should always wash new stampers before first use), and it's slightly (I do mean slightly) softer then other clear stampers I own.

If you're new to stamping or not familiar with clear stampers, they are more delicate than opaque ones and tear easily, so be gentle with it. Wash it with dish soap & warm water, dry with a paper towel and clean it with a lint roller or tape. Never buff it or use acetone, you'll make it cloudy defeating the purpose of a clear stamper. When picking up, ROLL GENTLY over the image if you apply too much pressure it won't pick up. When applying the image to the nail press straight down (again, with GENTLE pressure) and rock side to side or roll from side to side. Don't push the tip of the nail into it, it will tear.

All the plates stamp great, I didn't swatch every image, although plates 29 & 41 have shallow etching (in my experience this is normal for BP plates) so the thinner scraper is a nice addition. It's not as thin as the 0.5mm and not a thick as the 1mm ones I own, I'd say it's 0.75mm (I didn't get out the calipers). There are different size images, a little for every nail size. But I do wish the water marble designs were bigger, I'm not a Water Marble Witch yet. Plate 52 is great for lead lighting or Sharpie water coloring.

The stamping guide works like it's supposed to, I've added a photo to show how it's used just in case it's confusing. I have a set of 4 templates from another brand already, there's not much difference in size or thickness of the metal but the designs are different. The edges aren't finished, like a plate with no backing, but I don't think it would cause anyone to slice their finger open unless you're being extremely careless.

All in all a great set.

"Jeff's Wife" - I've used the white name brand for years and some store brands but not the charcoal ones. These work just as good as the others, although I'm not sure if the charcoal really makes a difference.

The description photos show slits in the strip but I haven't seen them in mine, not a big deal but they do serve a purpose. There is quite a bit of black residue left over (there's also residue left over when using the white ones, the black is just more visible) but it rinses away easily with warm water.

I'm very happy with these.

It's gentle and cleanses well but I notice that it left a thin slippery residue that cannot be washed off easily. If you have a Clarisonic though it could help get rid of this problem. If not, maybe use a washcloth after rinsing.

If you have multiple kids or travel a lot, these covers are excellent. Well made and very cute. I personally like the dog.

Easy to clean and well made.

The description says shaving brush and that's why I bought it. But the brush box says its a Beard Brush. So, I still tried using it as a shaving brush. Big mistake. It was like using a pot & pan scrub brush. I couldn't raise up a lather it's so stiff. But it did a nice job exfoliating my face.

Badger? Don't think so. I have many real badger brushes. This appears to be horse or boar. There might be some goat mixed in, who knows for sure?

The bristles are super soft, almost like a make-up brush soft. Too soft to clean anything. They were a light gray and got lighter after first use. 6 bristles fell out during first use. I doubt these have any charcoal compared to the deep, black coloring of other brushes.

The toothpaste is an unknown brand from China. I'll try many things, but I ain't trying that.

These files are fantastic. I really like the fact that they're not etched like any other glass file. They do a great job at filing natural nails without all that ear splitting, teeth hurting, grinding noise other glass files make.

As far as buffing/polishing goes, yes, they do make a naked, natural nail shiny. But unless your nail is free of bumps, humps, divots, etc., it's going to take a long time to shine the nail evenly. What you end up doing is making thin/weak spots in the nail which will cause breaks or cracks as the nail grows out because these files take off a lot of nail. You can get shinier nails quicker with a base coat.
They do what they're supposed to do.

AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_text: Love, love, LOVE this moisturizer. I love it so much that I may have replaced my Avon Anew. This one costs quite a bit, but the tiny travel sized tube will last a while. This is a VERY watery product, but that's great for 2 reasons: 1) a little bit goes a long way, and 2) it absorbs really well into the skin. The best way that I have found to apply this is to tap the lotion onto my fingertips, then just sort of dab it onto my face before rubbing it in. This saves on product and keeps me from spilling any from the tube. Like I said, this has a very "wet" texture, so you won't have to use much. The price is way up there but, compared to using a lot of a cheaper product (that doesn't work as well), or a same-priced product (but using more of it), this is the best value overall. I'm going to see how long the travel-sized tube lasts while I save up for a larger size. Since this is something I have to save for, I really wish there were more size/price choices. Still, I love this and I think my skin is getting addicted to it!

AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_title: Like the way it makes my natural & nappy hair feel
AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_text:
This has the very, very *very* faintest plant-like scent (which is clean and pleasing). It's also thicker than I expected - almost like a whipped lotion. Before I used it on my hair, I rubbed some into the back of my hand to see if I'd have any kind of skin reaction. I did not. What I noticed is that once this absorbed, there was absolutely zero residue. I don't know what that means, but I was just curious. When I rub in other types of hair masks & treatments, I always get a sense of something left that I need to wash off. When I used this on my hair in the shower, I left it on for about
2 to 3 minutes after I had massaged it in according to the directions. (I have to stop and mention that I was also using the Daelong shampoo and conditioner set beforehand. That might be why I got my results.) This rinses out extremely well. My hair felt conditioned but with a lot less of the residual slip from other conditioners. That kind of worried me. I like to know that a treatment is doing something & the only way to tell until you've used it for a while is by the way your hair feels. Where I became so happy with this is an hour after rinsing it out. I have coarse and "nappy" natural African American hair. My hair tends to be extremely dry - especially after washing. A good conditioner keeps things in check until I can apply my leave-in products (oils, butters, sprays, etc.), but this time, my hair stayed soft and easy to comb through for at least 2 hours. It might have been longer, but I went ahead and applied my usual leave-ins. Still, I know that this did soften my hair (the day after, my hair is retaining softness without any more leave-in applications) without making it feel fragile. With they type of hair I have, I have to worry about breakage. I realize that I have probably been clogging up my scalp by over-doing it with the oils and butters. I like that I haven't had to use more of them for my hair to feel manageable. As a test, I'm going to try easing up on using so much leave-in stuff while I continue to use this.I think these guys are on to something here. I will have to come back and update this review as I use this for a while but, for now, I love the way this makes my hair feel, even after just one treatment. Normally, I only fully wash my hair once every four weeks or so. I will do a co-wash about every other week to keep it clean without stripping it. While I am testing this out, I plan to use it at least once a week as my co-wash. Like I said, I am also using the shampoo & conditioner of this brand. That might be a big part of why this worked so well for me, but I think that this would work just as good on its own. By the way, I'm going to alter my washing regimen for a while to use the shampoo and conditioner at least every other week. I almost forgot to mention the other thing I was concerned about: the label says that this makes the hair "straight and silky" - which is exactly what I, personally, DO NOT want. I love my texture and want to keep it. My texture is the kind that is prone to slow growth (because of breakage) so... I'm not worried about losing my naps. I'm thinking that this aids in stopping breakage more than anything.
I got this at a very steep discount.

AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_title: As good (or better) than the expensive "R" brand!
AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_text: Finally tried this after using a much pricier whitening toothpaste. This works as good (or better) and I can actually afford it. The other paste (well-known brand, starts with "R" lol) was good, but the price was too high and I stopped using it because of that. The other day, I found this in a two-pack at such a good price that I decided to give it a try. Guess what? I could see really good results after about the 3rd time using it. That's just as good as the other expensive brand. The taste of this one is nice and mild - which is a Plus because I don't like overpowering flavors. I can't believe it took me this long to try this one. I could've been saving so much money all this time...

AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_title: Deep color & fast drying but chips
AHE6A2KMCMQSOHCMNE7JQHSAHTRQ.review_text:
3.9 stars

1. This is MUCH darker than expected (tho I happen to like it). One coat will give you a purple look but more than that, this gets dark enough to look purple-black.
2. This dries super fast - which is a big deal to me - and that's nice until you start getting to the end of the jar. Once this gets down to the last part of the jar and begins to get tackier, it's hard to get a smooth coat on. Adding any kind of thinner makes the polish effect dull and ugly.
3. This is kind of a small jar or the price.
4. This looks really nice and smooth when the bottle is new but the polish chips easily with more than 1 coat.

Overall, this is a good polish if you want something of a darker color, but it doesn't last very long.

I don't know what it means that I want to buy some more of this color - even though I think the price is too high.

I got this because all 11 ingredients are things I recognize & are all "natural". The first ingredient is propolis and the honey is fourth. That's what is shown in the product photo. However, the ingredients are in a different order on the actual product. Still good, but not what I expected. (see my screenshot.)

It's a tiny tube (see compared to a regular toothpick) and the actual stick of product is not very long.

Overall, this is better than the usual basic lip balm I grab at the stores. It's kind of pricy for a lip product but I think that the ingredients are worth it & do make my lips feel more moisturized than they usually are.

I side-eyed the price at first but then I look at the ingredients - even as shown on the package I got - and realize it's worth it.

This is a nice mask for the price. I have short hair & can get 2 uses from each packet (you get 10 packs). The softness is better if you also use the Royal Oils shampoo. When I used a different shampoo, the results weren't as good. Next time, I am going to use a cap and maybe even some wet heat to see if that helps. I think the issue is that my hair doesn't love coconut oil which is one of the ingredients - even though it's the 6th of 11 ingredients.

The packs are pretty hefty and I think that I could stretch the use more by adding more water to my hair beforehand. But to be honest, I think that the R.O. conditioner works better than this mask!

Love the R.O. line and I think this will work well if I use heat or leave it on longer than 5 minutes. Keep in mind that I have REALLY dry 4C hair... I have almost the entire R.O. line and love all of them but this is my least favorite of the set & I won't buy any more of the mask.

AHEASFQXMGQJD2XC2T7ONFRKPZJQ.review_text: The wig is horrible, was shedding right out of the pack.

These lashes are thin, yes they are long but there is no thickness to them. They look like tiny spider legs, the hairs were shedding all over the packaging. AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_title: Mantiene la forma por varios días!
AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_text: Si tienes muchas cejas este kit te ayudara a mantenerlas en completo control. Mantiene la forma por varios días. Es fácil de usar y hacerlo uno mismo. Si tienes poco vello y no lo peinas bien durante el proceso se pueden ver los espacios. Si es importante seguir las instrucciones al paso y hacerlo con calma.
Son fáciles de usar. Tarda un poco en secar el delineador y hasta que no seque por completo no puedes poner la pestaña. Debes de aplicar bastante liner por que si no se puede salir la pestaña.
Tiene una fragancia suave. Deja la piel muy limpia y suave. Hace espuma rápido. Mi esposo lo usa para cara y cuerpo.

AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_title: Son resistentes al agua pero no duran mucho.
AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_text: Son muy fáciles de aplicar te ahoras mucho tiempo solo pones el liner y luego ellas se acomodan. La verdad se pueden quitar muy fácil. No duran mucho pero si es resistente al agua. Aplica una considerable capa del liner para que puedan pegar mejor.

Este organizador quedo perfecto en mi baño. Tiene un buen tamaño, puedo guardar botellas de productos para el cabello como productos más pequeños y maquillaje. Se ve muy elegante. El material es muy resistente.

Esta peluca es sumamente suave. El color es hermoso y el grosor del cabello es perfecto. No pesa pero tiene bastante cabello. Apesar de ser un color poco usual se ve muy bonita y natural al ponérmela, parece cabello real. El único detalle que tuve es que el corte estaba mal echo y tuve que cortarla para que se viena mejor y parejo en ambos lados.
Muy buena peluca, excelente grosor. Tiene una cantidad de cabello razonable. Se ve muy bonita.

AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_title: No me gusto el estilo de peinado que tiene
AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_text: Apesar de que el color es muy bonito el cabello de esta peluca es un poco grueso y es difícil darle un estilo. Viene ya peinada con las puntas hacia arriba y eso no me gusto. Sin embargo es comoda. Para peinarlo a mi gusto pase mucho trabajo.

Muy buenas para llevar productos en un tamaño más accesible para el viaje. Puedo poner productos para el cabello, fragancias e inclusive productos de higiene. El grosor de la botella a pesar de ser fino es resistente.

AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_title: No es grande pero es super práctico para llevar en mis viajes
AHEJQ4CPSHAQNTHL4BCVCAPZ7YWA.review_text: Este organizador es pequeño pero es muy fácil de llevar a mis viajes. Me gusta tener todo organizado y con este todo se ve bonito y organizado. No es grande en tamaño pero sirve para tener lo esencial. Me gusta mucho que tiene espejo y eso me hace todo más fácil. No es pesado y no ocupa espacio en mi maleta.

Se ve muy bonita, tiene mucho grosor de pelo. Es paciente de colocar y no molesta. Puedo ajustarla sumamente bien y se me ve super natural. Los rizos se ven perfectos. Es un poco difícil de lavar ya que los rizos pierden un poco su estilo.

El estilo obre se ve perfectamente. Cuando me la pongo se ve super natural no parece peluca. Tiene una ligera onda pero pude peinarlo y darle estilo a mi gusto. Es super facil de colocar, lavar y peinar.

AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_text: My husband is very happy with this razor. I think of Wahl as a hair clipper and probably wouldn't have thought of them when replacing his razor, but I am glad to have learned that they make just as good of a quality razor. He uses a regular razor in the shower, then runs an electric around to catch any missed spots. Because of this the battery doesn't need to be charged very often. The battery life indicator is very helpful as is the razor's ability to charge very quickly. He likes it. He is not raving about it being the best razor ever, but we are both happy with this unit.

Well, I do have a setting light. These polishes work fine. I think some of the premium ones, like OPI, work better, and are easier to see what colors are in the bottle. But, for the price they are OK. Gel polish is a pain to use.

I had never used one of these before, so I didn't realize how much of a mess they can make.

First, I saw that the USB charger did not come with a plug. I have plenty, so it wasn't a problem, but it would have been if I hadn't.

The plug that covers the USB port is not attached to the unit and I can see it very easily lost.

There is no hose. The whole unit needs to be picked up and rotated to use this item. I found it a little cumbersome, especially when I couldn't figure out which button was the off one when I was using it.

If you don't get the nozzle in just right it will come off and you will get sprayed. Again, without being able to see the "off", it gets messy.

The water canister isn't very big. I frequently have to fill it twice per use.

All in all, it is an OK unit. I don't have the expectation that it will still be working in a couple of years. But, it is very nice to use now. I will likely buy another WaterPik type device when this breaks. I just don't know if it will be this brand or if I will upgrade to a better one.
We have been using this for several months and it hasn't died yet. That shouldn't be a big deal, but there seems to be more and more stuff that doesn't last. It is easy to use and does a good job.

AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_title: small and weak, but it does the job
AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_text: I have the Amope, which only has one file. This has three, from coarse to fine. But the files are quite a bit narrower than the Amope. I thought this would be a bigger deal, but most of the time only part of the file is being used as I am working on the tough spots like the heel or edge of the toe. It doesn't have a lot of power and it kind of slows down a lot. But it gets the job done. I like that it is rechargeable as the Amore went through a lot of batteries.

The lever to lift the brushes up and down is tough to push. I don't know if it will get better with time, but the dozen or so times I have used this has not helped. But it works well to brush my dog and I am finding pulling the fur off the bristles works just fine.

AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_title: got them for my palm tree
AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_text: These are the same as epsom salts. They should not be used in gardens unless you need more magnesium. Too much is not a good thing, so all of the internet stuff recommending epsom salts are really bad advice. But, palm trees often need supplemental magnesium, so I got this. The effect takes time to show, so I am not going to lie and say my palms instantly look great, but this is a decent product and it should work just fine. But no, your tomatoes will not grow better if you add this.

This has very sharp tines that scratch my dog. The packaging is all in Chinese. I don't like it when a company doesn't bother to write the packaging in the market's dominant language. Two stars because it does actually brush, but that's about it.

Unless this is on sale, you can do a lot better by buying a thick lotion from a major brand or even just a jar of coconut oil. It works fine. I use it before bed and wear socks to keep it on my feet and prevent my sheets from turning yucky.

AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_title: very nice on my sensitive skin
AHEMJ62SUJPUYNWGROPI6MUAYQ5A.review_text:
This is a very soft, creamy foam. It has a pleasant scent, not flowery but with the faint scent of the aloe.. It is not strongly scented and I don't smell it at all once the foam has been rinsed away.

It did a good job of removing my makeup. Some cleansers don't touch my non-waterproof mascara. I didn't think this removed it the first time I used it, so I used another tiny amount just on my eyes. When I dried my eyes on a white towel only a faint amount showed on the towel, so it did a pretty good job.

My skin feels good after using this, It is clean but not dried out.

The most important thing for me is sensitivity. My skin is very sensitive and easily irritated. This caused no reaction. I don't know if the aloe helps, but I really like this cleanser.

AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_text: Smells great!!! Great, refreshing eucalyptus scent, and you only have to use just a tiny bit to lather up your whole beard. Even if you have a very large one. If you want a great beard wash, this is definitely the best I've had.

AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_title: I LOVE Beardsmen's Bold Forest scent
AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_text: I LOVE Beardsmen's Bold Forest scent, but this one not so much. When I first put it on I was expecting a more tea tree scent but didn't really get that. It says that it also has peppermint in it but that is not what I smell I put it on. I don't know how I would describe it but my particular ol factories just don't care for it too much. And I really didn't care too much for their citrus sent either. But I really LOVE their Bold Forest scent, but for some reason they are out of stock or not making it or something. It is unavailable here on Amazon and it is also unavailable at their official website. When and if it becomes available I would recommend getting that one instead or just buy the uncensored version. As far as the oil itself you will not find a better one because it is nice and light and non-greasy yet makes your beard soft and shine.

AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_title: I like Beardsmen's Bold Forest the best
AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_text: I like Beardsmen's Bold Forest the best, but to change it up a little bit I bought the Rousing Citrus. The Rousing Citrus isn't what you might expect. It is not that bright refreshing Citrus smell that you might be anticipating. It is more of a clove with citrus in the background. When you put it in your hands and onto your beard you smell the Citrus right away. But just as soon as you put it on your beard and rub it in the Citrus dissipate and there is a rather strong close scent. If you like the smell of clothes like I do then you will love it. If you don't then you will not like this sense at all. To be honest I had to use it about 3 or 4 times to really decide if I like it or not. So if you buy it and you used it for the first time and don't like it try it for another 3 or 4 days and see if you still don't like it. I think you'll find that it is a pretty good scent after all.

AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_title: The best beard straightening brush I've ever
AHEN6WGNOWHPZC7XQL57ROKFTDIA.review_text: truth be told I have only used one but this is the only one I need to use from the performance that it is all really giving me a few times. It has three settings and I put mine on 355 I believe or whatever the middle setting is and I slowly brush my beard and it straightens it with perfection after about five or six go-rounds. There is a couple of brushes on the market for $100 or so which I think is ridiculous. This was about $27 and it works just as good as them. AHETDGASODBTH5UNKJMMGGE6M25Q.review_title: This is a good set of contouring colors
AHETDGASODBTH5UNKJMMGGE6M25Q.review_text:
This is a good set of contouring colors. It has a huge range of colors needed for dark skin, to light skin, It even includes a white cream for highlighting along with some green and pinks to even out skin tone. Basically this set is a great set to start with and to have on hand for when your skin goes thru some funky changes. We all have that happen from time to time. Anyways my contouring kit is a cream set of 15 colors. Each color is very creamy and I had no issues with blending and rubbing in. However I always use a high quality primer with all makeup so that may add to the easy technique of blending into the mixture. Each color has its advantages along with its disadvantages. Like I said not every color is going to suit your needs so If you are looking for specific colors this is not the set for you, this is a range of colors for different shades of skin.
The makeup seemed to be long wearing but please dont forget that I used primer and that could have something to do with makeup wear length. I also did not break out with this cream as I have done with so many other colors. Of course I made sure to clean my face off each evening and I never slept in it at all. The plastic holding the makeup tins is a hard black plastic, I wouldnt call it super high quality but its not the cheapest I have come across. The reason for 4 stars is because I prefer mirrors in the compact as sometimes I like to have my makeup in hand while applying and it would be nice if a mirror was included. However it takes no value away from the makeup its just my personal preference. I also need to research some of these ingredients, (which I havent done as of yet while writing the review) I have not recongized a couple and usually most ingredients I am somewhat familiar with as I am a makeup fanatic. Nothing jumps out and screams do not put on your face though. I also wish the ingredients was listed on the hard plastic case so once you dispose of the box which everyone does you still have a list of ingredients in case you have some delayed reaction after long term use. Another reason for 4 stars. However overall I am pleased with this makeup palette. It seems to be well suited for a starter pack for those learning to contour, and those whose skin goes thru some weird skin tones from time to time. My only complaints were the ones listed above and no others. Makeup seems to spread smoothly and blends well. Which is what most women prefer when it comes to contouring. I did notice it did take several coats and more during application than what I am used to however compared to regular drug store kits its pretty comparable to it, may be a tad better in quality as it blends easily.
I received this makeup palette for free for testing and reviewing purposes, I have come to this conclusion by using and wearing this makeup for a few days myself.

AHF2R43HMV6S2J42LN6NLQTRBLJA.review_title: Does work but you have to be a patient person as this could take weeks to fully happen
AHF2R43HMV6S2J42LN6NLQTRBLJA.review_text:
Alright so I got this for me and my husband to try on his vacation which we did this on 9/10/21 it is now 1/29/21. I will start from the beginning. This was the first time ever doing anything like this for me and my husband so we werent sure what to expect with the process. When you take these out I will caution you to watch how much you cute the parts that go on your feet as I cut my husband's too wide and some of the liquid that is inside did come out. So you know there is liquid inside each of the bags that go on your feet that feels weird on your feet and cold. We left on for the recommended time of an hour the process is explained in detail which I will give them kuddos for. Now after we let them stay on for an hour we then showered them off I placed lotion on my feet the first night again not sure what to expect and I didnt want this to dry my feet out too much as to where my husband didnt have a preference so he did not lotion his feet. He started seeing the peeling first. Now keep in mind I do get pedis and my last one was probably in March of 2020 and since then I have used a foot file and soak during that time. My peeling did not start until halfway thru the week so I thought that was important to mention. He does not get his feet done and never has. His peeling lasted about a week. We are about what a week and half in of peeling 2 weeks in since I did the foot mask my feet still look aweful and they are still peeling. I have started to apply lotion to the feet to see if this will help the process and only have seen minimal improvement. Now keep in mind I am an impatient person. Also to mention a burning and tingling sensation is expected its what we felt during the process once we were done. Overall I think I will stick to my parifan drips and doing my feet the way I have been doing I will say that it did wear down a few calluses I had on my feet its just the process I am not patient enough for I dont mind wearing socks too much but this is more of being forced to wear socks so I dont shed everywhere and even then I still find dead skin somewhere. This process was horrible to me and I think there are better ways to get these results. My husband didnt too much mind the process and his feet were in worse conditon than mind and his process didnt take as long and for me that was even more frustrating. This would not be something I would recommend unless you are a patient person and dont mind waiting like this for results I just want to let my feet breath again.

Update: 2/2 My foot is still peeling this is def something I will not be doing again for me its about the fact that this is suppose to be something that takes time but really this amount of time for me is ridiculous and I can get the results its providing by using a foot file after soaking is that process more difficult yes but I get results within an hour not almost a month. My feet look nasty and dry even lotion isn't helping.

AHFOVAB3W6BLQSGZYBZ5U4W2FDYQ.review_text:
I am a college student with a very inconsistent and haphazard sleep schedule. My sleep schedule has caused me to get some serious under eye dark circles. I was worried about how it was affecting my appearance. Even with piling on concealer in the morning, I still feel like my severe dark circles are visible. I was so excited to try out this eye gel in hopes that it could help me!

I have always had dark circles, and after using this eye cream for a few days, they have been going away! My dark circles have been much worse this past year, so I was worried that I wouldn't be able to find a product effective enough to help. I am a fan of MARLOW products...I have several others not included in this set and all are great. I'll break down each product briefly below.

BAG: Very nice, basic black but well padded and holds it's shape. I basic in shape but I higher quality then usual.

SOAP: Great balsam/fir scent. Excellent balance of exfoliation and suds. Leaves body invigorated, soft and smelling great!

SHAVE: Has a tea scent, hint of some sort of alcohol. Builds into a creamy texture, not much sud but decent coverage. Does it's job. Finishes with a clean scent.

FACE WASH: Nice balsam/fir scent to it. A little goes a long way! Very slick, seems to not penetrate but wash the exterior of skin. Takes some work to wash off. Finishes with a green tea scent and refreshed.

FACE MOISTURIZER: Has a tea/alcohol scent at first...Goes on smooth. Dries fairly quickly, leaving a sweet green tea scent. Leaves face feeling soft not oily.

POMADE: Great scent, more cologne like. Goes on easy, not too tacky or slick. Does a decent job.

LIP BALM: Awesome balm!!! At first I thought it was an odd addition to the set. But man I love this balm. Goes on with a hint of sweet tea. Not waxy, not glossy, just a perfect balance that keeps lips moisturized.

AHG5KKQMMZJA46LDH73IZ4QUHYXA.review_title: Thin but works well. Not crazy about the scent.
AHG5KKQMMZJA46LDH73IZ4QUHYXA.review_text: The cream is fairly thin, with a pudding like consistency. Applies and spreads well. Leave a hydrated feel without an oily or shiny residual. Happy with it's performance, just not crazy about the scent. Smells earthy, like peat moss.

AHG5KKQMMZJA46LDH73IZ4QUHYXA.review_title: Amazing scent. Brings out the color in my skin.
AHG5KKQMMZJA46LDH73IZ4QUHYXA.review_text:
First, the scent is AMAZING...Sweet blood orange with a grapefruit bubble gum undertone, maybe even some jasmine and peppermint, something that awakens your olfactory. Its very strong but not overpowering. Truly one of the best things I've smelt.

APPLICATION: Goes on fairly oily and blends pretty well. Immediately brings color to my face, I have medium skin and it starts with an apricot redness but fades back to an awakened tone. I really enjoy that about this, I see others complain about this so maybe it's not best for fair skinned people?.

Once dry, I am left with a matte sheen that is well hydrated. You expect it to feel oily but it's more like a raw feel. A really nice balance of hydrated but not wet and definitely softer. I really enjoy this product as well as their others I've tried and will happily continue to use this as my nightly regiment.

I like the serum, it's more of an oil though. Fairly runny. Does a nice job on my skin and beard. I do like it and the scent I'm just embarrassed to smell that way in public.

Performance is okay. The balm is very fluffy ad soft like coconut butter. It doesn't tame as much as I like but softens and gives a nice glow.

Overall I want to hate on this but just can't... I can see why some might hate the cologne smell, it's quite strong and different from the dozens of balms I've reviewed... BUT if you like wearing cologne, you'll love this. It's a bit high in price but hey, you'll be saving in cologne price.

I bought some of this in the Caribbean last week for my toes. I was tempted to buy 3 and get 1 free but am glad I didn't now. I bought a lighter color that turns a darker sparkly pink outdoors. If you apply it indoors you can’t tell if it’s going on neatly.

The Good: It does change color in the sun - the colors are nice
The Bad: It doesn't go on evenly. It tends to streak and is difficult to apply. I didn't find it to be quick-drying.

I applied it indoors then went outside and could see how it had gone out of the nail line all over my toes and I had to use a Q-tip w/nail polish remover to clean up around the nail. It wasn't easy to do that and not remove polish that was already on there, even when waiting a few minutes for it to dry. I applied a couple more coats but still had to clean up.

The final look is ok but doesn't look like a professional pedicure that's for sure. I'm not sure my nail-tech would appreciate having to apply this. Perhaps if I had purchased one without glitter it would have been easier to apply. I think the concept is great, and glad I tried it but also glad I didn't buy for gifts.

The 3-star average rating this has been getting is fair.

AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_title: My new favorite primer! On par with High End Brands!
AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_text:
When it comes to primer, I've tried a ton of different brands, from high end to drugstore brands, but I always goes back to the same one. I'm very particular about primer, especially when it comes to how it feels on my face and the texture of it. I was interested to try this, but it was going to take a lot to really impress me.

One thing that will turn me off from a primer immediately is the smell. I don't like my primers to have a strong smell or anything like that, and right away I was pleased with the way this smells. I really liked the texture of this. I've found that most primers that work really well tend to have this texture, it's definitely thicker than a lotion and isn't runny at all.

Obviously the true test is how well does your makeup hold up??? Well, I worked a 10 hour shift and my face makeup still looked amazing, which is saying a lot during the summer! In fact, I kind of hope they make an eyelid primer, because as you can see in the picture my eye makeup did NOT hold up as well as my face makeup did!

My favorite primer happens to be a high end primer that generally tends to "smash" the competition, but I would say this primer is on par with that primer, and I love the addition of the vitamin E!

AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_title: Positive results for under eye circles and puffiness within 30 days!
AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_text:
I generally don’t like to review eye creams and items like this because you really have to use a product like this for an extended amount of time to see how it really works. This is not formulated to give instantaneous results and you really can’t use it or a few days and say “oh this is fantastic!” When I was approached to review this the company was more than willing to give me as much time as I needed to properly use and review this product and that really impressed me so I decided to give it a shot.

I’ve had a big problem with under eye circles and bags lately due to my erratic sleep schedule and other issues. I don’t have a huge problem with wrinkles or crow’s feet yet, but any improvement with the dark circles under my eyes was going to be a plus for me. I’ve been using this product for approximately 4 weeks. I try to use it in the morning and at night, but I’m not the best at removing my makeup, so it’s really been more in the morning.

I took three pictures, one at the beginning, one half way, and one today I definitely feel like there’s been significant improvement with under eye puffiness and dark circles. I’m definitely using less concealer than before, and I feel like my under eye area is tighter than it was before. I think if used consistently you will definitely get results with this stuff, but understand that it does take a few weeks to really see results, it is NOT instantaneous.

Pictures from left to right ( today, 2 weeks ago, 30 days ago)

AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_title: Fantastic set of brushes that has a wide variety of brushes!
AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:ee57af813ba86c8b2811225ae44f15f4]] I love makeup brushes and I own several sets of them so while I’m not an expert by any means, I do have quite a few sets to compare these to. First, I absolutely love the color of these brushes. Pink is my favorite color so I couldn’t resist this set of brushes. Not only do these come in a super cute pink case, but they have adorable pink handles and quite a few of the brushes actually have pink bristles.

There are 24 brushes included in this set so there are a wide variety of brushes. This is a great starter or supplementary set of brushes. The great thing about makeup brushes is you can use them however you want to use them, so this set of brushes will really cover any use. I personally love the wide variety of brushes that are great for eye makeup. I’ve really gotten into eye shadow and creating fun looks and having the right tools is extremely important and this set has pretty much every brush you could possibly need.

Each brush has a practical use, and there are four or five brushes that are great for face makeup as well. I really like the fan brush for highlighting and contouring. There’s actually a smaller fan brush and a larger fan brush and both are great tools.

The quality of these brushes is phenomenal. I always wash my brushes as soon as I get them and I’ve gotten a few sets of poor quality brushes where as soon as you wash them the handles become loose and come apart due to poor quality, but these held up very well even when fully submerged in water. The bristles also didn’t fall out while washing which is another sign of good quality. Overall I love these brushes and I’m glad I was able to add them to my collection!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest, unbiased opinion.

AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_title: Fantastic set of brushes in a nice case!
AHGOODGQNJRKELF3UXX5RKJ5PSQA.review_text:
[[VIDEOID:f0c2bad6411cb1763775ff07a47ae6b]] [[VIDEOID:b28c8169ff4b8186d0a5677e1564a732]] [[VIDEOID:868d17a43bf44324e45b16ef2516f38f]] I own a lot of makeup brushes, it’s a bit of an obsession of mine and I’ve become pretty picky when it comes to quality of brushes. There are a few things I look to determine the quality of brushes and they’re how well the brushes are put together, how soft the bristles are, and if the bristles are thick and full. This brush set meets all of my requirements so I’m pretty pleased with this set.

This is a set of 32 brushes, with most of the brushes being eye shadow brushes. These come in a nice roll up case that has a kind of pleather look and feel to it. When you have the case rolled up it takes up very little room considering there are 32 brushes in it, which is great for traveling.

The metal piece that connects the handles to the bristles is called a ferrule. I’ve gotten some lower quality sets where these are poorly glued together and are loose when they arrive and easily come apart. These came glued together very well and held up when washed. The bristles are super soft and they are nice and thick too. When you pull on the bristles you don’t get a ton of fall out either, so this is another sign of good quality. You may notice a bit of a smell when you open them but washing them thoroughly will get rid of that smell and it’s not uncommon for brushes to smell like that when brand new. I really like the variety of brushes and this is a great set at an affordable price.

They’re nothing like the “real” beauty blender and they’re just an absolutely waste of money. I will be 100% honest, I did not have high hopes for these sponges, BUT I wanted the little stands and two stands at this price would still be a great deal. You get three different products and I’m going to break down the quality of each product for you.

First up is the actual sponges. I have tried several off-brands of these and this is literally the closest thing I’ve ever bought to the “real” beauty blender, without the super spendy price tag. This is sponge is amazing! I gave the 2nd sponge to a friend who didn’t have the money to get a new one and she referred to this sponge as “life” and all I can say is my foundation has literally never looked better. I don’t believe you can currently buy just the sponges, but I’m hoping that will change!

Next you have the holders themselves. These are fantastic! Before I got this I would just store mine in a drawer and I know it probably wasn’t the most sanitary practice for something you use to apply face makeup and this is literally so much better.

You also get a little pad that’s great for cleaning your brushes. I think you can also use it for your face, but I prefer to use it for cleaning my brushes as it works great. Overall this set is just fantastic and well worth the price. I cannot say enough how much I love the sponges and the holders. I *thought* I had a fairly decent sponge before I received this one and I was so wrong.

When still damp from a shower, I rub the oil on my skin and it moisturizes much better than any type of lotion that I have tried.

These oils also make wonderful body scrubs using essential oils for scent and sugar or salt for the exfoliating. Using the scrubs also helps to moisturize.

I found the oils to be fresh, no sign of a rancid smell. They both come in an amber colored bottle which is the best way to store them.

Just in case you are not familiar with these types of oils, they are not scented. Neither oil has any type of scent at all and they are meant to be used as moisturizing products or carrier oils.

Overall: really nice set of oils that are fresh and in the right type of bottle.

This holiday headband fits an adult or older child perfectly. Because the pieces are very lightweight, it stays in place and does not feel uncomfortable to wear.

It is very shiny and festive looking. Mine appears to have been made with care and is so very much nicer than a dollar store headband would be.

This powder is very soft and definitely feels like cornstarch. The first time I used it, I could tell the difference between it and other powders that I have tried. It quickly absorbs any remaining moisture.

The bottle is very easy to use because it doesn’t pour out too much product and it opens and closes easily.

These silicone bottles are super easy to open and fill. They can then be clipped onto something like a back pack or a purse. I have one with hand sanitizer that stays on my purse. I have learned to be careful when opening them to dispense product. They squeeze really easily and I have gotten way to much product before I learned to be careful.

I like that they come in a set of different colors to share with friends or simply use for different things.

This is a really simple brush, no spinning heads and no charging cable. The handle holds a AA battery, not included. Once the battery is put in, you choose a head and turn the device on. It vibrates rather than spins and it does an amazing job cleaning my face. I really like the silicone head because it cleans but it also feels great. The brush head is a bit abrasive and not as comfortable but does clean deeper.

Because the brush is waterproof, I can use it in the shower. It also has a stand so I can leave it upright in the stand when finished. I also like not having to charge it.

I use one of these bottles on my gym bag with lotion and another with hand sanitizer. They are super convenient. The clips are great, so much better than the cheaper clips that come on most bottles.

You do have to be very careful to make sure the lid is completely shut. Also, with hand sanitizer, it can come out of the hole too fast when dispensing if you are not paying attention.

This gel polish has a nice collection of glitter gels. They are shiny and sparkly. I worked with mine while they were at room temperature and did not have any trouble with thickness. I found them to be easy to apply and to cure quickly. I do wish that they had come with a base and a top coat.

While there is no colored label on the bottles, they do provide a set of stickers to make your own.

This kit includes everything needed with the exception of a UV light. The instructions are included and and come with illustrations but there is room for improvement in the clarification of the process, particularly for anyone new to using this type of nail kit.

The only issue I have is the gel tubes. The gel is quite thick even at room temperature. This makes it a bit difficult to work with.

This water gel cream has a pleasant and light scent. It is a translucent gel. It comes with a small spoon for scooping so that the jar does not get contaminated. When applying the gel, it at first feels a bit sticky. That stickiness soon disappears and then my face just feels like it has come type of facial cream on it. Using it as a night cream, I wake up in the morning with my skin feeling nice and hydrated vs dried out. This is a nice cream to use after being outside in the elements all day. The wind or sun can really dry out my skin.

I have had no skin irritations since I began using this product.

These iridescent butterflies add another dimension to my nails. They can also distract or cover up some not so prefect spots. They stuck quite well to the top coat and then I put another top coat over them for security. I found them easier to apply to the wider and flatter nails, my thumbs.

This is a nice assortment of colors and types of butterflies. There should be something to match pretty much any color.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: My new favorite brand for wipes
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
These wipes are excellent. They are thick enough as well as large enough to do the trick. You can tell they have alcohol in them because for the smell. However, it dissipates quickly. The wipes are wet enough but not too wet. The best part is the flap to open and close them. There is a security seal to remove the first time you use one. After that, you just pull open the flap and snap it closed when finished. You don’t have to rub a seal to make sure it is securely closed.

Just like the other Germ Shark products that I have tried, this one is a winner.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: A Cadillac compare to my other light
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
This light is large, powerful, and easy to use. It has a long enough cord to reach any outlet that I need to. I like that it also has an option to charge my phone. It is all one piece so no worry about parts falling off when you lift it. However, the base can be removed if you choose.

The timers include the standard 30 and 60 seconds as well as a 10 second option. There is a smart sensor option also.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: Not fancy but handy to have
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
This mirror is perfect for my needs. It is large enough to see my entire face and yet takes up just a small amount of room when closed. I can even slide it into my desk drawer that is only three inches deep. It has a stand that is part of the frame so I can have it standing and don’t have to hold it. The mirror itself has no distortions and is crystal clear.

With no bells and whistles, this is just a simple mirror, but a nice size and the easel holds it up without falling.

I don’t usually use makeup remover pads, just a cleanser with my facial brush and a wash cloth to rinse. However, I find these pads easy to use and a quick solution when I am tired or in a hurry. The pads are extra large and easily clean my entire face. One side is for cleaning or removing make up and then the other side is for wiping the face.

The pads are in a large jar with plenty of liquid. The lid fits tight so I can flip the jar over to make sure they are always wet.

This 6 piece set of gel polish does not include a top or base coat. It does include 6 beautiful colors and a gel polish that is just the right consistency to apply evenly and yet get decent coverage. The gels cure in 60 seconds. I found two coats to be adequate or 1 coat and glitter on top.

An irritant is the lack of either a dot of the color on top of the bottle or a set of stickers to create my own.

This assortment of headbands includes mostly pastel colors. The fabric around the bands is a silky fabric with a bit of fabric folded around the ends so there are no sharp areas. The bands are comfortable to wear, even for an adult. They are not so tight as to give me a headache from wearing.

After looking over all 12 bands, I can see no issues of bad workmanship in any of them.

This soap gets points for cuteness and the interesting bag that it arrived in. I also like that there are different colors to choose from. It does the job as a facial soap but it does it better using a soap bag because it is a little hard to get lather.

I was not impressed with how it left my skin after washing my face. My skin feels dried out. It is also a very tiny soap for a pretty hefty price.

I have tried a lot of different types and brands of soap and this one is a stand out for me. I love everything about it beginning with it’s scent. The scent for some reason gives me a warm fuzzy feeling and makes my morning showers feel just a bit nicer.

I like the shape of the soap very much because it makes the bar easier to hang onto in the shower.

The soap lathers very well and leaves my skin feeling clean and like it has been pampered.

Nail Polish Gel Remover Tools Kit for Women with Nail Clip Caps, Nail File, Nail Remover Cotton Pads

This simple set is super important in making gel polish removal easy. Anyone that has sat with foil pouches on their fingers for 15 minutes will really appreciate the clips. You also receive a large collection of pads that you can wet with the nail remover solution.

Everything in the set works well and is a handy item for removal. This set is a good value at it’s current price and will save time and annoyance in polish removal.

KRISNICE Gel Nail Polish Blue Green Purple Valentine's Day New Year Manicure Soak Off UV LED

This is a really pretty collection of colors. Each bottle is a good size at 7.3ml. The colors are very opaque and look beautiful with a matte finish just as they are shown on the product page. The bottles do not come with the colored dots on their tops and dots are not included.

The consistency of the gels is good and it is easy to work with.

It should be noted that if you are ordering this collection for a gift, they go arrived in a plastic bag with each bottle in it’s own plastic bag.

Review for C'est Moi Vanilla Vibes Sugar Balm Body Scrub | Invigorating & Hydrating Exfoliant, Clinically Tested Non-Toxic Ingredients

This is my kind of sugar scrub. It cleans and exfoliates while it also hydrates my skin. When I get out of the tub or shower I don’t have to apply lotion to my body because the scrub left my skin completely moisturized.

The sugar in this product does the job of exfoliating and making the skin fresh and new. The oil in the product does the moisturizing, much better than just a lotion after because it really coats the skin.

There will be some residue left in the tub or shower that has to be rinsed with really hot water when done or it will be slippery for the next shower or bath.

Definitely a recommend for anyone that understands what this product is.

Review for Spanature Olive Hand & Body Lotion Travel Size Selection Made In Korea 75 ml/2.53oz (4pcs)

This is an impressive lotion. It is lightweight and yet very moisturizing. It has a low key and pleasant scent. Each of the 4 tubes arrived in it’s own gift box. The collection is really nice because each box makes a nice gift in it’s own right. You could also just gif the entire set or better yet, keep them all because it is such great lotion.

Each of my tubes of lotion arrived with seal beneath the cap.

Review for Specific Beauty Skin Brightening Pads, Skin Smoothing for more Even Texture & Tone- Dark Spot Fading Kojic Acid & Licorice 90 X 2 180 Pads

I received on jar of skin brightening pads. Sometimes only partial orders are received by reviewers in the Vine program so I was not concerned with that. However, there is another reviewer that also only received one jar so I felt that I should mention that.

My jar arrived with a security seal beneath the lid. Once removed, I was able to pull out a few pads. I found it difficult to separate them so that I only got one to use on my face. It turns out that every time I use these, I have to fight to get them apart and make sure I am only using one.

Once I have separated out one pad, I like how they work. They are quick to use and they do a nice job on my skin. My skin has a tingling sensation when it comes in contact with the pads. This quickly passes. I use the pads after washing my face and after use, I apply a serum. My skin feels smooth and soft.

Review for HASK COCONUT Body Wash 2 Pack- Nourishing, vegan formula, hypoallergenic, dermatologist tested, pH balanced- 2 Pack of 24.5 oz Bottles

The body wash creates a decent amount of lather when used with a loofa or sponge. I have used it as a bubble bath also and if you add it to the water as the water is running, it does a nice job. The coconut scent is a bit light for my tastes but not everyone likes a strong coconut smell like I do.

You get a lot of product with these two bottles. They both come with a pump for dispensing. I felt that one pump is not quite enough to get a nice amount on my loofa. The body wash does a nice job of cleansing the skin and it also rinses off easily.

Review for: John Frieda Detox and Repair Shampoo and Conditioner Set, 8.45 Ounce Each with Nourishing Avocado Oil

I am impressed with how fantastic this set makes my hair feel. After using both items, may hair is silky smooth and easy to style. It does not feel heavy or oily.

The shampoo smells nice and lathers well. It also rinses out easily. The conditioner smells even better and makes a big difference how easy it is to comb through my wet hair. Once the conditioner is on, my hair feels very slippery and I can brush right through it.

Both items come in a tube with a flip top. There is not security seal beneath the cap on either item.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: Love the shampoo, not so much the conditioner
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
Review for: Purple Shampoo and Conditioner ​Set - ​Sulfate Free Salon Grade (2 x 16.9 fl oz) - Hydrating Toner - Shimmer ​Correction​ ​for​ Platinum Blonde, Silver, Light, ​and Grey​ Hair

I love the purple shampoo. I has really good lather, a strong pump and a wonderful scent. It lathers easily and also rinses out easily. I like how my hair feels after using it. I am not so much of a fan of the conditioner. I was a bit surprised that after putting it in my hair, my hair did not feel slick like it does with most conditioners. It actually felt quite coarse. I always brush my hair while in the shower with the conditioner still in it. I attempted that with this conditioner and found that not only did the conditioner not do any untangling, but I got the brush stuck in my hair! I then rinsed and rinsed to get it all out and then tackled the knotted hair. My hair acted as if I had not had any conditioner at all and I had to fight my way through the knots. Once dry, my hair felt normal.

I have ceased using the conditioner but I do like the affect of the purple shampoo on my salt and pepper hair.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: Adds moisture to prolong my tan
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
Review for: MINETAN BODY.SKIN Tan Booster Foam - Boosts Color Results for Deeper, Darker, Longer Lasting Results, 10.14

I tested this product both as a tanning agent and as a tan booster. As a tanning product, I found it ineffective but that was not surprising as it is really meant to be a booster. As a booster, it does a nice job of moisturizing the skin and creating a bit of a glow on tanned skin. I believe it helps my tan last longer and possibly even to darken.

It is easy to apply, just spray on a mitt and massage into the skin. The product is clear and an actual spray, not foam.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: Good opportunity to try a lot of different products
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
Review for: Burt's Bees Baby Bath Time Kit With Ultra Gentle Lotion, 1 Count

I have been a fan of Burt’s Bees products for years. I welcomed the opportunity to try this assortment.

I found the bubble bath to be a good product for my household. Lots of bubbles, no scent that I could detect and an easy to use dispenser. The body wash/shampoo is fine as a body wash and I love the foam dispenser. It works ok for an infant as shampoo but I don’t like it as shampoo for a toddler with more hair. The wipes are great and I like the small package so they stay moist longer. The lotion is quite thin as most baby lotion is so you have to be careful when opening or dispensing it because you can find yourself with way more than you wanted very quickly. I also could not discern any scent on the lotion. The oil I only use to pour just a tad into a bath so soften and moisten the skin. You do have to be careful not to put too much in or the tub will become a slip and slide.

Overall: Nice products, not perfect but would make a nice gift, comes in a gift box.

Review for: Gel Nail Polish Kit With U V LED Light Nail Kit With 150W Nail Lamp 10 Colors Soak Off Gel Polish Nail Art Salon & Starter Kit With Rhinestones Glitters Manicure Tool Kit

This is a great starter kit for anyone new to doing their own gel nails. It includes a full sized LED light, something not all kits do. You get a lot of smaller tools and accessories in this kit and you also get 10 colors of polish as well as well as a top coat and base.

The polish itself has a nice consistency and the handles of the brushes are easy to use. They come with the colored dots on tops of the handles. I did remove one star from my review because two of the bottles of polish did not have their lids on tight and my kit arrived with two leaking polish bottles and a mess to clean up. This is a QA issue, not a packing issue as everything was packed with care.

Review for: Lemon Oil Towelettes - 20 Count

Each of the wipes is individually wrapped, making them convenient to carry in a backpack or purse. They also make good travel items so I can wipe down my armrest and tray if flying.

The wipes have a pretty strong but pleasing lemon scent so if you don’t like the smell of lemons, you won’t like these. They are just large enough to clean my hands. After using one, my hands feel a bit sticky but once they dry, the stickiness goes away.

Review for: PRESKBOO Facial Hair Remover for Women,Painless Hair Remover Shaver for Face,Nose Ear Trimmer

This small hair remover works quite well. It is also small enough to keep in a bag or back pack. It comes with a cover over the top so it looks like a lipstick tube at first glance.

The shaver requires 1 AA battery that is not included. It is easy to change out the battery just by pulling the base off. There is an on/off button that slides and is easy to access.

I am happy with the closeness of the shave. It also does not leave my face feeling all tingly like some shavers do. Because the head is small, I can use it close to my eye brows to catch any excess hair. There is a tiny head included for nose or ear hairs.

AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_title: Love the razor but what about refills?
AHGQDSOBAIVAAKJFIVEGS344MSXA.review_text:
Review for: Women Ultra Smooth Razor Womens Razors for Shaving Comfortable handle 5-blade Razor + 2 Refill Blades

I love this razor. It provides a really close shave, leaving my legs smoother than other razors. It is easy to use and the handle is large enough that it is easy to hang onto, even in the shower. The blades flows along the contours of my legs easily and does not cut me. It has a cover for the blade and a holder for when not in use.

It comes with two blades and if I knew how I could be replacements, I would throw out all the other razors in my house.

Review for: Cocoa Butter Cream Peppermint Body Butter - Mint Cocoa Whipped Body Cream

I love this body cream for so many reasons. To begin with, it arrived inside a clear bag with a silver tie, making me smile at the nice presentation. Being impressed with the packaging was nothing compared to the wonderful aroma that I was treated to when I peeked under the seal and looked at the product. It looked like whipped cream cheese and smelled good enough to eat! The scent is a combination of chocolate and mint. Taking just a tiny bit of the cream in my hands to feel it let me know why it is called velvet body cream. It truly does feel velvety, silky and soft.

I was able to appreciate all of the above before I even tried the product. However, using the product is the real treat. This soft and silky cream is just fun to use. Getting out of the shower and dealing with dry skin in the winter is a pain and this product changes that. Instead of being in a hurry to get some lotion slathered on my skin so I can get dressed, I look forward to pampering myself with this product. I feels so good on my hands while I am applying it to my arms and legs. Of course it smells wonderful too but the really great part is how well it absorbs and leaves my skin feeling hydrated.

If you are looking for a gift for a friend that complains of dry skin in the winter, look no further. Your gift will be appreciated!

Review for: 100% PURE Coconut Body Scrub

I love body scrubs and I love when they have an oil base that that helps to fight winter dryness. This one has a wonderful oil base that coats my skin and really hydrates it. It also smells fantastic. Because this is oil based, it does leave any oily film on my shower floor. I deal with this by turning my hot water all the way up and then rinsing the floor really well before getting out of the shower.

Review for: Dry Weightless Hair Texture Spray | Hair Spray for Fine Hair | Dry Texture Spray for Hair | Hairspray for Women & Men, Hair Styling Products | Texturizing Spray | Sulfate and Cruelty Free 244ml (7oz)

This spray is definitely lightweight. It does not make your hair sticky or stiff. It also does not hold as well as hairspray that is heavier of course. The can is easy to use with complicated spray nozzle that is hard to figure out.

I’m excited to see the results from this growth serum. I over plucked my eyebrows, so hoping to grow a few hairs back in. I will update this post when I have more to share. Very nice packaging!

This is a fun new tool to try. It was bigger than I thought it would be...picture included for reference. Works as intended (don't expect miracles, but overall very good).
These are a fun addition to my travel items when it’s safe to travel again. They all came individually wrapped, are squeezeable and a tight seal. Good overall quality.

These are so fun...I have one at my sink, one in the shower, one in my travel case and an extra. These fine little scrubbers are now replacing using an apricot scrub that is pretty harsh after using these. I highly recommend! The colors are cute too!

AHHWI6X47RXVMZOZCKRZCGZG36CQ.review_title: Norelco is great, this one is just OK
AHHWI6X47RXVMZOZCKRZCGZG36CQ.review_text:
I have used Norelco shavers for many years and prefer them to all other models I have tried. This review comes from much experience with the brand.

This Arcitec design looks fancy and works well, but gets three average stars because it really works no better than the previous non-space-age, less expensive designs. The 1050, 1060, and 1090 all operate the same, they just have a different display: none is better than the other, and don't waste money on the Cleaner accessory. It is fairly comfortable to hold (I prefer the feel of the original model because this is one is smaller), and looks fancy sitting on the counter, but it does not do a better job. It requires cleaning after each use as there is no space for the hairs. I have always cleaned my shavers after each use anyway. Unless you just want the apperance, it is not worth the extra money.

Technically: The triple-blade per round head (each cutter has three spinning blade areas) does not do any better than a double cutting blade. Kind of like a Saturday Night Live skit in the 70's, Jim Belushi said, "Buy a triple bladed razor. For those that will believe anything". Lift-and-cut is a ridiculous concept and a marketing ploy, but Norelco's do a nice job. Norelco went back to more diagonal openings with this model, which is good. Many other newer models have lots of little pin-holes which are worthless, as the hairs have no time to enter a small hole with shaving motion. You would have to set it directly on a hair to cut it. The less pin-holes the better.

Feel: The head design feels better on the neck, and has not caused razor-burn if I do not stretch the skin tight like I need to with the original model. It takes the same time to shave as my older unit, and I get no better results, no faster. It takes the same time to get a smooth shave, and the same persistance in some areas.

Function: It is a little bit easier to shave under the nose, above my mustache, but not a major difference. It is much harder to trim my sideburns with this unit as the heads almost cut my hair on my head above the ears the way it is shaped. Very poorly designed trimmer, so I use my older shaver for that.

Battery: Early, new battery life is good, as with most new battery devices. But, it states to not over-charge. Meaning, you need to be around when recharging to unplug it after it is charged; not good for those that shave and must go to work. The other units would shut off after charging.

Cleaner/Charger: Again, one needs to be around when it is finished to not over-charge. The cleaner is not necessary and a waste of time, money, and chemicals. I use a razor brush from an older unit, brush it out quickly over the wastebasket (one can't blow it out without getting hair dust all over the bathroom, and it can't be shaken into the wastebasket as easily as the older models), and I spray it quickly with Remington Silicone Lubricant (I can only find it at Wal-Mart, which is the only thing I ever go there for, by the way).

Overall: Buy it for looks and keep your old one in the drawer for sideburns. Nicer on the neck.

I would return it, BUT, it was a gift, AND I like the look of it. I know, I know!!

I was able to return the Arcitec and am really happy with this Braun 9595 model.
