AHISU6WTZZJNNVYK5A5UITDIWCNQ.review_title: HEATS UP VERY FAST & WORKS GREAT
AHISU6WTZZJNNVYK5A5UITDIWCNQ.review_text: I can't believe how fast this flat iron heated up, it was like instantly. It has a nicely lit LCD screen. All the buttons are on the inside, which is good since I usually hit the controls on my hair curling wand because they are on the outside. The temperature is adjustable, I only needed it about halfway since I have a finer hair. It does come with a heat resistant glove, instructions and a carrying case/ storage bag. There is a little loop on the cord so you can hang it and the cord also rotates so it doesn't get all tangled up.

I had bought myself a  heat cap for my hair because my hair is dry and it has really been thinning since I started becoming middle aged. My sister gave me this deep condition protein  hair mask a few months ago to try. I have been using it once a week and my hair is definitely a lot softer and shinier. The one thing that really sticks out is the smell, it is very pleasant and not over powering.
My hair is fine and I have a hard time finding hair clips that keep my hair up, usually my hair slides right on through and falls down. I am very happy so far.

I am so happy that I finally have a flat iron to take with me when I travel to Greece this spring, it is my 1st dual voltage hair appliance so I am quite excited to test it out there.  My hair has a mind of its own, so I have to keep it straightened. It is pretty light weight and I really like the black color with the rose gold accents.  It heats up very fast and really left my hair smooth and silky. So far I am very happy with it and to me the true test will be when I go overseas. As you can see in my picture it has an infrared light strip in the center of  the straightener.

As I get older my skin seems to be drier and itchier. I can no longer reach all my back area and this loofah brush is great for getting those areas.  It is always fun to watch how big it can get in water. Not only does it clean my back but it also feels like a massager. It has a wooden handle that is removable and a rope through the handle to hang it in the shower. It is very well made.

[[VIDEOID:f989859dba437111dda043bac274e8c6]] This is really good for my hair because my hair tends to break easily. These are velvet covered and very soft. They are so easy to use. All you do is open up, put your hair in it and close it up. They are well made and great colors. On the inside are these teeth all the way around it that grab on to your hair really good.

AHITRGVN4Z4YMOQQTJKUPU4IZDWA.review_text: Works well! Protects my hair from getting wet when showering.
I like these better than the regular plastic shower caps. They come in a 2 pack and are not bulky; fits just right. Stylish design. I wish they were available in other colors.
I like these for the most part. Love the almond shape. They lasted about a week with no issues. However, I think there should be more smaller size nails included.

I like that these were shorter press on nails and the color was very pretty, however I used the nail glue that came with them and they continued falling off. Did not last as long as other press ons that I've used in the past.
Very useful for facial cleansing and they're disposable so they're good to use when traveling.

AHIYQ25TVVYPJZT7QM32RMEOQW4Q.review_text: These stay on all day. Even in water like the pool. Or crying. I love them. Wish they had more colors to chose from..and lipliners just like it.

The liquid eyebrow pen was dried out. What little that did come out was very thick and caked up on eyebrows. Was not a smooth application. I would like to try a new one. Maybe this one was defective in some way.
My powder eye colors work broken

AHJ4TQQ77XQQNAF3MMOJHNVKHSYQ.review_text: Beautiful extensions. Perfect color and length. Arrived quickly.

I have been using for several weeks. Works just as described. Doesn't irritate my eyes. My lashes are longer and stronger. They don't fall out as often. I've just started using it on my eyebrows and expect good results.
Nice formula but not the color I was expecting
Mostly use this in the evening before going to bed. Nice texture with out being heavy. Has a very faint scent but not overwhelming.

AHJ5LXYWWWIGTONRRE324QLU6UCA.review_text: These flossers are not "waxed" but have a thin floss that does a nice job of getting between the teeth.  It is a sturdy flosser and did not get "stuck" in my teeth nor did it break when pulled on.  I definitely recommend these flossers.

I was really excited to receive this product because I thought I might find an easier alternative to blowdrying and flat-ironing my hair.  This brush styler is extremely thick and awkward to hold in my opinion. It has a lot of weight and bulk to manipulate while you are styling your hair.  The buttons are at a weird position making it hard to change the heat levels unless you stop what you are doing and actually move your hand to look at the buttons.  I thought it felt a lot hotter than my hair dryer with less options to reduce the heat.  I liked it better without the brush rotating but felt like it actually took a lot longer to dry with this styler than my blowdryer.  I received a compliment that my hair had more body today but I felt like it was more frizzy than usual.  I like my hair better when I flat-iron it and today I just felt like I had poofy 90's Jennifer Aniston hair.  I'm just not thrilled with this device.

These took 3 coats to decrease the blotchiness of the first 2 coats, but did eventually go on smooth and blemish-free.  The colors are natural looking and pretty, but my manicure chipped after the 3rd day and I had to remove all the polish.  Defeats the purpose of a "gel" manicure if you have to take it off after 3 days.

I did not like this product.  It's VERY thick and hard to squeeze out in the shower.  The cherry blossom smell I received was not pleasant and smelled more plasticy than fresh or sweet.  The product has the very strange greasy feel left on your skin.  Not oily like a nice body oil, but greasy like butter.  The polish is a nice abrasive texture on the skin, but the thickness, terrible smell and the greasy feel outweigh the polish.  I won't use this product twice and I won't order a different smell.  I just really didn't like it.

For $40, this is a "luxury" price point. I do not notice a difference between using this primer and not using this primer. I think my makeup looks the same and the longevity is the same. I hate the texture of this primer. It's like a whipped gel and I do not think it it applies smoothly. It feels like it "catches" on the skin during application. For this price, I feel like the primer should wow me. This is a $10-15 primer, not $40. On a positive note, it is packaged nicely.

I was going to use these for Halloween to greet trick or treaters (muah ha haa) but I got lazy and did not end up wearing one. I did apply one just to write this review and it applied the same as any temporary tattoo with water. I first applied lipstick and put the back of the tattoo on my mouth so I could see where my lips would need to open. Then I cut out a little piece for my mouth and that worked well when applying the tattoo. But honestly, they should have thought of that when selling tattoos that go over your mouth. You have to somehow find a way to create an opening for your lips. So, based on the hassle of creating my own opening, I don't think I would order these again. However, overall these tattoos work just fine.

AHJ6RT3EYLZ4SKIDSWKC2PHOBLLA.review_title: The best water bottle for my Rats
AHJ6RT3EYLZ4SKIDSWKC2PHOBLLA.review_text:
I have ordered two of those 8 oz bottles, one by one. I was so happy about the perfect water flow on the first bottle that I ordered an additional one of the same brand. Both of them came in red, which I am satisfied with, however I wish there was a color choice prior to ordering, I would choose teal. I also bought a smaller, 4 oz one from Supper Pet, which constantly clog, after the first lick (do not buy it). I then ordered a 4 oz one [[ASIN:B004LOETEY Kordon/Oasis (Novalek) SOA80404 Plastic No Chew Small Animal Bell Bottle, 4-Ounce]], which is just as great as the 8 oz bottles. It came in my favorite teal color.

These bottles are flowers patterned, full in one color with a metal pipe. They are the most pretty water bottles I have seen and also high quality ones. I totally recommend them.

I am amazed with this product. A tinted moisturizing sunscreen? My skin is very fair, where I live is hot all year round, and I apply only sunscreen for a day time, because using foundation and going out on a bright sun was melting my make up and making me feel dirty. This sunscreen is amazing, my skin looks fresh and is glowing, I don`t look like I have foundation at all, yet my face is of a nice shade. I love this product, much better effect than it sounds.

I received a sample.

Very nice hydration face mask by OZ Naturals, made in the USA and cruelty free. Main ingredients are Hyaluronic Acid (very effective), Vitamin B5, Vitamin E. It smells pleasant. My face does feel baby smooth and the tube is huge, it will last for a long time. I tried many products by OZ Naturals and they are all very natural and of a high quality. I do not like that I have to wash this mask off, I would personally prefer a peel-off.

I received a sample for evaluation.

AHJ6RT3EYLZ4SKIDSWKC2PHOBLLA.review_title: The slowest nail polish remover I ever saw.
AHJ6RT3EYLZ4SKIDSWKC2PHOBLLA.review_text:
I am a big fan of Pure Body Naturals, however not of this particular product. In fact, I don't get all the positive reviews, this nail polish remover hardly works. It takes a very long time to clean my nails with this. I use a regular nail polish, that any cheap remover, even the one from a dollar store has no problem taking off, but not this natural remover by Pure Body Naturals. I followed instruction, put a drop on each of my nails, waited and tried to rub it off with a cotton ball, to no success. It took some of the polish off, but left a whole lot left behind. It is possible to remove nail polish with this, but totally not worth the time/effort.

I also haven't notice my nails feeling any better using this natural product over the regular ones, so I definitely will not be using this one, nor ever buy again, nor recommend. This may be worth, if you don't mind spending long time removing your polish and are very concerned using only natural products, other than that, its not at all. I am very disappointed, its the worth nail polish remover I ever came across, nothing beats it. Unfortunately I already opened it, so I am not going to return it nor gift it, it will probably just go straight into the trash, I don't think I will want to use it any time.

I received a sample in exchange of my honest opinion.

AHJ6RT3EYLZ4SKIDSWKC2PHOBLLA.review_title: Im highly impressed with these great scents.
AHJ6RT3EYLZ4SKIDSWKC2PHOBLLA.review_text:
I am absolutely thrilled upon opening the package with these bath bombs. They smell amazing. Each ball is 2 1/4'' in diameter, they are pretty big, they weight 4.1 oz each. There are six scents: Yoga Strength, Garden of Heaven, Revive, Energy Grapefruit, Stress Relief and Vanilla Indulgence. Each is separately wrapped in a tissue. They all lay on a bed of cut paper, looks really nice. Box is also quality and additionally factory foiled at arrival. This is very suitable for gifting. Definitely a five stars product. Their smell is addictive.

Yoga Strength - Lemon, Lime, Orange and Bergamot Oils;
Garden of Heaven - Lavender, Geranium and Lima OIls;
Revive - Peppermint, Lemon, Rosemary and Eucalyptus Essential Oils;
Energy Grapefruit - Grapefruit Essential Oil;
Stress Relief - Lavender, Marjoram and Ylang Oils;
Vanilla Indulgence - Vanilla Essential Oil.

Yoga Strength is the best.

Sample received for a fair evaluation.

This bag is almost exactly what I wanted. I had an almost same Caboodles makeup bag purchased from Walmart about 8 years ago and just wanted same, new one. This one is bigger than the ones Walmart sells. I wish it was the same size as my old one as the new one appears bigger, mostly on the outside, but it sort of fits the same amount of cosmetics. Regardless, this is a beautiful bag, mine came with a separator and exactly as described. I will be purchasing Caboodles` bags again. I think the quality is very good. The top of my bag is larger than it should be and makes the bag to unnecessary look big but it still zippers around just as well. I`m happy with my purchase.

AHJCM3JRBF4KIY35BR5CJIL63WTA.review_title: Frontal with low quality hair mats after a week
AHJCM3JRBF4KIY35BR5CJIL63WTA.review_text: Literally lasted a week and lost its curl pattern and became matted. They really need to up the quality of frontal hair. Bundles have good hair quality but we get extorted with these frontals.

I really like this hair, the bundles are kind of thin so make sure you’ve got some extra hair around if you want your weave thick thick.  I didn’t want to post a pic without the closure because I never understand folks who do that. I may post an update with a pic but it was a good buy.

I bought this hair because I loved the curl pattern and saw all the reviews. As soon as I washed and conditioned it...as you can see from the pics nan one curl left.  The wefts are thick, the hair is good quality - although I haven’t worn it may post an update after - the frontal acted a little crazy after I bleached the knots but I used a great conditioner and it came right back. But no curls 😟😟
The curl pattern is really weird, looks like they dipped it in hot water to make it longer? The top is thick and the bottom is stringy-looking.  The hair feels soft though. I’ll post an update.

The price is honestly good.  We all know these products are called Human Hair and they’re clearly not literally human hair.  The hair did melt when I tried to curl it, but I’ve kept it in a whole month with the help of hair serums and braiding it at night.  The curls were really pretty and it looks like Yaki hair now, it tangles a bit, but it is fine by me.  It doesn’t frizz or anything, once you brush the knots out and use serum, you’re good.

AHJDTCWJ34VEI2FYID5QONKVAUAA.review_text: I do nails and I only use this brand. It lasts long, cures great, only takes about 2 coats and the color choices are amazing!

AHJDTCWJ34VEI2FYID5QONKVAUAA.review_title: Great wig, true to picture. Buy it!
AHJDTCWJ34VEI2FYID5QONKVAUAA.review_text: Ladies let me tell you this is a great synthetic wig!  It comes true to the pictures but it did not come in the nice box like the ones in the videos.  I myself didn't prefer the color on myself so I did airbrush it with my Luminous Air brush makeup to give it the darker red tones you see in my pictures. The curls were too much for me so I paddle brushed the heck out of the wig, then with my flatiron on about 300° ran it through the hair to relax the curls even more. I love how it blends seamlessly with my natural hair line. I did cut just a few baby hairs to blend with my own. The wig is so light on my head, the hair is so soft but it tangled like crazy before I straightened the curls out.
This wig is not worth the money! The scalp is this white plastic thing that you can't color or remove without cutting the wefts. The hair tangles so badly and it just looks wigy.
The description is deceptive I did not get wig caps with these and I tried to at least like the bands but they just slip all over my head. Very disappointed, don't waste your money.

So far it still looks good even after a day at the beach. This hair does look and feel better than what I've purchased before. Definitely will buy this hair again vs going to the hair supply store.

AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_title: Finally files that I can actually use on my weak nails without tearing them up!
AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_text: Finally files that I can actually use on my frail nails without tearing them up! I used to like Sally hansen nail files, but can no longer find these anymore. I believe they were a softer grit emery board as these are. I'm very happy to finally have found the fine grit that I need for my thin nails. I personally like that these come individually wrapped so that I can store one in every bag without damaging anything around them!

AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_title: Will not hold very thick hair.
AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_text: This really is not for very thick hair. The barrette clip itself is only 2 1/4" wide. The clip is pretty though, but unfortunately will not work for my mother as there is no way this would hold all of her hair.
These would be cute, and functional for me if A LOT smaller. These will not hold my fine hair at all - they are HUGE.

This is predominately Sunflower seed oil and Safflower oil - ie. CHEAP COOKING oils! I'm thankful Amazon refunded this, as I expected a bottle of vitamin E oil, not cooking oils with a little bit of vit e and other stuff.

AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_title: NEW formula is TERRIBLE!!!!! ALL good reviews are from the AMAZING previous version!!!!
AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_text:
The previous Pure Body Naturals Pure Gloss Smoothing Shampoo was AMAZING. This new version leaves my hair stringy and dry!

See the difference in ingredients in my photo! The previous formula had argan oil as the second ingredient!

I am soo sad they discontinued this amazing shampoo and replaced it with such a terrible product!

AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_title: The best hair curler ever for fine hair!
AHJEM2HZDNZWYIAGENWW6GTHHLNA.review_text: I use this at home and when traveling. I have mid length (my hair reaches mid back) very fine hair. This is by far the best hair curler ever! It's short enough that I don't burn myself! I rarely use the flattener position. I wish I could buy a backup of this fantastic little tool! It's compact for traveling, and the perfect size heating element for fine hair!

I much appreciate French deodorants. I do not understand why do many in the US smell like baby powder-YUCK! this has a pleasant feminine scent and  keeps my underarms dry all day. I also love that it's alcohol free and doesn't sting when applying straight after shaving in the shower.

AHJGOVXWEV57QYKHIJZVHA5S5DBQ.review_text: I have really thick hair (like it looks like thread) and this works great!  It actually fits all my hair and I was happy that I got two!  Great deal and super cute when showering.

AHJGOVXWEV57QYKHIJZVHA5S5DBQ.review_title: This surprised me... its a very strong comb!
AHJGOVXWEV57QYKHIJZVHA5S5DBQ.review_text:
I have extremely thick hair. And I break combs pretty easily. I wanted to try this out with little expectation that it would work. I honestly thought it would bend, yet I was wrong.

This is actually very strong, and went through my hair nicely. It can put my hair up in a pony tail, and goes through my wet hair nicely as well.

For the price, this is a great comb.

Tried this out on my daughter hair. She has finer hair than mine… it was easy enough to do, her hair is on the shorter side.

And the curls came out nice! Overall happy. It’s like the old curlers but more comfortable

This pack comes with the nails and stickers to put them on. No glue but I am okay with that cause I don’t like using the glue.

Note that the directions are a translation so doesn’t make total sense but you can just YouTube a video and you would be fine.

I did have a harder time to find right size. But over all happy.

AHJGOVXWEV57QYKHIJZVHA5S5DBQ.review_title: This is a great kit! Everything you need in once place.
AHJGOVXWEV57QYKHIJZVHA5S5DBQ.review_text:
It has everything you need in this kit!

It’s super easy to use… and comes with so much. This is great for a kids party or just for fun.

You can reuse the stickers, but probably only a few times before the glitter gets too messy. Highly recommend for kids bdays or parties.

AHJH4533YOYFU5OHTBYMITNU2PNA.review_title: I love this! It saves counter space and it was ...
AHJH4533YOYFU5OHTBYMITNU2PNA.review_text: I love this! It saves counter space and it was easy to put up. I was able to surprise my husband.
I love these! They work nicely!

AHJH4533YOYFU5OHTBYMITNU2PNA.review_title: Works but not sure about a whole day
AHJH4533YOYFU5OHTBYMITNU2PNA.review_text: I think I like these but I'm not sure how long they will stay on especially if it's warm out. I used them for a video I made. I do youtube videos and I hate the way my neck looks. They make a big difference but I think they might have a tendency to pop off. Make sure you put alcohol or something on your neck so there is no oiliness. It's a good idea for short term use I think but I'm not sure about a whole day.

AHJJBE3K44LAX3EKQ62EXPZMHQPQ.review_text:
I like to use a retinol moisturizer at night to help with my fine lines and combat aging and this one is pretty great. It is a thick cream but, absorbs right into my skin and leaves it feeling moisturized, not greasy or dry, just perfect. You just can't beat the high quality ingredients in the Retseliney product line. Made in the USA with only good things for your skin. No parabens, dyes or sulfates just a great moisturizer.
*Sample provided for review

These metallic temporary tattoos are lots of fun and pretty to wear. I love that each sheet has different designs to pick from, instead of the same on every sheet like others I have tried. The tattoos that have black in them seem to look the best. The silver kinda looks like foil. They are easy to apply and easy to removed with a little oil. Do not use body oils while wearing these temporary tattoos or you will rub it right off. A fun way to look like you have a new tattoo or look like you are wearing jewelry.
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

This product is just okay. For me to contour I had to keep building up the color because when I would blend the color would disappear. My dark circles are not that bad but I felt like I could not get the product to conceal completely. I do not feel like the pigments of this palette held up. It needs to be set with powder. An expert makeup artist would not use this palette but, is good if you are just starting out.
*Sample provided

This set of brushes is perfect for travel or a great beginner set for someone just starting to get into makeup. I was surprised at how soft the synthetic brushes on my skin. I am picky about what I use on my face and these brushes past my softness test. 7 different pieces, the only one I rarely use is the sponge tip, but that is just preference. Cute set! Always remember to wash your brushes before use.
Sample provided

This is perfect. I was running out of room for my lipsticks and I like to keep them all on display so I know what I have. This stand is a simple and space saving way to hold all your lipstick. I will also use it it for anything that is lipstick size, like pencils, lip scrubs and sample perfumes. Made of clear acrylic this stand is sturdy. Great product.
Sample provided

This is perfect for me! I was using sponges and brushes but, one needs to be replaced every couple of months and the other needs batteries replaced. This wash cloth is exfoliating and soft at the same time. I have combination skin and this pad is great for my skin. If you need a gentler wash just lighten you pressure and if you need a good scrub just at more pressure. I throw the pad in the wash with my towels each week so, it is easily kept clean. Also, it has a hook so, I hang it up to dry after each use. Great product that is just so simple and easy to use.
Sample provided for review

AHJPJAUI5LLLLQ4ST4CE2IHHXAZA.review_text: Fits great on my head but it’s not big head or long hair friendly

AHJT4BJYS66VZYMT3525LKO25CPA.review_text: I just used this product for the first time just now.  I had been using one that I bought 8 years ago, that one was hot on my hands to the point of burning.  This one didn't do that at all.  Warm not hot.  I believe this light is newer technology with LED/UV lights, my old one was UV only. I recommend this product for doing any gel polish.

I like this moisturizer a lot.  Goes on smooth and absorbs quickly.  I got this product because I liked the ingredients.  Feels nice.  No reaction at all to my sensitive skin either.

The only reason I wanted this bottle was for the compact size, which I got, and the fine mist, which I was not able to accomplish. First I used #0 on my dry hair. My hair is a bit longer than shoulder length and I used the entire bottle of #0 but once I got the hang of putting this on my dry hair, I think I could have gotten 2 uses out of that bottle. After 10 minutes I added #3 and let it set for 10 minutes. I know I can get another use out of that bottle.

Then I hopped in the shower and rinsed my hair and it felt very smooth as I rinsed it. Then I shampooed with #4, rinsed and then conditioned with #5 (left on 3 minutes). Once I towel dried my hair and I applied the mask #8. After 10 minutes I rinsed the mask out of my hair.

I really didn't notice the scents of #0 and #3 but #4, #5, and #8 have nice, light scents. I can tell my hair is in better shape after these treatments. I can get two full uses out of the kit in the future with additional uses out of #4, #5, and #8.

On one hand, I was putting off going through all these steps but now I see that it's worth the time it takes.

AHK5OLFYFN5GTBACJ2KYQ5S5PELQ.review_text:
VALITIC Foot Peel Mask for Dry Cracked Feet and Dead Skin Callus Removal

I've been using monthly foot peels for three years now, ever since they were recommended to me by my dermatologist. I wear hiking boots, work books, or running shoes everyday and put in at least seven miles a day in those boot/shoes. When indoors I'm usually barefooted on our hard tile floors. Until I started using foot masks I thought it would be impossible to have soft, callus free feet. But I was wrong.

My feet are used to monthly foot peels so I will go for the longest time that the directions indicate. In this case that is 90 minutes for this foot peel. I soak my feet before a peel (and make sure I don't have any abrasions that would make the ingredients in the peel uncomfortable for me). I put on the booties and seal them but then I put a pair of loose tall socks over the booties to keep everything semi snug. I picked the tea tree pack because tea tree oil has become a favorite scent of mine.

This peel has done a very good job. Since I do peels once a month, there is so much less peeling than back in my early days of using peels. Now I maintain all the soft skin, callus free gains I've gotten in the past. The hardest part of using foot peels, for me, is being patient and not interfering with the peeling process. For this reason I wear socks during the entire peeling stage, unless I'm showering or soaking my feet, which helps me to leave my peeling feet alone while the process does it's job.

But this mask is so painful to use. There are seven nodes that stick out from the inside of the mask. I don't notice four of them but the two forehead nodes and the chin node are very uncomfortable. I've never used magnetic lashes before, but was very intrigued! These magnetic lashes + the eyeliner are STRONG! I've attached photos of the lashes after wearing them for 10 hours at my workplace. The magnetic lashes and the liner are so strong in fact, that I actually ripped out a lash because I accidentally had the magnetic liner on my lash!

I'm very impressed by how well it stuck onto my eye throughout the day. I am also VERY surprised of the formula of the eyeliner. I have tried many, many waterproof, smudgeproof eyeliners, but this eyeliner is by far THE MOST waterproof and smudgeproof! I have oily eyelids and my original waterproof eyeliner would still smear on my lower lids (I bought a waterproof Missha eyeliner for $27 and it still smudges!)

Not only that, the liner will also remove very easily with micellar water or makeup removing face wash -- it washes off so clean that I don't have to follow up with another makeup wipe after the shower. This is amazing!

I only really took off 1 star for three reasons:
1) The formula of the eyeliner has a scent that is very perfume-y/chemical-y. This doesn't bother me too much, but I do think that some customers may be bothered by it.
2) The brush of the eyeliner is very flimsy -- it is difficult to get a sharp line, because the brush is so thin.
3) the inner corners of my lashes began to curl up and off my lash line, pulling some eyeliner with it (leaving gaps in my liner).

Overall, I really like this small kit! It is VERY easy to apply and the lashes look so natural! I got very many compliments while wearing these!

I've been experimenting with glue-free and magnetic-free lashes and I really enjoyed using this product! Is it my absolute favorite? At the time of writing this review, so far, yes!

I really like the formula of the eyeliner, it has been one of the smoothest I have tried so far. As for the strength of the adhesiveness of the eyeliner with the lashes, it is super strong! Even the slightest touch of the lash to the eyeliner will have it STUCK! The eyeliner also is very water and smudge proof!

I have only taken one star off because the lash band itself can be a little bit irritating for people with small eyelids/monolids. While wearing these lashes, the inner corner of my eyes were feeling a bit irritated because the band was poking the skin. Eventually this made my eye water, and the inner corners of the eyelash were beginning to peel up. I feel that if I readjusted these lashes, or cut some portion off, it would help with the issue.

I cannot highly recommend this brush enough. The bristles are soft, sturdy and gentle on my hair. I love the wood handle because there is no metal that appears to be crafted into the brush (IMPORTANT because I have had boar bristle brushes rust because of the metal screws making contact with water).

I am also very happy about the brush cleaner and teasing comb included with this set!! The brush cleaner is something you don't realize you really need until you REALLY do, and it is a godsend.

A common complaint many people give about boar bristle brushes is that the brush is too soft to penetrate the bottom layers of your hair -- duh! You will need to section your hair and brush each section! This will help you brush out your hair's natural oils more effectively, leaving you with stronger, healthier hair.

I don't know about you, but our household goes through nail clippers fast. Most of the time they don't cut right, or they just don't last. Toenail clippers- well it is even harder to find a decent pair. Let's see how this set measured up for us..

WHAT IS THIS NAIL CLIPPER SET LIKE?
This set comes with a hefty set of nail clippers. It says it is for fingernails and toenails. More on that in a minute. The clipper comes with a catch all for the clippings. It also comes with a faux leather snap shut case that also houses a nail file.

HOW DO THESE CLIPPER PERFORM?
These clippers are surprinsingly nice. I tried them on both finger and toe nails and they worked very well. I did not get any ragged edges, or dull bent nails or anything else that I usually have problems with regarding most clippers. I did even have good results on the thickest nail which is on the largest toe.

WHO MIGHT NOT BENEFIT BY THESE CLIPPERS?'
The only person I would think would not benefit from these are those who deal with very thick elderly nails. Those need special clippers.

THE NAIL FILE
The nail file is nice, very fine grade of file, this files nails decently. The tip is not overly great at cleaning under the nail but it works okay.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This nail clipper seems to work well on finger and toe nails not having any trouble with ragged edges or dull bending of nails. The enclosed case is great in that it keeps the file and clippers together.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like the whole set although the nail file could be a bit better.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: We Tried EVERYTHING To Get This To Work
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
When it comes to styling devices, my family all has different preferences because we all have different hair. This looked like a really great product. Let's take a look..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a nice box, well packed in a fancy presentation and comes with a little manual. The device has four buttons on it which are power, temp up or temp down or timer. The bent curling iron is supposed to be more handy to use.

MANUAL
The manual is bare bones. It looks fancy but never tells what temperature or time would be good to start with for different types of hair. That was very disappointing. It does tell how to basically press the buttons and what they are for, however.

HOW DID THIS PERFORM?
We tried this several times on various occasions. Each time, we set the temperature higher and higher until we were at the top temp but very few of the curls we tried making worked. The hair simply had a light bend in it. When using a different curling iron with each person, the hair looked great. Finally after trying for the last time today, we have determined that this curling iron just does not work. I am not sure if we got a bad one or what, but it just does not do hardly anything except leaving a partial bend in the hair no matter how we wind it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although a great concept, this curling iron did not seem to curl hair properly no matter what hair we used it on or how high or low the temperature was set.

MY RATING
TWO STARS. Great idea, just didn't work at all for us.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Removes Regular (Not Gel) Tough Polish Well, Does Not Leave Nails Parched
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
When it comes to nail polish remover, I have two choices. I use either the store brand, or professional brand, which is often pure acetone used in tough removal like gel polish. Let's look at this one.

WHAT TYPE OF POLISH?
I had on a very dark red polish which was wearing very intensely for a week. Removal with some removers would leave red stains everywhere.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This polish remover comes in the same type of bottle most store brands do. There is no special scent and it is typical remover.

HOW DID THIS PERFORM?
This polish remover took off the red polish with no problem, left no red staining, and did not leave my nails completely parched like some harsher ones might.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This polish removes regular nail polish (not talking about gel here) very well. It does not leave nails too stripped.

MY RATING
Five stars. It does what it is supposed to to without excessive problems or smells.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Not Quite As Nice As I Had Hoped- BLINDING At Times
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I was spoiled. I had a wonderful big compact mirror from OTT LITE some time ago. I used it a lot. However, it broke and I could not replace it. I was hoping Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This mirror closes and snaps shut with a plastic clip on it. It says open, but honestly, it is not easy to do. Once open, the inside has the 10X magnifier on one side and the reguiar mirror surrounded by the light ring.

ON/OFF
This has one light brightness- on. There is a little switch on the back that you push from one side to the other to turn it on and off. It does not shut the light off when you close it.

CASE
The case is quite slick. If it is cold out and my hands are cold, it is sometimes a bit tough to hold on to this. Most of the time it is not a problem.

BRIGHTNESS
This is a bit too bright for me. It really does seem to be so bright that I can not look into the regular mirror long, but the magnifier is okay IF I REALLY WANT TO SEE MY PORES. Sorry, but it is a bit overwhelming.

BATTERIES
This takes 2 CR2032 batteries.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am not really that impressed with this mirror. It works, but it is a bit frustrating to open, and bright to look into.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. This works, but it is not the best light in my opinion. That little switch on the back could easily be damaged in my purse.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Simple Scent Free Skin Care Absorbs Easily Does It Do What It Says?
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I am always on the lookout for really nice simple skin care. Let's take a look at this ampule.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a clear solution that comes out with an eye dropper.

HOW TO USE
The idea is that you use a toner on your CLEAN face, apply this to the face and neck and chest, and then follow up with a moisturizer.

WHAT DOES IT PROMISE TO DO?
This promises to lighted dark spots, and add firmness, glow, and hydration.

DOES IT DO WHAT IT SAYS?
I used this with another Korean toner which is pretty simple, and also the BE PLAIN Aqua moisturizer. When used, this did not seem to moisturize that much on its own, and for brightness and glow, I would say not over WOW factor after using for a month.

DID SKIN LOOK FIRMER?
I guess you could say my skin looked a bit firmer, but nothing so dramatic that people said, "WOW, WHAT ARE YOU USING ON YOUR FACE?"

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a scent free, easy to use serum for the face. It works well with moisturizer, is simple, scent free, and gives a moderate amount of what it says it will do. It is not remarkable, but it is not terrible either.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is decent, but not my favorite product at this point.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Seems To Work, But I Think Mine Might Be Going Rancid
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I am all about natural skin care. When I read about this product and the lovely smell it had, I was very excited to try it. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This cream is yellow in color- very pale yellow. It is creamy but not heavy. There is a very faint lemon smell, but there is also a smell which is not good- almost like the oils in the cream are about to turn completely rancid. They are not quite there yet, but I have used enough products over time where I recognize that smell.

That is not necessarily the fault of the cream. This could have been kept in a hot warehouse too long, or who knows what. The manufacture date on my box is April 2019. That is over a year old already.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
Since it is not unbearable at this point, I wanted to at least test the product for a few days. There was no burning or stinging, so it is still okay to use for now. The product is quite nice. It does soak in quickly and it does not leave the face greasy at all.

WHAT IS THE EFFECT ON SKIN?
The next morning after using this, I will say that the skin is left looking like it has a slight glow to it. It does leave the skin looking much nicer than other creams I have used. It is warmer weather right now and this cream is still not leaving the face greasy or heavy at all. My skin is definitely left looking nice the next morning.

ANY SENSITIVITY?
I have not had any sensitivity to the sun or anything else yet. Like I said, I can not use this long as it is ready to turn bad soon so I only have a short time. For now, it is really nice.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I really wish that this cream was fresher than it is. The product manufacture date on it is April of 2019. I am really disappointed that I could not test it at its best because it has great potential to be a really nice cream.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS- I can not give this five stars in its current state. It is potentially really nice cream though. If you get a fresh one, I imagine it is really nice. Just make sure to use it up and if you live in a hot climate, keep it in the refrigerator or air conditioning.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Used For Watercolors, It Works Well For Small Details
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I have a set of Kolinsky sable brushes which moths got at a while ago and I have been wanting to replace them. This was a perfect shape for me, so I got it. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This has a wood handle for nails or even watercolor painting- it is a nice solid wood handle. The brush itself is a teardrop shape with a very fine point. The ferrule is average, nothing WOW, but not awful either.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This brush has a nice pocket in it which absorbs the watercolor when using it. It will gradually disperse the paint in a nice thin line, but it does make it so I don't have to dip it as constantly as with a narrow brush. As for smoothness of lines and how it paints, I really like it. It is great for small areas of paintings.

CLEANING
I clean this regularly in the same product that I use for cleaning wool when it is time to store it. It has deterrent to moths in it. Other than that, I just clean with water most of the time and only use the other stuff when i am going to put it away for any length of time.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this can be used for nails, I prefer it for watercolor. I like nail brushes out of synthetic brushes instead of real sable.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This works for what I want it for in doing watercolors. It is not quite as nice as the Kolinsky Sable brushes I lost, but it is a nice fill in for now. I would buy it again.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Halloween Or Messing Around Okay, But Serious Wear, Not So Much
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I have been working with wigs for quite a few years now. One thing I know is a good quality vs not so great quality wig. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?

HAIR
This wig has some great hair. the colors are definitely platinum white and what I would call light auburn base hairs. The white hairs are about 1/3 or so longer than the auburn hairs. There is a nice kink to the hairs.

THICKNESS
That is where this wig is sadly lacking. At the top, the wefts of hair are way too far apart. The lace in the cap is a very light butter colored yellow. The hair is not too thin, but it is not quite thick enough to cover hair below. Yes, this comes with a nylon cap, but it just is not comfortable with those. If you have dark hair it will definitely show the bright colored lace and elastics through the wig when the wind blows.

BANGS/STYLE
That is where this wig is just not practical unless you don't mind looking stupid for a party or Halloween. The bangs are WAY too long for anyone to wear. That usually would not be a problem, but what you will get instead of the cool light ends on the entire head is chopped bang that is bland looking and then these white cool looking ends around the head. The bangs are best cut painstakingly so that the auburn is cut way shorter (about 2/3) than the white hairs. That takes a lot of time but worth the effort. Then you have to cut them at a staggered manner.

Other than the bangs being hard to trim so you can at least function with this wig on, the overall style is fabulous. I love how it falls and looks while on the head.

ELASTIC BANDS
Inside the wig, there are elastic bands with hooks to help hold the wig on the head. You might want to take them down to the spot you like it in as the hooks have a tendency to come undone during wearing.

WHAT I WANT IN A WIG
Believe it or not, I would actually wear a wig like this with the right outfit, and not to be silly either. I prefer wigs that look authentic,, and can be worn realistically as well as for fun.

1. I have to be able to see out of it
2. I have to be able to wear it comfortably without fussing
3. I want it to not have my real hair showing
4. I want it to look realistic
5. I want it to last for quite a few wearings

DOES THIS WIG PASS THE TEST?
I am giving this wig THREE stars because it is hard to wear and see. In order to trim this in a realistic manner, I have to take a LOT of time and that takes stars off for me. I happen to love the style and coloring, so I am wiling to put the work into it, but honestly, I think it should be a bit shorter in the bangs area since it is so hard to trim and keep it looking real. Also, the wefting on the top is just a bit too widely spaced. I wish also that the cap was made with light auburn lace and elastic instead of the icy yellow colors.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want to wear this for fun, it will be hard to see and hard to trim and not look silly in this. It is comfortable and the style is epic, but there will be work required. You can bandana it to help, but it still will look a bit floppy unless trimmed a little bit in the bangs/fringe area. I like this, but it takes work to wear and not look silly for me.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. The trimming of the bangs is VERY time consuming since we only have one shot at it and if it is screwed up, then the wig is toast. I wish there was more hair on top and that the lace cap did not show as easily. A darker cap underneath (light auburn color) would have been much nicer with this. I will still use this, but it could have been a bit nicer with small inexpensive changes.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Nice As Bronzer On Cooler Toned Skin, But Fabulous Eye Shadow Too,- Read On
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I am a makeup artist. I am always finding ways to make cosmetics work for all sorts of uses to get the best look and bang for the buck. This Luminating Bronzer has some surprises up its sleeve.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
COMPACT
This comes in a heavy cardboard compact with a strong cardboard hinge on it. There is no mirror. The pan inside has printed letters and design on it. In this case, the color is number 2, the darker of the two in this collection.

WHAT COLOR IS THIS?
This bronzer is a unique color. Instead of being the usual brown or orange color so many bronzers are, this one is a rose toned base which at first seems unusual. If used on cooler toned skin, you will still see a luminzer effect but the undertone is more of a rose tan.

WHAT COLOR SKIN DID I USE THIS ON?
Right now, I tried this on two colors of skin. One was translated into MAC foundation color as NC27- a tanned color which leans toward the cooler side, and NW25 which is a cooler lighter caucasian leaning color.

EFFECTS?
Things like this have a need for you to choose the right brush. The wrong brush can make it look horrible. The right brush can make it look like a million bucks. When used with a STIPPLING brush (look that up to find out what that means), this bronzer provides the perfect luminescence and glow along with color.

You can see the cheekbones highlighted and see the spot of color, but it is subtle, and not overbearing.

If you use the dense fluffy brush like you might use to apply blush, the results border on ridiculous. It is like you have smears of bright shimmer on and it is hard to blend in well.

WHAT OTHER USES?
Interestingly, I have both color 1 and 2 of this line of Sungasm bronzers. When using this particular color 2 on the creases of the eyes, it provides a GORGEOUS natural look similar to the old J Lo type look or other natural based looks which in reality take a lot of makeup but they just don't look like it.

This put together with color 1 in this series, the two together make a great duo on the eyes. It really is amazing. It brings out the color of the eyes perfectly. In fact, I use the lighter one on the upper cheekbones for highlight/bronzer and the darker number 2 under it and blend well. The effect is subtle but beautiful.

HOW TO APPLY TO EYES
I have used good shadow brushes and my finger as well. The idea is for medium to subtle color, use a tear drop shaped shadow brush. For more intensity use a flat eye shadow brush on top of eye primer and blend once you have applied the other colors. For a quick application, I have successfully used my fingers.

DOES IT BURN ON THE EYES?
I have a terrible time with products on my eyes. They usually burn and give me trouble. This bronzer did not do that. If you are concerned, be sure to get a good eye primer that you are comfortable with and use that first on your eyes.

WHAT ABOUT DARKER SKIN TONES?
If you use this on darker skin tones, there is a good chance it could show up a bit on the ghostly side. It has to be applied very lightly and blended well a little at a time to test the best depth if you want to try it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Not only as a gorgeous rose based bronzer highlighter, but also as a contour or all over eye shadow, this color bronzer is a great price with good performance. It is not the usual color for bronzers but it works on medium to lighter skin tones.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a great multi purpose product for summer. It doubles as bronzer and luminzer but also as a great eye shadow.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: GReat Bronzer For Medium To Lighter Skin Tones, But Great Eye Shadow Too- Read On
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
As a makeup artist, I am always trying to find ways to get the most mileage out of the products that I use. This bronzer had some surprises to it. Read on..

PHOTO- My photo has swatches of both color 1 and 2 which are labeled. I tried to get accurate photos colorwise and it is hard to do as the camera does not capture the nuances. When applied with a brush, the effect is MUCH lighter.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
COMPACT
The compact is a high layered cardboard with a strong hinge to it. There is no mirror and the pan inside has the product with designs pressed into it. It does not come with a brush.

WHAT IS THE COLOR LIKE?
This color is more of a bronze gold color. It is still on the cooler side, but light warmer skin tones could use this too.

TYPE OF SKIN TESTED ON?
This was tested on both MAC translation of skin tones NW 25 (which is what you see in the photos) and NC37 which is a more tan but cooler skin tone.

HOW TO APPLY?
This applies well but you have to be sure you find the right brush. A stippling brush was the best way to get a natural look from this bronzer and highlighter. It allows for subtle application so that it does not look like you have on too much. If you use too dense of a brush, it is easy to get a stripe of glow on your face that others will see and it can really look odd. You also need to get a fresh brush and blend it very well into your skin. Apply this in the backwards 3 figure on each side of your face. Imagine two 3s in a mirror image on your face with the tips and centers touching.

ANY OTHER USES?
I found that this also makes a fabulous eye shadow. I found it to be a perfect match with the other color in this series of number 2 which is a darker more rose brown color. This is a great companion to that. If this is all you have, It also makes a great eye shadow alone or with another lighter satin finish shadow or even a matte. I would not go super frosty.

HOW TO APPLY TO EYES
In terms of eyes, you can use this as a contour, all over color, or in combination with the other darker color of this Sungasm series or another set of shadows. The application is best for a lighter look to use a teardrop shaped brush. Then for a heavier look with more color, a flat eye shadow brush packing this gently into place over a good eye primer is the way to go. For a quick application, you can also use a finger to apply and blend it with a brush or your finger

ANY IRRITATION PROBLEMS?
I am VERY sensitive and did not have any problems with this product on the face or eyes.

THE BOTTOM LINE
As long as you are willing to take some time to find the right brush for the application of this, this bronzer is a pretty color especially for cooler toned skin. It is a good highlighter for darker skin tones as a highlighter, though. This is beautiful on the face, eyes, and in tandem with the other color of this bronzer too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a nice bronzer and I am surprised at how well it works on cooler skin tones, something that is not all that easy to find, especially in TWO colors of a collections.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: Perfect For Baby Fine Hair (Even Adults)
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I have baby fine hair. That means that although I can make it look like I have quite a bit of hair, in reality, my pony tail is the size of a watercolor brush. I need hair ties that can pull my hair back, stay put, and not destroy what hair I do have.

HOW THESE COME
These come in a plastic bag.

COLOR
The colors are all brilliant neon which I LOVE, except the blue- I would call it neon navy if that were a thing.

PERFORMANCE
These work perfectly for me. I use them alone on hot days and even have them stay put during exercise and activity. They do not tear out my hair when I remove them either.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These hair bands are perfect for me. I have baby fine hair and not as much of it as it looks, so having these is perfect. They also work well for kids.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am thrilled to have these. Most other hair bands slide out easily and frustrate me. These stay put most of the time.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: This Line Continues To Impress Me (I Have Tried Many High End Products)
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I have tried many high end skin products over time and I also make my own skin care which I use a lot as well. Once in a while I like to check out another line to trade off for a while. This line, Wow. I am impressed so far.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box. The bottle inside is glass with a lock pump top. Turn to the side and you can pump and then turn it back and it locks.

TEXTURE OF THE LOTION
This is what I would think of as a lotion texture. Thick, but not too thick.

MY SKIN TYPE
I tend to have normal to dry skin and it has some uneven patches on it which most probably don't notice, but I do.

HOW I USE THIS
I start with the XXI cleanser which is great stuff. Then I apply a Hyaluronic Acid serum on my skin. After that, I use this Vitamin C lotion and I finish with the XXI firming lotion on top of that. I only do this 1 time at night.

RESULTS
The results of this product line have been really impressive. My face has looked younger, more glowy, and my skin looks more awake and less tired. I have been through a lot of deaths this year and my face has looked very tired. I could not believe how much this and the other two XXI products affected how I look. It was quite exciting for me right now.

THE BOTTOM LINE
My skin glows after using this. It is soft, moisturized and when combined with the other XXI cleanser and firming lotion, the results are impressive.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I will continue to buy products from this line (well the ones I mentioned, anyway). I really have been thankful to have them right now. They have given me a boost when I really needed one.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: VERY Small Bottle, But Works Well
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I have been looking for some shampoos to help with cleaning hair, but also making the scalp heal for nice hair growth and also flaking.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes wrapped tight in plastic with the pump down.

HOW TO USE
Once the plastic is open, you turn the pump to make it pop up and then you can dispense the shampoo.

SIZE
The bottle is only 6 inches from the base to the top of the pump. It is pretty small.

SCENT
My mom found a really old bottle of shampoo in her attic that was by Fabrege called Farrah Fawcett shampoo. This scent reminds me of that. It is a really nice smelling shampoo.

SCALP
I did feel some tingling in my scalp when using this. It did not burn or hurt at all, it felt nice.

HAIR CLEAN?
I have very fine hair which is easily weighed down. It is hard to find a shampoo that encourages volume, does not make my hair look flat, and that does not make it full of static. This shampoo leaves my hair clean for a few days and it somewhat encourages waves. I can not comment on static, as it is not near winter yet. My hair was not left dry or frizzy at all.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice shampoo. It is a small bottle, but a little bit goes a long way. It makes my scalp feel better and leaves my hair nice and clean.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I wish the bottle was not so small, but I do like the shampoo. I was going to give this to my daughter (she has scalp issues) but I think I will buy her a 2nd one and keep this one for me.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: For Oily Problem Skin Yes, For Drier Skin, Feels Dried Out And Tight
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
HOW THIS COMES
This bar of soap comes wrapped in plastic with a label on each side.

TEXTURE
This bar of soap is very crumbly before unwrapped. The soap feels like it will crumble but when you put water on it, it turns into a very muddy bar of soap. You can feel the mud in it.

CLEANING
This does clean the skin well, but if you have normal to dry skin, it really does make it feel stripped and tight when done using it.

INGREDIENTS
There is nothing in this bar of soap to indicate its ingredients other than Dead Sea Mud.

COUNTRY OF ORIGIN
Israel

WHO MIGHT LIKE THIS
Anyone with very dirty greasy skin or who has problems with oil and blemishes might be able to use this.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This bar of soap does not list ingredients but you can definitely feel there is a lot of mud in it. It cleans well but strips the skin.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. No ingredient list took a star off for me. The performance is good for some skin, but mine is more on the normal to dry side so I don't use it as much as the guys do.

AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_title: This Is A Great Design- But Caution, How To Get Out Of A Jam
AHMG3ALUBE3FEBHODTBHP5J24YDA.review_text:
I have baby fine hair. Thin hair makes it difficult to curl my hair because either they are too hot, to large, hair gets caught in clips, or other reasons. As a result, I don't curl my hair often. This might change that.

CHARGING
Charging this took 3 hours once I got it. It has a gauge on it which lets you know when the battery is full and status of it.

CONTROL PANEL
The control panel is covered in the instructions, but it is not quite what it is described. I found it very intuitive, however and no problem in using it. Just mess with the buttons and you will figure it out. The right button changes the section, the left button chooses the level.

SETTING
Every time I turn this off, I have to reset it to F instead of C and then I have to reset the different times too. It does not remember so far every time I have used it and I have tried multiple ways.

CURLING
This thing is AWESOME. The thing is you have to have SMALL pieces of hair and make sure no other hairs are caught with it. If you don't then it will curl your hair tight and jam it up. More on that later. I set my hair for baby fine at 300F and 8 seconds and once it heated up, the curls were perfect. I had to redo a few of them but for the most part they were nice.

JAM
When you are not careful to separate ALL hair from a section, sometimes the shorter hairs will catch in the roller in the opposite direction and it will cause a jam. It is scary. That is one reason why I set it only at 8 seconds. All you do is make sure you have a mirror and then hit the controls until you reverse the direction and run it for a moment and VOILA- hair is out.

Make sure to comb the hair and then redo it in smaller sections.

TIMER
One more thing, this will roll up your hair and then it will beep each second of the count down of your hair in the roller. It gives a long beep when done, you release the button and your hair comes out.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great curling iron. I love that I can do this in the living room with a mirror and not have to stand in the bathroom. My hair looks natural and beautiful.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS I wish this would set itself to Farenheit and stay there. It is annoying to reset it every time. I know it is supposed to stay, but mine doesn't. Other than that, this would get five stars, but I am taking one off for that.

PHOTO
I posted a photo of my hair so you can see how curly it is. Keep in mind, I have very little hair and it is very very fine. This curling iron really make my hair look amazing.

AHMIAAOBRSCBQQO2P6ZX7WY6UJGA.review_text: This brush is absolutely FANTASTIC!!! When you use it the bristles are so very soft and hold your product on the brush wonderfully so you are able to place it I. The exact spot you want your contour ... No product falling on to your face so GREAT I ordered 2 more for my different colors of contour I use
Best powder EVER!!! Fantastic product ... Love it!!!
I love the sheer beauty of the colors ... Light and pretty ... Packaging is super cool... I absolutely love this for a sweet sweep of color for summer!!!

Oh these are rough. They look extremely false when on, and are very clunky. The magnetic eyeliner makes it harder to apply and keep these on. AHMZDG7TLXFO6H5RPWEX6PX6EN5A.review_title: Lightweight, compact, easy/ fun to use
AHMZDG7TLXFO6H5RPWEX6PX6EN5A.review_text: This is a decent portable nail lamp. It’s affordable, very lightweight, easy to use, and comes with some accessories and the settings on the lamp are convenient. It takes a bit longer than I was hoping to fully dry, but after about 10 minutes, you’re good to go. I like this because it’s small and light so I can pack it with me anywhere. It is easy to use, and a child could use it (with supervision so they don’t look into the light) because you just slide your hand under the light and it will detect your hand and start the light/ drying process. I have noticed that the lag time seems to be getting longer on the motion detecting light, but it’s not extremely bothersome. Sometimes it takes a few swipes, but it generally works. It’s a great thing to have if you enjoy doing your nails at home, or even just a fun “spa” thing to do with your friends, or kids during winter and/ or quarantine. This is by no means a professional style nail lamp but for the price, it gets the job done.

This Is the first product out of 5 in disco’s men’s facial care lineup. It is essentially a circular deodorant stick for your face. The face mask by disco is the 3rd step product in their lineup for mens facial care. It’s to be used 1-2x weekly after using the facial scrub, then followed by their facial moisturizer! I got these headbands because of that one enticing line: "perfect to keep the sweat out of your face." When I'm hot, my hairline starts dripping. Really. I would wear these if they were hideous, they're so effective, but they're not - navy with flowers or white with flowers - I could wear them as a fashion statement. And so effective.

I have to admit I'm not a fan of the "feathery" eyebrow look, but I am a fan of ensuring that what eyebrow you have stays in place and provides a good base to build on, which this product supports.

Once you use this gel, you can augment your shaped eyebrows with eyebrow shadow, which can provide a light shaping line, and help fill your brow in with consistent shading. You can build on that, or use by itself a pencil, to add additional depth or go for that vintage look. This gel just gives you another tool to make your brows more defined.

Like most reviewers, the prospect of 12 lip liners was too tempting to pass up. I use soft crayon liners, or a brush of my lipstick, to create an one-the-spot liner all the time - so this seemed like a great buy.

These are clearly imported. The good news is the manufacturer actually lists the ingredients on the box; I've taken a photo of the box so you can see the ingredients - personally, I don't recommend using products where you can't see the ingredients before you order.

The pencils you get are an interesting range, and seem to vary from package to package. Mine were in a variety of colors; the one color I was looking for - a basic nude - was not in my package - but I got a range of plums (which I never wear) and pinks (which I rarely wear).

If you've used any of your mom's pencils, you're familiar with carmine, which can flake. You have to be careful with the pressure used to avoid application debris, but it's the best to stop lipstick from bleeding or feathering. Since none of the colors were perfect, I used a lighter pink with my lipstick so it wasn't noticeable, and it worked fine.

I really love this hydrating and moisturizing product.

I wasn't sure I would at first. Although the box is in English, and has clear instructions and ingredients, the product itself lacks those things. Celimax comes in a streamlined bottle that looks like mineral water. Aside from the general disaster that could pose with small children, the FDA requires cosmetic products sold in the USA list their ingredients on the bottle in English.

The ingredients, by the way, which I wish Amazon would leave a spot for cosmetic vendors to include in their listings, so we would know before we order in case of allergies, are Sedum Sarmentosum, Butylene Glycol, Water, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glycerin, Glycereth-26, Polyglutamic Acid, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Ceramide NP, Xylityglucoside, Anhydroxylitol, Xylitol, Dipotassium Glycrrhizate, Citrus Tangerina Peel Oil, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia Oil, Glucose, Phospholifpids, Diethoxyethyl Succinate, Caprylic/Capric Triclyceride, Ammonium Acryloylidimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer, Hydrogenated Lecithin, C12-13 Pareth-9, Disodium EDTA, Chlorphenesin.

Having said that, I poured a little bit of the product onto a cotton pad in the evening and dabbed it onto my face, and onto the back of my hands. It initially felt just a bit tacky, but almost immediately absorbed. I followed up on my face with my nightly cream. My face this morning feels AMAZING. The moisture level is through the roof.

I also want to mention fragrance. Like 95% of chronic migraine headache sufferers, I have a sensitive sense of smell. Anything cosmetic that has perfume (think lip smackers) or added scent has the potential to make me nauseous and bring on a migraine. This had just a faint authentic citrus smell, vaguely pleasant, which thankfully disappeared within a few seconds of hitting the cotton ball. That kind of fragrance is ideal.

And the effects are just amazing. I don't see my face all day, but I can sure see my hands on the keyboard. My hands are visibly more plumper, less dry, and more hydrated. I am loving this product. Hopefully they're in process with getting their bottle properly labelled and safe for distribution in the United States, because this is my new routine. Such results!

AHOYQ263ZGBZIBPQGKNVAWG35DNQ.review_title: Not Sticky, No Smell - Smooths Winkles
AHOYQ263ZGBZIBPQGKNVAWG35DNQ.review_text:
I really like this Vitamin E Serum. And I don't get to say that very often. My experience with serums, toners, and lotions is mainly one of "I hope they don't."

As in, I hope they don't have "fragrance," because invariably, that gives me a horrific headache and I have to wash the stuff off within minutes of application. As in, I hope they're not "sticky," because for some reason, that means they stay on the surface of my skin all night long, sticking to the pillow or my pajamas (or worse, the hubs). As in, I hope they don't do something "creative with ingredients" because my skin is pretty tolerant, but can only take so much.

This serum has no fragrance, doesn't cause endless stickiness on the surface of my skin, doesn't do anything scary with the ingredients - and smooths over the problem spots on my face. I love that the ingredients are organic (on the box as well as on the site - I'm assuming "certified organic" is the same in the U.S. as it is in France) and I like the way the lotion feels. Recognizing, of course, that we all have individual skin that reacts differently, this is certainly a winner for me.

I have a major weakness for rhinestones. And this headband is just chock full of them. And when the headband arrived, they were all firmly affixed, ready to wear, not a flaw in sight...and SO attractive.

I have short hair, so I can't do the major flip or wrap-around hairdo that perhaps others have tried, and I haven't experienced the hair catching in the headband at all. The band is not tight, which is generally -my- major complaint. It's a little large, but rests comfortably behind my ears.

And it's SO glittery! the rhinestones are just lovely. Couldn't be happier. My model (the Otter) is quite taken with the look. I plan on wearing the headband regularly. I will be the envy of all, I'm sure.

I Love Burt's Bees products. I'm not sharing them generously with anyone - they're all for me, me, me.

First of all, I like that the products are designed for sensitive skin. Like most people, I have a mix of really delicate skin and skin on which I could get a tattoo and not notice. So I love that these products support my delicate skin areas.

And I like that Burt's uses natural origin ingredients - and no synthetic fragrances. I feel like I type this in every review: like 1B (in 2021) people, 3:1 of which are women, I suffer from chronic migraines. And like 95% of those sufferers, I have a sensitive sense of smell, and for me, artificial fragrances are dreadful. (I've found artificially made "Honey" to be one of the worst.) Burt's Bees products consistently have mild, unobtrusive natural scents.

That's not to say I like every single Burt's Bees product, but their baby skin care products leave my adult skin feeling baby soft. I especially like the apricot baby oil, which is extra softening, smells faintly of apricot and leaves my skin feeling wonderful. And I'm so happy that they have the ingredients not just on the products, but listed on Amazon as well, so we know in advance what we're getting. Awesome. Yes, I'm the baby here, and happy to be one if that means I get to use these great products.

I have a bunch of these little brushes. I love the feel of the silicone "bristles." So I have some for lip exfoliation, a few for facial massages, and even separate ones for facial cleansing. They're easy to clean and so soft.

What I haven't had is a single brush that does it all. And when you travel, it's just ridiculous to be carrying not only a toothbrush, a sponge blender, and two makeup brushes, but three additional silicon brushes. You end up with a makeup tote instead of a makeup case, and suddenly you're checking a bag just because of your annoyingly overstuffed makeup bag.

Not me, because now I have one, and a spare, silicon brush that does it all. One side for massage (which, by the way, if I am so lacking in good taste, I can do in the comfort of my seat on the plane), one side for cleaning, and one appropriately small-sized area for exfoliating lip and/or nose. And that lip exfoliation is one of my favorites - back in college, we used to grab a towel and do a quick scrub before putting on lipstick, but this is so much nicer to your lips.

And these two brushes are so much more efficient and space saving for me.

AHOYQ263ZGBZIBPQGKNVAWG35DNQ.review_title: Like a Less Forgiving Old-Style Pencil
AHOYQ263ZGBZIBPQGKNVAWG35DNQ.review_text:
I'm an eyebrow fanatic, and I've used eyebrow wax, powder, pencils and stencils. I'm a huge fan of shaping and powder - that seems to work best for me - but I've never seen applicators like these so I thought I would give them a try.

Mine didn't arrive overly wet like those of other reviewers; they just seemed to be like normal pens. But the application was uneven and I did have to press hard to get any color other than simply a dark shading (like the side of a lead pencil).

Once I did use firm pressure, it was a little like using an old eyebrow pencil - but less forgiving with the multi-levels. Be sure to shape your eyebrow first, then apply the pen; don't expect the pen to comb as well as draw. The pen can provide the dramatically even look, or, with a lot of manipulation, a more natural look (which I prefer).

I didn't find the pen to be as long-lasting as expected. I try to be really careful in application, as I don't like to abuse my eyebrows or skin, and remove product only using makeup remover. However, I do perspire on my t-zones and that perspiration completely defeated the eyebrow pencil.

This is an interesting innovation with the four-tier brush - and it may work well for others, just not for me. Ingredients, which I so appreciate being noted on the box: water, acrylic ester copolymer, propylene glycol, hydroxyethyl cellulose, c177491, c177492.

I constantly use moisturizer, both on my face and all over. Huge fan of keeping my skin moist and soft. This product had all the right ingredients, plus that enticing "fragrance free."

But this product definitely has a scent to it; perhaps they just mean there's no added fragrance when they designate the product as "fragrance free." That scent might be due to the plum extract, but I'm a plum fan, and the smell was a bit dank and musty for that (although this is my super-sensitive sense of smell doing an interpretation).

Like 2 billion people (in 2021), I suffer from chronic migraine headaches, and like 95% of those, I'm sensitive to smells. Very sensitive. Too much laundry soap is untenable. I can handle most essential oils, but manufactured scents may actually trigger a migraine. I can't have such a smell anywhere close to my nose, like, say, on my skin (or especially on my face).

Although the initial application felt wonderful on my arm, where I test products, the smell was intolerable for me, and I had to wipe it off. I'm really bummed - it felt exceptionally good, but I just couldn't cope with the scent. That's definitely a me thing - not everyone is so scent-sensitive, and it may work great for you...just not for me.

This silver metal comb, on which two large, and three small, metal flowers are secured, is 1.5 x 1.5 inches. Each flower has a crystal center; the large flowers have an additional five crystals around the center and two hanging crystals. There are four metal leaf fronds with pearl 'fronds' attached.

The wire is delicate, so the comb is not designed for rough treatment (definitely not for children). But you can carefully shape both the brooch, and the comb tines - which are integrated - to hold it in place. My hair is thick, but short, and it works fine with my current styling. When I had long hair, I wore combs a lot, and if I still had that length, I'd probably wear this comb as a decoration, rather than to secure my hair in a certain way. The comb is somewhat fragile - and if you want to reuse it, you have to be careful.

It arrived in a jewelry-size box with a seal, and padding - great for a gift. Just lovely. (Although the photo, on my screen, makes the flowers look slightly gold, they are a more wedding silver/white. Perhaps they show up properly on your screen!)

I just can't have enough sparkle in my life, so this comb seemed tailor-made for me. And it's one of the best I've received. It arrived in a sealed box, with a pull out drawer rather than just a lift-off lid - nice presentation.

The comb is metal, two inches long and an 1.25 inches wide. The teeth are close together, so it worked well on the short area of my hair as well as long. Because it is a shorter comb, though, I'm not sure it could hold a large amount of hair in a style; it's more of a post-style add-on. The comb is soldered to the decoration in two places so it seems securely put together.

The decoration itself is just amazing sparkle, with three small crystals used to make each leaf, larger crystals for drops, and small flower designs made up of crystals. The decoration is about four inches at the widest point. It seems sturdy enough to last longer than one event - unlike most - and is really just lovely. I'm quite happy with it and may have to wear it around the house. Every day. It's just that perfect.

In this world of hyperbole, particularly in the cosmetic industry, it's rare that you find something that does exactly what it says. And when I tried this product I stood in the mirror looking at my laugh lines with a particularly jaundiced view. Only to be proven wrong.

This product minimized my laugh lines. After two squeezes. You get three little dots on the brush with each squeeze, brush those on with the applicator, and wow.

Having said that, it is a primer - so it doesn't provide all over color. It does brighten your skin - because it's white - and it does tighten. And you have to be careful (or at least, I have to be careful) not to get it near your eyes or mouth, where lots of lines are, because it tastes dreadful and I'm sure it's not designed for eyes. But it certainly works a miracle.

In the past, I've used a clear primer with a bit of a tan color. No more. This is my new daily. I'm hooked.

This is a lovely set of bamboo elements. I love the toothbrushes, which have different colored bristles and trim at the bottom so you don't get them mixed up - and the comb, with the wide teeth, perfect for after a shower. The brush is ideal for dry brushing, of which I'm a huge fan - great for removing dry skin prior to a shower or bath. The whole kit comes with a washcloth, and a carrying bag.

It's depicted on the Amazon site with a tray, which is not included, unfortunately - that would have been extra lovely - but as is, this is a nice set to keep in your guest room, to take with you when traveling, or as a gift. It's nicely put together.

My husband was an acne sufferer before I knew him, and still gets some problem areas on his back from sitting and getting all sweaty in his office chair. I thought maybe this would help. His skin does seem to bring out the big guns when it comes to attacking ingrown hairs and any other perceived foreign substance.

And I have to say, upon the two-minute inspection I was allowed, it actually does seem to be helping. Even though it's not like he's using it regularly - actually, he uses it whenever I'm allowed to spray it on him after his shower and before he goes to bed. I'd say I manage to get to him about three times a week. And the impact appears, to me, to be noticeable, and beneficial - there are several problem areas that are now looking quite subdued and normal.

I can only imagine what his overall back might look like, if he would just let me do it twice a day every day.

I tried this specifically because of the name, but was prepared to be disappointed. "Citrus Souffle" sounds almost too good to be true.

But it's not. First, the scent. I get migraines, and scents are a trigger. Citrus, eucalyptus, and peppermint are OK - perfumes or manufactured fragrances have become a big "no" for me. Since a side effect is an extra sensitive sense of smell (which means things I put on my face have to be tolerated), I gravitate towards those I can tolerate. Sometimes even scents I usually like go awry in plastic containers or in a specific cosmetic mix. But this citrus is lovely. Limes, oranges, lemons, all rolled into one. A veritable orchard from this single cream. Wonderful.

And the cream? So light, silky smooth, and creamy. From trying other creams, I know that if there's any chance the product will be slow to absorb, that will happen with my skin. This cream was quick to absorb, not heavy or weighing down, and left my skin feeling moisturized, refreshed, and as velvety soft as the cream itself.

I'm also delighted that this product complies with the Australian SafeCosmetics Toxic Free Campaign and is listed as a participating vendor. Safer for me, safer for the environment in which we live. Great product, one I enjoy using.
