Nice but I’m not sure why it’s called cat eye? There’s no magnet with it. Maybe I’m missing something about it. I’m still new to gel polish. Also with companies would show what color is in a bottle so you wouldn’t have to open each one to see. I would even pay a little more for that. But the price is really good so it’s all fair.

The good part is, they are great colors and looks so nice. Goes on smoothly and looks good without being too thick or thin.
This leaves my skin so soft feeling. And it’s such a clean feeling. Not sticky at all. I love it so much! I have oily skin and it doesn’t make it worse. It controls it.

AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_title: Works great for shampooing or massaging scalp
AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_text: This makes my head feel so good. I have my cosmetology license and one thing we learned was it is good to massage the scalp. This helps increase blood flow there and helps with hair growth. Overall, it helps the health of the scalp and hair. The brush works great for this and is also good for shampooing. If your hair is long and tangles easily it will still work but be careful not to get it stuck.

AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_title: Long barrel may be good for really long or thick hair
AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_text: I just can’t get used to the barrel length. It’s different than my norm. The clip part is harder to hold hair than expected but it’s ok. Heats up nicely.

AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_title: Lightweight foundation at a great price
AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_text: This was a great price. Can’t go wrong with that. However, it’s very light coverage. Which is exactly what my daughter likes so I gave it to her and she loves it. Nice sponges too.

Oh my gosh, these last forever! I can’t get over how big the container is. And so smooth and soft powder. Sometimes when my dark roots show, I use this on them at scalp to keep from going to the beauty shop. It blends well and looks light like blonde. But for the face, they are so smooth and I find it takes less of this as it does other brands. The opening is wonderful and has perfect amount of holes to let powder come through. Even has a small sponge applicator that has a little finger strap. I use this and like it better than brush. They last all 12 hours of my shift without getting a shiny oily face. Even with wearing a mask the whole time. The container is gorgeous and I love the square design. So what’s the catch? I feel like I have discovered gold. I mean look at the price?! How could it be possible to get so much powder at such a ridiculously low price and it be a high end quality? Thank you to the makers for keeping the customer in mind. Very affordable. I’ll be purchasing again.

Nice foundation. It’s light coverage so I only wear it around the house. My daughter loved it. It goes on well enough and smooth. It’s a good price and the bottle looks pricey. The sponge works great.

These last so long. They are reusable. Just clean the glue stuff off a little after wear and rinse. I love them. And you get so many sets. I like that it’s a variety of long and short and all in between. They are very easy to use. If you have trouble first time, try again. Took me a minute first time but the next I could do it without hardly trying. They really stick good. I wore them all night to work for 12 hours and had no problems. I highly recommend. These even come with crystals.

This is a good set. The colors are great and a nice variety. One might think the wattage low on light but consider, it is also an LED light so they are more powerful. I still prefer a higher wattage. But even after doing any nails, they are a tad tacky. This is because with gel polish, one must take a wipe or cotton ball with your acetone, or I prefer alcohol. And wipe over nails gently. This is the very last step after top coat and curing. This takes the tackiness away. Won’t mess up polish either. I wish the bottles showed color on them. It must be a thing with gel polish. To protect from light.

AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_title: They stay on my whole 12 hour shift!
AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_text: Remarkably wonderful! These work so great. They stay on my whole 12 hour shift at work. They are also easy to put on. It took me a few practice runs first time I ever used magnetic eyelashes but after the first time, it was nothing. I really recommend these. It’s easy enough to remove. Sometimes I just peel off but most times I take some liquid makeup remover on a cotton swab and rub across them. They come right off. It’s always good to use a lash cleaner on them in between uses and they last longer. But my coworker said she also uses shampoo on hers. I haven’t tried that.

AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_title: Lasts my 12 hour shift at work
AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_text: These are excellent. There’s a pretty good variety of sizes but mainly pretty natural looking. They are very easy to put on. First time I ever used magnetic lashes it took me a few tries, after that, I was good to go. Takes hardly no time and the liner dries quick so I don’t even wait to put lashes on. It still is good enough to wipe off when you don’t get it on even if you work right away. As far as lashes, you can take them off and reposition them. If they are too long for you, just trim the ends a little and they are perfect. I reuse mine quite a few times. You can wash them after each use with shampoo. Sometimes I’m lazy and use liquid hand soap. At first I was just pulling them off. But the best way to get off is liquid makeup remover. All you have to do is take a swab soaked in it and rub along lashes and they fall right off! It’s like magic. As far as wearing them, they last my whole 12 hour shift at work. No problems.

I absolutely love this face serum!  It came very nicely packaged with the serum being contained in a sturdy, pretty round cardboard container.  Inside is the Pure Essential Oils.  The ingredients listed include pure: vitamin E, carrot seed, raspberry seed, Argan oil, frankincense, geranium and Bulgarian lavender- All pure Essential Oils with no fillers!  It is a wonderful anti aging serum.  At first I was surprised by the smell.  It’s kind of a plain Listerine Mouthwash smell (the gold color Listerine.)  However, the first time I tried this Serum, I was totally hooked and now I absolutely love this smell, so clean!  After using this product I don’t want to use any other product on my face.  It cleared up my facial redness and gave me such a clear, clean complexion, shrinking my pores and softening my fine lines.  This stuff really lives up to its name of Liquid Gold.  After I finish off this bottle,  I will definitely be reordering more.  I would highly recommend!

I love these green shades. There’s something for everyone. The magnet is also a nice addition and looks really cool. Cats eyes! I get a lot of complements when I do that design. It’s easy too. The polish lasts a long time and is glamorous.

Love every color! So much to choose from. The odor isn’t bad on these. I think my favorite is the denim blue looking color. You can do them matte or glossy. They stay on well and go on good. It’s one of my favorite sets.

This lotion is awesome.  It is such good quality, creamy, deep penetrating and 100% vegan.  I like to make my own scents with this lotion by separating small quantities in other containers and adding my own essential oils.  I have a jasmine blend going now that’s so unique and awesome smelling. And the scent possibilities you could make with this are endless.  It also doesn’t smell bad on its on!  Pop it In The fridge for a really nice, cool pampering treat on a hot day.  This gallon of lotion is so worth it.  I will never buy expensive store bought lotion again.  This lotion even has arnica extract and aloe added for sore muscles.  Such a great deal.  I can’t stress it enough.  I would highly recommend!

AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_title: Big range or colors that stay on a long time
AHPG65LKS3QKRWDUWAKZNLEK5RZQ_1.review_text: So many colors. This is one of the best collections I’ve owned. The colors are such a big range. There’s nudes and blues and greens. Some even shimmery. There’s something for every mood and outfit. They stay on well and look gorgeous. I highly recommend.
Really nice and creamy. Blends and absorbs well. Leaves under eyes very moisturized but not too greasy. There’s hardly any scent, if any.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Decent wig, very fine strands.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
Due to the costs, one cannot expect to get a high quality human hair wig. Rather, with the proper expectations, this is a decent, synthetic strand, wig. In fact, the strands look like very fine, real hair. I would say that it is very similar to Chinese hair, which is fine, and very straight.
Being 14" long, you have the choice of leaving it at the current shoulder length, or styling and cutting it. I like that aspect, making it more versatile. This niche product works well for halloween, costume party, dung disguise event, as stated in the product description.
Overall, it's an inexpensive option for a decent wig. It's not really meant to fool anyone into thinking it's your real hair, nor to be a full, robust hairpiece. As such, it fulfills it's expectations and purpose. I'd rate this 3.5 stars.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Nice, silicone back 'brush' bit too soft. Good handles.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
We gave this 3 test uses for an initial assessment of this back scrubber/brush. It is designed nicely, with handles that make usage very user friendly. If they made this out of elastic, you could shower and do resistance band exercises. hehe. Seriously, the handles work well, and act as convenient loops to hang the device to dry out in the shower.
There is an issue with using silicone brush heads, they tend to be soft/flexible. So, if you use this brush, do not expect the same experience as a loofah or bristle brush. And, you have to really work up a lather in your hands and then transfer it to the silicone brush head. Attempts to create foam/lather by rubbing body wash or soap on the silicone just wasn't satisfactory.
As mentioned, the brush surface tends to be soft/gentle. The 'scrubbing' side does rub, but nowhere near deep cleaning or exfoliating level. The bumpy side, for massage, does provide a textured rub, but is even less effective for soaping and cleaning your back.
Maybe I'm too old school, liking my cleaning brush to be able to really scrub.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
Did not use the included hooks, because we used the shower caddy that already had hooks for shower accessories. The bonus bath sponge looks fine, but did not use that yet. Again, maybe I don't pamper myself enough while showering. haha. If the significant other uses it, any pertinent information will be added to this review. However, I think the majority of people will be concerned about the effectiveness and quality of the back scrubber.
So, the product does match the description and depiction in the product details. However, my opinion is the softness of the brush hinders the effectiveness as a shower back scrubbing device. I do like that it is very resistant to mold and is extremely easy to clean and maintain. Maybe I have to learn to adapt to the softer texture of this type of brush. Based on our experience, this silicone brush garners a 3.5 rating. If you already use and like silicone back scrubbers, this is a quality product worth considering. If you are old school, this might disappoint expectations.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Light pink hue, good quality. Bit pricey for one tube 15g.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This poly gel is a light shade of pink. In the product details, the picture what shows a finger/fingernail, the pink is a bit lighter than the tip of that nail. Also, depending on how thin/thick you make the nail will affect the translucent aspect, making it appear lighter or darker.
The product seems to be good quality, time will tell how long the nail actually lasts.
The main issue is this seems to be somewhat expensive compared to other brands (some of which are well established). There are sets with 4 - 6 tubes, with different shades/colors, at 3 - 4 times the cost of this one tube. (for the mathematically challenged, that makes this tube around 50 - 75% more expensive per tube.)
So, it's a good quality product, but the cost ratio affects the recommendation. Thus, it's a 3 - 3.75 star product with a moderate level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Exciting assortment of gels. Excellence!!!
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
Excellent assortment of poly gels that will complement anyone's collection. These are nice sized tubes, with popular colors and some pearlescents. This would make a welcome addition to the home nail artist, or to simply add beautiful poly gel polish to the nails. I note that this would make a good addition or complement a collection, because you'll need a UV lamp to cure the poly gel. And a brush is necessary, too.
Included in this set are some generic fake nails and some gold foil nail forms to facilitate nail artistry. Also, they include a container of silvery glitter as a free gift. Nice touch.
This is a very nice set, and the overall quality (including the presentation) makes this a serious gifting option.
Overall, this set earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: USDA Organic, orange peel grounded into powder.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is a truly versatile product. It can be used in cooking or for external uses (as an astringent, vitamin C enriched application). I thought the value would be for adding an organic orange flavor aspect to cooking/baking. However, I was enlightened by the significant other that it would make for an excellent face mask/scrub. Knowing that i'd eventually lose the argument, I simply divided the package into half, so we both could utilize this powder.
I do like that they included a bag clip, to help keep the foil pack airtight and watertight. This facilitates the longevity and safety of the powder. Still, I put my share into a sealable glass jar (dark colored to minimize sunlight exposure).
I sprinkled some of this powder into green tea, and it 'bloomed' into a tasty, tangy orange delight. it's a pleasant way to get a bit more Vitamin C, as well as any other flavonoids associated with orange peels.
It is true you can zest a fresh orange, or dry orange peels (my mother used to dry tangerine peels, to use in cooking asian cuisine, a tradition my sister carries on). However, having this ground orange peel ready to go is very convenient. And it's USDA Organic.
I will give some of this powder to my sister, perhaps hinting she could cook something and give me some. haha.
Besides being a time saver/convenient, the quantity is more than ample when you consider the amount of dried orange rind that is necessary to deliver quantity in powdered form.
I feel this orange peel powder merits a solid 4.5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Beautiful, precision tweezers. Nice case, with cleaning brush.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This set actually exceeded my expectations based on the pictures in the product details. It easily matches up to the descriptions and depictions in the product details. It is attractive enough, that this would be welcomed as a gift.
Inspection of the implements found no defects or flaws, there were no scratches or marks on the nice black surface. The lengths might be a bit on the smaller size, but they are easily manipulated with one hand.
The only issue I have is there is no specific slot in the case for the scissors. So, it either rests between slots or shares it with one of the tweezers.
Overall, these are excellent tweezers and petite scissors. It merits a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Nice supply of files (planks & foam), brush and cuticle cutting tool.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
Basically, this is a supply of materials to sand nails (actual nails, fake nails, glues, polishes). The spongy foam has a grittiness, so it conforms to the nail with the intent to smooth out ridges or any 'imperfections'. The emery planks have 2 different levels of grit: 100 & 180. The 100 grit is suitable for artificial nails, the 180 intended for natural nails. The cleaning brush is decent and does an adequate job. The cuticle cutting tool is rather generic, but is functional, as well.
At under $6, this is probably priced accurately. 6 dual function emery boards, 6 gritty foam sponges, brush and cuticle cutter for the price seems acceptable. Although if you 're in the market for just emery boards and sanding sponges, you could probably find individual product sets at better values.
Overall, it fulfills the goals of the product details. It earns a solid 4.25 star rating, with a moderately high recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Small bottles (.25 oz) of beautiful metallic glittery gel polish.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This would make a great addition to an existing manicure/nail art set. Included in this set are 6 bottles of quality gel polish, 7.5ml (0.25 ounces). While each bottle could do a few maniures, I think of them as being more akin to samplers. For the price, I would have like more quantity.
It's winter, in fact we're having a severe snow storm right now. So, perhaps the cold affected the polish. Per the companies suggestion, we immersed a bottle in warm/hot water (not too hot). This had the effect of loosening the consistency of the gel polish. Whew!
The polish, with metallic glitter, is like metallic paint on a car, only more shiny and glittery. My original intent was to use this on 3D printed models, or for my crafts. But, the significant other made a convincing argument that it's gel NAIL polish. So, she claimed it (after I restored it via the hot water bath), and took it to her nail art/crafts station. She mentioned that it didn't have the strong 'stink' that some other glitter gel polishes have. Okay...She said that if she does her nails, she can't help me shovel the snow tomorrow. Why didn't I think of doing my nails, first?
The price of this set is slightly higher than comparable products (a dollar or two). I can't compare the products, but the quality of this set is very good. Plus, the fact that it needed a hot water bath, I feel the thickness is a positive indication of the quality of the polish. Being thicker means needing less for good coverage.
Overall, positive impresseions regarding this gel polish. It garners a solid 4 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Vibrational massaging face cleaning. Not a scrubber. Gently effective.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
I feel the nature of the product, coupled with the quality, makes this an ideal gift option. Included in this product set is the device body, with silicone brush already attached, another PBT soft bristle brush, base/stand and travel/storage bag. I'm sure most people are familiar with silicone and how it'd feel as a brush. I did not know what PBT was, and the company does not explain this term. So, research finds: "Polybutylene Terephthalate (PBT) is a high-performance thermoplastic that is an optimal choice for food processing applications, as it is FDA- and USDA- approved for use with food." So, it is a plastic, that can be molded per need/specifications. And, since it is FDA and USDA approved, I have no concerns about the safety of the material. In fact, the bristle brush is soft and seems durable.
I tested the silicone brush head, since it as already attached. inserted a fresh AA battery, re-sealed the bottom cap. Applied some liquid soap to the silicone brush, added some water, then applied to a wet face. It actually felt like a nice soapy massage. i put it on the 2nd, faster speed, and the massage felt even better. Keep in mind that the brush head does not rotate, it vibrates. So, do not expect this to scrub your face clean. Instead, it feels like the silicone brush is humming on your skin.
The significant other tried it and liked it, too. Then she opted to change to the PBT brush head. She said that it seems to lather up the liquid soap better, and felt like it cleaned the skin better, especially at the faster speed.
I think that we both prefer using the second faster speed, and will use that most often. The stand base has a tiny hole in the well. I guess this is to allow some drainage, any water that drips down the handle. So, be aware that it's possible that water sill collect under the base.
This is a cute, functional face massager/cleaner. She said that she had a face scrubber, that only had one speed, and it tended to rough up the skin. So, it eventually got tossed. She likes the features and speeds of this product.
I will still wash my face as usual. But, every once in a while, a face massage would be a welcome treat.
This product receives a 4.0 - 4.25 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Cute design, nice colors. Functional misting spray bottle.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
Even though these spray bottles look like giant pills (capsules), they are not a pill to operate. The set of 8, 4 of each color, has a clear bootle, with a pastel color (pink and blue) snap on top. In addition, there is a small clear cap that covers the spray head. So, in effect, there are 2 caps that cover the spray bottle. Hopefully, if there is a leak, either one or both caps will contain the liquid.
Even though the spray bottle looks like capsule, the bottom of the bottle is flattened, so it can stand upright. I was initially concerned about this when I first examined the product.
Using water as a test, the spray bottle emitted a fine spray; perhaps a bit more than a misting. It would excellent for a spritz of fragrance. I cannot say how well it will deal with thicker liquids, like oils. But, the product details state that it's fine for essential oils.
These are cute, and individually wrapped. As such, they are perfect for gift bags. They are cute and have good quality manufacture. The set of 8 spray bottles receives a 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Great amber glass spray bottles. Exactly as described and shown.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
These are excellent amber colored glass spray bottles. The capacity of each bottle is 16 ounces. Keep in mind that this is glass, not plastic. There are inherent advantages to using glass, such are durability and environmental concerns. Also, glass will not chemically interact with most liquids (however, caution is still necessary since the spray top and mechanism is composed of plastic). The disadvantage is that this kind of glass bottle is heavier than comparative plastic bottles. The amber color protects the contents from light (sunlight and uv exposure). My view is this type of spray bottle is more on the premium end of the scale.
Included accessories: 4 regular screw on tops, 1 screw on eye dropper top, funnel, labels and marker. Each of the bottles comes with the plastic spray top already installed. I appreciate the regular tops, which effect a better seal than the spray tops, which will protect the contents from spills, evaporation and contaminants. I wish they provided at least 2 of the eye dropper tops, but I guess even getting one, when the the product is sold as spray bottles, is a bonus.
The sprayer mechanism can actually rotate, it's not a one piece sprayer top, the screw on segment is separate from the spraying segment. This is not a cheap spraying cap.
The set of 4 amber color glass bottles fully matches the descriptions and pictures in the product details. At $34, these are a bit pricey, but the glass is substantial, not thin.
Overall, these are impressive, and appear to be a premium variation of spray bottle. And priced accordingly.
These spray bottles receive a solid 4.5 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Very good set for a beginner. Excellent color selection, with base and top coat bottles.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
The manner of presentation raises it's value as a gifting option. This is a fairly good assortment of color poly gel polishes, including 2 tubes of temperature changing polishes (an addition not usually found in beginner sets). Small jars of base coat and top coat (10ml each) complete the liquid components of this set. 2 nail art tools are included: a two sided positioning pen and nail file board (the rather large pink item in the attached photos).
The gel poly polishes come in 15ml (0.5fl oz) tubes. The colors cover the range of popular hues. The gel poly tends to be on the thicker side. For a beginner to intermediate user, perhaps the best approach is to use slip solution or alcohol. Put a small quantity of alcohol or slip solution into a small bowl/container. Apply some gel polish then dip your brush into the alcohol, and smooth out the polish. The alcohol or slip solution acts as a solvent to loosen up the polish, enabling the user to manipulate the polish more easily. It's better to deal with a gel polish that is too thick, than a circumstance of the polish being too loose/thin. Also, gel poly is a different product than regular liquid nail polish.
Overall, a very good set for beginners. Intermediate users will find use for the colors, especially the temperature based color changing varieties. And top coat and base coat bottles are always handy to have as additional resources.
Based on these considerations, this set obtains a solid 4 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Excellent design, quality. Excellent value.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
The two implements in this set are solid with excellent design. It is characterized by quality materials and manufacture. The presentation also elevates the giftability. One tool serves as a mini roller and an applicator. It has a round, flattened end that allows the user to easier scoop creams or oils, and apply to the face (especially in the eye region). On the other end of this tool, is a spherical massage surface. The small size makes it ideal for delicate areas, like around the eyes.
The larger massaging tool is more akin to other similar massaging tools. However, this has no moving parts. This is a very functional tool for acupressure as well as general massage techniques. The gently rounded pointy side is good for focusing pressure at a target point. The dual sphere end covers more surface area and distributes pressure accordingly. The spheres on this tool have an insert, different metallic nub on each sphere. I think this is to give the option to use the rounded pressure of the sphere and gradually transition to the more direct point on the nub.
These are visually attractive and solidly constructed. They are functional with an elegant, graceful aspect.
My inspection of both tools found no defects, nor flaws, no sharp edges. Basically they are exceptionally well done.
I feel they are well designed and match the descriptions and depictions in the product details. For the quality, i feel it's an excellent value for a bit over $13.
This set receives a 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Perfect size. Excellent silicone squeeze bottle with mini-carabiner.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This set of 6 soft squeeze silicone bottles, with mini-carabiner (ok, they're not actually carabiners; they're belt clips, but similar to being small carabiners, allowing you to secure the bottle to backpacks, belt loops, etc). The bottles come with 3 in clear, 1 blue, 1 green and 1 pink. It's a good mix, and the clear probably being the most versatile, since you'll be able to view the quantity and more easily identify the contents.
The silicone appears to be very good quality, is soft enough to easily squeeze, but firm enough to retain it's shape. Plus the tactile qualities of the silicone is very nice. The screw cap has a hinged topper that has a plug that fits snugly into the spout. The cap screws onto a hard plastic threaded piece. It's a relatively simple design that just works well.
Using plain water as a test, there was not a single drop of leakage. A very good sign. I did not abuse the bottle, and I'm sure that with enough pressure on the silicone bottle the cap could open, or there could be a leak. But, under normal circumstances I don't see leaks happening.
These are ideal to keep handy good quantities of hand sanitizer, hand lotion, creams, essential oils. I like the idea of the belt clip and the general design of the bottle.
Examination of the bottles found uniform construction, with no defects or flaws. These are cute and functional.
These silicone squeeze bottles earn a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Interesting design. Very nice rubber brushes.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This comes as a set of 2 brushes. I was intrigued by the design of these detangling brushes. The brushes appear to be constructed of quality materials, with a nice tactile feel (meaning they feel good in the hand). Examination of the brushes found them to be free of defects, both were in excellent condition, thus it had quality manufacture.
There is a spacing bar that separates the brush tines (for lack of a better term). On specific segments, there is a hole in the tine, which correlates to a prong in the spacer bar. This kinda determines the spacing of the segments, with each space on the bar 'snapping' over the brush tine for a secure connection. One of the attached photos shows a close-up of the spacer bar and the brush tines to illustrate the parts and the holes in select tines. Amazingly, it is a working setup.
The rubber bristles are excellent to run through the hair. It is slightly curved, with long bristles. They are firm, but not inflexible. My initial impression is very positive, it's an excellent brush.
Cleaning is simple, too. Just pull out any errant hair strands, and run it under hot water. Done.
Overall, the brushes match up to the descriptions and depictions in the product details. It fully met expectations, too. In fact, I think I like the feel of the brush more than I expected. As such, this set of 2 rubber detangling brushes receive a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Amazingly soft brush. Premium quality, nice design.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This long handle brush is exactly as described and depicted in the product details. The handle is bamboo, and appears very durable. The brush is amazingly soft, the texture actually surprised me. The bottom of the handle has a rope loop, to hang up after use (you can also put the loop around the wrist while using it). A nice touch, rope is wound around the lower end of the handle for a more secure grip. This is useful when in the bath or shower, and water could make any handle slippery.
The only thing I'd change would be for a bit larger brush head. The diameter is approximately 3 inches. It's fine, but a larger brush head would be better.
The brush does lather up nicely, and feels nice against the skin. Time and use will determine the durability of the brush head. However, from initial impression it seems to be quality materials.
This brush easily met my expectations. It earns a solid 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Very nice collection of nail art decorations. Decent value.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is similar to being a sampler, but with a nice quantity of most items. In fact, the product details indicates 3 cases, with 12 compartments per case. I received 4 cases, each with 12 compartments. Yes, the compartments are a bit small, but they have a reasonable quantity of glitters, gems, etc. So, getting an extra case full of goodies is certainly a much welcomed discrepancy with the product details.
The tweezers are decent quality, not cheap plastic but metal tweezers. The round segmented container, containing what appears to be only tiny gold beads is not as full as the picture in the product details. Possibly they spilled over into neighboring compartments, because while some segments look sparse other are quite full. I will assume if neatly and equally portioned, it would look similar to the pictures.
Instead of nice cute butterfly stickers, I got a sheet with strange bee themed stickers. Odd. I seriously doubt that these stidkers will get any use. (Yes, send me the right butterfly stickers. haha).
The containers of various foils, the content is not plentiful, but more than enough for a few applications.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the components of this nail decoration set. I feel that it easily met my expectations. The additional case of sparkly, glittery goodies actually gives a slight ratings boost. Based on a very positive impression of the set, the product receives a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Very nice design/form. Easy base top connection. Provides USB ports.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is a surprising UV curing lamp. It has a minor elaboration of the conventional design, allowing for a slightly wider opening, but still having a multi=angle lamp placement. 72 Watts is not the most powerful UV rating for this gel curing/drying lamp, but is more than ample power to do the job in reasonably quick time.
That said, I believe that this UV lamp actually normally will output 36W, unless you specifically activate the "Double Power" setting. To do this, you select one of the 3 'regular' timers: 10S, 30S or 60S (S = seconds). This sets the timing for the lamp operation. If you then press the last button, which is also the 99S "Lowe Heat Mode" button, and hold for about 3 seconds, it will activate the lamp into 72W...double the power. Thus the regular default UV setting is 36W. If you press the 99S button, the UV power will gradually increase over the 99 seconds.
The device also has a sensor to turn the system on/off depending if it senses hand/foot in the cavity. If you need more time, just hit one of the timer buttons again.
There is no power on/off button. Once you plug the power adapter in, the unit is 'on' and ready to go, once you set timer and insert your fingers.
While the opening is wider than most other UV lamps, it's still a tight fit for both hands. But, I appreciate the slight elaboration of the cavity opening.
One new design element that I truly appreciate is the method to connect the top and base. There are small posts with magnets atop them. These magnetically attach to corresponding screws in recessed holes. So, it takes minimal effort to separate them, but easily hold together. Other lamps have a tab in slot method that sometimes is difficult to unlock or match up easily to attach. This improvement is a smart innovative upgrade.
Another innovation is the inclusion of USB-A and USB-C ports, located about the power plug port. Both of these USB ports are rated at only 5V 2A. So check the usb specs of any device you connect to these USB charging ports. But, it's a nice addition, anyway. It is a handy port to connect a nail dust fan, or nail drill.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with close-ups to highlight features.
On my wish list is a separate power on/off button, and while the display is view-oriented for the person inserting fingers, it would make sense to have the timer buttons oriented in the same manner. I think most people purchasing these lamps are DIY nail artists. It's not too difficult to manage the timer buttons, but it would just be simpler and common sense to have these controls positioned for easy operation by the user. These issues apply to all the UV lamps that I've encountered. It's a personal perspective/opinion, and does not affect the ratings of this device.
So, this UV curing lamp is default 36W, with the capability of user option to double power to 72W. It has a nice design and improved magnetic connection for top and base. it's a very capable and competent device.
Accordingly, it earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Excellent gel polish. 6 glorious colors.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
A smart presentation elevates this as a gifting option. You receive 6 bottles, 8ml (0.26fl oz), of popular fall, winter colors. The significant other loved 5 of them, and thought the brown was nice, but doesn't complement her. But, that is would work nicely if she used contrasting decorations on it. So, actually all 6 are attractive and usable, but she was especially fond of the other 5. haha.
Attached are photos to show the unboxing, and images of the product. Also a close-up of the gel polish that was being used today.
The gel polish is rich and somewhat thick. The significant other said it's really good. That she can use a thin layer and get good coverage. The bottles are numbered, but wouldn't it be smart to put a dot with the actual color of the enclosed gel polish on the bottle top? She agreed, and shrugged her shoulders. Since this seems like an industry standard, of not identifying the colors with...color, the lack thereof does not ding the rating.
These seem to be quality gel polishes. The colors are rich and look great after UV curing. Personally, I don't comprehend 'fall, winter' colors, but I appreciate the vibrant color.
Based on initial impressions, this set receives a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Nice jade massage tool set. Large rollers on one tool. Issues with Gua Sha Jade.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
The very first glance of the jade massage tools, I was enamored of the rich green coloration. Plus the massage roller seemed to have a roller that was larger than usual. I was thus prepared to have this product exceed my expectations.
The roller has good quality materials, with decent manufacture. I am a bit dismayed because the rollers seem to interact directly with the golden tone metal arms. Most credible massage rollers have a 'buffer' , like a gasket, that minimizes the stone from rolling against the bare metal. This is important because direct contact will eventually take a toll on either part. The rollers on this tool more freely, but keep in mind that the stone is rolling against the metal rod. Add pressure and you have a circumstance wherein friction will gradually erode either of both contact surfaces. This issue is little noticed, unless you have some experience with this type of massage device.
The gua sha jade stone, also with the striking green hue, unfortunately had a number of issues. It has pitting on the surface, a nick on the edge and a few obvious scratches on the surface. I understand that natural jade stone will have imperfections, but nicks on the edge are not acceptable, and scratches that appear to be a machine error, not a natural phenomenon definitely affect the rating.
So, I have to say that my expectations were not met. In fact, sad to say, examination lead to disappointing issues. As such, this massage roller and gua sha earn a 3.5 - 3.75 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Excellent quality. Very attractive assortment of confetti and glitter polishes. Small bottles.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is an excellent assortment of attractive, quality gel polish, with base coat and top coat (no wipe and matte versions). The presentation elevates the worth as a gifting option. One of the best features of this set is the bottles of gel polish provide actual representations of the contents. On the top of the cap is a sticker with proper identification of the color (including glitter, confetti varieties). Also on the front label is a small circle, under the brand name, that has an accurate portrayal of the contents. Finally, a company gets it. So, this boosts the rating a bit.
There are 16 varieties of gel polish, with confetti and glitter. The consistency is perfect, allowing application of a thin coat. An ability to apply a thin coat is essential, mainly due to the size of these bottles. They are 5ml (0.17fl oz), which is one of the smallest bottles of gel polish that i've encountered. This is actually a disappointing size/quantity of gel polish. Based on the size of the bottles of gel polish, I consider this to actually be a sampler set, as opposed to a set of 'normal' sized bottles of attractive confetti, glitter gel polishes. So, i guess one can try out the various polishes and then purchase larger bottles of desired varieties.
Overall, I feel all of the polishes in the assortment are visually attractive. The polishes are excellent quality, and produce excellent results. The significant other tested the gel on some fake nails, and i commented that it looks beautiful as is...no need to add any embellishments/decorations. She agreed., but said she'd combinde solid color gel polish with these, and add some rhinestones or other decorations, maybe create a marbled effect. I could see her creative juices flowing.
The product does match the descriptions and pictures in the product details. The presentation is effective and top notch. We like the quality and consistency of the gel polishes and base/top coats. If the bottles were at least the size of the base/top coat bottles, this set would be perfect and worth 5 stars. As currently configured, based on observations and impressions, this quality 'sampler' set earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Exactly as described and pictured. Lovely, stylish headbands.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
These are two stylish, attractive headbands. They have faux pearls attached in a visually appealing, decorative fashion. There is the appropriate amount of spring inherent to the curvature of the headband. The satiny material (most likely a polyester blend material), has a nice look and feel, and is arranged in a braid-like manner. The headband is covered with a velvet fabric. Overall, it's and attractive pair of headbands.
I don't feel they are high enough quality for a formal gathering, but easily appropriate for office and casual affairs. Attached are photos to show real world images, with various angles of the headband. A close-up shows more of the texture of the fabric and the faux pearls.
In general, these are functional and attractive headbands. The receive a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Nice facial steaming product, with handy portable misting device.  Decent performance.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
At a spa, people go into the steamroom to relax muscles, open pores and detoxify. This device isn't a steamroom but aims at providing some of the same benefits to the face and neck, especially regarding the skin and pores. This device heats water up to 104F, creating steam which is expelled from the golden rim outlet. Unfortunately it cannot handle the addition of essential oils, recommending only pure water (or weak alkaline mineral water). This would have been a fantastic ability and function. Oh well. As a pure water streaming device, it is a decent performer.
It does not take long for the water to heat, about 30 seconds, and a fine steam mist is pushed out from the device. The optimum range is 6 - 10 inches away from the steam port. It's a good idea to start at a 12 inch distance, and ease your face closer, gauging your skins tolerance.
(Note: you can add toner that can fully dissolve into the water. The key is not to have a viscous liquid, or particulates, which will adversely affect the atomization.)
We found operation to be fairly simple and easy. Fill the water reservoir, put reservoir back into it's position. turn on the unit, within 30 seconds face gets a spa steam experience.
Is this as effective as those face steamers that have a cone that keeps the steam contained? No, because the steam floats freely. But, it's also multiples cheaper than those kinds of facial steaming devices. This is a credible portable device, that is compact enough that it won't take up much counter space. It's minimalist design will allow it to fit in with most decor.
It's easy to set up and operate. It's acceptably effective.
Also included with this steaming device is a mini misting device, a headband (with pink ears) and 4 skin care tools (intended to help treat acne and blackheads).
The mini misting device does not heat the water you put in it. Rather, via a rechargeable battery, a touch of the button will spray a fine mist. This is very handy in the summer, when you might want a spritz of water to help cool you when outside. It's an apt complement to the facial steaming device.
I found the facial steaming device to be capable of decent performance. If you have realistic expectations, you'll enjoy this product. And, I like the rechargeable portable misting device.
Overall, a worthwhile product set, which earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Different design than conventional bathtub pillow. Not as plush. Good price.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This bathtub pillow doesn't use the conventional tub pillow design. it seems less plush, concentrating on providing a more pronounced gray colored, centered pillow. This grey section is indeed more padded than the surrounding areas of the pillow. The white portion of this product has a very thin layer of cushioning, which makes the gray section seem fuller. But, in fact, it's less plush than my bathrub pillow of the conventional design. And that applies to all aspects regarding the cushioning.
Perhaps this design, with less cushioning allows them to lower the price point. This product is significantly less than the conventional design product. So, if budget is a primary consideration, this might be worth consideration.
While I am not overwhelmed by the plushness (or lack of) nor with the overall design, it does match up to the description and pictures in the product details. Both of us felt that it was not too comfortable, not close to the 'spa' experience.
Based on these observations and impressions, this bathtub pillow earns a 375 - 4 star rating, with a moderate level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Basic nail drill. Plastic body with decent power/speeds. Good price/value.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This nail drill has a plastic body, which contributes to it's light weight. I was actually surprised by how light the drill felt in my hand. Not that other drills, including metal bodied versions, are overly heavy, but this one has to be one of the lightest nail drills that I've handled.
This product does have the usb power cord with a control 'box'. The control box has a switch for off, and forward/reverse and a dial to adjust the speed of the drill. This seems to be the current control system for most nail drills. So, if you've used other recent nail drills, you'll be right at home with this unit.
Ease of operation and handling makes this a desirable nail drill for beginners and more advanced users. In fact, intermediate and advanced users might like this in their resource kits, due to it low weight and competent performance.
The company does warn about overheating. It suggests that operating sessions should be limited to within 20 minutes. Then let it cool down before resuming operation. This should not alarm potential customers. This caveat is often issued by other nail drill products. Common sense will let you know when the handle feels hot. And, in general, don't leave the drill running unnecessarily. If you're going to not use the drill, power it off. This will allow it to cool down, and prolong the life of the motor. Also, if for some reason you need to reverse the direction of the drill rotation, let it full stop and 'rest' for a few seconds, before revving up in the opposite rotation direction. This is true of power drills, too. A sudden change of direction could damage a motor.
While it comes with a usb power cord, a usb power plug is not included. This is disappointing. I do not advise using the drill close to a laptop or computer. You don't want errant dust to have a chance to enter these devices. Instead, use the usb power plugs that are used to charge cell phones. At this point, many people have spare usb plugs of this sort.
Included with this drill are 2 cases with various drill bits, and sanding belts. They are generic, but decent quality.
This product has the feel of a basic nail drill set. It is very reasonably priced for it's market niche. I think they've minimized the extra accessories to contain costs.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the product, with a ruler for size reference. The nail drill has a nice piano black finish.
The nail drill is a competent performer. It's great for packing into a travel kit, due to it's weight and effectiveness.
It earns a solid 4 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Small encapsulated eyeshadow sticks. Very cute, functional. Good value.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
An interesting delivery system for eyeshadow. They look like giant pill capsules, or midget lipstick shapes. Twelve different colors, shades complete this set, each delivering a rich, luxurious shimmering sheen. Each eyeshadow appears to be composed of quality materials/ingredients. The sizes allow them to be easily kept in a handbag or small clutch. In fact, that is the main feature of this product, the size.
In my opinion, these make great liners or to add accent. As a eyeshadow stick/pencil, these serve very well. Thanks to the variety of colors, in popular shades, they should be applicable to most users.
When I saw these, I felt they would be an excellent addition to a gift, swag bag (guest bag or gifts for bridal party). They are visually attractive, with a quality eyeshadow within,
Attached are photos to show real world images of the twelve pieces, with a ruler for size reference.
The significant other saw these and loved the mini format. She examined the colors and said all of them are nice, worthwhile. She dabbed a sample on her arm and used a finger to spread it. She said the consistency and shimmer are excellent. At the current price of $13, she felt it was a good deal: "Not bad, just a bit over a dollar each. it's well worth it." So, clearly, she like the form factor and the quality of the makeup (which I think is the priority).
Based on the initial impressions, the apparent quality of the eye shadow makeup, the cuteness factor and the good value, this product earns a solid 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Attractive and functional.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
Two nicely decorated, attractive hair bands. The silky fabric has a nice feel and sheen, and the pearls are visually appealing decorations. The received hair bands match the pictures in product details. Attached are photos to show real world images of the hair bands.
I would have liked more cushioning for the interior of the band, to make it more luxurious. As is, it is fine, but it feels like only the silk fabric covering the interior hair band structure. The ends are nicely attended with thoughtful closure design.
Overall, very nicely designed, with much eye catching details. Plus, like the choice of colors.
This pair of hair bands earns a solid 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Very nice design, materials. Some issues with the roller surface.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
There is much to like about this product offering. You get two boxes, and each has two of the rollers. So, you receive 4 of the massage rollers. In this fashion, you could give one set away as a present, and keep a pair for yourself. Anyway, getting four massage rollers is a nice feature.
The handle is ergonomically shaped, and has a sleek appearance. The composite material is lightweight but feels very sturdy, durable. The roller is composed of the same composite material and sheathed in a thin metal veneer. Overall, it's a visually attractive massage tool. Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
Examination of the product found that 3 of the four rollers has noticeable defects on the metal covering the rollers. The fourth had some very minor pittings/spots. These are unfortunate blemishes on an otherwise credible and stylish massage roller.
Despite these defects (see attached photos, for three instances of the said defects), the massage rollers do perform as described in the product details. If the stainless' steel did not exhibit the physical issues (note that these were not surface dirt/smudges, but engrained scuff and pitting) did not have obvious defects, this might be close to a 5 star rated product.
Again, it's a nicely designed product, and most of the massage roller is composed of quality composite material. Based on observations and considerations, this product set earns a 3.5 - 3.75 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Premium presentation. Premium quality. Premium appearance. Almost perfect.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
The presentation elevates this product's value as a gifting option. It conveys a premium sense, that carries over to the three piece massage tools. The rose quartz are well matched amongst the three pieces, exhibiting a harmonious grouping. The massage implements are composed of quality materials and manufacture. The rose quartz in my group was a pale pink, which has a delicate appearance.
The gua sha follows the traditional design, and is very competently manufactured. There are no nicks, scratches or defects in the surface or edges. The edges, the usual location of defects, are clean and smooth.
The two headed roller, has an interesting roller that i haven't seen before. Besides the usual smooth roller, the complement (which is usually a smaller version roller) is about the same width, but slightly thinner, with 'ribs' along the roller. I wasn't certain how it's feel/work. Surprisingly, it's a very effective design. It gives the roller more traction and with some pressure, the grooves tend to keep the roller in a straight tract. it's an excellent complement to the smooth roller on the other end of the device.
The third massage implement has a segmented handle, with the smaller smooth roller on the end. The handle is the novel addition to this tool. It has a pointed end, which enhances an acupressure approach. This is a smart addition to the set.
As a massage resource, this is a very attractive and credible toolset. The rollers have the siliconee (maybe plastic) grommet in the roller openings, where the metal arms intersect the rose quartz. This acts as a 'bearing' of sorts, protecting the rose quartz roller and the metla retaining arm. This grommet is missing on cheaper massage rollers. The grommet affords a smoother operation, and protects the roller and metal arm, thus prolonging the life of the massage roller device.
A nice drawstring bag with pocket is also included for storage and travel purposes.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the product, with close ups of pertinent aspects and features.
Careful examination of the components of this set found them to almost free of defect. The only issue was with the double roller massage tool On one metal arm, there was a rough spot, apparently a manufacturing defect. it was not a significant flaw, but i detected it by brushing my finger over the metal arm )see photo, a closeup of the metal arm shows the grommet and this slight flaw). I detected no other flaws or defects in any of the pieces. If not for the one rough spot, this would be a 5+ star product.
Based on observations and impressions, and factoring in the slight flaw, this product earns a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Very cute, small heart shaped glass cups with lids. Versatiale uses.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
These adorable heart shaped glass cups, with accompanying lids is exactly as shown in the product details pictures. While they are intended for damping or mixing polishes, powders for nail polish/art, they can be used for any other purpose where a small vessel is warranted.
For example, write a tiny love note, and place a tiny rose bud inside. Hide it under the pillow, or leave it on the pillow, find a cute way to present it to a loved one. I'm sure it will be heartfully welcomed.
The bottom has a felt like paper glued on. I believe this paper also give the coloration to the interior bottom, which is an interesting visual aspect. Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
One of the heart cup has a slight defect with the felt paper. It was minor, but I noticed it easily. The glass aspects were fine, with no cracks or defects, though.
To be honest, I did not get these for the significant other to use her nail care/projects. Her birthday is coming, and I'll incorporate it into some surprise for her.
Based on the cuteness factor, and the overall quality, but noting the slight defect in the felt paper, this glass set earns a solid 4.5 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Decent manicure/pedicure tools.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
Nice presentation lifts the value as a gifting option. The tools are designed with visual appeal. The wide mouth nail clippers, in black coloration, is a sharp and sturdy tool. The red handled nail 'pliers' is a bit on the smaller side, but is sharp and performs as expected. The spring mechanism is on both handles, to allow the user to choose which side to implement. This comes into play when the spring could interfere/obstruct the grip. This is a standard design for tension springs on similar 'plier' style nail clippers.
The other four stainless steel tools are decent quality, but the 2 nail clippers are the featured items, obviously.
At $18.69, these tools are priced slightly above comparable nail care tools.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the nail care tools, with a ruler for size reference.
Based on initial impressions, this nail care toolset earns a 3.75 - 4 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Excellent quality rose quartz massage roller. White/very pale pink, with hints of pink.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is a typical rose quartz massage roller, but it's crafted with quality rose quartz and excellent manufacture. The presentation lifts it's value as a gifting option. While there is a natural variation of the rose quartz, and there's no way to tell if you'll get the same rose quartz colors that I got, I love the almost white/very pale pink color, with hints and shades of light pink interspersed faintly in the roller. The color is the first thing you notice about massage rollers, and this is an eye catcher.
This product is not perfect, though. The handle seems to be composed of a resin/plastic. It is very light weight. Use of the resin/plastic magnifies the imbalance of the product. The color matches the stone rollers, though. If the handle was also rose quartz, this would be at least a 5 star product.
The rollers have the plastic grommets that are found on properly designed/manufactured massage rollers. It serves to protect the stone and metal arm/axle from rubbing against each other. It also acts like a bearing, enabling a smoother rolling motion. The massage rollers without these grommets i place are sub par products. Thankfully, this feature is mentioned in the product details, and indeed is found on each of the connecting points.
Overall, the massage roller displays quality aspects and is visually impressive. Except for the resin/plastic handle, it's a fantastic product. For me, the balance is an important element. But, when I encounter a beautifully constructed tool, a structural miscue become more pronounced. Still, it's amongst the premium level of this product genre. As such, it merits a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Very nice green coloration. Decent design/construction. Great value/bargain.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is a decently designed and manufactured massage roller and gua sha set. The aventurine/jade stones are nicely color matched, exhibiting attractive green gradations. Of course, each set will differ due to natural variations of the stone. But, the set received is visually similar to the images in the product details.
The massage roller has the plastic grommets where the metal arms/axles enter the stone rollers. These plastic aspects protect the metal and stone from abrasive interaction, which would affect the longevity. These plastic grommets also act as a bearing, allowing for smooth motion/interaction while using/rolling the tool. Having these in place is indicative of competent design and construction.
The gua sha follows the traditional heart shape. It also is of the flatter version. This version is not as thick, and has a flattened characteristic. The edges are rounded, so harsh sharp edges are not present.
The aventurine/jade stones are not highly polished. The surfaces are reasonably smooth, but not with the glass like sheen of high quality rollers and gua sha. Depending on your personal preferences, this more natural stone feel might be considered a desired tactile quality.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference. Inspection of the tools found no defects or flaws. The stones were free of scratches, nicks.
I am very amazed at the current cost of $8. A comparable gua sha, alone, would cost about $8 or $9. A comparable aventurine massage roller could be had for $9 - $12. These comparison prices are the low end of the range for those respective items. So, the price for this set of a massage roller and gua sha is beyond competitive. It's an excellent value/bargain.
Accordingly, this very competent, cost effective set earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Good value, $12 for rose quartz massage roller and gua sha. Attractive, quality stones, design.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
The attractive presentation elevates this as a worthwhile gifting option. The quality of the massage roller and gua sha is evident in the appearance and feel of the stones.
The massage roller has the customary large and smaller stone rollers. Composed of pale pink rose quartz, these rollers are nicely polished with smooth, shiny surfaces. They are impeccable, with no apparent defects, scratches or nicks. They contain the necessary plastic grommets where the metal arms/axles enter the roller ends. (see attache photo of close up of the roller end, showing the plastic grommet, in place) These protect the stones and the metal arms from abrasive interaction that would erode and adversely affect their respective surfaces. It also acts as a bearing, affording smooth rolling action. Also, along with smooth rolling action, these grommets effectively silence the tools when in motion; Without these plastic grommets, squeaking noises would be noticeable.
The rose quartz gua sha follows the conventional heart shape. It has a nice thickness, and mirrors the quality of the rose quartz on the massage roller. It's also well polished, affording a shiny and smooth surface. The edges are rounded, providing a comfortable fit in the hand. Close inspection of the gua sha revealed no defects or flaws, no scratches or nicks.
At $12, this is an excellent value/bargain. For the excellent quality of design, materials and manufacture, this would be a very good value for just the massage roller, with the gua sha being a bonus addition. I would guess that comparable quality sets would sell in the $16 - $22 range.
Based on the quality of design, materials and construction, coupled with the excellent value/bargain, this product offering earns a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Professional character. Smart design. Quality toolset. But, one serious issue/flaw.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is a very credible cuticle care toolset. The handle/shaft can be used with one or two specialty heads inserted. You can customize it according to your specific needs, at the time. And, using a simple hex shape connection gives sufficient grip of the various heads. I believe there's a magnet inside the shaft, to enhance the hold of the head.
Having a central shaft/handle, with access ports on either end is a clever design. Unfortunately, this is great in theory, but I encountered a problem with the opening on one end. Most of the heads would not fit into the cavity. And one that did fit, would seem to get stuck, requiring much force to remove it. Each of the heads should fit into the hex opening on either end. I think it's a manufacturing error, the opening not the exact same size as the 'good' opening.
The assortment of heads is impressive. They are composed of quality stainless steel, with a professional appearance.
If the handle did not exhibit the problem, creating a serious issue with inserting the heads, this would be a 5 star rated product. However, based on an issue which seriously affects the basic functionality of the tool, it receives a 4.0 - 4.25 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Top notch. Excellent quality set. Exellent bargain/value.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
There are two important aspects regarding this product. Price and quality...and both are positive impressions.
In terms of cost, with the current coupon, the $8 cost of this set is not just an excellent value, it's an amazing bargain. That would be a good value for just the rose quartz gua sha, alone. Even if this was a mediocre, average quality massage duo set, $8 would still represent a very good value. And, as the following review will note, the components of this set are more than worth that price.
I consider the gua sha to be the lesser of the two pieces. Still, it is a good quality rose quartz stone, with beautiful coloration. it has ample polishing, affording a shiny and smooth surface. The contour is adequately and evenly rounded with the same smooth surface as the rest of the gua sha. Close examination of the stone finds no defects or cracks, no scratches or nicks. The only concern is the gua sha is a bit thinner than I prefer. Gua sha stones seem to follow two paths: thicker with more of a rounded aspect and thinner/flattened stones that seem to be a slice of rose quartz, that's then polished to smooth out the surface and edges. This gua sha is in the latter category. It's still a valid, credible gua sha.
The highlight piece is the massage roller. This has two sizable roller heads. One is the typical smooth roller, while the other is a segmented/ribbed roller. The smooth roller is nicely polished, while the ribbed roller has more of a natural texture. On a normal dual sided massage roller, there are two different sized smooth rollers. On this tool, the rollers are distinctly different, but approximately the same size. This gives the tool a good balance.
The massage roller has the plastic grommets where the metal arm/axle enters the roller. This serves to protect the rose quartz and the metal arm from abrasive interaction. It also acts a bearing, affording a quiet and smooth rolling action. Furthermore, the plastic grommet is larger and better designed than other quality massage rollers. Another nice design feature is the metal collar/ring on the metal arm/axle at the intersection point. This design aspect is found on premium level massage rollers.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the product offering, with a ruler for size reference. Various angles and close ups are provided.
I am very impressed with the quality of design, materials and manufacture. It clearly met expectations. If the gua sha was the thicker version, this set would rate a 5+ star rating. So, if you prefer the thinner/flattened gua sha then you'll love this set. Based on my personal preferences, and overall positive impression of this set, due to the gua sha, the product receives "only' a 5- star rating. Yes, a 5 minus, just a very slight negative based on the gua sha preference. A very high level recommendation for this product.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Massage roller=good quality. Gua Sha=average quality.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
The quality of the components of the set is not equal. Of the two pieces in this set, the massage roller clearly outshines the gua sha. The massage roller has rich, dark green aventurine/jade stone rollers and center handle. The stones are not highly polished, but there is a natural feel to the jade stones. The metal arms/axles have a metal collar ring where it meets the stone rollers. It may be mostly cosmetic, but it's an attractive visual element. Also, at this juncture is the plastic grommet that better quality massage rollers possess. These grommets act as a bearing for a quiet and smoother rolling action. Perhaps just as important, it serves to protect the stone and metal prong from eroding due to abrasive interaction. The handle seems to be composed of aventurine/jade, too and not plastic/resin material. Very high marks for the massage roller.
The gua sha, with a lighter green hue than the massage roller, follows the thinner, flattened design. It's not very polished, with more of a natural stone feel. While this is subject to personal preference, less polish tends to result in less of a glossy appearance, and a surface that is not as smooth. Perhaps as a consequence of this level of polishing, nicks and rough textures are more readily apparent. Such is the case in the gua sha I received. There's a number of nick, pock marks and small scratches on the stone surface. Due to the thin nature of the gua sha, there is less of a gentle rounding of the edges, too. This results in more of a definite edging on the contour of the gua sha (sort of similar to a coin edge). I like the quality of the aventurine/jade stone, but feels it doesn't match the quality of manufacture exhibited by the massage roller.
The colors of the pieces are not really in sync. Individually, they are nice examples of their respective massage types. The massage roller has a high quality look and feel, the gua sha falls in the average quality realm.
Based on these observations and considerations, this set receives a 4.0 - 4.25 star rating.

AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Wow!!! Interesting, intriguing terahertz stone in gua sha form.

And, in terms of size and portability, she said it's well within reason to carry around. But, for the most part, she thinks most will keep/use this at home. And, take it along with other sundry cosmetics when traveling or for special purposes.
So, the verdict is that this is a significant upgrade for the product genre. It delivers on the statements in the product details, matching the pictures and description in the product details. AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_title: Metal drill handle/body = professional look/feel. Great battery. Easy to use. Good power.
AHPGHDFIU3BUB3RQBP56RQQA7W4Q.review_text:
This is quite an impressive battery powered nail drill. It's a very credible device, with a motor capable of 35000rpm. So, it has the power. Visually, it has an attractive design with a professional/industrial aspect. The metallic body of the drill body exhibits durability and sturdiness.
The top segment of the drill handle twists, with a marker that indicates position respective to the locked/unlocked icons. Obviously, these position are for removing/inserting drill bits. Make sure that after inserting the selected drill bit, the top is twisted and engaged in the locked position.
The battery pack also doubles as the control module for the drill. The silvery knob (plastic) turns on the power and gives access to the variable speed settings. When powered, the display shows the direction of rotation, F/R, and the speed. The button below the display allows the user to change the direction of drill rotation. Under that button, marked Status, toggles the display from direction and speed to the current power status of the battery. (In the attached photo, P91 indicates Power 91%)
The controls are easy to understand, and manage. There's a belt clip on the back of the battery pack/control module. You can opt to have it affixed to a belt or pocket, or place the pack on the table where you can easily make adjustments.
in terms of battery efficiency, it takes 2 - 3 hours to fully charge a depleted battery, while affording up to 20 hours of operating time. Actual time will depend on speed and application load. I would expect actual real time use to realize over 10 hours of operation. The charging:operating time ratio is very impressive.
I've seen/used prosumer level nail drills, very similar to this product. Those units can range in prices over $100. Based on comparative costs, this is priced very well in the market genre. In other words, it's a very good value for the features and quality.
Based on these considerations, this portable nail drill earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

AHPOHKN4PU4W3V5PGFL7AGTAD2AA.review_title: Doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Creamy,  requires very little to use. No actual change to wrinkles.
AHPOHKN4PU4W3V5PGFL7AGTAD2AA.review_text:
I'm not a big believer in all the hocus pocus claims made by every single women's skin care product on the market. They all say they will make your wrinkles or crows feet shrink or smooth out or give your 40 something face a "youthful" glow again. At best, these products moisturize, cleanse, and some provide some protection from sun exposure damage.

This serum from EB5 makes the usual claims, of course, but it's not as outrageously expensive as so many of the other brands. It's a creamy concoction and it takes very little to cover my entire face - the instructions say just use one pump and that is sufficient. There's a faint scent that makes me think of Asian food - I guess that's the sesame seed oil,but the scent fades quickly. It takes about ten minutes to fully absorb into my skin, so I am not using this immediately before going to bed. I haven't had any skin irritation or breaking out in a week. Nor have I noticed any visible difference in the overall condition of my skin and no "plumping" in my laugh lines. My face is soft and it feels just a moisturized as when I use only my regular moisturizer. So....four star rating for no negative reaction and for being a nice enough moisturizer requiring very little product.

AHPOHKN4PU4W3V5PGFL7AGTAD2AA.review_title: Totally painless, needs a battery, but works as it should
AHPOHKN4PU4W3V5PGFL7AGTAD2AA.review_text:
As much as I hate to admit it, getting close to 50 brings lots of unpleasant changes and some great ones. One of the ridiculous things is suddenly discovering random hairs on my face. Tweezing is certainly effective, but takes forever and is tiresome.

This is the first little shaver of this type I've used. It needs a single AA battery that is not included. It's reasonably quiet when running, has a little light and is easy to hold. It is completely painless as advertised - this actually shaves rather than ripping hair out like those epilator things. It works well and I don't really have any complaints.

I have very thick, very long hair and I work with horses and dogs daily. That means I've got a pony tail every day with a scrunchie. This one is a pretty deep green and it holds my thick hair well. The silk doesn't create friction or split ends and that's good. However, you only get one of these for the price and that is just ridiculous. This thing is no different from any other scrunchie out there except for the silk fabric and that still doesn't make it worth fifteen bucks.

AHPOHKN4PU4W3V5PGFL7AGTAD2AA.review_title: Seems to work well, no weird residue left behind
AHPOHKN4PU4W3V5PGFL7AGTAD2AA.review_text:
Between regular, every day germs and now Covid-19, we go through a bunch of sanitizer. It's in the cars, the house, the horse barn and luggage. We tend to use Purell in the giant wall dispensers in the house and barn, but these big bottles are nice too.

The sanitizer smells like what it is. This seems a bit thinner than the Purell, but dries quickly enough. I haven't noticed any sticky residue left behind or excessive drying of our skin. I'm taking one of these with me to West Texas tomorrow for use in the truck and cabin. It fits nicely in my overnight bag pocket.

Good grief.  If you have thick, long hair,  avoid these. The decorative bead things catch my hair and pull. Not cool. There is also less stretch and elasticity in these than with regular scrunchies- with thick hair that means these won't last long. Perhaps if your hair is very fine or very short you can make these work,  but I can't stand them.

I've been using this on my feet rather than my face. It's just too heavy and thick for a face cream. After 4 days, my heels are definitely softer.

It seems to absorb reasonably quickly, but slower than my usual moisturizer and skin cream. I can't detect any perfumes in this and that's definitely good.

I don't really have any use for the gloves included in this set. The curry comb is what I wanted. It works like it should and removes excess hair without pinching. Our donkey seems to really prefer a curry comb to any other type of brush and he likes this one.

This stuff smells. A lot. And it lingers for hours. I actually ended up washing my face all over again to get it off before going to sleep.

The lotion itself is smooth and didn't irritate my skin. It seems to absorb reasonably fast as well. But....that awful smell is a deal breaker for me.
